tei:div.tei:p: ༷ bye ༷hūṃ rgirdoṭ+wāṃ: hūṃ/ //rgi byeX/hūṃ /ṭ+wāṃ~X 5 51 dī ཿ dro7shāshā shā 2༷༵ chi 30 mi3sdulta 7
bsha//gub bababastan pa'i sgron me'igasung 'bum/tagung thang bstan pa'i sgon mes brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

༅tsoza za/0 /ma tsho bawagor+sām zo9ཿlocho mayokho zo shādiza za༅maloṣ+ṭha 2khru5 121༅ma 7—105—07450—71 ma spo 1 khya mjo mamagozo maza— thom 2946 6—53rgazalo gopo0 mtshoṣ+ṭharo(2khru5)zo153676bhezalomaloṣ+ṭhamalotshobo( 3zoyotsho za thumo14byu za1ཿ13)65977447 4474shādizazamagrotho/ngabami/skomamalnga lothamamatsha ro zaza1 2ཿro5tha 3 cho mthamaza 8mtshalo ma1144 1 2 gru 17 1bgrum khya1—2khyalo zayi35 gzam mtshograzaloshā kyazlazlo༅mabo jatsho

dbe skrun gsal bshad/de yang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'am mtshan yongs gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me dbang phyug sder 'bod pa'i dam pa de nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta lo ste spyi lo 1762lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge'i smad kyi yul du yab the bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khong dgung lo bdun par phebs dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge'i sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/ rim gyis rgya dang sog po'i skad yig sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas 'bras srungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang / mdzod/ 'dul ba/ tshad ma/ phar phyin bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rgyal ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/ dgung lo nyer gnyis par dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/ dbus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs 1

med du gyur cing / dbus gtsang gi mkhas mang dkyil na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyis gtsug tu bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/ dgung lo nyer lnga bar yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ dgung lo sum cu bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyel gyi khri chen du 'khod pas gdan rabs nyer gcig pa yin/ de nas bzung yul mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba'i yo lang kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo lug lo ste spyi lo 1823lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas chen mang du byung ngo / /khong gi gsung rtsom ni phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sdom/sgra dang snyan ngag sman dang rtsis/ lha ris thig tshad sogs sgyu rtsal skor gyi bstan bcos rnams gcig tu bsdus te po ti bcu gcig byas nas shing par du brkos yod pa de dag kun kyang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i legs bshad sha stag yin pas nged cag dpe skrun khang gis bla brang gi shing par gzhir bzung nas dpar du btab pa'i dge ba 'di yis thams cad bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig /mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /2

༄/ /dkar chagadakar chagabade gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ / (1)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don gyi rim par bsgrigs pa bzhugs so/ / (28)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs shin tu bsdus /pa/ thab((1pa //sa/ /rdo/ (51)grub chen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs bde ba can gyi myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (59)'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgo nas ril sgrub byed tshul phan bde'i mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (67)'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gi cho ga dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (77)'phags mchog thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa thar ba'i grong du 'jug pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba ཿpa/((1tha /2 / /rdos (111)'phags mchog thugs rje'i chen po la brten pa'i char 'bebs bya tshul /ba/((1ཿsa//sa /sa/ (149)smyung gnas kyi cho ga'i zur rgyan bde ba can gyi lam yig ces bya ba ཿpa/(//tha //sa/ /rdos (1(14))snang gnas dang 'brel bar stong mchod 'bul tshul gyi cho ga phan bde'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (1༅)1

༄/ /yo cabalor+yā ཿ gsung 4ma'aphags mchog thugs rje chen po la brten pa'i mig gzungs nyams su len tshul byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(197)kun rig gi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa kun phan 'khyer bde nor bu'i rna ——5 /sde 2ta shā rdo /ste/ste// / (2()())rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa mchog thun dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (206)mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa thar ba'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (245)'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lha du ma'i sgrub thabs kyi skor mchog thun dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /(331)kun mkhyen bla mas mdzad pa'i rdor phreng gi dbang gi kha skong kṛ ya'i phyag len dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / (433)ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal ston gyi bshad pa chos dung dkar po'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (la3)rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs kyi phyag len mtha' dag gsal bar bshad pa legs byas sprin gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(471)rab gnas kyi lo rgyus gtso bor gyur pa'i bshad pa bzhugs so/ / (498)bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi rnam bshad bkra shis dga' ston zhes bya ba ཿpa/(//ཿsa/pe / /rdos (5()8))rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi cho ga'i zur 'debs bdud rtsi'i zil mngar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (5(44)2

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigasagasum gyitsho gamador bsdus/༄༅/ / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i bdag / mi bskyod mgon po bla ma yi/ / zhabs la btud nas de mnyes pa/ / sgrub byed cho ga'i snying po bri/ /skyabasasemasasngon du btang / rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum brjod de nang mchod dang mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab/ rang mi bskyod rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru maṇ+ḍal le bh+ya zhesaphyag bya/ oṃ sadru ta thā ga ta arnya/ pā / pukhye/ jub/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/ ne+e khrirgya/ shalta bra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / / tshogs zhing rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ oṃ subhā wa shudha sazi dharma subhā wa shurnyo ྅rta/stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma'i ste bar ā las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ ser po las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas skor du mgyogs par 'khor ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ lte ba'i nang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid rdo rje 'chang dang yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gnyi ga'ang sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/1

༄ / /gung thangabastanaba'i sgronatsa' gsung 'phagayab yum gnyi ga'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can du gyur pa'i gnas gsum du rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa/ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa la khro bo bcus bskor ba spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhu ba'i thig le bcu gcig hūṃ ring po bcu gcig tu gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa dang khro bo bcur gyur pa'i mi bskyod pa nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs gar drangs/ badz+ra dh+rika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / phyogs bcur 'phros/ chos 'khor bskor ba la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par du'ang sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ mi bskyod pa ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas rang la rjes su zhugs pas sngar gye zla ba nyi gdan du gyur pa'i steng du rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje/rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mor gyur ba dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa sems dpa' gsum gye bdag nyid can dugyur/ khro bo bcu rang gi thugs gar drangs/ ya mān+ta krita/ praston+ta krita/༵ṭ+wāṃ /kre ༷kra/ brdodz+rīn+tasaXta rā/ ༷ thu/༷/ ka /༷ ṭ+wāṃX /phyuX la ༵/sa/ maXdī ṭ+wāṃ /rtsibs kyi nang dang steng gi pad nyi'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyes 'khod/ bdag nyid kyis bltas pas bkug pa'i gnod mdzes gnyis pa mdun du bka' nod pa la/ oṃ susta ni susta hūṃ/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ grozlo pa mgroṇ+ḍa pa ya:/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bibyu rā 2

༄/ /bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyichogamador bsdus/dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas gnod mdzes kyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje de rdo rje lcags kyur gyur nas bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung / mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te bkug nas khro bo bcu la gtad pas phyi rol tu hūṃ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa 'brub khung gi rnam pa can rnams su bcug par gyur/ byang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil bas sprul pa'i bdudabyu 'khyil ba gnyis pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ stod khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba lte ba man chad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can gyi phur bu me dpung rab tu 'bar ba bcur gyur te phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i mgo bor zug par gyur/ oṃ gha gha spu ta ya/ sadra dukhye phaṭa phaṭa/ kyi la ya kyi la ya sadru pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kyi la ya/ badz+re dha ro ādzā pa ya ti saze bigyu na bā yawā ltit+ta bā ya wā gyit+ta badz+ra kyi la ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag mtshanardo rje lcags kyu de rdo rje tho ba me 'bar par gyur pas phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og gi phur bu rnams kyi spyi bo nas brdungs/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gye bar phur bus btab pas lus ngag yid gsum g.yo 'gul med par gyur/ sprul pa'i gnod mdzes 'og gi gnod mdzes la thim/slar yang khro bo dang phur bu rnams rdo rje'i me 'od rab tu 'bar ba phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'khor gyi bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshig pas bros par gyur/ ṭakre hūṃ dza0 khro bo rnams kyi phyi rol tu lcags kyi rdo rje'i ra ba/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dza de'i phyi rol tu chu'i ra ba/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dza de'i phyi rol tu me'i ra ba/ṭak+ki hūṃ dza de'i phyi rol tu rlung gi ra ba/ hūṃ las lcags kyi ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i gur mchod rten lta bu/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla bre/ 'og gzhi hūṃ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams thams cad du mda'i dra ba ye shes kye me rab tu 'bar ba 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la ā dmar po/ snying gar nyi ma 3

༄/ /gung thangabastanapa'i sgronace' gas 'gyam/la hūṃ sngon po/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum brjod/ khro bcu'i srung 'khor ma byas kyang chad skyon med la/ 'on kyang grub na gal che'o/ / de nas/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ / bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ / de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ / bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ / sgod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad don dam par ngo bo nyid med pas rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhir ba gur bla bre me ri dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum pa gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūṃ gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i yirna paṃ li las 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs yab yum bzhi'i rang bzhin du gyur/de bzhi gcig tu 'dres te sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa'i lte ba'i steng du hūṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngoba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rgyan rta bab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi phyed kye tshad du rdo rje rtse gsum pas rlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gcig thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du lhag par mos pa tsam gyis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis dus gcig tu rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sngon po sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor tshugs can/mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/yum reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin 4

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigasagasum gyi gamador bsdus/chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa/ shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zur gyis blta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyuragyis mdzes pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod yon lnga'i dga' bas rol pa/ yab yum gnyi ga'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud pa/rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku stod lha rdzas kyi gos kyis ga shal byas shing / sku smad lha rdzas kyi dar gyi sham thabs 'phyar ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus na yab sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dkar nagadamar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar bo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dar pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin cing / g.yas kye dang pos thugs gar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang gu mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo/ lho nub tu mā ma ki sngon mo/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo/byang shar du sgol ma ljang gu/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma ser mo/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo/byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang gu shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon du byams pa dang sa snying dkar po/ lho sgo'i g.yas g.yon du phyag rdor dang nam snying ser po/5

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i ce' g.yo 4ma/nub sgo'i g.yas g.yon du 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dpal dmar po/byang sgo'i g.yas g.yon du sgrib sel dang kun bzang ljang gu/ shar sgor gshin rje'i gshed nag po/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngon po/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can sngon po/byang shar du stobs po che nag po/ stod du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal bo sngon po/ rnam snang nas kun bzang gi bar gye lha thams cad rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/'od dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha mo brgyad ka dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas shing / zur gyis blta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ dar la bab pa'i lang tsho can/ khro bo bcu dbu skra kham ser gyen du badzes pa la sogs pa khro bo'i nyams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ spyan ma nas gnod mdzes kyi bar gyi lha thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i dbu rgyan can du gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkug ste dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas zhugasapa la yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bde ba dang yid bde ba thob ste/ rdo rje sems dpar gyur nas rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dugashegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis rnam snang nas gnod mdzes kyi bar gyi lha rnams spyan drangs te rangagi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su 'khod nas gzugs kyi phung po la sogs pa dang ngo bo dbyer med du gyur ba ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/6

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigs gsum gyicho gamador bsdus/mgrin par 'od dpag med/ lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/ brla'i rtsa bar don yod grub pa/ lte bar spyan ma/ snying gar mā ma ki/ mgrin par gos dkar mo/ spyi gtsug tu sgrol ma/ mig tu sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug snying gar 'jam dpal/ gsang gnas su sgrib pa rnam sel/ tshigs rnams la kun tsabazang po/spyi gtsug tu byams pa/ mig gi sgor gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna ba'i sgor sgra rdo rje ma/sna'isgor dri rdo rje ma/ lce'i sgor ro rdo rje ma/ rdo rje'i sgor reg bya rdo rje ma/lag pa g.yas la gshin rje'i gshed/ lag pa g.yon la gzhan gyis mi thub pa/kha la rta mgrin/ rdo rje la bgegs mthar byed/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar mi g.yo ba/ dpung pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ bus mo g.yas la dbyug sngon can/ pus mo g.yon la stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi lha rnam snang / spyan ma/ sa'i snying po/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ byams pa/ gshin rje'i gshed/ mi g.yo ba rnams rim gyes 'od gsal du thim/ de nas rin 'byung / mā ma ki phyag rdor/ sgra rdo rje ma/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/'dod pa'i rgyal po rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim/ de nas 'od dpag med/ gos dkar mo/ nam mkha'i snying po/ dri rdo rje ma/ rta mgrin/ dbyug sngon can rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim/ de nas don grub/ sgol ma/'jig rten dbang phyug ro rdo rje ma/ sgrib sel/ reg bya rdo rje ma/ kun bzang / bgegs mthar byed/ stobs bo che rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim/ de nas gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ gnod mdzes rgyal po/ 'jam dpal rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim zhing / gtso bo'ang rim gyis 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ oṃ zu rgya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra sra'i wa āt+pa ko3 haṃ/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūṃ sngon po/ oṃ dkar po/ ā dmar po gsum las byung 7

༄/ /yo cabaloḥ yo ga las/ba'i nyi ma zla ba pad+ma dmar po'i gdan gyi steng du oṃ ā ཿ gsum du gyur/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa oṃ ā : gis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las longs sku rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa yabayum dpag tu med pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i mi bskyod rdo rje 'chang gis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par byas/ sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlabs pas bde ba thob/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i gong bu la rang nyid zhugs pas sprul sku rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ rang gi lus kyi phyogs bzhi ni dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhi/ steng 'og gi lam bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ rlung lnga dag pa'i rtsig pa lnga/ dbang po dang rnam shes lus kyi cha tha dad pa rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi cha so so sor gyur/ spyi gtsug nas skra mtshams kyi bar dang / de nas mgrin pa'i bar/ de nas snying ga'i bar/ de nas lte ba'i bar/ de nas brla'i rtsa ba'i bar rnams rim pa bzhin phung po lnga'i ngo bo oṃ ā : swāhā las rnam snang dkar po/ 'od dpag med dmar po/ mi bskyod pa sngon po/ rin 'byung ser po/ don grub ljang gu rnams mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ lte bar sa khams lam̐ las spyan ma/ snying gar chu khams māṃ mas mā ma ki/ mgrin par me khams paṃ las gos dkar mo/spyi gtsug tu rlung gi khams hūṃ las sgrol ma/ mig dbang zlo las sa snying / rna dbang oṃ las phyag rdor/ sna dbang oṃ las nam snying / lce dbang oṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rjer lus dbang oṃ las sgrib sel/ dbang po de 8

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigs gsum gyichogasadorabasdus/dgagi sgor dza las gzugs rdo rje ma/ hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma/ baṃ las dri rdo rje ma/ ho las ro rdo rje ma/ khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma/ rdo rje ma rnams rang rang gi yab dang phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ snying gar yid dbang hūṃ las 'jam dpal/tshigs rnams saṃ las kun bzang / rtsa rgyus rnams mai las byams pa/ de dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can du gyur/ gnas so sor hūṃ bcu yongs su gyur pa las/ lag pa g.yas la gshin rje'i gshed/lag pa g.yon la ga'an gyes mi thub pa/ kha la rta mgrin/ rdo rje la bgegs mthar byed/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar mi g.yo ba/ dpung pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas la dbyug sngon can/ pus mo g.yon la stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po/ bcu ga'ang khro bo'i nyams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha thams cad kyang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i dbu rgyan can du gyur/ rang gi spyi bo dang lce dang snying ga'i dbus su rim bzhin yi ge gsum las byung ba'i zla ba pad+ma nyi ma'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ ā dmar po/ hūṃ sngon po 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba rnams las spyan ma gos dkar mo mā ma gi'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spros pas/ skad cig gis sku rdo rje rnam snang /gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i lha'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gtso bo rdo rje gsum yum gsum dang sbyor ba'i mdun na bdag nyid gnas par gyur/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ / rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyes brlabs nas su/ / rdo rje thugs gsung skur mdzad gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ spros pa'i yab yum dang spyan drangs pa'ido rje gsum gyi lha'i tshogs snyoms par zhugs te 'od zer dkar dmar nag po'i ngo bor zhu ba ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis rang gi gnas gsum du 9

༄/ /gung ca bstan yosgronama'i gatshi ཿmazhugs te/ ye shes kyi sa thob pas lus thams cad bkang ste tshim nas sku gsung thugs kyi dbang phyug thob par gyur/ oṃ saze ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra subhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ oṃ sazo ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra su'i wa āt+pa ko3rta/ oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ bdag nyid rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje 'chang chen por gyur/ oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta kā ya wālcit+ta badz+ra su'i wa āt+pa ko3rta/ dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs gar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' dmar po rdor dril 'dzin cing yum dang sbyor bas lus thams cad rgyas par byed pa/ de'i thugs gar zla gdan la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ sngon po/ dam tshig sems dpa'i ral pa'i cod pan la rdo rje 'chang dkar po rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang kha spyor gyes sbyor bas byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i rgyun gyis lus thams cad tshim par byed par gyur/ rang gi snying gnas rang rigs kyi rig ma phyung / oṃ thu rgya tā sto na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ rig ma stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las rdo rje khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo mi baspyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa/ zur gyis blta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod yon lnga'i dga' bas rol pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par ā las 'od dpag med/ snying gar hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar swā las rin 'byung /brla'i rtsa bar hā las don grub/ lte bar li las spyan ma/ snying gar māṃ las mā ma ki mgrin par paṃ las gos dkar mo/ spyi gtsug tu ṭ+wāṃ las sgrol ma/ mig tu dza las gzugs rdo rje ma las snying gis 'khyud pa/ rna bar hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma la phyag rdor gyes 'khyud pa/ snar baṃ las dri rdo rje ma la nam snying gis 'khyud 10

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigs gsum gyichogamadorabasdus/pa/ lcer ho las ro rdo rje ma la 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'khyud pa/ bha garakho las reg bya rdo rje ma la sgrib sel gyis 'khyud pa/ lag pa g.yas la hūṃ las ro langs ma/ lag pa g.yon la hūṃ las gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ kha la hūṃ las khro gnyer can ma/ bha gar hūṃ las ral gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar hūṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum rdo rje ma/ dpung pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas la hūṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/pus mo g.yon la hūṃ las sna tshogs las ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ las nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ las sa 'dzin lha mo rnams su gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ba rwa dbus ma'i nor bu la hūṃ yig gis mtshan zhing bu ga yi ge phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bu ga yi ge phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang bar gyur/ rang nyid rin 'byung du gyur/ oṃ sadra ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ hūṃ snyoms par 'jug pa'i las la gnas par byas pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba thob/ rang nyid don grub tu gyur/ phaṭa oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ mtshams 'dir rags phra'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ spro na/ lha rang rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas sngags dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'irlung gis snying ga'i sa bon la 'jug pa'i spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pa can du gyur/ oṃ wa rtu/ oṃ ya badz+ra dzha ka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā spar+sha badz+ra khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā rdza na rdza ka oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā rat+na droka swā hūṃ/ oṃ ā ā ro lam̐ ka wa rtu/ oṃ ya pradzha dzha ༷hā hūṃ/ oṃ shā mo ha ra ti li hūṃ/ oṃ 〉 dreg ra ti rmā hūṃ/ oṃ sko rāg ra ti ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ya badz+rar ti hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā ru ba badz+ra dza :/ oṃ 11

༄ / /gung thang bstanasgo'irna ma'i gsung 'thum/ā shasta badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā gadhe badz+ra baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā ras badz+ra ho ཿ/ oṃ ā mai tri mi hūṃ/ oṃ mā k+ṣi tri gat+ta zlo hūṃ/ oṃ ya badz+ra pā ṇi oṃ:/ oṃ ā kha gar+bha oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā lo ke sha ra oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā maspu shrī hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā sazo ṇi wa ra ṇa bsko bi ni oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ya sa man+ta bha dra saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā ya mān+ta kyi ta hūṃ hūṃ/༵ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ rdo ༷ ༵ta ṭ+wāṃ rtu.oṃ/ ༵ ༷༷ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ rdo hūṃ cha.oṃ/ ༵ ṭ+wāṃX t+t+waṃṇ+ḍa hūṃ kri ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ /ā mahā bā la hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā uji ṣa tsakra wa rti hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā sum+bha rā dza hūṃ hūṃ/yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ / rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ / gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ oṃ sadru ta tha ga ta arnya nas sbar+sha'i bar gyis mchod/ skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ dbang bshad man ngag gi brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā :/ shrī gu h+ya sa ma dza maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sazo burnya bo rnyi satwa ḍā kis saze dharma pā las pa ri wā ra oṃ ā ཿ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba skyes/ bde ba chen po dang de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ rang yab yum sgoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur/ sgrib pa sbyangs nas hūṃ yig tu gyur/ des nam mkha'i khamasagang ba yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa rnams rang gi 'od zer gyis drangs nas rang nyid la dzim par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shudha saze dhasmo go ga shurnyo ྅nya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub gyur cing / / 'gro bas kyang ni de 12

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigs gsum gyichogasador bsdus/thob shog / byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang / / rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gang yin pa/ / byang chub rdo rjes gang gsungs pa/ / spyod de gnyis ga'ang bdag spyod shog / ces bsngo bas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / mdo rgyud kun gye snying po'i bcud/ / dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam bzang mthus/ / mkha' mnyam lus can mgon gyur pa'i/ / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku thob shog / ces gsang ba 'dusapa'i mngon rtog4mdor bsduyopa 'di ni/ dben sabaka' 'bum dang paṇa chenagasung gis mngon rtogayobasdus pa/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung sogs ci rigasalas btus te bsgrigs pa yin no/ /dngos kun lhan skyes bde ba cher/ / sdom mdzad bla ma he ru gar/ /btud nas de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs/ / man ngag yang snying mdo tsam bri/ /rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs bar gyur/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ subhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du skad cig gis thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba oṃ ā : gis mtshan par gyur/ ha ho hrī sa kha dog dri ro nus pa'i skyon bcom zhing / de rnams zhu bas bdud rtsir gyur/oṃ ā :/ lan gsum gyis nang mchod byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis thod pa'i nang du rtulas byung pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ a ā ka/ e 2hūṃ ā :/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ zu pe/ dī sba/ gaste/ ne+e bdu/ shasta ya 4/ de nas/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sems can kun gye don gyi phyir/ / bdag ni he ru gar gyur cig / rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du skad cig gis bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog 13

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i ཿga ཿma/dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'i yab yum gnyis ga'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ/thugasaka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ lus gang / bde ba skyes/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus gang zhing sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur/ te ru ga'i yig brgya bzlas la/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje semasadapa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ shrī hi ru ga te ni chos kyi bdag med pa/ ru ni gang zag gi bdag dang bral ba/ ka ni de kho na nyid kyi yul yul can mi mthun par mi gnas pa/ shrī stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i ye shes ye baṃ gyi don bzhin rang dang snang ba thams cad stong par gsal ba'i ngang las skad cig gis te ru ka yab yum gyi skur gyur/ shrī te ru ko3nya/ lan gsum/ oṃ a ā/ yi lte/ u yu/ ṛ dī/ le lī/ e i/ o mo/yi a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nyi/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rta ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣa rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum mam/ bsdu na/oṃ 〉 rtu/ gisachog rang gi lte ba'i phyogs su sngags 'phreng g.yon skor du gnas pa las lha lnga'i tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ slar byon nas rang la thim par gyur/ rang he ru gar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i pad zla'i steng gi ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi hūṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ oṃ gu ru tsakra sasba ra sadru ḍā kyi dī bh+ya zhes phyag bya/14

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigasagasum gyichogamador bsdus/oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta.acha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ā ྅/ gis nang mchod 'bul/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde stong gi ye shes gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / / tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sadra dharma subhā war shurnyo3nya/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3rta/ de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i stong pa'i ngang las rang gis sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du 'greng ba shin tu phra ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ stong pa'ingang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ me ri dang bcas ba'i dbus su 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su mtshan dpe'i ngo bo dbyangs so gnyis dang gsal byed brgyad cu las dbyangs gsal gyi gzugs brlan dang ldan pa'i zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can me long dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang nam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can mthong ba na bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar gyi dbus su skye ba blangs la sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas/ zla ba'i dbus su nā da zhugs pa las rim bzhin hūṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus nā da la thim zhing hūṃ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur ba ni bya sgrub ye shes so/ / oṃ ā0rtu/ oṃ saze dī ra yo gī nī kā ya wā gyit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ oṃ badz+ra shudha saspru dhasmo badz+ra shurnyo3 haṃ/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūṃ dang bcas yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams 15

ro༅/ /gung thang bstanapa' sgronace' gsung 'bum/cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ de yang gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab bzhi dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongasasu rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi gdana'i rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing ga zhal bzhi pa'i rtsa zhal nag g.yon zhal ljang / rgyab zhal dmar/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ zhal re re'ang spyan gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dpral par rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo mnan cing / g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdor dril 'dzin pas rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa sdegs mdzub dang bcas pas brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pa'i phyag gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing / dbu'i g.yon du cung zad yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'chang pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa/ mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa'i thod pa na bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ g.yas pas phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can kun la gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub 16

༄/ /bde gsang 'jigasagasum gyi chogamador bsdus/kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ spyan dmar zhing me ltar 'bar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla'i steng du legs par 'khril ba/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i thod dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang duwa ma ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/thams cad kyang 'al gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ mtshams su bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i steng du ka pā la byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba re re/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po byā las nor bu dmar po rtse mor byā ser bos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas ā las pad+ma dmar po byu las ze'u 'bru dkar po rtse mor byu ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang thugs ka dang / yum gyi mgrin pa dang spyi bor zla gdan la yum gyi snying po dang nye snying / yum gyi lte ba dang thugs ka/yab kyi mgrin pa dang spyi bor nyi gdan la yab kyi snying po dang nye snying rnams kha dog dmar po phan tshun zhal spyor zhing 'od zer 'khyud pa'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ ā ཿ/ snyoms par zhugs pas dka' bzhi rim bzhin drangs/ lhan skyes kyi bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo lha lnga'i rnam par shar ba nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla gdan la rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swāhā hū dmar po/phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la dpal he ru ga'i ngo bo po ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser/ dpral par nyi ma la yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ 17

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sa'i gatshi 'a4/ljang gu/ gtso mo'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ bsngon po/ mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo bhā mo dkar po/ mgo bor nyi ma la skyong byed ma'i ngo bo hrī hrī ser po/spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ljang gu/ dpral par nyi ma la yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin tsaṇ+ḍi ga'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud khas mtshan par gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar bo/ mgrin par pad+ma la ā dmar po/ thugs gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ phe thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi saphyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ arnya pratī ts+tsha 〉 rtu/ dza ྅ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shurnye sarba dhasma yo ga shurnyo3rta/ oṃ a r+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha ā ka/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas gtso bo la rdor sems/ phag mo la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan cing / dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngaraba'in byas pa/ oṃ sadra ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nasashasta'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra wi ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ brtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ tai ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hā sru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā be+e hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī tī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ t+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ju pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa dzā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa brjo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ spa ra badzā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhasmra dha tu bsgyu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ de nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje dril bu ba/18

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigs gsum gyichogamadorabasdus/rus sbal zhabs/ dzalarnya ra ba/ nag po spyod pa/ u h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/te lo pa/ nā ro ba la sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā hūṃ/bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ gzhan yang chos skyong srung ma la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā :/rangagi rtse la bdud rtsi bzhag la/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā :/ mgron thams cad bdud rtsis tshim par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi dang khyad par lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen pos rang dang lha thams cad kyis bde ba chen po nyams su myong zhing / bde ba dang stong pa nyid ro gcig tu gyur ba'i de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas dgyes par gyur/ de nasayab yum gyi snying po nye snying gnyis gnyisadang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngagasabajod pasasngags mchod bya/ shesashing spro na/oṃ bcom ldan dpa' po'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam ba'i 'od hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ral pa'i cod pan mi bzad pa dang ldan hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mche ba rnam pa gtsigs pa 'jigs pa'i zhal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ stong phrag phyag ni 'bar ba'i 'od zer can hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dgra sta zhagasagadengs mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa can hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sku chen dung kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ 'phags ma rig ma'i dbang phyug khams gsum gyis mi thub hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ 'byung po'i 'jigs pa thams cad rdo rje chen pos 'joms hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdo rje gdan bzhugs gzhan gyis mi thub dbang byed can hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gtum mokhro mo'i gzugs kyis tshangs pa skems pa dang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bdud rnams skrag cing skems pas gzhan gye phyogs las rgyal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rmugs byed rengasakhyed rmongs byed kun las rnam par rgyal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdo rje phag mo spyor chen 'dod dbang ma la 'dud hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bsngags kyi nang brgyad kyis 19

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'i 0sa khrung sde /kyang bstod/ bsdu na/ te ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ / rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / / rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ / rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing / / 'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ / dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ / kun la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pasabastod/ phreng ba mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ yab yum gyi thugs gar nyi gdan la hūṃ dang baṃ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba'i dbus kyi yi ge las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas dbus kyi yi ge la thim par gyur par bsamayol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he te ru ru ki hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la shaṃ wa ri swā hā/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sazo burnya ḍā kinī ye badz+ra wa zlo nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sku gsal bar dmigasal/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṭī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa bya/ spro na yab yum gyi 'phreng sngag4dang go cha'i sngags gnyis kyang bzla/ he ru ga'i brgya bzlas la/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gzhal yas khang rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pa rim gyes bsdus te gtso bo yab yum la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las dpal 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ / 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ / rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ / he ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / / de brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ / bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ / bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / bdag ni te ru gar gyur nas/ / sems can thams cad 20

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigasagasum gyicho gamadorabasdus/te ru ga'i/ / go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi/ / zhes dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngo bsargyas gdab par bya'o/ / bye ba bcu drug ma rgyud kyi/ / snying po 'od gsal lam bzang mthus/ / 'gro kun sgrib gnyis 'ching ba las/ /rnam grol chos sku thob gyur cig / cesa'akhor lo bde mchog gi mngon rtogs mdor bsdus pa 'di ni rgyal ba dben sa pa chen po dang paṇa chen blo bzang cho4rgyal gyi gsung la gzhi byas ngag 'don go bde ba'i phyogs gtso bor bzung zhing tshig spyor cung zad bsnan te bsgrigs pa yin no/ /rgyal kun ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje'i gshed/ / bla ma rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la/ / btud nas sgrub thabs snying po bri/ / rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ hrī khyi wi kre tān na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wang shurnye sabra dhasmo subhā wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa so so'inang du mchod pa khyad par gsum ldan dang gtor ma nang mchod zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ar+bhe ā ྅/ oṃ pā byeshis hūṃ/ oṃ gadhe ā :/ oṃ pukhye ā ka/ oṃ dru pe ā :/ oṃ ā lo ke ā ḍū/ oṃ dze+e wi r+ya 〉 rtu/ oṃ shasta be+e ḍū/ oṃ yā :/ lan gsum gyis mchod gtor nang mchod rnams byin gyisabarlab/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru maṇ+ḍa le bh+ya oṃ hrī khyi ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ wi kri tā na na duṣā satwa da ma ka ga ga ku mā ra rū pi ṇi dza dza : phaṭa/ oṃ hrī ha ) phaṭa/ oṃ dī sta lo tsāne wi kri tā na na mahā aspyo ṣ+ṭa ha sa na dī ni dīsta ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e wi r+ya ā rtu su hā/ oṃ badz+ra shasta ā ྅/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mche/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi 21

༄/ /gung ca bstan ba'iskyonasa' ga 'chagarang / / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde pa'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gye rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cigasems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang stoms la gnas par gyur cig su bhā wa shudha sabra dhasmra su bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ oṃ shu t+yā tadz+nya na badz+ra sa bhā wa ā t+ma ko3rta/ rang dang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa ga'i/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ me ri dang bcas pa'i srung pa'i 'khor lo dang / de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa yongs su dzogs pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum pa'i nang du hūṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma/ de'i dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyel 'khor/ de'i steng du dhī las ral gridhī sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad spyan drangs te 'jam dpal dang bcas pa nyi ma la zhugs/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis 'dzig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gyur/ nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad spyan drangs/ hūṃ la zhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po rtse dgu par shin tu dngas pa/ 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa lte ba la hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las rdo rje'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer de dag gi sne las rgyal ba sras bcas grangs med spros te sems can thams cad la dbang bskur nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 22

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigasag4 gyichogasador bsdus/'phang la bkod/ thams cad tshur 'dus te rdo rje la thim par gyur/ zla ba nyi ma rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ khams gsum po za bar nus pa/ ljags 'dri pa zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang dzi ma dang sma ra dang ba spu rnams dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing / dbu skra khams ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ma te'i gdong can/ de'i steng du khro zhal dmar po/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yas kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ de'i g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ser po/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yon gyi zhal dang po dkar po/de'i g.yas zhal dud kha/ g.yon zhal nag po/ zhal rnams shin tu khros pa/zhal dgu po thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa mgo g.yas dang spu phyir bstan te lag pa dang rkang pa g.yon pa nas brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas kyi phyag bcu drug gis bdeg cing 'joms pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa dang / g.yon bcu drug gis rol cing stob pa'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas pa brgyad bskums shing g.yon pa brgyad brkyangs te srog chags sna tshogs pa dang tshangs pa dang dbang po la sogs pa kha spub tu mnan nas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin cing g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum gyis yab la 'khril ba/ dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs gar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i thugs gar ā las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 23

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'thum/gyi dbus su ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/rang gi mig gnyis su k+ṣi/ rna bar dzi/ snar khaṃ/ lcer re/ dpral par ke/lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā / thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/tha rtu paṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ya mā nā ka ashā pratī ts+tsha ཿswahā nas shaltapratī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ oṃ yamān+ta ka oṃ 〉 rtu/zhes nang mchod dbul/ gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ / dpa' bo mchog gi spyod yul can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'jigasabyed la phyag 'tshal/ / zhes pasabastod/ rang gi thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/'gro ba'i don byas/ rgyal ba rnams mchod/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhī ma ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya ge ya/ya khre yats+tsha ni rā ma ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrī khyi wi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bait+ta lī ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūṃ dza swā hā/ zhes bzlas la yig brgya4lhag chad bskang / 'jam dbyangayodakar po dbyangs can ma dkar po gnyis dang sbrags sgrub byed par 'dod na/ rje btsun ye shesargyal mtshan gyisagong du ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dkar skyed pa dang / gong du 'jam dbyangasadamar sir bskyed nas bzlas pa'i mgor 'jam dkar du sgyur tshul gnyis gsungs pasagang byas kyang rung la/ skyed tshul ni/ yab kyi thugs gar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam 24

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigasagasum gyichogamador bsdus/dpal dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon chos ston gyi phyag rgya gnyi gas yut+pal re bsnams pa'i steng du shes rab kyi ral gri dang sher phyin gyi glegs bam gyis mtshan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas klubs shing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum gyi thugs gar dbyangs can ma dkar mo nor bu chu shel ltar dngas shing 'tsher ba/ ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa'i rtse mor zla bas mtshan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i bi waṃ bsgreng zhing tsog pu'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsamasal/ bzlasapa'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs gar ral gri'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a yig dang / rtsibs drug la oṃ wā kye de na ma zhes pa'i yi ge drug dang / dbyangs can ma'i thugs gar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar bhā yig dang / rtsibs rnams la dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis gnyis kyis mtshan par bsamasanasa'ajam dkar gyi sngags bzlayopa'i mthar 'jigs byed kyi sngagayogasum dang ro langs ma'i bsngags kyi gong du dbyang4can ma'i sngags bzla/ yang na 'jam dbyangasayab yum gyi sngags sngon dang / 'jigs byed yab yum gyi sngags rjesasu bzlas kyang chog la/ bsnyen pa dngos gzhi byed na 'jam dbyangasakyi bsnyen grangs phal cher rdzogs nayodabyangayocan ma'i grangs bsnyen bsags na legs par gsungs so/ /bzlas pa'i mthar gre phugasasu mayig cig bsams nas dbugayothengasagacig la yobargya rtsa bzla zhing / mthar de nyid khong bar song bas shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i dmigasapa skyong tshul dang mi brjed pa'i gzungasaskrub tshul sogs gzhan las shes par bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ yi ya mān+ta ka i de ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā nyi/gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ ma mān ka a sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ yamān+ta ka oṃ 〉 rtu/ gisanang mchod dbul/ gzugs mchog mchog tu zheyo25

༄/ /gung ca bayoba'isgronasa'i ga 44/sogasakyi4bstod/ oṃ badz+ra mu gtor mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ rnam dag bsam pas tshul 'dir 'bad pa las/ /byung ba'i dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams/ / skye zhing skye bar 'jam dbyangs zhi khro yis/ /'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /mdor na deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ /rim gnyis lam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ /sku gsum go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang la thim/gzhal yas khang rang la thim/ rang ye shes sems dpa' la/ ye shes sems dpa' hūṃ yig la zem/ de'ang mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ltar gyur te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigasabyed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ bsngo ba smon lam ci rig4bya/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kye bkra shis shog /ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod par bya'o/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po yis/ /ded dpon mdzad pa'i mthu byin las/ /rim gnyis rgya mtsho'i mjing brgal te/ / zung 'jug nor bu'i gling son shog / ces dpal rdo rje 'jig4byed kyi mngon rtogs mdor bsdus pa 'di ni/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po rnamasakyi gsung du ma layobatus te bkod pa yin no/ /de'ang gsang bde 'jigasagasum gyi mngonanog4rje bla ma'i gsung rnams ni tshig 'bru re re la'ang rgyud dang grub chen gyi dgongasapa go tshul/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed 'bras bu dang bca4pa'i gnad khyad par ba re med pa mi srid pasabasdu bar mi phod pa ltabu yin kyang / da lta'i skye bo blo dang brtson pa 26

༄/ /bdegasang 'jigasagasum gyi gamadorabasdus/zhan pa rnams la bsdus pa re med na sgyid lugs te bag chags cung zad kyang 'jog mi thub pas/ de 'dra'i rigs la phan pa'i don du gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa de dgos zhes ucu mu chin shog nasalhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bsam gtan gyisanan tan chen pos yang nas yang du bskul pa'ingo ma bzlog cing / dam pa gong ma mang pos kyang de 'dra mdzad 'dug pas dgos dbang gis mi rung ba med dam snyam ste bsdu tshul yang bla ma gong ma re re'i gsung gi tshog ris re sor bzhag pa'i steng nas snga phyi sdeb tshul gyi mtshamasaspyor tsam bcug ste/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bsgrigasapa 'di'ang 'gro ba rnams ltamachog khyad par can gsum gyis rje4su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / sarba marga le/ /27

༄/ /gung ca bstan ཿsgronama'i ga 'thug༄tsho/ / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don gyi rim par bsgrigs pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru badz+ra dhi ra wā ya/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don gye rim par bsgrigs pa ni/ skad cig dkrong bskyed/ rdo dril byin rlabs/ nang mchod byin rlabs nas tshogs zhing gi bar sgrubs thabs ltar la/ bum pa hrī khyi sabasangs/ subhā wasasbyangs/bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ paṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ tā ste 〉ste mahā 1ste swā hā/ lan gnyis/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/rnam rgyal bum pa phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas/ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i mtshan ma'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ las bum gye nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ gdan de gnyis kyi steng du hūṃ las 28

༄/ / dpaladorje 'jigasabyedadapa' bo gcigardo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mazing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin paragyur/ de thams cad kyi mig gnyis su khro/ zhesapa nas/ thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ hrī ha sgo ma ku ru swāhā/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ oṃ hrī0khyi wi kris oṃ hrī ha ma murga ra dza mar yang/ zhesapa nas/ gtso bo'i rtsa zhal gyi dbu la mi bskyod pa dang las bum gyi lha'i'ang mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar phyis mchod/ oṃ yamān+ta ka oṃ ā hūṃ/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ / zhesapa nas/ 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka bla hūṃ/ lan bdun/ dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi thugs nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum pa'i nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ rnam bum la gtso bo'i sngags gsum dang / las bum la/ hrī khyi brgya rtsa/bum pa gnyis kyi chu la/ cha badz+ra u da ka hūṃ/ brgya rtsa bzlas nas/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ hrī khyi dang hūṃ/ bdun brjod/ bum pa gnyis su dung chos kyi mchod yon phul/ lasasngags kyis me tog gsum gsum gzhug ya mān+ta ka gadhe nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ hrī khyi brjod nas las bum gyi chu4bum pa bsangs te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba rnams ma rdzogs pa de srid du bgegs rnam par bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bor bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ gzhal yas khang bum pa la thim zhing mtshan ma'i lha gnyis kyang zhunas phyag mtshan gyi rnam par gyur/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbuyosu 'dug 29

༄ / /gung thang bstanapa'azla ma'i gsung 'thugapar mos te/ bris pa'i dkyil 'bor/ trī che sa bsangs/ oṃ su bhā wamo oṃ shu n+ya ta ma rang dang tshogs zhing gi zhes pa na4mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang nyid gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du phye nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol tu mchod pa'i las la gnas par gyur/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa phul tshar ba na/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ gtso bo dang tha mi dad par gyur/bstod pa nas gtor 'bul rdzogs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ rang nyid skad cig gis hūṃ mdzad sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching zhing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du thogs pa med par zhugs par gyur/ yig brgya bzla/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ / sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril/ / jo rtu baṃ ho nyi hi hi hi hi/hūṃ/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ud gha ṭa sa ma ya prabe sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ sa ma ya pra be+e sha ya mi/ oṃ pra na ma mi sarba ta thā ga tai/sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cigamaṇ+ḍal dbul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ / byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum bdag la stsal du gsol/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ oṃ tsagru brnya rā ma na ya hūṃ/ oṃ hrīkhyi ma ju phaṭa/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes pa nas/'grol phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ 'khor lo phyir 30

༄/ /dpalardorje 'jigasabyedadapa' bogacigami ldog pa'i dbang / / dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ / mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi / de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / / sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / / sdom pa gsang mchog rtag tu ni/ / sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ / slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsung du gsol/ / tshar gcigasangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ / zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ / lan gsum/ kyi khyod su yin ci la dga' skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ / sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig bgyed 'tshal lo/ / sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems kun rdzob pa de nyid snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par gyur/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid dang / rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ho sidh+ra badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byen gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyis/ khyod kyis kyang de ba'in gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ / ā ka dī ra hūṃ/mahā ra ta/ su dri ḍā su to kho/ su su kho/ badz+ra satwa ā dhu sidhu ya mi/ shar sgor rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta snu dza u pas thā nāya āt+pa rna ni t+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur pa'i phyir bdag 'bul bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur ba'i nus pa can du byin gyis brlab 31

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i me'i sa 4ma/par gyur/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇa ya snu dza u basbya nā ya āt+pa rna ni sto ta yā mi/ sarba satwa pa ri dra ḍā ya āt+pa rna ni sto ta yā mi/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rnams kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ / oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / / khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ / gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ / de ma thag tu dral tegashegs/ / oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ / dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster/ / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ / khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dusabyas nas dmyal bar nyu nga bar gyur ta re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyes byin gyis brlabs te rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/lan gsum/ oṃ hrī khyi ma su bhā wamo stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor baṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po blum po bum pas mtshan pa la ha0snying gar li las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa ser po zur du rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa la hūṃ/ lte bar re las byung ba'i me'i dkyel 'khor zur gsum pa dmar po rno zhing 'bar 32

༄/ /dpalardo rje 'jigasabyedadapa' bo gcigab la shā rkang pa'i 'og tu yi las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po g.yo ba gzhu'i dbyibs can tha mar ba dan gyis mtshan pa la rnyi drag cing bzod par dka' ba'i gzugs can rlung gis bskyod pas lte ba'i me'i gnas su phyin pa/ slar yang rlung gis bskyod pas snying ga'i sa 'bar bar gyur te/spyi bo'i chu las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs pas tshim par gyur/ oṃ hrī wi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ a be sha ya sto bha ya/ ra ra/ ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/hūṃ ha ā dzhai 4 phaṭa/ tikhyi badz+ra/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma bcug pa 'di'i/ / lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ji ltar de ltar shog / 'di yi dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ / bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra ba/ / de 'dra dkyel 'khor du gyur cig / rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/gtso bo'i mdun na gnas par gyur/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho oṃ pra ti grit+na snyi i mi satwa mahā bā la/ bdag byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rjes su gzung zhig /rang gi snying gar zla ba la hūṃ/ dpral bar ram̐/ mig gnyis la oṃ 'od zer 'bar ba re re/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ / mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ / phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ / rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ / da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ / dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ / phyag rgya sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ / dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs/ / dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ / rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol pas/ / gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyis/ / te badz+ra sh+ya/ de yang phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo me ri dang bcas ba'i nang du gzhal yas khang grubazhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbus su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ de ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i 33

༄/ /gung ca bstanaba'i sa'i ga tshomadakyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyel 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ / oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong / / oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khorachen por bdag dbang bskur/ / sa ma ya ho rig pa'i dbang lnga'i don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ / bdag kyang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / / mchog kyang bdag la stsal tu gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ oṃ hrī khyi ma su bhā wamabadag dang dbang rdzas bum chu stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum mā ma kyi sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnasanas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab yum mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta am+bha/ pā hūṃ/ puṣ+pe/mo sta pra tīsmo hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ / 'gro ba skyabs pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ / de ltar 'di la stsal tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkha'i rgyal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang nyid mi bskyod par byas pa la dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha ladabang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ma shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ snahā/ mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbangangos bum chur gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir 34

༄/ /dpaladorje 'jigasabyedadapa' bo gcigadu bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma dang bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnams rang gi steng phyogs su 'dzin/ glu gar mdzad cing rol mo brdung / me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems bdudañtsas gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyis shis pa brjod/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ / sdang bas zil mnan skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa/ / mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshan gsol de yis ni/ / bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i/ / gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ā badz+ra u da ka a snyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / bde ba chen po pyong / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ jo rtu baṃ ho rang gi ba sru'i sgo nas thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā sā/ de ltar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs/ nam shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang de'i rigs kye dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /trī khyi ma su bhā wam bdag dang dbang rdzas cod pan stong pa nyid du 35

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan ba'izla ce' gas 'a ma/gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tram̐ dang rin po che las rin 'byung ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rin chen sgol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcun bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab yum mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya/ pāhūṃ/ puṣ+pe nas sta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /zhes nas/ de ltar 'di la stsal tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab bas nam mkha'i rgyal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang nyid rin 'byung du byas pa ladabang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas/shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ rin 'byung yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas cod pan du gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis zhesapa nas stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba zheyopa nas/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan/ / phongs pa'i sdug bsngal grol bar yongs su rab brtson zhing / / khengs pa'i zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ / zhes pa nas/ gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ku la mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ dbang bskur rdo rjes sbyin par bya/ oṃ ā sarba ta 36

༄/ /dpalardorje 'jigasabyedadapa' bo gcigathā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bsgur/ zhes pa nas/ spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba yongs su gyur ba las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ horang gi ba spu'i sgo nas thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta am+bha nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas bsgyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / hrī khyi za su bhā war bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrī dang pad+ma las 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhes pa nas stsal tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyisaphyogs bcu na zhesapa nas/ spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas/shasnya pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje can gyis zhes pa nas/ rang nyid 'od dpag med du byas pa la dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ 'od dpag med yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te zhes pa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan/ / 'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i dra ba 37

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'isgronasa'i ga ཿma'ajoms pa po/ /chags pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje zhes pa nas/ sbyin par bya/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi/ / dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ / rdo rje rab tu grub phyir zungs/ / dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ā sarba nas/ shrī ma hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar bdud rtsis zhesapa nas/ gyur pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha/ zhes pa nas/ thim par gyur/ yi sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags kye dri ma sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / trī khyi za su bhāmabadag dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ dang ral gri las don grub ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyes ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu zhesapa nas/oṃ sarba zhes pa nas/ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje can gyis zhes pa nas/ stsal tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba zhes pa nas/ rang nyid don grub tu byas pa la dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ don grub yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes rgyal ba 'khor 38

༄/ / dpaladorje 'jigasabyedadapa' bo gcigabacas zhes pa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ / brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spongs/ / de sbyong thabs ston de ni kun nas bsal mdzad pa/ / bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje zhes pa nas/sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra a ti pa ti ṭ+wāṃ a snyi ṣi ñtsā mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dbang bskur rdo rje sa sbyin par bya/ / oṃ sarba mo ye hūṃ swā bhā/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus zhes pa nas/ gyur pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/bla ma dang gtso bo zhes pa nas/ thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba mo pra tītsu hūṃ swā hā/de ltar don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs/'du byed kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/donayod grub pa dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / trī snyi ma su bhā wa mo rang nyid stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu zhes pa nas/ oṃ sarba ga tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje can zhes pa nas/ stsal tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba zhes pa nas/ rang nyid rnam snang du byas pa la dbang bskur bar gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer khyas rgyal ba zhes pa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ / rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing / / rmongs pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ / bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la 39

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/dbang rab bskur/ /dbang bskur rdo rjeng sbyin par bya/ / oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a rnyi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ / dbang bskur rdo rje'i sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ya sarbang shrī ma 〉 rtu/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus zhes pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo zhelopa nas/ thim par gyur/ oṃ sarbang tī5 hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thog gti mugagi dri ma sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las/ / rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur ba/ / rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / / snying brtse'i gter gye bdag la stsol/ / lan gsum/ hrī khyi ma su bhā wam rang nyid stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang nyid hūṃ dngado rje las rdo rje 'chang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje dbyings kye dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gye gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ma'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu na zhes pa nas/ oṃ sarba ཿ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje can gyis zhes pa nas/ stsal tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba zhe4pa nas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang pa la dbang bskur bar gyur/ hrī khyi nga su bhā waḥ rdo rje stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ khams gsum pa yi ral gri che/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ / las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu/ / bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir 40
