༄/ /dpalardo 'jigasabyedadapa' bo gcigazungs/ / stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i ye shes rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ngo bo ni gsang ba'i rdo rje yin la/ de dran pa'i don du rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje de kho na nyid kyi sgo nas zungs shig / hrī ji ma su bhā wa༅ dril bu stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid/ / rdo rje dril bu rab grub phyir/ / bu yis yang dag gus pas zungs/ / khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ / chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i sgra dril bus sgrog par sems pa'i sgo nas dril bu 'dzin pa dril bu de kho na nyid kyi sgo nas zungs shig / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag / ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ / rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ / srid pa dam pa byed par gyur/ / yid kyi lus ni brtan pa nyid/ / phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ / gang gis lus ni thams cad brtan/ / des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ / rang rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya 'du byas nas 'dod yon la longs spyod pa'i tshul gyis dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya'o/ / bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ba'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ / kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje/ / ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ / bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ / zhes pa nas/ gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ā sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ zhesapa nas/ gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 41

༄/ /gung ca bam ba'i yo ga las/'od zer gyes dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dza nyu baṃ ho rang gi lus kyi ba spu'i sgo nas thim par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+bhe nas/ shalta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ sā hā/ de la sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas ma yin pa gnyis de kho na nyid du mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi pa/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhidag pa ni shar gyi sgo/ yang dag spong bzhi dag pa ni lho'i sgo/ rdzu 'phrul rkangabazhi dag pa ni nub kyi sgo/ dad sogs dbang po lnga dag pa ni byang gi sgo/rdo rje zeg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor ba'i phyir nang gi rdo rje'i zeng ba/rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnam pa dag pa ni dpalado rje 'jigs byed chen po'o/ / bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / gtor ma'i cho ga dang / bsrung ba dang / phyir bzlog pa dang / dkyel 'khor bsgrub pa dang / der slob ma gzhug pa'i mtshan nyid ni slob dpon gyi las su bya ba'i rim pa yin no/ /bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sems dpa' sum brtsegs can du gyur/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ / gcigabacom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi/ / bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ / gsum/ gtso bo'i sngags gsum lan gsum re 'don/ sngags kyi phreng ba bla ma'i thugs ka nas brgyud de zhal nas byung ba rang gi snying gar hūṃ gi mtha' skor du gnas par gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis la yi ge pra re re/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa li hrī ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ / 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ / bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ / rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ / ma rig pa'i ling tog dang bral nas ye shes kyi spyan phye bar gyur/ ā las byung ba'i me long ā / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ / gzung du med cing bajod du med/ / rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / / rdo rje sems dpa' me long 42

༄/ /gung thangabastanaba'izla ma' gas 'thugashig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha ye ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yāmi badz+ra satwa hi nyi hi hi hi hūṃ/ bla ma rgyal po shākya thub pa'i cha lugs can du gyur/ 'dir ni khyod rnams ngas lung bstan/ / rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ / srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ / kye dpalache ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sirnyi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zur byu wa su ma/ gang la phyag rgya 'dis lung bstan pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par mdzad de phyag rgya 'di nyid kyi mthu dang sngags 'di'i stobs yin no/ / 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig / khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral nyid/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma la ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyel 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa yis/ / sdig pa kun las nges par grol/ / de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas/ / bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ / srid pa shin tu grub bya'i phyir/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pas/ / gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ / sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ / byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ / dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung / / nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ / de yang nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ / nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ / slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ / rang gi bdag nyid dor nas ni/ / dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / / ci bde bar ni bde bar bzung / / 'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / de ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ / slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ / sangs rgyas 44

༄/ /dpaladorje 'jigasabyed dpa' bo gcigabyang chub sems dpa' dang / / lha rnams kyang ni mthun par dgongs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ / khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ / rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ / sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis las phyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du slob dpon du bya ba'i ched du chos kyi rgyal srid du dbang bskur bas na slob dpon gyi dbang dang phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi dbang dang 'dra zhing / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon khyad par can bskrun par byed pa'i phyir na phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang zhes pa dang /dbang drug ka la bum pa'i chu'i bya ba rjes su 'gro bas bum pa'i dbang zhes bya ba thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma gsum sngar bsags spyong zhing phyi ma sdom pa dang / lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma 'khrud pas na sku rdo rje sbyong / lam bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul ba'i sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go / gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ / mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ / bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ / nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa dpal rdo rje 'dzigs byed sems dpa' sum brtsegs can du gyur/ rig ma stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las yum ro langs ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ gtso bo'i gsang gnas midamigs pa las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ las byung pa'i nor bu bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ā las byung ba'i ze 'bru bu gaphaṭa kyis bkag pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3rta/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su 45

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'i sa' gatshi las/zhu ba rdo rje nor bu'i nang du bskyed pa brtan par byas/ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje yi ni lus sgrub par/ /bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la/ /yida'is byung ba'i chu 'thungs shig / a ho ma hā su kha/ slar yang yum gyi pad+mar gnas pa'i lha rnams zhu ba'i bdud rtsi/ btung ba rin chenas nga mo masu kha/ gsang rdzayodangosasayod na nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje yi ni lus sgrub par/ / bu khyod kyis ni shes gyes la/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thungs shig / a ho mahā su kha/ de ltar bla ma yang yum gyis byin pa'i byang sems dkar dmar myang ba las bde ba chen poskyes/ bde ba des stong pa nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med de nyid gsang dbangagi dngos gzhi yin no/ / khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bzhi las kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rdzas gsang ba las byung ba'i dbang la gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba zhes bshad pa de thob/ thun mong ba ngag gi dri ma rdzun du smra ba sogs sngar bsags pa dag cing phyi ma sdom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa rlung la dag tu gsungs pa'i dri ma rlung sngags so sor snang zhing zhen pa'i dri ma 'khrud pas na gsung rdo rje spyong / kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku'i rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje'i sku bdag byin gyis brlabs pa bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can ba'ag go /sher dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ byangachub rdo rjes zhes sogs lan gsum/gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di de ni/ / bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ / rdo rje rjes chags spyor ba yis/ / bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ / thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ / de pas 'khor bar sbyor bral ni/ / khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ / de la mchog gi dngos grub 46

༄/ /dpaladorje 'jigasabyedadapa' bogacigamed/ / ces gsungs shing shes rab ma gtad pas/ rig ma des kyang tsan dan dang gur kum la sogs pas byugs shing / shin tu dri zhim pa'i me tog gi phreng bas brgyan te gos med par pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa gsal por ston zhing /dri chen dri chu bza' ba dang / / khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha/ bud med gus mchog de bzhin du/ / bha ga pad+mar tsum pa ni/ / bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ / ji ltar bde bar bus spros shig / dri chen dri chu sogs bza' ba/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ / bud med rnams la rtag gus bya/ / bha ga nyid la tsum pa ni/ / zhes brjod pas lha mo de dgyes nas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ / bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ / gang zhig cho gas sten byed pa/ / de yi mdun na bdag gnas so/ / sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ / pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ / bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ / 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ / bha dza mo k+ṣa ho zhes gsung bar gyur/rang nyid hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa'i rnam pa can du gsal bar gyur/ rig ma stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ yum ro langs ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje zhes pa nas/ yum gye gsang gnas zhes pa nas/ bkag pa/ oṃ sarbazhesapa nas/ at+pa ko3rta/ rang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar slebs pa na mchog dga'/ snying kha nas lte bar skebs pa na khyad dga'/ lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi rtser slebs pa na lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba skyes/ bde stong dbyer med kyi lhan skyes kyi dga' ba ni dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo yin no/ / khyod kyis bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ma la brten nas 47

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'thugathob pa'i dbang la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhes bshad pa de thob/ thun mong ba yid kyi dri ma brnab sems la sogs sngar bsags 'dag cing phyi ma sdom/thun mong ma yin pa gang snang kun bde stong dbyer med du 'char pa la sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud pas yid dag par byed/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go /dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis/ / gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ / de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / / bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ / lan gsum/ khyod kyes dbangagasum pa thob pa'i skabs su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum du snang bzhin pa'i dus na/ sems lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas de kho na nyid kyi don nges pa gnyis mnyam du yod pa de bzhin du/ don 'di goms par byas pa las mthar rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang snang gi rig ma dang kha spyor ba'i lus can dang / de'i dus nyid na thugs lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / stong pa nyid gnyis ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i 'od gsal thams cad stong pa gnyis ngo bo dbyer med pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du byed de de ni thob bya don gyi ngabang bzhi pa yin no/ / mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na/ / sdig pa kun las rnam grol bar/ / de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas/ / bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /mi tshugs pa dang ma bcing bar/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med dga' bar gyes/ / srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro phas khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ / ston pa'i mchog tu yang dag 'gyur/ / dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ / khyod 48

༄/ /dpalardorje 'jigasabyedadapa' bo gcigakyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ / slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ / bde gshegs bka' las bda' mi bya/ / de bzhin khros nas srun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ / sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang nges par spang mi bya/ / byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ / rang gzhan chos la mi smad do/ / yongs su ma smin sems can la/ / gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ / bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ / chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung / / gdug pa'i byams pa rtag tu spang / / chos la tshad gzung mi bya'o/ / dad ldan sems can bslu mi byed/ / rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ / shes rab rang bzhin bud med rnams/ / skyon gyis nyes pa mi bajod do/ / rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing / / rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas/ / rtag tu dam tshig la sogs bsten/ / gal te bla ma smod de bzhin/ / dam tshig bag med par gyur na/ / de tshe dkyil 'khor nges bris la/ / bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ / deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ / gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ / dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ / gnas par 'gyur ba the tshom med/ / sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pa/ / kun gyi tshe ldan deng dbang bskur/ / khams gsum pa yi rgyal po che/ / rgyal srid bdag por bstan pa yin/ / de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal/ / grong khyer mchog tu rab bzhugs so/ / de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ / thob pa 'di la the tshom med/ / 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ / rang gis dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis/ / de ring 'gro ba bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang / / mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur/ / gtso bos ji ltar bka' bsgo ba'i/ / gsung ni de ltar bdag gis 49

༄/ /yo bam ཿtshanama'i sa la gabagyi/ /de dag gis don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ /lus ngag yid gsum gye sgrib pa'i bag chags 'khrud pa'i nus pa bzhag /bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim sgom pa sogs la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ / maṇ+ḍal dbul/gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ bzod gsol sogasabyas la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las zhal gcig phyag gnyi4par log4su phye/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu na4ras bris kyi rnam par gyur bar bsams nas bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /de'ang slob ma'i dbang gis rigayolnga so sodang / slob dpon gyi dbang gis gsang chen rigs gcig tu sgrub pa ni chags bcas kyi tshul bzhi'i rgyud dang gleng gzhi'i don yin pa ltar bkra shisagang zhig ma'i shisabarjod 'di'ang de'i 'gros dang bstun na legs pa dang / gsang dbang rig4bdag gi yum la brten nas bskur ba mi rung pa min yang / skabasa'adir rig ma phul na de nyid lhar bskyed dgos la/ bcu gsum ma gsum gyi dkyil chog dang / bskyed rim chen mor 'jigs byed la yum yod pa'i sgrub byed du gsang dbang rang sher dbang yod pa bkod pa'i dgongayopa'ang ro langs mar bskyed pa'i dbang du mdzad snang bas/de gnyis tsam ma gtogasargyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung las 'don cha'i rim pa khol du byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa 'di'ang gzhung lugs smra ba'i dbang po lha ram pa rgyal mtshan dang / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa chen po blo bzang dkon mchog dang /dge slong dge legs rnams kyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bsdebasapa'o/ / 50

༄/ /dpalardorje 'jigasabyed lhabacugasumama'i ngonatogs/༄7/ / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcu gsum ma'i cho ga rgyun 'khyer 'chag med la ha cang brel ba sogs kyis ma lcogs tshe dmigs bsal mdor bsdus tsam byed na/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ hrī snyis bsangs/ su'i was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi las rlung/ ri las me/ ā las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gye steng du spru las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du bahūṃ yi ji khaṃ hūṃ las sha lnga/ li rmā paṃ hūṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang pos mtshan pa'i steng du oṃ ā : brtsegs te gnas pa zhu bas/ hūṃ gis ma dag pa'i skyon sbyangs/ ā sa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir rtogayopar byas/ oṃ gyis mang por spel bar gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu lan gsum gyisanang mchod byin gyis brlab/ sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ / stong pa'i ngang las ā lasabyung ba'i thod pa'i nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams zag pa med pa'i mchod rdzas khyad par gsum dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ a 〉 rtu/ nas/ oṃ shasta ā hūṃ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/de'igator ma nang mchod ltar byin brlab bya/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs skyong 'khor bcas bkug ste 'od gsal du bcug pa las rdo rje 'jigs byed yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi spu gusagator ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ya marā dza 51

sa / /gung thang bstanapa'izla sa gsung 'bugasogs tshar gcig bhu tsa ra sogs tshar gsum/ oṃ nga sha ṭīka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ wa rtu btags la nang mchod dbul/las gshin phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ / gshin rje'i gshed po'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ / sgrub pa po yi 'gal rkyen kun sel zhing / / mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / bdag bskyed mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyes brlab/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs gar pad nyi laganas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor baspyan drangs/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs la/ / mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /rab 'byams mchod tshogs kun 'bul na/ / zag med bde bas tshim gyur cig /sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ zhes pa nas/ mchis kyi bar/ /rigs lnga spyi dang so so yi/ /dam tshig sdom pa ma lus gzung / / ma bsgral ba rnams/ nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang / / bral zhing bde la gnas pa dang / / zag med dga' ba mi nyams shing / / chags sdang rtog pa zhi gyur cig / oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba rmā subhā wa shud rnyo3rta/ oṃ zu n+ya ta dzā na badz+ra subhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngo dmar rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/re las me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dbu ma bas mtshan pa/ li las sa'i dkyel 'khor rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer kun tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ me ri dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum dang bcas pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i chos 'byung gi dbus su sna tshogs 52

༄/ / dpaladorje 'jigasabyed lhabacu gsumasa'imangonatogs/pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ las 'khor lo hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskoraba'i nang gi re'u mig dgu pa'i dbus su yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/zhes pa nas/ gdan zung re re/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ zhes pa nas/brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas kyi phyag bcu drug na gri gug nyi dhi pā la/gtun shing / chu gri/ ka ṇa ya/ dgra sta/ mdung / mda'/ lcags kyu/dbyug to/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rdo rje tho ba/ ral gri/ cang te'u rnams dang / g.yon gyi lhag ma bcu drug na thod khrag tshangs mgo/phub/ rkang pa/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ rgyu ma/ dril bu/ lag pa/ dur khrod kyi ras/ skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ me thab/ thod tshal/ sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ rlung ras rnams 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas pa brgyad kyis mi la sogs pa'i srog chags brgyad dang / g.yon pa brgyad kyis bya rgodal sogs pa'i 'dab chags brgyad/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams mnan te me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ rang nyid ma tshig sems dpa'i thugs gar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / de'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro bas mtshan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sngon mo g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / zhesapa nas/ ze'u 'bru bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ oṃ sarbata thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyi lcags kyus mkha' khyab kyi sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas rang gi zhal du bcug thugs gar 'od du zhu ba rdo rje'i 53

༄/ /yo ca b.loba'isgronace' g.yo ཿmalam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs pa'i thig le cha gcig hūṃ dang de yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa/ thig le cha gcig gdan de rnams kyi steng du cha bcu bdun du gnas pa las/ dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje zheyopa nas/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyi mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lha bcu gsum gyi skur yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal dgu/ phyag so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na yum rdo rje ro langs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dang / shar lhor tsa rtsi ka dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gathum/ phyag 'og ma bzhi'i g.yas 'khor lo ral gri/ g.yon nor bu pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po/ ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas nor bu/ ral gri/ g.yon 'khor lo/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu phag mo sngon mo phag gdong can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/g.yas rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon 'khor lo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dang / nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar mo dmar sngo dkar pa'i 'al gsum/ g.yas pad+ma/ ral gri/ g.yon nor bu/ 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed dang / byang shar du go rī ljang gu/ ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon nor bu pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar sgor tho ba gshin rje'i gshed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas tho ba/ ral gri/ g.yon nor bu/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje'i gshed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas dbyug pa/ ral gri/ g.yon pad+ma 'khor lo 'dzin pa/nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/g.yas pad+ma/ ral gri/ g.yon 'khor lo/ nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral 54

༄/ /dpalardorje 'jigasabyed lha bcu gsumaspa'imangonagogs/gri gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu/ ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas ral gri/'khor lo/ g.yon nor bu/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ yab brgyad ga'i rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gri thod 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing / thod skam lnga'i dbu rgya na dang /mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ yum bzhis rtsa phyag gnyis kyisagri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam polnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyi'i grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni ra'i yi ge bzhi yongs su gyur / las mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhir gyur/ oṃ hrī khyi wi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na d+ngha ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a ro li ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra dz+nyā dzha ka hūṃ phaṭa/ gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/yum gye ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi dug lnga sbyangs/ ye shes lnga la bkod/ tshur 'dus gtso bo rang yab yum la thim zhing / gzhan bzhi phyogs bzhir 'khod/ oṃ mugo ra dzhaka hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ daṇ+ḍa dzha ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma dzha ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṅge droka hūṃ phaṭa/ sgo ba bzhi bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gye ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi bdud bzhi bcom/ dad pa'i stobs sogs la bkod/ tshur 'dus/ sgo bzhir 'khod/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra ga ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ de ṣa ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra ga ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ yum bzhi bskul/ dpag tu med par mo/ yum gyi ba sru'i sgo nasam/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi 'byung bzhi'i khams sbyangs/ tshad med bzhi la bkod/ tshur 'dus/ grwa bzhir 'khod/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ thod pa bzhi bskul/ dpag tu med param/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas྾/ phyogs bcur mo yul drug gi dri ma sbyangs/ slar 'dus/ phyi'i grwa bzhir 'khod/ (snyi ra ba) ma ā rtu/ gzhal yasam/ dpag tu med par nga/ yum gyi ྾/ phyogs bcur ྾/ snod kyi skyon sbyangs/ bde ba la gnas 55

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'izla ces gatshi ཿmapa rnams brtan par byas/ gcig tu 'dus/ dam tshig gi gzhal yas khang la thim par gyur/ oṃ hrī khyi ma : hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sarba dukhye in+d+ra ā di na sa pa rī wā ra ā ka r+sha ya dza rang gi snying ga nas khro po gshin rje'i gshed lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa bkug nas gzhal yas khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod par gyur/ oṃ hrī khyi ngartu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ sarba du khyim wā rā na ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed phur bu thogs pa dpag tu med spros te/ phyogs skyong rnams la phur bus btab pas/ grub pa'i bcud len grub pa bzhin du 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su k+ṣi/ rna bganyis dz+re/ snar khaṃ/ lce rtsa bar ram̐/ dpral bar ke/ lte bar saṃ rnams dang / spyi bor sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ dkar bo/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo ā dmarapo/ thugs gar thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/rangagi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ oṃ hrī mo : ha shabha be+e ḍū/ 'od zer gyis bkug ste lha rang rang gi rdo rje gsum la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā gas ko3rta/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta kā yarako3nya/ oṃ hrī ha snyo mahā kro dha a gasmo a gats+tsha a sma dbu dza pra ti gro mchu pra sā da me dhī mān ku ru swā hā/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gye dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ hrī khyi0blu kṛ tam ju phaṭa/ oṃ hrī khyiha ma sta wa rtu/ oṃ mu ga ra dza ma daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma baṃ/ oṃ khago ho ma slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ hrī khyi ha ཿ shabha wa rtu/ de bzhin gshegs 56

༄/ /dpaladorje 'jigasabyed lhabacu gsumama'imangonatogs/pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol btab pas/ tsa rtsi ka la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag/ chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa las mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ya mān ta ka sa pa ri wā ra a pā tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes sogayokyisamachod/ oṃ mchod do skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā :/ oṃ hrī khyi nas badz+ra ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā rtu/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi sa/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang sems can thams cad lhar gyur pa rnams kye zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ trīkhyi wikṛm ā ཿ/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3rta/ mchod pa phyi ma gnyiyobyed na gzhung ltar bya/ shin tu zhi ba'i tshul 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /drag po'i stobs kyis snyems pa'i gdug pa can/ / 'dul phyir shin tu khros pa'i skur bstan pa/ / rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / de'ang gtan la dbab pa'i gzhi/ gsung rab yan lag dgu'i brjod bya nas/ go bar byed pa'o/ / phreng ba bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur/rangagi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ā ro li ka arnya sogs kyisamachod pa dang nang mchod/ 'dod chags rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod chagasagashin rje'i gshed zhu nas khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo'i phreng ba'i rnam par 57

sku / /gung thangabastanaba'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/gyur/ gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnamalobablazhing yig brgyasalhag chad bskang / gtor ma nang mchod ltar 'byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la gtso 'khor so sor rim bzhin dbul/ mchod pa nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams gong bzhin bya/ ya ma rā dza sogasakyi4phyogayoskyong la phul nasa'azin las bcol/ gtang rag gi mchod bstodadang / rnam dag bsam pas zhes sogayokyi4bsngo ba/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhi nongs pa bzod gsol/ nyer bsdu/ bkra shisamatha' brgyan pa rnamasadakyusaltarakhya'o/ /dge 'dis 'jam mgon bla ma dang / /dbyer med gshin rje'i gshed po yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes gzung ste/ /yang dag lam bzang myur bgrod shog /de'ang rje bla ma'i gsung gi tshig re re la'ang rgyud dang grub chen gyi dgongasapa'i gnad dang dgosapa khyad par can du ma yod pas bsdu bar mi phod pa lta bu yin kyang / gtan ma lcogs tshe mdor bsdugatsam re yin kyang byasan legs par dgongasanasadam pa gong ma rnamayokyisa'adi 'dra mdzad 'dug pa ltar mdor bsdusapa'i ngag 'don tsam zhig bkod pa 'di ni/ mthon po'i rigs su'akhrungasashing lhag bsam rnam dpyod kyi rgyan dang ldan pa bā rin tho yon dkon mchog bstan pa'i nyi masabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yige pa ni sngag4ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /bkra shis/ /58

༄/ /grub chen lo0pa'i lugs kyi thugasarje chenapo/༄7/ / grub chen chem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs bde ba can gyi myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / gang gi zhabs sen snying la 'grogs pa yis/ / srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ / deng nas byang chub bar du rtag skyong zhing / / khyad par bde ldan zhing gi sa mkhan mdzod/ / bzod dka' yun ring ngan song sdug bsngal gyi/ / smag rum stug po'i klong nas glog 'gyu bzhin/ / lan gcig yud tsam thob pa'i dal 'byor 'di/ / don med ngang du gtong ba kye ma 'khrul/ / skyid kyang mi 'tsheng sdug kyang mi 'phod pa'i/ / tshe thung 'di ni ji ltar byas kyang sla/ / gting zab 'khor ba'i mtsho las rang gzhan kun/ / sgrol ba'i dus la babs phyir 'dir zhugs shig /deyang rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i bdag nyid mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi zhabs la 'jus te tshe lhag don ldan du bgyid par 'dod na/ spyir 'di'i rigs mtha' yas shing grags che ba'i bka' srol lnga tsam byung ba las/ 'dir bla med dang 'brel ba grub chen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi dmar khrid zab mo nyams su len pa la/ dmigs rim zhib par rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dang /lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje sogs dam pa gong ma mang po'i gsung las 'byung bas/'dir ngag 'don kho na nag 'gros su byas te mdor bsdus pa'i tshul rgyas 'god pa la/ mchog gsum mthu dang chos dbyings bden pa'i mthus/ /snod bcud yongs dag kun bzang mchod sbyin dbus/ / bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 59

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ཿ 0ma'i ga lam/mtha' yas pa'i/ / tshogs zhing rgya mtshos bskor te bzhugs gyur cig /dngosabargyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / ston pa sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /skyob pa dam chos rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /tshogs mchog dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis spyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ / 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bdag sogs 'gro kun chos la blo phyogs shing / /gegs med lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams/ /zhu nas bdag sogs byin gyis brlab par gyur/ skyabs sems kyi sho lo ka gnyis lan gsum sogs 'don/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /hūṃ dang rdo rje'i 'od zer 'phro 'dus las/ / rdor sems dkar po rdo dril bsnams pa yis/ / rdo rje bsnyems ma gri thod 'dzin par 'khyud/ /rin chen rgyan spras rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ / mi bskyod rgyas btab gnas gsum yi ges mtshan/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ yig 'od kyis ye shes pa/ / spyan drangs tsa rtu baṃ ho dbyer med gyur/ / de yi thugs ga'i sngags phreng hūṃ bcas dang / /de yi 'od kyis spyan drangs rigs lnga yi/ /sbyor mtshams nas thon bdud rtsi tshangs bug nas/ / zhugs te sgo gsum sdig ltung byang gyur cig /de nas/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ zhes sogs te ru ga'i yig brgya dang /de mi shes na yongs gragasardo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya/ ma mtha' oṃ badz+ra satwa āzhes ci 'grub bzla/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ / dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ / bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig / gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ / thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ / 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ / de nas rigs lnga rdor sems bcas/ / rang la dzim pas sgo gsum dang / /de dag rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /dbyer med sgrib gru

༄/ /grub chen ma bu pa'i lugs kyi thugasarje chen po/bralango bor gyur/ / slar yang rang gi spyi bor seng ge'i khri/ / pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng / / rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /dbang sngon mdangs ldan mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zhing / / thabs shes rang bzhin rdo dril thugs gar 'dzin/ / sku yi cha la zhi khro rab 'byams kyi/ / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa kun dzogs shing / / gnas gsum yi gegasum mtshan hūṃ yig gi / 'od kyis rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ / sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung kun/ / bsdus te thim pas skyabs gnas ma lus pa/ / dbyer med gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ / ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ / skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ / 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nyer spyod 'dod yon bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis phyogs kun khyab/ / zag med bde ba chen po bdud rtsi'i rdzas/ / ye shes lnga ldan mchod pas dgyes par rol/ / mtshan ldan phyag rgyar snyoms par zhugs pa yis/ / sgrib bral dga' bzhi'i bde ba chen po rgyas/ / mchod pa'i 'khor gsum snang la bden med pa'i/ / bde stong ting 'dzin mchog la gzhol bar gyur/ / thog med nas bsags sgo gsum nyes ltung kun/ / gnong 'ing 'gyod pa drag pos mthol lo bshags/ / gzhan phan dam pa rnams kyi mdzad bzang sogs/ / rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / / mya ngan mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ / dge tshogs kun kyang don med 'khor ba'i rgyur/ / mi smin mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sgrol ba'i phyir/ / bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / de nas maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma'am nyer gsum mas thog drangs tshom bu bdun nam grangs gsog gis gang mang dbul/ dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ / bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ / phyin ci 61

༄/ /yo cabayor+yā ཿ sa ཿma/log gi blo sna kun 'gag cing / /yang dag lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba dang / /phyi dang nang gi bar chad kun zhi zhing / / khyad par rim gnyis lam gyes rgyud sbyangs te/ / zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma lha'i/ /go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyes rlobs/ / de ltar gsol btab bla ma'i gnas gsum las/ /'od dang bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing ga'i tshogs/ / rim dang gcig char byung nas bdag nyid kyi/ / gnas gsum rim dang gcig char thim pa las/ / sgrib bzhi dag cing rnam dag dbang ba'i dang / / sku bzhi'i go 'phang dam pa thob par gyur/ / bla ma rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas/ /rang nyid bla ma lha yi ngo bor gyur/ / de dag gis sngon 'gro 'brel ba can bzhi bsdus pa'i tshul du song ba yin la thun mgor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang rdor sems bsgom / bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga sogs rgyas pa byas na/ de dang des 'thus pas 'di'i tshig ris de nyid nges can du gdon mi dgos so/ /dngos ga'i ni/ oṃ su bhā wa shurnya/ sa rba dharmā sa bhā shurnyo ྅nya/ snang ba thams cad bsdus te rang la thim 'ing / rang lus kyang stod smad nas zhu ba shel sgong lta bu dang / mthar de yang mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chu las chu bur gyi tshul du rang sems hrī yig dkar po ring cha tshig drag dang bcas de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa hrī sa mtshan pa/ de la sa 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa phul/ de dag gi thugs rje 'od zer dang lhan cig rigs drug so so'i gnas su song ste rang rang gi sdug bsngal las bsgral nas thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer thams cad tshur 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ /rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog zla ba ltaradakar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs gar thal mo 62

༄/ /grub chen so༄pa'i lugs kye thugasarje chen po/sbyar te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje bskul ba/ g.yas 'og mas nor bucu shel gyi phreng ba bzung ste 'gro ba rnams srid pa'i mtsho las 'dren cing /g.yon 'og mas rang nyid srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa mtshon pa'i pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ shin tu zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ mthon mthing ral pa'i thor tshugs lan bu 'phyar ba/ mtshan dpes mdzes shing rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par klubs shing / sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar pad zla la ye shes sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba dang / ye shes sems dpa'i thugs gar zla ba la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrī yig dkar po'i mthar yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas ye shes pa rnams thugs rje chen po'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rang la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ rang la dbyer med du thims pas rang nyid yi dam kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsung gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags rigs sngags thams cad spyan drangs pa snying gi'i (kha'i)sngags phreng la thim pas snying po kun 'dus su gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad spyan drangs/bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas sdeg sgrib thams cad dag cing zag med kyi bde ba chen po 63

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'i r+yā r+sāng 4ma/myong / chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ drin can rtsa ba'ibla ma'i ngo bo longs sku 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan cing / de'i sku las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad bsdus te de'i thim pas bla ma kun 'dus kye ngo bor gyur bar bsam la/ kun 'dus gsum gyi bdag nyid de nga'o snyam du nga rgyal bsgom/ mchod pa byed na bde mchog sogs bla med ltar ram/ bsdu na/ oṃ ā rtu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shā ra arnya sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs ga'i hrī yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas ma dag pa'i nyes pa sbyangs te snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /bcud thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sgra ji snyed yod pa thams cad kyang grags stong dbyer med yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyi gdangs su shar/ snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus te stong bar bsgom pas byang sems 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i ye shes gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ slar yang thugs rje chen po'i skur bzhengs shing snod bcud dag pa'i rten dang brten par gyur nas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu sngags kyi sgra 'ur 'ur bsgrags bar gyur par bsam la ma ṇi bzla/ rgyun par kun 'dus gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas bya zhing / snod bcud sbyangs bsgyur sogs kyi 'khyer so gsum yang ya ma bral bar bya'o/ / snga ma'i mngon rtogs de tsam mam yum bcas gsang sgrub la brten pa'i rdzogs rim dngos dang dod thub ci rigs bsgom tshul dang / zas gos gnas mal gang la longs spyod pa'i tshe lha dang bla ma la phul ba'i dmigs pa bya ba sogs chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor drug la sogs pa ni khrid yig rnams las shes par bya'o/ / shin tu brel ba'i dus su rgyun ma bcad tsam gyis mdor bsdus pa byed na/ sangs rgyas 64

༄/ /grub chen bu pa'i lugs kyi thugasarje chen po/chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la hrī dang pad+ma las rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis shel phreng dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par be+e thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te rang la thim/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma byon nas bum pa'i chus dbang bsgur/ longs sku 'od dpag med kyi rnam par gyur te rang gi spyi bor rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ thugs gar zla ba la hrī 'i mthar yi ge drug pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ gsang sngags thams cad bsdus te bstem/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad sbyangs/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas sngags kyi spras/ 'jig rten thams cad gang bar gyur par bsam la dmigs rim snga ma ltar gyi ngang nas bzlas ba bya'o/ / bzlas pa grub nas yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhing mchod bstod byas la/ 'dir 'bad dge pas bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs dbangagis/ / byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog / 'chi tshe spyan ras gzigs dbang mngon sum du/ / byon nas bde ldan zhing du 'khrid pa dang / / de nas sprul pa'i bkod pa mtha' klas pas/ / ma dag zhing gi 'gro ba 'dren gyur cig /ces sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab cing / ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstem ste/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa sogs dkyus ltar bya'o/ /smras pa/ rgyal sras dpa' bo rgyu skar 'bum gyi dbus/ / thugs rje nya 65

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung lam/gang mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / bla med rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang 'brel bar/ / sgrub tshul grub chen tshem bu pa yi lugs/ / ji bzhin ngag 'don rim par bsgrigs pa yi/ / dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / phyag na pad+mas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ / myur du srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni blo dang ldan pa ri khrod pa blo bzang dkon mchog gis sngar nas bskul zhing / nye char dad brtson dge ba dge slong chos bzang dar rgyas kyis nan cher bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bla ma'i man ngag bzhin dbon gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du briyopa'o/ /

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jigartenadabang phyug gisgonas ril mabyed tshul/༄༅/ / 'phags mchog 'dzig rten dbang phyug gi sgo nas ril sgrub byed tshul phan bde'i mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru lo ke shā rā ya/ / sgrib bral nam mkha'i dbyings kyi rdo rje ni/ / rang mdangs 'od lnga'i rigs su shar ba las/ / sor rtog bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ / btud nas de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam spel/ / de'ang dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar gtso bo 'pho ba'i man ngag gis 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgo nas ril sgrub bya tshul ni/ rgya bod kyi rten sna/ bum rdzas nyer lnga sogs sbyar ba'i ril bu legs par dril zhing na bza' gsol te bum par blug nas brog zhu dang dar dpyangs sogs kyis brgyan/ stegs mthon por bzhag la mchod gtor legs par bsham/skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ / rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i 'al gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin cing /g.yas kyi dang pos thugs gar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i dri rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ gnyi ga'ang rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhes sogs rdor dril byin rlabs/ nang mchod dang sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor byin rlabs rnams dkyus ltar la/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ga'i oṃ dmar po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa 67

༄/ /༅ cabastan pa'i ཿ khrung ཿma/bkug ste/ zhes pa nas rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi bar 'dra/ rang nyid 'jigarten dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i thugs gar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ dmar po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar dzim/ zhes pa nas/ phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la oṃ be+e ḍū gis mtshan pa/ pad+ma āt+pa ko3rta/ mtshams 'dir kha cig dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhig bskyed na rung zer yang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas de ltar ma gsungs pa ni mtha' dpyod myu gu'i dgongs pa yin pas/ des na mtshams 'dir/ pad+ma yi ge dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin cing / g.yas kyi dang pos thugs gar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ rang gi lus kyi mdun rgyab dang / zhes sogs lus dkyil dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs yan chad dkyus ltar dang / rang nyid debazhin bshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gyur/ oṃ sadru ta thā ga ta kā ya wā gyit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs gar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ kha spyor gyi sbyor bas lus rgyas par byed pa/ de'i thugs gar zla ba'i gdan la pad+ma'i lte bar ting 68

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jigartenadabang phyug gisgonas ril sgrubabyed 4/nge 'dzin sems dpa' oṃ yig dmar po/ rtag tu 'char ba mar me chen po lta bu/ zheyosogs man 'dra/ rig ma stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las dri'i dung chos baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi rtsa phyag gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yasado rje 'khor lo/ g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ sazo ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gyur/ hūṃ/ stoms par 'jug pa'i las la gnas par byas pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba thob/rang nyid don grub tu gyur/ phaṭa/ oṃ sazo ga ta thā ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3rta/ gshegs pa gzhan gtso bor 'phos pa'i tshe mi bskyod pa dang gos brjes pa tsam gyes chog la/ gshegs pa gzhan bzhi'i rigs kyi sems dpa' lta bu gtso bor 'phos tshe gshegs pa de nyid rigs bdag tu byas nas de'i go sar mi bskyod pa 'god cing / sems dpa'i gnas der rang 'dra gnyis pa bkod pas lha so gnyis tshang bar 'gyur ba yin gye/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam pa la 'od dpag med kyi nga rgyal 'dzin par rje 'gos kyis bzhed pa bzhin byas na 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso bor 'phos par mi 'gro bar mtha' dpyod myu gu las gsungs so/ / 'od dpag med rigs bdag tu bsam tshul yang cho ga rgyas pa'i skabs mngal 'byin gyi tshe slar spyan drangs nas rang gi rigs bdag la bstim pa des chog la/ sbyor gyi skabs 'dir de ltar bstem rgyu med kyang rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo 'od dpag med dang dbyer mi phyed par bsams na chog gi / de bsgyur nas 'od dpag med zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gsal btab na man ngag mi mthun pa'i rtog bzor 'gyur ro/ / 'dir 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis pa gsal btab yod pa bzhin du 69

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isgroname'i gatshi 'chagabazlas pa dang mchod pa'i skabs kun la'ang de'i sngags ma chad pa dgos pa dpyod ldan rnams kyis shes par bya yi/ gong du song zin snyam nas dor mi rung ngo / /dang sbyor tsam byed na mtshams 'di nas bzlas pa la 'jug par bya ste/ 'bru gsum yid bzlas dang / oṃ ā hrī zhu/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes yi ge bcu pa nas/ sum+bha rādza'i bar mdun bskyed nas 'byung ba ltar rim ba'in bzla/yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / de nas) rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka lngasabastod pa nas bzung ste/ rang nyid don grub tu gyur/ phaṭa oṃ sazo pa thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra subhā wa āt+ma ko3rta/ zhes pa'i bar dang / lus dkyel gyi lha thams cad kyis kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong ste bde ba chen po dang de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas dgyes par gyur/ gzhal yas khang gi cha so so yang rang gi lus kyi cha so so la thim par gyur/ rang yab yum stoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur/ sgrib pa sbyangs/ oṃ yig tu gyur/ des nam mkha'i khams gang ba yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gyur pa rnams rang gi 'od zer gyes drangs nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shurto saze dhaspo yo ga shurnyo ྅rta/rgya ta ṭ+wāṃ ༷ dhiX rdo snye/ ṭ+wāṃ/ gyuX /āX ṭ+wāṃdī ༷༷ ṭ+wāṃ/sa ṭ+wāṃ dīX ༵rjo ༵dī ༷/na ṭ+wāṃ che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du ril bu rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhir ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su ril bu rnams re re nas sna tshogs 70

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jigartenadabang phyug gisgonas ril sgrubabyed tshul/pad+ma'i gdan sum cu so gcig dang / de'i steng du thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan sum cu so gcig gdan de rnams kyi steng du oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ skyes thug skyes hūṃ/ 14 41 swā hūṃ/ tsaX stag hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ 41 hā hūṃ/ 74 〉〉 43 hūṃ/oṃ ā māṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ ā rta hūṃ/ oṃ ya dza ka/ oṃ sko 4 hūṃ/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ ya ho hūṃ/ oṃ ā mi hūṃ/ oṃ ā blo hūṃ/ oṃ ā oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā 44 hūṃ/ oṃ ā skyes hūṃ/ oṃ 〉 rtu hūṃ/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ ā shā hūṃ/ oṃ ā : hūṃ bcu rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma/ dri'i dung chos/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ rdo rje/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ yut+pal/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ me long dmar po/ pi wang sngon po/ rdo rje/ro'i snod/ klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa/'khor lo/ rin po che gnyis/ pad+ma gnyis/ ral gri gnyis/ zhes pa nas/lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ zhes pa nas/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ yum dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ zhes pa nas/ 'dod yon lnga'i dga' bas rol pa/ yab yum gnyi gas phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ gnyi ga'ang rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba/ zhes pa nas/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan canam rin 'byung ser pong mi bskyod pa sngon pongadon grub ljang gu nga spyan ma dkar mo ma lnga ma kyi sngon mo nga sgrol ma sagazugs rdo rje ma nga sgra rdo rje ma kho reg bya rdo rje ma 〉 ro rdo rje ma sa lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol/ zhes pa nas/ dga' bas rol pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na rang rang gi gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ byams pa dang sa snying dkar po sa phyag rdor dang 71

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izla ma'i gsung 'bum/nam snying ser po za 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dpal dmar po/zhes pa nas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs paragyur/ de rnams kyi thugs gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa re re/ ye shes sems dpa' de rnams kye thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ oṃ baṃ/ oṃ swā hūṃ hā/ lam̐ rmā paṃ rta/ dza : khaṃ ho / me zlo oṃ oṃ/ oṃ hūṃ oṃ saṃ/ hūṃ bcu rnams 'od zer gyi phung po chen po dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams kyi thugs ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pa rnams gcig tu gyur pas ye shes pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs can rnams kyi thugs gar btab ste sgrub pa po la dngos grubastol par bskul ba'i 'og tu rang gi thugs ga'i oṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis gnod mdzes bkug nas mdun du bka' nod pa la rgyal ba rnams dam rdzas ril bu 'di la dngos grub ched du 'byon par skul cig ces bka' bsgos pas des kyang rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs shing / de rnams kyang rang rangagi dam tshig pa so so la thim par gyur/ e bye hi bh+ya ga wan nas hūṃ swā hā/lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ga'i oṃ dmar po 'od zer lcags dkyu'i rnam pa can gyis 'og min gyi rgyal ba/ zhes pa nas/ spar+sha snu dza megha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye ā ྅/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin nas 'dir gshegs shigalan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza dza dza dza zhes pa nas/ so so la dbang bskur bar gyur/ mchod pa byin brlab bya/ dag cing dri med sogs kyi4chu bzhi/ lha yi me tog sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po sogasakyis 'dod yon lnga/ zhing 'di rin chen sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun rnams dbul/ lo ke shā ra oṃ ā ྅/ gadhe badz+ra oṃ ā :/ dzin dzika oṃ 〉 rtu/ zhes panas/ sum+bha rā dza oṃ ā ཿ/ bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ / zhes pa nas/pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ sā hā/ rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /sogasasho lo ka la 72

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jigartenadabang phyug gisgonas ril sgrubabyed tshul/dang / gang zhig gzugs dang zhesasog4sho lo ka gsum gyis bstod/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ zhes pa nas/ chu la chu bzhag bzhin du ro gcig gyur/ / oṃ ā hrī rtu/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ ā lo ke shwa ra oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā gadhe badz+ra baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā dzi na dzika oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā rat+na sprika swā hūṃ/ oṃ ya badz+ra sprika hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā mdzā spri ka hā hūṃ/ zhes sogayosngags yongayordzogasabazla/ yig brgya4lhag chad bskang / oṃ lo ke shar sa pa ri wā ra arnya nayoshasta'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags so so'i gsham du 'bru gsum btagayopayonang mchod dbul/ rdo rje dpag med sogs sho lo ka lngas bstod/ de ni thun dang po'o/ /thunaganyis pa la/ rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/rang dang 'dra ba'i dri rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ gnyi ga'ang zhes pa nas/ sham thabs 'phyar bar gyur/ nang mchod dang mchod pa byin brlab bya/ oṃ ā bisdin+ta krita/ nas/ haṃ/ bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du ril bu rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrī las pad+ma hrī sa mtshanapa/ de yongs su gyur ba las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ dri rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyi ga'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par sko thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ 7 3 baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ yo lo shā ra gadhe badz+ra a sogs kyis mchod/ lo ke sha ra oṃ ā :/ gadhe badz+ra oṃ ā ḍū/73

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ༄sa' ga 4chagardo rje dpag med ma sho lo ka gcig dang / dri med dung mdog mayobastod/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / zhes pa nas/ ro gcig gyur/ oṃ ā hrī rtu/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes yi ge bcu pa dang / yig drug 'bru gsum gyi bar du bcug la ci nus bzla/ oṃ ā lo ke shā ra oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā gadhe badz+ra baṃ hūṃ/zhesadang / mthar yig brgya bzla/ oṃ lo ke sha ra gadhe badz+ra a sogasakyis mchod/lo ke shwa ra oṃ ā :/ gadhe badz+ra oṃ ā rtu/ rdo gis bstod/ thun rjes ma rnams de'i rigs 'gre bya'o/ /thun tha ma'i bzlas pa'i mtshams su spyan 'dren khrus gsol dang / mjug tu gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ga'i oṃ dmar po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyes/ zhes pa nas/ spu gu can rnams su gyur/ma.ā hrī pra wa ra sad ka ram̐ argyu sogs kyis chu bzhi/ oṃ ā lo ke shwa ra oṃ/gadhe badz+ra paṃ/ dzi na dzika oṃ/ rat+na dh+rika swā/ badz+ra dh+rika hūṃ/ pradz+nya dh+rika hā/ zhe4pa nas/ uje ṣa tsa kra wa rti hūṃ/ sum+bha rā dza hūṃ hūṃ/ sarba du khye sa ma ya/ zhesapa nas/ tsa ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas 'das ltadang / oṃ ā hrī dus gsum skyes pa kun dang / zhesapa nas/ zhi ba dang ni srung bar mdzad du gsol/ hūṃ swā hā/zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i lha tshog4rnams la gtor ma dbul/ oṃ ā : pra wa ras da ka ram̐ añtsa ma ṇi arnyam badz+ra taspu la ye swā hā/ oṃ sabra pa thā ga ta pukhye nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ lo ke shwa ra oṃ 〉 rtu/ gadhe badz+ra oṃ ā rtu/ dzi na dzi ka oṃ ā :/ zhes pas nas/ susna rā dza oṃ ā shā/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa ba ri wā ra pukhye/ zhesapa nas/ oṃ be+e ḍū badz+ra sa phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ dgacing dri med mas chu bzhi/ lha yi me tog mayonyer spyod rol mo'i bar/e ma'o mchod pa dang / phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po/ zhes sogs gang rung gis 'dod yon lnga dang / lo ke shwa ra oṃ 〉 rtu/ zhes sogasasngagayoso so'i mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje dpag med sogs sh+lau ka lngas bstod/74

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jigartenadabang phyug gisgonas ril sgrubabyed tshul/de nas/ dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs kun/ / gcig tu bsdus te sras bcas rgyal kun gyi/ / thugs bskyed smon pa'i chu klung dang 'dres nas/ / byang chub mchog gi rgya mtshor gzhol gyur cig / tshe rabs kun tu dal ba'i rten thob cing / / mchod ldan bshes gnyen dam pas rjes gzung ste/ / sngon 'gro thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ / dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam la 'jug gyur cig / rnam dag dbang thob dam sdom tshul bzhin bsrungs/ / bskyed rim phra rags rnal 'byor mthar phyin cing / / rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa yis/ / bden gnyis lam bzang mngon du 'gyur par shog / tshul 'dir 'brel thogs skye bo mtha' dag kyang / /'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i gru gzings la/ / brten nas phra rags 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ / brgal te zung 'jug go 'phang myur thob shog /ces smon lam dang / yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ shis brjod rnams dkyu4ltar bya/grolakha'i thun la/ yig brgya/ mchod bstod/ gtor 'bul/ gtang rag mchod pa/nang mchod/ rdo rje dpag med sogs sho lo ka lnga/ gang zhig gzugs dang zhes sogs sho lo ka gsum/ dri med dung mdog ma/ smon lam/ yig brgya/ gang yang bdag blos ma rnyed yongs sum bdag la dngos grub nas/ dngos grub bla na med pa stsol/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhes pa nas/ ril bu thugs rje chen por gsal ba rnams/ / 'od zhu gnyis su med par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes ril bu la bstem/ de nas/ 'chi med rol ba'i lam bzang yongs gang ba/ / bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug lha tshogs kyis/ / dge mtshan bye ba'i me tog char phab ste/ / 'gro kun dbugs dbyung dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal sras grub pa'i tshogs/ / kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras dang / / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs/ / dngos brgyudabla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog / gang gi mtshan tsam yid la dran pas 75

༄ / /gung thangabastanapa'is sa' gsung 'busakyang / /srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog 'chi med dpal ster ba/ / thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad rgyud rnams dang / / rgyud sde bzhis bsdus spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud/ /smin cing grol byed rim gnyis lam la sogs/ /lung rtogs dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog / spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i zla zer gyes/ /rnam dpyod ku mu da tshal rab rgyas shing / /bshad sgrub sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyes gtams pa yi/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi bkra shis shog / nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i pho brang mchog / cesasogs bkra shiyokyiyomatha' brgyan par bya'o/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi rtser son 'dus pa'i lam/ /'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs/ /go sla 'jug bder sbyar ba'i dge tshogs mthus/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig /ces 'phagasamachog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgo nas ril sgrub byed tshul phan bde'i mchog sbyin zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa mkhas grub kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 7kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsung gzhir bzhag la/ 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir bdag bskyed dang spyor dang 'brel bar byed tshul gsal bar kha bskang ste bsgrigasapa'i yi ge ba ni rat+na ā na ces bgyis pa 'disakyang skye 'gro rnam4la phan thogs par gyur cig /76

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyamatsho'idabang gi ga༄7/ / 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gi cho ga dngos grub gter mjod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / na mo gu ru lo ke sha rā ya/ dmigs med thugs rje sgyu ma'i rol ba la/ / spyan ras gzigs zhes mdo rgyud kun du grags/ / khyad par bde chen snying rje'i bdag nyid kyi/ / zlos gar rgyal ba rgya mtsho gtan gyi skyabs/ /mgon po gang gi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ru/ / zhugs te dngos grub dga' ston spyod pa'i tshul/ / rgya chen tshig gi spros pa ring spangs te/ / ngag 'don chog sgrigs rim pa 'dir 'god bya/ / de yang 'phagasamachog rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis yo byad rnams phyag len bzhin du legasapar bstar te/ bdag skyed sngon du btang la/ bum pa layosngag4kyisabasangs/ oṃ bru n+ya ta dzā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3rta/ bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ taste taste ma hā taste swā hā/ lan gnyis/lha'i chu bo gago dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi byed par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su mtshan so gnyis kye ngo bo ayā/ i ste/ u u/ ṛ dzā/ tha lī/ e i/ o au/ yi a ste dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas skor dang / slar yang a ā/ zhesapa nas yi a0ste dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yon skor du gnas palongs gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po cha thams cad yongs su 77

༄/ /gung ca bstan ba'i ma'i g.yo 4ma/rdzogs pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍa rta rta ṇa/ ta tha da da dha dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ya ra la la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phragagacig g.yas skor dang / slar yang ka kha ga bhā nga / zhes pa nas/ k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyel 'khor dmar po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i dbus su dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs can gyi hrī las pad+ma hrī sa mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hrī las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pa'i sne mor thugs rje chen po'i lha'i tshogs nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang ba spros/ 'gro ba rnams thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab yum thams cad spyan drangs te mnyam par sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas zhu bar gyur te hrī yig la thim pas hrī yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las gdan dang lha rnams skad cigagis grub par gyur pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ de yang pad+ma'i lte bar zla nyi'i gdan dang / phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi gdan la 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyagaganyis pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing lhag ma sil bur babs pas sku stod khebs pa/ rus pa la sogs pa'i rgyan dpag tu med pas sku la spras shing / phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mu tig gi phreng ba dang / g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing / zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs pas bzhugs pa/ de'i bang na yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar 78

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyam༅dbang gichogamo phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul ba nas 'khyud cing zhal du stob pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma la shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin cing /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar du rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo dkar po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor rin chen rigs kyi khro bo ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ byang du las kyi rigs khro bo ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin cing / gsum ga'ang g.yon pas ut+pal 'dzin pa'o/ / rnam rgyal bum pa'i mtshan ma lnga'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan rnams kyi steng du hrī rtu i hūṃ khaṃ rnams las pad+ma dang rdo rje rin po che 'khor lo ral gri rnams hūṃ la sogs pas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dkar po g.yas mu tig gi phreng ba dang / g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og gi shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ lhor rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang dril bu/ nub tu rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu/ byang du don grub ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ las bum gyi nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de gnyis kyi steng du hrī yig gnyis las khro rgyal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po 'al mche ba gcigs shing spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar ba'i khrod na rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher ba/ g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug tho 'phyar zhing /79

༄/ /gung cabastanaḥr+ṣayo sa 4ma/g.yon thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thod pa skam zlon dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ga'i hrī yig las 'od zer 'phros/bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza ཿ baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su oṃ/ rna ba gnyis su hūṃ/ sna bug gnyis satī/ kha la ā dpral bar haṃ/ snying gar hūṃ/spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mi/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang rang gi rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan cing / las bum gyi rta mgrin gnyis la snang ba mtha' yas kyis rgyas btab par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la tshigs bcad dang bcas pas mchod cing bstod/ de nas dung chos kyi chu la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u dka hūṃ/ zhes dang / mabe+e ḍū/ lan bdun bzlas la/ dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/sngags kyi 'od ze gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ rlu ma ga ye ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya swā hā/ zhesapa brgya rtsa brgyad/ yu da ka brgya rtsa/ las bum la/ hrī badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am pad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhe4ci mang bzla/ gtso bo'i sngags dang hūṃ bdun gyis bum pa so sor mchod yon dang / las sngags kyis me tog dkar po gsum gsum dbul/80

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyamatsho'i dbang gitsha galas sngags kyis bsangs la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnam par bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig me tog sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje zhes sogs dang / 'jigs rung dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ / mi bzad drag sngags nga ro sgrog pa'i gsung / / mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag par dka' ba'i thugs/ / khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pasabastod/ bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ste byang chub kye sems kyi ngo bor bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mtshan ma'i lha rnams kyang zhu nas rang rang gi phyag mtshan gyi rnam par gnas par gyur/mdun skyed ni/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par mos te/hrī badz+ra kro dha ha ya spri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ thu n+ya ta sto na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3nya/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa phyi nang gi dngos po thams cadabaden pas gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir rang bzhin gyis stong zhing bdag med par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zhesapa nas/ pad nyi'i gdan re re/ zhesapa'i bar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgrub thabs ltar la/ de nas/gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ zhes pa nas/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ zhes pa'i bar bum skye ltar dang / de nas yang / zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo 'phags pa thugs rje chen po ba rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing lhag ma sil bur babs pas sku stod khebs pa/ rus pa la sogs pa'i rgyan dpag tu med pas sku la spras shing /phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mu tig gi phreng ba dang / g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing / zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs bas bzhugs pa/81

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'i sa'i g.yo ཿma/de'i bang na yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul ba nas 'khyud cing 'al du stob pa/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin cing / skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shar sgor rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo dkar po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ lho sgor rin chen rigs kyi khro bo ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ byang sgor las kyi rigs kyi khro bo ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin cing / gsum ga'ang g.yon pas ut+pal 'dzin pa'o/ / yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lha pa oṃ las skyes pa'i nor bu bu ga phaṭa kyes bkag pa/yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las spru las skyes pa'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3rta/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs gar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar phyung pa'i thig le cha brgyad du gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las hūṃ t+t+waṃ trī 〉 rtu hūṃ trī a0rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang khro bo bzhir gyur pa rnams slar yang hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī a rtu hūṃ bhā 〉 rnams kyis pad+ma nas phyung / badz+ra yi ku sha dzabadz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra spo ṭa paṃ/ badz+ra gha ṇ+ḍa ho ma shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ thugs ga'i hrī yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i dkyel 'khor 82

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyamatsho'idabang gitsho garten dang brten par bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya sogs kyis mchod/dza 4 baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su oṃ dang 'khor lo lasagati mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rna ba gnyis su hūṃ dang rdo rje las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sna bug gnyis su t+t+waṃ dang rin po che las ser sna rdo rje ser po g.yas rin po che/ khar ā dang pad+ma las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ dpral bar haṃ dang sna tshogs rdo rje'is phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ snying gar hūṃ dang rde rje lasado rje yid dkar po g.yas rdo rje/ spyi bor oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ mgrin par ā dang pad+ma las gsung rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ snying gar hūṃ dang rdo rje las thugs rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje 'dzin cingaka thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ / slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha3mas spyan drangs/ sngar ltar mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mi/zhes gsol pa btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang /dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo yab yum dang nub phyogs pa gnyis la 'od dpag med/ shar phyogs pa gnyis la mi bskyod pa/ lho phyogs pa gnyis la rin 'byung / byang phyogs pa gnyis la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ dag cing dri med ces sogs dang / lha yi me tog kha dog dbyibs legs/ zhing 'di rin chen/ lha rjes las byas zhes sogs la rang rang gi sngags sbyar te chu gnyis nyer spyod/ 'dod yon/ rgyal 83

༄khya/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams dbul/ gzhan yang / dri med gser gyi rtsibs stong 'od 'bar ba/ / rin chen yin+d+ra nī la'i tog gis mdzes/ /sna tshogs phra bkod mu tig chun 'phyang gis/ / khor yug brgyan pa'i gdugs kyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ts+tsha tram̐ ga na pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas gdugs dbul/ drang zhing ldem pa'i rin chen yu ba ni/ / zla phyed rdo rje rin chen rtse mo can/ / dar lce gsum pa rlung gis bskyod pa na/ / sil sil 'khrol ba'i dril chung sgra sgog cing / / sum khug 'khyog gi 'gying dang rab tu ldan/ /mdzes pa'i srog chags mtshan ma yod med kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / / rab mdzes ba dan rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ke tu pra taṅka pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ / zhes rgyal mtshan dang ba dan/nam mkha'i rgyan gyur rin thang med pa'i gos/ /sna tshogs dar gye sham bu g.yo ba can/ / tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dris bsgos pa/ / rab 'byams bla re sprin gyis mchod par bya/ / yi badz+ra bi tā pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bla re dbul/sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba/ zhes tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas gos dbul/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas gang bum rnams dbul/ sarba ta thāg ta ār+ya lo ke shwa ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ā :/ nang mchod dbul/mchod pa'i mgor rang gtso bo las logs su phye ba de nyid slar tha mi dad du gyur par bsam la/ yab kyi gsang gnas zhes pa nas phaṭa kyis bkag pa/yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pan dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar gleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gye dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes bas lha thams cad kyis kyang bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams lhan skyes kyi bde ba 84

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyamatsho'idabang gi chogadang de kho na nyid la snyoms par zhugs pas/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma gnyis bshams shing byin gyes brlabs te/ thugs ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor pa dang / phyogs skyong zhing skyong la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya lo ke sha ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra i de ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bcas pa sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs ltar dbul/ rang nyid skad cig gis hūṃ mdzod sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'chang zhing / g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du thogs pa med par zhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing rtsig pa btegs nas 'og nas nang du zhugs/ lha rnams kyi steng nas ma rgyud rnams la g.yon skor dang / gzhan thams cad la g.yas skor du slob ma rnams dang lhan cig tu rol mo'i sgra dang bcas yig brgya 'don zhing / oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol bar ldan/ / sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril/ / dza nyu baṃ ho nyi hi hi hi hi/ / mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ badz+ra ud gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ lan bzhi/ oṃ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig / de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs pa la/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal rgyas par phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ / dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ / byang chub sems 85

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sa'i ga 'chagakyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum bdag la stsal tu gsol/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a laṅkar wa s+t+ra pū dza ma gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes smad g.yogs/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes stod g.yogs/ oṃ badz+ra yusmi ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gtsug gtor/ oṃ tsagru parnya wā rā ma na ya hūṃ/ zhes mig dar/ ā ka dī ra hūṃ/ zhes me tog gtad/ hrī badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bsangs/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ rang gi snyeng gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ mgrin par nyi ma la mā dmar po/ spyi bor bla ba la oṃ dkar po/ yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyes lus 'od gsal bar byas/ kye khyod su yin ci la dga'/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs lan gsum gyis byang sdom dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis sngags sdom gzung / sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems kun rdzob pa de nyid snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par gyur/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid dang rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar bo rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta yu mi/ oṃ su ra tis ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sibhu badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod la de ba'in gshegs pa thams cad kyis byen gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ khyod kyes kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya 'ing / ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ / hūṃ dza 4/86
