༄/ /'phagasamachog rgyalab rgyasatsho'i dbang gi choga.ā ka dī ra hūṃ/ ma hā ra ta/ su dri rta/ su to kho/ su su ṣe/ badz+ra satwa ā dhu sirgya mi/ lanagasum/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ oṃ na ma mi hūṃ/ oṃ na mo na ma ju swā hā/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyo ) de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kye dngos grub rnams kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang ba di darirtel 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba lasnas na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ / oṃ de ring rdo rje semasadapa' rang / / khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ / gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ / de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ / oṃ badz+ra u dka ja 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ / dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig / deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ / khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig / byas na khyod yang ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po 'al gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i rkang ba'i 'og tu yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ gsang gnas su re las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum padzha yig gis mtshan pa/ snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru ba'i pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par yi las rlung gi dkyil 87

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'i po sa las/'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa la ā dmar po/ spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po thum po has mtshan pa bsgom/ de nas slar snying gar nyi ma'i dkyel 'khor 'od zer 'phro bas mtshan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi lus la char bzhin du babs par gyur/'di ni rdo rje dam tshig ste/ / rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ / ye shes rdo rje bla med pa/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ ma ṇi paze hūṃ ju ma ga ye ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya swāhā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma bcug pa 'di'i/ / lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ / bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog / 'di yi dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ / bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig / rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ gtso bo 'khor bcas kyi mdun na gnas par gyur/ pra tī ts+tsha badz+ra ho.oṃ pra ti grojo s+t+waṃ/ i mi satwa ma hā ba la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la hūṃ/ dpral bar ram̐/ mig gnyis la oṃ 'od zer 'bar ba re re/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ / phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ / rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ / oṃ dzā na tsagru hūṃ ā sā hā/da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos/ / khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ / phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyes brlabs/ /dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyi/ /rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol pas/ / gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyes/ / te badz+ra pā byu/ de yang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo me ri dang bcas pa'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i shar sgor rdo rje'i 88

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyamaḥ dbang gi cho garigs kyi khro bo/ lho sgor rin chen rigs kyi khro bo/ nub sgor pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo/ byang sgor las kyi rigs kyi khro bo/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro/dbus su 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yab yum ste rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ / oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong / / oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur/ / sa ma ya ho ho ho0 dbang dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ bum pa'i dbang gi thun mong ba slob ma'i dbang rnams zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar/ / bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum/ trī badz+ra krodha sogs kyis bsangs/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang nyid drangs pa zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar thon pa skad cig gis stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gye gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i zhes pa nas/ 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab yum mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas shasta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ / 'gro ba bskyab pa'i ched du dbang / / yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ / de ltar bdag la'ang stsal 89

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan ba'izla ce' gsung 'bum/tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkha'i rgyal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'ispri bo nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang nyid mi bskyod par byas pa la dbang bskur/ yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung ste/dkyel 'khor gyi shar du khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar dmar nag pa'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/'phar ma gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbus su rdo rje nag po/ shar du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/ byang du ral gri ljang gus mtshan pa'i steng du shing stan la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ trī badz+ra kro dhas bsangs/ oṃ shun+yata ma nya/ dbang rdzas bum chu stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi zhes pa nas/ 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo zhes pa nas/'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i zhes pa nas/ 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs/ bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma dang bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rang gi steng phyogs su 'dzin/ glu gar mdzad cing rol mo brdung /90

༄/ /'bagasamachogargyalab rgyamatsho'idabangagi cho game tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzungaba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyis shis pa bajod/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ / kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog / sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ / des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog / dbang bskurdo rdo rje chen po ste/ / khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ / sangs rgyas kun gye gsang gsum pa'i/ / gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ya badz+ra yu da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / bde ba chen po myong / dri ma thams cad dag/ chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams mi bskyod pa'i rang ba'in du bkug nas/ dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang ba spu'i bu ga nas bstem pas rang mi bskyod par gyur/arnya sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / cod paṇa gyi dbang la rang nyid las sngags kyis bsangs/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes rang nyid drangs pa/ zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las ṭ+wāṃ dang rin po che las rin 'byung ser po 'alagacig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rin chen sgol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhes pa nas/ phyung 91

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sa g.yo khum/ste rang gnas su 'khod par gyur/ dbang rdzas cod paṇa bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las t+t+waṃ dang rin po che las/ zhes sogs nas/ rin 'byung yabayum zhu ba las byung ba'i cod paṇa du gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i/ zhesapa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan/ / zhes pa nas/ dbang rab bskur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ sbyin par bya/ / oṃ badz+ra rat+na ku la mu ku ṭa a snyi ṣiñtsa mi/ dbang bskur/ zhe4pa nas/ sbyin par bya/ /oṃ ā sarba ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ swā hā/4zhes bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ zhes pa nas/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams rin 'byung gi rang bzhin du bkug nas/ zhes pa nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gye dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/tshor ba'i phung po gnas bsgyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/rin chen 'byung ldan dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / rdo rje'i dbang la rang nyid las sngags kyes bsangs/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las hrī dang pad+ma las 'od dpag med dmar po 'al gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pasayum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/zhes pa nas/ phyung ste rang gnas su 'khod par gyur/ dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hrī dang pad+ma las/ zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan/ / zhes pa nas/ dbang rab bskur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ /zhesapa nas/ sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo 92

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyal ba rgyamatsho'idabang gi cho garje yi/ / dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ / rdo rje rab tu grub phyir zungs/ / dbang bskur rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ā sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin du bkug nas/zhesapa nas/ shasta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang de'i rigs kyi dngosagrub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / dril bu'i dbang la rang nyid las sngags kyis bsangs/ bla ma dang gtso bo/ zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ dang ral gri las don grub ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgol ma ljang gu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhesapa nas/ phyung ste rang gnas su 'khod par gyur/dbangaphas dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ dang ral gri las don grub ljang gu/ zhes sogs nas/ don grub yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ / zhes pa nas/ dbang rab bskur/ dbang bskur rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ sbyin par bya/ / oṃ badz+ra arnyi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ya s+t+waṃ/ dbang bskur rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ sbyin par oṃ ā sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes pa nas/don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams don grub kyi rang bzhin du bkug nas/ zhes pa nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de ltar don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas 93

༄༅/ /gung thang bstanapa' sgronas gsung 'bum/bsgyur/ bya ba sgrub ba'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang byas so/ /ming gi dbang la rang nyid las sngags kyis bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zheyopa nas/ phyung ste rang gnas su 'khod par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad/ ces pa nas/bgegs bskrad par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ / zhes pa nas/ dbang rab bskur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ sbyin par bya/ / oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a snyi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ / dbang bskurardo rje/ zhes pa nas/ sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ā sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyes dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams rnam snang gi rang bzhin du bkug nas/ zhes pa nas/ shasta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las/ / rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur ba/ / rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / / snying brtse'i gter gye bdag la stsol/ / rang nyid las sngags kyis bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje 'chang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje dbyings kye dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhes pa nas/94

༄/ /'phagasamachog rgyalab rgyasatsho'i dbang gi cho garang nyid rdo rje 'chang du byas pa la dbang bskur/ yum gye pad+ma nas phyung ste dkyil 'khor gyi shar du khrus kyi dkyil 'khor/ zhes pa nas/ byang du ral gri ljang gus mtshan pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la 'khod pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ phyogs thams cad du mchod pa'i sprin dang bcas te 'khod par gyur/ hrī badz+ra kro dhas bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ / rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ / kun tu bzang po'i kun bdag nyid/ / rdo rje bsnyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o/ / oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i ye shes rgyal ba'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo ni gsang ba'am nang gi rdo rje la/ de dran pa'i (don)du rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ rdo rjede kho na nyid kyis zungs shig / dril bu sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ / dril bu dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ / byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ / khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ / chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i sgra dril bus sgrog par sems pa'i sgo nas dril bu 'dzin pa dril bu de kho na nyid kyis zungs shig / a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag / ngo bo nyid kyis srid 'gal byas/ / rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pas/ / srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ / oṃ badz+ra gha ṇ+ḍa a yid kyi lus ni brtan pa nyid/ / phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ / gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ / des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ / ye shes phyag rgyas byin rlabs nas/ / 'dod pa tham sa cad longs spyod pas/ / dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ / rang rdo rje 'chang yab yum phan tshun 'khyud pa las byung ba'i 95

༄/ /yo ca bam lotshonama'i gatshi 4ma/bde ba dang stong pa nyid sbyar ba'i bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin no/ / bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas/ zhes pa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis shis pa brjod/ / dbang bskur rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ da bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ rang gi ba sru'i sgo nas thim par gyur/oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ de yang bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ngo bo gcig la ldog pas phye ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la sogs pa lnga dang / byang chubakyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun du yod pa rnams gtso bo dang 'khor rten dang brten pa so so'i rnam par shar ba yin pas/ dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid shes par bya zhing / las kyi rim pa ni bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang /bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / gtor ma'i cho ga dang / srung ba dang / phyir bzlog dang / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / der slob ma gzhug pa'i mtshan nyid ni slob dpon gyi las su bya ba'i rim pa yin no/ / rang nyid 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho sems dpa' sum brtsegs can du gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs can gyi thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrī yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ / bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi/ / bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ gong gi sngags kyang lan gsum brjod/ skabs 'dir gtso bo'i sngags kyes chog par gsungs kyang / 'dir oṃ ma ṇi paze hūṃ/ zhes pa gtso bo'i sngags dang / blu ma ga ye zhes pa yum gye sngags/ lhag ma'i yig 'bru brgyad 'khor gyi sngags yin kyang dkyus gcig tu 'byung bas sbrel nas bzlas 96

༄/ /'phagasamachog rgyalab rgyamatsho'i dbang gicho gan legs so/ / sngags kyi phreng ba bla ma'i thugs ka nas brgyud de rang gi snying gar hūṃ gi mtha' skor du gnas bar gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis la yi ge pra re re/ oṃ badz+ra na tre a pa ha ra pa ṭa li hrī ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ / rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ / ma rig pa'i ling togadang bral nas ye shes kyi spyan phye bar gyur/ ā las byung ba'i me long /ā chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ / gzung du med cing brjod du med/ / rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ / der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med/ / sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni/ / bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ / rang bzhin med cing gnas med par/ / chos rnams de ltar shes nas khyod/ / sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ / skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye/ / spyir chos thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu dang / khyad par du rang gi snying la zhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' ni me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis shig / ho las skyes pa'i mda' gzhu/ ho oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya mi/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ / khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ / phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ / ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyis shig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa rta dhā ra ya mi badz+ra satwa ho nyi nyi hi hi hūṃ/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'bas g.yas cung zad brkyangs pas bzhugs pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā0/ thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 97

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sa'i g.yo 4ma/zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru thod pa rnams snying po lan gsum gsum bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di/ / phyi dang nang na yang dag gnas/ / kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed dag /byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis/ / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lha'i sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru shes rab stong pa nyid/ thod pa bde stong dbyer med du skyong ba/ tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa'i mtshon byed du shes par gyis la de dag dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig/ hūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra te tu mi/ dbyangs tha ma a las byung ba'i dung / oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa ram̐/ dbyangs dang po a las byung ba'i rgyud kyi po ti/deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ / tsam gyis chos dung bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /dbyangs tha ma a las byung ba'i dril bu/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ / nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ / nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor bas/ / thams cad mchog ni mnyam nyid gsal/ / rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ sems can kun la phan don phyir/ / 'dzig rten kun tu thams cad nas/ / ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / sems can kun lam/ 'jig rten kun tum/ ji ltar sna tshogasam/ rdo je'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / sems can kun ma/ 'dzig rtenam/ ji ltaram/ rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / sems can ma/'jig rten ma/ ji ltaram/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / sems can྾/ 'jig rtenam/ ji ltarang/ las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / bla ma rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i cha lugs can du gyur/ 'dir ni khyed rnams ngas lung bstan/ he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ / srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /98

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyamatsho'i dbang gitsho gasrid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ / kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sirnyi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ spur bhu bsra a/ gang la phyag rgya 'dis lung bstan pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par dzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par mdzad de/ phyag rgya 'di nyid kyi mthu dang sngags 'di'i stobs yin no/ / da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ / slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / / lha rnams kyang ni mthun par dgongs/ / sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ / khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ / rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ / sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ / de ltar phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor gnyis las/ phyi rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du slob dpon du bya ba'i ched du chos kyi rgyal srid du dbang bskur bas na slob dpon gyi dbang dang / phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi dbang dang 'dra 'ing phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon khyad par can skrun par byed pa'i phyir na phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang zhes pa dang / dbang drug ka la bum pa'i chu'i bya ba rjes su 'gro bas na bum pa'i dbang zhes bya ba de thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma gsum sngar bsags sbyong zhing phyi ma sdom pa dang / lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma 'khrud pas na sku rdo rje sbyong / lam bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go / gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ / mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar/ / bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gye phyir/ / nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa 'phags mchog thugs rjechen po sems dpa' sum brtsegs can du gyur/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dhaglu

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'i sgronasa' gsung 'bum/rmā su bhā wa wa shurnyo ྅rta/ rig ma stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul ba nas 'khyud cing zhal du stob pa/ de'i mig gnyis su oṃ/ zhe4pa nas/ mtshan par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las/ zhes pa nas/ āt+pa ko3rta/ yab yum stoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje nor bu'i nang du lhan cig skyes pa brtan par byas/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ / byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ / de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgye/ / nang mchod myang zhing / a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod/ de ltar bla ma yab yum gyis byin pa'i byang sems dkar dmar myang ba las bde ba chen po skye la/ bde ba des stong pa nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med de nyid gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin no/ /khyod kyes dkyil 'khor bzhi las kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rdzas gsang ba las byung ba'i dbang la gsang ba'i dbang bskur bzhes bshad pa de thob/ thun mong ba ngag gi dri ma sogs sngar bsags 'dag cing phyi ma sdom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa rlung la ngag tu gsungs pa'i dri ma rlungasngags so sor snang zhing zhen pa'i dri ma 'khrud pas na gsung rdo rje spyong /kunadzob sgyu ma'i sku'i rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje sku bdag byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu longs spyod dzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go/ sher dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sems rgyas la/ / nas deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyi/ / bsten kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ / bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ / rdo rje 100

༄/ /'phagasamachog rgyalab rgyamatsho'i dbang gi cho gaskyil krung gis sems ni/ / nor bu'i nang du chud pa lta/ / zhes gsungs shing shes rab ma gtad pas kha rig ma des kyang tsan dan dang gur kum la sogs pas byugs shing / shin tu dri zhim pa'i me tog gi phreng bas brgyan te gos med par pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa gsal bar ston cing / dri chen dri chu bza' ba dang / / khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha/ bud med gus mchog de ba'in du/ /bha ga pad+mar tsum pa ni/ / bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ / ji ltar bde bar bus sgros shig / ces 'dri ba la/ dri chen dri chu sogs bza' ba/ / lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ / bud med rnams la rtag gus bya/ / bha ga nyid la tsum pa ni/ / zhes brjod pas lha mo de dgyes nas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ / gang zhig cho gas sten byed pa/ / de yi mdun na bdag gnas so/ / sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ / pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ / bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ / 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ / bha dza mok+ṣa ho zhes gsungs par gyur/ rang nyid bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ zhes pa nas/ brkyangs pas bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na rig ma yum gsang ba ye shes kyi/ zhes pa nas/ hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas/ zhes pa nas/ze'u 'bru bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ rang dang rig ma'i lus 'dod lha yab yum du gsal ba lha'i 'du shes/ gnyis ga'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te yi ge bkod pa sngags kyi 'du shes dang / thabs 'di la brten nas zag med kyi bde ba mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad bkug nas bdag gi lus la thim pa rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par 101

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'itshonasa'i khrung 4masleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes mngon du byas/ ye shes des stong pa nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo yin no/ / khrod kyis bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ma la brten nas thob pa'i dbang la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhes bshad pa de thob/ thun mong ba yid kyi dri ma brnab sems la sogs pa sngar bsags 'dag cing phyi ma sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa gang snang kun bde stong dbyer med du 'char ba la sgrib ba'i dri ma 'khrud pas yid dag par byed/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go/dbang bzhi ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod 'bas pad+ma'i bka' drin gyes/ /gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ / de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ / gsum/ khyod kyis dbang gsum pa thob pa'i skabs su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum du snang ba'in pa'i dus na/ sems lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas de kho na nyid kyi don nges pa gnyis mnyam du yod pa de bzhin du/ don 'di goms par byas pa las mthar longs spyod dzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku rang snang gi rig ma dang kha sbyar pa'i lus can dang / de'i dus nyid na thugs lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bdang stong pa nyid gnyis ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i 'od gsal la thams cad stong pa gnyis ngo bo dbyer med pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du byed de/ de ni thob bya don gye dbang bzhi pa yin no/ / de ltar don dam byang chub kye sems kye dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bag chags 'khrud pa'i nus pa bzhagabaden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim bsgom pa sogs la dbang 102

༄/ /'phagasamachog rgyal ba rgyamatsho'i dbang gi cho gabaracos/ 'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ / mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na/ / sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ / de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ / bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/ / phyin chad 'chi ba khyed la med/ / mi tshugs pa dang mi bcings par/ / gang la'ang 'jigs med dga' bar gyis/ / srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ / sred pa shin tu mtha' grub phyir/ / ston pa'i mchog tu yang dag 'gyur/ / dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ / khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun gsungs pa/ / mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ / slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ / bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ / de bzhin khros nas spun rnams la/ / nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ / sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ / nam yang nges par spangs mi bya/ / byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ / rang gzhan chos la mi smod do/ / yongs su ma smin sems can la/ / gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ / chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung / / gdug pa'i byams pa rtag tu spangs/ / chos la tshad gzung mi bya'o/ / dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya/ / rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ / shes rab rang bzhin bud med rnams/ / skyon gyi nyes pa mi bajod do/ / rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing / / rnal 'byor spangs par mi bya ste/ / rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas/ / rtag tu dam tshig la sogs bsten/ / gal te bla ma smod de ba'in/ / dam tshig bag med par gyur na/ / de tshe dkyil 'khor nges bris la/ / bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ / deng khyod skye la 'bras bur bcas/ / gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ / dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ / gnas par 'gyur bar be+e tshom med/ / sangs rgyas rdo rje 103

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/can bcas pa/ / kun gyes tshe ldan deng dbang bskur/ / khams gsum pa yi rgyal po che/ / rgyal srid bdag por bstan pa yin/ / de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal/ / grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ / khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid/ / deng 'dir thob par the tshom med/ / de ltar yid ni rab dwangs rdo rje nyid du gyis/ / rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis/ /'gro ba bde ba nyung bar rdo rje sems dpa' dang / / mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par gyur/ / gtso bos ji ltar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /gsung ni de ltar bdag gis bgyi/ / lan gsum/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas par phul/gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ gong bzhin dbul zhing bstod pas bstod/ / smon lam ni/ 'di yi dge bas myur bar snying rje'i lha/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i go 'phang mngon gyur te/ / sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar pa'i 'gro ba kun/ / nyam nga srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig /mi rtag srid pa'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' 'ing / / rang nyid kyis mtshon 'gro la snying rje'i blo/ / shugs drag rgyun mi chad pa'i dbang gyur te/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod la slob gyur cig / phyi dang gsang ba rgyud sde rab 'byams las/ /legs gsung mgon po snying rje'i gter chen gyi/ / dkyil 'khor bkod pa kun tu smin byas te/ / mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis snod gyur cig / nyes lhung rnyog mas ma bslad bag yod kyi/ / chu lon brtan ldan dam tshig gtsang ma'i mtshor/ / mchog thun dngos grub pad+ma dkar po'i phreng / /bzhad pa'i rtse dga' khong nas rgod gyur cig / grangs ring bskal pa'i tshogs kyi dbye ba brgyar/ / ltos min skye shi bar do btsan thabs su/ / sbyangs te sku gsum lam du bsgyur ba yi/ / smin byed bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar phyin shog / gtum mo rlung dang sdud rim rnal 'byor gyis/ / 'od gsal lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur te/ / gang 'dul bkod pa sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs 104

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyasatsho'i dbang gico gapa'i/ / bden gnyis rdzogs rim rtogs pa mthar phyin shog / brtan pa ma thob tshe yi mthar gtugs na/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ / zhal bstan lhang lhang snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ / dbugs phyung dga' dad ngang nas 'pho gyur cig / las kyi bar do mi dge'i rlung shugs kyis/ / bdas min bla ma lha yi dpung tshogs mthus/ /bsam bzhin bde ba can dang gru 'dzin nam/ / sngags spyod rten bzang mchog tu skye gyur cig / skye zhing skye bar spyan ras gzigs mgon gyis/ /nam yang mi 'bral dge ba'i bshes mdzad cing / / bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas sa lam rim bgrod de/ / bla ma lha yi go 'phang myur thob shog / ces bsngo zhing / yig brgya lan gsum/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ / gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ / mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ / ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ / 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyes pa/ / de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzod rigs/ / zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi dam tshig pa'i cha gcig bsdus te rang nyid la dzim/ rang nyid gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du phye nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu gnas ba'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par be+e thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor pa'i dam tshig pa'i cha gcig dang ye shes pa rnams bsgrub gzhi 'di la sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ / 'di ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ / nasalegs par stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ shis brjod paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa sogs kyis mtha' ba rgyan par 105

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'itshonas gsung 'bum/bya'o/ /smras pa/ rnam 'dren kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje yi/ / bdag nyid mchog tu bsngags pa spyan ras gzigs/ / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud ltar sgrub pa'i tshul/ / dkyil 'khor bya ba'i las kyi rim par bcas/ /bkod pa'i dge bas mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ / mi khom ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa las grol te/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum sa mkhan gyis/ /rmad byung dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid gyur cig /ceyopa 'di ni thos don sgrub la gzhol ba'i spong ba pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyiyodzis tshang dgon du 'di'i sgrub mchod tshugs rgyur/ 'di'i dkyil chog cha lag tshang ba zhig dgos tshul bskul ma byung bar brten/ 'jam dbyangs ral gri dang / sngagasa'achang 'jam dbyangs pa sogs kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa dang / skyid shod pa dang / rgyal dbang bdun pa sogs kyis cho ga gsum bskyed tsam mdzad la/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes kyis ma rgyud spyi'i sgrub thabs kyi chings sngags rim las 'byung ba ltar du mdzad pa rnams kyi nang nas phyi ma ga /ra byasate/ de dang 'gros bstun nas mdun bskyed kyi skor gsar du bsgrigs shing / dbang gi cho ga 'khon ston dang / sngags 'chang 'jam/ dbyangs pas mdzad pa gnyiyodang paṇa chen gyi dkyil chog rnams gung bsgrigs te/7btsugs pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bsdebayopa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /༄༅/ /thugs rje chen pocul ba rgya mcho'i dbang gi brgyad 'debs dang mngonartogs bsdus pa bzhugs/ /༄za/ /dpal ldan rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /snying rje'i gter chen mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros 106

༄/ /'phagasamachogargyalab rgyam༅dbang gi cho garin chen te/ / rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyes rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / dngos grub mchog brnyes tai lo sher bzang dang / / rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ / 'phags pas rjes bzung mi tra dzo ki ste/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnam gsum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen byams pa dpal/ / mkhas shing grub pa bsod nams dbang phyug dang / / nyams rtogs mthar son bsod nams seng ge 'bas/ / rje btsun rin chen seng ge rnam bzhi la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / thams cad mkhyen dngos bu ston rin chen grub/ / khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams dang / / rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ / thub bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /smra ba'i nyi ma mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ / snyan brgyud bka' babs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / / 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes chos rdo rje/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /107

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonaza' gsung 'bum/zab lam mngon gyur rgyal ba dben sa pa/ / mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas ye shes dang / / blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ / mtshungs med bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ / sngags 'chang chen po dge 'dun don grub dang / / lung rtogs mnga' bdag ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zhabs/ / 'dul 'dzin dam pa blo bzang mkhas btsun te/ / gsang chen gdams pa'i gter mdzod rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gye gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ / rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug blo bzang dar rgyas te/ / byang phyogs skye dgu'i 'dren mchog rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / skyes mchog dam pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / / rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan te/ /bka' drin mtshungs med 'dren pa rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ /zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'di yang btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brisapa'o /bla ma thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir 'phags 108

༄/ /'phagasamachog rgyal ba rgyamatsho'i dbang gi cho gamachog rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul du nyams su len pa la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gye gdan la hrī las pad+ma trī sa mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro chags 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings shing / spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mu tig gi phreng ba bsnams shing / g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing / zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum gsang ba ye shes kye mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol blang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ de'i mig gnyis su oṃ/ rna ba gnyis su hūṃ/ sna bug gnyis su hūṃ/ kha la ā dpral bar haṃ/ snying gar hūṃ rnams dang / spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs te/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ yab yum gnyis ka la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang lasayo las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kye nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong / rnam pa 109

༄khya/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgronas gsang 'bum/mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ a ā ཿ nas/ oṃ shasta ā : gi bar gyis byen gyis brlabs/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shā ra arnya sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal kun sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / gzugs sku'i rnam rol rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag / ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso dang mnyam spyor ba/ / bcom ldan thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang gi thugs gar hrī yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs drug sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal ma lus pa sbyangs te 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras bcas kye thugs rje byen rlabs ma lus pa bsdus te sngags phreng la thim par gyur par bsams/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ ju ma ga ye ha ri ni sa tsa hrī ya swā hā/ zhes 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags sam/yang na yig drug ni thugs rje chen po'i spyi sngags yin pas/ 'di'i mngon rtogasakyi sgo nas ma ṇi grangs gsog gi bzlas pa byas kyang rung bar gsungs so/ /mjug tu yi ge brgya bas lhag chad bskang / mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni thos don sgrub la gzhol ba'i spong pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskur ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /110

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcigs/༄7/ / 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa thar ba'i grong du 'jug pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / na mo gu ru ār+ya lo ki sha rā ya/ spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol grags pa'i dbyangs/ / bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rna bar lhung bas kyang / / nam yang 'chi med gtan bde'i srog ster ba/ / bcom ldan thugs rje'i gter chen de yis skyongs/ / thun mong lam sbyangs snying rjes rgyud bskul te/ / gang gi dkyil 'khor chen por legs zhugs nas/ / zab lam rnal 'byor sgrub pa dang mtshungs pa'i/ / thar par bgrod pa'i zem skas gzhan yod min/ / de phyir brgyud ldan dam pa'i man ngag bzhin/ / de yi sgrub dkyel cha lag dang bcas pa/ / nyung ngu'i tshig gi phreng bar spel ba 'di/ /rnam grol don gnyer gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan mdzod/ 'dir rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po grub brnyes dpal mo'i lugs kyi mngon dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa/ blo dman 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ba'i cho ga'i yan lag rgyas pa rnams ba'ag ste/ med mi rung gi gnad rnams cha tshang bar phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa la gsum/ bdag bskyed bsnyen pa dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing dbang blang ba/ zhar byung cho ga'i yan lag ga'an bstan pa'o/ /111

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sa' gsung 'bum/dang po ni/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing /dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ sa ga zla ba sogs dus bzang por/ gnas khang byi dor byas shing sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/tshogs zhing mchod pa dang / bdag bskyed mchod pa/ rdor dril lam ting shag sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du byas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra legs par byas nas stanabade ba la 'khod/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul du byed pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam rgya snying gar ba'ag ste/ oṃ pad+ma yuta bha wa ye swāhā/ces brjod/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsam la/ tshogs zhing gi mchod pa/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā subhā wa shurnyo ྅rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ 'bas bsil/me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can/ byed las zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster bar gyur/ oṃ arnya 〉 rtu/oṃ pāhūṃ wa rtu/ oṃ pukhre ā :/ oṃ ju pe ā rtu/ oṃ ā lo ke ā :/ oṃ gadhe ā :/ oṃ ne+e wi te ā :/ oṃ shasta spya rtu gis byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ / rtag par bdag ni skya bas su mchi/ / shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag / sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bgyes te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed brgya/ /lan gsum/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos 112

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs rje chen po zhal bcugacig pa/skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du bzhugs par gyur/ ces tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyis phyag mchod sogs byed par mos nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / dkon mchog gsum gye rtsa ba ste/ / bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ / 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs/ / nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal/ / gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / / spyan stong bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / / gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/ / btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ḍā kyi'i gtso mo lak+ṣi kā ra'i zhabs/ / lnga rig paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu dang / / ye shes bzang po zla ba rgyal mtshan sogs/ / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal ba kun dngos blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ / mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid rgyal ba yab sras dang / / kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ste/ / dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang gis bdag la rig pa bslab pa dang / / mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag rjes bstan cing / / bslab pa mnos dang dbang bskur byin brlabs pa'i/ / dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skyob pa chos 'khol phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gsum la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ / 'phags pa seng ge'i sgra dang yid bzhin nor/ / pad+ma gar dbang thugs rje mi bshol dang / /don yod zhags dang ha la ha la ste/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / pad+ma rgyan dang rdo rje chos dbang phyug / ha ri ha ri la zhon 113

ro༅/ /gung thang bstanaba'i sgonashā gsung 'bum/mgrin sngon te/ / phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ / zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ / lus btud pa yis rnam pa kun/ / mchog tu dang pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhesaphyag bya/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shā ra sa ba ri wā ra ar+bhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ debazhin du/ arnya gyi gnas su/ mahūṃ/ pukhye/ju pe/ ā lo ke/ gasnya/ ne+e waṃ te/ shasta rnams bcug ste bya rgyud nas 'byung ba'i rang rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing dudamigs te phul ba yis/ / 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma 'bul/ long yod na mtshams 'dir ltung bshags dang spyi bshags 'don/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun tu/ / sdig pa bgyis par gang gyur pa/ / sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ / skrag pas rmi 'drar bshags bgyi zhing / / deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid/ / dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / / 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / / thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ / de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing / / dam pa gsum la skyabs su mchi/ / zhes yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig / sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyisadang bral ba'i btang stoms la gnas par gyur cig / ceyobarjod de/tshogs zhing rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam/de nas bdag bskyed dngos gzhi bsgom pa ni/ oṃ su bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā0114

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs chen po zhal bcugacig pa/su bhā wa shusgo ྅rta/ oṃ thu n+ya ta dzā na badz+ra su bhā wa ād+ma ko3rta/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin med pas stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī dkar po las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrī0la thim pas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba'i lte bar hrī sa mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ pad+ma hrī dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan rasagazigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa sku mdog dkar po lang tsho dar la bab cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal bcu gcig gi rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ljang /g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus lngang / g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar pa/de'i steng ma dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams kyang spyan dkyus ring zhing phra ba zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa spyan gsum pa ral ba dmar ser gyen du bsgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ rgyan spangs shing mgul ba dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs gar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kye gnyis pas bgrang 'phreng / gsum pas mchog sbyin las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi bas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi bas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang mar pus 115

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sa g.yo 'asgegamo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing / ras bzang po'i sham thabs can/ nor bus spras pa'i gser gye ska rags dang ldan pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyi phreng bas mdzes pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub can/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs shing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trī dkar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ thugs ga'i hrī0las 'od zer 'phros/ po ta la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ma rtu baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi sa lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i gos dkar mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya thi ye ā hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar byin gyes brlabs/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ shasta'i bar gyes mchod/ skyon gyes ma gos sku mdog dkar/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan/ / thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ / spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod/ rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 116

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcugacig pa/hrī yig dkar po/ de'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus/ thugs ga'i hrī la thim par gyur par bsam/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya dzā na sa ga ra bai ro tsa na byu ha rā dzā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+ya sarta te bh+ya sagyigre budhe bh+yan ma ār+ya a wa lo ki te sha rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ mahā satā ya mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ ju ru ju ru/ ibhe wartse/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me/ ku su ma wa re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ya swā hā/ zhesagazungs ring snying po ci 'grub bzla zhing / snying po ni/ tar+ya thā/zhes pa man chad do/ / gal te snying po dang gzungs ring mi shes na sa bon gyi mthar yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar mos te/ ma ṇi bgrang bas chog la/ de'ang sems g.yeng pa dang / glal ba sprid pa 'og rlung lha gzhan gye bzlas pas bar chod pa sogs skyon gyis ma gos par bya tshul/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa bzhin lag len du gdab/ de nas/ oṃ pad+ma satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ zhes sogs yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams su 'jug cing / bdag bskyed rkyang ba rgyun 'khyer du byed tshe thun mthar gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ mchod bstod kyi mjug tu/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsam la/ oṃ ā ྅/ lan gsum gyis byin gyes brlabs/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi spug gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ ār+ya lo ki sha ra sa 117

༄/ /yo cabalomi'itshonama'i ga ཿma/pa ri wā ra ba bla pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis dbul/mchod bstod sngar ltar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi las nyon sgrib pa ma lus pa byang zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhesa'adod don la gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra sku bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa dang / gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ / zhes sogs bsngo smon bya zhing thun mtshams su 'khyer so gsumadang mi 'bral ba la slob bo/ /'di ni gtso bor bsten pa'i dbang du byas pas/bdag mdun 'brel mar byed na gtor 'bul dang bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegayogasol mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub cing dbang blang ba la/ sta gon dang / dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis/ dang bo la'ang / sa ltadang / lha dang / bum pa sta gon/ lha la gsol ba gdabapa/ slob ma sta gon dang lnga/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor 'grem pa'i gzhi de'i dbus su malngi'i khar maṇ+ḍal la dri'i thig le dang tshom bu bkod/ sa lha'i mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs/ dkyil 'khor gye dbus su baṃ las sa'i lha mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can zhi ba/na bza' dkar po mnabs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lus phyed 'thon pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon gser gye bum pa bsnams shing pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du zla ba'i steng du hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sor mo'i rtse mo sa la lan gsum bsnun pa'i sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bskul bas sa g.yos pa'i gseb nas sa'i lha mo ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ dṛ thi wī de wī bh+ya sa pa ri wā ra 〉bye pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā dang / pāhūṃ 118

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcugacigapa/gyes gnas su/ añtsa mā r+ṇa/ a / puspe sogs kyi sngags bcug pas mchod/a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon dril bu dkrol pa dang bcas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cang kye/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / / sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la / / lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ / skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ / ji ltar bdud kye dpung bcom pa/ / de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ / bcom nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ / zhes lan gsum brjod rjes/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ji ltar bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par gyur par bsams/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams byas pa des sa mnan la/ oṃ badz+ra shrī wa hūṃ/ zhe4lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i hūṃ yig 'od zer 'bar ba 'phros pas dbang chen gser gye sa gzhi la thug gi bar rdo rjer byas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra dri rta tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir dri bzang la sogs pas byugs shing me tog gcal du bkram/ phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri bzang pos lha gnas so sor ram maṇ+ḍal lta bu'i steng du thig le bya zhing / de'ang gtso bo'i gnas su gru ba'i dang / lha ga'an rnams kyi gnas su blum po/ dri'i thig le'i steng du lha rang rang gi sngags brjod nas me tog gi tshom bu re 'god/ mtha' skor du nyer spyod nyung mtha' tshar bcu las mi nyung ba mdun gyi lha'i g.yas nas mgo brtsams te bshams/ rang shar nas dbus su phyogs par 'dug pa lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ oṃ subhā wa shudha sarba rnyarma su bhā wa shurnyo ྅rta/stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa ga'i ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i 119

༄/ /yo ca b.lopa'i sa' gatshi 'bum/gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi ba rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang phyogs ba'i'i 'dab mar zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hrī las pad+ma/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes pa bstem pa/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/mchod pa byin rlabs kyi bar 'og nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin byas la mchod pa sngags 'bul dang / phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i zhes sogs kyis bstod pa bya/gsum pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba dang / las bum gnyis legs par bsgrubs la las sngags kyis bsrung / dar gyi mgul chings zur srog gsum pa'i tshul du dkri 'ing / oṃ badz+ra the kha ra ru ṭa ma ṭa di shaṃ brnya hūṃ/ zhes srad bu dkar pos bcings/ rnam rgyal la pad zla'i steng du pad+ma/rdo rje/ rin po che/ 'khor lo/ ral gri rnams dang / las bum la pad nyi'i steng du pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa bris pa gdags/ stegs kyi khar ku sha'i gdan la bkod de/ chu gtsang gis ran par bkang ba'i nang du bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas gzhug 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ steng du dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa phyag len bzhin bshams nas/ paṅgān+ta kṛta kyis bsangs/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dha subhā wa shurnyo ྅rta/ bum pa gnyis stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ taste taste mahā taste mahā taste swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gang gā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gtso 'khor gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni dbus kyi gdan la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa/ zhes pa nas/ na bza' can du gyur/120

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcugacig pa/zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin brjod/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i mtshan ma lnga'i gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su hrī las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ zhes pa'i bar dang / shar du hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag lhor t+t+waṃ las rin 'byung ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam ga'ag nub tu oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ byang du a las don grub ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar sna tshogs kye na bza' can du gyur/ las bum gyi nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī las khro rgyal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar ba'i khrod na rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug tho 'phyar 'ing / g.yon thugs gar sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ thod pa skam rlon dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 〉hūṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā dang / pāhūṃ gi gnayosu/ añtsa mā rna/arnya zhes pa bcug ste chu gsum phul/ jo rtu baṃ ho ma shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so la thim par gyur par bsam mo/ / bum pa'i mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya pratī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā dang / ar+bhe gyi gnayosu/ pābye/ pukhye nas/ shasta'i bar bcug pa'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod cing / rgyas par spro na/ tshigasasu bcad pa'i mchod phreng gi sgo nas mchod 121

༄khya/ /gung thangabasnyan ba'itshanasa'i gsung 'bugakyang rung ngo / /de nasarnam rgyal bum pa'i lha la sgrub thabs nasa'abyung ba'i bstod pa rgyasabasdus gang yang rung ba dang / la4bum gyi lhal/ hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lu4'jomasamadzad pa/ /dngos grub thams cad sgol pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha hūṃ dang / oṃ ā rtu/ lan bdun bzlas/ dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ ces dung chos kyi chu byin gyes brlabs/ hūṃ zhes brjod cing gzungs thag gi sne mo lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung / g.yas pas bgrang 'phreng bzung la/rangagi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kye thugs ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kye byin rlabs nus mthu rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur par bsam nas/ gtso bo'i sngags ring thung gang rigs brgya rtsa brgyad dang /'khor rnams kyi sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ ā yakhro bh+ya ཿ hūṃ/ oṃ ā ra tā sam+bha wa hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā be+e ro tsa na hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā sa mo snya sidha hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa rnamasabargya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig gam bdun re bzla/ gzungasardor layobum gyi khar sposanas/ hrī badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am sngags thung gang rigalobargya rtsa brgyad bzla/ yi ge brgya pa brjod de gzungasathag bsdu/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes pa dang / hūṃ lan bdun bzlas nayodung chosakyi chus bum pa gnyis gar mchod yon phul/ oṃ paspyon+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas nas bum pa gnyis gar me tog dkar po gsum gsum gzhug sarba ta thā ga ta pukhye nas/shasta'ibar gyis mchod/ oṃ par+sān+ta krota hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing las bum gyi chus bum pa gnyis la g.yas skor gyis bsangs te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba rnams ma rdzogs pa de srid du bgegs rnam par bzlog pa'i phrin las 122

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa/mdzod cig/ ces brjod nas las kyi sta la 'phrin las bcol/ gtor ma byin rlabs sgrub thabs bzhin byas rjes/ bum pa'i lha rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar po'i 'od kyi sru gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba bo ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pas gtor ma phul/sangasargyas kun gyes rab tu bsngags/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig dang / hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgogs shing / / zhes sogs kyiyobastod/ bum pa'i lha rnamayokyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnamasa'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur cing / mtshan ma'i lha rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas phyag mtshan gyi rnam par gan4par gyur/ ces brjod cing moyol rnam rgyal bum pa gnas dben par sba zhing las bum bsang gtor gye don du rang gi nye logs su 'jog bum pa'i lha la dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma zin par nyin re bzhin mchod bstod bzlas pa snga ma bzhin tshar re ma chag pa bya'o/ /bzhi pa lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sta gon gyi lha la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+bhe nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs te/ bdag nyid kyi lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ lag pa g.yas spos phor thogs/ g.yon pas dril bu dkrol nas/ bcom ldan mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ / slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang / / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ / mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ / dkyil 'khor sgrub par bdag 'tshal lo/ / de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ / bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ / byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / / gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ / lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / / 'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / / sems can bstan la 123

༄/ /yo ca bayopa' 0sa' ga lam/mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ / spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ / ji ltar nus pa nyer spyod pas/ / 'gro ba sbyangs phyir bsgrub par bya/ / de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ / rjes su brtse bar nyer bzung nas/ / dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ / nye bar 'byon par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /lnga ba slob ma sta gon la lnga/ kun slong 'chos shing gtso bor bskyed pa/gsol ba gdab cing 'dzin du gzhug pa/ sdom pa gzung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa/ so shing dor zhing 'khyor chu sogs gsum sbyin pa/ spro ba bskyed cing bsrungs te rmi lam brtag par gdams pa'o/ / dang po ni/ sta gon gyi tshom bu dang bum pa sogs yol ba lta bu'i bsgribs/ slob ma rnams khrus byas shingagos gsar ba bgos nas 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sta gon gye rim pa rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug spyi bye brag gi chos bshad ji ltar 'tsham pa dang khyad par du/ la la gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ /'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ / bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yi/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yis/ / tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ / tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ / 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ / 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu'ang rgyas/ /zhes gsang ba spyi rgyud nas 'byung ba 'di nyid kye don gang zag la la tshe 'di'i phun tshogs don du gnyer bas/ gsang sngags kyi las sgrub par 'dod nas de'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / yang gang zag gi rigs 'ga' zhig phyi mar phan pa'i bsod nams 'dod nas de'i phyir dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / la la 'jig rten 124

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhalabacugacigapa/las gzhan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod nas de'i ched dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa gsum yod pa las snga ma gnyis ltar mi bya bar/ phyi ma ltar bya dgos pa'i tshul bshad de slob ma ga'an don dang byang chub 'dod pa'i sems bskyed du bcug nas kun slong 'chos pa shin tu gal che ste/ bsam pa 'di tshig tsam du song na zeg chen pa'ang tshig tsam du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ / de nas slob ma gtso bor bskyed pa ni/ gsang chu gtor ba dang mnyam du/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasazhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/gnyis pa ni/ slob ma la gsol 'debs kyi tshig don bshad nas de rnams dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i phyi rol tu gnas pas gsol ba 'debs par mos su bcug ste/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ / dam tshig de nyid stsol tu gsol/ / byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par bgyi/ / zhes pa lan gsum rjes zlos kyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ bu tshur shog cig jeg chen po/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ / khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ / khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ / dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ / rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ / ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ / gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med pa/ / gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ / mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ / mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ / 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ / de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /125

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i ce' g.yo 'am/buyis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces pa'i don bshad nas sngags la mos pa brtan po 'dzin du 'jug /gsum pa byang sdom gzung ba ni/ mdun gye nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sogs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad bzhugs par mos nas/ bla ma dang lha tshogs kyi spyan sngar skyabs 'gro sdig bshags yi rang rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi smon sems gzung ba dang / byang sdom blangs nas/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bslab par bya snyam du sdom pa gzung zhing srung 'dod skyed pa sogs brda 'phrod nges byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhesapa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces pa'i bar lan gsum gyis byang sdom 'dzin du gzhug cing lan gsum pa'i mthar byang sdom skyes pa'i thob dus kyang go bar bya/ byin gyes brlab pa ni/ las sngags bajod cing bsang chu gtor la bsrung / slob ma rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga ba'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ nag po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la ā dmar po/ spyi bor 'khor 'o dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar pos mtshan par gyur/ ces brjod cing slob ma'i snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis dri'i chu byug cing / hūṃ ā / zhes gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byen gyis brlabs nas mchod yul du byas pa la/ dbu la me tog shangs la bdug spos/ spyan la mar me/ snying gar dri'i byug pa phul bar mos te mchod pa de ba'i rim pa bzhin/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra ju pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gasde/ zhes brjod na4'bul/bzhi pa ni/ so shing 'dor ba'i gnas rgyar khru bzhi pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi 126

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs rje chen po zhal bcugacig pa/pa'i dkyil 'khor la ba lce sogs kyis srab mthug pa'i ko ba tsam byug so shing 'o ma can gye shing ha cang sbom phra'i skyon dang bral ba drang shing srog chags med pa ma gas ba rma med pa mgo mjug mnyam pa sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad can dri bzang gi chus bkru zhing bdug pas bdugs/ rtse mor me tog bcings pa la bla mas/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te kha byang du phyogs pas slob ma'i lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin la des/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hi/ zhes bajod cing rtse mo nas 'chos te dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ltos pa med par 'dor/so shing gi mgo gang du bstan pa la brtags nas dngos grub 'di 'grub ces brda' sprod/ denas/ baṃ las skyes pa'i chu/ baṃ bzlas pa kha bshal ba'i phyir byen te kha bshal du bcug de nas/ las sngags lan bdun bzlas pa'i dri zhi/ma po'i chu khyor ba gsum/ oṃ hrī bi shudha dharmā sarba bā paṃ ni tsa a sru sho ngh+ru sarba bi galbā na a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas byin/ de nas/ bkra shis pa'i rmi lam mi 'khrul ba'i ched du ku sha mang ba rtse mo ma nyams pa/ hūṃ las byung ba'i ku shahūṃ zhes byin gyes brlabs pa stan dang / ku sha nyung ba/ dhī las byung ba'i ku sha dhī dang / las sngags bzlas nas sngas kyi don du slob ma'i lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du/ oṃ badz+ra tīspru baṃ/ zhes sngags brjod nas byin/ de nas/ hūṃ lasabyung ba'i skud pa dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad gsum bltab la mdud pa gsum brgyab ste/ oṃ budha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sar+pān swāhā/ zhes brjod cing slob ma'i dpung ba g.yas su bcing ngo / /lnga pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ / res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ / u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ / brgya lam yar ni res 'ga' zhig / gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ / mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ / de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ / bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ / sdig pa gang 'ig sngon byas 127

༄/ /༅ ca bayopa'itshonasa'i g.yo 'bum/pa/ / dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis/ / de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na/ / grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ / tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ / go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ / spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams kyi/ / blo gros shin tu dri ma med/ / de rnams kyis ni sdug bsngal kun/ / 'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag 'i/ / bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ / de ring rnyed pa mnyam med rnyed/ / gang gi khyed rnams rgyal ba kun/ / bdag nyid chen po sras bcas kyes/ /bstan 'di kun la yongs su bzung / / gnas pa skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ / de yis khyed rnams theg chen la/ / legs par skye ba nyid du 'gyur/ / theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ / lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ / gang gis khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur bas/ / de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ / zhes pa'i don bshad nas spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams la bsang chu gtor ba dang mnyam du las sngags bzla bas bsrung / sngagayode slob ma la bzlas pa'i don du byin la/ khyed rnamayokyiyoku sha che bstan dang chung ba sngas subacug nas/ shar phyogs su mgo bstan seng ge'i nyal stabs kyisanyal ba'i tho rangs kyi char rmi lam gang byung ba de nyid ma brjed par byos la/ nang bar nga la sbosashig ces rmi lam brtags par gdams/ slob ma'i sta gon thob pa'i gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs te srung ba'i don du las sngags bzla/ sta gon gyi lha la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sogs kyis mchod/ hūṃ badz+ra uta tiṣ+ṭha/zhes pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bzhugasapar bsam mo/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ stegs kyi khar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor legs par bkram/128

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcu gcigal/sngar lhag gnas byas pa'i bum pa spos rol sogs kyis sna drangs te dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor nas rnam rgyal dang las bum shar sgo'i kha nang lta'i g.yas g.yon du 'god/ dkyel 'khor la nyer spyod ma mtha' bcu las mi nyung ba'i gang rgyas dang / gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa bshams pa rnams/ hūṃ dang / oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas dbul lo/ / de nas bdag bskyed rgyas pa sngon du btang ste lha'i rnal 'byor laganayobazhin pa'i ngang nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs te/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ces brjod cing las bum gye chus dkyil 'khor lo gnas pa'i bgegs bsangs/ oṃ su bhā wa shurnyi sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ga'i hrī las t+t+waṃ dkar po 'od zer kha dog lnga dang ldan pa gcig mdun du chad/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du baṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang /phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hrī las pad+ma hrī sa mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa spyan rasagazigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa sku mdog dkar po lang tsho dar la bab cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal bcu gcig gi rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ljang /g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus ljang / g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/de'i steng ma dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams kyang spyan dkyus ring zhing phra ba/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ral pa dmar ser gyen du bsgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ rgyan spangs shing mgul ba dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kur thal mo sbyar ba/129

༄/ /gung cabastanapa'i sa'i khrung 4ma/g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng / gsum pas mchog sbyin las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ ba'i pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/g.yon gye gnyis pas gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin mdzad pa phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yang dbu'i gtsug tor dang mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing / ras bzang po'i sham thabs can/ nor bus spras pa'i gser gye ska rags dang ldan pa/ ral ba dmar ser gye phreng pas mdzes pa/rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/zhabs gdub can/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs shing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ shar du hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyamagazhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor tram̐ las rin 'byung ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ byang du a las don yod grub pa ljang gu/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kye na bza' can du gyur/ thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ba'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su 130
