༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chenapo zhal bcugacigapa/gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ki shā ra sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma dza dza ka baṃ ho ma shes pa'i rten brten pa rnams dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas nam mkhar bteg pa'i sta gon gyi lha la/ a: sogs kyis mchod/dza 4 paṃto sta gon gyi rten brten pa rnams kyang dam tshig pa so so la thim par gyur/slar yang thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khye ka ta sa ma ya shriye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan cing / 'khor rnams la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ pad+ma n+ta kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ swa bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can/ byed las zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster par gyur/ oṃ ar+bhe ā0྅/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ arnya gye gnas su/ pāhūṃ/ puṣ+pe/ gyo pe/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/ ne+e blu te/ shasta zhes pa rnams bcug ste byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub pa'i/ / zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / yon tan rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ / dad pa rgya mtshos 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ ār+ya lo ke sha ra sa pa ri wā ra arnya pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhe4dang / mchod yon gyi gnas su rim pa ba'in/ zhabs bsel/ me 131

༄/ /gung bang b.lopa'izla ma' gsung 'bum/tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang / a gyi gnas su/ 〉bye nas shasta'i bar bcug ste chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang /yang mchod yon gye gnas su/ gzugs mchog sgra snyan/ dri mchog ro mchog reg mchog dang / a gye gnas su/ rū pa/ shaste/ gadhe/ ra sa/spar+sharnams bcug ste 'dod yon lnga 'bul/ de nas/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba/ /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyangs phyir 'bul/ / bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog / oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye ā ཿ swāhā/ zhes pas na bza' dang / rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ / rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang / / rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyes/ / mtshan dpes rgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a li ka ra wa pu ṣa ṇi ā ཿ swāhā/ zhes pas rgyan dang / rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di/ / sna tshogs bcud kyis bkang ste phul ba yis/ / las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun byang nas/ /byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /oṃ badz+ra ka la sha ā :/ zhes pas bum pa phul/ phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / / gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/ / btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs gar zla ba'i steng du sa bon gyi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs drug so so'i gnas su song ste rang rang gi sdug bsngal las bsgral nas 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod cing / de thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu sngags kyi sgra bsgrags par bsams la/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa/ 'khor gyi sngags nyer gcig sogasagang 'grub bya/ 'dasagator byin gyisabarlab nas ljags byin rlabs man chad gong bzhin/ phyi rol tu cha gsum dkyus ltar gtong / nye reg byas pa layosngags gsung 132

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcugacigs/bzhinapar nang du 'ong ste/ rang nyid hūṃ mdzad du gsal bas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsam/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis bskor ba bya/ oṃ bzod gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha yashā/ zhes lan bzhisasgo so sor phye/ oṃ pra na ma mi sarba ta thā ga ta na/ zhes phyag byas la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig / ces gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gsum/ bdag nyid zhugs shing dbang blangs te bden pa'i byin rlabasabya ba/ slob ma bcug cing dbang bskur ba dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ bdag nyid zhugs nas dbang blangs pa dang /bden pa'i byin rlabasabya ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang /zhugs nas dbang blang ba'o/ / dang po ni/ bdag 'jug gi mchod pa rnams byen gyis rlabs/ rang la dbang bskur ba'i bla ma dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ngo bo dbyer med du mos pas rang la dbang gi bya ba rnamasamadzad pa dang / rang gtso bo las phye nas dbang zhu ba po'i slob ma'i tshul du mos nas thog mar shar sgo'i phyi rol tu gnas pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor rnams zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa phul la/ gsol 'debs kyi tshig don rnams dran bzhin par/ gdung shugs drag pos/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ / slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ / dam tshig de nyid stsal tu gsol/ / byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni gzhug bar bgyi/ / zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ las bum gyi chu 'thor pa dang bcas/ hrī badz+ra kro dha ha ya spre ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ oṃ pad+ma n+ta kri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa gang rigs brjod nas bdag dang dbang rdzas sogs kyi bgegs bsangs/ matsagru brnyi wa ra man ye swāhā/ zheyopas mig dar bcing / ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis me tog gi ma

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'itshonace' gsung 'bumaphreng ba bzung / pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya rang gi snying gar bcingayonas/ṭ+wāṃ ༵ngh+ru pat+t+waṃ ༵ngaye galda hānyi/ mazhe ༵ ṭ+wāṃ spyan/ por/nga 3ṭ+wāṃ narje ༷༷༵ ༵༵ ṭ+wāṃs ༷༵༷༵ spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyes lus 'od gsal bar byas par bsam/ sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin gyi byang sdom len pa'i yul dang kun slong sogs tshul bzhin gsal legs par btab nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs lan gsum gyisabyang sdom gzung / thams cad rnal 'byor gyi sems bskyed pa la byang chub kyi sems gnyis legs par bskyed cing / de gnyis kyang 'bras dus kyi sems gnyis kyi ngo bor moyonas/sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems kun rdzob pa de nyid/ snyeng gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par gyur/ chos thams cad rang ba'in med pa'i stong ba nyid dang / rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta usni ta yā mi/ zhes brjod/ bla mas rdo rje me tog dang bcas pas snying gar reg cing / oṃ su ra ta sa ma ya sto ho dh+ra badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes bajod nas sems gnyis brtan par byas par mos/ de nas gsang bar gdams pa ni/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyel 'khor 'di/ dkyel 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ / zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bcug par mos la dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi yol ba bsal/ de nasashar sgo nas thal mo spyi mgrin snying ga rnams su rim bzhin sbyar nas gtso bo la lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag byas par moyol/ oṃ na mo te hūṃ/ na ma me hūṃ/ na mo nam hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod/134

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcugacigapa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje chen po bdag la dbang par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hrī yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes hrī yig la sogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi lus la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha a a a/ zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs brjod/ bla masardo rje mgo bor bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes ye shes pa brtan par byas par bsam/ de nas slob ma la dbang bsgur ba'i skabs yin na/ mig dar cung zad bsal nas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la har gyis bltar bcug nas/ khyod kyi mig la ji ltar snang zhes dris la dkar po sogs su snang zer na/ zhi sogasakyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan tshul go bar bya zhing / 'di bdag 'jug la mi dgos so/ / de nas rang gi mthe bong gnyisabla ma'i phyag g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa4bzung ste/ rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyi gar gyi tshul gyis dkyil 'khor la skor ba gsum byas par mos nas/ lasasngags lan gsum brjod do/ / de nas bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas gtso bo la mngon du phyogs par byas te rdor dril bzung bas/yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / bdag gi slob ma bcug pa 'di'i/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ / bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog / 'di yi dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur/ / rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra bar/ / de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig / ces pa brjod nayobaden pa'i byin rlabs byas par bsam/ sngar bzung ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba tram̐ gyes bsngags pa las yang zhing ma rnying pa'i me tog gcig bton la lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ba rin po che'i 'phreng bar mos/ rang nyid 'bru gsum gyi 'od zer gyis sgo gsum gye sdig sgrib bkrus te dkyil 'khor 135

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'isgronasa'i ga 'phagagye nang du zhugs/ gtso bo 'khor bcas kyi mdun na gnas par gyur bar bsam/ de nas me tog de nyid gtso bo'i dbu la phul bar bsams nas/sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ / bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan pa'i gtso chen gyis/ / sman par dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ badz+ra pra ti grosna hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod nasame tog 'dor zhing 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na/ pratīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes pa'i sngagasatsam gyisador kyang rung / slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin na me tog gtso bo dang / shar lhonub byangagi mtshan ma rnams la phog na rim pa bzhin snang mtha'/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / don grub kyi rigs dang gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de'i rigs dang /nye ring mnyam na gnyis ga'i dngos grub 'grub pa sogs kyi brda sprad par bya'o/ /de nas bla mas me tog phul ba de bzung nas/ oṃ pra ti groṇ+ḍa snyi i mi satwa mahā bā la/ zhes brjod nas slob ma'i mgo bor bcings/ de ni me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur zhes bla mas lha la slob ma gtad pas des slob ma byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i thabs zab mo'o/ /de nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la hūṃ/ dpral bar ram̐/ mig gnyis la oṃ 'od zer 'bar ba re re bsams nas/ bla mas/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i/ / rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ / ces brjod nas gdong g.yogs bsal bar bsam/ te badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhesapas dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul rjes dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rim pa bzhin du mthong bar mos la/ de yang phyi rol tu rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de'i shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor 136

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chenapo zhal bcugacigal/rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu rnam par snang mdzad/ byang du don yod grub pa ste/ de ltar rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur bar bsam zhing / lhango ston pa'i tshig bsdusapa la mos na/ de ltar 'phags spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ ceyobarjod kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa zhugayonas dbang blang ba la bzhi/ chu'i dbang / cod pan gyi dbang /chos bshad kyi rjes gnang / rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi dbang ngo / /dang po ni/ dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ / mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ / bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ / nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag sgol/ / zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/dkyil 'khor gyi shar du dbang stegs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gyur bar bsam/ dbang rdzayobum chu la/hrī badz+ra kro dha sogs/ la4sngagasargyas bsdus gang rigs dang bum chus bsangs/subhā was sbyangs/ bum chu stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ hrī 〉 rnams las byung ba'i ye shes lnga'i bum chur gyur par bsam/ de nas dbang lha gsar bawān 'dren pa ni/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hrī yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs/ bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma dang bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rang gi steng phyogs su 'dzin/ glu gar mdzad cing rol mo brdung / me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char 'bobs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung pa'i bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur/137

༄/ /yo ca bstanar+yāsgron ཿ ga las/gzugasardo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyis shis pa brjod/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur par bsam/ bla ma nam mkha'i dbang lha dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu rang la bkra shis brjod par mos nas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/zhes sogs brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa'i chus/ / skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ / las dang nyon mongs sgrib ba dag gyur te/ / byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /na mo rat+na tra yā ya nas a pa na ye sāhā'i bar dang / oṃ ār+ya lo ke sha ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra de wa ka la sha a bhi ṣi ñtsa mi/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra snu dza ka la sha a ste ṣiñtsa mi/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ / lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ / de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ / oṃ ā badz+ra u da ka a snyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/zhes brjod nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'bras dus kyis ye shes khyad par can thob pa'i mos pa byed cing /slob mar dbang bskur ba'i skabs bum pa mgor 'jog pa dang / bum chu 'thur du bcug kyang rung ngo / de ltar dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / bde ba chen bo myong / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ rang gi ba sru'i sgo nas thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de ltar chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa lnga gnas bsgyur/ lam mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog 138

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs chenawa zhal bcugacig pa/go / zhes dbang gi dag pa brjod/gnyisapa cod pan gyi dbang ni sngar ltar gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ cod pan bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī ā las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi cod pan du gyur par bsam/ dbang lha gsar pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hrī yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur gye bar dang / sngar ltar mchog gsum gyi bkra shis brjod/ de nas bla ma thugayorje chen pos rang gi mgor rin po che'i dbu rgyan bkon par bsam nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan 'dis/ / skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ / sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ / rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa badz+ra pat+ta a snyi bañtsā mi/ zhes brjod cing dbang gi ngo bo'i zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / zhes pa nas/ khrus bgyi'o/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣe ka ta zhes sogs kyis mtha' rten chu dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / zhes sogs nas/ bdag nyid la mchod pa'i bar sngar bzhin/de ltar cod pan gyi dbang thob/ dri ma lnga sbyangs/ phung po lnga gnas bsgyur/lam mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/'bras bu gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go / zhes dag pa brjod/gsum pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra he tu me/ zhe4payomadun nam stan du byin/ dbyangs tha ma a las byung ba'i dung / oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa ram̐/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su byin/ dbyangs dang po a las byung ba'i bya rgyud rigs gsum gyi po ti/ a zhes brjod nasalag pa g.yon du byin la/ deng nas 139

༄/ /yo ca b.lob yo ga ཿma/brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos dung bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyes/ /zhes brjod/da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud kyang 'dzin par gyur/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / / lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par gsungs/ / sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ / khyod kyis dkyel 'khor cho ga bzhin/ / nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya/ / sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes brjod/bzhi pa ni/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugasabarnyan la las sngags kyilobasangs/subhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /theg mchog chos kyi srid la mnga' bsgyur ba'i/ /rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis dbang bskur bas/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /oṃ sasta rat+na a stiṣiñtsa mi/ zhesabarjod/ bkra shis rdzasabargyad/ lasasngags kyis bsangs subhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mi las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyadamathong ba tsam gyis kyang mi shis pa mtha' dag sel bar byed pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur bar bsams la/ gang zhig reg cing mthong thos dran pas kyang / /mi shis kun sel phun tshogs mchog stsol bar/ /rgyal bas byin gyes brlabs ba'i bkra shis rdzas/ / dam pas dbang bskur dge legs 'baragyur cig /oṃ aṣā pa tra be mgo li a sti ṣiñtsa mi/ zhesapas bkra shis rdzas brgyad byin/ de ltar rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi chos ston pa sogs kyi slob dpon du bya ba'i ched du rjes su gnang ba sbyin pas rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi dkyil 'khor bri bsgrub dbang bskur ba sogs la dbang bar byas/'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /'bras 1khu

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs chen po zhalabacugacig pa/bu rigs gsum gyi chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes brjod/ de nas/ dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad du mos pa la maṇ+ḍal rgyasapa 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bdag 'jug zin nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin na/ bden pa'i stobs brjod nas byin gyis brlab par bya dgos pas/ rdor dril bzung ste/ bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog / shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ / bden pa de yis mgon po khyod/ /'dod pa bdag la yongs rdzogs mdzod/ / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ / gzung du med cing bajod du med/ / rgyu dang las dang yang dag 'byung / / de nyid de bzhin nyid nges 'byung / / bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ / gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ / kun gyes sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces lan gsum brjod nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma bcug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ gong du bkod pa de rnams bdag 'jug gi dbang du byasapa yin pas ga'an la dbang bskur ba'i tshe rang nyid ces pa dang rang la zhes sogs rnams/ slob ma rnams zhes pa ltabur bsgyur zhing / tshigayobacadadang sngags rnams kyi don dang / dbang gi ngo bo ji lta bu zhig rgyud la skye tshul sogasaslob ma'i dbang po dang 'tsham par brda legs par sprad nas/ med du mi rung ba'i dbang gi skor rnamasam chad cing mtha' rten sogs la long skabs dang mos pa dang bstun pa'i rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba shesapar byas nas brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag len mthong ba brgyud pas kyang brgyan te leg4par dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba ni/ gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā gta ar+bhe pra tīsmo hūṃ swāhā nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod cing / bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ dge pa'i rtsa ba rnams byang 141

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sa'i g.yo sde /chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i smon lam dang bsngo ba shugs drag po bya zhing / phyag bzhes kyi rgyun la gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i mjug tu dpon slob lhan gcig tu smon lam dang bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i bden tshig shis brjod bcas mdzad pa'i srol yod/ de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba'am/ de ltar mos nas shar sgo nas gtso bo la phyogs par 'dug ste chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ / gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ / mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ / ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ / 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ / de kun gtso bos bzod mdzad rigs/ / zhes pas ma tshang ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bzod gsol bya zhing / rang gzhan gyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen thamayocad zhi zhing gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'dod don rnams 'grub pa dang / bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgyas pa sogs kyi gsol ba gdab/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ / 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / / mchog rnams legs par stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod nas ye shes pa ras bris la brtan bzhugs bya/ rang gibadag 'jug tsam len pa la bdag bskyed zin pa'i rjes subum pa sgrub/ de nas mdun gyi rayobris kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub ste sngar ltar dbang len pa'i rnam dbye shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa zhar byung cho ga'i yan lag gzhan bstan pa ni/ lho sgo'i cho ga'ang yongs grags ltar la khrus kyi skabs sogs su gzungs ring ngam pad+ma'i rigs kyi yi ge brgya pa 'don/ ngan song dgug dral gyi tshul sogs spyir rnal 'byor rgyud lasagasungs pa/ bla mgong ma rnam sa kyis rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu rgyas 'gebs mdzad pa yin cing / bya 142

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcugacig pa/rgyud la brten pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga tshad thub mang por mi 'byung bas ma byas kyang chad skyon medal/ rgyal dbang bdun pa'i kha sabo ṇi'i lho sgo'i cho gar dkyus ltar gsung zhing /'jug pa bde ba'i phyir spyi 'gro ltar byas na legs/ bdag 'jug sogs dang ma 'brel bar khrus dbang tsam byed tshe/ bum pa bsangayosbyangs nas/ gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du hrī yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ gzungs ring dang yig drug yig brgya rnams ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ zla ba hrī yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur bar bsam/ khyad par du 'di'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo thun mong ma yin pa lta bu sprung bar gnas pa'i cho ga ni phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pas/de nyid ji ltar lag tu blang ba'i tshul dang / bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga sogs kyang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung las shin tu gsal bar 'byung bas/ 'dir yi ge mang gis dogasanas ma brisal/ gzhan yang 'di'i rnal 'byor lha drug gi bskyed chog la ma mtshan bcas mtshan med kyis bgrod tshul sogs zab gnad cha tshang ba shes par 'dod na rje btsun yoshes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i bya rgyud don gsal sogs la blta'o/ / 'ar byung 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams su len par 'dod na/ dus gsum gyi dge tshogs mtha' dag kyang bdag dang pha ma rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i 'bas drung du skye ba'i rgyur bsngo ba sogayo'apho ba 'byongayopa'i rgyu tshogayornams sgo du ma nas bsgrub/ dngos gzhi la skyabs semayosngon du btang ste tshig don dran ba'in pa'i sgo nas/ri po ta la yi rtse mo nas/ / lha gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / ma mgon med 'gro ba'i mgon gcig khyod/ / thugs brtse ba chen pos gnas 'dir gshegs/ / zhes spyan drangs/ mdun mkha' la pad dkar zla ba'i 143

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'i sgonama'i gsang 'thugasteng / /sku'i snang ba mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/ / yid sgo gsum gus pa'ikhyag dang bcas/ / dpal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyes mchod/ /sdig nyes ltung gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /las rnam dkar dge la rjes yi rang / / chos zab rgyas 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ / dge mtha' dag byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ / zhes pas yan lag bdun pa dbul/ lus shel gyi phru ma bus pa ltar/ / ches dwangs shing gsal ba'i dbus kyi char/ / rtsa dbu ma smad phra stod sbom pa/ / rtsa'i mar sne lte 'og sor gsum tsam/ / steng tshangs pa'i bu ga thal gyis phyes/ / dbus chos kyi 'khor lo'i thad drang du/ / ches phra ba gnyug ma'i sems kyi dngos/ / mdangs dkar la dmar ba'i 'od chags pa/ / gsal 'tsher zhing 'phar la khad pa yi/ / 'od thig le'i gzugs su gnas par gyur/ / ces rtsa dang thig le gsal gdab/ de'ang rnam shes kyi ngo bo thig le de nyid 'phen bya dang / rang nyid 'phen pa po lta bu'i so so bar bsam nas ji tsam sbyang yang 'pho ba gnad du mi 'gro bar gsungs pas/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang der lam gyi 'du shes dang / rang dang phra ba'i rlung sems kyi ngo bo thig le gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa'i tshul gyi der 'gro ba bor mos pa shin tu gnad che'o/ /de nas yang mdun gyi mgon po spyan ras gzigs la dmigs pa'i dad pa shugs drag po dang bcas/ lha skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / rje drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med pa 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter/ / bu nyam thag 'gro ba'i mgon mdzod cig / ce4gsol ba gdab/ tshul de ltar gsol ba gdab pa yis/ / mdun mkha' la bzhugs pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ /tshur byon nas rigs bdag tshul bzhugs pa'i/ /sku'i dkyil du dbu ma stod phra zhing / / smad yangs pa rang gi tshangs bug dang / / dbyer med par sbyar ba'i yar sne'i nang / thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dngos/ / hrī dkar zhing gsal bas mtshan par gyur/ /144

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chenapo zhal bcugacigapa/ces brjod la mgonapo spyan rasagazigs rang gi spyi bor byon nas bzhugasapa'i dru ti'i yar sne'i nang gi zag med ye shesakyi ngo bo 6 yig de nyid rang gi dbu ma'i lam nas yar bltasate mthong bas/ rang nyid kyang der 'pho 'dod kyi 'dun pa shugs drag po bskyed la slar yang phur tshugs sugasol ba gdab pa ni/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i gter/ / rgyal sras phyag na pad+ma snying rje'i lha/ / cher snyigs lnga bdo gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams/ / sgrol ba'i thugs bskyed dam bca' nyer dgongs te/ / srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las bskyab tu gsol/ / 'khrul snang bar do'i 'jigs skrag bsal du gsol/ / bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bsgral du gsol/ / 'di snang zhen pa'i 'ching ba bcad du gsol/ /zhing mchog po ta la ru drang du gsol/ / byang chub bar du rjes su bzung du gsol/ / gsol ba 'debs so mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / byin gyes rlobs shig bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / zhesalan gsum brjod/ de nasasteng gi hrī yig las 'od zer thur du 'phros pa4rang semasazig le'i rnam pa de nyid nya la lcags kyusabatab pa bzhin du yar drangs shing 'og rlung drag tu 'azen pa'i shugs kyis gyen du 'phangs pa'i dmigasapa dang bcasangag tu/ nyi ga ce4brjod/ slar yang ka zhes brjod pas rang gnas su dbab pa lan gsum sogs su byas la/ 'chi ga'i nyams len nam/ gshin po lta bu'i don du yin na hi ka lan gsum gyi mthar/phaṭa ces brjod pas/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs de nyid po ta lar rgyangs te byon pa'i thugs ka nas rnam par shes pa phyir thon/ pad+ma'i spubs su yid lus blangs nas de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi longs spyad pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ /mdor na lha mchog thugs rje'i gter chen 'di nyid lhag pa'i lha'i gtso bor bzung ste las rab 'byams kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che sgrub pa'i tshul brgyud ldan dam pa'i man ngag bzhin nyams su bstar te dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par bya'o/ / de nas smon lam dang shis brjod ni/ thugs 145

ro / /gung thang bstonapa'izla sa gas 'bum/rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ dkyil 'khor mchod bstod bsgom dang bzlas pa sogs/ / bsgrubs pa'i dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / mtshan nyid kun ldan bshes gnyen zhabs bsten nas/ / skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis/ /thun mong lam gye dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ / zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur cig / 'phags mchog spyan stong mnga' ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /chudang cod pan byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chus/ / yid kyi bum bzang gang ba thob gyur te/ / dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog / tshogs kyi zhing la sbyor ba tshogs gsog dang / /sa bon phyag mtshan sku gzugs rdzogs pa dang / /bzlas bajod dang bcas srog rtsol rnal 'byor gyis/ / tha mal snang zhen dri ma 'khrud par shog / me dang sgra la gnas pa'i bsam gtan gyis/ /lha dang sngags kyi gsal snang mthar phyin cing / / sgra mthar thar la ster ba'i bsam gtan mthus/ / srid pa'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin par shog /'phags pa'i 'phrin las gru gzings la brten nas/ / mi bzad sdug bsngal rgya mtsho nyer brgal te/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub nor bu yis/ /re ba'i shing rta yongs su gang bar shog / tshe yi 'du byed gtong tshe spyan ras gzigs/ /'khor dang bcas pa mthong nas de ma thag / bu bu dag pa'i zhing du tshur shog ces/ / dgyes pa'i gsung gis dbugs 'byin thob par shog / nub phyogs bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du/ / yid 'phrog pad+ma'i spubs su skyes nas kyang / / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho rdzogs byas te/ / sku gsum go 'phang bde blag thob par shog / rab yangs lha yi lam kun spyan ras gzigs/ / 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor pas/ /khyod la mchog stsol rab dga' skyed cig dang / / shis brjod gdangs snyan bdag gis bsgrags par bya/ / dge legs me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs 146

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje chen po zhal bcugacigapa/pa/ / 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal ldan dpal mo'i zhabs/ / ye shes bzang po pe nya pa la sogs/ / dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs/ / mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang / / rnam par snang mdzad don yod grub pa ste/ / de bzhin gshegs pa lnga yi bkra shis shog / rtsa ba'i rgyud dang pad+ma dra ba'i rgyud/ / don yod zhags sogs rgyud dang gzungs kyi skor/ / mtshan bcas mtshan med rnal 'byor la sogs pa/ / lung rtogs dam chos rnams kyi bkra shis shog /phyogs bcu'i zhing na dad pas yid drangs te/ / rmad byung pad+ma'i rigs kyi nyams len la/ / brtson pa lhur len skal bzang sgrub pa po/ / tshogs mchog dge 'dun rnams kyi bkra shis shog / 'phags pa'i spyan sngar thub bstan tshul bzhin du/ / bsrung bar 'al 'ches myur mdzad mgon po sogs/ /mthu ldan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / deng 'dir bkra shis dge legs stsol gyur cig / nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i pho brang mchog / nyi zla'i 'od dang mnyam pa'i 'od 'phro zhing / / grangs med rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa la/ / dge mtshan ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ / khyed cag gang dang gang du gnas pa der/ / mi shis mtshan ma 'ga' yang mi 'byung zhing / / zhing gi 'byor pa phul du byung ba yis/ / bde legs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bkra shis shog / ces brjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo/ /smras pa/ dmigs med dbyengs su rol ba snying rje'i sprin/ / srid zhi'i gdung sel bdud rtsi'i snying po can/ / zhing khams rab 'byams kun khyab spro bsdu'i gar/ / bsgyur mkhas gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa dpal ldan dpal mo'i lugs/ / skal ldan smin byed dbang gi cho gar bcas/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen brgyud pa'i man ngag ba'in/ / nyung ngu'i tshig gis don tshang gsal bar bris/ / 'dir 'bad 147

༄ / /gung thangabastanapa'i sgronas gas 'thugadage ba 'dzaspu phrok+ṣa'i 'bras/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed ma dros mtshor/ /zhugs te mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dbul sel ba/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu smin gyur cig /celo'aphagasamachog thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcasapa thar pa'i grong du 'jug pa'i myur lam zhe4bya ba 'dini/ har chen thu med shog nasarnam dpyod mchog tu yangasapa rab 'byamasapa dkon mchog rgya mtshosabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesadam pagong ma rnams kyi gsung gi snying po bsdusate g.yar khral du bkod pa 'disakyang skye bo kun la phan thogs par gyur cig /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rab rgyas 'gro kun thar mchog 'bras bzang la/ /spyod phyir dga' ba brgya ldan pho brang nas/ /chos sbyin mdzad med dal 'gro'i rgyun 'di spel/ /dge'o/ /148

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje'i chenapo labarten pa/༄༅/ / 'phags mchog thugs rje'i chen po la brten pa'i char 'bebs bya tshul bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / thugs rje'i sprin gyi gdengs ka las/ / byin rlabs char gye rgyun 'bebs pas/ / skal bzang yid kye re skong ba/ / phyag na pad+mas dge legs stsol/ / de yang char 'bebs kyi gdams pa ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dgongs pa bzhin rje bla mas mdzad pa'i stobs po che'i char 'bebs/ klu dbang rgyal po/ rta mgrin/ khyung khra/ rig byed ma sogs lhag pa'i lha sna tshogs chos skyong du ma dang / dmigs brtse ma'i sgo nas 'bebs tshul/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal zla gsang gi rgyud la brten pa'i char 'be+ebs/ klu sgrub kyi man ngag rgya nag chu 'khor du grags pa/ sa lha zhi ba'i 'khor lo/ gnam lha drag po'i 'khor lo gnyis/ de dang 'brel ba drang srong rākhu la'i char 'bebs lag 'khor du grags pa/ rig 'dzin rat+na gling pas bum thang mkhar nas bton pa'i gter chos bzhin skyer phur dang / rdzas lnga'i smyug tshigs la brten pa/ bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i gter phran char 'bebs gla ba chu 'thung du grags pa/ dbang phyug chen po'i sgo nas rdzas sngags 'khor lo gsum gyis char 'bebs gcod/ sog lugs char rdo la brten pa sogs lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa zhig yod kyang / 'dir 'jug pa bde zhing 'di phyi gnyis gar phan pa'i thabs su 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas 'bebs tshul bshad par bya ste/ de yang rang gi sgrub nus na lhag pa'i lha gang yin kyang dngos grub phra mo 'di tsam tshol ba la dka' ba mi srid cing /149

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'atshonace' gsung 'bumakhyad par thugs rje chen po 'di nyid klu'i don la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang gis char 'bebs sogs la byin rlabs bla lhag tu myur ba'i tshul/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las/ gang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'di rtag tu 'dzin cing zlos pa la brtson pa'i sems can de dag bsod nams dang ldan pa yin no/ de dag bzlas pa byed pa'i tshe klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho 'ching rnams dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la sogs te klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma ni sa yongs su 'byung bar byed do/ / zhes gsungs shing / sa bsrung tshul yang sad ser than pa sogs kyi nyer 'tshe bzlog nas char chu dus su 'bebs pa lta bu yin la/ rgyu mtshan gzhan yang / rgyal sras thogs med dpal bzang gis/ in+d+ra bhu tis lung bstan 'phags pa sgrub/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dge slong ma dpal mo la dang por klu'i gnod pa drag po byung ba'i tshe/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis klu dang sa bdag gi ded dpon thugs rje chen po yin pas de sgrub na legs/ zhes bskul ba ltar/ li kha ra shing 'phel du 'di'i bsnyen sgrub la gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pas ring por ma thogs par 'phags pa'i thugs rje la brten nas nad zhi zhing / de nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te klu rnams dran du 'khol ba'i tshul/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bya rgyud don gsal las/ phyogs skyong bco lnga po thams cad bran du bkol zhing / khyad par du yang klu chen brgyad kyis 'al bcu gcig pa'i sgos kyi chos skyong du khas blangs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na 'di la sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug gi rim pa gsum/ dang po la rten gye gang zag tshul khrims rnam par dag cing bla ma dang lha la yid ches rnyed pa/yig drug gi bsnyen pa rab dung phyur/ 'bring bye ba/ tha ma'ang 'bum phrag bcu song ba'i sgrub pa pos/ sngon du dkar po phyogs brgyad dam/ sprung gnas ci thub/ ma mtha'ang sha chang sgog tsong sogs zhag kha shas kyi gong nas spangs 150

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje'i chenapo labarten pa/la dkar chog re tsam sngon du btang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bris 'bur ci rigs sogs rten rnams legs par dgram/ de'i mdun du dug rigs dang shakhrag gla rtsi sogs kyis ma gos pa'i klu sman sna tshogs gro phye dang sbyar te ra dkar mo dang ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sprus pa'i ril bu lug gi ril ma tsam kha dog dkar por byas pa brgya rtsa brgyad zangs kyi bum par blugs/ dar dmar gyis kha bcings nas stegs mthon por bkod/ yul mi las phye phud dang dkar phud bsdus pas mchod gtor gtsang zhing rgya che ba bsham/ ting shagabum pa/ 'thor nas/ dar lcog dkar ljang dmar sngon sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams sta gon bgyis nas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra byas la skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ bdag bskyed bsgom pa ni/ oṃ su bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ oṃ thu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3nya/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang ba'in med pas stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du cha dkar po las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrī la thim pas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba'i lte bar hrī sa mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ pad+ma hrī dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa sku mdog dkar po lang tsho dar la bab cing 'od zer 'phro ba/'al bcu gcig gi rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ljang g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus ljang / g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus dmar/g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams kyang spyan dkyus ring 'ing phra ba/'al 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs 151

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i me'i gatshi las/shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral ba dmar ser gyen du bsgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa tshangs bar spyod pa'i cha lugs can rgyan spangs shing mgul ba dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs gar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng / gsum pas mchog sbyin las bdud rtsis rgyud babs pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon phyi gnyis pas gser gye pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang mar bus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing / ras bzang po'i sham thabs can/ nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags dang ldan pa/ ral ba dmar ser gyi phreng bas mdzes pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub can/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs shing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī yig dkar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ po ta la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/dza 4 baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'odazer 'phros/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'igos dkar mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang 152

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje'i chen po labarten pa/ba'i bum pa thogs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya thi ye ā 4/zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ār+ya lo ki shā ra a pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos zhes sog4kyis bstod/ ril bu rnamasa.a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ril bu rnams pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrī las pad+ma hrī sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ pad+ma hrī dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ zhes rang sgra dor la dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi tshe 'di la zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ mchod bstod kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ de nas/mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs gar zla ba'i steng du hrī yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chosaskyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byinablabs nus mthu ma lus pa bdud rtsi 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ ril bu lhar gsal ba la thim par gyur bar bsams la/ gzungs ring ci 'grub sngon du btang ste yig drug ril bu'i grangs kyi brgya rtsa brgyad re bzla/ pad+ma'i rigs kye yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la mthar/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam paragyur par bsam/ dar lcog bzhi la dbus su rang rang gi sa bon dang /de'i gsham du 'og nas 'byung ba'i bzlas sngags rnams rin po che'am/ sman 153

༄/ /gung thangabalopa'itshanas gsung 4ma/dang sbyar ba'i mtshal gyes dbu can du bris pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rim pa bzhin oṃ las rnam snang gi rigs kye khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ ma ṇi las rin 'byung dang las kyi rigs kyi khyung khra bo/ pad+me las pad+ma'i rigs kyi khyung dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ hūṃ las mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi khyung sngon po g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi mdog can gyi sprul bzung nas 'al du gsol ba/ rwa dang mchu sder shin tu rno ba/ klu dkar phyogs pa rnams rjes su 'dzin cing / nag phyogs pa rnams tshar gcod pa'i nus pa can du gyur/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā0 thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ a pra tīsmo swāhā nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /sogs kyis bstod/ sngags phreng gi spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gong bzhin byas la yig drug dang / tabya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga ta bha wa na/ nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiji na a dhiṣ+ṭi te swāhā/ oṃ bakhro swāhā/ oṃ nā ga phu ba ti badz+ra tudhe/ mi li mi li/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bha ri sha ya/ bha ri sha ya/ char drag tu phob/ myur du phogamā ra ya/ spyo spyo spyo phob/ oṃ bu le ni te mi li swāhā/ char drag tu phob/myuradu phob/ ces ci mang bzla/ mthar/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas dar so so'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ khyung gnyis pa'i kha dog paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs su ljang gur gsungs la/ skyabs mgon mchog gi gsung las khra bo zhes 'byung yang / phyag mtshan khyad par med pas/ gnyis ka yang khyung 'di rin 'byung dang don grub kyi rigs gnyis 'dus su bzhed par dgongs pa mthun te/ rgyud sde spyi rnam las/ sems can kyi bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa'i sgo nas rin po che'i rigs yin la/ las su bya ba'i sgo nas las kyi rigs yin pas las dang byed pa po gcig tu bsdus/154

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje'i chenawa labarten pa/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / des na bzhi pa'i phyag gi ral gri yang don grub kyi phyag mtshan du byas pa min gyi/ mi bskyod pa thugs kyi rigs yin pas drag po'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ rigs lnga dang 'phrin las bzhi sbyor tshul de ltar dgos par rje yab sras kyi gsung rab du mar 'byung ngo / / de ltar sgrub pa'i rim pa sngon du btang ste las la sbyor ba ni/ chu gza' chu skar sogs 'phrod sbyor 'dzoms pa'i dus su klu gnas nges kyi chu mgo'i khar 'gro ba'i tshe/ lha'i nga rgyal dang yid ches/ sems can la gsung rab du mar 'byung ngo / / de ltar sgrub pa'i rim pa sngon du btang ste las la sbyor ba ni/ chu gza' chu skar sogs 'phrod sbyor 'dzoms pa'i dus su klu gnas nges kyi chu mgo'i khar 'gro ba'i tshe/ lha'i nga rgyal dang yid ches/ sems can la phan sems drag po gsal bzhin pas 'gro zhing / der gleb phral skyabs sems dang /skad cig gis rang nyid 'phags pa thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i skur bzhengs par bsam/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ klu chen brgyad la sogs pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi klu rigs thams cad spyan drangs/klu gtor rgyas bsdus gang 'grig btang la/ klu chen brgyad la sogs pa klu rigs bzhis bsdus pa'i klu mchog 'bring dman gsum thams cad dang /khyad par sa phyogs yul phyogs chu mig 'di la gnas pa'i klu rnams nyon cigakho bo khyed rnams la don med kyi glags tshol ba'i phyir 'ongs pa min gyi/ char gyi dngos grub zhu ba'i don du 'ongs pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i bka' dang / grub brnyes dge slong ma dpal mo/ paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu la sogs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i dam las ma 'da' bar char phun sum tshogs pa phab ste/ rtsi bcud lo tog rgyas par mdzod cig/ces lan gsum gyis bka' bsgo/ ring thung 'tsham par chu mig gi phyogs bzhir tho bslang la dar spyog bzhi so sor btsug ste/ sngar bzhin bsangs 155

༄/ /gung thangangastan pa'icanas gsung 'bum/sbyangs lhar bskyed pa nas mchod bstod kyi bar bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ga ru ṭa sa pa ri wā ra yi rda ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis bsngo/ slar yang mchod bstod dang / yoshesakyi khyung rig4bzhiyochar 'bebs pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad bzlog nas/ klu rnams gzhan du ma gtong bar char 'bebs su gzhug pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces gsol ba gdab/ de nas sdod ring nyin re bzhin mchod gtor 'bul zhing 'azin las bcol/ yul gyi gzhi bdag rnams la yang bsang dang dkar gtor btang ste 'dod don bcol khyad par du rlung gnon pa gal che bas/ ras sam shog bu la rlung lha gtso bo gcig gzhan drug gis bskor ba'i gzugs dang / de dag gi snying gar yi yig gi mthar/ bha yu stam bha ya li nan/ zhes pas bskor ba bris te mdun du bzhag nas bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las yi sngon po bdun yongs su gyur ba las/ rlung lha mched bdun du ba'i mdog can sha ba nag po la zhon pa/ lag pa gnyis kyis rlung ras dril te 'dzin pa/ rlung lha sha ba dang bcas pa gnyid log pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ nub byang nasarlung lha mched bdun bkug ste gzugs brnyan la thim par gyur/ bha yu akar+sha ya dza dza ka baṃ ho zhes gang mang brjod cing khug pa'i mos pa brtan po bya/ de nas yi so so la lte ba chag ma shor bar blteb la/ nub byang mtshams su dong gru gsum brus pa'i nang du bzhag de'i steng du khyi dkar sna dmar gyi thod pa'am/ rdza phor gyi nang du ri rab hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ gis mtshan pa bris pas bkab/ de'i steng du rdo g.yam la sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa'i dbus su rdo rje lte ba la li gyis mtshan pa bris pas mnan nas steng sas bkang / de'i steng du sasmo ser po rab gnas can gyes mnan pas rlung lha 'khor bcas thib kyisanon pas ldang mi nus bar bsam ste/ rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po 156

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje'i chen po la brten pa/dang / mjug tu/ bha yu sta ma bha ya su ma li nan/ zhes btags la ci mang bzla/ dngos gzhi chu mig gi khar ril bu'i bum pa'i steng du thugs rje chen po'i sku bzhugs zhu bcug mchod pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa bsham la/bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas/ mdun gyi sku brnyan la dmigs te/ a dṛ tas bsangs/ su'i wayostong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hrī las pad+ma hrī sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ pad+ma hrī dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ zhes sogs rang sgra dor la mchod bstod bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ spro na mchod phreng / rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad byas na legs/de nas/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka dang bum nang gi ril bu rnams las 'od zer phyogs bcur spros/ sems can rnams kyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par yul de'i skye 'gro rnams kyi rgyud kyi than pa'i gdungs pa bskyed pa'i las dang / de'i grogs su gyur pa nag po'i phyogs kyi klu la sogs pa'i bsam ngan sbyor tsub thams cad sbyangs/ yul gyi gzhi bdag klu gnyan thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa la bkod cing / byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par byas pas de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten khams su mthun pa'i gru char 'bebs pa'i las la brtson par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang bsrung ma'i tshogs la mchod pa phul zhing thugs rje bskul/ de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ nam mkhar sprin gyi phung po shin tu stug po 'khrigs pa las char gye rgyun chen po babs te rtsi bcud lo tog rgyas bas skye 'gro rnams dga' bde'i dpal la bkod par gyur bar bsam la/ dmigs pa gsal po re mos kyi 157

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'i sa'i g.yo ཿma/ngang nas gzungs ring dang yig drug gang mang / bar bar du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te sa myakle buji ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra/ tshirnya tshirnya/ badz+ra she la ting ye swāhā/ zhes sprin sdud kyi sngags dang /oṃ badz+ra turte mi li mi li swāhā/ zhes sprin 'dzin pa'i sngags/ oṃ nā ga ༅ bra ti badz+ra turte/ zhes sogs gong gi char 'bebs kyi sngags rnams spel te bzla/ zla grogs sogs stabs 'grig na sngags thun ma chad par bya zhing / thun 'jog khar yig brgya bzlas la mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ thun mtshan su yang brgyartsa/ klu gtor/ bsang / 'byung bzhi dang lan chags gtor ma sogs gtong ba/ sprin chen po dang gzungs 'dus sgrogs pa/ yi dam chos bsrung la mchod gtor 'bul zhing khrus gsol dang char gyi don la gsol ba 'debs pa sogs rgyab chos la 'bad/ yul gyi skye bo thams cad la yang thugs rje chen por gsol 'debs dang / yig drug grangs gsog byed du 'jug sha chang sgog tsong / tha ma kha/ dam nyams kyi zas dang / mi grib can la phrad pa/'thab rtsod ngag 'khyal sogs spangs shing gtsang sbra dang / sems can la phan sems/ dkon mchog la dad pa sogs sgo gsum bag yod la gnas pas zhag gsum mam bdun du sgrub na 'dod don nges par 'grub bo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi byang ni/ mchod gtor rgya chen po bsham la gtang rag gi tshul du 'bul zhing / dge rtsa rnams bstan 'gro'i don dang rdzogs byang gi rgyur bsngo smon rnam par dag pas kha bsgyur/ rlung lha'i gzugs kyang bton te/yul gyi lha klu rlung lha rnams la bsad dang dkar gtor rgyas par bsngos/'jig rten skyong ba khyed rnams kyis char dbab pa'i grogs ldan 'phrin las mdzad pa legs tshogs su gyur cig/ slad kyang char chu dus su 'beb cing /lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i 'phrin las sdongs grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes legs so brjod/ ril bu tshur go'i nang du blugs pas klu rnams 158

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugasarje'i chen po la brten pa/kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad lhun gyis grub par mos shing / bya khyi sogs kyis mi za ba'i thabs bya/ dar lcog bzhi'i khyung rnams kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su bshegs/ dam tshig par rang nyid la thim/'jig rten pa'i mgron glo bur du lhags pa rnams dang rlung lha sogs kyang rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs par gyur/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan cing /dar lcog bsdus te tho bsgyel nas rje mi mngon par bya/ yul mi rnams la yang 'phags pa'i bka' drin bsgrags te dge ba la 'god ci nus su bya'o/ /smras pa/ blo gros chu 'dzin 'khrigs pas legs bshad dang / / byin rlabs dbyar skyes 'phreng bas phan dang bde/ / sprin sngon brtsegs ma stug pos gru char gsum/ / lhan cig 'bebs pa'i dga' ston deng 'dir 'grub/ / gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ / gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang mthus/ / gang bsam yid kyi re ba'i 'bras bzang gi / gang bu g.yur du za ba'i bkra shis shog / ces 'phags mchog thugasarje chen po la brten pa'i char 'phebs byed tshul 'di ni/ sgyung gnas pa dge slong blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes skye bo rnams la 'phral yun gnyis gar phan du re bayobris pa'o/ /159

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izla ma'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / byung gnas kyi cho ga'i zur rgyan bde ba can gyi lam yig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / ji snyed rgyal ba kun gye thugs rje ni/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i mgon du shar ba'i lha/ / khyad par snyigs ma'i 'gro la jes brtse ba/ / bla ma spyan ras gzigs mgon zhabs la 'dud/ / bde gshegs gzhan gyis 'dul bar ma nus pa/ / khyod nyid gcig pus bdag gir mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang lha mchog kun las khyod zhabs la/ / gus pas bsnyen no byang chub bar du skyongs/ / de'ang dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyes 'gro ba skyob ba'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa ni brtse ba snying rje chen po yin la/ de nyid gcig tu bsdus te bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po yin pas/srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las thar bar 'dod pas med mi rung du 'di nyid skyabs bsten dgos so/ / de bsten pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba'i bka' bab kyi brgyud pa'ang 'phags pa thugs rje chen po nyid mi rje'i gzugs su byon pa srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum sogs nas 'byung ba rgyal po lugs grub thob dngos grub nas brgyud pa dang / ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bco brgyad dang ldan pa mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa dang / la stod dmar po'am dam pa dmar pos rdo rje gdan pa la zhus pa nas brgyud pa dang / bi ru ba grub thob mang po'i bla mar gyur pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta e ra pa ti nas brgyud pa dang / jo bo rje'i dpon po dā byang chub sems dpa' nas brgyud pa dang / dmar khrid byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa dang / gnyan tshem bu pa dar ma 'od zer nas brgyud pa 11

༄/ /sgyung gnas kyicho ga'izur rgyanabade ba can/sogs mang du yod kyang / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'grin las dang byin rlabs kyi bka' bab khyab gdal du che ba ni grub brnyes dge slong ma dpal mo'i lugs gtsotha sgyung bar gnas pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa 'di yin/ sprung gnas kyi cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i rim pa mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pas gsar du bri mi dgos/ 'dir de thams cad la thun mong du sbyor rgyu'i nyer mkho'i rim pa 'ga' zhig zur 'debs kyi tshul du 'god pa la/ spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir lo rgyus dang phan yon bshad pa/ gnad du 'gro ba'i phyir blang dor gye lag len bshad pa/ thugs rje bskul ba'i phyir gsol 'debs kyi dmigs pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bskal pa bzang po 'di 'a/ sangs rgyas stong 'byon pas/ gzhan rnams kyis rang rang gi zhing bdag gir mdzad de snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i skabs 'di yal bar 'dor ba na ston pa thugs rje can gyes rjes su gzung ste byon nas 'gro ba nams smin grol la bkod kyang / kha ba can gyi zhing 'di de'i 'ang dngos kyi 'dus zhing du ma gyur bar lus pa 'phags mchog thugs rje chen pos bdag tu mdzad de za ma tog bkod par gsungs pa bzhin/dang por sprul ba'i sgo nas mi'i 'gro ba bskyed/ de nas zas gos sogs gnas skabs kyi 'tsho chas dang / de sgrub lugs tshun chad bslabs te phan pa la sbyar/rim pas blo gros rgyas te chos kye snod du gyur pa na sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pas chos la bcug pa yin pas/ rang cag rnams la dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad las kyang 'di nyid bka' drin che zhing 'brel zab ste/ lha tho tho ri'i ring la bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa'i tshe'ang pho brang steng du za ma tog bkod pa'i glegs bam babs pa yin la/ srong btsan sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe ma ṇi'i sgra 'brug skad lta bu zhig grags shing gye re'i brag la yig drug rang byon du phebs pas gsung rten gyi mgo'ang de dag nas tshugs pa yin/ sku'i rten gyi thog ma'ang srong btsan dgung lo bco lnga pa'i gus tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po las rang 161

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sa'i ga ཿmabyon gye thugs rje chen po'i sku gdan drangs te rang byon lnga ldan bzhengs pa nas tshugs pa yin zhing / da lta'ang byis pa chung du tshun chad la ched du slob mi dgos par ma ṇi shes pa 'di de'i 'dul skal yin pa dang 'brel che ba'i rtags yin/ lhag pa'i lha gang la 'brel che ba de sgrub na 'grub thag nye la/ lhag par yang 'di snying rje'i lha yin pas 'grub sla ste/ sngon dge slong ma dpal mo la'ang sngon las kyis klu nad byung ba thabs gang gis kyang ma phan pa'i tshe in+d+ra bhu tis lung bstan te/ li kha ra shing 'phel gyi jo bo bcu gcig zhal la zhag bdun du gsol ba btab pas klu nad sos shing grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes/'ga' zhig gis skur ba btab par rang gi dbu bcad nas mkhar gsil gyi rtse la btags te gar stabs mdzad cing nga la pham pa ma byung na sngar bzhin gyur cig gsung bas phyir 'byar ba sogs rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan/ de'i tshe paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes bzang po bya bar thol mig byung ste lus lcags sreg bzhin tsha ba 'bar bas mtshe'u bskyil te nang du bsdad na chu khol 'byung yang sngon las kyis srog 'dor mi thub pa byung nas/ kho rang gi bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu gdan drangs pa na/ de la mkha' 'gro mas khyod rang phyin yang mi phan/ dge slong ma dpal mo spyan drangs na don che tshul gye lung bstan byung ba bzhin khong gis gdan drangs te phebs nas paṇ+ḍi ta gnyi gar dbang dang gdams pa gnang /ye shes bzang pos skyung gnas lan bdun byas pas nad lhag med du dwangs/mthar gnyis gas kyang mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so/ / de rjes bal po pa nye ba zer ba sems can la snying rje shugs 'byung gis dus 'da' bas 'di thams cad la phan che zhing sgrub sla ba'i gdams pa zhig dgos par 'dug snyam nas rgya gar du phebs te paṇ+ḍi ta de gnyis dang mjal nas gsol ba btab pas 'di las zab pa med gsung ste 'di'i chos skor gnang / lo lngar bsgrubs pas 'phags pa'i zhal mthong grub pa brnyes te sems can dpag tu med pa'i don 162

༄/ /smyungaganas kyichoga'izur rgyanabadeb can/mdzad/ de'i drung nas byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis gsan te rang byung wa ti'i drung du smyung gnas mang du mdzad/ zhag bdun la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas 'phags pa'i zhal mthong / sa chen kun snying dang phag mo gru pa sogasamakhas grub kun gye gtsug rgyan du gyur mi brgya phrag gi srog bskyabs pa/gtsug lag khang brgya phrag bzhengs pa/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi 'tsho ba sbyor ba sogs gzhan phan 'phrin las bsam gyes mi khyab pa byung / de'i slob ma nyi phug pas kyang 'phags pa bsgrubs pas mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la dbang 'byor/de'i slob ma spu ba rdo rje rgyal pos smyung gnas lo lnga dang / de'i slob ma zhing ston bheṭ+wāṃ dh+ridī ༷ ṭ+wāṃ/ spyardo ṭ+wāṃdīX ༷ ༷sumade ༵ñtsāb pa~X rlo sdu~Xsapa ba/la bag ṭ+wāṃrdo ༵//de'i slob ma byang sems chu bzang pa gsum gas smyung gnas sum brgya re song ba'i mtshams su 'phags pa zhal gzigs te grub ba brnyes pa sogs yi dam gzhan las 'di nyid sgrub thag nye ba'i lo rgyus shin tu mang ngo / / sdig pa tshan po che ji lta bu'ang 'di la brten nas sbyang sla ba ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzugs zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snyeng po 'di ni de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba legs so/ / lan gcig brjod pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur/mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po dag kyang ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur na/ ji skad bstan pa bzhin du nan tan bgyid pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'byung ba lags na/ bzlas brjod bgyid pa dang / bsgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ / su zhig bdag gi slad du tshes bcu bzhi'am/ bco lnga la sgyung bar bgyes na bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur lags so/ /163

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronace' gas 'bumabacom ldan 'das bdag gi ming 'dzin pa ni don mchis te/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum gyi bas lhag lags so/ / bdag gi ming 'dzin pa'i sems can thams cad ni phyir mi ldog pa nyid la gnas par 'gyur/ bro nad thams cad las yongs su thar par 'gyur/ sgrib pa thams cad dang / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi nyes par spyod pa thams cad las yongs su thar par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig cho ga bzhin du sbyor ba bgyid na de dag gi sug par sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob pa lags so/ / zhes gsungs/ thabs gzhan gyisasbyong mi nus pa dge 'dun gyi dkor 'phrog pa lta bu'ang 'dis sbyong nus rdozlo bhe~X la/ sathugaṭ+wā hūṃs che ༵napo dhing sdu~X rnyig che /g.yo ༵༵na sdu /sdu za /rji rdor+shadī 'phrog cing chud gson pa gang lags pa de dag gi sangs rgyas stong 'jig rten du byung ba dag la 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags na'ang 'byung zhing tshangs par mi 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on dang thugs rje chen po'i rigs sngags 'di bton pa de dag yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur lags te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi zhal zas dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor nor 'phrog cing chud gson pa de dag ni phyogs bcu'i ston pa rnams mngon sum du gyur pa'i spyan sngar bshags na gdod yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur lags la/ thugs rje chen po'i gzungs 'di 'don pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i ston pa rnams der gshegs nas dbang mdzad par 'gyur bas kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib pa de dag thams cad kyang yongs su 'byong bar 'gyur/ mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams ma mchis pa lnga dang /gang zag la skur pa btab pa dang / chos la skur pa btab pa dang / gso spyong bshigs pa dang / tshul khrims bshigs pa dang / mchod rten bshigs pa dang / gtsug lag khang bshigs pa thams cad dang / dge 'dun gye dkor brkus pa dang / yongs su dag pa'i tshangs par spyod pa sun par bgyis pa 164

༄/ /sgyungaganas kyi cho ga'izur rgyanabade ba can/'di lta bu la sogs pa sdig pa'i las lci ba thams cad yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur lags so/ / zhes gsungs te/ jo gdan mkhan chen bsod nams bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgyung gnas kyi lo rgyus las kyang / zas bcad de sgyung gnas byas pas lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag / gtam mi smra bar ngag bcad byas pasangag gi sgrib pa 'dag / chags sdang gi ngan rtog bkag ste dad pa dang yid bzlas byas pas yid kyi sgrib pa 'dag / de gsum gyis rim pa bzhin yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ dmyal ba rnams su skye ba'i las kyang sbyong bar gsungs/'on kyang yid ches kyi dad pa med mi rung du gal che ste/ the tshom cung zad cig skyes na'ang phan yon bshad pa ba'in mi 'byung ba'i tshul thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i lung de'i 'phro de ma thag tu/ ze tshom 'tshal bar gyur na tha na kha na ma tho ba chung ngu'i las yang ba tsam yang yongs su 'byang bar mi 'gyur na kha na ma tho ba lce ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags zhes stobs chung tshul dang / yang yid ches med par kha nas bton pa tsam la dgos pa ci yang med dam snyam pa la/ de ma yin par nam zhig na des kyang thar pa'i sa bon bzhag ste 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur tshul ston par/kha na ma tho ba lce ba dag yongs su 'byung bar mi 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang byang chub kyi ring ba'i rgyu ni bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ / zhes gsungs so/ /shin tu snyigs ma'i dus 'dir de 'di tsam la'ang don che tshul shes dgos te/don zhags kyi cho ga zhib mo las/ rje dpon gyis skrag pas bgyis sam/bzhad gad tsam gyi rgyus nyan par bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das mkhas pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mthus de dag gi rna khung du sgra de grag pa lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ / zhesapa nas/ g.yo dang rgyus mchod pa bgyid na'ang de nyid sems can dmu rgod dag gi dge ba'i rgyur 'gyur lags so/ / zhes gsungs te thugs rje dang smon lam bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i 165

༄/ /gung cabastanab po sa las/mthu yin no/ / spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong du sprul pa'i gzungs las/ gang zhig ri brag dgon par gnas pa'i tshe/ /gcan gzan stag dang dom dred spyang ki dang / / sbrul gdug can dang brlabs pa'i 'dre rnams la/ /sngags 'di brjod pa tsam gyis gnod mi nus/ / gang zhig rgya mtsho'am chu klung sar 'gro na/ / klu gdug 'jog po chu srin nya rnams dang / / gnod sbyinasren po 'bar ba ru sbal rnams/ / sngags 'di thos pa tsam gyis lus sbed 'gyur/ /pha rol dmag tshogs phrad de dgras bskor ram/ / sdig pa can gyes nor zas 'joms pa'i tshe/ / bsam pa thag pas thugs rje'i sngags brjod na/ / de dag byams sems g.yo zhing phyir yang ldog / gang zhig rje dpon dag gis btson bzung nas/ / khri mon dang ni btson rar 'jug pa'i tshe/ /bsam pa thag pas thugs rje'i sngags brjod na/ / rje dpon sems slod gnang zhing slar la gtong / / dug can zas rnams gnod par gyur pa'i tshe/ / bsam pa thag pas thugs rje'i sngags brjod na/ / dug can zas de 'phral du bdud rtsir 'gyur/ / bud med gang zhig bu dag btsa' ba na/ /gdon bgegs zhugs te sdug bsngal mi bzad tshe/ / thugs rje yi ni sngags 'di brjod byas pas/ / gdon bgegs byer zhing bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur/ / klu gdug gor 'dres rims nad gtong ba na/ / na tsha mi bzad 'chi sgor bsnyen pa'i che/ / bsam pa thag pas thugs rje'i sngags brjod na/ / rims nad zhi zhing tshe srog nus par 'gyur/ / klu dang chu srin gdon gyesaskrangs gyur cing / / 'bras dang shu ba rnag khrag mi bzad tshe/ / bsam pa thag pas thugs rje'i sngags brjod nas/ / mchil ma zebs gsum btab pas rjes bzhin 'byung / / snyigs ma can gyi sems can sdig spyod cing / /sngags dang byed kyis khon la shar gnyer ba/ / bsam pa thag pas thugs rje'i sngags brjod na/ / byang sngags drag po de la slar 'khor ro/ / dus ngan 166

༄/ /sgyungaganasakyicho ga'izur rgyanabade ba can/snyigs can 'khrug cing chos 'jig tshe/ / chags med bdo zhing 'dod la sems rmongs te/ / bza' shugs dben zhing nyin mtshan gzhan dag la/ /'dodapa'i chags sems gtong ba'i dus med pa/ / de tshe thugs rje can gyi sngags brjod na/ / 'dod chags me dang 'khrug sems 'gag par 'gyur/ /gal te nga yi sngags kyi yon tan kun/ / rgya cher bshad du bskal par mi rdzogs so/ / zhes gsungs la/ dam chos pad dkar du 'jigs pa brgyad las thar tshul gsungs pa sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon mtha' yas pa 'ig mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs shing / khyad par du 'chi kha'i dus sangs rgyas rnams kyis zhal bstan nas dag zhing du 'khrid pa'i tshul sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs las/ lha'am mi gang la la zhig thugs rje chen po'i tshig 'don zhing 'dzin par bgyid na 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams der gshegs nas phyag slong bar 'gyur bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang du skye bar 'tshal bar ji ltar smon pa ba'in du de dag tu skye bar 'gyur lags so/ / zhes dang / don zhags kyi rgyud las/ 'gum pa'i dus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge slongagi gzugs su mngon sum du zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ / bde bar 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ / lta ba 'khrul bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang du smon pa der skye bar 'gyur zhing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ / mdor na dam chos pad dkar las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gaṅgā'i klung drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa/ zhes pa nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de nyid la bkur bste byas pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa dang / gang gis tha na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag lan cig byas pa dang /167

༄/ /yo thang bstanapa'i ma'i g.yo 'a4/ming 'dzin pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa gnyi ga mnyam ste/ lhag pa'ang med/ 'phags pa'ang yod do/ / zhes mtshan thos pa tsam la'ang gzhan las lhag pa'i phan yon 'byung ba ni mgon po 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin pas/ spyod 'jug las/ de bas mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba yis/ / 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa'ang bsal ba'i phyir/ / rang gi mtshan yang byin gyis brlabs/ / zhes gsungs te/ snying nas gsol ba 'debs nus na nyin zhag gcig la smyung gnas bsrung zhing yig drug bgrang bas kyang / sa chen po'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i lo la dmyal ba'i me nang du bar mtshams med par bsregs nges pa'i las ngan tshanawa che'ang byang zhing dag par rgyud sde las gsungs pas/ rang cag thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig pa mtha' yas pa'i thog tu tshe 'dir yang sdom gsum gyi bcas mtshams dang 'gal ba/ bla ma dang grogs rdo rje spun dkon mchog gsum gyi rten sogs zhing khyad par can la sdig bsags pa/ dkor zas sogs la bag med du spyad de dmyal ba'i g.yang khar gnas pa rnams kyis lha dang chos 'di lta bu zhig dang mjal ba'i tshe sems shig yod na rang la nus pa gang yod kyi sa 'bad pa chig dril du mi bya ba'i thabs med do/ /gnyis pa gnad du 'gro ba'i phyir blang dor gyi lag len bshad pa ni/rang cag chos sgrub pa'i khul byas kyang ji bzhin mi 'grub ba de/ sangs rgyas kyis 'bras bu 'di 'grub pa la rgyu 'di byed dgos gsungs pa gcig kyang ma byas/ 'di dang 'di byar mi rung gsung ba thams cad byas pas lan pa mi shes par da dung sangs rgyas kyi gsung ma bden par brtsi ba ni spyon pa'i spyod payin te/ dper na shar gyi grong khyer du 'gro 'dod pa la gzhan zhig gis de'i lam drang por bstan kyang / kho rang nub tu song song nas shar du slob rgyu ma byung tshe gzhan des rdzun smras par 'dug ces bshad pa dang khyad med do/ /168

༄/ /sgyungaganas kyicho ga'izurargyanabade ba can/'di la dgongs te 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ tshul khrims 'chal la thub dbangagis/ / sngags 'grub par ni ma gsungs te/ / zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ gang zag bzhis ni 'jig rten du/ / bsgrubs kyang 'grub pa nyid mi 'gyur/ / byang chub sems ni ma skyes dang / / the tshom ldan pa nyid dang ni/ / bka' bzhin du ni mi spyod pa/ / dad pa med nyid 'grub mi 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pas/ 'gal rkyen rnams dang bral zhing mthun rkyen rnams tshang na 'bras bu ji ltar gsung ba bzhin 'byung ba la the tshom med do/ / de'ang bsam pa'i khyad par khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes pa'i nges 'byung dang / rang nyams la dpag ste ma rgan sems can rnams la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ de dag gi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa sems bskyed rnams ma mtha' bcos ma tsam re yin kyang gsal btab nas des zin par byed pa dang / sbyor ba'i khyad par khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba las ma 'das la/ 'dir sdom pa ni thugs rje chen po'i dbang nges bar sngon du thob dgos shing / der sngags sdom 'dzin rgyu med kyang byang sdom len dgos pas/ de'i bslab bya rtsa ltung bco brgyad dang / nyes byas zhe drug gi bsrung mtshams sogs 'dir bris na ha cang mang 'gro ba dang / bla ma gong ma'i gsung gi bslab bya rgyas bsdus ci 'dra zhig dgos kyang lag mi thogs pas de dag gi steng nas legs par rtsad bcad de bsrung dgos/ de'i steng du sngags kyi dam tshig kyang mang po zhig gsungabs 'dir lag len nyer mkho gal che ba 'ga' tsam smos na/ legs grub kyi rgyud las/ dngos grub myur du thob 'gyur ba'i/ / gsang sngags zlos pa'i 'dul ba bshad/ / mkhas pas gsang sngags cho ga dang / / gsang sngags rang bzo mi bya zhing / / bla ma dkyil 'khor ston pa ni/ spyod pa ngan par gyur na yang / / ngag gam yang na yid kyis su/ / nam yang smad par mi 169

ro༅/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgron 'a gsung 'bumabya'o/ / gzhan gyis rjes su ma gnang bar/ / gsang sngags gzung bar mi bya ste/ / rgyud dang dkyil 'khor bshad pa dag / dkyil 'khor ma zhugs la mi sbyin/ / sngags kyi sgrub pa po dag dang / / lhan cig nam yang 'gran mi bya/ / nyes pa chung ngu dag la ni/ / khros nas drag shul spyad mi bya/ / zlos pa cho ga la gnas pas/ / glu gar rtsed mo mi bya ste/ / mdzes par bya phyir phreng ba dang / / kha dog 'chang bar mi bya'o/ / 'gong ba dang ni mchong ba dang / /rgyug pa dang ni tsab hral dang / / lus las byung ba'i gnas ngan len/ /thams cad yongs su spangs par bya/ / bden pa'i chos la gnas pa yis/ /don med gtam yang mi bya'o/ / blo can bzlas brjod byed pa na/ / sngags g.yog gcig pu ma gtogs par/ / gzhan dang lhan cig dgos med par/ /'ga' dang yang ni smra mi bya/ / snyim pa kho nar mi za ste/ / 'khor ba'i snod du'ang za mi bya/ / lo ma'i rgyab tu'ang mi za zhing / / mkhas pas chags pa'i zas mi za/ / yang dang yang du mi za ste/ / ha cang chung dang cher mi za/ / mi za bar yang mi bya la/ / gang dag dogs pa'ang mi za'o zas dang de bzhin spyod pa la/ / ma bsdoms par ni yongs mi bya/ / sgrim pa lhod par mi bya'o/ / yid ni gzhan du ma gyur dang / / bsam pa mang po ma yin dang / / mi gtsang chags pa'i sems med par/ / zlos pa pos ni gsang sngags gdon/ / zhes dang / dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud las/ stangs dang mchong ba dang ni gar byed dang / / glu len rnga brdung skye bos dpyas 'gyur dang / / lhag pa'i nga rgyal 'drid dang 'dod chen dang / / rgyan po dang ni 'dus pa blta 'dod dang / / dus min gnyid dang mi 'grub smra ba dang / / bstan bcos ngan dang snyan dngags klog 'don dang / / chags dang 'tshigs dang dregs dang rgyags pa dang / / zhe la 'dzin dang le lo g.yo sgyu spang / sha chang ko'u btsong dang sgog rdog dang / / 'bru mar til dang la 170

༄/ /sgyung gnas kyicho ga'izur rgyanabade ba can/phug su ra na/ / 'byung po'i zas dang lha bshos gtor ma dang / / gu lang mchod byas gtor ma mi za'o/ / zhes gsungs/ don zhags kyi rgyud las kyang /chang dang sha dang kun dong dang ke'u dang sgog skya dang / 'dres pa dang / lhag roladang / 'di rnams khyad par du don du gnyer bas spang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes dri ngan 'di dag la 'dzem dgos tshul nan tan du gsungs pas nges par phanayon zhiga'adod na shin tu zlon byed dgos te/ sngon lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i slob ma zhig la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs gnang nas sgom du bcug pa'i tshe des kyang rtse gcig tu bsgrubs te dus yun ring song yang grub pa'i mtshan ma gang yang ma byung pa na/ lo chen gyi zhal nas ngas ni khyod la dga' bzhin du byin pa yin/ cho ga'i yan lag 'dra nyams pa min nam gsungs pa na/ khong gis cho ga'i yan lag gzhan rnams tshang ste/ khrus byed pa ma byung zhus pa na/ lo chen gyi zhal nas des lan pa yin pas da khrus kyis la sgrubs shig ces gsung / khong gis kyang de bzhin byas pas myur du grub pa'i gtam rgyud lta bu/ phra mo de tsam res kyang phan gnod chen po byung ba yin/mdor na bya rgyud don gsal las/ 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams dag pa dang /byang sems kyi spyod pa la slob pa ga'ir bzung nas sngags kyi nyams len bya dgos tshul dang / skabs 'dir gtsang sbra shin tu gal che bas spyod lam kun tu gtsang sbra dgos tshul dang / de'i nang nas kyang bza' btung gi tshe gtsang sbra shin tu gal che bas/ gnas gang du za ba dang / gang du mi rung ba'i khyad par/ snod gang du za ba dang gang du mi rung ba'i khyad par/ zas gang za ba dang gang za mi rung ba'i khyad par/ sbyin bdag ji lta bu la slong rung ba dang mi rungaba'i khyad par rnams zhib tu shes par byas nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar byed pa shin tu gal che/ gsungs pa ltar yin pas zas dang spyod lam gyi skor dade la gzab dgos lhag par yang bdud kyi cho 'phrul/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i 171

༄/ /gung ca bayo༅ ཿ go ཿmarang rtags tha ma kha zer ba'i rdzas ngan 'di la shin tu 'dzem dgos te/ gong du sgog pa sogs la dgag bya cher mdzad na'ang / de'i nus pa 'dul ba mdo rtsa bar/ sgog skya ni zhag bdun/ kun dong ni zhag gsum/ ke'u ni zhag gcig ma lon par gtsug lag khang du 'jug par mi bya'o/ / zhes yun de'i bar du dri ngan yal mi thub pas gtsug lag khang du 'jug mi rung yang / rlung nad can gyis rten gsum med pa'i dben bar bsdad na skyon med par gsung /'di ni dri ngan pa tsam ma yin par 'di phyi kun la gnod pa'i nyes dmigs mang po yod de/ de'i rgyu mtshan dang po'i 'byung khungs kyang / slob dpon pad+mas rat+na'i lung bstan du gsungs pa ltar dam srid srun dgu'i chung gis smon lam log 'debs byas pas bdud rigs kyi bud med cig tu skyes slar yang las smon logs pa de la gsos btab ste shi ba'i zla mtshan gyes sa bon byas nas skyes/ dam sris snying bsgul te skye bo mang pos de la longs spyod pas 'phral du dga' snang skye zhing / de nas nyon mongs pa dug lnga me ltar mched/sgo gsum gyi spyod pa thams cad lad/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams mnol/ nad 'don kun gyi sna 'dren pa'i nyes dmigs shin tu mang ste/ rat+na'i lung bstan las/ rten gye sku la du ba phog pa yis/ / lhan cig skyes pa'i lha ni bros pa dang / /'thung ba'i mod la byang chub sems rtsa skems/ / srog rtsar gdon zhugs tshe thung dbugs kyang 'tshang / / bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams sna 'dren byed/ / mdog ngan 'gyur dang mkhris nad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /yul der mu ge byung nas phal cher 'chi/ / 'thab rtsod 'khrug pa byung nas mtshon gyis 'chi/ / bstan 'dzin sku tshe mi brtan zhing gzhan gshegs/ /dug gi dud pa ha cang che drag pas/ / nam mkhar ltas ngan gtong ba'i skar ma 'char/ / dug gi dud pa nam mkhar phog pa yis/ / lha yi grong khyer 'bum tsho 'jig par byed/ / de yi stobs kyes gnam nas char mi 'bab/ /172

༄/ /sgyungaganas kyicho ga'izwarargyanabade ba can/dug gi dud pa sa gzhir phog pa yis/ / klu yi grong khyer chen po 'bum tsho 'jig / de yi dbang gis gnam la sprin mi 'byung / / char chu mi 'bab lo phyugs mi legs shing / / 'thung ba'i mi rnams yi dam lha bsgrubs kyang / /lha zhal mi ston tshur la gdon zhal mthong / / bskal par bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub bar chad 'byung / / zhes dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol bas sad ser dang / / mi 'dod 'bras bu sna tshogs 'gro la 'byung / / rnam smin rang nyid ma zad dri phog pa'i/ / 'gro rnams dmyalab yi dwags dud 'gro sogs/ / gnas ngan mi khom gnas su skye bas na/ / rig ldan su zhig de 'dra la mi 'dzem/ / zhes gsungs shing / rang gis 'azen par ma zad gzhan gyis 'azen pa'i du ba phog na'ang dge sbyor la shin tu gnod par rgyal sras blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis gsungs so/ / 'di sangs rgyas kyi dus su med pas gleng gzhi ma byung ba ma gtogs/ byung na chang dang khyad med du 'gog rgyu'i tshod yin zhes paṇa chen gyis gsungs tshul dam pa gong ma'i gsung rgyun las 'byung bas/ 'dul ba mdor bsdus kyi don bzhin rung mthun sbyar tshe 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa'ang chen por 'gro/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'dis sems myos par byed cing mang du bsten gyin spyod pa je rtsing du song ste 'phyar g.yeng sogs bag med pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs la 'dug par 'gyur ba dang / dam sri'i log smon gyis bskyed pa'i rdzas yin pas/ dam sris sna drangs te gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad sha rul la sbrang bu 'khor ba bzhin du der 'du/ de dag 'dus pa bzhin gyes grib dang cham pa glo nad tshad rims sogs lus kyi nad sna tshogs pa/ 'dod chags phrag dog sogs nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa dang de la brten pa'i lus sems kyi sdug bsngal mi kha gtam ngan sogs mi 'dod pa sna tshogs pa/ yul khams su'ang sad ser lo nyes mi nad phyugs nad dmag 'khrug sogs bkra mi 173

༄/ /yo ca bayobasoyo ga ༅mashis pa sna tshogs sgo du ma nas 'ong ngo / /khyad par du sgrub pa nyams len byed pa la phyi'i sgab 'dre mnan pa zhes dam sri phar bskrad dgos pa de bsam bzhin du tshur bos/ bsten rgyu'i yi dam chos srung rnams la lha dbye'i rdzas ngan gyi dudapa bdug ste rang mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i thabs pha rol gyi byad mas byed rgyu de rang gis byas pa yin sngags kyi nus pa nyams shing / du ba mang du 'then pa des rtsa lam rnams 'gags te 'pho ba sbyangs kyang mi thebs la 'chi kha'i dus skyes bu dam pa gzhan gyes 'pho ba btab kyang phan mi thogs pas 'di phyi gnyis phung ba/ gzhan gyes mthong na ma dad pa skye bas khyim pa sun 'byin du 'gro zhing bstan pa'i dbu 'phang smod pa/ nyes dmigs che la dgos pa ci yang med pa'i spyon pa'i spyod pa lta bu 'dir dga' ba ni shes rgyud bdud kyis brlams pa yin pas rtog dpyod dang ldan pa zhig yin na 'jug tshul med do/ /de dag gis spang bya'i gtso bo rags rim tsam bshad pa yin zhing / de nas lag tu len rgyu'i rim pa nyer mkho gal che ba rnams brjod na/ bsnyen mtshams lta bu byed tshe gnas bzang por phyag dar byas te bgegs gtor gtang / oṃ a mo ghas man+ta/ da sha di ka mahā bi ma na/ brnya yi ju ru ju ru hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yungs ka ra lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas mtshams gcad/yul lha la dkar gtor bsngos/ sman pa lta bu gal can slar 'ongs dgos pa yod na de'i 'du shes kyi de'u bzhag ste mtshams nang du yod pa'i dmigs pa bya/rgyun gyi mtshams g.yog dam gtsang bag yod blo dang mthun pa gal che/mtshams tho 'phags skyes por bsams la mchod pa dngos su yod na a sogs dang / med tshe mahā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya shri me〉/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dzā la tiṣ+ṭha sidhi lo tsā ni sabra arja sādha ni swāhā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas sprul te dbul/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ / sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ / bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes 174
