༄/ /sgyungaganasakyitshoga'izurargyan bdeb can/bzhin/ / bdag gi sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig / ces pa lta bus 'phrin las bcol/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mo gha bi mok+ṣa/ maṇ+ḍal mahā da ju ta bi ma le/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ra rnyi ra/ mahā ཿ ta/ a mi tā bha/ ma ku ṭa dha ra hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzlas te bsngags pa'i chusachag chag btab ste 4gzhi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a mo gha pad+ma sa sun dha ra/ rnya ra rnya ra/ dha ra ṇi/ maṇ+ḍi hūṃ/zhes bstan byin rgyas brlab/ oṃ a mo gha rak+ṣa ṇa/ pā shaha ste/ bhu ru bhu ru swāhā/ zhes bdag bsrung ba bya ste 'di dag bla med kyi srung 'khor sgom pa'i dod yin/ stan gyi 'og tu g.yung drung g.yas skor bri zhing dur ba dgram par 'jamadapal rtsa rgyud las gsungs la/ dpung bzang gi rgyud du ku sha dgram par gsung / dus yar ngo'i tshes brgyad dang bco lnga sogs gtso bor bya ste/don zhags kyi rgyud las/ rig sngags 'chang ba khrus byas nas/ / gos gtsang bgos te smyung ba la/ / nye bar gnas pa tshes brgyad dam/ / bcu bzhi tshes ni bco lnga ste/ / zla ba yar gyi ngo la bsgrub/ / ces gsungs/ khyad par bzhi ba'i bco lnga ni dus chen gsum 'dzom yin par ma zad/ dge slong ma dpal mos lam 'di'i sgo nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i dus yin zhing /brgyud pa'i bla ma mang pos kyang dus 'dir 'phags pa'i zhal gzigs pa sogs kyi rten 'brel gyis sgrub pa'i mgo 'di nas brtsams na byin rlabs myur ba'ikhyad che/ kha lta phyogs shar du gsung ba mang yang / sgyung gnas 'di la khang pa'i stabs 'grig na nub tu blta zhing / min na der yid kyis mos pa gtso bor byed pa sgos chos yin/ de nas/ oṃ a mo gha dza la bim le/ su ru su ru swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pa'i dri bzang gi chu khrus dang nye reg sogs kyi don du bzhag / dkyil thang dam pad+ma 'dab brgyad la tshom bu dgod pa 175

༄/ /yo thang bstanapa'i me'i go lam/dang / gzhan yang 'phags pa'i sku bris 'bur ci rigs/ bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas btab pa'i bum pa gtsang ma mgul chings can mchod gtor dang bcas pa bsham tshul ngag 'don gye rim pa sogs cho ga'i gzhung bzhin bya/ don zhags las gtsug tor sogs kyi chos gos thams cad la sngags mang po so sor gsungs pa bzhin grub na rgyud sde gong ma'i skye mched byin rlabs sogs kyi dod yinapas gal che la/ dngos dag pa zhi ga yong dka' bas de thams cad kyi tshab tu sku gsung thugs byin rlabs kyi 'phro der lag pa pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul du byas pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam rgya snying ga sman mtshams/ mgrin pa/ dpung mgo g.yas g.yon te gnas lngar gtugs la/ oṃ pad+ma uste wa ye swāhā/ zhes pa tshar lnga brjod na go chod bas nan tan tu bya'o/ / 'phreng ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la bo de tse/ pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma'i snying po/ rdo rje'i rigs la ru rak+ka mchog tu gsungs pas skabs 'dir pad+ma'i snying po 'byor na rab dang / de min po de tse'am/ shel 'phreng gang rigs byas na legs par mngon/ 'phreng ba gsar du bzung ba'am mtshams mgo lta bu la snyim par ba'ag ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ke te shā rā ya/ bo rnyi satwa ya/ mahā satā ya/ oṃ amṛ tam ga le shrī ye shrī ya ma yi na sāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas rab gnas bya/ rgyun par bzlas pa byed dus ni/ thal mo snyingapa/ra sbyar nas/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta pra ṇa ma na sarba ta thā ga tā badz+ra pā da bsnya ni ka ro mi/ zhes ltadang bla ma la phyag byayote 'phrengabasnyim par blangs la/ oṃ ba su ma tai shrī ye swāhā/ zhes pa 'di lan bdun bzlas te byin gyes brlab/ zhogs ka ngag byin rlabs/ 'gyur sngags/ phreng sngags sogs kho 'os chos spyod gsal sgron du bkod pa bzhin byas yod na des 'thus/ 'phreng ba 'dzin tshul/ gung mo dang mthe'u chung brkyangs/ mdzub mo rgyab tu bzhag nas srin lag dang mthe bos 'dren par gsungs la/ 'di'ang 176

༄/ /sgyungaganas kyichoga'izur rgyanabadeb can/las thams cad pa la shis pa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin lugs yin pas thog mar gzungs ring ngam snying po brgya rtsa re lta bu g.yas kyis de bzhin 'dren la/rgyun par ma spyogs na g.yon pas kyang gang bder bgrang chog par sngags rim las gsung / bzlas pa'i skabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs gar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra'am zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ de'i thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrī dkar po/ de la sngags phreng dkar po 'od zer spro bzhin pas g.yas skor dubaskor ba/ de'i 'od zer gyis lus gang bas sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cadasbrangs/ phyir spros pa'i sne las mchod lha spros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/rigs drug so so'i gnas su song ste rang rang gi sdug bsngal las thar par byas/'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod pa sogs 'khyer so gsum gye ngang nas bzla/sngags 'don tshul ni dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud las/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing / / sgra cher mi bya ha cang chung ba'ang min/ / smra bzhin ma yin gzhan du g.yeng bzhin min/ / gug skyed klad kor tsheg rnams nyams pa min/ / zhes dang / legs grub kyi rgyud las/ bzlas brjod byed pas khro mi bya/ / yul gyi bdag nyid dga' mi bya/ / zhum dang mi dga' 'jigs pa dang / / 'jungs dang nga rgyal yongs su spangs/ / zlos tshe ci yang mi smra zhing / / yan lag 'gyur par mi bya'o/ / kun rtog rlung gis bskyod nas ni/ / ci yang rung ba mi bsam mo/ / zhes rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar gsungs pas sems ma g.yeng ba shin tu gal che ste/ gdong drug gi rgyud las/ gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems kyis ni/ / de lta'i tshul du bzlas pa bya/ / yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis/ / bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / bzlas pa'i skabs nor nas lha gzhan gye sngags bzla ba dang / gtam smra ba/ gnyid dang 'og rlung /177

sa / /gung thang bstanapa'izla ce' gsung 'chagaglal ba dang sbrid pa sogs byung na nye reg byas nas thun slar bsdams dgos kyi/de yan la thun der bzlas pa rnams kyis grangs kyi go mi chod do/ / gzhan yang 'phreng ba ma rdzogs par 'phro bzhag pa dang / gnas gzhan du bzlas pa'i 'phro bskang ba lta bus bsnyen grangs kyi go mi chod la/ mtshan mo rmi lam ngan pa byung tshe nangs par rigs kye bdag po'i sngags brgya ma bzlas par bsnyen pa byas kyang grangs su mi 'gro bar gsungs so/ / bya rgyud kyi skabs 'dir spyod lam shin tu gzab dgos la/ thun ring na skyon med cig 'ong dka' bas dang po thung tsam byas na legs/ thun gyi grangs ni bsam gtan phyi ma las/ dus gsum du ni phra mo 'di/ / gsang sngags sgrub la brtun pa yin/ / zhes dang /legasagrub las/ mkhas pas dus gsum kho nar yang / / khrus byas nas ni bzlasabarjod bya/ / zhes gsungs la/ don zhags kyi rgyud las kyang / gso sbyongadag ni blangs pa dang / / dkar gsum zas kyi 'tshal nas su/ / dus gsum bzlas brjod bgyis nas su/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dus gsum ni legs grub las/ snga dro mel tshe thun gcig dang / /phyi dro mel tshe thun gcig bzlas/ /nyi ma'i gung la thun phyed dam/ / yang na thun gyi sum cha gcig bzlas/ / yang na thun gyi bzhi cha'am/ / yang na mkhas pas cung zad bzlas/ /zhes snga dro nyi ma phyed shar nas grib ma sor bzhi la sleb pa'i bar dang / nyin gung chu tshod brgyad dam dgu/ phyi dro grib ma sor bzhi lus pa nas nyi ma phyed nub pa'i bar gsum la byed par sngags rim las gsungs/ don zhags las/ nyin par dus su lan gsum re/ / mtshan mo'i dus su lan gsum bgyed/ / ces thun drug byed tshul yang gsungs la/ legs grub kyi lung snga ma'i 'phror/ mtshan mo srod dang tho rangs la/ / mel tshe thun ni phyed de du/ / gang zhig mkhas pas bzlas byas pa/ / de ni lhag par mchod par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar na mtshan thun gnyis lta bur snang zhing / de ni nyi ma 178

༄/ /sgyungaganasakyi cho ga'izwar rgyanabadeb can/phyed nub nas srod phyed kyi bar dang / tho rangs kyi phyed nas nyi ma phyed shar ba'ibar yin la/ nam phyed kyi dus de bsnyen grangs dngos gzhi'i dus yin min sngags rim la dpyad dgos/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni legs grub las/bco lnga man chad grangs rnams la/ / spyir na yi ge du yod pa/ / de snyed 'bum phrag bzlas brjod bya/ / yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ / bzlas bajod sum 'bum bya bar bshad/ / de bas yi ge mang po la/ / sngon du bsnyen pa khri bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / zla phyed kyi mtshams su smyung gnas byas te ba byung dang bcas pa'i chu la/ na mo bha ga wa te usmo ṣa ya i bi shudhe bī ra dza shi bi sharnyi ka re swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags brgya bzlas nas shar du bltas te tsog pur bsdad nas chu srang gsum tsam 'thung na zla phyed kyi ring glal ba/ sprid pa/bza' bya min pa zos pa sogs kyes sngags nus phrogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad byangabar legs grub las gsungs pas/ rang cag nyes spyod shin tu mang ba rnams kyis rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i nyes spyod sbyong thabs zab mo 'di dag shes pa shin tu gal che'o/ / gzhan yang dge rtsa khong khro sogs kyis mi 'joms par bya ba dang / dge ba mi nyams shing gong 'phel du 'gyur phyir bzlasabarjod kyi mjug tu bum pa'i phyag rgya bcas te dge rtsa lha la 'bul ba sogs ni cho ga'i gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin nan tan du bya/ mtshams kyi skabs gzhan gyis rang mthong ba la ral ba dang / rang gis gzhan mthong ba la bug pa zer bas 'dzem dgos shing / lhag par dam tshig nyams pa'i lag nas byung ba'i zas sogs dug ltar spangs/ me mi srur 'ing mtshon rtse khar mi gzhug pa/ gdan mi sprug cing drod ma yal bar byed pa/ phreng ba mi 'gom pa/thun mtshams su long gtam sna tshogs mi bya bar phyag dang mchod pa/ gzungs kyi phan yon/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ byams snying rje'i dmigs rnams sogs yang yang gsal btab ste thun dngos gzhi'i 179

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'i 0sa'i g.yo las/bogs 'byin du 'gyur ba bya/ gtor 'bul skabs mtshams tho'i rgyal chen la'ang bsngo zhing / mtshams grol tshe rgyal chen la gtang rag gi mchod bstod gshegs gsol byas te mtshams tho dbon pa'i gtsang sar 'jog dang po nang mtshams grol te yid mthun re gnyis dang phrad cing / de nas phyi mtshams grol ba ma gtogs har 'don mi bya/ cho ga gzhan 'don mi 'don dam pa'i phyag bzhes gnyis 'byung yang / dam bca' yin na bdag bskyed bsdus te thun bar du gdon/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul sogs rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i ngang nas byas par 'gal ba med/ mtshams kyi spang blang zhib pa ni slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i gegs sel dang bya rgyud don gsal sogs las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa thugs rje bskul ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa po bstod kyi don ni/ oṃ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes oṃ smos pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mor oṃ gyis mchog dang nor ster ba dang bkra shis pa'i don du gsungs la/ don zhags kyi rgyud las thugs rje chen po'i sngags yi ge gcig par gsungs pas thugs rje skul byed yin no/ / 'jig rten mgon po zhes pa 'gyur phyag yin nam snyam/ de nas khams gsum sems can thams cad la rang rang dang 'tsham par phan pa mdzad de de dag kun gye gus pa'i yul du gyur pas/ 'jig rten bla ma srid pa gsum gyis bstod pa po/ / tshangs pa dang dbang phyug sogs kyang gnas skabs kyi phan pa tsam sgrub nus rung /gtan gyi don la rang rang yang mgon po 'di'i thugs rjer re dgos pas/ lha yi gtso bo bdud dang tshangs pas bstod pa la/ /thub pas rgyal ba mchog ces bstod yul la byas na'ang bstod pa gzhan dang 'grig la/ 'on kyang mgon po 'dir gus pas bsten pa las nyes spyod mtha' dag sdom zhing bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas kyang re 'grub nus pas/ thub bas rgyal mchog bstod 180

༄/ /sgyungaganasakyicho ga'izur rgyanabadeb can/pas grub par mdzad pa po/ / 'gro ba ris med par srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun lasasgol pas/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mdor bstan to/ / rgyas par bshad pa ni bsten pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/rten gye yon tan dag dang ni/ / brten pa'i yon tan phan tshun du/ / 'tsham pas khyod kyi sku dang ni/ / yon tan phun tshogs mchog dang ldan/ / zhes rten sku dang / brten pa yon tan gnyis phan tshun rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'khrul ba'i mtshon bya mtshon byed du gsung ba dang mthun par bshad pa la/ rten sku'i yon tan dang / de la brten pa don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan gnyis las/dngapo ni/ bde gshegs dpag med cesapa nas sham thabs 'dzin pa po/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ / de'ang za ma tog bkod par gsungs pa bzhin ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag med bzhugs pa dang / klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba bzhin phyag stong las 'khorasgyur stong dang / spyan stong las bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong sprul pa dang / gzhan yang spyan gnyis las sgol ma dkar ljang / rta mgrin/ dzo dkar sogs sprul pa'i lo rgyus ltar kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pas/ bde gshegs dpag med sku ste sku bzang 'dzin pa po/ / rigs kyi bdag po bla ma 'odadapag med sku lus yongs rdzogs sam zhal gyi rnam par 'bral med du spyi bor bkur bas/ bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas dbu rgyan 'dzin pa po/rgyun par bsgom dus rang blor gang 'tsham gyi phyag stong dang / brgyad dang /bzhi dang / g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa'i phyag gnyis gang bde bya bar dpal mo'i sgrub thabs su gsung bas 'dir phyag gnyis gtso bor bstan/ de'ang sku las chu rgyun 'bab pas dmyal me chil chil gsod cing /khyad par du nyam thag rnams dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir legs par brkyangs 181

༄/ /gung ca bayopa'isgronasa'i ga ཿma/pa'i sor rtse las bdud rtsi dang 'o rgyun 'bebs pas/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yi dwags bkres skom sel ba po/ / rang nyid 'khor ba skyon gyes ma gos pa mtshon pa'i phyir/ phyag g.yon gser gye pad+mas rnam par brgyan pa po/ /yul la zhen pa spangs pas dbu skra gzhan rnams gnag cing snum la byang chub yan lag goms pas dri bzang dang myang 'das mngon du mdzad pa'i brdar steng gi khro zhal gyi dbu skra gyen du bsdes pa ste/ dri zhim ral pa'i phreng ba dmar ser 'khyugs po/ / smon lam yongs su rdzogs pas dbu dang 'gram pa sogs la 'bur dang rnyongs med par cha mnyam du gang bas/ zhal ras rgyas pa zla ba lta bur mdzes pa po/ /chos thams cad gzigs shing 'gro ba kun la bu gcig pa ltar dgongs pas dkar nag 'byis shing dkyus ring bas/ spyan gyi pad+ma mchog tu bzang zhing yangs pa po/ /skyon gyi rigs mtha' dag zad cing tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pas mkhur tshos dang 'gram pa sogs zhal dang sku'i cha gang la yang nag po'i ra re med pa/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar dri ngad ldang pa po/ /dpal mos mdzad pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa dang / zla mdzes mas mdzad pa'i bstod pa zer ba gnyis kyang po bstod 'di dang 'gros mthun par snang bas/ snga mar pad+ma ltar yangs mchog tu mdzes pa'i spyan/ /mkhur ba gangs kyi dum bu lta bur dkar/ / zhesadang / phyi mar/mchog tu mdzes pa'i spyan ni pad+ma lta bur sangs/ / kha ba dung ltar rnam par dkar ba'i 'gram mdog can/ / zhes 'byung bas zhal nas mar rim gyis spos par snang ngo / / rgyan so so'i mtshon don dang dag pa bla med ji lta ba 'dir mi spyor yang / thun mong ba rnams sbyar du rung bas gong gi dbu rgyan gyis bla ma/ la gus par mtshon pa des zhe sdang spangs pa'ang mtshon zhing /'dir nga rgyal dang ser sna spang pa tshon byed du mgul bar nor bu'i rigs du mdang spel ba'i/ dri med 'od chags mu tig tshom bu 'dzin pa po/ / yang 182

༄/ /sgyungaganas kyicho ga'izurargyanabadeb can/'di'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod par/ nyi ma 'char ka ltar dmar btsod kyi mdog / pad+ma gzhon nu lta bu mchu dmar la/ / zhes thad 'dir 'byung ba bzhin skya rengs shar te mtshams sprin gyi mdangs shar ba ltar 'dzum zhing / mdzes pa'i 'od zer skya rengs dmar pos brgyan pa po/ g.yas g.yonagyi phyag rnams bsgrigs te gnas pa ni phan tshun gyi 'gram brgyud de me tog gi phreng ba kha phye nas yod pa'i/ pad+ma'i mtsho ltar phyag ni dngar bar byas pa po/ phyag de dag kyang 'dres nas yod pa lta bu ma yin par mtshams gsal zhing brtsegs ma brtsegs mar yod pa char dang bral ba'i/ ston ga'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan zhing gzhon pa po/ 'jam gnyen gzhon sha chags pa'i phyag de dag kyang tshigs kyi mtshams gong 'og tu gdu bus spras pa gti mug rnam par dag pa mtshon byed yin pas/ rin chen mang pos dpung pa gnyis ni brgyan pa po/ gdul bya la phan bde'i chos kyi dga' ston stsol ba'i phyir phyag lhag ma phal cher mchog sbyin mdzad pa'i ngos ni lngug phran gsar skyes kye/ lo ma'i mchog ltar phyag mthil gzhon zhing 'jam pa po/ khyad par du snying je chen po mtshon pa'i phyir krokhri sa ra'am de zur chags pa si snyan zhes bya ba'i/ ri dwags pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa po/ 'dod chags rnam par dag pa mtshon byed du/ snyan cha gdu bus sgeg cing rgyan rnams 'chang ba po/ srid par gnas kyang de bzhin nyid las mi g.yo bas srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar/ dri ma med pa pad+ma'i mchog la gnas pa po/ de ltar bzhengs pa'i rnam pa brjod pa na lte ba dang sku smad kyi nyams shar yong ba de dang mthun par bstod pa ni/ dgu rlum zhing ma rnyong bas phyang nge ba pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa'i 'dab ma thang chod pa lta bu'i dkyel na chos zab mo rtogs pa mtshon pas lte ba'i sbubs zab la g.yas su 'khyil ba'i/ lte ba'i ngos ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa po/ phrag dog rnam par dag pa mtshon byed 'og bag gam/ gser 183

༄/ /gung thangabasnyanapa'asgronasa' g.yo ཿma/gyi ska rags mchog la nor bus spras pa po/ rgyan 'di rnams kyis dug lnga rnam par dag pa mtshon pa'i shugs kyis ye shes lnga mtshon tshul shes dgos la/brtag gnyis su phyin drug la sbyar ba rnams kyang 'dir tshang ngo / / rgyan las/rgyalasras ngo tsha shes pa'i gos can ni/ / zhes pa ltar ngo tsha khrel yod mtshon byed/ sta zur dkris pa'i ras bzang sham thabs 'dzin pa po/ /zhes pa 'di yan gyis sku'i rnam pa gtso bor byas te bstod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de la brten pa don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan la/rang don tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gzhan don 'azin las lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gnyis/dang po la ye shes kye tshogs yongs su rdzogs pas mnyam rjes res 'jog med par ji lta ji snyed kyi rnam pa mtha' dag cig car mngon sum du gzigs pa mthar thug pas/ thub pa'i mkhyen mchog mtsho chen pha rol phyin pa po/bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs te rin chen phreng bar 'jig rten kun gyi bsod nams bcu 'gyur byas pas sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig 'grub par gsungs pa lta bu rgya che ba'i spyod pa mthar phyin pa las byung bas na/mchog brnyes bsod nams mang po nye bar bsags pa po ste 'di gnyis la 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod par/ rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ / bsod nams du ma las ni 'khrungs pa'i mgon/ / zhes 'byung ngo /gnyis pa gzhan don phrin las la/ skyes bu chung 'bring che gsum gyi don so sor mdzad tshul dang / zhing khams ris med kyi sems can ma lus pa'i don mdzad tshul gnyis/ dang po ni rgyan las/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang / / ngan song dag ni thabs min dang / / 'jig tshogs theg pa dman pa las/ /skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar chung ngu'i rigs can 184

༄/ /sgyungaganas kyicho ga'izurargyanabadeb can/rnams tshe 'dir nad rims rgud pa kun gyi 'tshe ba las skyob cing phyi mar rim pas nges legs kyi bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas mngon mtho khyad par can la 'god pas/ rtag tu bde ba'i 'byung gnas rga nad sel ba po/ / 'bring rnams 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i 'ching ba bcad de khams gsum gyi 'khor ba las thar pa'i nyer zhi'i dbyings kyi mkha' la 'khrid pas/gsum mthar mdzad cing mkha' spyod spyod pa ston pa po/ / chen po'i rigs canarnams bdud bzhi phra rags ma lus pa las rgyal pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar bkri bas/ lus can mchog ste bdud dpung 'khrug las rgyal ba bo/ / 'di gsum 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod par/ rims dang nad 'joms bde ba mchog skyed pa/ / srid pa mtha' mdzad mkha' la rgyu ba dang / / bdud rigs sna tshogs stobs ni nges par 'joms/ / zhes 'byung ba dang sbyar na go bde'o/ /gnyis pa zhing khams ris med kyi sems can ma lus pa'i don mdzad tshul ni/ mngon shes drug gi rim pas sems can gye don mdzad tshul/ rgyan las 'byung ba bzhin/ dang por gdul bya gar yod kyi zhing du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten nas byon te don mdzad dgos pas/ gser gyi rkang gdub sgra yis zhabs yid 'ong ba po/ / 'jig rten 'byor rgud 'du 'dzi 'khrugamang sogs zang zing ji lta bu'i gseb tu byon yang theg chen gye byams snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi'i sgo nas dman pa'i yid byed dang mtshan ma'i rnam g.yeng rgyang ring du bsrings te/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi yis dbenapar mdzad pa po/ de'ang mi la sogs pas steng gi 'gro ba tsam du ma zad sa bla dang sa 'og gi 'jig rten du'ang byon nas de'i 'gro ba rnams gdul bar mdzad pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis/ ngang pa'i 'gros 'dra glang chen dregs ltar gshegs pa po/ / mdor na rje bla mas/ 'dren pa mchog des dka' ba 185

ro / /gung thang bstanapa'is ce gsung 'thum/dpag med kyis/ / nan tan snying por mdzad nas bsgrubs pa 'di/ /gsungs pa bzhin lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas gcig pur dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas bsags shing bsgrubs pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid 'phel zhing gnas pa'i thabs kho na don du gnyer bas/ yongs rdzogs nye bar bsags shing bstan pa gnyer ba po/ / zhes pa'am/ yang na dang por thugs bskyed bar du tshogs bsags pa kun gyi dgos pa'i mthil gdul bya'i don yin la/ de'i gtso bo cho 'phrul gsum las gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyes so so'i skal ba bzhin chos bstan nas smin grol la 'god pa'i don du bya ste/ 'gyur gzhan las/ tshogs kun nye bar bsags nas chos kun ston pa po/ / zhes 'byung ngo / / de ltar byas te gdul bya'i don rdzogs par grub tshul ni nyan rang gi myang 'das thob na zag med kyi bde ba dang ldan yang zhi ba'i mtha' la lhung bar gzigs te/ de las kyang sgrol bar mdzad na sdug bsngal gsum gyi rba klong 'khrugs pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba lta ci smos pas/ 'o ma'i mtsho dang chu yi mtsho las sgrol ba po/ / ste srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag las bskyabs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i don no/ /'gyur gzhan du/ sdug bsngal mtsho dang nyon mongs mtsho las sgrol ba po/ / zhes 'byungab don la bsams nas bsgyur ba'am/ yang na 'o ma'i ming dngos ni/ba ya yin kyang / bzhos pa'i don gyi du sgo zhes zer ba dang / chu'i ming gi rnam grangs kyi lā li 'ching byed dang / asta ni nang byed la 'jug pas skad dod kyi steng nas yin dpyod dgos/ zla mdzes mas mdzad par/ 'o ma'i chu gter rgya mtsho lta bur rtag tu gnas/ / zhes 'byung ba ni 'gyur 'chug pa'am don gzhan yin gyi 'di dang bsgrig tu med do/ / mjug gi don phan yon ni/spyir rgyun du gsol ba 'debs shing / khyad par tho rangs ni byang chub pa'i dus dang dpal mo rang gis kyang mchog brnyes pa'i dus yin pas rten 'brel 186

༄/ /sgyungaganasakyicho ga'izurargyanabadeb can/gyi khyad/ gang zhig rtag tu tho rangs langs nas gus pa yis/ / re sa gzhan na med pa'i blo ltos byas te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yid la sems byed cing / / de'i yon tan brjod pa tshig ris tsam go sla zhing zhar la sku'i rnam pa 'char bde ba/ blo gros can gyes brtag na don zab cing rgya che ba'i/bstod pa'i mchog 'dis dag cing gsal bar bstod byed na/ / nges par rjes su 'dzin la/ ma mtha'ang / skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan/ / thugs rje'i spyan gyes 'gro la gzigs/ / spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa 'di dpal mo rangagis mdzad pa po bstod 'di'i don bsdu lta bu yin pas de tsam las mi shes kyang yid ches kyis gsol ba 'debs nus na dbang po rtul zhing sdig pa che ba rigs ngan tha shal ji 'dra zhig yin kyang 'phags pa'i thugs rje la nye ring med pas/ de ni skyes pa'am ni bud med yin yang rung / / brtse bas rjes su gzung ste nad rims gdon bgegs phyin ci log gi blo sna ngan pa sogs zhi zhing / tshe dang bsod nams dad brtson shes rab sogs rgyas pas/ skye ba 'di'am ma 'ongs skye ba thams cad du/ / bde ba nas bde bar 'gro zhing sa lam gyi rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bas/ 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dgos pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ / zhes bka' bden pas zhal gyis bzhes pa la yid ches bskyed de 'bad par bya'o/ / bstod pa 'di 'don pa'i tshedamigs pa bya tshul ni/ dge slong ma dpal mo rang gi spyi bor bzhugs te 'phags pa'i zhal la gzigs nas ngo chen gyi tshul du rang la 'don grogs mdzad/ rang gis lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar bas 'phags pa'i zhabs la 'jus/ zhabs kyi mthe bong la smin mtshams gtad nas gsol ba btab pa na chang rdza'i them bu brdol ba ba'in mthe bong gi rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa smin mtshams nas zhugs pas lus kun gang / sdeg sgrib thams cad byang /187

༄/ /gung bang b.lomi'itshonamatha g.yo 'atsoga'aphags pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa bya/ goms pa na rigs drug sems can thams cad kye spyi bor dpal mo re bzhugs te gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang dang / mthar thams cad 'phags pa'i skur gyur ba'i mos pa bya'o/ /smras pa/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe la long med cing / / ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sa nyam nga bas/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du 'bros 'dod rnams/ /'phags mchog sgrub pa'i nye lam 'dir zhugs shig /zab cing rgya che'i gdams pa grangs mang yang / /snyigs dus sgrub sla shin tu don che ba/ /lha chos 'di las lhag pa gzhan med pas/ /'bad par rigs so shes ldan grogs po dag /'dir 'bad dge ba rta mchog pa la has/ / bdag sogs mkha' mnyam lus can don mthun tshogs/ /'khor ba srin mo'i gling nas myur drangs te/ /bde chen thar pa'i sa la 'god gyur cig /ces smyung gnasakyi cho ga'i zur rgyan bde ba can gyi lam yig ces bya ba 'di ni chos tshul 'di la mchog tu mos pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog smon lam gyisa'adi'i phan yon lo rgyus blang dor gyi lag len dang bcasagasal bar bstan pa zhig dgos zhesalan bcu gsum gyibar nan tan du bskul cing / dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog ye shes kyis thugs rje chen posagatsosapa'i bya rgyud kyi bsnyen yig cig dgos tshul sngaranas bskul ba dang / yang dge spyor la brtson pa'i ri khrod pa dkon mchog mchog ldan gyis po bstod la ṭīk+ka zhig dgosazheyoyang yang bskul pa rnamasadon mthun par snang bas phyogs gcig tu bsdebasate/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyome byi'i dgun mtshams skabs nyin gung gi thun gseng la sug brisasu bgyisapa las shog bur 'be+ebasapa po ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /dge 'dis phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dar/ /bstan 'dzin thugs mthun bshad sgrub bya ba 'phel/ /mi yi dbang phyug pe li blon 'bangs 188

༄/ /sgyungaganasakyichoga'izurargyanabadeb can/sogs/ / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar bar shog / khyad par 'brel thogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / phyag na pad+mas 'bral med rjes gzung ste/ / zhing mchog bde ba can dang po ta lar/ / skyes nas sa lam bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni hal ha dar han ri li'i shog nas dad ldan sngagayoram pa dkon mchog bstan 'phel gyisapar gsar bskrun bgyesaskab47btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o|189

༄/ /gung ca bayoba'i ma'i ga lamag༄༅/ / smyung gnas dang 'brel bar stong mchod 'bul tshul gyi cho ga phan bde'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / phul byung mkhyen dang brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis/ / gzigs pa'i cha tsam gang la lhung bas kyang / / srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel skyabs kyi phul/ / 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mas rtag skyongs shig / snyigs ma'i rgud pa lhag par bdo ba'i tshe/ / mgon 'di las lhag skyabs gzhan yod min pas/ / skal bzang blo dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams/ / 'di nyid bsnyen cing mchod la 'bad par rigs/ / de'ang rgyal ba kun gye snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog thugs rje chen por stong mchod 'bul tshul mdo tsam bajod pa la/ spyir stong mchod kyi khungs ni rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs mdo las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos tshes bco lnga'i nyin par khrus byas la gos gtsang ma gyon tebasnyen gnas la gnas te lan stong du bzlas brjod byas na sems can tshe zad pa'i tshe phyir nur bar 'gyur ro/ / nad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyang yin la/ tshig ris 'di dang cha 'dra ba zhig ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs su'ang 'byung ngo / / khungs shin tu gsal ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kye gtsug tor rnam par rgyal pa'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa las/ de lta bu'i cho gas mchod rten la g.yas skor gyi spyor bas pad+ma'i 'dab ma la bri bar bya'o/ /debazhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i 190

༄/ /sgyung gnasadang yil b.rastongasachod 'bul 4/gzungasabres la/ de'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can du byas la dri zhim po dang bsres pa'i chu gtor zhing dri zhim po'i me tog gis mchod la stong phrag gcig gi mchod pa chen po byas te/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad kyi nyin zhag la smyungabar gnas shing sems can thams cad la phan pa'i blos tshe dang blo ster ba'i yon byin te stong phrag gcig bzla bar bya'o/ / zla ba re re zhing byas na zla ba drug gis tshe lo stong thub par 'gyur ro/ / rtag tu lo gcig tu byas na tshe lo 'bum thub par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di yin no/ / yang de nyid las/ mchod pa rgya chen po byas te nyi ma re re zhing brgyad brgya'i bzlas pa bya'o/ / yang zla ba re re la stong stong gi mchod pa byas shing stong stong gi bzlas pa byas na tshe dpag tu med pa dang zhes sogs kyis kyang 'byor pa rab la me tog sogs bcu gnyis pa re re nas stong stong tshang ba'i stong mchod dang /'bring brgyad brgya pa'i mchod pa/ tha ma ci 'byor gye mchod pa byed tshul gsum bstan par rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos gsungs so/ / gzhan la de 'dra ba'i stong mchod 'bul tshul gyi khungs gsal ba med kyang dgos don khyad par can la dpag ste man ngag gis rgyas bka' chog pa rgyud dang grub chen rnams kyi dgongs pa yin par ma zad rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal snga nas kyis kyang a ru ra'i stong mchod ces sman bla dang sbyar te mchod pa dang phyag skor ba sogs stong tshang bar byed tshul gyi cho ga mdzad pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i cho ga zhib mo las tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya ba la bslab pa'i gzhi brgyad bzung ste/ gos gtsang ma bgos la ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun du'am/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi spyan sngar tsardon dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bgyis la der me tog sna tshogs gtor bar bgyi/ bdug pas kyang bdug par bgyi/ mar me yang bud par bgye'o/ / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gus pa skyed par 191

༄/ /gung ca bamapa'isgronas g.yo ཿma/bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi khungs sngar drangs pa rnams dang 'gros shin tu mthun zhing / 'dir mchod pa las zur du gus pa skyed par gsungs pa ni bstod pa dang phyag skor ba sogs la go dgos te/ blo gros brtan pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel bshad du de dag mchod pa dang bkur ste gnyis subyas pa'i phyi mar gsungs pa bzhin no/ / des na 'dir smyung gnas dang 'brel bar stong mchod 'bul tshul gyi rim pa ni/ thog mar stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng tsardon dkar po'i lde gus byugs pa'i steng du rdul tshon nam ras bris kye dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid tshang ba'am pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris par tshon bu dgod tshul sogs phyag len bzhin byas la/ mchod gtor sogs kyang sgyung gnas kyi cho ga'i gzhung bzhin bsham/ stong mchod kyi nyin de'i steng du mdun bsgyed la 'bul rgyu'i mchod pa so so nas stong re dngos sam ri mo bris pa tshun chad kyis tshang ba dang / de ma 'byor na lha bshos mar me spos rnams stong tshang ba/ de'ang ma 'byor na lha bshos dang mar me gang rung stong tshang zhing gzhan rnams ci 'byor byed/ rnam rgyal stong mchod skabs gdugs dang ba dan lda ldi rnams bsnan pa ni gzungs mdo las sngon gye byung ba gsungs tshul zhig dang bstun par snang la/ bya rgyud spyi'i lugs su gos rgyan gang bum rnams gtso bor gsungs pas 'dir yang de bzhin byed/ khyad par du bum pa 'dul ba ni tshigasabacad kyi nang du'ang / las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun dag nas/ /byang chub sems kyi dran gyis brjod par shog / ces 'byung ba ltar las nyon sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kye rtogs pa khyad par canaskye ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas skabs 'dir shin tu 'brel zhing gtso che'o/ / der ma zad lung las/ ji 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ / 'bras bu de 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bras bu ji 'dra 'byung rigs mthun gyi rgyu la ltos par ma zad/ zhing khyad 192

༄/ /sgyung gnasadang 'brel b.rastongamachod 'bul tshul/par can la mchod pa phul na gang phul ba'i dngos po de nyid dang rigs 'dra ba dngos grub kyi thog mar 'byung brten 'brel gyi che ba yin pas/ da lta snyigs ma'i skyon gyis snod bcud mtha' dag gi nus pa nyams te rtsi bcud lo 'bras zas nor longs spyod sogs sgo mtha' dag nas rgud pa slar gso ba'i phyiradu sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin chen lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga rnams phul na legs pas snod so sor bshams pa'am gcig tu spungs te 'jog gzhan yang ci 'byor pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs bkod pa mdzes par bshams la/nangs par lag ris mthong ba'i tshod tsam du gso spyong gi sdom pa len pa nas bzung bdag bskyed dang / mdun bskyed kyi dbang bskur rgyas gdab par cho ga'i dkyus ltar bya/ de nas stong mchod kyi spos dang mar me sogs sbar la mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas tshigs bcad ci rigs pa dang / bya rgyud rang gzhung ltar gyi phyag rgya sngags dang bcas pas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo/'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ gos rgyan/ gang bum rnams dbul/de nas/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs/ / bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la/ / lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog / oṃ pañtsa pañtsa bi ma la pū dza me gha ā : swāhā/ de nas bzlas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la/ 'dir skor ba dang phyag sogs kyang stong re 'gro dgos pas/ sgrub pa po bcu tsam yin na skor ba sogs brgya re dang / nyi shu yod na lnga bcu res grangs tshang ba 'byung la/ go yul dang bstun nas rten dngos sam lha khang la skor ba byed cing / de'ang bzlas pa'i skabs 'dir gzungs bzla bzhin du byin pa'am thun mtshams su byasakyang chog pa/ sgrub pa po nyung bas mi lcogs na gzhan la byed du bcug kyang rung ngo / / phyag ni po bstod kyi skabs su de dang sbrags te sgrub pa po mang nyunga'i gzhal nas stong gi grangs tshang nges su bya/ mchod pa'ang thun gsum 193

ro / /gung thang bstanaba'ilhanama' gsang 'bum/gar po stod tshar nyer gcig re 'don dgos pas/ mi bcu drug yan chad yod na po stod tshar re'i mjug tu mchod pa re phul bas grangs tshang ba 'byung rwarngo / /'dir mchod pa 'bul tshul yang / oṃ ār+ya lo ke shā ra sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ/pābye/ zhes pa nas/ shasta/ badz+ra wa sta/ a laṅgār/ ka lā tha/ pañtsa pañtsa bi ma la ā ྅ swāhā/ zhes sngags tsam gyis dbul/ sgrub pa po grangs nyung bas de tsam gyis stong mi 'gro na po bstod tshar ba'i rjes su mchod sngags dang / skyon gyis ma gos zhes sogs sbrel bas kha bskang ste stong tshang bar byed/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma sogs cho ga'i gzhung bzhin logs su byed dgos pas/'dir stong gi grangs gsog rgyu'i gtor ma ni 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi mgron mtha' dag la thun mong du 'bul dgos pa phyag len yin pas/ ril bu stong byas te zangs la sogs pa'i snod gtsang ma gcig tu gtor spung byed pa'am/ snod bcur ril bu bcu bcu blugs pa chu dang sbyar te bsangs sbyangs byin gyes brlabs la/ dus gsum phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ / 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ / mgron rnams ma lus mchod sbyin gnas/ /'dir gshegs 'dod pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes spyan drangs/phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ / zhes sogs kyis phyag bya/ oṃ saze ta thā ga ta a nas sta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ akā ro mu khaṃ sadru dharmā hūṃ ār+ya nu t+pardo tā da oṃ ā hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas bsngo/ ril bu brgya re lhan du bshams tshe mi bcu yod na sngags kyang tshar bcu res bsngo zhing / de'i mtshams su/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis/ / 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skor gyur cig / rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur nas/ /lan chags bu lon khyer pa dang / / bla med byang chub myur thob shog / ces brjod/ slar yang ril bu brgya bshams te/ oṃ 〉 〉/ lan 194

༄/ /smyung gnasadang 'brel b.rastongamachod 'bul 4/gsum gyisabyin gyi4brlabasal/ phyag byar 'os pa man chad sngar bzhin bya/ de ltar stong tshang ba na slar yang yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma rnams thun mong du byin gyes brlabs te gzhung bzhin dbul/ mjug 'dir klu chen rnams la'ang gtor ma gtong bar bshad de/ de'i rgyu mtshan mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa las/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo 'di rtag tu 'dzin cing zlos pa la brtson pa'i sems can de dag ni bsod nams dang ldan pa yin no/ / zhes pa nas/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho mching rnams dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la sogs te klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma ni sa yongs su srung bar byed do/ / zhes 'di'i bsnyen sgrub byed pa'i phyogs der klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis kyang char chu dus su 'bebs shing sad ser srung ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas sa'i bcud gso bar gsungs la/ bya rgyud don gsal las kyang dge slong ma dpal mo'i spyan sngar klu chen brgyad kyis 'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgos kyi chos skyong du khas blangs tshul gsungs pa ltar yin pas yul phyogs su zas nor longs spyod sogs 'phel ba'i don la cho ga 'di dang 'brel bar klu gtor bsngos na phan shin tu che'o/ / de'ang gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin klu gtor gyi cho ga rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na klu sman btab pa'i dkar gsum gyi gtor ma bshams la/ klu chen 'khor bcas skad cigagis byon par bsam te/ na ma sadra ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bhar sam+bhar hūṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod cing / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i klu chen 'khor bcas rnams/ / 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ / 'bru bcud zas nor longs spyod 'phel ba yis/ / chos dang srid kyi dge mtshan rgyas par ma/dzod/ / ces 'phrin las bcol/ de nas sku khrus gsol ba man chad dkyus ltar bya'o/ / byin rlabs gter chen 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / mchod chog lag len 195

ra / /gung thang bstanapa'izla ma'i gsung 'bugarim par bsgrigs pa yi/ / dge bas mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /'phags pa'i thugs rjes rtag tu skyong gyur cig / ces sgyung gnasakyi cho ga dang 'brel bar stong mchod 'bul tshul gyi cho ga phan bde'i char 'bebasazhesabya ba 'di ni oradu su.o thag shog gi mtshan nyid gra tshang gi bla mgazhung lugasam ba'i dbang po blo bzang yon tan dang sman ram pa brtson 'grus gnyis nas 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul gye skul mnan cher byung ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brigapa'o/ / dge 'dis 'brel thogs skye bo kun/ / phyag na pad+mas rjes bzung ste/ / phra rags sred pa'i mtsho brgal nas/ / bla med byang chub myur thob shog / ces pa 'di'ang bskul pa po gnyisanasargyu sbyar te par du bsgrubasapa'i tshe bris pa'o/ /196

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs chen po la brten pa/༄༅/ / 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po la brten pa'i mig gzungs nyams su len tshul byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / byin rlabs thugs rje mig sman thur ma yis/ / mi shes rmongs pa'i rab rib sel mdzad cing / / mngon par mtho dang nges legs lam ston pa/ / 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs mgon de yis skyongs/ / de yang thugasarje'i gter chen mgon po spyan ras gzigs la brten pa'i mig gzungs 'di nyid nyams sulen par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis tho rangs bya rog gi skad ma grag4pa'i gong der skyabayo'agro semasabaskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams sngon du btang / swabhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du rang gi sems nyid trī yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/'phags pa mchod/ rigs drug so so'i gnas su song ste rang rang gi sdug bsngal las bskyabs shing / khyad par du dbang po nyams pa sogs kyi nyer 'tshe mtha' dag las thar bar byas/ tshur 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog ston zla ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yon gyi dang po thal mo kha phye ba'i srin lag gi rtsa bar g.yas pa'i srin lag gi rtse mo gtad de mig la byugs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing /g.yas 'og mas dngul gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang / g.yon 'og mas dngul dkar gyi me long bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras shing /dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/197

༄/ /yo ca bayopa'izla sa' khrung ཿmazhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par be+e thugs par hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ thugs gar zla ba la hrī yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sogs rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje byin rlabs mtha' dag bsdus te sngags phreng la thim par bsam zhing / tar+ya thā/ oṃ hūṃ ya byu ya/ hu du hu du/ki li ki li/ tsagru mi tram̐ sha tri na ya swāhā/ zhe4lan nyer gcig re mchog par bzla/de nas g.yon pa'isren lag gi rtsa bar sngags kyi mchil ma btab nas/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gi rtse mos blangs te mig g.yayopa la byugs/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtse mor bsdus te/ des mig g.yon pa la yang byug go / 'di ni rgyun 'khyer gyi dbang du byasapa yin la/dang por bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe khrus dang gtsang sbra la 'bad pa/ sha chang sgog rigs sngo rngadakyi zas spong pa sogs spyod lam tshul dang mthun zhing / zeg pa chen po'i gso spyong sogs la gnasapa'i sgo nas tha mal ba'i gtam gyiyobar ma chod par stong phrag gcig bzla dgos par gsungs so/ / rgyun du'ang yig drug sogs la 'bad cing / mjug tu snga ma'i mig gzungs de nyid lan kha yar dang / gzhan yang rgyud 'bum las 'byung ba mig rnam par sbyong ba'i sngags/ tadu thā/ hi li mi li ki li mi li hi li te mi li hu yā hu yā hu yā ma ni hu lu hu lu hu lu/ hu du hu du hu du/ tsakhrur me sho dha ya sāhā/zhes pa dang / mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ tadu thā/ ru ti re phu re dhi ra ak+ṣi phu rudhi ra bi ga le du khā te phu ba te le phu hi te phu māṃ sa rdu du bhi phu pad+ma mak+ṣi phu pad+ma ma daṇ+ḍa ha ri ṇi ye phu swāhā/ sargya sa pa ri wā ra dā na pa hi sa pa riwā ra sru tsa/ sarba tsagru rog bra sha ma nā ya sāhā/ zhe4pa gnyis kyang tshar kha shas re bzla4na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur la/ ma grub na snga ma gcig puyochog go / de nas/ bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa spyan ras gzigs/ / nyam thag 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad thugs rje'i gter/ / khyod kye thugs rje byin rlabs bden pa'i mthu/ / deng 'dir bdag la mngon sum bstan du gsol/ / thog med dus nas mi bzad sdig pa'i las/ / spyi dang khyad par 198

༄/ /'phagasamachog thugs chenapo la brten pa/mig sogs dbang po rnams/ / nyams byed nyes ltung bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /myur du byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / chos sbyin bgyis dang snang gsal phul ba sogs/ / dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / lha mig rnam par dag pa'i dpal thob cing / / zab mo'i gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur par shog / mdor na snying rje'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / khyod min re ba'i skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / mgon med nyam thag bdag gi dbugs phyung ste/ / re 'bras lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab bo/ rgyal mo chu 'byed dang / khaṇ+ḍa'i sbyor ba sogs sman gyi sbyor ba rnams ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ / 'phags pa'i thugs rje la brten nas/ mig gi nad rnams sel ba'i thabs/ / bris pa'i dge 'dis 'gro ba kun/ / chos kyi mig dang ldan par shog / ces 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po rang nyid kyis lho brag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyang pa sgrub pa po la dngos su bstsal ba'i mig gzungs zab mo nyams sulen tshul 'di ni/ dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byamasapa shes rab rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesa'abrong rtse'i be'u bum sogs las btus te bsgrigs pa'o/ /sarba mgo lam̐/ /1ya

༄/ /gung ca gsaba'izla ma'i tsha 'chag༄༅/ / kun rig gi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa kun phan 'khyer bde nor bu'i rna cha bi ha ra nyasma/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru bha ga wa ti sarba bid malho le bh+ya 'dir kun rig gi chog rgyud don gsal ba'i snying po bsdu4pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i dgongasadon slar yang bsdus te ngag 'don du bkod pa'i bsgrig4ni/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa nas/ yid kyi gzugs ni brtan phyir ro/ / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa nas/ shasta 〉 rtu/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa nas/ oṃ ā ཿ phaṭa swāhā/ mgon po kun gshegs nas/'phrin las mdzod cig badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ hūṃ badz+ra a na la nas/ shasta ā :/i nge gu rum tā ya mi/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi nas/ 'grub par shoga.oṃ su bhā wa nas/ lus dang mnyam par gyur/ badz+ra ma hā krodha nga sa ma dzarang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khro bo'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā nga e bye hi pra wa ra sa da nga sta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod/ / hūṃ dkyil 'khor nas/ gdon mi za/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la nas/ skra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ / skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / / mya ngan mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ / 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ / bdag la nas/ snying por mchis kye bar/ / rigs lnga spyi dang so so yi/ / dam tshig sdom pa ma lus gzung / / ma bsgrol pa rnams nas/ btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig tshogs zhing rang gnas su mi dmigs par gyur/ lag mthil 200

༄/ /kun rig gichog shin tubasdusapakhunaphan/gnyis su zhes pa nas/ badz+ra mukhyi baṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā nas/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ gnyis gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i yi ram̐ baṃ lam̐ sum̐ las rlung me chu sa ri rab rnams kyi steng du baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ las rta babs dang ldan pa'i phyi'i gzhal yas khang dang / de'i phyed kyi tshad du nang gi gzhal yas khang / gnyis ga'ang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin can/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol tu khor yug rdo rje ra ba me ri dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi nas/ seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du hrī las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo nas/ mi snang bar gyur to/ lha rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkarapo/mo : sngon po/ lha rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i steng du oṃ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad la sangs rgyas dang ma sa ma dza ma lus sems can nas/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / dza hūṃ baṃ ho mahā ཿ e gye hi/ bcom ldan 'dir ni nas/ sarba bid hūṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ nas/ ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lha rang gi'am lha de'i thugs gar〉 lha rang gi skog maras rdo rje'i lte ba la lha rang gi sngagasang sogs rang sgra sbyor zhing gtso bo'i sngags gcig pus chog 'phrin las kyi spel tshig ni/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la zab gsal gnyis med la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag skye ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig badz+ra yak+ṣa nas/shasta 5 4/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ / mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos/ / snang gsal dri chab zhal zas tshogs/ / sil snyan ji snyed yod pa dang / / bdag gis nas/ mdzad du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 201

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'itshonama'i gas 'buma.a6 ) shasta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra lwa sru/ badz+ra mā le nga badz+ra gadhe/ chos dbyings dang las mi g.yo thugs rjes skur ston yang / / thugs kyi gsang ba kun gsal me long mtshon du med/ / brtse dang smon pas gzhan phan yon tan mnyam pa nyid/ / bde gshegs lam gang gsung gis so sor rtogs par dīhūṃ/sa rgya/༷ ༵༵ gru~X ༵༵༷ rdoX ṭ+wāṃ ༷ gruṭ+wāṃ rjiX di phriṭ+wāṃgaXs gaXdzo ༷ /bon/ ༵ sdiṭ+wāṃ/sgra byung bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ḍā bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ cesadang rtsa rig bzla4nas yig brgya dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a ma shasta pra tits+tsha swāhā/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag nas/ kun rig la/ bum pa bsangasbyang sogs nas lha lnga bskyed tshul dkyus ltar la bum pa gcig yin na/gtso bo'i g.yon du pad zla'i gdan la k+ṣi las mched nas/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ bum pa'i lha tshogs nas/ nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa ma dza/dza ྅ paṃ ho ma hā ka ru nga e bye hi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya pra tī tsu swāhā/ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ oṃ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/san bid hūṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sogs lha drug ga'i phyag rgya bzhi dkyus ltar la gong gi rang zhes pa'i gnas rnams su thams cad du rang rang zhes tshig phrad bsgyur/mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a / zhes sogs/badz+ra lā sru/ zhes sogs/ sngags 'bul byas la/ chos sku nam mkha' zhes sogs kyis bstod pa man chad dkyus bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed la gzhal yas khang gong ltar dang gdan rdzogs par bskyed pa nas rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar dkyus bzhin byas la/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ zhes pa'i 'phror/ rta babs dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi khyams kyi lha snam gsum dang sgo bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su ke gre pra kri rnams las rdo rje rin po che pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje/ mkhar sil bcu drug dang bcu gnyis/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i 202

༄/ /kun rig gichog shin tu bsdusapakun phan/phyag mtshan bcu drug ke la sogs pas mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ lha snam nang ma la bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug bar ma la nyan thos bcu drug phyi ma la rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ sgo bzhirakhro bo bcu drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ phyi'i khor yug dkar po'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan rnams kyi steng du skad cig gis dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa'i/ srid pa gsum gyi sde brgyad 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang bcas par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor/ sogs spyan 'dren pa gnas gsum byin rlabs phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs rnams cho ga'i gzhung bzhin bya/'phrin layobacol ba ni/ na mo bha ga wa te nga bi sho dha ne+e swāhā/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ḍā bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ zhesapa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghartse ho bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba gzi brjod kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i lha so bdun gyis rdo rje slob ma'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig na mo bha ga nga ba sho dha ne swāhā/ galba bha tra 2lpa bha tra/dalpa bha tra galpa bha tra/ badz+ra shra wa ga badz+ra pra bye ga badz+ra kro dha/ badz+ra lo ka mgron thabs kyi lha drug cu dang dpal gyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lngas kyang rdo rje slob ma'i zhes sogs 'dra/ gshin po'i don du yin na/ tshe las 'das pa 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol te myur du mngon par byang chub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces bsgyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs dkyus ltar byas la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub pa'i/ / zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / yon tan rgya mtsho'i lo gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wa ra arnya pā rdu ma sta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' nas/badz+ragadhe/ dpag med bsod nams stobs las byung ba yi/ / rgyan gye khyad par brgyad dang yo byad drug / gnas kyi khyad par drug dang mchod pa lnga/ /203

༄/ /yo cabalopa'isgronama'i tsha gtsogargyalasrid rin chen bdun dang 'dod yon lnga/ / rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta snu dza spa gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye shri hūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra snu ra sru ra sru ra ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ ye shes rdo rje lnga bdag nyid/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / / rnam thar bzhi rnam dag pa'i bdag / spyan sogs bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad du/ / bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ / sgyu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa'arnams/ / dgyes bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ / sgeg mo phreng ba glu ma gar/ / spos dang me tog mar me dri/ / phyi nang mchod byed lha mo dang / / sgo pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lha snam gsum la bzhugs pa yi/ /sems dpa' nyan thos rang rgyal dang / / bcu drug sgo bsrung khro bo che/ /khor yug lhar bcas bstod par bgyi/ de nasagatso 'khor gyi bzla4pa yongasardzogasakyi mthar/ dngos grub thams cad cesasogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ cha gsum gyi mchod pa byin rlabasadang / sngagasadrug sogasagazhung bzhin la/ 'byung gyur cig/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba nas/ e byu he/ oṃ ru tra ye ྾shasta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams la gnas pa'i/ / brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ / rang rigs 'khor tshogs bcas pa la/ / mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / oṃ ru tra ye nas/ ba bo te swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum/ de nas/ phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas kyes/ mchod sbyin ྾kun 'grub shog lha dang lha min nas ba bla te gaha/ 'byung bo gang dag nas/ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa sogs/ / rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur/ / zhes sogs man chad dkyus ltar bya'o/ /smras pa/ rtog bzo 'khrul ba'i 'ching bu la/ / nor bur 'dzin rnams 204

༄/ /kun rig gichog shin tubasdusapakunalan/rjes bzung phyir/ / bsdus kyang gnad don tshang ba yi/ / cho ga nor bu'i rna cha 'di/ / gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i gru 'dzin pa/ 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ / dge bas mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi/ / lam bzang bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du par du bsgrub/shu bha mas sarba dza ga te/ /205

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'izla sa'i gsang 'bum ༄7/ / rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa mchog thun dngos grub gter mjod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru badz+ra bi dā rā ya/ gsang gsum sbrang char bcud ldan gsang ba'i bdag / mthu stobs sgra brgyas bdud 'joms rdo rje can/ /byen rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyes nyer 'tshe kun/ / rnam par 'joms pa lhag pa'i lha der 'dud/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid las gzhan min gsang chen bka' yi sdud pa po/ / snyigs ma'i skyon brgyas gtses kyang gzhan min 'gro ba'i don la gcig tu gzhol/ / lhag pa'i lha mchog gang dang gzhan min yab rje 'jigs med dbang po la/ / gus pas 'dud do nam yang gzhan min khyod nyid kho na skyabs su bsten/ / nag phyogs rnam par gcod pa'i rtsibs stong gi/ / 'khor los rab 'byams 'phrin las gling bzhi la/ / dbang bsgyur thabasakyi rnam par cha tshang bar/ / spel 'di skal ldan rnams kyis gus pas bsten/ / de'ang rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la rgyud sde ba zhi so sor gtogs pa dang /mdo lugs su gtogs pa/ grub chen so so nas brgyud pa sogs srol mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang / gtso che ba phyag na rdo rje che ba brgyad dam dgur grags pa rnams yin zhing / de'i nang nas rdo rje rnam 'joms khrus kyi che ba zhes bya ba yin/ 'di'i gzungs mdo dang za ma tog bkod pa sogs rgyud bsgyur ba'i thog ma yin zhing chos rgyal gong ma rnams thugs dam mdzad pas rgyal po mdo 206

༄/ /rdorjernam par 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyelaca lagalngar grags pa byung / grub mtha' ris med la 'phren las khyab brdal du che zhing / rnying ma pa rnams rdo rje phur pa dang ngo bo gcig par 'dod/ 'di nyid las/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa zhes pa'i don du bsams te ma gshin phur gsum sogs kyi los spyor gang la'ang bog 'byin pa'i rgyab chos 'di la byed do/ / 'di la'ang rnam 'joms ljangasngon rdo rje gdan pa nas pa ri lo tsā ba la brgyud pa da lta grags che zhing /rnam 'joms dkar po sa wa ri ba'i lugs lha bcu dgu pa'i dbang sogs de wa pā r+ṇa nas mgar chos bzang la brgyud pa dang / grub chen rā hu las mkhas grub khyung po la gnang pa rnam 'joms 'i ba dkar po dang drag po ljang gu sbrags sgrub cig kyang yod/ rnam 'joms mthing ga gsang sgrub ni khyung pos ni gu ma la gsan zhing / mang 'od byang chub shes rab nas brgyud pa rnam 'joms mthing ga khro bo bcus bskor ba zhig kyang yod/ grub thob shol po ba zhes rnying ma dang bka' gdams 'brel ma'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa zhig gis kyang rnam 'joms mthing ga'i sgrub pa byas pas zhal gzigs te sgrub thabs snga mdang cung mi 'dra ba zhig byas/ rje btsun sa skya ba chen po la birlu bas dag snangagi tshul du dbang bskur ba ni dbang bzhi tshang pas bla med kyi lugs yin zhing gtso bo yab yum khro bo bcu/ pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi/ sgo ba bzhi ste lha don dgu yod pas 'di la rnam 'joms bir lugs su grags/ mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje'i gdams pa 'di'ang phyogs tsam de dang 'dra'ang de la khungs bcol ba min par/ rang nyid la yi dam lhas ji ltar gnang ba bzhin dkod pa yin par 'dug pas grub chen gyi dgongs pa gzhir bzung / man ngag gab sbasakyis cung zad mi gsal zhing go rim dkrug pa rnams don dang mi 'gal bar bcos shing bsdebs nas lag tu blang bde bar nag 'gros su 'god pa la/bdag bskyed dang 'brel bar bsnyen pa sngon du bya tshul/ bsnyen pa las su rung 207

༄/ /yo cabalopa'azla sa' ga 'thuganas dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod de dbang bskur ba/ zhar byung nye bar mkho ba'i las tshogs gzhan bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/dang po ni/ rten dang mchod gtor bshams/ khrus dang gtsang sbra byas/bde ba'i stan la spyod lam tshul mthun gyis 'khod de skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje gtum po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ mchod pa/ athratas bsangs/ ga bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snong yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster bar gyur/ oṃ a 〉 rtu nas shasta ā : gi bar gyis byin gyisabarlabs/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ mthing gas mtshan pa las paṃ yig cig chad de mdun du gnas pa yongs gyur pa las/ pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can gyi gnas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje dbyer med pa 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ pad+ma'i steng du bzhugs par gyur/ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa 'di/ / dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing / /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skyob pa chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs nams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe4phyag bya/ oṃ a pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ a gyi gnas su/ 〉bye/ pukhye/ ju pe/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/208

༄/ /rdorjernamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagane+e wi du/ shasta pra tītsā ye swāhā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhesapa nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / cesapa'i bar gyisargyun bshagasalan gsum bya/ badz+ra mu tshogs zhing rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba mtha' dag dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba la gnas par gyur cig / sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po'i sa la gnas par gyur cig / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngo4gzhil rten dang brten pa gsal gdab pa/ yoshes pa spyan drangasate mchod cing bstems/ bzlasapa'i rim pa sogs gsum/ dang po ni/ gong du bsod nams kyi tshogasasong zin nas/ 'dir ye shes kyi tshogs gsog dgos payosngags don dran bzhinapar/ oṃ su bhā wa shurnya saspru dhasmo su bhā wa shurnyo3nya/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūṃ mthing ga gcig tu gyur pa de las e yig cig chad de 'og tu lon pa yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum rtsa ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka gyen du phyogs shing phyi sngo la nang dmar ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ de'i nang du yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu'i mchog ma gnyis la ba dan gyes mtshan pa/de'i steng du re las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po zur du ram̐ 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po blum po phyogs bzhir bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du li las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / zur bzhir lcog chen brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i 2khya

sa / /gung thang bstanaba'i sgronas gsung 'bum/steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can lte ba sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ rdo rje chung ngu mang pos srub thams cad bkag ste bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣi hūṃ/ de'i 'og gi nyi dkyil 'od du zhu nas ye shes kyi me'i ngo bor gyur te shar du zhe sdang sreg pa'i me mthing nag tu 'bar ba/ lhor phrag dog sreg pa'i me ser nag tu 'bar ba/nub tu 'dod chags sreg pa'i me dmar nag tu 'bar ba/ byang du nga rgyal sreg pa'i me ljang nag tu 'bar ba/ dbus su gti mug sreg pa'i me srug nag tu 'bar ba/ steng gi me lce 'og tu 'bar zhing 'khrug pa/ 'og gi me lce steng du 'bar zhing 'khrug pa/ me'u 'ur sgra dang tsheg sgras stong gsum g.yo ba lta bur gyur/ rang sems hūṃ gi rnam pa de las slar yang hūṃ yig cig chad de srung 'khor gyi dbus su gnas pa zhu ba las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag po dang / ljang gu dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i shar bu dang mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par phub pa/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung ba'is mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis spras pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ sgo'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang ri dwags dang / gzhan yang 'phan dang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas spras pa/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas 210

༄/ /rdorjernamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagapa'i phyi rol tu 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i shing ljon pa lo 'dab rgyas pa/ me tog kha dog sna tshogs dang ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i shing tog smin par 'phyang ba/ shing ljon pa de la sprul pa'i bya mang pos gsang sngags kyi sgra sgogs pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i khrus kyi dzing bu la chu bya mang po lding ba/ ne'u gseng dang ma rmos pa'i lo thog sogs yid la bde ba skyed pa'i mchod pas dkrigs pa/ de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag sogs kyi dur khrod brgyad na shir+sha la sogs pa'i shing brgyad kyi rtsa bar brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang / rtse mor glang po'i gdong ba can sogs zhing skyong brgyad/ bhi shadha ka la sogs pa'i chu brgyad la nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu brgyad dang / de'i steng du sgrog byed ser po la sogs pa'i sprin brgyad byang chub chen po la sogs pa'i mchod rten brgyad dang / in+d+ra bo dhi la sogs pa'i grub chen brgyad/ ye shes kyi me brgyad dang de la gnas pa'i srin po brgyad/ rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi lhun po la sogs pa'i ri brgyad/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su mi ro che chung mang po khra khres su yod pa/ keng rus skamarlon du ma rang rong du spungs pa/ stag gzig dom dred mang po ngar sgra dngangur sgras 'gengs pa/ dur bya rjen sha za ba mang po rgyu lto 'brad pa/ phra men dang 'dre srin mang pos skyo zhing 'jigs pa'i snang ba sna tshogs ston pa/bdudadang gshin rje srin po ma rung bas gad mo chen po rgod pa/ zhing skyong mkha'a'agro mang po sna tshogs pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang phyag rgya dang bcas te dur khrod brgyad po de dag nyul ba sogs skyi g.ya' zhing ngo mtshar bar byed pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng dang 'og gis gzhi thams cad shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus in+d+ra nī la'i sa gzhi ltar mthing ga de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa mu khyud rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte 211

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sne ga ཿma/bar a las zla ba dang ri las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi dang 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu/ sgo bzhi sogs la re las nyi gdan dang /mtshams kyi pad 'dab bzhi la a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ rang sems hūṃ gi yi ge nam mkhar gnas pa de nyid gdan dbus ma'i steng du babs pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod sems can gye don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa log 'dren tshar gcod pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs gar gdengs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung 'byin pa/ sma ra'i gseb nas me stag 'phro ba/dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'phro ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas dgra dang bgegs mnan pa/ g.yon brkyangs pas bdud dang mu steg mnan pa/ klu rgyal rigs dkar khras dbu brgyan pa/ rje'u rigs ser khras snyan rgyan dang dpung rgyan byas pa/ bram ze'i rigs dmar khras mgul ba brgyan pa/dmangs rigs ljang khras phyag gdub byas pa/ gdol ba nag pos do shal byas pa/ rdo rje'i la thod dang / rdo rje chung ngu za ram tshags su 'phyang ba/ rdo rje'i snyan rgyan dang dpung rgyan/ rdo rje'i mgul rgyan/ rdo rje'i phyag gdub zhabs gdub/ rdo rje'i do shal/ rdo rje'i la thod dang / mgul rgyan/ do shal gsum la rdo rje chung ngu zar ma tshags su 'phyang ba ste rdo rje'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūṃ bzhi chad de phyogs kye 'dab mar 'khod pas/ shar du hūṃ las rdo rje gtum po sku mdog spug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ lhor hūṃ las rdo rje phur pa sku mdog ser nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas phur ba/ nub tu hūṃ las rdo rje pe 212

༄/ /rdo rnamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyil cha lagacon sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas be+e con/ byang du hūṃ las rdo rje tho ba sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas tho ba/thams cad kyis g.yas kyi phyag mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdegs mdzub thugs gar gdengs pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ klu rigs lnga dang rdo rje'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang nas bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ hrī rta bzhi chad de mtshams kyi 'dab mar 'khod pas/ shar lhor hūṃ las sangs rgyas spyan sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/lho nub tu ṭ+wāṃ las mā ma kyi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che/ nub byang du hrī las gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyisagayas pad+ma/ byang shar du ྅ las dam tshig sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ut+pal/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin shel/ g.yu/ byu ru/ yin+d+ra dī la'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/thams cad rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhal gtso bo la phyogs te bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ga nas hūṃ bcu chad de rtsibs bcu la 'khod pa las/ shar du rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog dkar po rdo rje bsnams pa/ shar lhor dbyug sngon can sku mdog sngon po dbyug pa bsnams pa/ lhor gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog ser po be con bsnams pa/ lho nub tu khro gnyer can sku mdog dmar nag ral gri bsnams pa/nub tu rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po pad+ma bsnams pa/ nub byang du don yod zhags pa sku mdog mthing kha mdung thung bsnams pa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang nag rdo rje bsnams pa/ byang shar du rdo rje 'khor lo sku mdog ljang gu 'khor lo bsnams pa/ steng du hūṃ chen kā ra sku mdog mthing kha rdo rje bsnams pa/ 'og phyogs su stobs po che sku mdog nag po rtse gsum bsnams pa 213

༄/ /yo cabalopa'azla ma'igasang 'atsogaste/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs gar sdigs mdzub gdengs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams gsol ba/ klu rigs lngas brgyan cing rdo rje rgyan drug gis spras pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la shar du bkra shis kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar mo g.yas gdugs dang g.yon me tog bsnams pa/ shar lhor bkra shis kyi lha mo sku mdog ser mo g.yas gser nya dang g.yon snang gsal bsnams pa/ lhor bkra shisakyi lha mo sku mdog dmar mo g.yas dung dang g.yon sil snyan bsnams pa/lho nub tu bkra shis kyi lha mo sku mdog dmar mo g.yas pad+ma g.yon zhal zas bsnams pa/ nub tu bkra shis kyi lha mo sku mdog ser mo g.yas gser bum g.yon pi wang bsnams pa/ nub byang du bkra shis kyi lha mo sku mdog dmar mo g.yas rgyal mtshan g.yon bdug spos bsnams pa/ byang du bkra shis kyi lha mo sku mdog sngon mo g.yas dpal be'u g.yon dri chab bsnams pa/ byang shar du bkra shis kyi lha mo sku mdog ljang gu g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon lha'i na bza' bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang sku la rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs gar stabs su bzhugs pa/ shar gyi khyams la rdo rje'i rigs kyi pho nya bcu drug sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ lhor rin po che'i rigs kyi pho nya bcu drug sku mdog ser po/g.yas rdo je g.yon zhags pa/ nub tu pad+ma'i rigs kyi pho nya bcu drug sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon lcags sgog byang du las kyi rigs kyi pho nya bcu drug sku mdog ljang gu g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu bsnams pa ste/thams cad kyang rin po ches brgyan cing zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul gyes pad+ma'igadan la bzhugs pa/ shar sgor dza las lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho 214

༄/ /rdorjernamapar 'jomasapa'i ༅dkyelaca lagasgorahūṃ las zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor baṃ las lcags sgog ma dmar mo/byang sgor ho las dril bu ma ljang gu ste/ thams cad rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ de bzhi ga'i phyi ngos su shar sgor yul 'khor srung / lho sgor 'phags skyes po/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang / byang sgor rnam thos sras te bzhi ga'ang sku mdog phyogs kyi mdog can/ zhi ma khro'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i steng du mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mchod cing skor ba mdzad pa/phyi rol 'jig rten skyong ba'i khor yug la phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rnams dang srung ma'i tshogs thams cad bzhugs pa/lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ mthing gas mtshan par gyur/gnyisapa yoshes pa spyan 'dren pa sogayoni/ hūṃ ma lus sems can kun gye mgon gyur cing / / mi bzad bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gye lha tshogs rnams/ / thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can srung ma dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bi rā ra sa pa ri wa ra a nas sta'i bar gyi4mchod/ dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/oṃ arnya sogs kyisamachod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ / ji ltar mchod cing gsol ba ltar/ / bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ / nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs 215

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'izla ma' ga 'chagabaskrad/ rigs lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ rang dang lha tshogs kyi spyi gtsug nas/ khrus mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin pas/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta a snyi treñtsa ta ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams/ mgrin pa/ snying ga te ba/ gsang gnas/yan lag rim pa bzhin gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rim bzhin dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la dbus su phyag na rdo rje/ g.yas su 'jam dpal/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dang / gzhan rnams la'ang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/gsum pa bzlas pa sogasakyi rim pa ni/ rang gi thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa sogs mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad med par byas/ pha rol gyi rig sngags byad stems sogs kyi las dang / gza' dang rgyu skar ngan pa sogs mi bzad pa'i gdon gyi nyer 'tshe dang / rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad zhi bar byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa phul te/ de dag gi byin rlabs drangs nas bstem pas rig sngags ma grub pa rnams grub cing /grub zin rnams brtan par byas/ tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur par bsam4la yid gzhan du ma yengasapar bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzla bya'i sngags gzungs ring ni rtsa sngagasayin la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsa ṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tadu thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/zhes pa nas/ sti bhirdo badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ce4pa snying po dang / na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā 216

༄/ /rdorjenamapar 'joms pa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagaya/ zhes sogasanye snying yin zhing de gsum gang rung gis chog go / paṇa grub so so'i 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs rnams su lha lnga/ lha dgu/ lha bcu gsum/ bcu dgu sogs mi 'dra ba mang bas 'khor gyi sngags ngos 'dzin mi 'dra'ang / grub chen gye gsung 'di sangs rgyas gsang ba dang mthun shas che bas/ de ltar na nye snying gi hu lu sogs bzhi nang gi khro bo bzhi la byas nas de lnga gar gtso bo'i tha snyad kyang mdzad do/ / snying po'i ha ra ha ra badz+ra sogs bcu khro bcu'i sngags yin zhing / rtsa sngags kyi nang du rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo khro mo pho nya mngag gzhug thams cad kyi sngags tshang ba yin no/ / yang tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa zhes sogs sngags tshan bzhi'ang nang gi khro bo bzhi'i sngags yin zhing so sor spyor tshul/sangs rgyas gsang bas phur ba be+e con tho ba gtum po bzhi la rim bzhin sbyar yang / slob dpon pad+mas mdzad zer ba'i 'grel par/ gtum po/ phur bu/be+e con/ tho ba bzhi la sbyar ba sngags dang mtshan zur mthun zhing sgrub thabs 'di'i go rim dang 'grig go / bzlas pa'i mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams la sngar bzhin mchod/ mthu stobs rtse brgya 'bar ba yis/ /bgegs dang log 'dren kun 'joms shing / / 'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ / khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / ces pas bstod/ bod kyi bla ma snga ma pha cher bsnyen pa byed tshe mdun bskyed bum pa nyi rigs la brten dgos par 'dod kyang / mar me mdzad bzang po sogs khungs thub du mas mngon rtogs kyi bsnyen pa las zur du ma gsungs pas bdag bskyed kyi steng nas byas chog par sngags rim du gsung ngo / /des na 'dir bsnyen pa gtong tshul zur tsam 'god na/ thog mar chos srung la gtor 'bul/ yul lha la dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor sogs btang ste/ mtshams tho bslang nas skyed chog gdan la g.yung drung 'bri ba/217

༄/ /yo cabalomi'isgronace' g.yo ཿmayo byad tshogs shing mchod gtor bsham pa/ khrus dang bsang dud bya ba sogs spyi ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i tshe ma g.yeng zhing tha mal gyi ngag dang lha gzhan gyi sngags kyang ma 'dres la/ glal sbred 'og rlung gnyid sogs kyang ma shor ba byed cing / gal te byung na thun btang ste khrus dang nye reg byas te slar thun la 'jug dgos pas snga ma bsnyen grangs su mi gzhug spyir bya rgyud la sngags dang phyag rgya rim pa mang po zhig yod kyang / 'di snyigs ma'i gdul bya brtson 'grus dang blo'i mthu zhan pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du 'jug pa bde ba'i tshul gyes yi dam lhas dngos su gnang ba yin pas kha bskang dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang / las rung gi skabs sogs su cung zad rgyas par byas na bzang bas/skad cig dkrong skyed kyi rjes der rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam rgya thal mo bzlog ste sbyaral mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung sbyar te lte ba'i thad gar bzhag nas/oṃ badz+ra uste wa ye swāhā/ zhes dang / mthe bong gis mthe'u chung gi sen mo mnan la sor mo lhag ma rnams rdo rje'i mtshan nyid du byas te bsnol nas dpung bar bzhag la/ na mo rat+na tra waya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha brnya bsnya ha na ha na a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bdag dang gnas thams cad bsrung / mtsham mgor 'phreng ba snyim par bzung ste/ oṃ kyi ri gī ri ro tri ṇi sāhā/ zhes pa lan brgya rtsa bzlas nas 'phreng ba bsgrub/ rgyun du bzlas pa'i mgor/ oṃ badz+ra ya dza tan dza ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun bzla'o/ /phreng ba ni ru rak+ka mchog yin la/ bo ti tsis kyang rung / bzlas pa byed tshul dpung bzang las/ bzlas bajod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing / /sgracher mi bya ha cang chung ba min/ / smra zhing ma yin gzhan du g.yeng bzhin min/ / gug skyed klad kor tsheg rnams nyams pa min/ /zhes sogs dman lhag myur bu la sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba bya/ thog mar shub bu'i bzlas pa 218

༄/ /rdorjenamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagadang / cung zad brtan pa thob nas yid bzlas bya bar gsung / grangs legs grub las/ bco lnga man chad grangs rnams la/ / spyir na yi ge du yod pa/ / de snyed 'bum phrag bzlas bajod bya/ / yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ /bzlas brjod sum 'bum bya bar bshad/ / de bas yi ge mang po la/ / sngon du bsnyen pa khri bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pas/ nye snying la byed na sum 'bum bzla dgos shing / snying po'am rtsa sngags la byed na khris chog go / 'di'i gzungs mdor/ lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ / yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ / rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas ni/ / zhes pa bi ma la mi tra sogs kyis khrus kyi tshe rgyal po dang 'bangs la khyad phye ba yin par bshad kyang /sangs rgyas gsang ba dang ye shes rdo rjes rtsa sngags dang sngags thung la sbyar zhing / spro tis thun re la rtsa sngags nyer gcig sngags thung brgya rtsa brgyad yan chad bzla ba'i don du bshad pas de ltar bya/ ye shes 'beb sngags ni nye snying gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes btags pa yin la/ spyi 'gro lhur hūṃ ha arto zhes btags kyang chog ces kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos gsungs/ bzla tshul thun thams cad la cha bgo ba'am/ gtso bo'i sngags grangasardzogs nas bzla ba gang byas kyang chog la/ grangs khri phrag gcig bzla/bsnyen grangs gnas dang mtshams rgyun gcig la 'gro dgos shing kha skong gi sbyinasreg slar nam 'grig tu bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrubasate mchod cing dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag bskyed sngon du btang / dkyil 'khor 'grem pa'i gzhi der maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu dgod/ mdun du skad cig gis sa'i lha mo brtan ma sku mdog ser mo/g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin cing rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ gre shrī bi nge bī arnya sogs kyisamachod/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / spyod pa'i tshul dang 219

༄/ /gung cabamami'itsho me'i ga ཿma/khyad par dang / / sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ / lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ / ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ / de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ / pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /lan gsum/ dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par gyur/ ras bris la brtan chos brtag bslang sbyang ba rnams mi dgos shing / lha sta gon ma byas kyang chogabum pa sta gon ni/ grub chen gyis bla ma phyag na rdo rjer bskyed pa/ yi dam phyagan rdo rjer bskyed pa zhes gsungs pa'i snga ma bum skyed yin pa gzhung du gsal la/ phyi ma mdun skyed yin pa gtor ma 'bul tshul sogs kyis shes shing / mngon rtogs mun sel sgron mer bdag mdun bum gsum byas nas gsungs so/ blos lcogs na bdag skyed dang gsum ga mnyam du sgrub chog par gsungs kyang bdag skyed sngon du btang na bde bas/ 'dir bum pa dang mdunaskyed lhan du sgrub tshul ni/ ras bris bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung gru gsum/ zheyopa nas/ stong gsum g.yo ba lta bur gyur/ de'i dbus su sbyo yig yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i gdan re re/ de nasabum pa bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa phra ba la lha rdzas kyi gos kyis dkris pa/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang phyi nang kun gsal par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ takuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad zla nyi so so'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ gzhal yas khang gnyi ga'i dbus dang phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi rtsibs bcu rnams la hūṃ yig dang /220
