༄/ /rdorjernamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagamatshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ hrī ṭ+wāṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi sgo bzhir dza : baṃ ho bzhi rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs kyi skur bzhengs pa ni/ gnyi ga'i dbus su dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag ce4pa nas/ 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ shar du rdo rje gtum po zhes sogs dang / lhor rdo rje phur bu zhes sogasasbyar/ g.yon brkyang nas bzhugs pa/ shar lhor sangs rgyas spyan zhesapa nas/ phyogs te bzhugs pa/ rtsibs bcu la shar du rnam par rgyal ba zhesapa nas/ brkyang bskum gyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ / mdun bskyed kyi so so'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la zhes pa nas/srung ma'i tshogs thams cad bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar bdag skyed ltar la/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu zhes sogasabasgyur/ las bum gyi nang du baṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs gar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon sna tshogs rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / dar gyi stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ khro bo'i nyams thams cad dang ldan zhing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po zhes pa nas/ rgyas gdab kyi bar bdag skyed ltar la rang sgra dor/ mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlab/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub pa'i/ / zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / yon tan rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ / dad pa rgya mtshos 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra a pra tīts+tsha sāhā/ zhes mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil sogs dang / a gyi gnas su 〉rdusogs bcug ste shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ / phyogs 221

༄/ /gung ca b.lo༅ ma'igayo lamadus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ / mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal tu gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan yid 'ong sgra snyan zhes sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga dbul/ phun tshogasatshos kyi srid la 'dod dgu ru/ / dbang sgyur byed pa'i rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra mahā sasta rat+na pratī ts+tsha swāhā/ mthong thos dran dang reg pa tsam gyis kyang / / dge legs dpal ster bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad/ / mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi/ / bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ badz+ra bi dā ras pa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭṛ mgo la pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ dbus phyogs rnam dag drag po'i dkyil 'khor du/ / chos nyid rnam dag dbyings las bzhengs pa'i dpal/ / sku mdog mthing nag mkha' ltar dag pa'i 'od/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nyon mongs spong la bstod/ / zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas brgya gram 'dzin/ / g.yon pa sdigs mdzub gdengs pas log 'dren gzer/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs hūṃ gi 'brug sgra 'byin/ /spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur bgrang la bstod/ / dbu skra gyen bsgreng mi bskyod dbu la brgyan/ / brkyang bskum gar gyis dgra bgegs gdug pa brdzis/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ / nyon mongs rtog pa'i grong khyer 'joms la bstod/ /ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor kun gye gtso/ /rigs kyi mnga' bdag khro rgyal kun gyi rje/ stobs bcu'i stobs ldan pha rol phyin bcu'i bdag / rdo rje rgyan gyes spras la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bzhi'i chu skyes nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ / hūṃ las skyes pa'i phyogs kye khro rgyal bzhi/ / rigs kyi khro bo rngam pa'i ngang tshul can/ / las bzhi'i las 222

༄/ /rdorjernamapar 'jomasapa'i sadakyilaca lagamadzad khro rgyal bzhi la bstod/ / mtshams bzhi'i chu skyes ri bong dkyil 'khor steng / / rigs kyi mdog can rgyal ba'i yum chen bzhi/ / sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis klubs/ / mdzes pa'i tshul 'chang rigs kyi yum la bstod/ / 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcur ram̐ yig las byung steng / / pha rol phyin bcu'i mnga' bdag khro rgyal bcu/ / sku mdog nges med mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis/ / phyogs bcu 'dul mdzad khro rgyal bcu la bstod/ / phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng / / sku mdog sna tshogs mdzes tshul gar stabs kyis/ / 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyal ba mchod/ / bkra shis lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang rtags chas 'dzin las kyi pho nya dang / / 'phrin las bzhi ldan ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ / rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu la sogs/ / drag po'i las mdzad srung ma'i tshogs la bstod/ / rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bum nang gi lha dang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas/ rgyal bsras bcas kyi byin rlabs bsdus te bstem pas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang par bsams lagazungs thag bzung ste sngags gsum bzla gzungs rdor las bum gyi khar bzhag la amṛ ta bzla/ nye snying brjod de dung chosakyi chu bum pa gnyis su blug pas lha rnamasazag pa med pa'i bde ba'i rang bzhin du zhu ste bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsamasagator ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ ā rtu zhu ba las zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs ka nas kyang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par gcig tu 'dres pas kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ro brgya dang ldan pa gcig tu bsams la/ salha ra lan gsum gyisabyin gyis brlab/ mdun 223

༄/ /yo thangabastanapa'itshanamatha ga 'gegabaskyed kyi lha rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus drangs te gsol bar gyur/oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro zhesasogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ bsnyen pa'i skabs ltabur bdag skyed kyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul tshe byin rlabs kyi rjes la/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje3ma par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus drangs te zheyosogasasbyar dgos/ sta gon gyi nyin bum pa tsam sgrub tshe/ gdan dang bcas par gyur pa'i dbus dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi rtsibs bcu rnams la hūṃ yig dang / mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ hrī 1 rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs kyi skur bzhengs pa ni/ dbus su dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhegaspyor zhing / brkyang bskum gye tshul gyis bzhugasapa'o/ / zhesapa'i 'phror las bum bsgrub cing mdun bskyed ceyopa bzhag pa'i lhag ma thams cad 'dra ste/ grub chen gyisarnam rgyal du lha bcu dgu las ma gsungs so/ /de nas slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas mdun du 'khod pa la/ de'ang 'di nyid kye gzungs mdo las/ de nas rab bkrus gtsang ma yis/ / mdo sde dam pa mnyan par gyis/ / gang dag yid dge sems dngas shing / /gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ /zhes pas slob ma sta gon gyi rim pa dang / nor bu yungs gar durba dang / zhes pa man chad kyis bu mchog bstan par slob dpon zhi 'tsho'i 'grel par gsungs la/bumachog bstan pa'i shugs kyis dkyil 'khor gye cho ga 'grub par ye shes rdo rje'i 'grel par gsungs/ snga mas sta gon gyi rim pa bstan tshul ni/ rab bkrus gtsang ma zhes pa slob dpon bde ba'i myu gu'i rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa las/ phyi'i khrus kyis nyon mongs sbyangs te nyan thos kyi byang chub 'grub pa/nang gi khrus lha'i rnal 'byor gyis rang rgyal gyi byang chub 'grub pa/ gsang ba'i 224

༄/ /rdorjenamapar 'jomasala'i sgrubadakyilaca lagakhrus kyis sems tsam du rtogs pa/ de kho na nyid kyi khrus kyis spros bral rtogs parabashad pa lta bu don la gnas mi gnas kyi bshad tshul mang po yod kyang /rgyudardo rje rtse mo las khrus bzhi dang gos gsum gsungs pa'i don tshang dgos pas/ mdor bsdu na kun slong rnam par dag pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa gzung ba/ lha'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa ste snod rung du byed pa'i rim pa bstan pa yin/ dang po kun slong 'chos tshul ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ la la gsangasngags sgrub don gnyer/ / 'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ / gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ / 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ / dad pa mang du byed pa yi/ / blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yis/ / tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ / tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa las/ / 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ / 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ / 'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu'ang rgyas/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kun slong dman pa'i 'di dang phyi ma'i mngon mtho tsam don du gnyer ba lta bu ma yin par/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du chos zab mo 'di nyid gsan snyam pa byed dgos/ gsan bya'i chos ni rgyal bas chos phung ji snyed cig bka' stsal pa rnams kyi mchog gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde ba'ir yod pa las bya ba'i rgyud/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs gsum ste drug yod pa'i rdo rje'i rigs/de la'ang sde tshan 'ga' yod pas/ kha cig rdo rje'i rigs kye khro bor 'dod kyang / rang lugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag por 'jog pa yin/ gsung ba'i gnas kyang gzungs kyi mgor/ rdo rje la bzhugs te zhes pa la brten nas rdo rje gdan du gsung bar 'dod mkhan mang yang / slob dpon sangs rgyas 225

༄/ /gung ca bstanar+sā 7 g.yo la /gsang bas rdo rje gdan ni 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas yin gyi/ chos gsung ba'i gnas ma yin par bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i mdo las gsungs pa drangs te bkag nas/ gzungs 'di ri rab kyi shar lho rdo rje lhun po ri rab kyi zom zhes bya bar gsungs pa yin/ der ma zad/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ / zhes pa'ang rdo rje lhun po ri rab kyi zom gyi rgyud de la le'u brgya dang brgyad yod pas/le'u dang po mdor bstan lta bu 'di yin pas 'og ma thams cad kyi rtsa bar bstan pa yin/ 'di la 'phags yul gye 'grel ba bdun brgyad tsam dang /gzungs kyi tshig re re la brten pa'i las spyor re re byas pas/ las sbyor brgya rtsa sogs bshad sgrub gnyi ga'i sgo nas dar rgyas che ba byung / spro na gong gi lo rgyus kyang 'dir sbyor/ khyad par du lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje zhes pa dpal gsang ba'i bdag po mi'i gzugs su shar ba yin pas yi dam lha dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis shing / thun mong snang tshod la'ang yi dam lhas zhal dngos su bstan te zab cing rgya che ba'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa stsol bar mdzad pa'i nang tshan rdo rje rnam 'joms mthing ga'i dbang gsan par byed pa la/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong kun spyod spyi bye brag thams cad gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ zhes brda sprad/ de nas chu dang yungs gar/'bras chang / chang bu lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ste g.yas dang g.yon du bskor zhing / oṃ sazo pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing byur thams cad bsal bar bsam/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ / slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ / dam tshig de nyid stsal tu gsol/ / byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par bgye/ / zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/226

༄/ /rdo rjenamalar 'joms pa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagasems bskyed pa'i cho ga yan lag bdun pa bya ba la/ mdun du tshogs zhing nam mkha' gang ba bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas te/ de'i drung du sngon 'gro sdeg pa bshags shing skyabs su 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi bdag 'bul ba dang sems bskyed pa'i sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gzung ba/ rjes kyi yan lag bskulagasol bsngo ba rnams tshul bzhin du byed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis byas la/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ / sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas byang sems spyan sngar ni/ / dus rnams kun tu bshags par bgyi/ / sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ / sems can rnams la brtse ba'i phyir/ / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ / byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ / sangs rgyas kun dang de yi sras/ / shes rab can la bdag 'bul gyi/ / khyed rnams kyis ni bdag bzhes la/ / 'bras bu rgya chen stsal tu gsol/ / sdug bsngal chu bo'i nang gnas pa'i/ / skye bo yun gnas bskyangs padang / / rgyal ba'i bzhed pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ / byang chub snying por nyer gnas te/ / gang rnams byang chub mchog rtogs pa'i/ / bdag gis gsol bas rgyal ba kun/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ / bya ba thams cad sngon byas nas/ / sangs rgyas mya ngan 'da' rnams la/ / bdag gis gsol bas rgyal ba kun/ / sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'dar gsol/ / phyag 'tshal mchod sogs bsod nams gang / /tshad med bdag gis bsags pa rnams/ / ji ltar mgon pos mkhyen pa bzhin/ / byang chub tu ni de bzhin bsngo/ / zhes lan gsum gyis byang sdom 'bog / des byang sdom thob pa yin pas byang sdom gye bslab bya mtha' dag la slob dgos shing / 'di la sngags sdom len rgyu med na'ang sngags kyi dam tshig bsrung dgos pa mang du yod pas 'di dag kyang gsan par zhu/ de ring phyin chad khyed rnams kyis/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / / rigs 227

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'izla sa gsung 'bum/lnga'i tshogs rnams ma lus par/ / dad pa rab tu bsten par byos/ / khyad par theg pa chen po la/ / rtag par rab tu mos par bya/ / dam tshig can dang mdza' bo dang / / bla ma la ni gus par bya/ / lha rnams kun la sdang mi bya/ / dus mtshams rtag tu mchod par bya/ / ston pa gzhan gyi gzhung mi mchod/ /rtag tu glo bur mgron mchod bya/ / srog chags rnams la byams pa yis/ / rab tu brtan pas nye bar bzhag / theg pa che la dga' rnams kyis/ / bsod nams dag la nan tan skyed/ / bzlas brjod byed la 'bad pa yis/ / gsang sngags spyod la brtson par bya/ / gsang sngags rgyud la brten pa yi/ / dam tshig rnams ni bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig med pa rnams la ni/ / sngags dang phyag rgya sbyin mi bya/ / gsang sngags rgyud nas legs gsungs pa/ / de yang bdag gis rtogs par bya/ / zhes pa'i bar bajod/sdom pa 'bog pa'i skor 'di rnams ni/ gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing / /zhes dge ba'i bsam pa khyad par can skyed pa dang / yul khyad par can la sems dang bar byed tshul ni/ zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul pa/ /zhes zab cing gsang bar bstan pas snod du rung mi rung dang bar chad yod med sogs zhib tu brtag dgos par bstan pa de rtog tshul so shing dang rmi lam gye sgo nas brtag khyor chu dang dpung skud kyis dri ma bkru zhing srung bar byed pa yin pas 'di rnams tshig rkang des bstan pa yin/ so shing gi rtse gyen nam bla ma la bstan na mchog dang / shar lho nub byang zhi rgyas dbang drag dang /mtshams su 'jig rten pa dang / thur du bltas na 'og gi dngos grub thob par brda sbyar te/ so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog bcings pa badz+rayags bsangs nas lag par gtad de 'dor du gzhug / las bum gye chu sbyin zhing / oṃ hrī bi shurnya dharmā sarja bā pi ni tsa asru sho dhu saze bi mawā na a ba na ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ hub gsum btung bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi 228

༄/ /rdorjenamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagasdig sgrib dag par bsam/ lhag ma cung zad rgyab tu dor/ srad bu dmar po sum sgril la mdud pa gsum byas pa la yang snying bzlas pa dpung pa g.yon la bcings te/ oṃ lo tsā na ya tha ta tram̐ saṃ pra ḍi mi ba shu ti ta rat+na tā ya sad ti na biradar sha ya swāhā/ byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du gnod byed srungs shig / ces bajod/ ku sha badz+ra yak+ṣas bsangs te/ chung ba dhī zhes g.yas dang / che ba ha zhes g.yon du gtad/ chung ba sngas dang che ba stan du byas te rmi lam brtag dgos par brda sprad/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhuga'adir 'ga' zhig tu sbyin sreg gi sta gon zhig kyang bshad/ grub chen gyis gtor ma lhag gnas bya bar gsungs pas/ sang dbang skur byed pa la bar chadami 'byung ba'i phyir yi dam chos srung la gtor 'bul dang cha bzhi sogs bsngo/ sta gon yongs grags kyi khyad par ma tshang ba rnams kha bskang dgos pa'i nges pa med do/ / dngos gzhi'i nyin bdag skyed sngon du btang / bum pa dang mdun bskyed lhan du bsgrub/ bum lha bzhus nas mdun bskyed la gtor ma dbul/ shugs 'jug mi dgos/ 'og tu dbang tshul bshad pa 'dor len cung zad dang / slob ma zhes pa rnams su bdag sgra sbyor ba ma gtogs ji lta ba bzhin du bdag 'jug blangs/ bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog / shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ / bden pa de yis mgon po khyod/ /'dod pa dag la yongs rdzogs mdzod/ / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ / gzung du med cing brjod du med/ / rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung / / de nyid de bzhin nyid ngos 'byung / / bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ / gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ / kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces bden stobs brjod/ slob ma khrus byas mdun du 'khod nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dri lam dris nas bar chad zlog pa'i phyir las sngags kyis bsangs/ kun slong bcos te/229

༄/ /gung ca bayo bsoyo go ཿma/dga' chen khyod bdag ces sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum bya/ las bum gyi chubyin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ / dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ / ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ / de ma thag tu dral nas gshegs/ / rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / / bdun brgyud rigs rnams rlag par byed/ / de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis/ / rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang / / sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'/ / shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ / khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ / ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /rdzun dang 'dod pa spyod pa rnams/ / dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing / / sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ / sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ / nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ / dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang / / dus kun tu ni byang chub sems/ / snyibapo sngags dang phyag rgya dang / / lhag dang bla ma de bzhin no/ / sdig pa'i las rnams gang yin dang / / bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ / lha la phul ba'i rnying pa dang / / de yi grib ma'ang 'gom mi bya/ / phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no/ / sngags dang lha la smod mi bya/ / gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min/ / mu stegs can la smad mi bya/ / mdor na the tshom yid gnyis spangs/ / bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ / zhes dam tshig bsgrags nas dbang bskur ba la/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i rim pa dang / zhugs pa la dbang dngos gzhi bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po la'ang byin gyes brlabs pa nas bkru bya ba bsrung ba'i bar mang du yod pas so sor spyan dmigs ma yengs pa mdzod ces brda sprad la/ slob ma'i spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par spru las pad+ma ā0sa mtshan pa/ thugs gar hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ lte ba dang gsang gnas su'ang hūṃ re res mtshan par gyur/230

༄/ /rdorjernamapar 'jomasapa'isnabadakyilaca lagam hi sbri rā ya swāhā/ zhes lus ngag yid gsum byin gyes brlab/ de nas mig dar bcing / bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa kye/ / gtso 'khor bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ / mi shes mun pas bsgribs pa la/ / dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ lam chen 'di ni bstan par bya/ / khyod kyis lam 'di bsgrub par bgyi/ / lam mchog sgrub par rab tu dka'/ / nyes pa dag gis ma gos par/ / 'bras bu myur du 'byin par nges/ / dam tshig 'das na dmyal bar lhung / / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ñtsaṇ+ḍabadz+ra pā ḍā ye/ na ra gan hūṃ/ zhes mna' chu blud/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yi ge hūṃ gi rnam par slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim par gyur par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra pra be sha yartsu/zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas lan mang du brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs te dril bsil dang bcas/ / badz+ra dag pa yi/dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ / lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin/ / ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog / ces bden stobs brjod/ slob ma'i lag tu me tog gtad de/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ ju ru ju ru pru dza hozhes dkyil 'khor la me tog 'dor du gzhug me tog blangs te slob ma'i mgor bzhag pas me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa byed du gzhugami shes mun pas bsgribs pa la/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni bstan par bya/ maṇ+ḍal phaṭa/ ces gdong g.yogs bsal/ srung ba'i 'khor lo me ri dang bcas pa'i nang du gzhal yas khang chen po mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba dus gsumagyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba thams cad kyi bdag po yin no/ / pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi shar du rdo rje gtum po/ lhor rdo rje phur ba/ nub tu rdo rje be con/ byang du rdo rje tho ba ste thugs kyi khro bo chen po 231

sa / /gung thang bsnyan ba'izla sa gsung 'thugabazhi dang / shar lhor sangs rgyas spyan/ lho nub tu mā ma kyi/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma ste yum bzhi dang / de'i phyi rol gye 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i shar du rnam par rgyal ba/ lhor gshin je'i gshed/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang du bdud ste 'khyil ba/ shar lho dbyug pa sngon po/ lho nub tu khro gnyer can/ nub byang du don yod zhags pa/ byang shar du rdo rje 'khor lo/steng du 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ 'og tu stobs po che ste khro bo bcu dang / de'i phyi la bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad dang / khyams la pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi phyogs re re la bcu drug bcu drug dang bcas pa de dag khyed rnams kyi yi dam gyi lha yin no/ / gzhan yang shar sgo na yul 'khor srung / lho sgo na 'phags skyes po/nub sgo na mig mi bzang / byang sgo na rnam thos sras/ sgo'i nang na sgo ma bzhi dang / khor yug la phyogs skyong bcu dang bcas bzhugs pa/ 'di rnams khyed cagagi srung ma yin pas deng phyin chad mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par gyis shig / de nas yi dam chos srung de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas bgegs thams cad rgya mtsho'i phar 'gram du bskrad par mos la/ sngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang spyan snga ru/ / gdug pa 'dul phyir rdo rje can gyis ni/ /rjes mthun khyad par 'phrin las gad bsgo ba/ / dam bcas 'phrin las de ni dedagongs la/ / phyir rgol bgegs dang log 'dren tshar chod cig / 'gro ba 'di la rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ / sdug bsngal nges bsal bde mchog sbyor ba'o/ / khro rgyal khyod kyis deng 'dir byin rlabs mdzod/ / na ma sa man+d+ra kā ya 1gyi t+ta badz+ra ṭ+wāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro rnya ya/ ma hā dekhyo ta gas sti ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pa sha ha stu ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bharnya bharnya/ han han/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi sgo1 ya bi sbo1 ya/sarba bisne na/ bi na ya ka na/ mahā ga ṇa pa ti dzi bi tān+ta ka rā ya/ sarba du ṣā na u tsata partu phaṭa/ ces brjod cing mar dang bu ram gu gul bsreg pas bdugs/232

༄/ /rdo rnamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagardo rje khu tshur gnas gsum du gtug cing / oṃ badz+ra da ma da martu sboṭa ya bha smi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ oṃ pra tsa ta ku pi ta sa sa ti uk+ṣi pi dha na dha ra ṇi dha ra dha ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod la yungs gar gyis brabs/ na mo ran+ta tra yā ya/ na ma ñtsaṇ+ḍa badz+rakro dhā ya/ mihā birnya sru/ mahā birnya ra tsa ya/tabya thā/ dha ra dha ra/ mahā kro dha/ mu ru mu ru/ sarba bihūṃ na bi nā ya ka na ma tha ma tha/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ sarba dukhye yan+ta ka/ ba ta na bi nā sha ya bha smi ku ru/da ha da ha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ni rma tha ni rma tha/ mahā krodha/ dza ya dza ya/sarba dukhye pa ri ka / dz+wa la dz+wa la swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ slar yang slob ma'i don du ltal gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje slob ma 'di dag rnams/ / tshe 'dir nad med bde ba dang / / gdon rnams kun las thar pa dang / /dgra rnams kun las rgyal ba'i phyir/ / mgon po khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam pa gang yin rdzogs par mdzod/ / bcom ldan khyod la thugs rje'i mnga'/ / 'di la skyabs gnas ma mchis pas/ / des na 'gro ba gus pa 'di/ / khyed kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / ces brjod/ de nas bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzung ste/ hūṃ khrus mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ / thugs rje'i khrus ni bla na med/ / byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ / ci 'dod dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ / ye shes chu bo khrus kyi dzing / / bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam shing / / bkra shis bum pas spyi blug nas/ / dbang bskur thams cad 'dir stsol cig / yang snying sngon du btang ste/ oṃ badz+ra bā ṇa ye che ge mo'i sarba bisdi na shīrnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ sarba byā dhi 6 shīrnyi ma sarba u pa dra bebh+ya nga sarba a kā la mṛ t+yā rgya sarba gra he bh+ya sarba dz+wa re bh+ya sarba dur su sne bh+ya sarba du ni mi tebh+ya sarba tsit+ta byā ku le bh+ya shīrnyi ku ru ye swāhā/zhe4khrus bya/ rma bya'i sgro'i steng du hūṃ yig la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros te bkrus pas ma dag pa'i dri ma rnams byab par bsam zhing /233

༄/ /gung ca bstan ཿ yo sa ཿma/gong gi shīrnyi ku ru ye zhes pa'i tshab tu/ a pa na ye sāhā/ zhes pa bcug ste byabs nas khrus chu rgyang ring du dor/ a pa na'i tshab tu rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa bcug ste gnas lngar rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag / thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las/ mdzub mo gnyis dang gung mo gnyis bkug ste/ mthe bong gnyis dang srin lag mthe'u chung bsgreng ba ni srung ba chen mo'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba ste/ snying ga dang dpung pa g.yas dang rgyab dpung pa g.yon du gtug ste/ gnas de rnams su/ tsa/ pa/ sa/ k+ṣa bzhi las mi 'jigs pa gser gyi mdog can dkar mo gos dkar po gyon pa dbyug to can/ 'jig pa thams cad med par byed pa sku mdog dang na bza' dkar po can ral gri 'dzin pa/ gdul dka' ma dmar mo gos dmar can 'dzum pas dkyil 'khor la blta ba/ mi thub pa nag mo khro gnyer ma smad g.yogs nag po can dbyug to 'chang ba/ kun kyang thor tshugs cod pan dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'od kyis 'gengs pa re re bzhugs par gyur/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te spyo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya sarba tar+ṣa ugo rak+ṣa mahā ba le/ sarba ta thā ga te pur+ṇa ṇi ra dza te hūṃ hūṃ tra tha tra tha/ a pra ti ha ta hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhesapas byin gyis brlab/ bum chu mgo lus la byugs shing / ba spu'i bu ga tham4cad lhamo'i tshogasadang khro bo rdul phra rab kyis gang bar bsam/ hūṃ lcang lo can gye gnas mchog dam pa ru/ / dregs pa kun 'dul gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms pa/ / phyag na rdo rje'i sngags bzlas drag po'i mthus/ / klu yi gdug pa'i nad gdon dag gyur cig / mthu stobs bdag pos gdug byed gnyen po mdzod/ /las dang rkyen 'dzom skyes bu 'di dag gi /dus gsum rnam smin gdug pa'i nad chen 'di/ / phyag na rdo rje'i mthu yis dag gyur cig / rlung mkhris pad gan 'dus las gyur pa yi/ /mdze dang skran dang skya rbab phol 'bras sogs/ /gang zhig sa bdag klu gnyan gdug pa yis/ / zin pa'i gdon dang nad rnams dag gyur cig /234

༄/ /rdorjenamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagaces brjod/ slob ma'i lag tu mda' dar bzhag ste/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar gyur/ / sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ / ces de ltar bsam zhing brjod du gzhug / slar yang rdo rje gan4gsum du gtug cing / bi sha badz+ra kā yowāgyit+ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sāhā/ slob ma'i lusangag yid gsum la rdo rje'i go cha bgos par rgyur/ gong gi rdorje slo ma 'di dag rnams/ / zhegapa nas/ 'di'i bar gyi bkru bya ba srung ba'i skor bdag 'jug la mi dgos/ gnyis pa dbang dngos gzhi la/ bum dbang / rigs gtad/ rjes gnang gsum/ dang po ni/ gdan dkar la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa briyopa'i steng du slob ma 'dug tu bcug ste/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas bkra shis kyi lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros tespyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ las kye rdo rjes rnam bum btegs la/phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba zhes sogs mchog gsum gyi shis brjod dang /yon tan rgyas pa sku mdog btso ma'i gser dang mtshungs/ / shes rab rtags su sher phyin pu ste ral gri bsnams/ / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bkra shis gang yin pa/ / bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / thugs rje'i rtags su sku mdog ston ga'i zla ba'i 'od/ / ma chags skyon gyis ma gos phyag na pad+ma bsnams/ / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis gang yin pa/ / bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / chos nyid mi 'gyur rtags su sku mdog mthing nag ste/ / thabs dang shes rab dbyer med rtags su rdo rje 'dzin/ / dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ / bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / ces rigasagasum gyi shiyopa brjod/ legasagrub lasakyang bya rgyud la skabayokun rtsamachog gsum dang rigasagasum la phyag bya bar gsungasashing / bla med larigs lnga'i shis pa brjod pa ltar/ 'dir rigasagasum gyi shis pa brjod na skabasadang 'brel 235

༄/ /yo cabastanab ཿ tsha lagazhing / 'di'i gong gi tshigasabacad mang po sa wa ri ba'idakyil chog nas blangasa'adug pa ltar/ der gsungs pa'i shi4brjod 'di'ang byas na legs/ ji ltar bltams pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha yi chu/ /dag pa yis ni sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ na ma sarba ha thā ga ta asnyi'e ka ta sa ma ya thi ye hūṃ/ zhes khrus byasabs luyongag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag nasaluyolha'i skur gyur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/gnyisapa rigasagatad la sku'i rigasagatad ni bri4sku sbyin zhing / dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i sku yi mchog /sku dang yongs su rgyas pa'i sku/ / sku mchog 'di ni khyod kyis zungs/ /lus kyi mi dge spang bar bya/ /sarba tathā ga ta su tisbyir badz+ra oṃ/ gsung gi rigs gtad ni 'phreng ba sbyin zhing / dung dang pad+ma rā ga dang / mu tig las kyang bya ba yin/ /byu ru rin chen bzang bo yi/ /'phreng ba rab tu gzung bar bya/ /oṃ ru tse ra maṇi bra wa rta ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ glegs bam sbyin zhing / mi 'bral gzungs kyi bdag nyid che/ / mu tig rin chen phreng ba 'di/ /sku dang ye shes mi 'bral bas/ /ngag gi nyes sel phreng ba gzung / /sarba ta thā ga ta bra ti spri ra badz+ra ā mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes pa lta bu me tog gang la phog pa'i gsang mtshan gdags/ thugs kyi rigs gtad ni rdor dril bsnol thabs su snying gar 'dzin zhing / dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi mchogathugs dang 'phrin las brtan pa'i thugs/ / ye shes 'di ni khyod kyis zungs/ /yid kyi las dag mi bya'o/ /sarba ta thā ga ta ma ti spri ra badz+ra hūṃ/zhes brjod/gsum pa rjes gnang la gsum las/ slob ma rnams pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur ba las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i skur gyur/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig / khams gsum na ni gzhan med 236

༄/ /rdorjernamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilabo lagade/ / de bas 'dod la chags bral bas/ / khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig / ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ na hūṃ phaṭa/gnyis ba sngagasabazla ba'i rjesaganang ni/ bla mas/ rig sngags 'di la stsal lags kye/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zheyolha la gnang ba zhu/ slob ma rnamasakyis/ rig sngags bdag gis gzung lags kyi/ / bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba gdab/ gzungasaring snying po nye snying rnams kyi rjesazlos lan gsum de bya/ deng phyin chad dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung ste mchod dgos pasamachod pa 'bul bar zhu byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya/ mahūṃ/ puspe/ ju be/ ā lo ke/ ga dhe/ ne+e wi r+ya/shasta snu dza me gha samu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma yortu/ oṃ su bhā wa bi shudhedha rmā te badz+ra sirnyi hūṃ/ na ṭ+wāṃhāsarba ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ༷cho rdo ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ༵lamu di diX hūṃrdo ṭ+wāṃm ༵/ṭ+wāṃ ༵'ir yaṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ~X ༵ ༷kra dīX rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun rnams kye dbang bskur zhing shis pas mtha' brgyan pa ni/ de dag bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po zhu ba las srid zhi'i dge mtshan spel ba'i mthu dang ldan par gyur par bsam ste/ rgyas par byed na/ bkra shis gang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ / phyag na gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ / thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ / dbu la gdugs kyi bkra shis 'khor gyur cig / bkra shis gang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ / phyag na gser gyi nya mo 'od 'bar ba/ / thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ / spyan la nya yi bkra shis gsal gyur cig / bkra shis gang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ / phyag na gser gyi pad+ma yid 'ong ba/ /thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ / ljags la pad+ma'i bkra shis rgyas gyur cig / bkra shis gang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ / phyag na 237

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'atshanama'i sa 'chagagaseragyi bum pa yid 'ong ba/ / thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ /mgul la bum pa'i bkra shis mdzes gyur cig / bkra shis gang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ /phyag na chos kyi dung sgra sgrogs mdzad pa/ /thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ / gsung dbyangs dung gi bkra shis snyan gyur cig / bkra shis gang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ / phyag na gser gyi dpal be'u yid 'ong ba/ / thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ /thugs la dpal be'u'i bkra shis 'khyil gyur cig /bkra shiyogang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ / phyag na gser gyi rgyal mtshan yid 'ong ba/ / thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ / sku la rgyal mtshan bkra shis bsgrengs gyur cig / bkra shis gang zhig dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ / phyag na gser gye 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan/ / thogs nas slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas/ / phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i bkra shis mdzes gyur cig /ces dang / me long ye shes rgya mtsho zhes sogs dang / / lha rdzas las byas lte ba zhes sogs tshigs bcad dang sngags so so ba'i sgo nas byed la/bsdu na/ gang zhig reg cing mthong thos dran pas kyang / /mi shis kun sel phun tshogs mchog stsol bar/ / rgyal bas byen brlabs bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi/ / dbang bskur dge legs snang ba 'bar gyur cig / oṃ aṣā mgol a snyi ṣ+peñtsa rmā/ rtags brgyad la rdzas brgyad ces bsgyur te/ oṃ aṣā mgo la bha ba a bhi khyeñtsa rmā/ mi dbang rin chen bdun gyi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub yan lag bdun ldan lam bzang gis/ / theg mchog chos kyi sred la dbang 'byor te/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon dang dpal gyur cig /oṃ mahā sa s+t+ra rat+na a snyi ṣ+peñtsa rmā/ mi 'gyur lhun po zhes sogs dang /mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod de me tog gi char dbab cing / sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i zhes sogs bden pas byin gyis brlab bo/ / slob ma 238

༄/ /rdorjenamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagarnamasakyis gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing / bla mas mjug gi mchod bstod/nongs pa bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs te dam tshig pa rang la bstem pa/bkra shis kyes mtha' ba rgyan pa sogs bya'o/ /gsum pa zhar byung nye bar mkho ba'i las tshogasagazhan bstan pa la/ sbyin sreg ni/thab kyi dbuyosu rdo rje la hūṃ gis mtshan pa bri/ dam rgya rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam rgya gong du bshad pa bzhin byed/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūṃ gsal 'debs shing /me lha'i thugs gar me gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi la gtso bo mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ 'khor rnams gsal 'debs mi dgos/ cho ga'i gzhung ni bya rgyud kyispyan sreg tshad ldan gang rigs shig dang bstun na chog go / gzhanayang 'di'i sngags so so dang / mdo tshig re re bzhin la brten pa'i las spyor brgya rtsa brgyad ye shes rdo rje sogs kyis mdzad cing / slob dpon pad+mas mdzad par grags pa'i them yig dang bcas pa yod/ de dag bsdus nas la4mtha' bco brgyad du phye zhing / zhi ba'i 'khrul 'khor gsum/ tsas pa'i bzhi/ dbang gi gnyis/ mngon spyod kyi brgyad/ khrus kyi cho ga dang bcas las bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor du bsdu tshul smṛ ti'i man ngag las 'byung zhing / spro ti'i 'grel par de drang don gyi sgrub tshul du byas te/ nges don stong nyid bco brgyad rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad du sgrub tshul zhig kyang gsungs te/ mdor na lha gcig mi gcig gi tshul du yi dam 'di nyid kho na la rtsal du bton na 'di'i sgo nas kyang mchog thun gyi las rab 'byams ci 'dod grub par nus pas nor bu'i gter mdzod lta bur yod do/ / 'dir de dag gi nang nas nyer mkho nyung shas shig tho tsam 'god na/ nor longs spyod spel bar 'dod pas rang rnam 'joms su skyed/ bum pa'i nang du sngags 'phreng gsal btab ste gzungs bzlas la bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du bstem/ mdun gyi 239

sa / /gung thangabastanaba'ilhanas gsung 'thuganam mkhar skad cig gis ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang / de'i 'og tsam du skad cig gis dzam lha dkar po g.yu 'brug la zhon pa'am/ ser po gter la gnas pa/ nag po nor sbyin ser po'i steng na bzhengs te bzhugs pa gang rigs shig kyang phyag mtshan rgyan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur par bsams te/ sngar sgrub pa'i bum chus spyi bo nas khrus gsol zhing zhal du phul bar bsams terdza lha'i sngags 'don zhing chu sbyinabyu/ thub pa'i dbang podabang po'i tshul du bzhugs pa 'di bzhin du gnod sbyin chen po khyed kyis dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i bka' las ma 'da' bar rnal 'byor pa bdag gis chos sgrub pa'i dpal 'byor legs tshogs thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong nas gong du rgyas pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod cig /ces 'phrin las bcol/char 'bebs par 'dod pas/ rang nyid sgrub grogs dge slong bzhi dang bcas pas nangs snga bar theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blangs te/ rang gis rnam 'joms gtso rkyang ngam gtso 'khor gyi bdag bskyed bum bskyed gzhung bzhin bya/ sgrub grogs bzhi'i gnyis kyis 'di'i gzungs mdo dang sprin chen po'i mdo brlag / gnyis kyis klu rnams kyi snying po bzla zhing klu gtor bsngo/sngags kyi mjug tu/ char gye rgyun phun sum tshogs pa 'bab bar byin gyis zlobs shig /ces spel tshig spyor zhing / mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te klu rnams kyi rgyud bskul nas char phab pa'i dmigs pa dang /bum lha 'od zhu byas nas chu mig sogs su blugs bas byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis klu rnams tshim ste char phab ba'i dmigs pa byed/ des ma bab na snying po drag tu bzla zhing khro bcu'i lha tshogs rang 'dra dpag med 'phros te klu rnams kyi mgrin pa nas bcings shing bsdigs te drag shul gyi sgo nas 'beb tu bcug par bsams/240

༄/ /rdo rnamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagaser ba bsrung na/ sngon nas phur ba bcu khro ba bcur bskyed nas yun ring du bsgrubs/ dngos gzhi'i dus rang nyid rdo rje rnam 'joms phyag mtshan rgyan sogs gzhung ltar la sku mdog dmar por bsgoms te snying po dang nye snying bzla/ ser pa 'ong ba'i phyogs phyogs su phur bu rnams gdab cing sngags bzlas pa'i yungs gar gtor/ rang gi kha nas sngags phreng me 'od 'bar ba dpag med 'phros pa'i me dpung gis nam mkha' khengs shing drag po'i rlung gis sprin rnams phyogs phyogs su gtor bar bsams te nam mkhar sdang mig dang mdzub ris bya/gzhan gye ngan sngags gcod par byed na/ bdag skyed sngon du btang /rang gi lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag ba pa'i bu ga tshun chad rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyis gtams shing / de las me'i tsha tsha dpag med 'phro bar bsams/ro ras la ngan sngags byed pa po'i ming rus bri ba dang / srad bu nag po mdun du bzhag ste bden bajod sngon du 'gro bas pha rol gye byad ma'i rnam shes bkug pa ligo la bstim zhing / de'i ngan sngags kyi nus pa thams cad srad bu la bstim par bsam zhing dgug gzhug lan mang du bya/ de nas/ oṃ sa ras ra mā ra ya badz+ra biṅgā rā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing ligo gris gtubs nas dur khrod du rlung la bskur/ srad bu dum bur gtubs te me la bsreg go / yang na durakhrod kyi g.yam pa sngon po la dug khrag gis sna tshogs rdo rje bris te lte ba la/pha rol gyi rig sngags na ni/ zhes pa dang / rwa rnams la li nan zhes pa bri/mtha' skor du/ pha rol gye mthu gtad ngan sngags thams cad stasta ya nan/zhes pa bris te/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mthu stobs kyis pha rol gyi nus pa thams cad mnan par bsam zhing / oṃ a mo snya badz+ra nan/ oṃ lam̐/ ā li/hūṃ li/ zhes pa khri phrag gsum bzla/ de nas lam rgya gram du mnan na byad phur de dag ldang mi nus so/ /241

༄rngo/ /gung thang bsnyan pa'izla ce' gsung 'bum/mig nad sel bar 'dod pas/ lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du btang / rang gi thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dpag med 'phros te rgyal ba sras bcasal gzugs kyi mchod pa sna tshogs pa dang snang gsal la sogs pa phul/de dag gi ye shes kyi spyan gyi byin rlabs bsdus te bum chu dang byugs pa'i rdzas la thim par bsams nas sngags ci mang bzla/ de nas khrus kyi cho ga spyi ltar byas pa'i mjug tu sngags bzla bzhin par sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzas kyis byugs te/ de'ang mig nad spyi la ut+pal sngon po dang skyer ba'i khaṇ+ḍa/rab rib can la a ru ra'i khu ba/ ling tog can la mtshal dang cung zhi'i khu ba la bzlas te byugs na phan no/ /gzhan la srung ba gdags par 'dod pas/ ras dkar po gtsang ma la gur kum sogs kyis 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris/ lte bar/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ñtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṭī la/ mahā yak+ṣa sen pa ta ye che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣazhes pa bre/ rtsibs rnams la/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ tho ṭa ya tro ṭa ya che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa dang / mu khyud la snying po ste thams cad yig mgo phyir bstan nas bri/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas 'khor lo'i lte bar rdo rje rnam 'joms bskyed de bsnyen pa gnad du 'gro nges bya/ mthar mchod bstod byas te 'od du zhu ba srung 'khor la thim par bsam/ rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la rang sngags dang dkon mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pa sogs kyis rab tu gnas par bya/ legs par bltebs te dar sngon pos dril nas gdags shing 'gom yug ma shor bar byas na srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/deng dus phal mo che rang ngos nas rgyu tshogs ma tshang ba mi shes par/ lha'i ngos nas las spyor dang byin rlabs kyi sgo ma tshang ba lta bur blta mod kyang / sngags rim las/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig la bzlas pa dang bsgom pa tshad du phyin na/ de nas lha'i rnal 'byor de nyid la sgyur lugs re byas pas nad dang 242

༄/ /rdorjenamapar 'jomasapa'i sgrubadakyilaca lagabagegs zhi ba dang / tshe dang shes rab 'phel ba dang / bstan pa la mi dad pa la sogs pa dbang du bya ba dang / drag po min pas mi 'dul ba rnams mngon spyod kyis tshar gcod pa la sogs pa gang yang byas pas chog pas/ tshe sgrub dang blo 'phel sogs kye gdams pa rnams zur nas btsal mi dgos so/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas/ bsnyen sgrub kyis rmang gzhi zin nges pa zhig byas na rta phyag khyung gsum sogs kyi las tshogs gang la'ang lha sngags kyis kha bsgyur nas sbyar chog ste/ de nyid bsdus pa las/ snying po phyag rgya sngags rig rnams/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshul gyis ni/ / dum bu las bshad rang byas pa'am/ /sgrub pa 'dir ni thams cad do/ / zhes pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /smras pa/ bla ma lha yi zhabs mthil bkra shis mtshan/ / bdag gi gtsug rgyan rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo ste/ / gang gi gsung gsang 'gag med chos kyi dung / /rin chen 'khyil bas bdag gi snyan shal mdzes/ / de phyir mtshan tsam dran pas rgud pa kun/ / rnam par 'joms pa ye shes rdo rje yi/ / sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas grub chen gyi/ / bzhed dgongs dbang gi rgyal po'i 'phreng bar spel/ / dge bas lag na rdo rje'i gnas thob ste/ / bdud bzhi sde dang bcas pa'i dpung bcom nas/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ / bde ba chen po'i gnas la 'god gyur cig / ces rdo rje rnam par 'jomasapa'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bca4pa mchog thun dngosagrub gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni/ or tu sum thog shog nas gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam dang mkhyen dpyod rmad du byung ba sman pa zazur blo bzang yon tan gyis rin po che sna tshogasapa'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcasanan chen bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgonames 'di'i rgya gzhung rnams gung bsgrigayote sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ / cho ga par du bskrun 243

༄//yo ca b.lo barmaḥ gsung 'a gapa'i dge tshogs mthus/ /sgo gsum nyes pa'i dri ma kun byang ste/ /phul byung gtan bde'i dpal la rol gyur cig /cesapa 'di'ang skul ba po nyid nas bar du bsgrubs pa'i tshe bris pa'o/ /2pha

sa / /mi 'khrugasapalhadagu'ichogaca lag༄tsho/ / mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa thar ba'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru bha ga wa ti akyo bh+ya spros kun nyer zhi'i dbyings las snying rje'i mdangs/ / dag pa'i 'khor lo sgyu ma'i rnam rol ba/ / bcom ldan mi bskyod rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang / / dbyer med bla ma mchog la mgos phyag 'tshal/ / mi bzad las nyon chu bo 'bum 'dus te/ / sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrugs pa srid pa'i mtsho/ / brgal byed thabs mkhas gru gzings zla med pa/ / 'di yi bsnyen bsgrub dang mtshungs gzhan yod min/ / de phyir bdag blo ku sha'i 'dab ma yis/ / dam pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i bsang gtor gyis/ / gdung sel mchod sbyin bgyid do blo ldan rnams/ / srid pa'i tsha gdung bcil slad bsten par mdzod/ / 'dir ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo 'gog par byed cing / las kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin pa/ bya rgyud rdo rje'i rigayokyi bdag po/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rlabasapo che bsgrub par byed pa la/ thog mar bsnyen pa ji ltar byed pa'i tshul dang / de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod de dbang blang ba/ khruyodabang sogs kyi sgo nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang bzhi/dang po ni gnas khang byi dor byas la/ mi 'khrug4pa'i sku bris 'bur ci rigs sogasasku gsung thugayokyi rten bkram/ bdag skyed kyi mchod pa dang / sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor/ gtor mgron la 'bul rgyu'i dkar gtor/ rdor dril sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'dusabyas te/ bsang chu bsgrubs nas khrus byas/ bgegs gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngos/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong yang grub na mtshams 'dir bya/245

༄/ /yo b.loba'isgronasa' g.yo 4ma/de nas bde ba'i stan la 'khod de skyabagasems sngon du btang / lag pa'i rgyab gnyis g.yasapa steng dang g.yon pa 'og tu byasate sbyar/ g.yasakyi mthe bong dang g.yon gyi mthe'u chung gnyis dang / g.yon gyi mthe bong dang g.yas kyi mthe'u chung gnyi4bsgol te kha sbyar/ g.yasakyi sor mo lhag ma gsum steng dang / g.yon gyi sor mo lhag ma gsum 'og tu bsgreng ste mdzub srin gnyi4kyi rtse gung mo'i tshigasadang po la gtad nasardo rje rtse gsum pa'i dbyibs ltabu byasapa rdo rje'i rig4kyi dam rgya lteba'i thad gar bcings nas/mabadz+ra u bsta wa ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ rang nyid skad cig gisabacom ldan 'dasardo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na rdo rje bsnams pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ sngona'agro'i mchod gtor byin gyisabarlab pa ni/ a mṛ tasabasangs/ swa bha wayosbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ oṃ a rtu lan gsum brjod/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ / da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ / gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / / shākya'i bstan pa srung ba dang / / bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ / gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ / e h+ya nyi da sha deka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye swāhā/ zhe4spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ak+ta/ bābye/ buṣ+pe/ ju be/ a lo ke/ gadhe/ ne+e wī tre+e/shasta pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā las pa ri wā ra na ma sarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shra mu khe bh+ya sarba tad kha urga he sba ra na nyi mi ga ga na khaṃ gro sde dam pa bla te sāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyisagator ma phul/ shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas/ / gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ / me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po 246

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'itshogaca lagaste/ / dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / / steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / / lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / / ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la/ so so so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ / rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / / rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ / rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang / / nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ / me tog dri ngang bdug pa gtor mar bcas/ / 'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / / bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ / phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gi dge ba'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa dang de'i bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/bdagaskyed kyi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ as bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra a swāhā/oṃ badz+ra pā gyi swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bu1 swāhā/ zhesasogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shasta swāhā/zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ dha rma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba burnya khre hra/ bra tsa li na/ prasto ba ra mi tā nā da su bhā we/ badz+ra sad sasto ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ a khaṃ swāhā/ sogs rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ / byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ / bdag dang gzhan don bsgrub phyir du/ / bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ / phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gson/ /247

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i ma'i bang lamabadag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ / deng nas byang chub sems bskyed do/ /zhesasogs lan gsum bya/ tshogs zhing mchod pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs gar pad zla'i steng du hūṃ sngon po/ / de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza0 rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru ca na ma sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a khro bh+ya maṇ+ḍa las pa ri wā ra bh+yazhes pas phyasabya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra akhro bh+ya maṇ+ḍa las pa ri wā ra arnya bra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ shasta pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pasamachod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhesasogasalan gsum gyi4rgyun bshags bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms la tshogs zhing rnamasarang gnasasugashegs par bsam/dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ thu n+ya tā dzā na badz+ra subhā wa ā t+pa ko3nya/ rang dang bsgomakhya'i lha gnyis gang zag dang chos kyi bdag mtha' dag gis stong ba'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang lha'i de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed par rtog pa gnyis su snang ba thams cad dben pa'i rang gi sems don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par gyur/ de'i steng du na mor t+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ke ka ni ke ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa ni tā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba ga pa ram̐ pa ra rā ṇi me sarba satā ñtsa swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi rang gdangs kyi sgra dril bu'i sgra bzhin grags par gyur/ sngags kyi gdangs grags pa de nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yig 'bru bris pa'i rnam pa can du 'khod par gyur ba las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar sngags kyis mtshan par gyur/ zla ba phyag 248

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'icho gca lagamatshan sngags dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyi mthu las rgyal ba thams cad mchod cing / thugs rje char rgyun gyis dmyal ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ baṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog yi rnyi nā la'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dwangs shing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phro ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon dang /g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga ba 'dzin pa/spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'iwān gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gye stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas gnas gsum du reg la/ ki ka ni/ tshar re re brjod cing byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa māngo zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ a su hā/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ ma rtu baṃho de rnams rang nyid la thim pa 'od du zhu/ rang gi thugs gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbus phu hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du.oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lhor ṭ+wāṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog spyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub tu hrī las 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi 249

༄/ /yo ca gsapa'izla ma'i g.yo lam/phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang du ā las don yong grub pa ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yonamanyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing / 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'o/ / slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye 〉 rtu/zhes gsungasashing / bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag maspyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod bas dbu brgyan cing dbangagi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas/ a sogs kyisamachod/ bstod pa mnyam med ma'am bsdu na/ chos dbyengs rnam dag mkha' klong yangs pa las/ / dpal ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bcu gnyis bdag /dngos grub kun gyi 'od stong rab 'gyed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kun gsal lan brgyar me lces rab bzhus pa/ /byed pos pir gyis lhun por byugs pas kyang / /khyod sku'i cha shas la 'gran skal ba yis/ /dben par ston pa bcom ldan sku la bstod/ /khyod sku mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yis/ /nam yang yid gcugs mdza' ba ma btang tshe/ /rlung gi rgyal mtshan mdzes ma phrag dog gis/ /lha lam gzhon nur 'khrud pa'i ngal ba bsten/ /sgrib gnyis zad par spangs kyang rgod pa sogs/ /chags pa'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur ci yang ston/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i 'ching las rtag grol kyang / /dar zab rin chen rgyan gyis mngon par mdzes/ /gang gi rnal 'byor me yis sgrib pa'i shing / / ma lus bsreg kyang thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis/ /'jigs rung ngan song tsha gdung kun sel ba'i/ / bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rang gi thugs ga'i zla gdan la sngags 250

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'ichog cha laga'aphreng dkar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ / rgyal ba sras bcas mchod cing / de dag gi yon tan ma lus pa gzungs sngags la thim/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyes sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal ma lus pa sbyangs par gyur bar bsam la/ ki ka ni ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po thugasarje chen po dang ldan bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bdag gi snying ga nas ye shes ba rnams mdun gye nam mkharakhyon par gyur bar bsam mo/ / de la mchod bstod gong ltar byas la/bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhe4gsol ba btab/ rdo rje semagadapa'i yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra mu ma shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khor bar bsam/ rgyun 'khyer la bdag bskyed rkyang ba byed tshe thun gyi mjug tu/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na thun tha ma'i bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gye spu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ aspyo ca maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra a ka ro mu khaṃ zhes pa nas/ ba bla ta ye swāhā/zhes pa lan gsum gyisa'abul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdu4bya/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas bdag sogs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhesagasol ba gdab/ yig brgyalan gsum/ nong4pa bzod gsol byasal/ oṃ badz+ra mu bdag skyed kyi ye shes pa dang / gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes bajod/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / mi 'khrugs rgyal po 'grub gyur nas/ /251

༄/ /yo cabayopa'isgronar+gha'i gatshi las/zhes sogs bsngo smon bya/ thun mtshams su yang gang snang thams cad mi 'khrugs pa'i sku dang sgra thams cad gzungs sngags kyi gdangs dang / dran rtog thams cad zab gsal gnyis med kyi yi shes kyi rol par shes pa'i sgo nas dge spyor dang ma bral bar bya zhing / khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pa sogs bya spyod kyi bsnyen pa byed pa'i skabs kyi spyod lam rgyas par sngags rim sogs nas 'byung ba ltar lag tu blangs na shin tu legs so/ /gnyisapa dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing dbang blang ba la/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor ni spyir sgras brjod kye dbye bas bdun du gsungs shing /bum dbang gang du 'thob pa'i dkyil 'khor la yang / grub chen dril bu zhabs kyis/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor de'i rang bzhin/ /ci yin 'dir ni shes par bya/ / ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni/ / thig pas tshon dgye'i rim pa bstan/ / 'gro ba 'di nyid rang bzhin gyis/ / grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ / zhes ri mor gnas pa'i las kyi rang bzhin bris sku'i dkyil 'khor/ thig btab ste tshon dkye ba'i rim pas grub pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ 'gro ba dag la rang bzhin gyes gnas pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs so/ /'on kyang rgyud sde gong 'og thams cad du gdul bya'i tshogs rdzogs pa sogs dgos pa du ma'i dbang gis rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor bris nas der dbang bskur ba'i rnam bzhag rgyas par gsungs pa'i de'i dbang du byas te 'god pa la gsum/ sa'i cho ga rta gon gyi cho gdangos gzhi'i cho ga'o/ / dang po la/ sa brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/bzung ba/ bsrung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang lnga/ dang po la yang /phyogs dang / kha dog dang / khung bu brkos te sa dang chus bkang nas brtags tshul sogs yod kyang phal cher la nyer mkho chung bas ma dris/ gnyis pal/ gnas kyi bdag po mngon pa rgyal po sogs dang / mi mngon pa zhing 252

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'itshogapho lagaskyong sogs las bslang ba gnyis kyi phyi ma la yang / gzhi bdag dang / sa lha las bslang ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i stengan rdo rje rtse lnga ba 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur par bsam nas/ gzhi bdag gi mchod gtor bshams pa rnams gong du bshad pa'i sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor bzhin byin gyis brlab/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bas gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas bcan drangs/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa ba ri wā ra a r+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā hūṃ a r+ya nut+pa rdo tā t+ta/ oṃ ā hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ gang dag 'diraganas lha dang klu/ / gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ / sa 'di bdag gis bslang bur bgyi/ / dkyil 'khor don du khyed kyis stsol/ / zhes lan gsum bajod/ dkyil 'khor gye las ci bde bar rgyas shig / ces dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma ces pa bzlas pa'i yungs gar dang chu dang thal bas sa der gtor la bsang ngo /gnyisapa sa ltal bslang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du 'ong ba'i dbus su dri'i thig le'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa byin brlab sngar bzhinal/ / oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i zhabs bsil zhal bsil mchod yon/ me tog ces sogs dang / oṃ ba kyi ā hūṃ/ oṃ añtsa mā rna ā :/ oṃ arnya ā ྅/ oṃ buṣ+pe〉 rtu/ nas shasta'i bar brjod cing / gtor ma ye shes kyibadud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su bi las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ dga' ba dang ldan pa'i 253

༄/ /yo cabastanaba'irnanatsa' ga 'chagathugs can zhi ba/ na bza' dkar po man pas shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lus phyed 'thon pa/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams shing pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du zla ba'i steng du hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sor mo'i rtse mos sa la lanagasum bsnun pa'i sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes bskul bas sa g.yos pas gseb nas sa'i lha mo ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ yo bri thi wī de wi rgya sa ba ri wā ra ba bra ti kyi ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā dang / pā hūṃ gyi gnas su/ añtsa maṇi/ a / buṣ+pe bogs bcug pas mchod/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon dril bu dkrol ba dang bcas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / / sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ / lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ / skyobs pa shākya seng ge yis/ / ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ / de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ / bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi las jiltar bde bar gyis shig celoganang ba phyin nas nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur bar bsam/gsum pa sbyang ba la/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum gyes ji ltar sbyang tshul ni/ rang rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa'i yungs gar dang chu dang thal bas dkyil 'khor gyi sa la gtor zhing sngags de bzlas pa'i ba byung lngas shar nas brtsams te byugs la dri'i chus kyang gtor/ lag pa g.yas pa sa gnon gye phyag rgya'i rtse mos sa la reg nas/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ sa gzhi stong pa nyid du gyur/ hūṃ lam̐ hūṃ/sagazhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badzi bha badz+ra bha na dha hūṃ/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bcings te brtan par gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro ༅4

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'ichogaca lagadha hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom par gyur/ oṃ ā ཿ sho dha ya shor+sha ya/ rak+ṣa ra k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje gsum gyis sa'i nyes skyon sbyang zhing bsrung bar gyur/ de nas/ sngar nam mkhar bteg pa'i sa'i lha mo spyan drangs/mdun du sa'i dbus su bzhug4par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ bri thi khri de wī bh+ya sa pa ri wā ra a pra tismo hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ pri thi khri de wī bh+ya sa pa ri wā ra pābye pra tismo hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī bh+ya sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe bra tismo hūṃ swāhā/oṃ pri thi wi de sde rgya sa pa ri wā ra gyo pe/ sogs kyis mchod cing sngar ltar gtor ma phul/ sa'i lha mo dgyes bzhin du de nyid du thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur par bsam nas pad kor byas la/ oṃ 〉 rtu dang yig brgya bzla'o/ / de nas/ sa la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur par mos/ 'di ni bla na med pa'i dag bas sbyang ba zhes sbyangab gzhan las mchog tu bshad bas mos pa tshun chad kyis bsgom pa gal che'o/ /bzhi pa la gnyis/ lha'i rnal 'byor byas nas gsol ba gdab cing dkyil 'khor 'degs pa dang / langs te nga rgyal bzung nas bgeg4la bka' bsgo ba'o/ / dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sagazhir me tog gcal du bkram pa'i dbulosu kha shar du phyogs par 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa la thug gi bar rdzogs par btang /rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor ba'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag nyid kyi lce hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur bar bsam la/ lag pa g.yas bas spos phor ram spos bzung nas/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ / bdag ni rdo rje che ge yis/ / 'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun byon 'tshal/ / dngos grub 'di ni yang 255

༄/ /gung cabayopa'izla sa ga 'thugadag stsol/ /zhes brjod la snyan gsan dbab/ de nas sgo'i slob ma bzhi yod na phyogs rer 'khod nas thams cad kyis thun mong du bla ma bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs par mos pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra akhro bh+ya maṇ+ḍa la sa ba ri wā ra a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings rang bzhin ichu ni la'i mdog /ces sog4sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ mchod pa 'di sngags rim du mi 'byungabasam byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med la/ rgya bod kye dkyil 'khor tshad ldan gzhan mang por gsungs pas byas kyang rung / slob ma thams cad kyis thun mong du/ sa gzhi spos kyis zhes sogasakyis bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul/ shar gyi slob mas/ rang nyid rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyu can du gyur bas/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu gsol ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ / chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog / de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i phyag stabs 'di 'jam dpal gsang ldan dang bya rgyud thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gye sgrub thabs ltar bkod/ dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ lho'i slob mas/ rang nyid rin 'byung ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can du gyur pas nam mkhar gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu gsol ba ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs/ /kun tu bzang pa sku yi mchog / dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ nub kyi slob mas/ rang nyid 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can du gyur bas nam mkharaganas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu gsol ba ni/zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog / dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /256

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gabo lagazhes bajod/ byang gi slob mas/ rang nyid don grub ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can du gyur bas nam mkhar gnas pa'ide bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu gsol ba ni/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ / rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ / kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ / dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / zhes brjod/ sgo'i slob ma gcig la4med na gcig bus shar nasarim bzhin g.yasaskor du song nayorigs so so'i nga rgyal dang gsol ba 'debs pa sngar bzhin bya zhing / slob ma med na bla ma rang nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pas phyogs so so nas gsol ba btab par mos la/ tshig rnamasarang nyid kyis brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyiyordo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs la rtse mo sbyar ba 'og tu phyogs pas spyi bor bzung ste/ hūṃ badz+ra yuta tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes brjod nas/ bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ ces dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg go /gnyisapa ni/ slob dpon langs te shar du phyogs pasamanyam pa'i rkang stabs byas mgo bor thal mo sbyar te/ yobra na ma mi sarba ha thā ga ta na/ zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag bya/ de nas/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun pas bsgribs shing bdud kyi dbang du song ba rnams kyi bdud bsal ba'i phyir rang gtso bo las phye ba'i khro bo hūṃ mdzad sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugasagar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyisabargyan pa/ stag gi pagasapa'i sham thabasacan/ spyan gsum me ltar 'bar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ hūṃ gi sgra sgogs pa khro bo'i thamasacad yongs surdzogs par gyur pa'i mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/g.yon pa ṭa la4zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ las dusamatha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i ltabayophyogs thams cad du 'gro ba rnams la bltasapa4bgegs dang bral bar gyur bar bsam la/ rdo rje ltabs phyogs thams cad du blta/ de nas/ nga ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ / rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid nga / / nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /nga ni stobs chen rdo rje can/ / nga ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ / phyag na 257

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'itshanasa'i g.yo ཿma/rdo rje brtan pa nga / /nga ni bdag po rdo rje che/ /byin gyis brlab pa mi 'dor ro/ /zhes brjod nasang rgyal bzung / de nas/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba re re hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'gying ba dang bcas g.yas rdo rje gsor/ g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis dbang ldan phyogs su phyin/ de nas brtsams te sgo'i slob ma yod na de dang lhan cig tu dkyel 'khor gyi sa gzhir g.yas skor du rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis gar byas te skor ba gcig bya la/ mi shes na/ skor ba gcig byas pa'i mthar dbang ldan nas kha nang du phyogs te/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ / bgegs kyi tshogs kun yang dag nyon/ / nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / / bka' yi 'khor lo spyor ba po/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus gsum las byung dgas bya ste/ / gal te kha cig bdag las 'dra'/ / 'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas bka' bsgo bya/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs thams cad bskrad par gyur bar bsam zhing / susta ni dang / oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzlas la gu gul gyis bdug yungs gar gyis brabs/ rol mos tsham rngams bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi yang dbang chen gye gting gi bar du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam la byin gyis brlab bo/ /lngapa ni/ 'gro ba rnams rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir bgegs bskrad par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed cing / stong nyid bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogasardo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba spros pas phyogs mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / steng du rdo rje'i gur dang / de'i 'og rwa ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla bre dang /phyi rol tu mda'i dra ba dang / 'og gi sa gzhi yang 'bar zhing bzod par 258

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'ichogaca lagadaka' ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur bar mos/ de nas phur gdab bya ba la dam pa mang po'i phyag bzhes su bsam gtan gyi phur gdab mdzad pa mang pas de ltar yang rung la/ dngos su byed na phur bu'i grangs bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ seng ldeng ngam lcags sogasalas byas pa'i phur bu tshad ldan lnga'am bzhi dri dmar pos byug / me tog dmar po'e phreng ba bcing / tshon sku sna lnga'am dmar pos dkris te zangs gzhong la sogs pa'i snod du bkod la/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang / oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ phur bu rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las phur bu rnams stod khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcigaphyag gnyis kyi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ lte ba man chad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can gyi phur bu me dpung rab tu 'bar ba rnams su gyur par bsam zhing / spro na ye shes pa dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod sogs bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar byas pas rung /tho ba/ a mṛ tas bsang / su bha was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i tho ba me rab tu 'bar bar gyur par bsam/ de nas langs la dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan phyogs su phyin te lag pa g.yon du phur bu dang / g.yas pas tho ba thogs pa/ rang nyid khro bo hūṃ mdzad du gsal ba'i thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs thams cad bkug ste dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i dbang ldan sogs su hūṃ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa 'brub khung gi rnam pa can rnams su bcug pa'i mgo por phur bu btab par gyur bar bsam nas/ oṃ badz+ra k+ṣi li k+ṣi la ya sarba bisnen hūṃ/ zhesapa'am/ yang na/ oṃ gha snya snya ha ya snya ta ya sarba du khyo phaṭa phaṭa/ kyi la ya kyi la ya sarba bā baṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kyi la ya badz+ra dhā ra adz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bi sna na ka ya wā ka cit+ta badz+ra kyi la ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/259

༄/ /yo ca gsaḥ ཿ sa ཿmaces pa gnyisagang yang rung ba zhig gisaphur bu 'debasashing / oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod nas tho bsaphur bu rnamayokyi mgo po na4brdung /bgegasaram4kyi spyi po nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phur bu btab pas lusangag yid gsum g.yo 'gul med cing / yid de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig tu gyur/ bgegs lhagam rnams rgyang ring du brosapa dang / steng 'og dang phyog4su khor yug rtsen po'i bar du 'gro ba rnams rnam pa thams cad du bgegs dang bral bar gyur bar bsam de yang phur bu bzhi byed na dbang ldan nasabartsam4te mtshamasabazhir 'debs shing / lnga byed na/ dang por dkyil 'khor gyi dbusasu 'brub khung sngar ltar bskyed pa'i nang du bgegasabacug la btab par moyon4dbusasu 'debs stangs byas la dngosasu dbang ldan gyi phur bu'i 'khrisasu'adebs/ de nasadabang ldan nas brtsams te mtshamayobazhir gdab/ dang por slob dpon gyisagadab cing brdung la/ de nas mi nusan sgo'i slob dpon sogs kyis bya bar rung zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi las ma zin par du thun sosol phur bu'i mchod pa nyin re bzhin bya/ de nas/ lag pa gan rkyal du gnas pa bsgyur nas/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ḍū/ zhes brjod cings la bsnun te/ sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur bar mosapar bya'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon la lnga/ saltadang lha dang bum pa sta gon/ ltal gsol ba gdab pa/ slob ma sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid shar nasadakyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyogs par 'dug /dkyil 'khor gyi dbusadangosasam/ deng sang gi phyag len du dkyil 'khor gyi sagazhi'i dbusasu maljo'i khar maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du dgod pa ltar yang rung ba'i der dri'i thig le dang tshom bu bkod/ salha'i mchod gtor byin gyis brlab/dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su saṃ las sa'i lha mo zhesapa nas/ bcom nasadakyil 'khor bri bar bya/ zhesalan gsum brjod pa'i bar sngar sabaslang gi skabasaltar byas rjes/dkyil 'khor gyi las ji ltar bde bar gyisashig cesaganang ba byin nasade nyid du thim par gyur par bsam/ de nayolag pa gnyisardo rje nang bsdamasabyasapa de44mnan la/oṃ badz+ra bhā wa hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i hūṃ 260

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gca lagayig 'od zer 'bar ba 'phros bas dbang chen gser gye sa gzhi la thug gi bar rdo rjer byas par gyur bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra drispyo tiṣā/ zhe4lan gsum brjod byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ lha gnas ngesapa'i phyir thig gdab pa dang / de na4lhasta gonadangoyobya ba'o/ / dang po ni/ gtsang zhing ma nyam4pa'i rasaskud la sog4pa skra ma 'dres pa kha dog dkar po 'jur mdud med par sum sgril du byasapa'i ring thung gi tshad dpon slob gnyis kyi sor mo bzhi la dkris pa'i cha rnamasam gtogs pa'i bar la dkyil 'khor tshad ci tsam byed pa de'i mda' yab nas mda' yab kyi bar gyi tshad nyi4'gyur/ sbom sasgo'i nyi shu'i cha byed pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i las dzig gi skud pa 'du bya/ de la dri bzang po'i chu dang / zho 'o ma mar sbrang rtsi ka ra ste phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / ba byung lngas byugs te snod gtsang mar bzhag rang mi 'khrugs pa'i rnal 'byor dngaldan pas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sābhā wa shurnyi sarba dharmā su bha wa shurnyo3rta/ thig skud stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur ba las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing /g.yon thugs gar bsdegs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang nyams thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ma ju baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ thig skud kyi mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs sogs byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza arnya nas sta'ibar gyi4mchod/ hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing / / bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ / dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha/ / bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 261

sa / /gungathangabastanapa'azla sa' gsung 'gyam/'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ lag pas thig skud la reg cing / oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ cesabazlasate bsrung / sngags de nyid bzlasapa'i phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga'i chu dang / ka ra dang / dri'i chusagator la rdo rje dang bcas pasalag pa g.yas pas reg ste/ oṃ badz+ras ma ya sru dra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhesabazlasanas/oṃ ā ཿ/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te thig skud lhag gnas bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi yol bum pa thamasacad kyi chus bsang gtor bya zhing / oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas gtsang mar byas pa'i sa la drisabyugs nayophyi rol tu me tog bkram/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gyur bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/chos dbyings rang bzhin zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ de nas/shar sogs phyogs kyi thig le'i steng / /srad bu bzung nayomaṇ+ḍal bzhi'i/ /nya yemago dang mjug ma'i mthar/ /tshangasathig dang ni zur thig gdab/ /ce4gsung4pa ltaragyi tshangs zur gyi thig gi 'gro 'tshamasartogs pa'i phyir skum po la skor byasarjes/rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa dang slob ma skad cig gis bdud rtsi 'khyil bar gyur pa'i mig gnyis dza dza las nyi ma dang / zla ba 'od zer ser po can du gyur par bsgoms la/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyisathig skudaltebar bzung zhing grogs la/ dza 4 6 zhesapa dang / dza gsum brjod pas thig skud kyi sne mo slob ma la gtad/ des kyang sngagasade bzhin du brjod nas/drangasate g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyisaltobar bzung la/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs thams cad blos btags pa tsam las rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid do/snyam du mos nas/ rang rkang pa g.yon pa skyil krung phyed pa dang / g.yasapa yol btsugs te bsdad/ slob ma de las ldog ste bsdad nasaganyis ga'i lag pa lhan cig yol phab/ de yang bla ma nub nas shar dang / /slob ma shar nasanub tu phyogasapas shar nub kyi tshangs thig gdab/ de nas/ rang dang slob ma'i rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar ba re re/ zhesabarjod cing bsgos pasarkang ba byin gyis brlab la 262

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'icho gca lagaganyisaka g.yasaskor gyiyosong ste zam lho dang / slob ma byang du gnas pas lhobyang gi tshangasathig gdab/ de nas g.yas skor gyisayongasate slob dpon shar lho dang / slob ma nub byang du gnas pasame rlung gi zur zig gdab/ de nas g.yas skor gyisaslob dpon lho nub dang / slob ma byang shar du gnasapasazur thig gnyis pa gdab/ de nas slob dpon shar ltodang / slob ma byang shar du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig slob dpon nub byang dang / slob ma ltonub tu gnas pas nub kyi rtsa zig slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma byang shar du gnas pas byang gi rtsa dzig slar yang slob dpon shar ltodang / slob ma lhonub tu gnasapasalho'i rtsa thig rnams gdab/ de nas/ rang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha sku sgyu ma lta bur gsal ba'i mig gnyis tī tī las g.yas nyi ma g.yon zla bar gyur bar bsam te khro bo'i lta bas phyogs thams cad du bltas nas tī tī zhes brjod nas/ thar ba'i sgo'i bgegs su gyur ba'i sgrib pa rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ / snyam du bsam nas shar sgo'i tshangs thig dang rtsa thig gnyisaphang mtshams g.yas g.yon nas rtsa thig gi cha chung gnyis dbyi la/ de nas lho nub byang gi sgo'i thig kyang dbyi bar bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gye phyi thig lhag ma ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul ni/ khul sogs pa'i rtsa thig ga dbus su brgyad cha phyis pa de/ / sgo de'i bzhi cha chu chung ste/ / rtsa ba'i phyi rol gcig dngaganyis/ / gcig gnyis gcig dang gcig gi mthar/ / thig drug zur nas ngos su ste/ / tshangs las rim gyes ring bar ni/ / cha chung gsum du dang po'i thig / gnyis thig cha chung gnyis rtser reg / cha chung brgyad du gsum stegs bu'i/ / thig las drang ba'i thig bzhi ste/ / gsum ni cha chung lnga bzhi ba/ / cha chung bzhi de'i dang po ni/ / ngos thig rtse mor yang dag reg / gsum ni cha chung re re'i bar/ / bzhi ba'i rtse nas ngos su thig / cha chung bcu dang ldan pa'o/ / rtsa ba'i rtse nas byung ba'i thig / cha chung bzhi ba ngos steng du/ / cha chung gnyis gnyis thad gar ni/ / cha chung brgyad de gsum 263

sa / /gung thangabastonapa'izla ma'i gsung 'buma'agyog pa/ /zhes pa'i don de ltar legs par gdab ste 'gram logs sgo dang mi mnyam pa'i lugs so/ /de nas rta babs kyi thig gdab pa ni/ ka ba'i rtse nasaphyi ngos su/ / cha chung re re dor bar thig / bcu gcig 'di la lnga ba dang / /bdun pa cha chung phyed dang gnyis/ / yang na gsum pa bdun pa dang / /dgu ba cha chung re re'o/ /bzhi ba drug pa bcu rnams/ /so sor cha chung phyed phyed do/ /lnga ni cha chung phyed dang gnyis/ / de la phyogs gnyis su ni rgyar/ /tshangs pa'i g.yas dang g.yon du ni/ /cha chung phyed bcas mda' yi mthar/ / snam bu cha chung phyed dang gsum/ / thig ni cha chung phyed dang bzhi/ / cha chung drug mthar gnyis pa dang / / gsum pa cha chung gsum pa'o/ / cha chung bzhi mthar bzhi ba ni/ / cha chung lnga ste mda' phyed bcas/ / gsum dor nas ni phyed dang lnga/ / gsum nas drug pa cha chung lnga/ /bzhi ni cha chung bdun rnams te/ /thig bcu gcig pa cha chung lnga/ /snam bu lnga ba'i steng gi ni/ / ngos su cha chung phyed dang bzhi/ / bdun pa'i 'og la cha chung gsum/ / steng ni cha chung drug steng du/ / snam bu rnams mthar son pa'i thig / gzhan gyi mtha' dang lhan cig ste/ / phyogs po gcig po 'di nang du'ang / /cha chung phyed nas de bzhin gzhan/ /de'i phyir cha chung rig byed mthar/ / thig blum de ni gnyis yin te/ / cha chung gnyis gnyis dor bar ro/ /bzhi dor bar ni blum po gzhan/ /zhes pa ltar gdab ste rta babs sgo tshad gsum ma'i lugs yin pas 'di nyid lags so/ / sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa'i thig skor lugs ni/ / tshangs dang mda' yab phrad pa nas/ / cha chung bzhi dang bzhi gsum ni/ / song bar cha chung dgu dang ni/ /bzhi chas g.yas g.yon phyi rwa bskor/ / mda' yab tshangs las cha chung ni/ /phyed bcas gsum ni thad gar g.yas/ / drug nas phyed bcas bcu gnyis kyis/ / g.yon bskor g.yas pa de las ldog / ces pa ltar gdab/264
