༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gaja lagadakyel 'khor gyi nang gi thig gdab lugs ni/ tshangs pa'i thig las phyi ngos su/cha chung lnga dor bar pad+ma'i lte ba'i don du thig rlum po gcig de'i phyi ngos su 'dab ma'i don du cha chung bcu dor bar blum po gcig bskor/ de'i phyi ngos su cha chung gcig dor bar gdung 'khor gyi rdo rje'i phreng ba'i don du skor thig gcig nang gi lte ba'i thig gi phyi ngos su ge sar gyi don du slar yang cha chung phyed dor nas thig blum gcig bskor la/ tshangs thig bzhi 'deb ma'i dbus su 'ong bar byas nas phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad cha mnyam pa bya'o/ /phyi nang gi thig gzhan de rnams 'debs pa'i tshe yang skor phyogs dang / sdong sa'i gnas dang / go rim rnams snga ma ltar bya zhing skabs thams cad du slob mas rgyab mi ston par 'gro la/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis thig thams cad 'debs pa ma bde na dang po la phya zhing lhag ma ci bder bya/ skor thig rnams phyed pa'i tshe seng lding gi phur bu 'og rdo rje rtse gcig pa steng rdo rje rtsa lnga ba'i dbyibs can bsad sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i phur bu steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'og rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can du gyur bar bsam nas/ oṃ badz+ra kyi li kyi la ya sarba bisdin hūṃ/ nye4pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlasanas/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bsdod cing rdo rje tho bas brdungs nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su btab pa la thig skud gnyis bltab tu byas pa btags nas dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas skor du bskor la gdab/ skor thig zin rjes phur bu dkyil 'khor gyi mjug chog skabs su bshad pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyasadabyung nas/ phur bu rang gi lag gi rdo rje la thim par gyur bar bsam zhing / phur bu ngos su med na'ang bsgom pa'i rim pas de dag bya la/ gzhan gyi thig gi ltas brtag lugs sogs zhib par sngags rim chen mo las shes par byas nas tshang ldan gyi phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa bzhin thig legs par gdab par bya'o/ / de ltar thig rdzogs par thebs nas thig skud la/ oṃ badz+ra 265

༄/ /yo b.lo ba'icanasa'i ga las/ma hā kro dha rā dza a r+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyilomachod/ sngar gyi bstod pasabastod/ oṃ ā : badz+ra mu ga skud kyi ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/zhesabarjod cing mosal dam tshig pa rang la bsdusate/ thig skud gnaloci bde bar bzhag go / gnyisapa lhasta gon dngos bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sagazhi dri bzang la sogasapas byug4shing me tog gcal du bkram/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcasapa'i dri bzang posaltaganas so sor thig le bya zhing / de yang gtso bo'i gnasasagru bzhi dang / lha gzhan rnams kyi gnas su blum po/ dri'i thig le'i steng du lha rang rang gi sngagayobarjod nasame tog gi tshom bu re bkod/ mtha' bskor du nyer spyong nyung mtha' tshar bcu la4mi nyung ba mdun gye lha'i g.yasanayomago brtsams te bshams/ rang shar nasadabusasu phyogasapar 'dug la lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ oṃ su bha wa shu rnya sarba dharmā su bha wa shu rnyo3nya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ zhes pa nas/ zla ba la rgyab brten cing sems dpa'i skyel mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i gar gyi gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed tshul 'og nas 'byung ba'i mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar byas rjes/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sngar nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza dza nyu baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye 〉 rtu/ zhes gsungs shing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur ba las mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan par gyur bar bsam/ sta gon gye mchod pa/ a mṛ tasabasang la/ sngar ltar byin gyesabarlab/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul legs kye/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' 266

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'icho gca lagadrin stsol/ / oṃ ā trī bra wa ra sad ka re a r+ghaṃ bra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes dang /mchodayon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil/ a gyi gnas su pā bcug pasachu gnyisa'abul/ lha yi me tog dam pa 'di/ / dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ / thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ / mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta buṣ+pe bra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du me tog gi gnas su/ bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sgra snyan/zhesapa rnams dang / puṅge'i gnas su/ ju pe/ alo ke/ gadhe/ ne+e wi t+ya/sha bha rnams bcug pas mchod/ mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can/ thugs pha'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ / dri med mi g.yo mnyamamed dam pa'i mchog chos can/ / yon tan shin tu phra ba'o cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun dusad ma yin/ / dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ / sems can khams la dngosagrub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ / rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugasalas byung / / smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'groba'i don bsgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ / thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / / tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ / thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ / e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ / mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ / khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ / dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la3lo/ / zhesabastod/267

༄/ /yo cabamaḥyod+ku gas lasagasum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ rnam rgyal dang la4bum gnyis/ kha rgyan dung chos gzungasardor mchod pa dang bcas pa phyag bzhe4bzhin bshams/ amṛ tasabasang /swā bha wa4sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyel 'khor gye steng du sgyi las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba lter ba/zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba bcing ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chudang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog yin+d+ra ni la'i lhun po/ zhes pa nas/skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes gtso bo gong ltar bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du shaṃ las dpal be'u/ zhes pa nas/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /las bum du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur ba las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing /g.yon thugs gar bsdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing blum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du badzes shing / rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabasakyis bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin para.ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gye lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza sprin bral mkha' la 268

/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'itshogaca lagayid 'ong 'ja' tshon bzhin/ / chos dbyings ngang las gzugs sku'i rnam rol gyis/ / grangs med 'gro ba'i don mdzad lha'i 'khor lo/ / rten dang brten par bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ / zheyobarjod/ lasasngag4lan bdun gyis bsngagasapa'i mchod yon rgya snod dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ mdzub mo g.yob cing / dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ / bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / / mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra akhro bh+ya e bye hi/ zhes dang /oṃ mi ga la shrī dza d+ma dza swāhā/ 'di la kun dga' 'grol mchog gi cho gar shrī bang4zhes 'byung ba 'khri shing shan sbyar dang ka la ba'i ṭīk+ka sogs dang mthun dang gzhan phal cheralayodza'i rjesasu de skya dang ma brtsegs pa 'di 'byung ba4dpyad/ de bzhin du sngagasakyi thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ mi ga la pad+ma/ mi ga la tsha hre ga mi ga la shaṃ1ba/ mi ga la tsa kra/ mi ga la dhā dza/ mi ga la ka la sha ga la nya tsha swāhā/zhes pa rnamasare re'i mthar/ e byu nyi/ zhes brjod cing / so so'i mthar bzed zhal gyi nang du mchod yon cung zad re blugs shing spyan drangs/ oṃ ya bi snya na ta kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ cesalan gsum gyiyophyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan te/ yi sarba ta thā ga to ste wa ye swāhā/ zhes bajod pas lha thams cad mnyes par bsam/ dza ka baṃ ho0 lha rnams bum ba'i nang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs bdag bskyed ltar bya/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying gnas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song ba bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ gzungasaganasabazung ste/ gzung4ring dang lha mo brgyad kyi sngags brgya rtsa re/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣe 269

༄/ /yo cabastan༅ yo ga las/ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhegapa ci mang dang / lasabum la/ a mṛ ta brgya rtsa dang yig brgyasalhag chad bskangs/ dung chos kyi chu la dmigs te/ oṃ wa rtu/ lan bdun bzlas/ gzungasakyi mthar hūṃ lan bdun gyisabum pa'i lhal dung chosakyi chusamachod yon 'bul/ la4sngagayokyi me tog dkar po gsum gsum gzhug las bum gyi chu gtor la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnam par bzlog ba'i 'azin las mdzod cig cesa'aphrin la4bcol sarba ta thā ga ta pukhye sogasakyisamachod/ chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra ni la'i mdog /zhe4sogasadang / hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgogs shing / /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /zhesasogs kyis bzod paragasol/ oṃ badz+ra spu ma shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab par gyur bar bsam la/ rnam rgyal bum pa steng kheb sogasakyis g.yogasate dben par bzhag /lasabum bsang gtor gyi ched du rang gi nye logasasu 'jog cing dkyil 'khoragyi bya ba ma zin bar du/ mchod bstod bzlas pa tshar re de nyin re bzhin ma chagasapa bya/bzhi ba lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sta gon gyi lhal/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugalote/ bdag nyid kyi lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur par bsam la/ lag pa g.yayospos phor thogs/ g.yon pasadril bu dkrol nas/ mi 'khrugs rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs pa'i rgyal bo khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdagagus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /270

sa / /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'ichogaca laga'abyung bo byang chub bstan gnas dang / / sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ / gang su rdo rje spyan mnga' rnams/ / bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ / bcom ldan mi 'khrugs dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa nyer spyod pas/ / 'gro ba spyad phyir bri bar bya/ / de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ / rjes su brtse bar ltar bzung nas/ / dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ / nye bar 'byon par mdzad par rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gyi4gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /lnga pa slob ma sta gon la yang / kunaslong 'chos shing gtso bor bskyed pa gsol ba gdab cing 'dzin du gzhug pa/ sdom pa gzung zhing byin gyisarlabs pa/ so shing dor shing khyor chu sog4gsum sbyin pa/ spro ba bskyed cing bsrung ste rmi lam brtag par gdamasapa'o/ / dang po ni sta gon gyi tshom bu dang bum pa sogasayol bsabaskor la/slob ma rnams khrus byasate nang du 'dus par me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ sta gon gyi rim pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas spyi dang bye brag gi chosabashad gang 'tshamasadang / khyad par gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ / la la gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ / 'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ / bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ / gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ / 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ / dad pa mang du byed pa yis/ blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ / tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ / tshe 'di 'dod par gyur ba la/ / 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ / 'jig rten pha rol don gnyeraskyes/ / 'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ / zhesagasungs pas don bshad de kun slong 'chos/ slob ma rnamasal bsang chu gtor zhing / amṛ ta sa bsang la/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ zhesabarjod cing bsam/gnyisapa ni/ slob ma la gsol 'debasakyi tshig don bshad nasade rnamayodran 271

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ༅sgronama'i ga las/bzhin pa'i sgo nasadakyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i phyi rolatu gnasapas gsol pa 'debasapar mosasu bcug ste/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra ya/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig bu/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar ba chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum rjesazlos kyisagasol ba btab/ de nas/bu tshur shog cig theg chen po/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyed la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyes/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ / gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ / mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /zhes sdom 'byung sogasalas ci rig4bar 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad 'di rnams kyi don bshad na sngagayol mos pa brtan po 'dzin du 'jug go /gsum pa la/ byang chub semayodapa'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sogs pa'i rgyal ba srasabacas thamasacad bzhugs par mo4subacug nas/ bla ma dang lha tshogasakyi spyan sngar skyabasa'agro dang sdig pa bshag4pa yerang sngonakhu 'gro ba'i sgo na4semasacan thamasacad kyi don du rdzogasapa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi smon semasabazung ba dang / byang chub semasadapa'i sdom pa blangasanas/ rgyal sras kyispyod pa mtha' dag la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bslab par bya snyam pas sdom pa 272

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'i chog cha lagabazung ba dang bsung 'dod bskyed pa sogasabarda 'phrod nges byayonas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum gyis byang sdom 'dzin du gzhug cing lan gsum ba'i mthar byang sdom skyesaba'i thob dus kyang go bar bya/ / byin gyis brlab pa ni/ badz+ra amṛ ta'i sngags brjod pa dang mnyam du bsang chu gtor la bsrung / slob ma rnams kye snying gar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga ba'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ nag po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la yā dmar po/ spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar pos mtshan par gyur/ces brjed cing bsam nasaslob ma'i snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo rnamasasu rdo rje dang bcas pa'ikhu tshur g.yas pa'i dri'i chus phyug4shing / : ā0 / zhes brjod la gnas gsum byin gyisabarlab/ de nas/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nasamachod yul du byasapa la/ dbu la me tog shangs la bdug spos/ mdun namasprun la mar me/ snying gar drisabyugs la phul bar mos te mchen la de bzhi rim pa bzhin/ badz+ra buṣ+pe/ badz+ra rgya be/ badz+ra a lo ke badz+ra a lo kebadz+ra gadhe/ zhesabarjod ba'i sgo nas 'bul/bzhi ba ni/ so shing dor ba'i gnas rgyasakhru bzhi ba/ dbyibasagru bzhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la ba lci sogasakyis srab mthug ba'i ko ba tsam byugs/ so shing 'o ma can gyi shing ha cang sbom phra'i skyon dang bral ba drang zhing srog chags med pa ma gsapa rma med pa mgo mjug mnyam pa sor bcu gnyiyoba'i tshad can dri bzang gi chus bkru zhing bdug pas bdug rtse mor yetog bcingasab la blangs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te kha byang du phyogs payoslob ma'i lag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin la/ des byang ngam shar du phyogs te/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa haṃ/ zhesabarjod cing rtse mo nas 'chosate mig steng du bltabasadakyil 'khor gyi steng du lto4pa med par 'dor du bzhugaso shing mgo gang du bstan pa la brtagasan4dngos grub 'di 'grub ces brda sprod/ de nas/ baṃ las skyes ba'i chu baṃ/ bzlas pa kha bshal ba'i phyir byin te kha bshal du 273

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'izla sa gsung 'bumabacug /de nas/ badz+ra a mṛ ta/ lan bdun bzlasapasadri zhim po'i chu khyor ba gsum/ oṃ hrī bi shurnya rnyarmā sarba bā bā ni tsā a sru bi shodha ya sarba bi mawā na a ba na ya4/ zhes brjod nasabyin/ de nas/ bkra shisaba'i mi lamami 'khrul ba'i ched du ku sha brtse mo mnyam pa/ hūṃ las byung ba'i ku sha hūṃ/ zhes byin gyisabarlab pa stan du gting ba'i bon dang / ku sha nyung ba dhī las byung ba'i ku sha trī zhesadang /badz+rayo mṛ ta bzla4nasasngasakyi don du slob ma'i lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar/ oṃ badz+ra ti k+ṣa baṃ/ zheyopasasngags bajod nas byin/ de nas/ hūṃ lasabyung ba'i skud pa dmar po slob ma'i lusatshad sum pa ltab mdung ba gsum bya4te/ oṃ bud dha mi tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sar+pān swāhā/ zhes brjod cing slob ma'i dpung ba g.yasasablam rang nyid kyis bcing ngo /lnga ba ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ / res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ / yu dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ / brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig / gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ / mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ / de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ / bskal ba bye ba du ma ru/ / sdig pa gang zhig sngon byas pa/ / dkyel 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis/ / de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na/ / grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ / tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ / skyobs pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ / go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ / spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams kyi/ blo gros shin tu dri ma med/ / de rnams kyi ni sdug bsngal kun/ 'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag 'i/ / bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ / de ring rnyed pa mnyam med rnyed/ / gang gis khyed rnams rgyal ba kun/ / bdag nyid chen po sras bcas kyis/ /bstan 'di kun la yongs su bzung / / gnas pa skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ / de yis khyed rnams theg chen la/ / legs par skye ba nyid du 274

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'ichogaca laga'agyur/ / theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ / lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ / gang gis khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur bas/ / de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ / zhes rnam snang mngon byang sogasalas 'byung ba 'di'i don bshad nas spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ / de nas/ slob ma rnams la bsang chu gtor ba dang mnyam du/ badz+ra abṛ ta'i sngags bzla4pas bsrung / sngags de slob ma la bzlasapa'i don du byin la/ khyed rnamasakyis ku sha che bstan dang chung ba sngagasu bcug nas/ shar phyogs su mgo bstan seng ge nyal stabs kyis nyal ba'i mtshan mo la thun bzhir byasaba'i tha ma tho rangasakyi char mi lam gang byung ba de nyid ma brjed par byosal/ nangasapar nga la sprosashig ces pa ltabusarmi lam brtag par gzabs la/ slob ma'i sta gon thob pa'i ka tang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul rjes rang gnasasu btang ngo / / bla ma rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi khang bar zhugayote bsrung ba'i don du/ badz+ra a mṛ ta/ gang 'grub bzla/ sta gon gyi lha la/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a / nas/ shasta'i bar gyisamachod nas/ hūṃ badz+ra uta tikhyu/zhes pa'i sngagasadang phyag rgya sngar bshad pas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ cesabarjod nas bteg go /gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la gnyis/ ye thig gdab cing tshon dkye ba dang /bsgrub cing mchod nas dbang bskur ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ ye thig gdab pa dang /tshonadakye ba'i chog lo/ / dang po ni/ rang shar du phyogs te gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan bzhin ba'i ngang nas thig skud kyi rgyu dang 'khel mkhan sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i skud pa lnga tshan lnga snod so sor bzhag la yungs gar gyi phye ma dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang /dri zhimapo bsresapa'i tshon sna lngas skud pa lnga tshan re kha bsgyur/ de nas/ rang bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa dang slob ma skad cig gis bdud rtsi 'khyel bar gyur bar bsam la/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i maze'u chung gi rtsa ba nasamathe bong gi rtsa ba'i bar du skud pa dkar/ ser/ dmar/ lngang sngo ba rnamasarim pa ltar bkod/thig skud dkar po oṃ las rnam snang / ser po hrī las rin 'byung / dmar po hrī las 'od dpag med/ ljang khu ā las don grub/ sngon po hūṃ las mi 275

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'isgroname'i ga lam/bskyod pa'i ngo bor gyur bar bsam la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga bzhugs pa'i thugs gar oṃ la sogs pa rang rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thig skud 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can du gyur bar bsam la/ oṃ ā shā shata badz+ra sru tra me bra ya ts+tsha mahā maṇ+ḍa la sru tra ḍā ya hūṃ/ zhesapas rnam snang la gsol ba btab/ de nas/ shā shā ta'i gnasasu/ rat+na sa sta wa zhesabacug pasarin 'byung / a mi ta bha wa bcug pasa'od dpag med/ a mo gha sirnya bcug pas don grub/ ak+ko bh+ya bcug payomibaskyod pa lagasol ba btab/ rang gi migaganyis dza dza las nyi ma dang zla ba ser por gyur/ oṃ dīsta di a ku sha dza/zhes brjod cing mig myur du bsgril nas ma 'degasashing sdebs pa dang bcas/'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis btang ba'i ye shes kyi theg skud bkugs pa rnams lag pa'i thig skud so so la thim par gyur bar mos/ de nasaslob ma dang lhan cig tu/ oṃ ā rgyo n+ya a nu ga tā sarba snya rmā spa ra sba ra a nu bra biṣā sarba dharmā ya t+ya n+ta a nu bra biṣā sarba dha nā 5 4/ zhesapa brjod nas/ dang por skud pa dkar po lnga gcig tu bsgril ba sogs lnga so sor bsgril ba dang de nas lnga ka gcig tu bsgrig/ de ltar zin pa dang sngar gyilogazhi drisabyugs pa'i snod gtsang mar dri'i chu dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / ba byung lngas sbangs shing / thig skud kyi nang gi mtha' gnyis dang dbus su oṃ wa rtu gis mtshan par gyur bar bsam/ mchod pa byen brlab bya4nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas shasta'i bar gyisamachod/ lag pa g.yasabs reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ceyobazlasapasabasrung / rang gi migagayas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba 'od zer ser po can du gyur bar bsam la/ badz+ra dri ṣā ma ṭa/ ceyobarjod na4brtan par byasate/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ cesabazla4pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu dang / yungs gar dang / dri'i chus gtor te/ rdo rje dang bca4pa'i lag pa g.yasapasareg la/ oṃ 276

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'ichogaca lagabadz+ra sa ma ya sru tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes bzlas nas/ oṃ ā :/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlasate thig skud lhag gnas bya/ de nayodakyil 'khor gyis la bum pa thams cad kyi chus bsangs gtor bya zhing / oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod la gtsang mar byas pa'i sa la dri4byugs nasame tog gcal du bkram/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gyur par mos nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnyanasasha sta'i bar gyisamachod cing / chos dbyings rang bzhin zhe4sogs kyis bstod/ rang bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa dang slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil bar gsal ba'i mig gnyis su dza dza las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can du gyur par mos nas/ 4 sgo dz+dza0 zhes dang / dza gsum brjod nas thig skud kyi sneslob mar gtad/ des kyang de brjod nayolte bar bsung / shar la sogs pa'i phyogs thams cad blos btags pa tsam las rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid do snyam du mos nas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor kyi nub dang / slob ma shar du gan4nasaslobadabon gyes rdo rje dang bcasaba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang mdzub mosathig skud bzung nasanam mkhar 'debasashing / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes pa dang / hūṃ maswā ā hā/ zhes brjod cing segol gyisaspra bya la sngagasade thig gdab ba'i skabs thams cad du brjod/ gdab tshul mtheb srin gyis thig skud steng 'og tu bzung la/ 'og tu bcug nas steng du gdab bar yang gsungs/de'i tshe/ thig gi sgras/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ / dus yin de phyir 'dir spyon cig / cesabaskul bsanam mkha' khyab ba'i sang4rgyasarnams byon te thigaskrad la thim par gyur bar bsam/ de nas dpon slob gnyis ga'i lag pa4la mnyam du phab nas tshangs thig dang po'i steng du yothig gdab/ thig gi sgras sangasargya4rnams bskul te byon nas thig skud la thim zhing / ngo bo yoshes la rnam pa srad bu kha dog lngar snang ba'i thig skud re chad nasayas thig la thim par gyur bar bsam/ dmig4pa de ni yothig gdab pa 'og ma rnams la'ang 'dra/ de nas/ rang rang slob ma'i rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar ba re re/ zhes rkang pa byin gyis brlab nas 277

༄/ /yo cabamab me'i ga lamagayasaskor du yong ste bla ma ltodang / slob ma byang du gnasapasanam mkha' dang sal tshangasathig gdab lugasasngar ltar bya/ de nasaslob masarnam pa thamasacad du slob dpon la rgyab mi ston par 'gro ba dang / skor phyog4dang / dpon slob kyi sdong ba'i phyogs sngar las thig gi skabasaji ltab bzhin byagate/ me rlung gi zur thig thamasacad kyi steng du yothig gdab cing / de rnamasal nam mkha'i thig gdab pa midagos la thig skud kyi ltas rtog4lugs lasathig dang 'dra'o/ /de'i tshe thig byin gyi4brlabasazin pa la 'gom dgosapa dang 'og tu tshon dgye ba'i tshon byin rlabasacan la 'gomadagosapa byung na/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ga a kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing thig tshon gang yin te nam mkhar btegs pas 'og tu 'dzul bar bsam te song rje4slar yang thig tshon so so la thim par mos/ de ltar ye thig rdzogasapar thebs zin pa'i rjes suthig skud la/ oṃ sa rba ta thā ga ta arnya nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma byin gyisabarlabasate/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ zhes sogs kyi sngagasakyis phul rjes/ oṃ 〉 rtu badz+ra spu zhes pas/ye shes kye thig skud nam mkha'i sta gon gyi lha'i thugs gar gshegs par gyur bar bsam la/ thig skud rnying ba mi 'gom pa'i gnasagatsang mar bzhag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis tshon byin gyisabarlab pa dang / des rten dang brten ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro ba'i/ rab rin chen las byas pa'am/ rin po che bsres pa dang / ma 'byor na 'bras dang khamayosa'i phye ma sogs las byasapa'i tshon rtsi sna lnga sgod sosor blugs pa dbusadang shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i rim pasabazhag /baṃ lam̐ re haṃ i rnams las rim pa bzhin byung ba'i dkar ser dmar ljang sngon po'i tshon rtsi rnams su gyur bar bsam nas/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ trī 〉 rnamayoso sor bris pa la/badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang / su bha wasasbyang / stong ba'i ngang las rdul tshon dkar po oṃ las rnam snang / nag po hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ ser po ṭ+wāṃ las rin 'byung /dmar po hrī ā las 'od dpag med/ ljang khu ā las don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ rang gi mig gnyis dza dza las nyi ma dang zla ba ser 278

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gca lagaboragyur/ oṃ dī s+t+ra dri ṣā a d+ku sha dza/ zhesabarjod cing sngar yothig gi skabasasu bshad pa ltabu'i lta stangs byas nas/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus bkugs pa'i/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i thugs gar rang rang gi sa bon las grub pa'i ye shes kyi tshon thugs ka nab btang ba rnams tshon so so dang gcig tu gyur bar bsam/ oṃ hūṃ hā hrī ā zhesapasabasngagasanas/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhesabargya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de nas 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis gzi brjid bskyed cing rdul tshon rnamasal 6 yig bkod nas/bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul tshon mang zhing / sangs rgyas rnams ni sems can rnams la chags pas rjes su chags par 'gyur ba'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces ltastangs dang bden ba'i byin rlabasakyisatshon mang por 'phel bar bsam/ de nasardul tshon la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a na4 bha'i bar gyisamachod do/ / gnyisapa ni/ skor thig gi du4btab pa'i phur bu sngar smosazin pa ltar/ sngagasargyas phyung ste/ de'i shul tshon sna lngas dgang la bsam gtan gyiyode ltar bya4pa yin na tshon lngas bkang bar mos/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug nas rdo rjegasor/ de kho na nyid kyi don dran par byas nas/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag ba ste/ / sems can khams ni rab grol bar/ / rgyal chen dgyes pa rdo rje yi/ / dkyil 'khor rab tu bri bar bya'o/ / zhes brjod/ 'di'i dgosapa ni 'og tu tshon la brten na4byung ba'i mtshan ma ngan pa rnamasasel ba'i ched do/ / de naloslob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas su rdo rje bzung / g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyisadabang ldan nas brtsams te shar gyi rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar lngang sngon po'i rim pas rdul tshon dgye la/ de yang sor bcu gnyisakyisred kyi bar slob dpon rang nyid kyis ngelopar 'bri dgosashing / ri mo yon posagadung ba bskyed/ dma' ba4dngos grub mi 'grub pa sogs gsungasabasabag dang ldan par bya la/ tshon gyi re kha rnams rin po che dkar po sogs lasabyasapa'i thur ma la sogs pa'i ngo bor mos/ de nas rang 279

༄/ /gung thangabam yo ma'i ga las/ngam slob ma sogasakyis bkye bas chog cing / rdo rje khu tshur gyis 'bri ba yang tshon dkye ba'i dang por byas nas/ zi4ci bde na bya rung ngo / dkyil 'khor gyi tshon sani rtsig pa phyi nasarim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar lngang sngo ba dang / gzhal ya4khang gi nang shar dkar/ lhoser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ de'i dbus susna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ltob dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re gdung 'khor gyi re kha gzhi sngon po la rdo rje'i ri mo can/ gzhan ma thamasacad spyi dang 'dra bas dkyil chog gzhan las shes par bya/ brten pa lha'i gnas rnams sasku rdzogayopa'am/phyag mtshan nam/ sa bon nam/ sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon gyi thig le rnamasagang bder bya zhing / dkyil 'khor bri ba nas brtsamasate gnas der dbang thob pa cig med par stong bar bzhag tu mi rung la/ tshon gyi skabasakyi ltas rtogayolugs dang / mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa'i thabasal sogasapa zhib par sngags rim chen mo las khong du chud par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis chad lhag yod med legasapar brtag ste/ chad pa 'bri/ lhag pa dang tshon 'thor ba rnamasadabyi la/ chad lhag mtshor ba rnam4yege brgya ba brjod de nyes pa sbyangs par bde chen rol mtshor gsungs/ hūṃ dang / badz+ra amṛ ta bzlasapa4bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus dkyil 'khor gyi phyi ngos su byugagashing de bzlas pa'i chusadakyil 'khor bsangs/ tshon lhag ma rnamasal/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas sha sta'i bar gyisamachod/ sngar ye thig gi skabasaltar gtor ma 'bul ba'am ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med la/ de nas/ oṃ 〉 rtu badz+ra mā lhag ma'i rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pas rigs lnga'i thugs gar gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur bar bsam nas/ tshon rnamasaci bder bzhag go /de nas rasabris la bsten pa yin na/ sa'i cho ga lnga las/ dang po gsum midagosashing / phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu phyi ma gnyisadamapa 'ga' zhig gi phyagabazhe4sumadzad pa ltar byung na legs la/ 'on kyang 'jug pa bde bar byed na/sa chog gi skor rnam4bzhag ste/ bdag bskyed rdzog4par grub nas/ sasasta gon bya4la/ dkyil 'khor gang du bkram pa'i gzhi der dri bzang byugs shing me tog gcal du 280

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'itsha gca lagabakram/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du dri bzang gi chusathig le gtso 'khor gyi gnasasosor byed tshul dang / tshom bu dgod tshul/ mchod pa sogs rdul tshon gyis skabasasu bshad pa bzhin byas la/ ngag 'don yang de dang mtshungasashing / khyad par ni/ der rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros sngar nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogasayo badz+ra sa ma dza zhesapa'i tshab tu/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza zhes 'don pa bsgyur zhing / bum pa sta gon dang / lhal gsol ba gdab pa/ slob ma sta gon gsum ni snga ma ji ltab bzhin no/ /gsum pa dngosagazhi'i cho ga la/ bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngar lhag gnasabyas pa'i bum pa spos kyi4sna drangs/ rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs dang bcas dkyil 'khor la g.yasaskor lan gsum byasan4rnam rgyal dang las bum shar sgo'i kha nang lha'i g.yasagayon du 'god/ dkyil 'khor la nyer spyod ma mtha' bcu las minyung ba'i gang rgyayodang / gzhan yang gosazung dang /gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan lasogasapa mchod pa'i yo byad/ tha na ri mor bri4pa tshunachad kyiyokyang ci 'byor ba bshams pa rnams/ hūṃ dang / kai ka ni dang / oṃ badz+ra ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod bas 'bul lo/ / de nas bdag bskyed rgyas pa nyer bsdu'i bar btang ste lha'i rnal 'byor la gnasapa'i ngang na4kha dkyil 'khor la phyogasate 'dug / oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ceyopa'i sngagasabarjod nasalas bum gyi chuyodakyil 'khor la bsang / oṃ swa bhā wa shu rnyi sarba dha rmāsu bhā wa shusgo ྅ haṃ/ dkyil 'khor stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ dra ba dang / gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngon po'i lte bar hūṃ las rin po che sna 281

༄/ /gung bsar+sā ཿ sa las/tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi ba/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim ba lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng du gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / dril bu dang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang / steng du langs pa'i rin po che'i dra mig seng ma'i bu shus bskor pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol tu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod pa byed pa/ sgo dngasgo khyud kyi mtshams dang zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung blum po dang /de'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang g.yas g.yon na ri dwags pho mo dang bcas shing / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang /dbus sngo ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa/ zheyopa nas/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhesapa'i bar gyis gong ltar gtso bo bskyed/'dab ma brgyad la shar du shaṃ las dpal be'u shaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas dpal be'u 'dzin pa/ lhor baṃ las pad+ma baṃ gyis mtshan pa 282

༄/ /mi 'khrugasal lhadagu'itsha gapho lagalas/ 'od ldan ma dmar mo g.yas pad+ma ྾/ nub tu tsho las gdugs tsho gis mtshan pa las/ mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas gdugs ྾/ byang du shaṃ las dung shaṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ dri med ma ljang gu g.yas dung nga/ mer rtsa las 'khoram rtsa gyis mtshan pa las/ 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo nga/ srin por t+t+waṃ las rgyal mtshan t+t+waṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rnal 'byor ma sngon mo g.yas rgyal mtshan ྾/ rlung du ke las bum pa ke gis mtshan pa las/dkar sham ma dmar skya g.yas bum pa ྾/ dbang ldan du mi las gser nya mi gyis mtshan pa las/ yid gzhungs ma ljang gu g.yas gser nya 'dzin pa/thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs gar 'dzin cing / g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho dar la bab pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zla ba la rgyab brten cing / sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ / de thams cad kyi dbral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / bcom ldan skal ba grangs med du ma ru/ / 'gro ba brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / / smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ / khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di legs na/ / de phyir chos dbyangs pho brang lhun grub nas/ / rdzu 'phrul byen brlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / / mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /283

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'izla ma'i gsung 'bram/yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ / sprin bral mkha' la yid 'ong 'ja' tshon bzhin/ / chos dbyings ngang las gzugs sku'i rnam rol gyis/ / grangs med 'gro ba'i don mdzad lha'i 'khor lo/ / rten dang brten par bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ zhesabarjod/ lasasngags lan gsum gyis bsngags pa'i mchod yon gyi snod dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bzung la 'dzub mo g.yob cing / dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ / bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / / mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra akhro bh+ya e hu hi/ zhes dang /oṃ ma ga la shrī dza d+ma dza swāhā/ de bzhin du sngagayokyi thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ mi ga la pad+ma/ mi ga la tsha tram̐ ga mi ga la shaṃ kha/ mi ga la tsakra mi ga la dh+wa dza/mig la ka la sha mi ga la nya tsha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams re re'i mthar/ e hu haṃ/zhes brjod cing / so so'i mthar bzed zhal gyi nang du mchod yon cung zad re blug cing spyanadrangs/ oṃ ā bigru na ta krita hūṃ phaṭa/ ceyolan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ / tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ / bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bra wa ra sa dkar ar+bhe pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ spron/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ / lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ / de bzhin bdagagis khrus bgyi'o/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/zhesakhrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ / nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ / ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ / de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ / oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhesapa'i gdan phul la/ oṃ badz+ra budz+dza ā :/ zhes sogasakyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wa kyi t+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra brnya rna ka ro mi/ zhes pasaphyag bya/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya 2yo

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'i cho gca lagabastanate/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tosnye wa ye swāhā/ zhes brjod pas/ lha tham4cad mnyes par bsam/ dza ྅ baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/denas sngar nam mkhar bteg pa'i ltagon gyi lha la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas/shasta'ibar gyis mchod/ ( rtu baṃ ho zhes pa'i sngagayorgyasadagug gzhugs bcing mnye4byas nas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur bar bsam/slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya thi ye hūṃ/zhesagasungs shing / bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan cing / dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur/ zhesadabang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabayol/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rte khams ni dpag med na/ / mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ / sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra akhro bh+ya maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wa ra arnya bra ti ts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas 'bul/ mthar dha rmya ra ṇi/ zhes rol chen dang bcasapa bya/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di/ / sna tshogs bcud kyis bkang ste phul ba yis/ / las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun dag nas/ / byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog / oṃ badz+ra ka la sha pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba/ / gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ / gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyangs phyir 'bul/ / bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog / oṃ badz+ra wa s+t+ra ye 285

sa / /gung thang bstanapa'azla sa'i gsung 'bum/ā ྅ swā hā/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ / rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan bar mi 'tshal yang / rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ / mtshan dpa'e brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā li kā ra wa bu ṣa ni swā hā/ phun tshogs bkra shis dge mtshan ma lus kun/ / gcig tu rab 'khyil yid 'ong dpal be'u/ / dngos bshams yid sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ / gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/྾/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mi ga la shrī dzasma dza bu dzi te hūṃ/ de bzhin du tshigs rkang 'og ma gnyis 'dra ba'i/ stong gsum kun la thogs med dbang bsgyur ba'i/ / gser sbyangs las grub 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'di/ma/ sngags kyi theg mtha' 'dra ba la/ shrī dzad+ma dza'i tshab tu/ tsa kra/ rnyog bral yid bzhin dal 'gro 'khyil ba'i dbus/ / mnyen 'jam 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i pad dkar 'di/za bad+ma/'dod dgu'i char 'babs nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ / srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng ba'i rgyal mtshan 'di/ mo rta dza/ rin chen phra tshom gyis spras yub can/ / lha rdzas dar gyi sham bu g.yo ba'i gdugs/ tsha gri ga zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i btung ba yis/ / mngon par bkang ba'i bum pa bzang po 'di/〉 ka la sha rab snyan tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra chen po/ / phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'di/ma kha/ gzugs kun gsal mthong 'dren byed rab ldan pa'i/ / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las grub pa'i nya/ma nya tsha ra/ zhes phyag rgya med pa rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyasadabul/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po be+eḍū r+ya/ / sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs/ / rnam gsum gzugs kye rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bya/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra akhro bh+ya ma ṇ+ḍa la sa ba ṛ wā ra rū pa pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i/ / brjod bral dbyangs la sogs pa sgra yi tshogs/ / rnam gsum sgra 286

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'itshogapho lagayirdo rje mar byas nas/ / dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la dbul bar bya/ / oṃ sarba nga wa re sha sta pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ ga bur a gar dzā ti la sogs pa/ /legs par sbyar las byung ba dri yi tshogs/ / rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ / dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la dbul bar bya/ / oṃ sarba ཿ wā ra gadhe pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ lus mchog rtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas sogs kyi/ / mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro/ / rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ / dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la dbul bar bya/ / oṃ sarba ma wā ra ra sa pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba/ / dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs/ / rnam gsum reg bya'i rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyel 'khor lha yi sku la dbul bar bya/ / oṃ sarba ཿ wā ra spar+sha pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ be+estur ser po'i brtan pa 'phrog byed ba'i/ / gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rtsibs stong 'khor lo 'di/ / mi 'khrugs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul/ / ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thāg ta tsa kra rad+ma snu ji te hūṃ/ bsam pa tsam kyis 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ / rab ster nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'di/ / mi 'khrugs nga ji snyed ngam ṇi/ sngo bsangs ri dwags mig can skyengs byed pa'i/ / sgyu rtsal nyams ldan thun mtshams mdzes ma 'di/ / mi 'khrugs ma ji snyed mo ste/ blo gros chugater che las chos kyi sred/ / rba rlabs gyen 'phyur khyim bdag rin chen 'di/ /mi 'khrugs ma ji snyed 〉 pu ra ṣa/ bsil ldan lhun po ra rgyan gyi 'phyang mo yug / 'dzin byed stobs ldan gnyis 'thung dbang po 'di/ / mi 'khrugs ma ji snyed mo ha ste/ rdul gyi rgyal mtshan dal ba'i gnas bsten par/ / byed po cang shes yid 'od rta mchog 'di/ / mi 'khrugs ma ji snyed nga tu ram̐ ga a sha/ dpa' rtsal stobs kyis ra gru'i sras po yang / / zhum par byed pa'i phun tshogs dmag dpon 'di/ / mi 'khrugs dkyil 'khor 'khor 287

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'i sa' g.yo 4ma/lo'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal tu gsol/ / kha ḍa ga rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang long skabs med dus mchod pa 'di rnams tshigs bcad dor ba'i sngags tsam gyiyophul kyang rung / de nas rdor dril 'dzin bas dril sngags dang bcasate/ rgyasapar spro na/ chos dbyings rnam dag mkha' klong yangs pa las/nas/ bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / grangs med 'gro la bde chen stsol ba'i slad/ / mdzes sdug yid 'ong sprul ba'i lha mo brgyad/ /mkha' la dbang bo'i gzhu ltar rnam bkra ba'i/ / bgrang yas lha yi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sgrib med mdzes ldan spyan gyi nyer gzigs la/ / bdag cag rnams kyis tshe rabs thogs med nas/ / rmongs pa'i dbang gyur bsags pa'i sdig ltung rnams/ / bag chags bcas pa drungs nas 'byin par mdzod/ /khyad par sdom gsum bcas 'tshams las 'gal dang / / bla ma dkon mchog byang sems pha ma la/ /log par bsgrub dang dam chos spangs pa sogs/ / da lta nyid du byang zhing dag par mdzod/ / mi khom brgyad du skye 'gyur las sgrib sogs/ / ming tsam lhag ma med par zhi gyur nas/ / 'di snang 'gags tshe bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa/ / sras bcas mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ / mngon dga' la sogs dag ba'i zhing mchog tu/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zab rgyas dam pa'i chos/ / thos bsam bsgom pa'i skal ba mchog thob nas/ / rgyal sras spyod la slob par byin gyis rlobs/ / gzungs dang mngon shes rnam par thar ba'i sgo/ / mu mtha' yas pa'i ting 'dzin tshogs thob nas/ / rgyal rnams mchod dang 'gro ba sgrol ba la/ / rgyal sras kun bzang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes brjod/ bsdu na/ chos dbyings rang bzhin/ zhesasogasatshigs bcad gcig tsam gyis bstod/ grub na/ na ma sarba burnya sto dhi sa tā ṭ+wāṃ/ sarba tra saṃ ku ru mi tā bi dz+nyā ra shi ni na mo sdu te swāhā/zhes bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngagasa'adi yang ci nus brjod/ de nasabazlas pa ni/288

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gca lagamadun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa bon gye mtha' sngags phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros so/ / rang dang dmigs yul gyis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdeg sgrib spyi dang khyad par du ngan 'gror skye 'gyur gyi las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag sa lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ gzungayoring brgya stong sogs dang 'khor rnam4kyi sngags kyang ma mtha' nyer gcig tsam de bzla/ mjug tu yig brgya brjod de lhag chad pa bskang / dkyil 'khor ba la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma byen gyiyobarlabs la/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra akhro bh+ya maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra a ka ro mu khaṃ zhes pa nas gri t+na rta ba bo ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas phyi rol tu gtor ma cha gsum spyi 'gro ltar btang / nye reg byas la las sngags bzla zhing nang du 'ongs te/ rang nyid hūṃ mdzad du gsal bas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ yig brgya brjod cing bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ oṃ badzod gha ṭa/ zhes sogs lan bzhis sgo dbye bya/ oṃ bra na ma mi sarba ta thā ga ta na/ zhes phyag bya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig ceyogasol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gsum/ bdag nyid zhugs shing dbang blang ste bden pa'i byen rlabasabya ba/ slob ma bcug cing dbang bskur ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ bdag nyid zhugs nas dbang blang ba dang / bden pa'i byin rlabs bya ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / zhugs nas 289

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/dbangablang ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ gdong g.yogs dang bcasate 'jug pa dang /dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid du 'jug pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang / nang 'jug go /dang bo ni bdag 'jug gi mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ rang la dbang bskur ba'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ngo bo dbyer med du mosabasarang la dbang gi bya ba rnams mdzad pa dang rang gtso bo las phye nas dbang zhu ba po'i slob ma'i tshul du mosanas thog mar shar sgo'i phyi rol tu gnayopas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor rnams zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa bul la/ gsol 'debasakyi tshig don rnams dran bzhin par gdung shugs drag pos/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ / slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ / dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ / byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ / thar ba chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhugs par bgyi/ / zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogasalan gsum dang / byang chub snying por mchis kye bar/ / sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ / tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ / ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ / byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ / de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ / de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed bgye zhing / / de bzhitsha du ni bslab pa la'ang / / rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ / zheyopa rnams lan gsum gyis skyabasasemasakhyad par can dang byang sdom bzung / oṃ tsagru brnya wā ra ma na yeju/ zhesapasamig dar bcings/ ā bī ra hūṃ/ gisame tog gi phreng ba bzung / chaga'ajug bsdus pa la mos na mig dar dang potog bzung ba de tsam gyis chog la/ yang rgyas par spro na phreng ba lasa'abyung ba 290

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gca lagabazhin/ lasasngagasabazlasapa'i gos dmar po'am ser po sog4khadog gang yang rung ba'i smad g.yogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu t+ta ra bo dhi a le kā ra wā 〉 glu dza me gha sa mu dra sba ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas bgo zhing / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/zhes pas stod g.yogs dang / oṃ badz+ra usnyi shahūṃ phaṭa/ ceyobarjod la gtsug tor gyonardo rje'i rigayokyi dam rgya snying gar bcings te/ oṃ badz+ra yusnye wa ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ ma amṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bgegs bsad/ rigs nges pa'i slad du/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ zhes dri/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/ zhes lan gdab rang gi snyeng gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga ba 'od zer 'phro ba zhig byung bar mos/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sidhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brtan par bya/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje ba'ag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kye/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / zhes dam la bzhagaganyis pa yol ba'i nang 'jug gi phyag len la dkyil 'khor gyi yol ba dang rnam rgyal gyi steng khebs sogs bsal zhing / bsgom don ni/ bla mas/ ā / bī ra hūṃ/zhes brjod de/ rdo rje dang bcayopa'i phyag gis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid par bsam/ye shes pa dbab ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa bdag la dbab tu gsol/zhesagasol ba btab nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 291

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sa' g.yo ཿma/'khoragyi steng du hūṃ sngon po/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun skyed kyi lha nams kyi thugs gar phog thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūṃ sngon po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ yig la gnyis su med par thim/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas de 'dra ba du ma byung ste/ rang gi thugs gar zim pas rgyudabyin gyis brlabs par mos/ gzungs ring gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a ya ti ṣā badz+ra/ zhe4rdo rje dang bcas brtan par bya/ spyi bor dam rgya dang / kai ka ni/ tshar gsum gyis byin gyisarlabs/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo dril 'dzin pas/yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ / bdag gis slob ma bcug pa 'di'i/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ji ltar de ltar shog / 'di yi dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur/ / rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ / bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra bar/ / de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig ces pa brjod nas bden pa'i byin rlabasabya/gnyi4pa dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du 'jug pa ni/ sngar bsrung ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba t+t+waṃ gyisabasngags pa lasayang zhing ma rnying ba'i me tog gcig bton la lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ba rin po che'i 'phreng bar mos/ rang nyid 'bru gsum gyi 'od zer gyis sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bkrus te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ gtso bo 'khor bcas kyi mdun na gnas par gyur bar bsam/ de nas me tog gcig 'greng bar moyopa de nyid gtso bo'i dbul phul bar bsam nas/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ / bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ / 'gro la phan pa'i gtso chen gyis/ / sman par dgongs 292

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho ga cha laganas bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ bra ti ts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes me tog gtor/ oṃ pra ti gro t+na s+t+waṃ i mi satwa mahā bā la/ zhes me tog bcings/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ / mig 'byed bar ni brtson par mdzad/ / phye ba'i thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i/ / rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ / ces brjod la mig dar bsal/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes pa'i dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul/ de yang phyi rol tu rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa la zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du dbus su bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du pad+ma can dkar mo/ lhor 'od ldan ma dmar mo/ nub tu mdangs ldan ma sngon mo/byang du dri med ma ljang khu/ shar lhor 'jigs byed ma dkar mo/ lho nub tu rnal 'byor ma sngon mo/ nub byang du dkar sham ma dmar skya/ byang shar du yid bzhung ma ljang khu bcas mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mtho bar gyur bar bsam la/ dkyil 'khor dbang po 'di la ltos/ / da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ / khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ / sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ / 'gro ba'i phun tshogs dngos grub kyang / / thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur/ /dngos grub phyir ni dam tshig srungs/ / gsang sngags dag la'ang brtson par gyes/ / zhes lha ngo bstan par byas te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor ro/ /gnyi4pa zhugs nas dbang blangasapa la ba'i/ chu'i dbang / cod pan gyi dbang /chos bshad kyi rjes gnang / rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi dbang ngo / / dang po ni/ dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas 293

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gas 'bumal/ / mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ / bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khrir sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa/ zhe4sogs bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin la/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam la/ bum chu bsang sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ trī u rnams las byung ba'i ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bum chur gyur bar bsam la/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rang la dbang bskur ba'i phyir bskul te spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs/ bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma dang bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rang gi steng phyogs su 'dzin/ glu gar mdzad cing rol mo brdung /me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzungaba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyi shis pa brjod/ khro bo rnams phyags mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gye ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ / sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ / 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yis nyes bar mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ / chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams 294

sa / /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'i cho gabo lagal zhi byed pa/ / 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra gnyis pa'o/ / dge 'dun dam pa chos dang mthun pa'i bkra shis phyug / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gye mchod pa'i gnas/ / tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang ngapal gye zhing / /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ / rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum ba'i chus/ / skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa dag gyur te/ / byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ zhes pa nas/ sarba sa twa ñtsa swāhā/ oṃ akhro bya maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā rwa de wā badz+ra ka la sha a snyi ṣe ñtsa mi/ oṃ akhro bya maṇ+ḍa las pa ri wā ra badz+ra bru dza ka la sha a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyes ni/ zhes pa nas/ khrus bgyi'o/ / oṃ ya badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/su ra ta snyi a haṃ/ zhe4dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / bde ba chen po pyong / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur ba las rigs lngas dbu brgyan cing / dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas shasta'i bar gyis bdag nyid la mchod/ de ltar chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa lnga gnas 'gyur/ lam mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go / cod paṇa gyi dbang la rgyas bar na sngar ltar gsol ba lan gsum btab/ cod paṇa bsang sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ trī ā0las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi cod paṇa du gyur/bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad ma zhes pa nas/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ sngar ltar mchog gsum gyi bkra shis brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod paṇa 'dis/ / skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang 295

ro༅/ /gung thangabastan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/bskur bas/ / sku gsum thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ / rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog / oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa badz+ra pasbyo a sti ṣiñtsa mi/zhes brjod de dbu rgyan bcings/ mtha' rten chu dbang ni/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes pa nas/ khrus bgyi'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣi ka tas ma ya shrī ye ā :/zhes ngabang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / zhes sogs nas bdag nyid la mchod pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ de ltar cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ dri ma lnga sbyangs/ phung po lnga gnas 'gyur/ lam mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbangabar byas/ 'bras bu gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go /gsum pa chos bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/ sbyo las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ mdun nas bstan du byin la/ oṃ badz+ra hi du mi/ zhes brjod/ dbyangs tha ma a las byung ba'i dung / oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa ram̐/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su byen/ dbyangs dang po a las byung ba'i po ti/ a zhes brjod nas lag pa g.yon du byin la/deng nas bcoms te sems bskyed pa/ / tsam gyis chos dung bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyes/ /zhes brjod/ dbyangs tha ma a las byung ba'i dril bu a zhes brjod nas lag pa g.yon du byin la dkrol/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ / nam mkha' yang ni mtshan nyid med/ / nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor pas/ /thams cad mchog ni mnyam nyid gsal/ / zhes brjod/ da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ / sngags dang rgyud kyang 'dzin par 'gyur/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / / lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ / khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ / nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya/ / sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi chos ston pa 296

༄/ /mi 'khrugasal lhadagu'icho ga cha lagasogs kyi slob dpon du bya ba'i ched du rjes su gnang ba byin pas rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi dkyil 'khor bri sgrub/ dbang bskur ba sogs la dbang bar byas/ 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhaga'abrasabu rigs gsum gyi chos kye 'khor los sgyur ba'i go 'phang myur du thob ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes bajod/ rjes gnang 'di dag rnam snang mngon byang sogs ci rigs par gsungs pas bya spyod gnyisaka'i skabs su ster bar 'gal ba med par ma zad legs pa yin la/ sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangayopa'i mi tra'i mngon dkyil sogasalayom byung bsachad pa'i skyon min pas bzhag kyang chog go /bzhi ba rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shiyordzasabargyad kyi dbang ni/ rgyal srid sna bdun briyo'abur ci rigs mdun du bshams/ bsang / sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las las byung ba'i rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ ngo bo ye shes la rnam pa bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal ba'i rdzas su gyur/ 'khor lo de lag tu thogasal/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu blum/ / rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam ldan/ / sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur ba'i/ / 'khor lo rin chen dam bas dbang bskur ro/ / oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhesabarjod cing gtang / rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baithur+ya/ / kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing / / dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ / nor bu rin chen ma ma ṇi rat+na a snyi ṣiñtsawaṃ/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang la/ lbags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ / yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ / btsun mo rin chen nga ste rat+na a bhi ṣeñtsa mi/ gang yang rgyal ba mu tig mdangs ldan pa'i/ / gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i/ / blon po rin chen nga.oṃ bu ru ṣa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /297

༄/ /yo thangabastan pa'i sgronace' ga ཿma/rab gnas gangs chen ri 'dra glang po che/ / rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ / glang po rin chen sa / oṃ ha ste rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ / sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus pa/ / rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ / rta mchog rin chen za oṃ tu ram̐ ga a shwa rat+na aste ṣiñtsa mi/ 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur bas/ / ma lus bdud dpung 'jigs par byed pa ste/ / dpa' brtan 'byor ba'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ / dmag dpon rin chen nga yi khago rat+na a bhi ṣi ñtsa mi/ de nasabakra shiyordzas brgyad dngos sam tsa ka li sogs bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rma las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad po rnams tshe dang bsod nam dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ mgo la aṣā tra bya swāhā/ de nas rim pas lag tu gtad la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/deng 'dir yang me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cigame long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ste/ / ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur nas/ / rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ / bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig / de bzhin du sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che nor skyong gis ghi haṃ phyag tu phul ba zhes dang / ghi haṃ gi rdzas la zhes 'don pa spro/ sgo haṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ / sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtog gyur te/ nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ / bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig / de bzhin du/ zhing ba'i bu mo legs skyes mas go phyag tu phul ba zhes dang / zho'i rdzas la brten nas ma zho ni kun gye snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes mchog rtog nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ / bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig / rtsa tshong khye'u 298

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'itsha gad+ku lagabakra shis kyis rtswa dur ba nga dur ba'i rdzas la brten nas ma dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ / nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur ba yi/ / bkra shis des ni tshe yang 'phel gyur cig / lha tshangs pas shing tog bil ba ma bil ba'i rdzas la brten nas mabil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ / byang chub snying po mchog tu dag gyur pa'i/ / bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba nga dung dkar gyi rdzas la brten nas ma dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ / ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dad gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ / bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog / bram ze skar rgyal gyis li khri nga li khri'i rdzas la brten nas ma li khrir dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ / chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang / / chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ / bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig / phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs gar ྾yungs gar gye rdzas la brten nas nga yungs gar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ / bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ / mthu stobs yod tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ / bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi bar shog / ces brjod/ bsdus pa la mosan/ rgyal srid sna bdun la/ dus gsum rgyalab kun gyes bsngags pa yi/ / theg mchog chos kyi srid la mnga' bsgyur ba'i/ / rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyi dbang bskur bas/ / bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal gyur cig / oṃ salta rat+na a bhi jo ñtsa mi/ zhe4dang rdzas brgyad la/ gang zhig reg cing mthong thos dran pas kyang / / mi shis kun sel phun tshogs mchog stsol bar/ / rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis rdzas/ / dam pas dbang bskur dge legs 'bar gyur cig / oṃ aṣā 2༅

༄/ /yo cabastanapa'i sa gatshi lam/ba tra be ma go la a bhi khye ñtsa mi/ zheyobarjod par bya'o/ /de nas/ dbang du4su khas blang ba'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pa byas la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal ba/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /ces lan gsum dang / deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / / cha yi kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zheyobajod/ de nasadabang rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad du moyopa la maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa dbul lo/ /gnyisapa ni/ de ltar bdag 'jug zin nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i skabasayin na/ bden pa'i stobs brjod nas byin gyilobarlab par bya dgos pasardor dril bzung ste/ bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa de yis mgon po khyod/ /'dod pa bdag la yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing bajod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung / / de nyid de bzhin nyid nges 'byung / / bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces lan gsum brjod nasaslob ma la dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /gnyisapa slob ma bcug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ gong du bkod pa de rnams bdag 'jug gi dbang du byasapa yin pasagazhan la dbang bskur ba'i tshe rang nyid ces padang rang la zhes sogs rnams slob ma rnams zhes pa lta bur bsgyur zhing / tshig4bcadadang sngags rnams kyi don dang / dbang gi ngo bo ji lta bu zhig rgyud la skye tshul sogasaslob ma'i dbang po dang 'tshams par brda legs par sprad nas/ med mi rung ba'i dbang gi skor rnamasam chad cing mtha' rten sogasal long skabasadang mos pa dang bstun pa'i rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba shesapar byas nas brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag len mthong ba brgyud pasakyang brgyan te legs par dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de yang chas 300

༄/ / mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gabo laga'ajugagi rjes su slopam la rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam rgya 'chings su bcug nas/ oṃ badz+ra usnye wa ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi rjes bzlos byed dgos la/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i 'jug tu bla masardo rje'i rigs kyi dam rgya bcings nayoslob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ke ka ni/ tshar gsuzu gsung / de nasakhyed rang rnams kyis mig dar cung zad bsal nas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la har gyis ltos la/ kha dog ci lta bu snang ba spros shig / ces smras nas bltar bcug la/ khyod kyi mig la ji ltar snang zhes dris/ slob mas dkar po snang na dkar po snang zhes lan 'debs/ des ser po sogs kyang mtshon/ de ltar bltas bas dngos grub kyi ltas dkar po zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang / sngon po dang nag pos mngon spyod/ ljang ku'am/ sna tshogs sam/ khra bo mthong bas las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / zhes brda sprad 'di la bu ston gyi mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil mchog las/ nam mkha' dkar pos mchogaser pos nor/ dmar pos rdzas su dga' ba/ nag poyomangon spyod/ sna tshogs pa mthong na dngos grub thams cad kyi ye shes la bslab bo/ / zhes brda sprod par gsung /de nas/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas gtso bo la mngon du phyogs par byas tedor dril bzung bas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / zhes sogs lan gsum brjod dgos/ chu dang cod paṇa gyi dbang gi 'jug tu dbang lha bstim pa'i rjes su/ de ltar khyed rang rnams mchod pa'i yul du gyur ba la/ mchod pa 'bul ba bdag gir mdzad par zhu/ zhes brda sprad cing / mchod g.yog pas mchod pa btegs te/ tha mas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya sogs kyi mchod la/ de nas dga' brjod/ cod paṇa gyi dbang gi 'jug tu bkru bya bayobasrung gsum byed dgos shing / sngags dbang payobazlas lung ma byas kyang chad skyon med mod/ 'on kyang sngags bzlab sogs la bzlayolung thob na legayopas/ desan bzlas lung zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ / bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi 301

༄/ /gung cabastanapa'i sa khrung 4mamatharasngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba de las rang 'dra gnyis pa mar me gcig lasaganyis chad kye tshul du byung ba slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs gar zla gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ke ka ni/ zhes sogs lan gsum/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyi4rlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mo4pa mdzod/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog 'jog pa'am 'thor ba dang bcas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / sngags kyi dngos grub stsal ba dang / / brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ / zhesabarjod/ mtha' la/ bkru byabasabasrung gsum byed pa la/ spro na lha la khrus gsol/ de nayoslob ma ha cang mang na gtso bo la dngos su rang gzhan rnam4la me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba la byas kyang chog pas skabs shes par byas la mchod g.yog gis ka dor lta bu bzed/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum ba'i chu las las bum du cung zad blugayopa lag chu thogasate 'di skad ces/ khyed rnams la bum pa'i chus khrus byas pas las ngan sdig sgrib dang de'i dbang gis byung ba'i nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bkrus te sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i/ / zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus/ / slob ma rnams la khrus bgyes pas/ / sdig sgrib ma lus dag gyur cig / na mo rat+na tra ya ya'i mjug tu/ rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shārnyi rku ru swāhā/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan zhes sogs dang / oṃ mgo la thi dzad+ma dza swāhā/ rdo rje'i slob ma zhes sogs sbyar/ de bzhin du/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyes sogs da nga/ oṃ mgo la pad+ma swāhā/'di ni sbyin pa'i/ tsha tram̐ ga 'di ni tshul khrims/ shaṃ kha/ 'di ni bzod pa'i/tsa kra/ 'di ni brtson 'grus/ dha dza/ 'di ni bsam gtan/ ka la sha/ 'di 302

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'i cho gca lag ni shes rab/ nya tsha swāhā/ rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shā rnyo ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa rnams re re'i mthar bum chu blugs pas khrusabya/ 'thur du 'jugade nas/ gtso 'khor gyi sngags thams cad spel ba'am/ ke ka ni gcig bu'i mthar/sarba pā baṃ bh+ya shāsto ku ru swāhā/ debazhin du/ sarba bi sdi na bh+ya0 sarba ro gang sarba du khye nam sarba gra nyi mo sarba dz+wa reng sarba byā dhi ma sarba u ba tra bem sarba a kā la mṛ t+ya yum sarba dur su ba nim sarba dur mi ti/ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+ya zhes pa rnams la/ shrī rnyi ku ru swāhā/ btagasa'akhrus bya zhing / spel tshig rnams byabs khrus kyi cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba ba'in/ bod skad du brjod kyang chog bsde /de nas byabs pa ni/ khar chu cung zad re 'dzin du bcug la/ nged kyi lag na thogs pa'i rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ de'i 'od zer gyis bkrus pas ma dag pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon phra zhing phra ba thams cad kyang rdo khab len gyis lcags phye len pa bzhin blangs te khar bzung ba'i chu la bstems pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ bla mas lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas rma bya'i sgro chun gyis byabs pa'i tshul dang bcasasngags dang spel tshig gi mthar shirnyi ku ru'i tshab tu a ba na ye swā hā/ zhes btags/ mjug tu kha nang gi chu snod du don/ de nas/sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / zhes pa nas/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad khrus chu 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang gi gnas su songs shig / gal te mi 'gron khro bo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas bsreg cingarnam par 'joms pa gdon mi za'o/ / las sngags dang sum bha ni drag tu 303

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'itshonas gsung 'bum/brjod/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra bya zhing khrusachu rgyang ring du dor ro/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ / chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ / dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ / dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ / lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ / nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ / me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ / chu ni me las rgyal ba ste/ / rlung ni sprin las rgyal bar gyur/ / rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug / lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ / sa yang bden par gnas pa las/ / sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ / bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags/ / bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis slob ma rnams bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya/ sirnyi sidhi/ phal phal ho zhes brjod par bya'o/ /denas bsrung ba ni/ slob ma'i gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram re re bzhag pas/ rdo rje de las de 'dra bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros lus la rdo rje'i go bkon te/ phyin chad gnod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs par byas pa'i mos pa gyis/zhes brjod la/ gnas de rnams su bla mas rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du bsnol mar gtug cing / sngags kyi rjesasu che ge mo sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las zhesasogs gong dang 'dra ba la/ shīrnyi ku ru'i dod du rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes pa bcug gnas bdun ni/ spyi bo/ snying / sog brag dpung ba g.yasagayon/ bus mo g.yas g.yon rnams so/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa yi thugs rje yis/ / 'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrung zin gye/ / 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig / ces bsrung ba bya'o/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba ni/ cho ga'i chad lhag gi nyesapa zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang / lha tshim par bya ba'i phyir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dngos su bya ba'am/ ma grub na bsam gtan gyi sbyin sreg bya/ gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ tshigs bcad sngagasadang bcayopa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 304

༄/ / mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'i cho gaja laga.ar+bhe sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyayobasdus gang rung gis bstod/ gzhan la dbang bskurab yin na/ slob ma rnams la nus pa dang bstun pa'i dkyel 'khor mchod du bcug la/ bza' ba la sogs pas tshim par bya/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / dbang bskur tshul bzhin du byas pa sogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i smon lam dang / bsngo ba shugs drag po bya zhing / phyag bzhes kyi rgyun la gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i mjug tu dpon slob lhan cig tu smon lam dang bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i bden tshig shis brjod bcas mdzad pa'i srol yod/ de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba'am/ de ltar mos nas shar sgo nas gtso bo la phyogs par 'dug ste chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir yi ge brgya ba lan gsum brjod/ me tog dang bcasapa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / nyes byas cung zad gtso bos bzod mdzad rig / ces pas chad pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa thi bar bya ba'i phyir bzod gsol bya zhing / rang gzhan gyi chosasgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen tham4cad zhi zhing gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don3mas 'grub pa dang / bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgyas pa sogasakyi gsol ba btab/de nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / oṃ ā0rtu badz+ra snyu zhes brjod nas/ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par gyur bar mos/ de nas/oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṭ+wāṃ a du nu da ba na na tā ta oṃ ā shā 4 zhe4'don cing chosathams cad rang bzhin med par mos nas g.yon pas dril bu dkrol/g.yas pasathog mar lha tshon rnams mtha' nas rim bzhin bsdus/ de nas g.yasapa'i rdo rjes shar sgo nas brtsamasate tshang4thig gi lam nas gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar du dbyi zhing / rang gi mgo bor rdul tshon cung zad tsam blug nas pad+ma la sogs pa rnamasadabyi/denasasgo rnams dang zur rnamasardo rje'i rtse mo4gzhig par bya'o/ / de nas rdor dril 305

༄khya/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgronasa'i gsung 'bum/bzung ba'i lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyisakyi mdzub mo lcagasakyu bzhin byasate/ phan tshun 'khyud pa skam pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra kyi la ud gī la ya sarba kyi la na badz+ra dha ra ā dzā ba ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ho zhes bzlasate phur bu rnamasadabyung ngo / / oṃ ru ru sbu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sidha lo tsa ne sarba aze sā dha ni swāhā/ zhesa'o ma la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlagate/ phur bu rnam4bkrus pasabagegalornamasayos te sangasargyalopar bsam zhing phur bu'i khung bu dag pa/ bsam gtan gyi phur bu btab na 'byung pa dang dgang ba mos pa4bya la sngar phur bu la yoshesapa bstem pa yin na/ yoshesapa rang bzhin gyis gnas su gshegs par gyur bar bsam mo/ nad zhi ba la sog4pa'i don du slong ba la cung zad re byin nas rdul tshon byingasarnamayornam rgyal la sogs pa'i bum pa gos kyis brgyan par blug rol mo'i sgra dang / gdugasadang rgyal mtshan dang mchod pa rnams dang ldan pas khyer nas 'bab chu la sogs pa'i 'gram du klu'i dkyil 'khor bya tshul sogs sngagayorim chen mo lasa'abyung ba bzhin byas nas klu rnamasal byin gyis brlabasapa'i rdul tshon rnams gtad/ klu rnams kyis kyang bkur ste chen po4sa 'og tu khyer bar mos/ rdul tshon khyer ba'i bum pa de chus bkang nas snga ma bzhin du khyer te chu des zhi ba'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi khang ba la sogayopar gtor te shisapar bya/ de ltar sngar bshad pa'i cho ga la sog4pa dang / mjug chog gi rim pa 'di dag rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i dbang du bya4pa yin la/ rasabris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur na/ mjug chog gi skabs/ bzod gsol dang / 'dod don la gsol ba btab ba'i mjug tu/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ / 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / / mchog rnams legs par stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ su pra ti ṣ+ṭha
