badz+ra ye sāhā/ zhes brjod nas yoshes pa ras bris la brtag bzhugs bya/ rdul tshon bsdu ba dang / spyan 'dren gyi skor ma gtogs/ phur bu dbyung pa sogs kyang snga ma bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa khrusadabang gi sgo nasagashin po sogasarje su'adzin tshul ni/ bdag bskyed bum bskyed mdun bskyed rnams sngon du gtong dgosal bdag 'jug gam slob 306

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'icho gca lagama'i dbang dang 'brel na/ bum pa rgyasapar bsgrubs shing / de ltar min tshe/ bum pa bsang srung / stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bram pa dkar po zhes pa nas/ gago dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du zlaba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar bzlas byas sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i bskor pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs nus mthu ma lus pa 'odazer gyi rnam par spyan drangs hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/delas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa'i bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur bar bsam la/ ki ka ni/ brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig bzlas/ zla ba hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer mi byed par gyur/ zhes khrus bum tsam gyiyomachog go / de nas gshin po'i ming byang mdun du bzhag las bum gyi chu dang las sngags/ oṃ badz+ra a spita kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ces pas bsang / mashun+ya tā dz+nya na zhes sogs kyis sbyang / rten snang ba mi dmigs pa'i stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshe 'das kyi ming yig dang po thigales brgyan pa yongs su gyur ba las/ tshe las 'das pa tha mal ba'i cha byad can/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang /dge 'dun gye bden pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad dang / khyad par du bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi bden pa dang /bden pa chen po'i byin brlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa srid pa bar do/ khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas 307

ro / /gung thangabastan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/bzhis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gang na gnas kyang / skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig / rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba a thung gi gzugs su bkug ste/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs snying gar thim par bsam/ de nas rdo rje bsdam pa lasagung mo gnyis sbyar nas brtan par sbreng ba rnams snang gi'am/ semayom rdo rje ma'i dam rgya bcings nas/ oṃ badz+ra sarba bi shodha ni shornya ni sarba pā baṃ a na ya:/ tshe 'das kyi thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad bkug par bsam/ oṃ akhro bhā sarba a ba ya bi shodha ne+e hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ sdig pa thamayocad sbyangs par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las mdzub mo gnyisamadud nas legs par gyen du 'phang4pa ltung ba slong ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ sarba a pā ya/ ā gar+sha ṇa bi shodha ni badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ngan 'gro ba thams cad kyang bkug par bsam/ de nas rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis bsgrengs te kha sbyar/ mje bo du mthe'u chung sbyar ba drag tu dral ba'i tshul dang / oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi bi dīṭ+wāṃ dhi ༵ di ༵ pā ba ༵ ba/ ༵ hūṃ ngh+ru ṭ+wāṃ d+dhi ༵ dhī~X lda ༵༵༷ ṭ+wāṃ t+t+waṃ bco~X dīX hūm̐sadī de nas badz+ra badhā tra ṭa cesab dang / rdo rje bsdams pa lan gsum dral bas lu4ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom par bsam/ de nasathal mo mnyam par sbyar ba dpral bar bzhag la/ tshe 'das kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ thal mo kha phye ste pad+ma'i rnam par byasapa mgrin par bzhag la/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ rdo rje thal mo las gung mo rtse mo sbyar ba snying gar bzhag ste/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po'i mtshan par gyur/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyi4bcings nas gung mo dang mthe bong dang / mthe'u chung gyen dubasgrengs nas kha sbyar te mdzub mo dang ming med sems dpa'i skyil krung du byasal/snying ga dang mgrin pa dang kha dang dbral ba dang mdzod sru dang sman mtsham4dang sna dang rnab dang / dku dang bus mo dang / rkang ba dag dang byin pa dang mig gnyisadang /gsang bar reg la/ oṃ mkhro bh+ya badz+ra atrī ṣ+ṭa dz+nya na sa ma ya hūṃ zhes pas/ gnas de 308

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa dgu'i chogaca lagarnams su zla ba rdo rje bsam la byin gyisabarlabs so/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i dam rgya bcing ba man chad 'di'i lho sgo'i chog dpe nas pa dang / ngor ba dkon mchog lhun grub/kun dag 'grol mchog lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa sogasakyisamadzad par mi 'dug kyang / bu ston dang / zha lu ba ye shes rgya mtsho sogs mkhas pa du ma'i gsungs las 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin pas/ rang gi chos pa dang bstun na chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bar mngon/ de nayobagegs sbyangs pa ni/ khro bo spyan drangs nayomachod bstod kyi bar bya ste/ gtor ma bshamayonas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba bisne na na ma sarba ta thā ga spyo/ zhes sogs gsum gyis bgegs la bsngo ba ni/ / zhi ba4skyang ba/ ting lo'i mar me dang chang bu sprags nas rten la phyir bskor zhing / oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūṃ/gri sna gri t+na hūṃ/ gri t+na ba ya/ gri t+na ba ya hūṃ/ a na ya ho bha ga wa na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing ting lo dang chang bu gsum gyis bskor ba ni/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o/ / de nayosngar bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / zhes pa nas/bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che go mo zhes bya ba gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing / tshe 'phos nas gang du gnas pa'i lus srog dang mtho ris dang thar ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad dang / tshe las 'das pa'i cha byad bzung nas de'i nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa rnams la bslu zhing gnod par byed pa'i gnod sbyin dang sha za dang /'byungapo la sogs pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spong la/ phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su songs shig gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje me 'bar ba rnams kyis sreg cing rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za'o/ / zhes brjod cing sum bha ni'i sngagayobazla/ gu gul gyis bdug yung4shar gyis byabs sogasabya'o/ / de nas me bsangs sbyang4nas/ re las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du/ khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig 309

༄/ /yo cabamapa'i 0 yo ga ༅ma/phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing / zhal gdangs par bskyed pa/ tshe 'das kyi rkang mthil gnyis su rlung gi dkyil 'khor lte bar ye shes kyi me 'bar ba snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon baṃ nag po la lus ngag yid gsum gye sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus par bsam la/ lte ba'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyes snying ga'i baṃ nged nas sna sgo nas thon sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas/rang gi lag pa'i til la thim par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra ṭa ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/sarba pā baṃ dā ha na bha smi ku ru swāhā/ zhes khro bo'i zhal du 'bul/ de nasaphye ma'am yungasadakar la/ ke ka ni sogs kyi gzungs yang du bzlas la/ oṃ sarba pā baṃ zhes sogs brab sngagayobaco lnga brjod de phung bo'am ming byang sogs la brab/ de nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ zhes sogs dang bcas pa'i khrus gsol ba'i chu bum par blug ste/ ming byang sogs me long bshar pa la khrusabya ba ni/ 'di ni sbyin pa'imakhrus bgye'o/ / na mo rat+na tā yā ya/ zhes sogs brjod pa'i rjeyosu/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang / khyad par du nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod/ sbyin pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/bzod pa/ brtson 'grus bsam gtan/ shes rab/ ces dang / ser sna/zhes pa'i gnas sa/ tshul 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng / shes 'chal/rnamayobacug nas sngar ba'in bkrus/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ / bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ / gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing / / khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / na mo rat+na t+na yāya/ zhes sogs dang /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ / dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa/ / rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/ / khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ / na mo rat+na 310

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'itsho gca lagatā yu pa/ zhes sogs dang / dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis/ / yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ / sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ / dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ / na mo rat+na tā yā ya/ zhegasogs kyi mthar/ 'jig rten 'di nas zhes pa dang / khyad par pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas nyon mongs pa dang dug bsal ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ / bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ / sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ / na mo rat+na tā yā ya/ zhes sogs dang / khyad par nyon mongs pa dang de'i dbang gis byung ba'i dug thams cad byang zhing dag nas myur du zhes sogs brjod/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas zhes pa'i gnas su/ bcom ldan dam chos/ zhesapa dang / dam chos/ zhes dang / na mo rat+na tā yu ya/ zhes dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun/ zhesadang /dge 'dun/ zhes dang / na mo rat+na tā yā ya/ zhes pa spel tshig dang bcasapa sbyor/sa ni dug gi ma yin te/ / sa ni dug gi pha yang yin/ / bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ / che ge'i dug ni dug med shog / dug ni sa yi nang du song / / gang ba'i snod du dug song shig / na mo rat+na tā ya ya/ zhes dang /che ge zhes bya ba'i 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las gyur ba'i dug thams cad shirnyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes dang / de bzhin du sa'i gnas su/ chu me rlung / rnams dang /gang ba'i gnas su/ gsher ba'i/ tsha ba'i/ g.yo ba'i/ zhes pa dang / gong gi sngagasaspel tshig dang bcas pa bya'o/ / de nas mi shis pa spyong ba ni/ gang la ser sna rnams chags pa/ / zhes pa dang / khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig / ceyodril bu bsil zhing me tog gtor la/ che ge mo zhes bya ba bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis par gyur cig cesabarjod/ de nas 311

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/bul sogs pa'i nye bas ming byang bzung nasaphyag byed pa'am med kyang rung ste/ tshe 'das 'di nyid bsam pa dag pasadakon/ mchog gsum 'dus rdo rje mi 'khrug4pa'i lha tshogs dang nye ba'i sra4brgyad la skyabs su 'gro zheng / phyag byed par bsam la/gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jigs pa myur du bsal tu gsol/ /zhes brjod par bsam/ de rnams ni sbyang ba'i rim pa'o/ / de nas dbangabaskur pa bo rnams 'disadabang thob cing bsnyen pa song yod na/ slob ma rje 'dzin gyi skor rnams phyag len bzhin bya rgyu byung na shin tu phan yon che ste/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rdul tshon dkyil 'khor briganas ni/ gshin la gson bzhin dbang bskur na/ /ngan song gsum du skyes na yang / /de nyid kyis ni thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungasashing / du4'khor rtsa rgyud la4kyang de ji ltabu bzhin gsungasal/ skyod rgyud las ming byang gnyen bshesatshun chad gzhir byas te/ dbang bskur tshul phan yon dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs so/ /de'i 'don tshul ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag nas mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ 'di 'dra'i tshe/ slob ma4brjod par mosadagosapas/ bdag ces pa tshig bsgyur mi dgos/ dkon mchog gsum lasogs gsum/ byang chub snying por sogs gsum/ oṃ tsa gru kho ā ka bī ra hūṃ/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba'i nga su ra tam su khaṃ/ yā bi ra hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa ༅ slob ma skad cig gis nas slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ yig la gnyis su med par thim/ bla ma dang nas slob ma'i snying gar thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlab par gyur/ gzung ring mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ dam rgya bcing la/ ke ka ni/ tshar gsum slob ma 'bru gsum gyisang sangs rgyas dngos grub nas oṃ pra ti ma prang rdo rje sems dpa' nas pā sh+ya/ de yang nas mthong bar gyur/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje ma tshar gsum/dkyil 'khor gyi sharas bum chu bsang sbyang byin rlab dbang lha spyan 'dren/ shisabarjod dbang dngos rnams gzhung bzhin la/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i zhes dang / slob ma'i steng phyogs zhes dang / slob ma'i lus la thim par gyur/312

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'ichog cha lagazhes tshig bsgyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sogs kyes mchod/ de ltar chu'i dbang zhes sogasadag pa brjod mi dgos/ cod paṇa la yang dag pa brjod pa dor te gzhan rnamasasnga bzhin bya/ mtha' rten gzhan rnamasabazhag la/ rgyal srid sna bdun bsang sbyangabyin gyis rlab ste/ lha rdzas las byas sogs dang rdzasabargyad byin gyis rlab ste/gang zhig reg cing nas khye ñtsa mi/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nasatshe 'dayode nyidapad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa las lhar bskyed/ chu gnyisanyer spyod rol mo sogs sngag4phyag rgya dang bcas par mchod/ zasagatad bya dgoyobyung na/ bza' btung rnamasabasangayosbyangs bskyed la/ kha zas ro brgya sogs su sprul la 'dod yon lnga rnams/ tshigs bcad dang bca4pa'am sngags tsam gyis tshe 'das lhar bskyed pa la 'bul bar byed/ tshe 'das lhar mi bskyed na bza' btung gsur rnams byin gyis rlabs la/ tshe 'das kyis gtso byas pa'i bar do'i semasacan thams cad la byin payotshim par bsam mo/ / de nas bar do'i chos bshad kyang gang 'tshams byas pa'i rjes su/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ / dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ / dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa/ / tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam mthong pa'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ / bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ / byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ / rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ / brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas/ / 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog / oṃ rasne rasne/ mahā rasne/ rat+na saṃ bha we/ / rat+na ki ra ṇi/ rat+na mā lā bi shudhe shodha ya sarba pā baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas lam bstan la/ de nas/ 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na/ / mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams yod/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa/ / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las sgrol/ / 'ing gi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ / su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin cing / / dmigs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed na/ / zhing mchog de ru skye bar gsungs/ / tshe 'das 313

sa / /gung thang bstanaba'izla ce' gsung 'bum/rigs kyi bu khyod kyang / / mi 'khrugs pa yi mtshan bzung zhing / / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed kyis/ / zhing mchog de ru skye ba yin/ / zhing mchog de ru skyes nas kyang / / sems can don kun byed par shog / pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ / srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ / srid pa'i pad+ma las byung ba/ / mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog oṃ padro pad+ma pad+ma saṃ bha wa mahā abhi na n+ta gats+tsha nu swāhā/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes dang / lha ye shes pa dbyer med du bsres pa spyi gtsug nas thon te/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du pad+ma sogs la brten nas rdzus te skyes pa na/ de na gnas pa'i byang sems sogs kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bra lba ra sa da ka re a bra ti ts+tsha swāhā/ zhe4sogs kyi chu gnyis/nyeraspyod rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ mngon dga'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa 'khor bcas kyi zhal mthong / de rnams la yan lag bdun pa phul bas gdams pa dang rjes su gnang ba thob/ de na gnas pa'i 'khor 'ga' zhig gis/ bdag gis cho ga byas pa'i mthur shes nas/ bdag gi gam du 'ongs te/ sngar ltar mchod cing / sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ / chos dang 'dra ba'i dge ba med/ / dge 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med de/ / sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ / ce4ched du brjod par bsam/ des kyang der skyes pa'i rgyu brtags pas/ bdag gi cho ga byas pa'i nus mthur shes nas/skad cig gis 'ongs nas/ e ma shākya mgon po yi/ / sangs rgyas mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ / gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi/ / sems can glog bzhin myur du grol/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos ni bsam mi khyab/ / sngags kyi yon tan sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ / byang chub brten pa rnams kyang bsam mi khyab/ / tshangs spyod tshul khrims dri med skye bsam yas/ / e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ / sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che/ / gang phyir mtshams med lhung ba yi/ / sems can lha gnas myur du skyes/ / zhesached du brjod nas/314

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'ichogaca lagabadag dang ltal gong bzhin mchod nas/ slar yang mngon dga'i zhing du song bar gyur/ zhesabarjod de/ de ltar du bsam/ oṃ sarba budha ge tra gats+tsha rdu swāhā/ zhesabarjod cing me tog gtor ro/ / de nasadesakyang mngon dga'i zhing nasabalta4pagamathong bar bsam/ rang dang lharnamasakyis tshe 'dasakyi phung po lhag ma/ ro lta bu'am sdig sgrib dang bcasapa'i byang bu ram̐ las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi mesabasreg par bsam la/gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ / gson cig tshe 'das rigasaḥ phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ / rgyal ba lnga yi me sbar ro/ / 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi me sa dbang po drug gi bud shing la/ / byang chub sems dpa'i meng yul rnams drug gi bud shing la/ / lha mo drug gi me sbar ro/ /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ / rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar ro/ / sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ / 'gro ba'i don kun 'grub par shog de nas thamasacad mi dmig4pa'i ngang du stong bar bsam la/ gzugs stong ba'o/ stong ba nyid gzugs so/ / zhes sogasakyi shesarab snying po 'don no/ mjug chog sngar dang 'dra/ de lta bu'i tshul gyi4gshin po rjesasu'adzin pa ni phan yon bsam gyisami khyab par gsung bas/ rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ mi shi ba'i ro yi sngasamago la/ nor len 'dod kyi ban bon ca co 'don/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang dgon pa'i ri chosasugasungasapa ltar/ rnyed bkur la sred pa tsam ma yin par lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nasabaslang ste/ dam pa'i phyag len bzhin ma nyam4par byasanas/ rang gzhan gnyiyoka'i don sgrub tshul gnad du 'gro ngesapa la 'bad par rigasaso/ /bzhi ba sbyinasreg gi cho ga 'phros dang bca4pa ni/ spyir thab brtsig brko bri gsum gang byas kyang rung la/ phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir bri thab kyi dbang du byasan stegasabu sor bzhi pa ngos mnyam pa la dkar rtsi byugs shing dzig gdab tshul ni/ nub nas shar du rgyu ba yi/ /tshangs dang tshangs chen spyi bzhin gdab/ / dbus nasasor mo bcuganyisapar/ /thum po thab kyi nang thig yin/ / de yephyi rol sor bzhi dang / /sor mo bzhi yi blum gnyis bskor/ / nang ma thab kyi mur na dang / / phyi ma kha khyer rdo 315

༄/ /gung ca bstan ཿrtsa sa' ga 'thugarje'i gnas/ /kha khyer 'tsham4nasaphyi rol tu/ /sor gnyis dor bar phyogs bzhi ru/ /thig chen steng du mtshan ma btab/ /thig chen steng nasadabus gleb pa'i/ /stegasabu'i zur du bya rjes btsal/ /bya rje4steng nasazur thig dang / /stegs bu'i thig 'debasaman ngag lugs/ /pad+ma zla phyed 'phrul gyi thig /mthong ba brgyud las shes par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar byas la/ thab kyi dbusasu pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dze+ebar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ba/ sor brgyad pa dang / kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ grwa bzhir zla byed rdo rje rnamasabri/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig char/ 'dab ma brgyad la ltaso so'i mtshan ma bri bar yang bshad/ de nas/ thab kyi g.yas su me lha'i mchod pa dang gtor ma/ de'i nang du 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/deganyis kyi phyi rol tu yam shing sogs sreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i rim pa bzhin du bkod/ de'i mthar gogazung dang so rtsi gnyis bshams/ g.yon phyogs su chu bzhi'i snod gsum dang / de'i mdun du malji'i khar bzed zhal gsum/ las bum rdor dril lam ting shag rnams bshams/ mdun du mar khu dgang blug4rlung g.yab ku sha rnams bzhag /rang nyid khrus byas gos gtsang ma bgoyote/ stan bde ba la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod de sgrub thabs ltar/ bdag bskyed rdzog4par bsgom/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad bkug nas chu la thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tar brgya rtsa bzlas te bsang chu bsgrub/ ke ka ni'i mjug tu oṃ lan bdun gyis chu bzhi bsgrub/ a sri ta dang bsang chus rang dang thab dang rdzasarnamasagaya4skor du lan gsum bsang / mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyang byin gyi4brlab pa sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas rdzas spyong ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ oṃ sāhā/ oṃ ya sāhā/ oṃ oṃ shrī suhā/ oṃ dzi swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ rdzas rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyang zhing dag nas lha rdzas kyi yo byad phun sum tshogs par gyur/ de nasa'o ma can gyi shing sogs kyi me la lasasngagasalan gsum brjod pasabasang chu gtor te bsrung / oṃ a ze ni dz+wa la dz+wa la de 316

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa lhadagu'ichogaca lagabamu khe swāhā/ zhes pas me sbar/ las sngags kyis lan gsum bsang / rlan med pa'i rtswa'i chun po dang bcas thab kyi nang du 'jug / oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ dang / hūṃ lan bdun brjod rlung g.yab kyisame sbar/ ke ka ni lan bdun dang / mar khus me gso/ ku sha lag tu bzung la/ mabadz+ra satwa 〉 zhes pa lan bdun dang / oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge / tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed yin/ / dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ / sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying / /bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ / zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ / lasathamasacad pa bzla zhing thab kyi mthar ku sha bkram pa dang nang du yang ku sha g.yog bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ /zhesabarjod/ de nasame dang bca4pa'i thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las ye shes kyi thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs blum pa mu ran kha byer dang bcas pa kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ thab kyi nang du oṃ aze ni dz+wa la dz+wa de ba mu kheswāhā/ zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las/ me gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus su re las bgrang phreng de yongs su gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dkar po shin tu zhi ba'i cha lugs can ral pa dkar po'i thor cog dang sma ra dkar po'i ag tshom can/ phyag g.yas na bgrang phreng dang g.yon ril ba 'dzin pa/ gos dkar po dang srad bu dkar bo'i se ral kha byas pa/ pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs la/ thugs gar me gru gsum pa ram̐ gyes mtshan par gyur/ 'di lan bza' dang de mo'i yig char/ me lhaphyagabazhi ba g.yas rtse gsum dang dgang gzar/ g.yon dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin par bshad/ lha 'dren pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ / me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog dgang blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ / 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ / thab kyi me 317

༄/ /yo cabalob po tsha laga'atshams kyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugasapar bsam/ lasasngags kyi4phyi 'brang gi bgegayobaskrad/ mchod yon 'bul/ oṃ asde ye dz+wa lā ya dz+wa la ya ma rtu baṃ hodam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ā hrī bya wā ra sa da ka re brok+ṣa ṇi bra rta ts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ a ñtsa ma ṇi/ arnya/ 2hūṃ/ rnamasakyisachu bzhi 'bul/ oṃ asde ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe sogasakyisanyer spyod rol mo dang bcasapasamachod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gye sras/ / me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ / shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ / 'dzin byed me lha nyid la mngon par 'dud/ / ces pas bstod/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can la ri yig dang dgang blugs kyi kha la hūṃ yig dkar pos mtshan par bsam/ yo asde ye a di byā a di byā a be+e sha a be+e sha mahā thi ye ha byā ka byā ba hā nā ye/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcasapa rnams kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdeg sgrib nyes ltung bag chags nad gdon bar chad bkra mi shis pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ zhe4pa lan bdun gyes mar khu 'bul zhing 'phrin las bcol bas zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam la/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ya/ zhesapasayam shing dang / oṃ asde zhes pas mar khu dang / oṃ sarba ba baṃ da ha na badz+ra ye/ zhes pasatil dang / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe zhes pasadur ba dang / oṃ badz+ra buṣā ye zhes pasa'abras dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pā te zhes pasazho zan dang / oṃ apra ti ha da badz+ra ye zhes pa4ku sha dang / oṃ sarba aze sernya mazhe4pas yungs gar dang / oṃ badz+ra bī dza ye zhesapa4sob dang / oṃ mahā be ga ye zhesapasanas dang / oṃ ma hā pā la ye zhesapas sran ma dang / oṃ badz+ra gha sma ri zhes pas gro dang / rdzasakhyad par ba ni me lha'i sngagasakyisa'abul/ de thamasacad la spel tshig sngar gyi de nyid btagasapas chog cing / so so'i spel tshig spyor bar 'dod na/yam shing la/ bkra shis pa thams cad dang / zhesapa'i mjug tu/ gzi bajid 318

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'ichogaca lagaphun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du/mar khu la/ 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la ma til la/ sdig pa thams cad mdurab la/ tshe mthar phyin pa la za 'brasal/ bsod nams rgyas pa la ma zho zan la/ bde ba mchog la sa ku sha la/ bsrung ba mchog la bar du gcod pa dang grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad mo yungasakar la/ bgegs thams cad mo sob la/ nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la ma nas la/ myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa lam sran ma la/ stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi kuru swāhā/ grol/ nad thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bcug la sbyor/rdzasakhyad par ba la/ ma hā shrī ya a ma so ta/ zheyopa sbyor bar yang gsungs shing /spel tshig spyi 'gro ltar ram/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la/ zhesasogs sbyor/ yam shing mar til yung4kar bzhi ma gtogs rdzasagazhan rnams med na gang med pa'i rdzas de dag gi sngagasa'adon mi dgos so/ /rgyud sde la mkhas pa'i dam pa 'ga' zhig gi gsung las/ bya rgyud kyi skabs me ltadang 'ad4lha gnyis ka la rang sngags dang spel tshig sbyar bsachog rdzas sngags so sob 'dogs mi dgosapa spyi rgyud kyi dgongasapa yin par gsung snang ngo / de nas/ a ñtsa ma r+ṇa dang / pro k+ṣa ḍi phul la/oṃ asde ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes bajod pas me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur bar bsam/ de mo'i yig char me lha'i thugs gar 'dasalha bskyed pa sogasayongs grags ltaragasung kyang / 'dir lcang skya thamasacad mkhyen pa'i gsung nyid rgya gzhung rnamasadang bstun par snang ba'i rang sor bzhag go /'ad4ltamachod pa ni/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzasarnamasalogasasu bshamasayod na sngar ltar byin brlab bya/ thab kyi nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gang na re re/ dbus kyi gang na la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ zhesapa nas/ cho ga gsum gyis gtso 'khor dgu bskyed yeshes pa bstem pa dbang bskur rgyasagadab rnams bum chog ltar bya/ lha rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 319

༄/ /gung ca b.lopa'i sa gatshi 'am/'phro bar bsam/ spro na/ dag cing dri med/ sogasatshogasabacad dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ oṃ ā hrī sogasakyisachu bzhi sngar bshad pa ltar dang sgrub thabs nasa'abyung ba ltar gyi nyer spyod lnga rol mo sogasakyisamachod bstod rgyasabasdus gang rung gis bstod/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la hūṃ yig gis mtshan par bsam la/ kekani/ spel tshig btags pas mar khu dgang blugs bdun phul te 'phrin las mdzad par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyi4bzhes par bsam/ de nasayam shing nas rdzas khyad par ba'i bar gtso bo la/ ke ka ni'i mthar rdzas sngags dang spel tshig btags pa dang 'khor rnams la rang rang gi sngagasal spel tshig btabasapas phul zhing / yam shing mar khu gnyisagatso bo dang sdig pa sbyangs pa la til dang yungs gar gnyis mang du 'bul bar jo bo rje'i gsung las 'byung / grangs brgya stong khri 'bum sogs skabs dang sbyar/ de nas/ lha rnams kyis thugs ka nas lha mo bum pa dkar po bdud rtsi dkar pos bkang ba thogs nas bsgrub bya zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa la dbang bskur bas las ngan sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad dag nas lus shel ltar dwangs par gyur bar bsam/slar yang rtsa sngags kyis mar khu blugasal zar bdun phul/ gtor ma gzhung bzhin phul/mchod yon zhal bsil bsang gtor rnams phul/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra lbas sru swāhā/ zhes pas gos zung dang / oṃ badz+ra te bu la ye swāhā/ zhes so rtsi 'bul/chos dbyings rang bzhin sogayokyis bstod/ oṃ ā hrī sogasakyiyomachod yon phul/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag ste tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ yig brgyabazla/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ zhe4sogs kyis nongasapa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sru ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gye gnas su gshegs/320

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'ichog cha lagadam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ cesabarjod/ slar yang / asde ye dz+wa la ram̐/ thab kyi dbus su me lha skad cig gis gsal bar bsam la/ sngar gyi me lha'i skabs bzhin nyer spyod rol mosamachod/ bsang gtor/ zhal bsil/ so rtsi/gos zung rnamasa'abul rdzas lhag ma rnams sngar gye me lha'i skabs ltar rim pa ba'in phul/'jig rten dbang phyug zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gisabastod/ zhal bselabasang gtoradang nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ a ka ro lan gsum gyiyogator ma byin gyiyobarlab me lha'i sngagasal a ka ro btags pa lan gsum gyis ba la/nyeraspyod rol moyomachod/ me ste bsregs bya za ba'i lha/ / zhes sogasasho lo ka gcig dang / mchog sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / cesabarjod/ mchod yon phul/ bzod gsol dang 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ oṃ asde adhi ba ti gasmo/ me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur bar bsam/ bsngo smon bkra shisabarjod cing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /'di ni sbyin sreg dkyus ma'i dbang du byasapa yin la/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i skabasayin na/ bsgrub mchod gang du byed pa'i gnas khang gi shar phyogs su bya bar gsungayoshing / me lhabaskyed tshul sogasagong dang 'dra yang / 'das lha'i skab4su/'dabs rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re/ / zhes pa'i mtshams su/ las kyi rdo rje dkyila'akhor gyi drung du song ste/ shar sgo nas phyag gsum btsal gusabs 'dud cing thal mo sbyar te/ bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag dang bcas pa sogs sems can thams cad la mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i ched du sbyin sreg 'bul bas thab kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du gshegs par zhu/ zhes brjod de lag pa g.yon sposa'adzin cing g.yas pas me tog re len pa dang lha'i sngags re brjod pas/dkyil 'khor ba'i ltasaso lasalhaganyisapa re mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du spyan drangs par bsam la/ me tog snod bzang po'i nang du bzhag ste mchod rol dang bcasapas sbyinasreg gi sarasprun drangs/ las kyi rdo rjesade ltarastan 'dren pa'i bar la/321

༄/ /yo bstanapa'i yo go tshom/rdo rje slob dpon dpon slob kyis sngar bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas ltarnamasamar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du spyan 'dren par bsam la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes pa nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs sugasol/ zhes spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad dbyangs dang bcasapa bya/ spyan 'dren 'digazhung dang rjes 'brang gi yig char mi gsal yang 'ga' zhig gi lag len la byed srol snang bas/ spro na byas par nyes skyon med cing mi spro na ma byasakyang rung mod mi byed na me tog sleb pa dang gdan skyed tshar ba dusamatshung4pa bya/ de nasalalokyi rdo rjesame togaslob dpon gyi phyag tu phul/ slob dpon gyisaltarnams rim pa bzhin/ thab kyi gzhal yasakhang du rang rang gi gdan la bzhugasasu gsol bar mosate/ me tog re thab tu 'dor ba dang lha'i sngags re brjod/ de nas/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du pad+ma can/ lhor 'od ldan ma/ nub tu mdangs ldan ma/ byang du dri med ma/ shar lhor 'jigs byed ma/ lho nub tu rnal 'byor ma/ nub byang du dkar sham ma/byang shar du yid gzhung ma/ lha rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dkar po zhes pa man chad dkyu4ltar la/ mthar bzod gsol byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra snyu zhes bajod cing /lhajams thab kye dbus su gshegs par mos te slob dpon gyiyome tog lasakyi rdo rje la gtad/ deyoslob dpon la phyag byas te me tog blangasal sbosasogs mchod rol dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du spyan drangs/ lharnams gzhalaya4khang gi nang du spyan drangs par mos la rdul tshon yin na me tog dkyil 'khor gyi dbusaphyogs su phyar ba tsam byasal mdun du bzhag cing / ras bris yin na dkyil 'khor gyi nang du gtor te dkyil 'khor la phyag bya ba sogasamathong ba brgyud pa'i lag len ma nyams pa bya'o/ /rosreg la thog mar sa brtag bslang ba dang / stegasabu'i steng du sbyin sreg gi thig dkyusaltar btab la/ de nyid rasasam shog bu sogasakyisabakang stobur khang mchod rten gyi dbyibasalta bu'am/ khyim pa pho mo la gdan khri dang bil ba'i dbyib ltabu byed tshul sogs gzhung gzhan nasa'abyung ba dang / mthong brgyud ltar bya4la/ gnasayig 322

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'icho gapho lagasogasakyang tshad ldan byung na shin tu legs/ dang po'i 'dug gnas rang nasalho sgo'i cho ga lam sbyang bstan nas slar yang mngon dga'i zhing du song bar gyur/ oṃ sarba burto khre dra gats+tsha chu swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin bya/ de nasagang du ro sreg byed pa'i sar song ste sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don phal cher yang dkyusadang 'dra ba la/ dpal 'baragyi me las sngags kyis lan gsum bsang ba'i rjesasulag tu bzung ste/ dril stabasadang bcas pas/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ / gson cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ / phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro/ / gson cigaza gson cig za 'byung ba bzhi yis lha mo bzhi yi meng gson cig za gson cigaza dbang po drug gi sa byang chub sems dpa'i mer gson cigang gson cig ma yul rnams drug gi sa lha mo drug gi me sagason cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ / gson cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ / lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ / rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar ro/ / stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes/ / tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ / ye shes snang ba 'bar gyur cig / sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ / 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /zhes pa lan gsum dang / ma sa ze ni sog4brjod cing dpala'abar thab tu gzhug / rlung g.yab kyisame sbar ba'i rjesasu/ / gzugs stong pa'i zhesapa na4mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ zhes pa'i bar 'don/ ke ka ni lan bdun brjod la mar khus me gsosogayodakyus dang 'dra/ me lhabaskyed de/ dang po'i mar khu lan bdun phul ba'i rjes su/ me lha rdo rje las kyi gtso/ / tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyangs pa dang / / lha rnams tshims par bya ba'i phyir/ / 'di nyid du ni 'phrin las mdzod/ / drang srong chen po me yi lha/ / sngon gye dam la gnas dgongs la/ / lha rnams zhal ni me yin la/ / sbyin sreg de ni me la gnas/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ me lha'i thugs ga nas 'od zer 'phros/323

༄/ /gung ca gas yosgroname'i ga ཿma/tshe las 'das pa mngon dga'i zhing na gnas pa la phog pas/ des rang gi sgrib pa spyong bar shes nas dad pa'i shugs kyis skad cig nyid la 'ong ste mdun du 'khod pa dang / slar yang thugs ga'i 'od zer gyes de'i sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad drangs te ro dang bsreg rdzas rnams la gnyis su med par bstim zhing de nyid ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin kyi mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur/zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nasayam shing sogasal/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dang khyad par gang du gnas pa'i lus srog dang mtho ris dang thar pa dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru swāhā/zhesaso sor sbyar yang rung bar bshad la/ 'on kyang rdza4thamayocad la khyad med du/'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sgo gsum gyi nyes stung sdeg sgrib sogs mtho ris dang thar ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad sharto ku ru ye swāhā/zhes sbyar na 'jug pa bde zhing skabs dang 'brel lo/ /'das lha'i skab4su yang yam shingagi sngon mar khu lan bdun phul ba'i rjes su/ de mo'i yig char 'byung ba bzhin/nam mkha'i mdangs ldan kun nas gsal ba'i sku/ / mtshan dpes rab mdzes rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ / rdo rje dang bcas bdud 'dul mnyam bzhag mdzad/ / mgon po mi 'khrugs sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ / che ge zhes bya tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ 'dir ming brjod mi bde na/ dus kyi dbang gyur tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ /zhes kyang rung ngo / /thog med nas bsags srog gcod la sogs pa'i/ / lus kyi sgrib pa ma lus dag gyur nas/ / mi 'khrugs rdo rje'i sku yi dngos grub stsol/ /lha yi rnga bo che ltar rnam kun tu/ / rnal 'byor rtogs med legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /yan lag drug cus brgyan pa legs sgogs pa/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs gsung lam che ge zhes byam thog med 324

sa / /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'icho gca lagangh+rudī /༵༷di sdidī ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ rdo ṭ+wāṃXs pa~X/ shes/ ༵ ༷ngh+ru byārdo ṭ+wāṃ/ rdor ༵ṭ+wā ༵/ /drug/ t+t+waṃ ༵ byā~X rnam ṭ+wāṃX ༵dhi ༷ ༵ ༵ :dīsathu r+shaX/ la/ṭ+wāṃdache zhi/ dzhai~X ṭ+wāṃX rnadī | dī ṭ+wāṃ nas bsags pa rnab sems la sogs pa'i/ / yid kyi dri ma ma lus ma ye shes lnga ldan thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ / zhes pa'i bar yongasardzogayosam/ bsdu na/ṭ+wāṃrdo hūṃ ༵ṭ+wāṃ/ sa/༵ lha tshoṭ+wāṃX r+sha yeb rdo~X ṭ+wāṃn/ gyi/sad ༵/༵ dhidhi ṭ+wāṃ didīs la brtse ba chen po'i thugs rjes legs bzung ste/ / sngon chad bsags pa'i sdig sgribagang mchis pa/ / bag chags dang bcas rab tu sbyang ba dang / / srid dang rnam grol bde ba ma lus pa'i/ / dngos grub bde chen myur du stsal tu gsol/ /zhesabarjod cing ltung ba slong ba'i phyag rgya rdo rje khu tshur gnyisakyi nang du mdzub mo lcags sgrog ltar bcingasalegs par gyen du 'phangayopar byasal/ oṃ sarba a pā ya a gar+sha ṇa bi shwadha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ngan song gsum dang tshe 'das gtso bo'i mdun du bkug par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcings/ oṃ shadha ni sharnya ni sarba pā baṃ a na ya hūṃ/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bkugs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa lasagung mo gnyisabasgreng ste/ maze bong gnyis mthe'u chung gnyis bsreng ste mnye zhing / oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ zhes sogayotshar gcig gi mjug tu/ sarba pā baṃ bi shodha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ snying gar rdo rje bsdams pa sgra dang bcas pa dral ba lan gsum byas te/ badz+ra brnya tra ṭa/ cesapa lan gsum brjod/tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bkug cing dral te pa dang bsreg rdzas rnamasadang dbyer med du 'dres pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ces brjod cing bsam/ ngan song dgug dral gyi tshul 'di rnal 'byor rgyud las 'byung 325

༄/ /yobabaloba'i ཿ sa gas/ba'i bla ma gong ma rnam4bla med ladesargyas 'geb gnang 'dug cing / bya rgyud la yang de mo'i mi 'khrugs pa'i srog chog tu 'byung la/ rgyal dbang tham4cad mkhyen pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i kha sar ba ni'i ltosgo'i cho gar yang 'byung bas sbyar du rung bar mngon/de nas phung po yon 'bul bya ste/ bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la/ / tshe 'das phung po mchod par 'bul/ /phung po'i sgrib pa ma lus pa/ /ye shes me yis sbyang du gsol/ /bcom ldan lha mo rnams bzhi la/ /tshe 'das 'byung bzhinga'abyung bzhi'i sgrib pa ma lus pa/ / ye shes ma bcom ldan sems dpa' rnams drug la/ /tshe 'das dbang pos dbang po'i sgrib pa ma lus pa/ /ye shesam bcom ldan lha mo rnams drug la/ /tshe 'das yul rnamasang yul gye sgrib pa ma lus pa/ / ye shes2 rgyal ba'i sku dang gsung thugs la/ / tshe 'das sgo gsum mchod par 'bul/ / sgo gsum sgrib pa ma lus pa/ ye shes me yis sbyang du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas 'azin las mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur/ cesabarjod cing bsam/ de nas yam shing sogs 'bul tshul dang spel tshig gong dang 'dra/ 'phrin lasabacol ba ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bum pa dkar po bdud rtsi lngas gang ba thogs nas/ tshe 'das zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa la khrus byas pas sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ ceyobarjod/ slar yang tshe 'das hūṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/dkon mchog rin chen nas sarba pā baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lam bstan pa dang / 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na/ / mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams yod/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa/ / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las sgrol/ /zhing gi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin cing / /dmigs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed na/ / zhing mchog de ru skye bar 326

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'ichogaja lagagasung / / tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyang / / mi 'khrugs pa yi mtshan bzung zhing / / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed kyis/ / zhing mchog de ru skyes pa yin/ / de ni zhing mchog der gnas nas/ / sems can don kun byedapar shog pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ / srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ / srid pa'i pad+ma las byung ba/ / mngon dga'i zhing du bgrod par shog /oṃ pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha wa mahā a snyi nan+ta gats+tsha chu sāhā/ zheyolam sbyangs par byas la/ lhag ma dkyus ltar ro/ / de dag gi rjes sugatang rag gi mchod pa gong ltar phul/ smon lam ni/ gdod nas dag pa stong gsal nam mkha'i dbyings/ / mi 'khrugs dkyil 'khor 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba/ / mchod bstod sgom dang bzlas pa la sogs pa'i/ / grangs med dge ba'i tshogs kun bsags pa'i mthus/ / tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten thob nas/ / yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ /skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum lam gyi gnad/ /'khrul med brtson pas nyams su len par shog / thun mongs lam gyis rgyud sbyangs sngon song nas/ / rnam dag dbang gis dri ma kun bkrus te/ / ye shes mchog gi sa bon legs thebs nas/ / rang gi rgyud ni yongs su smin par shog /dam tshig sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar/ / legs par bsrungs shing mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi/ / rnal 'byor bsgom pas tshe 'dir bcom ldan 'das/ / mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog / gal te rten 'dir mngon du ma gyur na/ / tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags par gyur pa'i dus/ / shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams der/ / skyes nas theg mchod chos la spyod par shog / mdor na bdag dang dmigs pa'i yul la sogs/ / nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can kun/ / bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i rjes bzung ste/ / dngos grub rnam gnyis lhun gyis 327

sa / /gung bangabasnyanaba'izla ce' gsang 'bum/grub par shog / ces smon lam gyi4mtshams sbyar/ yige brgya bsalhag chad bskangs/ gang yang bdag blo/ zheyosogs kyis nong ba bzod par gsol/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab cing / rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang / sogasakyis brtan bzhugs dang / med na gshegs sugasol ba dkyuyoltar bya/ /de nas shis brjod ni/ rnam dag lha yi lam la bcom ldan 'das/ /lha mo brgyad sogs grangs med 'khor tshogs kyis/ / snyan pa'i glu dang rol ma'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs/ /bkra shis me tog phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs/ /'jigs rung khro bos bdud sde'i dpung tshogs bskrad/ /sna tshogs sgeg mos kun bzang mchod sprin spro/ /phul byung dag pa rab 'byams bkra shis kyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge legs rgya mtsho stsol/ / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spro bsdu byed po mchog /sangs rgyas 'jam dpal tshwa na gasto dang / / tshwa na shan+ta budha'i mtshan can zung / /ku sā li ba dha3 gī rte'i zhabs/ /a ti sha sogs dngos dang brgyud pa yi/ / bka' drin mnyam med bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus pas bkra shis shog /'dab stong lte bar chu shel dbang po'i steng / /yigro nī la'i lhun po nyin byed kyis/ / lan brgyar 'khyud pa'i mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan che/ / bcom ldan mi 'khrugs lha yis bkra shis shog / phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /lang tsho dar babs mdzes sdug lha mo'i tshogs/ /bkra shis rtags kyis mdzes pa'i phyag mtshan can/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis shog /ces sogasadang gzhan yang skabasadang 'brel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i rigs sogasabakra shisakyi glu dbyangs brjod cing /me tog gi char dbab bo/ /smrasapa/ gsang chen rgyud sde'i klung bzhi 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i rigs gyur gdengs can gtso/ /byin brlab zad mi shes pa'i sprin 328

༄/ /mi 'khrugasapa lhadagu'icho gca lagasngon las/ / srid zhi'i gdung sel bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'beb/ / de yi bsgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas 'di/ / ngan song 'ching rgya gcod pa'i ral gri dang / / sgo gsum rnyog pa bsgrung ba'i ke ta ga / 'dod dgu'i dbang ster bsam 'phel nor yang yin/ / zab gsang rgyud sde'i don la ma skyang bar/ /'ol tshod kho nas chos la dbang za dang / / rgyas dang bsdus pa'i dgos don ma mthong bzhin/ / sbyar byang tsam gyis kha bsgyur byas min par/ / legs sbyangabartson pas 'di yi chos skor gyi/ / legs bshad kun la ring du 'dris byas te/ / legs pa'i cha kun bsdus pa nor bu'i phreng / / legs par bstar 'di blo gsal mgul rgyan yin/ / 'dir 'bad las byung legs byas pad+ma dkar/ / nges legs sbrang rtsi gsar ba'i snying po can/ / zhing mchog mngon par dga' ba'i dga' tshal du/ / lhag lhag bzhad pa'i dga' ston myong bar shog / cesabacom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugasapa lha dgu'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcasapa 'di ni chos grwa chen po dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil kyi gso rig gzhan phan gling du/ skyab4mgon rdo rje 'chang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo 7rje btsun 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nasanyid kyis kun gzigs lnga bsamadzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga tshog4'don du btsug yod pa de nyid sor gnasakyi steng nas/ bdag 'jug dang sa thigatsho ga sbyin bsreg lhosgo sog4cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dgos zhes mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag sman pa slob zur blo bzang 'jigayomed/ smra ba'i khyu mchog sman pa dpon slob blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ dge bskos bsod namasagrags pa/ dbu mdzad 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub sogasagrwa tshang spyi nas bskul ma byung bar brten/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rang lo so bdun pa sa rta'i lo khrum stod kyi zla ba'i dkar phyogasakyi dga' ba dang po'i nyin chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling du rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yege ba ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog mkhyen rab bo/ /'dis kyang 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs dri ma med pa phyogs dus 329

༄/ /yo cabalob ཿ tsha ཿmakun tu rgyas par gyur cig / bshad dang sgrub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ / thub bstan sa chen khyon la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ / yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gus pas bdud/ / gang gi mkhyen rabs mkha' klong yangs pa las /'ongs pa'i sngon med legs bshad rta ljang can/ / shar tshe sdug bsngal mun tshogs drungs byung ste/ phan dang bde ba'i pad+mo'i dga' tshal rgyas/ / de lta'i cho ga thar ba'i 'jug ngogs 'di/ / phyi nang rigs gnas sbyangs pa mthar son pa'i/ / dar nyan chos rje bsod nams dbang rgyal gyes/ / mthun rkyen legs par sbyar te dpar du bskrun/ / tshul 'dir dang pas 'brel thogs skye bo kun/ / shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ / skyes nas sa lam bgrod pa myur rdzogs te/ / zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / bkra shis/ /330

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/༄༅/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lha du ma'i sgrub thabs kyi skor mchog thun dngos grub gter mjod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru badz+ra snyi ra wā ya/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i cho ga skad cig dkrongaskyed nasabadag skyed mchog pa'i bar gzhung bzhin dang / grub na rdor sems bsgom bzlasakyang bya la/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla mas gtso mdzad de dngosabargyud kyi bla ma'i tshogasasti bor bzhug4pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed largyalab sras bcasakyisabaskor nasatsun par bsamasate/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i zhes pa nas/ shasta ā sne gi bar dang / oṃ gu ru ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa nas/ spar+sha pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ wā ra'i mjug tu oṃ 〉 rtubatags pa4nang mchod/ yang sa pa ri ra'i mjugatu mu tra glu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ/zhes pasagasang mchod/ mu tra'i tshab tu yu ga nā da bcug pasade kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dbul/ sa gzhi spos byug mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur cesapa nas myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / khyod ni bla ma zhes sog4kyisaphur tshugasagasol 'debasalan gsum/ thun mong lam sbyangs nas/ 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gdung shugs drag pas gsol btab mthus/ / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnas rnams las/ / zhesapa nas/byin gyis brlab par gyur/ / cesadabang bzhi blangs/ de tshe dngos grub nas/bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs/ / sdeg pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ / zhesapa nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / sems can thams cad nas/ btang snyoms 331

sa / /gung bangabastan pa'izla ma'i gsang 'gyagal gnas par bya'o/ /de nas rgyus de'i snying bo nas/ myur thob shog de nas tshogasazhing rnams rim gyis bsdus te rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas mar byon/ rang gi snying gar shin tu maba'i rlung semasadang dbyer med du 'dresapar bsamasal/ rang semasadaga' bde khyad par can gyisazin pasasnang ba ban bun du gyur pa de'i ngang du re dogasabacasabacos sogasakyi rnam rtog gang gisakyang ma bskyod par semasakyi ngo bo nam mkha' ltar dwangasashing gsal la hrig ge ba rgyar ma chad cing phyogs ma lhung ba de'i ngo bor lhan gyis bzhag ste rnal du gnas par bya/ de nasasems de'ang dngas cha dang gsal cha/ yul rig pa'i cha/ dus snga phyi'i cha sogs sosor bsal na/ de dag tshogasatsam la ma ltos par rang gisango bos grub pa cung zad kyang med la/ de'i rigs 'grosakyigagazugasasogs 'dusabyas kyi chos gzhan rnam4dang /'dusam byas rnams kyang gdagasagazhi ci rigagal rnam rtog gisaphar btagasapa tsam las don dam par grub pa cung zad kyang med pa/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad brjod de yang dag pa'i ltab legasapar gsal gdab/ ngesa'abyung byang semayoganyis ni byin rlabalodapung zhus su'ang gsal/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dir bsgoms pas lam gyi gtso bo gsum yang tshang ba yin/ de nasarang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad bsduyopa rang dang rang yang yobon gyi nā bar rim gyis bsdusate 'od gsal du bcug pas lhan skyes kyi bde chen drangs par bsam zhing de dang snga ma'i stong pa nyid sbyar nas/ su bhā wa sog4kyi sngags don dran pa 'chi ba chosasku'i lam 'khyer man chad dkyusabazhin bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs su ting nge 'dzin semasadapa' hūṃ dī yig dang ral gri'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs so sol zhi ba'i sngagasabakod de yor ba tsa bzla/ sgri 〉 dang mthar gri gug gi4bskor bar ya ma rā dza sogasabakod nas sprags sgrub kyi dmigs pa gzhan du gsal ba ltar bzla/ gtor 'bul gyi tshe ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor mgon chosargyal lhamo rnam srasalcam sring phyogs skyongadang bcasapa spyan drangs/ yosheyopa dam tshig pa dang gnyis sumed par gyur/chos skyong rnamasashar sgo'i rta bab kyi nang dang / phyog4skyong rnamasaphyogs mtshamasasosor 'khod par gyur par bsamayol/ mgron rnams nas/ a rnyi pa ti/ shrī dha rmā 332

༄/ /'jam dpaladapa'atshagacig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/pā la sa pa ri wā ra i mi ba be+e sogs kyis gtor ma dbul/ nang mchod skabs su'ang oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra zhesasbyor/ lhag ma 'dra/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro yis/ / 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin gyur cig / gzhi yi 'chi ba bar do skye ba gsum/ / lam dang 'bras bu'i dus kyis sku gsum du/ / sgyur byed bskyed rim phra rags rnal 'byor gyis/ / tha mal snang zhen drungs nas 'byin par shog / rlung sems dbu mar zhugs gnas thim pa yis/ / rim par shar ba dpe don 'od gsal las/ / sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs spyod pa mthar phyin te/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob shog / der ma son pa'i tshe rabs phreng bar yang / / dga' ldan bde ba can sogs zhing mchog gam/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang rim brgyud de/ / yang dag lam la gegs med slob gyur cig / ces sogasabasngo bsamatshamasasbyar la/ nyer bsdu dang shis pa brjod pa sogasadakyusaltar bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni hal ha'i shog nayolhag bsam rnam dpyod yangayopa slob dpon blo bzang shes rab kyisabaskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /mdun du sna tshogs pad nyir 'jigs byed dang / / dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan la hūṃ yig las/ / 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis/ / rdo rje phag mos sku la 'khyud pa yi/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ gis dag pa mkha' spyod nas/ / 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ / gtso bo gtso bor thim zhing 'khor tshogs kyis/ / rang gi lus gnas kun bsrung khyad par du/ / sgo mtshams ma rnams dbang po'i sgor bzhugs pas/ / dman par 'pho ba'i lam kun bkag par gyur/ / de dag 'od zer 'thab pa'i rang gi lus/ / shel gong lta bur dwangs shing gsal ba'i dbus/ / dbu ma smad phra stong yangs tha le ba/ / lte gsang dmar cha'i phag mo snying ga'i dbyed/ / he 333

༄/ /gugabangabastanasgo'izla sa gas 'bumaru ka dang phrad de dgyes rol pas/ /gnyug ma'i sgo gsum lha dang dbyer med gyur/ /mi 'gyur bde ba mchog gi 'khor lo yis/ /'khor 'das stong par 'phen pa'i he ru ka / /dga' mchog myur ba'i rtsal 'byin phag mo dang / /mi phyed mnyam par sbyor bas rjes su skyongs/ /srid par 'khyer ba'i las rlung dgag tu gsol/ / 'og tu ltung ba'i lam ngan gcad du gsol/ / bde mchog 'khor lo'i thugs gar drang du gsol/ /mkha' spyod rdo rje'i grong der khrid du gsol/ / de ltar gsol btab thugs ga'i 'od zer gyi/ / lcags kyus rang sems bde mchog thugs gar drangs/ /'khor tshogs kun kyang bya brgya 'phur 'dra yis/ / bskor te mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /'di ni las la sbyor ba dus tha ma'i dbang du byas pa yin zhing / /thog mar spyong ba'i tshe cung zad re gyen du spar zhing phyir 'bebs pa'i dmigs pasahi ka dang ka spel mar bya la/ spyi gtsug nas phyir thon pa'i dmigs pa cher mi byed/ mthar yang mdun gyi 'khor lo bde mchog snying ga'i bde mchog la thim/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyang rang rang giganas su thim pas byin gyes brlab par bsams la/ dag 'don yang / lcags kyus rang sems gyen du drangs par gyur/ /ces dang / mjug tu/ gtso bo snying gar thim zhing 'khor tshogs rnams/ /rang rang gnas thim byin gyis brlab par gyur/ /cesabya'o/ /zhesa'akhor lo bde mchog la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i man ngag 'di ni chos don rnam par 'byed pa'i mkhyen dpyod yangasapa tā bla ma gu thi bkra shisarab brtan gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me4brisapa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rgyal dbang bdun pa'i gsung gi rdo rje 'jigs byed la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar 'jigs byed kye bskang bshags bya bar 'dod na dkyus kyi mchod pa bzhi rdzogs te/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ cesapa'i 'phror/334

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/yab gcig blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po dang / / dbyer med rdo rje 'jigs mdzad lha tshogs kyis/ / brtse bas dgongs te thugs rje byin rlabs chus/ /bdag gi nyes ltung lhag med byang bar mdzod/ / dngos grub 'byung gnas rje btsun bla ma rnams/ / sku bzhi'i bdag nyid mchog tu ma rtogs par/ / nyon mong4dbang gis tha mal rang bzhin du/ / zhen cing log lta brgyas rnams mthol lo bshags/ / 'jam dpal dpa' po'i rim gnyis gru dzings la/ /brten nas sku gsum rin chen len pa'i gegs/ / dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig tshogs/ / ji snyed 'gal ba ma lus mthol lo bshags/ / 'khrul bral tshang la ma nor khyod kyi bstan/ / zab cing rgya che'i de nyid ma rtogs par/ / ltar snang lam gyi rjes su zhugs pa sogs/ / rmongs pas spyi brtol bgyis rnams mthol lo bshags/ / mdor na sngon tshe 'khor ba thogs med nas/ / zhes pa man chad dkyuloltar bya/ de kho na nyid kyi maṇ+ḍal grub ste gsol 'debs kyi mgor/ rten 'byung lta ba 'dog med 'dzin ma'i gzhir/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin char gyis bran pa las/ / mchod rdzas rab 'byams snye mgayur za bas/ / bla ma yi dam dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / rak+ta'i mchod yon zhabs bsil mkhres pa'i dri/ / dbang po'i me tog gsung chen bdug spos dang / / zhun chen mar me don lnga'i zhal zas tshogs/ / snyan bajid rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa yis/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / / yi dam rdo rje 'jigs mdzad thugs dam bskang / / ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor tshogs thugs dam bskang / / bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / / thugs dam bskang zhing nyam chag sos gyur nas/ /bar chad kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlar bcas pa'i zhing / / 'dod yon rnam lnga rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ / bkra shis rtags rdzas lha mi'i longs spyod tshogs/ / ma tshang med pas phyur bur 335

༄/ /yo cabalo yo yo sa lagagatams pa 'dis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /yi dam rdo rje 'jigs mdzadam mo nga mo/ / gti mug srog rtsa gcod pa'i gri gug sogs/ /brdog cing 'joms pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / / bde chen dmar gyes yongs gang thod khrag sogs/ /rol cing stobs pa'i mtshan ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi za ma sa ma/ /dngos grub brgyad kyi snang ba me dang glang / / ma te lug sogs srog chags sna tshogs dang / /dbang phyug sgyu 'phrul bya rgod la sogs pa/ / mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'dab chags sna tshogs kyis/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi mo sa ma nga/ /pha rol phyin drug dag pa rus pa'i rgyan/ / nyon mongs dgra bcom sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs/ / ye shes lnga yi thod skam dbyangs gsal gyi/ / bdag nyid khrag 'dzag mi mgo'i 'phreng ba yis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyim sa ma྾/ /yangs shing rgya che'i mtshan ldan ka pā lar/ / na ra glang sogs sha lnga rir srungs shing / /khrag sogs bdud rtsi rnam lnga mtshor bskyil te/ /sbyangs rtogs sbar byas mchod gtor dam pa 'dis/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnamasam mom sa/ / bla ma yi dam dbyer med mos gus bcas/ / dbang dus khas blangs dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrungs/ / bskyed rim phra rags rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhis/ / 'jam dpal bsgrubs pa bla med rten mchog 'dis/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / / yi dam rdo rje 'jigs mdzad thugs dam bskang / / ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor tshogs thugs dam bskang / /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / / thugs dam bskang zhing nyam chag sos gyur nas/ / bar chad kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ / zhesabacug na rung ste/ sngar yang 'jigs byed kyi bskang bshags zhes ming zur du ma btags pa tsam las/ bshags pa'i skabs bla ma yi dam la ched du byas pa mang zhing / bskang ba'ang / bla ma yi dam 'khor 336

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/bcas thugs dam bskang / / zhes kun gyis 'don bzhin pa yin pas klan ga'i skabs med do/ / zhes pa 'di ni ta ri gang ga'i shog nasa'ajam mgon bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa er ti ni mer gen hu thog thu blo bzang 'jigs med rdo rjeyobaskulaba'i bzhed pa bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesa'aphral du spyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /༄༅/ / gtsug tor rnam paraculama'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa 'chi med dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru uspri ṣa bi dza ye/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pa'i zla zer gyis/ / 'chi bdag mun pa'i smag rum mthar mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs pad la/ / gus pas 'dud do mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / des bde gsang rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs kun/ / mngon rtogs gcig gi bar du rgyas 'debs pa'i/ / lugs srol dor te yab rje'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / ma nor don tshang gsal ba'i cho ga bri/ / de la 'dir gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i bsgom bsgrub nyamagasulen par 'dod pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bris 'bur gyi sku la sogs pa dang / bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i steng du mchod rten tshad dang ldan pa bzhugasasubacug pa'i mthar gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa tshar gnyis yan chad dang / 'bul gtor dkar rgyan can cha gsum sogasabakod pa mdzes par bshams/ skyabasasemasasngon du btang / lag pa gnyis bkan pa layomadzub mo cung zad bkug pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uste wa ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ oṃ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ceyobadag dang gnas bsrung ba byayol/ oṃ tram̐ brnya swāhā/dzi na dzi ka/ cesapa lan bdun bzlas pa'i bsang chusamachod rdzasal bran te bgegs bsangs/ oṃ te dza sa ni sirnyi sa dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod pa rnamayophul du byung 337

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa'abogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/g.yas rtse gsum bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po khro bo'i nyams can/ g.yon thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol zhing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ steng gi g.yas g.yon du gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu sku mdog ser po rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nasabacom ldan 'das ma la sku khrus gsol ba/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par yā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ dpral par tram̐ ser po/ lte bar hrī dmar po/ brla gnyis la i a lngang gus mtshan par gyur/ sngar gyi dam rgya thugs ka smin mtshamasamagrin pa dpung mgo rnams sareg la/oṃ ta thā ga ta uste wa ye swāhā/ zhes gnasarnamalobyin gyisabarlab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uji ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arnya pra ti ts+tsha sāhā/ nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ga'i zla ba'i mdog / zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i rgyan/ / ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ / rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rje btsun thugs rje'i gter dang gsang ba'i bdag / mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs gzhon nu zung gcig la/ / mchog tu dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi dang / gzhan yang snod bcud kyi bkrag mdangs yon tan thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/sngagasaphreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus gang / tshe dang bsodanams rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngosagrub thob par gyur par bsam la spro na gzungasaring dang / oṃ hūṃ swāhā/zhes pa snying bo ci mang dang / oṃ a mi te a mi to be/ a mi ta bi garnye/ a mi ta 339

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'isgronas g.yo ཿmgā dre/ a mi ta gā mi ni/ a mi ha a yurda te/ ga ga na kyirte ka re/ sarba kle sha/k+ṣa yi ka rī ye swāhā/ zhes phreng sngagasabazlas te mthar yig brgyasalhag chad bskang /sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya/ bum bskyed ni/ su bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ de'i steng du sbyo las byung ba'i mchod rten rin po che'i khri'i steng du rim pa bzhin bang rim blum po gsum/ bum rten bum pa bre/gdugasabacu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang daragyi lda ldis mdzes par byas pa'i dbus su zla ba'i gdan/ g.yas g.yon dang steng gi logs gnyis te bzhi la zla gdan dang / phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i gdan re re ste thams cad kyang sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du oṃ sbyi swāhā zhes pa'i sngags kyi gdangs nam mkhar grags pa de nyid yig 'bru bris pa'i rnam par gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la oṃ hūṃ swāhā zhes pa'i sngags kyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyisakhyas/ gcig tu 'dus pa las bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo dkar ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsumadang ldan zhing g.yon zhal yid tsam khro ba'i nyams can/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje/ gnyis par pad+ma'i steng du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ gsum pas mda' 'dzin zhing / bzhi pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang po rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs gar mdzad pa/ gnyis pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan mob

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/pa/ de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon du gsang bdag sngon po g.yon yut+pa la'i steng na rdo pha bsnams pa/gnyis ga'ang zhi ba'i nyams can g.yas rnga yab 'dzin cing bzhengs stabs su gnas pa/ gtso mo'i shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri/ lhor 'dod rgyal g.yas lcags kyu/ nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rtse gsum bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po khro bo'i nyams can/ g.yon thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol zhing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ steng gi g.yas g.yon du gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu sku mdog ser po rin po che'i rgyan gyis spus pa gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ma la sku khrus gsol ba/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrig par 〉 thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ ta thā ga ta uste wa ye swāhā/ shaṃ ka re sa ma ye swāhā/ dzi na dzi ga mchod pa rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uji ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra ya a sogasakyis mchod/ spro na rgyal ba rgya mtsho 4 sogs tshigs bcad ci rigasasbyong /dpal ldan lha mo ston pa'i zla ba'i mdog / zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ / ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ / rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rje btsun thugs rje'i gter dang gsang ba'i bdag / mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs gzhon nu zung gcig la/ / mchog tu dang ba'i yid kyes phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi ye shes kye bdud rtsi bkug nas bum pa'i chu la thim zhing / lha'i sku'i cha thams cad nas kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ par bsam la bzlas pa gong bzhin bya/ mjug tu yig brgyasalhag ma1

༄/ /yo cabalopa'itshonama'i tsha lam/chad bskang zhing dge rtsa 'bul ba ni/ bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe brtan cing 'azin las rgyas pa la sogs pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs la 'bul lo/ /mgon po khyod kyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe brtan cing 'phrin las rgyas pa la sogs pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol cig /ces pasamatshon te rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyasapa'i dngosagrub kyi rgyur ram/ 'jig rten khams sund mug 'khrug rtsod la sog4pa zhi ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud dam/ rnala'abyor pabadag gis chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thamasacad zhi zhing mthun rkyen legasatshogasam lus pa 'grub pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyur sogasaskabasasugang bab kyi tshig phrad bsgyur/gtor ma akā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyisabarlab la/ oṃ uji ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra yi rda ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun sogasakyiyodabul/ cha gsum yang oṃ ā : gis byin gyiyobarlab la/ bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gyi/ /mgron rnams kun la gus 'bul na/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /zhesabasngo/ de nas mchod bstod gong bzhin bya4la yig brgya lan gsum gyiyolhag chad kha bskang / gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ / mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzod rigs/ / ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /zhes nongasapa bzod par gsol/ sku brnyan nam mchod rten sogs dang dbyer med du bstim la/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhayobartan par bya/ gtso rkyang byed par 'dod na/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa zhes pa'i mjug tu de'i spyi bor oṃ sogs spyor/ uzlo ṣa bi ji ya a sogasasu sbyar tes pa ri wā ra zhesa'ador/ bstod pa'i mjug gi blo ka gnyiyopa yang mi dgos/ bum pa'i skabasasulda ldis mdzes par byas pa'i dbus su 342

༄/ / 'jamadapaladapa'apogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du oṃ hūṃ swāhā zhes sogasasbrel zhingatshig phrad lhag ma gong dang 'dra/ bdag bskyed rkyang ba byed na de'i bzla4pa'i mjug gi mchod bstod kyi rjesasu/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mas bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhesa'adod don la gsol ba'adebasashing nongasang/ bzod par gsol ba sogasasngar dang 'dra/ mjug tu/ dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma byung ba na/ /de yi mod la rnam par rgyal ma'i sku/ / gsal bar mthong nas 'chi bdag dpa' bcom ste/ / 'chi med rig 'dzin myur du thob par shog /ces sogasabasngosmon dang bkra shisakyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'chi med dpal ster rnam par rgyal ma yi/ / sgrub thabs rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i bcud/ / legs sbyar dge bas bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ / zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas gyur cig / de yi mthu las rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i bstan/ / phyogs mthar rgyas shing mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams/ / chos bzhin bsgrubs te bde ldan zhing mchog tu/ / 'od dpag med pa'i zhal bzang mthong bar shog / ceyogatsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa 'chi med dga' ston zhesabya ba 'di ni/ sgom sgrub sogs la gcig tu gzhol ba dka' bcu nor bu rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/7shākya'i dge slong cho4smra ba dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesadaga' ldan bshad sgrubadar rgyasabakra shis g.yasasu 'khril ba'i gling gi 'du khang chen mo'i yang rtser sbyar ba'o/ /343

༄/ /yo cabalopa'isgronasa' gsung 'bum ༄7/ / lo ma gyon ma'iril sgrub byed tshul phan bde'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /༄7/ / rgyal kun ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'od rnon gyis/ / lus can rgud pa'i mun pa mthar byed pa/ / bcom ldan ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum dang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ / de yi 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i gzeg ma yis/ / snyigs ma'i gdung ba bcil pa'i cho ga gsar/ / rdzogs ldan kun dga'i mgron du bstar ba la/ / skal bzang skye bo dga' bas 'jug par rigs/ / de'ang bar+ṇa sha ba ri'i mdo ri khrod ma'i gzungasasogasargyud sde du ma lasagasungasashing / dpal ldan sre rgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma rnamasakyis thugs kyi gcesanor du mdzad pa shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag gi gnad du ma dang bcasakun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjesagasal bar mdzad pa'i don bzhin rikhrod lo ma spyon ma rigasagasum gyi sgom sgrub nyam4su len pa la bum sgrub dang brgyad thodal brten pa sogasamang du yod pa las/ 'dir spyi 'jomasaril bu sgrub tshul gyi dbang du byas te bshad par bya'o/ /de la thog mar ril bu'i sdeb sbyor ni/ sman chen/ gla rtsi/ shu dag a ru ra gser mdog sha bo ru rta/ sha chen/ dri chen/ ghi hang / cu gang / byi te ga shi/ sug spel/ sdig srin/ stag 'a bu ram/ shing kun/ gu gul/thar nur ra/ chu rtsa/ ma nu 'di rnams zhib par btags la dge slong gtsang ma'i dri chus ril bu sran ma chung shos tsam du sgril/ rin po che'i snod du ril chags byas la mtshal gyi na bza' gsol te bum par blug stegs mthon por bzhag dar gtsang mas kha bcad de steng du gzungs rdor bzhag mdun du 'bul gtor blum po gsum mam gcig dang / bdag mdun gyi mchod pa 3yo

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/sogs legs par bshams/ de nas sgrub pa po sngags kyi dbang thob cing dam tshig gtsang ba/ khyad par du 'di'i smin byed kyi rjes gnang sogs legs par mnos pa'i gang zag gis rang gzhan gyi don du sgom sgrub nyams su len pa la/thog mar skyabs sems sngon du btang / subhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang / ljon shing sna tshogs kyi nags tshal dang / me tog sna tshogs du bkram pa'i dbus su baṃ las pad+ma dang ri las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid kyi rnam par shes pa baṃ yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma spyon ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la dam ral blum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badzes pa la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gnyis pas dgra sta 'debs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs gar mdzad pa/ gnyis pas shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab g.yob pa/ gsum pas gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi rteng bas 'og phyogs brten cing pus mo gdan du btsugs pa/g.yon bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang /shing lo gsar ba'i smad g.yogs can/ sgrul dkar po'i 'phreng bas ser la kha byas pa/ de'i thugs gar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma nag mo/ mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma dmar mo/gnyis ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pas thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad de gar stabs su bzhugs pa/345

༄/ /yo thangabamaba'irna ma'i ga 'thugarigs gsum ga'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā / thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / / zhesapa nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ba r+ṇa sha ba ri sa pa ri wā ra ye bye te dza dza dza : baṃ ho dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs khyed rnams kyes bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta aghi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rigs gsum ga la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/dbangagi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tasabasangs/subhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spes/ snang gsal/ dri chab zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/oṃ.a ā0rtu nag sta 〉 rtu gi bar gyisabyin gyi4brlab4rang gi snying gnas mchod lha spros te/ oṃ bar+ṇa sha ba ri sa pa ri wā ra a pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas shastapra tīts+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yis/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul las sha ba ri/ / lha mo gang gis bsgrub pas nad gdon bgegs/ /kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ rigs so so'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba'i sa bonasngags phreng dang bcas pa las rang 'dra'i sprul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ nad bdag gi lha mo nad pa bcas pa rnams sku'i 'od zer gyis 3yo

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/bsregs/ zhal du gsol/ phyag mtshan gyes thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlagayang sku las 'od zer 'phros/ lhag ma'ang bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams rlung gisagator/ slar yang sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dri ma bag chags tsam yang ma lus par dag par gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ bi sha tsi bar+ṇa sha ba ri sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇa ye swāhā/ oṃ dzi tha ra ti sa turnye dz+wa la saṃ bha ram̐ swāhā/ oṃ kun dhe kun bha ma lam̐ k+shi shal shal dug sod/ rgyu gzer la swāhā/ zhes ci mang bzla/ mjug tu/ oṃ despyoyag sbyo 'bras gzer byo 'brum gzer spyo snying gzer bh+yo lhog gzer bh+yo rgyu gzer spyo ma ra ya kha baṃ/ zhesapa dang / yang oṃ chi rdul rdul/rmugs shig shig hri ri tsa ka tri sad/ rbad ma la ya rbad/ sarba ma la rbad hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhesapa gnyisakyang ci nus re bzla/ yig brgyasalhag chad bskang zhing mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/denas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ bum pa ril bu dang bcasapa la a mṛ ta'i sngagayokyisabasangs/ subhā wasastong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang / ljon shing sna tshogs kyi nags tshal dang / me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i dbus su ril bu rnams re re nas baṃ las pad+ma dang re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma zhes pa man chad bdag bskyed ltar dang / 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhesadang / dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur/ ces tshig phrad bsgyur/ mchod pa byin gyiyobarlabasate mchod bstodagong bzhin bya/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /347

༄/ /yo cabastan ཿsgronace' gotshi ཿmabyin rlabs zad mi shes pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /nad rims rgud pa'i tsha gdung kun bcil te/ / phan bde'i dga' ston dpal la spyor bar mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sde dang bcas/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ / rnam dkar bshad sgrub gong du 'phel ba yi /'dod don lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / ces 'phrin las bcol/bzlasapa'i dmigs rim sngags bzla tshul sogasagong bzhin byasal khyad par thun gyi mjug rnams su/ rje btsun ma ser mo'i sku las rang 'dra'i sku dang 'khor lo dang 'od dkar po'i tshogs spros te bsrung bya rnams kyi phyi rol nas ra ba rim pa gsum gye tshul du bskor zhing / de bzhin du dmar mo'i sku las rang 'dra'i sku dang pad+ma dang 'od dmar po'i tshogs spros pas snga ma'i nang du ra ba rim pa gsum/ yang de'i nang du ri khrod ma nag mo'i sku las rang 'dra dang rdo rje dang 'od sngon po'i tshogs spros pa'i ra ba rim pa gsum ste dgu phrugs su bskor bas nyer 'tshe gang gis kyang mi tshugs par byin gyes brlab par bsams/ mjug tu thunasnga ma rnamasakyi tshe mchod bstod mdor bsduyor dang / rjes ma'i skabasagator ma a mṛ tayobasangs/ su bhā wasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor mazag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā r+ṇa adu nu t+pardo twad oṃ ā : phaṭa sāhā/ lan gsum brjod la byin gyisabarlabs/ ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsamasapa/ oṃ pi sha tsi bar+ṇa sha ba ri sa pa riphra ra i de ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyisadabul/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ grol kha'i tshe/ye shes pa rang bzhin gye gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam par gyur par bsamasal bsngo smon dang / bkra shis kyi4mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod ma'i/ /bsnyen sgrub bkod pa'i dge ba 348

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/yis/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing / / phan bde'i dpal la rol gyur cig /cesapa 'di'ang chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du dbang ldan srad rgyud kyi phyag bzhesabazhin lo gyon ma'i ril sgrub cig byed skabs7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung la gzhi byas te ngag 'don gyi rim par bsgrigasapa'o/ /༄༅/ / thig le bcu drug gi bsgom bzlas nyams su len tshul snyeng por dril ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / mnyam med jo bo yab sras 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ / byang chub bar du rjes su gzung du gsol/ de'ang thig le bcu drug gi nyams len snying por dril te lag tu blang ba'i tshul ni/ lha chos bdun ldan gyi rnam thar las gsung rab mtha' dag gi nyams len thig le bcu drug tu 'du ba dang / de rjes dran lngar 'du zhing / de'ang bsdu na thabs shes gnyis su 'du bar gsungs pas rjes dran lnga'i gdams pa ni rje btsun sgrol mas stsal pa yin te/ nor bu'i phreng ba'i le'u gnyis pa las/ sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs/ / khyed kyi rjes 'brangakho mos skyong / / kho mo'i gdams pa 'di long la/ / rjes su 'brang la bstan par gyes/ / skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mdzod/ /lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te/ / ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun par mdzod/ / 'gro ba ma lus pha mar soms/ / sems kyi gnas lugs stong par spyod/ / lnga po de yi skya bar nas/ / dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod/ / ces gsungs pa de yin la/'di'i thog mtha' spyor rgyu gnyis kyang snga ma'i 'phro de ma thag tu/ de yi sngon du gzungs 'di sbyor/ / bye ba 'gyur du rgyal bas gsungs/ / sras mchog de ni 349

༄/ /yo bamaba'i ma'i ga laga'adi lta ste/ /oṃ sasta ra sasta ra bhi ma na sa ra ma hā dzasta ba hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ sras kyi thu bo deng yang nyon/ /de ni gong du spel byed yin/ / sgyur bar byed pa bsngo ba mchog / dus gsum dge rtsa mchog bsags pas/ / mchog rab mchog gi lam nyid la/ / mchog gi sems kyis mchog tu bsngo/ /de ni sgyur byed bsngo ba yin/ /zhes thun gyi mgor 'gyur sngags bzla ba dang / mjug tu bsngo ba byed tshul bcayogasungs so/ /yang de dag thabs shes gnyis sam zab rgyas kyi lam gnyis su bsdus te nyams su len tshul le'u nyi shu pa las/ ngas chos thams cad hril te dril bzhin khyod la sbyin/ bdag thong gzhan long 'od gur bzhugs/ /snang ltos gzhi chod ngo bos stong / / dpyad nas ma rnyed lam du song / / lam de mi ldog pa yin no/ / gnas lugs tshad med rgyud la dril/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas chod/ / ces pa nas/ snang ba'i thabasakyis 'gro ba drongs/ / shes rab dbyings su gzims la bzhugs/ /hril te dril na 'di nyid yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bka' gdams glegs bam gyi snying po'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i bum bzang du gsungs pa bzhin yin te/ mdor bsdus na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can las ma 'das pas 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor nyid yin no/ /'dir rjes dran lnga'i chings dang sbyar te nyams su len pa la/ mdun gye nam mkhar dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs par bsams te/ 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /gangs ri'i mgon po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal yum sgrol ma bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon/ /bka' gdams lha mchog bzhi la gsol ba 'debs/ / byams pa thogs med ྾/ / 'jam dbyangs yod med phyogs 'jigaza sa ma sa/ /thugs rje chen po bde gshegasam ma sa྾/ / lam bzang gsal mdzad mgon po a ti sha / bka' gdams 350
