༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig maphags lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/bstan pa'i mes po rgyal ba 'brom/ / legs pa'i shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhi la sogs/ / dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / srid la zhen log rkyen ngan grogs su shar/ / bdag gzhan mnyam brjes rlabs chen spyod la zhugs/ / srid rtsa drungs 'byin lta bas rgyas btab ste/ / thun mong lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / gsang sngags sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / / zab gsal gnyis med lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /zung 'jug snying gi thig le mngon gyur nas/ / 'gro kun mgon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ skyabs yul rnams rim gyis bsdus te rang la thim par bsam/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis pa nor bu'i 'phreng ba dang shel gyi mkhar ba sangs rgyas stong gis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i skur gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ saṅgha nayosbar+sha ā rtu gi bar gyis byin gyis 'dra ba/ 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings las sems kyi mdangs/ / 'ja' tshon gur nang pad dkar lte ba la/ / steng dang phyogs bzhi 'og rnams yig drug gi / rang bzhin gzhal yas mtshan nyid dzogs pa'i dbus/ / trī las bkod pa bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i/ / rgyal ba rgya mtsho phyag stong spyan stong ldan/ / mtha' klas rgyalaba'i zhing kun sku la gnas/ / sprul pa'i gar gyis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren/ / de yi thugs gar stong gsum mi mjed kyi/ / thig le sngar dang mtshungs pa'i gzhal yas dbus/ / thub chen rnam snang skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag can/ / theg gsum 'phags tshogs mchog zung bcas te bzhugs/ /gsum pa kha ba can gyi thig le yi/ / gzhal yas dbus su 'phags mchog bcu 351

༄/ /gung b.lo losgronalo ga las/gcig zhal/ / gnas khang thig ler 'phags mchog phyag gnyis pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gis mtshan pa'i mkhar ba bsnams/ / de yi thugs gar yum chen phyag bzhi ma/ /skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag rdo rje glegs bam 'dzin/ / de nang bdud 'dul thub pa'i dbang po ni/ / sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /thig le bdun par 'phags mchog phyag bzhi pa/ / rtsa phyag thal sbyar shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin/ / thugs gar rgya yum sgol ma ma rgad mdog /phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon pas ut+pal bsnams/ /de nang sgrol ma ljang nag drag mo'i gzugs/ / gri thod ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭī 'dzin/ /thig le bcu par khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon/ / g.yon gyi pus btsugs ral gri zhags pa 'dzin/ / thugs gar rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can/ / jo bo chen po lha bzhi sogs kyis bskor/ / de nang 'brom rje pad dkar dril bu bsnams/ /phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs bcas bzhugs/ / thig le bcu gsum pa la byams pa mgon/ / steng du rgya chen spyod brgyud tshogs bcas dang / /de yi thugs gar mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zab mo lta ba'i bla ma brgyud par bcas/ / 'jam mgon thugs gar khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /nyams len byin rlabs brgyud kyi bla mas bskor/ /de nang chos sku zag med ye shes dngos/ / rnam pa longs sku mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ /chos dbyings ngang las 'gro don mkha' khyab tu/ / mdzad pa'i snying dbus byang chub thig le ni/ /khyon yangs gsal 'tsher dbus su rang gi sems/ /dzig le ser po 'od 'bar rgya sran tsam/ / mer mer 'ju zhing shin tu rgyas pa yi/ / btso ma'i gser mdog thig le'i rgya mtshor gyur/ / kun gyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan pa'i/ / hūṃ yig 'od kyis zhing khams rab 'byams nas/ /ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs te/ / bstem zhing dbang bskur sa bon gyis mtshan gyur/ / de nas gzhal yas khang thams cad kyi sgo gcig 352

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/caraste ste so sor yan lag bdun pa dang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i/ / rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal/ / skye gnas 'jig pas ma gos pa'i/ / dri med mchod tshogs 'bul lo lha/ / sgo gsum skye gnas 'jig bral ba'i/ / nyes pa'i g.yang sa mthol lo bshags/ / stong yang sna tshogs skur ston pa'i/ / grangs med 'dren la rjes yi rang / / smon dang mtshan mas stong pa yi/ / 'khor lo dbyings su bskor du gsol/ / skye bas stong pa'i chos sku khyed/ / lhun grub gnas pa'i rang bzhin las/ / gang du'ang 'da' bar ma mdzad cig /dge ba 'di yis 'khor ba rnams/ / 'di 'drar rtogs te 'di 'dra ba'i/ /gzhal yas khang du 'drongs gyur te/ / gsang sngags 'di bzhin spyod par bsngo/ / gnas skabs kṛ ya'i lha lnga bzhin/ / pad dkar stong ldan lte ba la/ / zla ba zhun ma'i gdan steng du/ / phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi/ /bskyedardzogs mchog tu bsngags par shog / glo bur 'di yang chos dbyangs las/ / tha dad ci yang yong ma mchis/ / tha dad med par phun tshogs pa'i/ / bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog / gtsang ma rigs kyi bkra shis shog / thog mtha' bar gsum gtsang ma las/ / g.yos pa med pa'i bkra shis shog / ces yan lag bdun pa phul/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma sogs tshigs bcad dang sbrag4pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ sazo ta thā ga ta a pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ suhā/ de bzhin du/ pār+ya puṣ+pe byu be a lo ke gadhe ne+e wir+ya sta rū ba shasta gadhe ra sa spar+sha pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes chu gnyisanyer spyod rol mo'adod yon lnga rnams dbul/ rab 'byams rgyal dang rgyal sras rgyal ba'i yum/ / rgyal ba'i bstan srung kun 'dus lha mchog bzhi/ / mi yi rnam rol jo bo yab sras sogs/ / bsru med skyabs mchog rnams la gus pas bstod/ / khyad par chos sku'i snying por thabs shes zung / / thig le'i rnam par shar la bdag bstod na/ / lha chos 353

ro / /gung thangabastanapa'azla sa gsung 'bugabadun gye snying khu thig le'i bcud/ /tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas yang rang thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa logs su phye bas sna drangs te mar gyur sems can thams cad kyis rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs phyi ma rnams la phyag dang skor ba byas te gsol ba btab/ khyad par rang gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs thams cad kyang 'gro ba mgon dang skyabs med pa rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyu gang la gang 'tsham gyi nyer 'tsho'i rten du 'gyur ba'i phyir lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa'i sprin dang bcas te phul bas zag med kyi bde bas dgyes/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum dang khyad par thugs ga'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob/ thugs ka phye nas nang ma nang mar phyag dang skor ba mchod pa sogs gong bzhin byas pas thams cad kyi byin rlabs thob par bsams la/ so so'i sngags sgrub dkyil rnams su 'byung ba ltar bzla ba'am/ thams cad la yig drug bzlas kyang chog par bka' gdams glegs bam gyi cha lag tu gsung / der ma zad thugs rje chen po'i sku'i ba sru'i bu ga rer yang dkyil 'khor gye lha tshogs rgyal bsras bcas bzhugs tshul/ / yi ge drug pa'i bzlas bajod byed tshul zab shosal dmigs rnam 'di 'dra zhig dgos tshul za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo la zhib tu brtag na gsal zhing / mgon po gser gling bas kyang de ltar gsungs yod pas bzlas pa yig drug gcig pur rtsal 'don byas na legs la/ thig le thams cad kyi nang du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis phyag mchod sogs dus mnyam du byed pa'i dmigs pa bskyangs na'ang chog go/ de nas lhagaphod skong ba'i phyir yig brgya ci mang bzla/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma thams cad dang / /yi dam thugs rje chen po'i lha 354

༄/ /'jamadabaladapa' bogacig ma sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/tshogasadang / / jo bo yab sras thugs rje can rnams kyis/ / bdag gi smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par mdzod/ / 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma dam pa yis/ / tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang ma mthar phyin shog / skyes bu gsum gyi lam du gsung rab kun/ / bsdus te nyams su blangs pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ / gsang chen sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / / zung 'jug snying gi dzig le 'grub par shog / lha bzhis lus dang sde snod gsum gyis ngag / bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan rjes dran lnga'i/ / nyams len mthar phyin 'gro kun sgrol ba la/ / rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyid dang mtshungs par shog / gsang chen snying gi thig le'i gdams pa mchog / dbon pa'i gnas su nyams su len pa la/ / jo bo'i bka' srung dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog / rang gi thugs ga'i byang chub kyi thig le'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud mtha' dag bsdus te phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thig le la thim/ thig le phyi ma bco lnga po rang rang gi gtso bo'i mdog can gyi thig le'i rnam par gyur te/ nang ma nang ma la thim zhing /bdag nyid sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'ang yi ge gsum dang / de'i oṃ spru la thim/ā rtu la thim/ hūṃ byang chub kyi thig le la thim ste thabs shes zung 'jug gi ngo boragyur/ de'i ngang las slar yang thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ legs tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog / sku gsum mngon du gyur pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis shog / thog mtha' bar du dge ba dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog / bslab gsum rnam par dag pa dge 'dun rnams kyi bkra shis shog / bdag gzhan mnyam brje rin chen byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog / thabs shes zung 355

sa / /gung thangabastanaba'ilnga ma' gsangabazaga'ajug rim gnyis rnal 'byor zab mo'i bkra shis shog /phan bde'i gzhir gyur thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / 'gro kun zeg mchog chos kyi dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog / ces shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /gsung rab kun gyi dgongs pa'i mthil jo bo yab sras thugs kyi bcud/ /snying gi dzig le'i rnal 'byor gyes/ /'gro kun smin cing grol gyur cig /ces thig le bcu drug gi bsgom bzlasanyams su len tshul snying por dril ba 'di ni mang du thosapa'i don yang dag pa'i sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i ri khrod pa yon tan rgya mtshosabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yege pa ni sngag4ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /rang gi spyi bor yid 'ong seng khri'i steng / / pad zla'i gdan la oṃ dang 'khor lo las/ / rnam snang dkar po zhal bzhi phyag gnyis pa/ / mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo bsnams/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /ngo bo dbyer med mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /dar zab rgyan spras skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba yi/ /gnas gsum yi ges mtshan pa'i hūṃ yig gis/ /ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med gyur/ / chos dbyings ye shes bdag nyid thams cad rig /mi bzad ngan song sdug bsngal yongs su spyong / / ma lus 'gro ba'i skyob pa bla na med/ / bla ma rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis legs mchod cing / /sngon bsags sdig stung ma lus snying nas bshags/ /bcom ldan thugs rje che ldan khyed rnams kyis/ /nor bu dri ma med pa bskyabs pa bzhin/ /bdag sogs ngan song sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las/ /bskyabs te byang chub spyod la bzhag tu gsol/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas mdzod spu las/ / 'od zer 'phreng ba stong gsum khyab par spros/ /ngan song kun sbyangs sras bcas rgyal rnams kyi/ /byin rlabs 356

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/bsdus te rang la thim par gyur/ / denas oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sadru du rga te pa ri sho dha na rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samya ka saṃ burnya ya/ tangu thā/oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne+e/ sabra pā paṃ/ bi sho dha ne+e/ shudhe/ bi shudhe/ sadru naspo ā wa ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhesabazla/ yang na/ oṃ sadra bid sazo ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ cesasnying po dang / de'ang mi shesan/ yi sazo bad oṃ/ zheyonye snying ngam skyed sngags bzlasapas chog la/ gsum ga bzlas na'ang phun sum tshogasapa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro/ / de nas yig brgyas lhag chad bskang la/ 'dis mtshon rang gzhan dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / pha ma nye 'brel rigs drug sems can dang / / rgyu spyor yon bdag bkol spyad dud 'gro sogs/ /'brel thogs gson gshin 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / mi khom ngan song skye ba'i rgyun bcad de/ / thun mong lam sbyangs sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ / zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ / rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni mong gol cin shog nas dad brtson ldan pa chos mdzad dkon mchog bzang posabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra ga ru ḍā ya/ / 'dir khyung nag me'i spu gri'i bsgom bzlas nyamasasu len par 'dod pas/ sku bris 'bur ci rigs kyi mdun du blum gtor 'dab ma bzhi pa chu gnyisanyer spyod sogs bsham la/ rang bzhin spros bral stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ / dug gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus/ / dug rigs mtha' dag tshogs pa'i lhun po'i spor/ / pad nyi gdan gsum brtsegs pa'i gdan khri la/ / rang sems hūṃ yig mthing nag 'phro 'du las/ / rdo rje mkha' lding nag po phyag gnyis kyis/ / gdug pa'i sbrul nag bzung nas zhal du gsol/ / gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rwa dang mchu sder can/ / nor bus gtsug mdzes gser mig nyi ltar 'bar/ / dung so tshar dngar rdo rje'i sgo 357

༄/ /yo thangabastanapa'isgronama'i ga lam/gshog las/ /khyung dang gnam lcags me yi tsha tsha 'dum/ /spros pas 'og gdon ma lus sdangs par byed/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gi /'od kyis ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha/ /spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med gcig gyur nas/ / dbang bskur mi bskyod rgyal bas rgyas btab gyur/ /mchod pa rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ṭa a na4shastapratīts+tsha swāhā'i bar gyes mchod/ srid gsum chem chem g.yo ba'i 'thor rlung can/ /rdo rje'i sgro gshog brdab pa'i me char gyis/ /gdug pa'i klu gnyan thal bar rlog mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan mkha' lding dbang por phyag 'tshal bstod/ / snying gar nyi dkyil steng du khro yig mthar/ /'khod pa'i sngags 'phreng 'od kyis rgyal kun mchod/ /'gro ba'i sgribasbyangs gdon gsum sreg byed pa/ /stong gsum me yi rwa gur gcig tu gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi khyung khyung sum̐ hūṃwad rbad swāhā/ zheyozhi ba'i sngagasasngon du bzlas la/ nag po kā la rak+ṣa rbad rbad/ sod sod/ phyung phyung / spu gri zang zang /lcags kyi sder mos snying phyungs/ gnod byed gdug pa'i sha la zo/ oṃ lhang lhang / tser tser/ 'ub 'ub sod/ ces drag sngagasabazla/ yig brgyasalhag chad bskang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / mkha' lding nag po 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs bsngo ba bya/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ bsangasasbyangs/stong ba'i dang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsamasal/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ṭa i de ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ 'di'i sgo nasand pa gsob/ 'jag (jag)bsrung / ser ba 'gog tshul sogs khyung khrasargyasabakab chog payothu'u bkwan rinapo che'i gsung lasa'abyung ba bzhin bya/ byab khrus byed na bum pa a mṛ tasabasangs/ de la dmigasate/ rang bzhin spros bral zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar 358

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/gong bzhin la/ rang sems zhes pa dor te/ hūṃ yig mthing nag 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / zhesasgyur/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ bum lha ye shes pa rnams dbyings su gshegs/ / dam tshig pa dang bum chu ro gcig gyur/ / byab khrus dngos gzhi sngags kyi khyad tsam ma gtogasakhyung khra'i byab khrusakho bos bkod pa bzhin byas pas 'thus/ zhesapa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog rab gsal gyisa'adi'i mngon rtogs lag tu blang bde ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyobris pa'o/ / na mo maci thi ye/ skyabasasems sngon du btang / swa bhāwas stong par sbyangs/stongs pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du dhī yig mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par 〉 thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ hoganyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa amṛ tas bsangs/ subhāwasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/yiyār+ya maci shrī arnya sogasakyisamachod rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes sprin sngon las/ / byin rlabs gru char 'jo bas nyes tshogs kun/ / spyong zhing phan dang bde ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ / mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i steng du dz+nyā yig mthing nag gi mthar sngags 'phrengagis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ gdon gsum gye gnod pa dang 359

sa / /gung thangabastanapa'azla sa gsung 'bugagrib dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ ngur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dza ke shaṃ tram̐/rbad phaṭa swāhā/ yig brgyasalhag chad bskang / mjug tu mchod bstod sngar bzhin dang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dpal dpa' bo 'grub gyur nas/ /zhesasogasabasngo smon bya'o/ /zhesapa 'di'ang dad ldan raba'abyams pa dkonamachog byams pas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabris pa'o/ /rang bzhin rnam dag 'od gsal klong yangs nas/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ / sngon gyi thugs bskyed dam bca' nyer dgongs te/ / bdag cag bsod nams zhing du gshegs su gsol/ / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /ma tshang med pa mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ / mi dge kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / / bskul zhing gsol gdab dge tshogs mchog tu bsngo/ /'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo thugs rje'i gter/ / khyod zhabs gus pas bsnyen cing gsol 'debs na/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / 'od zer rang gi lus kyi phyi nas gurakhang drug sbrags kyi rnam pa dang / bdud rtsi spyi bo nas zhugs pas lus gang ste nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsamalol sngagasaspel tshig dang bcasapa'i bzla4pa bya/ de nas/ 'jigs 'phrog lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i sku/ /gdangs snyan 'gag pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /dpag yas mkhyen brtse zung du 'jug pa'i thugs/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs la bstod/ /tshe rabs kun tu bcom ldan 'das ma yis/ /'bral ba 360

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa'apo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/med par brtse bas yongs bzung ste/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi ba dang / /lung rtogs yon tan mtha' dag rgyas par mdzod/ /khyad par dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul bcom ste/ / rnam dag dam chos sgrub pa mthar phyin cing / / bde ba can du pazo las skyes nas/ / sa dang lam gyi bgrod pa mtharaphyin shog /ceyopa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong ngag dbang nor 'phel gyis gser gyi me tog dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /༄za/ /lha mo tham ṇa'i sgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa shel dkar me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / thugs rje byin rlabs spo mtho'i ri bo nas/ / lung bstan dpyid kyi pho nya'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /dge mtshan gsar ba'i dus ston 'dren mdzad pa/ / lhag pa'i lha mo shā ma ṇa la 'dud/ / sngon byas dge dang mi dge'i ri mo bzhin/ /legs nyes rnam par bkra ba bzhin gyi mdangs/ /ji bzhin snang bar byed pa'i a dar+sha/ /rmi lam bsgrub pa'i gdams pa 'dir bshad bya/ /de'ang 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud nas gsung4pa'i lha mchog khyad par can 'di nyid la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la/ dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa dang / dngos gzhi bsnyen cing bsgrub ste lasal sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ shin tu dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnasasuphyag dar byas la spos chu'i chag chag btab/ spyor ba rtsom pa'i sngon gyi nyin gnyisagasum tsam la dkar gtor gtsang zhing gya nom pa dkar gsum sogs za4sna du ma dang bcas gzhi bdag rnams la dgung re bzhin bsngos te la4bcol/ de nas bgegs gtor btang gu gul gyisa'adug mtshamasatho bslang ste 'phags skyesapor gsal btab nas/ mtshamasanang du bgegs mi 'jugapa'i 'phrin lasabacol/ mchod pa gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bshams/khrusadang gtsang spra legasapar byas/ 'og tu sadakar gyi g.yung drung bris pa'i 'bol 361

༄/ /yo ca bayopa'azla ma'i sa thugagastan sogasal tshul dang mthun par 'khod de/ skyab4sems sngon du btang / khyad par bdag gis ma sems can cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba nyid du thob par bya/ de'i byur du rang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che bde blag tu 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /snyam du bsam/ de nas bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ su bhā was stong par sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hūṃ yig mthing ga / de las 'od zer phyogs bcur spros/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi me dpung 'bar bas yongs su bskor bar gyur bar bsam la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes pa ci mang bzla/ 'di'i sgrub pa'i bog 'don gyi mchog tu gyur pa ni dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par byed pa yin pas/ rdor sems sgom bzlasal 'bad dgosashing / de ni cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gyi rgyas pa'am/ mdor bsdu na/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje thug gar 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par be+e thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dza ka baṃ ho zhes bajod pas rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang bar mdzad du gsol/zhesagasol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyang ste rgyud byin gyis rlabs par gyur/ bar bsam la yig brgya bzla/ mjug tu/ spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems 362

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ de'ang yig brgya 'bum phrag bzla b.ragasung ba bzhin byung na legasashing / ma mtha' 'ang nyin bdun la thun bzhir bcad de yig brgya gtsor 'don dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa 〉 zhesapa bsnan te 'bum gye grangasagasog de'i zhar la phyag sbyang dang dkon mchog gi mchod pa khrus dang gtsang spra sogasanan tan shin tu che bar bya'o/ /gnyisapa dngoyogazhi ni/ rang gi sngas mgor stegasabu gru bzhi ba'i steng du rdul tshon nam ras gzhi la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris/ de'i dbus su bum pa gtsang ma/ bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas dag dkar gsum sogs bsgom pa'i chu gtsang gis bkang shug pa lta bu'i kha rgyanal tsa ka li btagasapa'i steng nasadar sngon po'i gur phub/ mtha' mchod pasabaskor/ phyogs gcig tu sgrol dkar gyi sku bris 'bur ci rigs mchod pa dang bcas pa/thun mthar 'bul rgyu'i dkar gtor gsum bcalobashams/ a ta'i sngagayobazlayote chab kyis bran/ dri bzang gi chus kha dag par byas/ dri bzang po4bsgos pa'i me tog lag tu bzung zhing / skyabasa'agro semasabaskyed/ rdor semasabasgom bzlasabasdusapa bya rgyudaltar gyi mchod pa byin rlabasabacasasngon du btang / bdag skyed ni/ su bha wasastong par sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid te yig dkar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs gar mazeb srin gyis 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par ya thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ dza ཿ paṃ hodabang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ā r+yatwa re a sogasakyisamachod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ / tut+ta re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ / tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ / sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thugs gar zla ba'i steng du te yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas 363

sa / /gungayangabastanapa'izla sa gsung 'bugabaskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sragadang bcas pa thams cad kyi gzungs spobs mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad bsdus te rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ zhe4pa ci nusabazlasal yig brgyas lhag chad bskangs/ mdun bskyed ni su bhā wa nasako3rta/ bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho be+eḍūr+ya/nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ rtse mor dpag bsam gyi ljon pa chenapo lo ma dang me tog rab tu rgyas pas mtshan pa/ ri rab kyi steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la lha mo shra ma ṇa sku mdog sngon mo/ sked pa phra ba/ nu ma rgyas pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong pa'i cha byad can ri rab la stegs 'dug gi tshul du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ g.yas me long dang rnga yab/ g.yon dpag bsam gyi shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ shin tu dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ blang dor mtha' dag gsal bar lung ston pa'i tshul gyis rang la gzigs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par sna thugs gar hūṃ/thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i lha mo ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza dza ka baṃ hodam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ de bi shra ma ṇa a pra tīsmo hūṃ swāhā nas/ shasta'i bar gyigamachod/ rgyal kun ting 'dzin bye ba'i 'jug ldang gi /sgyu 'phrul mngon par shes pa'i ga bur zer/ / skal bzang kurdo'i gnyen du shar ba'i lha/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rig mun par 'thom pa'i 'gro ba la/ / brtse chen thugs rje'i 'od kyi sgron ma yis/ /'phral yun legs nyes blang dor ma lus pa/ /gsal bar ston cig 'phags ma thugs rje'i gter/ /bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed kyis bdag la/ don 'di dang 'di zhesabya ba'i blang dor mtha' dag bslu ba med pa gsal bar lung bstan du gsol zhesagasol ba lan gsum 3yo

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/btab la lag pa'i me tog rnams lha'i me tog sna lnga pa'i phreng bar bsam zhing lha mo'i dbu la bcing bar mos te bum pa'i nang du gzhug lha mo'i thugs gar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du 'khod par dmigasate yid gzhan du ma yengasapa'i sgo nas oṃ shra ma ṇa bi sha tsi ni muṇ+ḍi swāhā/ zhesaci nus bzla/ thun mthar yig brgyasalhag chad bskang zhing / thun tha ma gtor ma bdud rtsir byin gyisabarlabasate cha gcig mtshanasngag4la ba ling ta btags pas bla ma dang gram ṇa la 'bul/ cha gcig lokā ros chos skyong la/ cha gcig sasta rasagazhi bdag la bsngo/ thun gyi tshe tha mal pa'i gtam/ gnyid dang 'og rlung / ltagazhan gyi bzlasapa sogasakyang ma shor ba bya la/gal te byung na thun btang ste khrusabya4nasaslar sdom zhing snga ma sngagasakyi grangs sumi gzhug go /thun mtshamasasu sgrol ma dang / yig brgya 'bad pa dang ltamo'i sngagasargyun par bzla zhing lhag par nyal kha gang mang 'don la/ nyal ba'i tshe lhamo'i pang du mgo bzhag par mosanas sngasabyang du bstan/ g.yas 'og tu bcug nas sngagasabagrang bzhinapar gnyid du 'gro ba bya/ mtshams kyi skabs mi khyi sogs dang mi 'phrad cing /shacang sgog tsong la phug sogayosngo rngad kyi rigs/ dkor zasadang grib can gyi zasasogasal 'dzem/ 'tsho ba dkar gsum la brten cing phyi dro'i kha zas spang / zasakyi phud bla ma dang lhamo la 'bul/ zas kyi mjug dang / zag pa dor rjesakhrus bya ba sogasagatsang sbra la 'bad/ de ltar 'bad pagazhag bdun nas ma grub na/ sgrib pa dang grib shasache ba yin pasabashags bsdam dang rnam 'jomasakyi gzungasachus khrusasogasanan tanabyusate slar sgrub cing / bdun phrag gsum gyis mi 'grub mi srid par gsungs/grubapa'i mtshan ma byung ba na thog mar bstan pa'i bya ba'am skye ba phyi ma'i don lta bu 'gang che ba re re tsam la brtag mi gsal na bskyar na4brtag ste rim gyis don gnyisagasum sogs mang du gtong zhing / brda don myong steng nayodapyad shesapa gal che la/lhag pa'i lhar bzung ste yun du bsten na slar mngon sum du lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /kun rdzob rdzun pa rgyu 'bras bya byed kun/ / nyid 'khrul rdzun pa rmi lam gyis bstan bzhin/ / legs nyes bden pa blang dor la 'bad pas/ / chos nyid 365

sa / /gungathangabastananga'asgronas gsung 'thugabaden pa mngon sum rtogs gyur cig /cesalha mo tha ma ṇa'i sgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa shel dkar me long zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa 'jam dbyangayobazod pas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4bri4pa'o/ /mdun du rma byas btegs pa'i rin chen khrir/ / pad zla'i gdan la mgon po 'od dpag med/ /byi ru'i mdog can mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zhing / /mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams/ / spyan ras gzigs sogs rgyal sras rgya mtshos bskor/ / nub phyogs bde ba can nas spyan drangs pa'i/ /ye shes pa dang dbyer med gcig gyur te/ /bdag sogs mgon du dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /ngan song 'jigs las sgol pa'i dpa' bo ste/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon mchog / mgon po 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi sras kyi thu bo'i tshul bzung ste/ /bde ldan zhing du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog / snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs mgon sogs/ / rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ / nyes ltung sdeg sgrib ma lus sbyang du gsol/ /mi khom ngan song 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / zhing mchog bde ba can du khrid du gsol/ / re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / zhes dad pa shugs drag po gsal btab la/'od dpag med kyi dam bca'i gzungs dang tshe gzungs/ thugs rje chen po'i gzungs rang thung ci mang bzla/ bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gis thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad sbyangs te/ 'od dpag med mgon sras dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob par bsams/de nas/ 'od dpag med mgon 'khor dang bcas/ /'od zhu rang gi snying gar rang sems dang / / dbyer med hrī yig rnam par gyur pa yi/ /'od kyis rang lus stong par sbyangs pa las/ /rang nyid khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang gi 366

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/mdog / dmar ljang dkar ba'i zhal gsum rta mgos mtshan/ / phyag drug rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ral gri dang / / g.yon pa sdegs mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags 'dzin/ / drag po'i nyams ldan khro bo'i rgyan gyis sras/ / brkyang bskum bzhi bzhi'i zhabs kyis klu chen mnan/ / dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes pa rnams dang / / dbyer med gyur pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum/ / snying gar sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba las/ / 'bar pa'i khro chung spros pas bgegs dpung bcom/ / 'od kyi lcags kyus rgyal kun byin rlabs bsdus/ / sngags kyi 'brug sgras sa gsum khyab par gyur/ / ces pa'i don bsam zhing rta mgrin gye sngags bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / 'dis mtshon dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / mgon po 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin rnams kyis rjes bzung ste/ / sa lam bgrod pa gegs med mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni mkhar sngon shog nas lhag bsam rnam dpyodayangasapa chosarje dkon mchog zla bsabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngag4ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /༄za/ / mi gabo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs blo gros dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / mtha' yas rgyal ba kun gyi mthu dang stobs/ / rnam par dag pa'i ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ / gtum chen gangs kyi ri bo g.yo ba'i gar/ /khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon pos deng 'dir skyongs/ / de la 'dir khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag giyoskyabayosemasasngon du btang nas/ su was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasape lasapad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ltebar rna las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūṃ yig dkar po/ de 367

༄/ /yo cabastanaba'isgronama'igs lam/las 'od zer 'phros/ semasacan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasasras bcas thamasacad la mchod/ de rnamasakyi mkhyen brtse mdzad pa 'azin las thams cad bsdus/ hūṃ la dzim/ de yongs sagyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'dasami g.yo ba sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar zhing brjid pa zhal gcig phyag gnyisagayasashes rab kyi ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon thugasakar sdigs mdzub dang bcasapas rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yasapa'i mthil gyisanyi gdan mnan cing / g.yon pa'i pusamo nyi gdan la btsugasapa/ dmar la blum pa'i spyan gsumadang ldan zhing zhal gdangasanasamache ba bzhi gtsigayopa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil zhing / dbu skra kham ser gyen du badzesapa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing / sku smad dar gyi sham thabasagasol ba/ de'i spyi bor yodakar po/ mgrin pa ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnasanas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i yeshesapa spyan drangs/ dza ཿ baṃ to gnyi4sumed par gyur/ slar yang thugasaka'i hūṃ lasa'od 'phros/ dbang gi ltarnamasaspyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyiyobadag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzi bha wa a sti ṣe ñtsa hūṃ/ zhesabadud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnasapa yongayosu gyur pa las/ mi bskyod payodabu brgyan par bsam/ mchod pa bsangasasbyangs byin gyis brlabasal/ oṃ ār+ya a tsa la sa pa ri wā ra arnya pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du shasta'i bar sbyar la mchod pa dbul/dusagasum rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi dngos/ / gangs ri ltar dkar rab brjid khro bo'i sku/ / dran pa tsam gyisashesarab mchog sgol pa'i/ / bcom ldan mi g.yomagon la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes /sa bstod nas/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūṃ yig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du oṃ tsalho ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bcu pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba gzugs yi ge dbu can gyi rnam pa can/ kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pas bskor ba/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus kyi 368

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig ma sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/nang thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal/'od zer ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/de rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi shes rab/ tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa rnams kyi shes rab dang mthu stobs thams cad dang / mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab thams cad bsdus nas rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la blo gros kyi snang ba thogs med du rgyas par mos nasasnga ba bcad de bsnyen pa bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhing / mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas te/ mdun bskyed logs su byed na sgrub gzhi ras bris sam tshom bu lta bu la dmigs te bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar re las nyi ma'i dkyel 'khor gye steng du hūṃ yig dkar po zhes pa nas/ bstod pa'i bar rang sgra dor ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus te rang la thim par bsam zhing bzlas pa bya/ yang na bdag mdun so so mi byed par/ bdag bskyedakyi dam tshig pa bsgom pa'i rjes su thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs te mdun du pad nyi'i steng du rang nyid la zhal phyogs nas bzhugs shing / gnyis ga'i thugs gar pad nyi'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa re re de'i lte bar ye shes sems dpa' mi g.yo ba tshon gang ba re re/ de'i thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mar me ltar 'bar ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu la sngags phreng yi ge bcu bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i mi g.yo ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung gnyis ga'i zhal nas thon/ mdun gyi mi g.yo ba phyi nang gnyis kyi zhal nas zhugs thugs gar thim/ de gnyis kyi lte ba 369

༄/ /yo cabam losgronama'i go 'gyaganas thon/ rang dang snying ga'i mi g.yo ba'i lte ba nas zhugs/ thugs gar thim zhing 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba rgyun mi 'chad pa la sems gtad/sngags kyi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas hūṃ la thim par bsam la bzlas pa bya bar mkhas pa yon tan khri dang / ngor ba dkon mchog lhun grub sogs kyis gsungs la snga ma rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa yin pas/ rang gi mos pa bzhin gang bde ba bya/ bogs 'byin sdigs mdzub kyi sbyor ba dang /le brgan dar gye sbyor ba sogs zhal shes mang du yod par snang yang / bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag ma thob pas/ dpe la slob dpon bcol bar ma nus so/ /thun mthar gtor ma 'bul na dkar gtor chab kyis bran/ oṃ ā : gis bdud rtsir byin gyes brlabs/ mdun bskyed zur du bsgom pa'am/ ye shes pa mdun du bzhag yod tshe de'i ljags byin rlabs byas te dbul zhing /bdag bskyed rkyang ba'i mjug tu yin na/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bsgoms dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba mdun du spyan drangs/ de'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'od kyi spu gu can du gyur bar bsam la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa ba bla ta kha kha/ khā nyi khā hi lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ a sogs kyis mchod/ sngar bzhin bstod nas 'dod don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ / zhesapa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa garma chos 'byor gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bsgrigs pa'o/ /༄7/ /bcu gcig zhal gyimangonartogs mdor bsdus bathugs/ /༄7/ /chos sku stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhengs 370

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig ma sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/pa'i sku/ / zhi ba'i zhal bzhi khro zhal bdun/ / bcu gcig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rtsa ba'i zhi zhal dkar po gsum/ / rab tu 'dzum zhing mdzes pa ste/ / las dang nyon mongs zhi mdzad pa/ / chos sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de steng btso ma'i gser mdog can/ / rngam zhing bzhad pa'i zhal gsum pos/ / tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor gsum/ / rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de steng byi ru ltar dmar ba/ / dbang gi las mdzad zhal gnyis po/ / rnam par gtsigs pa'i khro gnyer can/ / longs sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de steng drag po'i las mdzad pa/ / dud sprin mdog 'dra zhal gnyis po/ / 'jigs shing rngam pa'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /sprul sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de steng bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ / sangs rgyas kun 'dus li khri'i mdog / 'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba yis/ / gtsug rgyan mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra dang po yi/ / phyag gnyis thugs gar thal sbyar nas/ / sangs rgyas kun gye thugs rje rnams/ / bskul par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / g.yas kyi phyag bzhi rim pa bzhin/ / bgrang phreng 'khor lo mchog sbyin dang / / dus gsum sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ / legs par bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / g.yon gyi phyag bzhi rim pa bzhin/ / pad dkar spyi blugs rin po che/ / thabs shes zung 'jug mda' dang gzhu/ / legs par bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / thugs kyi sprul pa rin po che/ / thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa khyod/ / sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol/ / 'gro ba du ma'i skyabs gnas khyed/ / sdug bsngal du mas rnam gtses pa'i/ / nyam thag phongs pa'i sems can la/ / thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ / ma rig 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams/ / las ngan bsags pas lus ngan blangs/ / ngan song gsum du lhung ba rnams/ / thugs rje'i lcags kyus 371

༄sto/ /gung bang bstanaba'itshonama'i sa 'chagabazung du gsol/ / zhes pa 'di ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam poyolhasa'i thugs rje chen po'i mdun du mdzad pa yin la/ dang por rang byon du pheb4dusartsa phyag bcu pa yin pasade dang bstun pa'i gsol 'debasa'adi bzhin bya/ de nas/ 'phags mchogaspyan ras gzigs mgon dang / / phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ / zhesapa nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig / cesayan lag bdun pa bya/ de nasayig drug ci mang bzlasal yig brgyasalhag chad bskang / de nas/'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs mgon thugs rje can/ / bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ / zhesapa nas/ lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog / dmigs yul ma rgan po cho ga gis (yis) mtshon pa'i/ / pha ma gnyen bshes yon mchod gyur pa dang / / bkol spyad sha khrag zos sogs 'brel thogs kyi/ / 'gro ba rigs drug mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ / las nyon sdig sgrib dri ma kun byang ste/ / mi khom ngan song skye gnas las thar cing / / dag pa'i zhing mchog po ta lar skyes nas/ / spyan ras gzigs kyis 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog / cesasmon pasamatshamasasbyar bar bya'o/ /zhesapa 'di ni margan gyi dge rtsar dmigasadagon gsar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling du lo ltar dgu pa'i nyer gnyisaladusabazang thog ma ṇi bye ba re sgrub rgyu dang / de'i dmigasarten du rang byon lnga ldan gyi sku brnyan bcas bsgrub skabs/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabasgrigasapa'o/ / ro༅/ / sgrami snyan gyi tshe sgrub lag tu len tshul che dpal mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / 'chi med tshe yi dpal ster ba/ / tshe dpag med mgon la btud nas/ / tshe yi dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul/ / gdams pa'i snying po 372

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/bsdusate 'god/ / 'dir sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub lag tu len tshul rgyas par byed na tshogasazhing bcas pa rje'i gsung las 'byung ba bzhin bya la/ bsdus te byed tshul yang de nyid las zur tsam gsung pa bzhin byas te 'god pa ni skyabasasems sngon du btang shu n+ya ta'i sngag4kyiyostong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang sems hrī yig dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod pas mnyes par byas te de dag gi byin rlabs dang srid zhi'i tshe dpal mtha' dag bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dar dmar po'i chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing / 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i phrag gong g.yas g.yon nas nyi zla 'char ba/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā / thugs gar hūṃ/ khong ba'i nang gi rgyab la nye bar lcags kyi srog rtsa sba dbyug tsam/ yar sna spyi gtsug dang mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ de'i nang du rtsa dbu ma mda' snyug tsam kha dog sngo dmar nang 'od gsal gyi rlung dmar ljang gis gang ba/ dbu ma'i phyogs bzhir yar sne nas brtsams te sngags 'phreng mgo gyen bstan bzhi dang /mtshams bzhir mar sne nas brtsams pa'i sngags 'phreng bzhi ste brgyad kyis dbu ma'i steng rdzogs par khebs pa/ dbu ma'i mar sne'i nang du rang 'dra'i tshe dpag med dmar po/ yar sne'i nang du tshe dpag med dkar po/ snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gye dbus su tshe dpag med dmar la sngo ba'i mdangs can/ de'i thugasakar zla ba'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ de'i nang zla ba la gnasapa'i gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte ba'i thad du zla gdan la 'od kyi 373

༄/ /yo cab ba'isgronama'i ga 'chagaga'u kha spyor/ de'i nang du hrī yig dmar po dang hūṃ yig sngon po phan tshun 'khril zhing 'od zer lnga 'phro ba ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can/ nang gi hrī dang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gnyis las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ steng phyogs yon tan bkod pa'i zhing nas tshe dpag med ye shes pa spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi gtsug gi rgyab ngos su bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ a pa ra mi ta ā yur dzā na sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dza oṃ a pa ra mi ta ā yur dzā na sa pa ri wā ra arnya sogalokyisamachod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo zhe4sog4kyisabastod/ hūṃ skye 'chi rab spangs rdo rje'i tshe/ / bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ a yu ṣe sa ra ha ka ra re sha ra ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsumagasol ba btab pas steng gi tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ rang gi tshe bsod nams sogs yar pa nyams pa 'azor pa thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug ste/ de'i phyag gi bum nang du thim/bdud rtsi khol te phyir lud pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi rtsa nang thams cadagang bas tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ slar yang steng gi tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa kun gyi byin rlabs nus mthu snod bcud kyi bkrag mdangs nus pa thams cad 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te de'i phyag gi bum nang du thim/ bdud rtsi khol te phyir lud pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/lus kyi rtsa nang thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob pa la gegasabyed mtha' dag dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga sen mo nyi shu'i bar sogs nas nag nyil gyis phyir deng / bdud rtsi rnams sen mo nyi shu'i bar nas nang du log pas mkhrig ma phan dang brla rtsa man chad gang bar bsams la stengaskrung thur du mnan/ 'og rlung rnams gyen du drangs nas kha sbyar te bum 374

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/pa can tshar gcig bzung / de nas gru mo dang lte ba'i bar gang bar bsams la tshar gcig phrag pa dang snying ga'i bar gang bar bsams la tshar gcigamagrin pa man chad gang bar bsams la tshar gcig sna bug man chad gang bar bsams la tshar gcig spyi gtsug man chad gang bar bsams la tshar gcig lus kyi cha shas thams cad gang bar bsams la tshar gcig ste bum pa can lan bdun bzung / phyi nang gnyis dang spyi bo'i tshe da /ga med gsum ga'i sku las 'od zer spro bsdu'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ snying ga'i hrī yig gi mthar 'khod pa'i sngags 'phreng klog pa'i tshul gyes dmigs pa gtad cing / na mo budhā ya/ na mo dharmā la/ na ma sadha ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ a ta te/ bha da de/ nyid de/ sti nan te/ ku nan te/ ha ke/ tha ke/ tha ra ke/ ta ra ke/ hū ru ma te/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ saṃ bhak+ṣa/ snyi bhak+ṣa/ bha mu na/ dzi dzā ba ṭ+wāṃ/ si narlu rtu/ bharnya swāhā/ zhesabazla/ mjug tu mchod bstod byas la/ steng gi tshe dpag med gdan bcas rang gdan dang bcas pa la so sor thim pas byin gyis brlabs shing dngos grub brtan par bsam la bum pa can ci nus su gzung / de rjes tshe gzungs tshar bdun bzlas te bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ / rgyun 'khyer la gal te dmigs pa de tsam ma lcogs na dmigs med kyi ngang nas sngags tshar nyer gcig re bzlas pas kyang go chod par gsung la/ gdon pa'i dus rab tho rangs bya rog gi skad ma grag pa'i gong dang / de ma byung yang mi la ngag ma 'dres pa'i sngon du byed dgos pa phyag len yin no/ / snyan brgyud man ngag gsang ba'i gnad/ / 'jam mgon bla ma'i dgongs pa'i bcud/ / bsdus te bkod pa'i dge pa yis/ /tshe dpag med mgon gnas thob shog / cesapa 'di ni tsūn su nyid shog nas lhag bsam3ma dpyod yangasapa dka' bcu dkon mchog nyi masabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabrisapa'o/ /375

༄/ /gungathangabastanaba'isgroname'i gas 'acag༄7/ / khro bcu'i mngonartogs mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / na mo gu ru krodha rā dza ya/ 'dir khro bo bcu bsgom par 'dod pasargyas par na bdud las rnam rgyal sogs su 'byung ba ltar bya4pasa'athus la/ 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir zur du bkol te mdor bsdusapa'i tshul gyiyonyamasasu len lugasani/skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ swa bhā wa4stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i lte ba'i dbus dang rtsibs rnams kyi steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gnod mdzes rgyal po/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed/ lhor gzhan gyes mi thub pa/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can/ nub byang du stobs po che/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor sgyur/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i dbu rgyan can/ rab tu khros shing rngams pa/ 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dang khro bo'i rgyan la sogs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā0/ thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūṃ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ / bdag tu 'dzin pa bdud rtsi'i dpung 'joms phyir/ /bdag med ye shes drag po'i rnam rol pa/ / bcom ldan khro bo'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ / jo rtu baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ acha ā ཿ sogs kyisabyin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ma hā kro 376

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a nas/ shasta'i bar gyi4mchod/ oṃ 〉 rtu btagasal nangamar dbul/ shes bcu rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ / stobs bcu me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ / phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ / khro bcu'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang rang gi thugs gar hūṃ yig la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las rang 'dra'i bsregs shing tshar bcad par gyur/ na ma sa man+ta budhā ṭ+wāṃ/ zhesasogasagur nasagasungasapa'i spyi sngagayobazla/ yig brgya4lhag chad bskang zhing mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabasal/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes khro bo bcu'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ljags 'od zer gye sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsam4la/ mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu/ i rda ba bo ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ zhe4btags pa gsum mam bdun gyisadabul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ zlog pa byed par 'dod na bzlas pa'i 'phror khro bo rnams zhal phyir bsgyur te chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegasaspyi dang / khyad par pha rol gyi byad ma rbad 'dre bod gtong thamayocad rtsa phyag gnyisakyi thal mo nyi zlas mtshan pa'i bar la 'thag ste rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam zhing / hūṃ bla ma yi dam mchogagasum lha/ / dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / kun dang khyad par khro bo bcu'i/ / mthu dang bden stobs byin rlabs kyis/ / mi 'dod nyer 'tshe thams cad bzlog / bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs bzlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog / steng gdon gza' yi gnod pa bzlog / btsan dang rgyal bsen cho 'phrul bzlog / klu dang sa bdag 'tshe babazlog / mi 'dod kha smras gleng gzhi bzlog / lo zla zhag dang dus skag bzlog / rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog / pha rol gdug pa'i bsam sbyor bzlog / khram dang gtad la bcug pa bzlog / mdor na byad kha phur 377

༄/ /yo cabayoba'itshonama'i sa 'chagakha'i rigs/ /bzlog go byad ma nyid la bzlog /bsgyur ro byad ma nyid la bsgyur/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i go cha yis/ /pha rol byed phur mtshams bcad de/ /chos ldan legs tshogs smon pa bzhin/ /grub par mdzod cig khro bo'i tshogs/ /zheyobarjod cing srung ba'i don du zhal nang du bsgyur bar bsams/ man ngag gi gnad zhib par gzhan la4shesapar bya/ mjug tu yig brgyasalhag chang bskangs/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par bsamasanas bkra shis kyisamatha' brgyan par bya'o/ /khro bcu'i mngonanyogs sgom pa'i tshul/ /shin tu mdor bsdus bkod pa'i dges/ /nag po'i g.yu las rnam rgyal te/ /bshad sgrub bya ba mthar phyin shog /ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byamasapa dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4bri4pa'o/ /lo ma gyon ma'i rgyun 'khyer mdor bsdus byed na/ sangasargyasachos tshogasam lan gsum dang / sa bhā wa'i sngagasakyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng / /rang sems baṃ yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ /ri khrod lo ma gyon masku mdog ser/ /ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum re re yang / /spyan gsum dang ldan dbu skra gyen du badzes/ /g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje dgra sta mnga'/ /g.yon na zhags pa shing lo'i sbrang yab gzhu/ / bsnams shing g.yas pa pus btsugs stabs kyis bzhugs/ /dar dkar stod g.yogs shing lo'i smad g.yogs dang / /brang 'gro dkar pos se ral kha byas shing / /gnasagasum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang dbangagi lha/ /spyan drangs ma rtu baṃ ho dbyer med bstem/ /dbang lhas dbang bskur mi bskyod rgyas btab gyur/ /mchod pa oṃ yā : gisabyin gyiyobarlabasal/ oṃ brnyi sha ba ri a sogasakyisamachod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /zhes sogasakyilobastod/ thugs gar nyi ma'i steng du baṃ yig gi mthar 378

/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ nad bdag 'khor bcas bsregs par bsamasal/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+sha sha pa ri sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma na ya swāhā/zhes ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgyasalhag chad bskang / mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / lo ma gyon ma 'grub gyur nas/ / zhesasogasabasngo ba4mtsham4sbyar bar bya'o/ / zhesapa 'di'ang rnam dpyod mchog tu dge ba chos rje blo gros phun tshogs kyi rgyun 'khyer du/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ḍā ye/ tshogs bdag dmar chen sgrub par 'dod pas 'bulagator la phug dang kha zas gtsang mas bskor ba/ dkar gsum mngar gsum 'brasabu gsum rnamasazan dang sbyar te ril bu byasapa'i la du sogs mchod pa gtsang ma bsham/ skyabs semasasngon du btang ste/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po yis/ / ba dan rtse gsum gyis mtshan rdo rje 'phyar/ / g.yon gyi dang po thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin/ / 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs/ / spyan gsum sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar/ / thod skam dbu rgyan mi mgo'i do shal dang / / sbrul dang rin po che yi rgyan gyis spras/ / stag sham gsol zhing g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs/ / thugs kha'i hūṃ yig 'od kyis ye shes pa/ / dbang lhar bcas te spyan drangs dbyer med bstem/ /dbang bskur mi bskyod rgyal bas rgyas btab gyur/ / mdun du be+eḍūr+ya yi brag ri'i steng / / 'dab brgyad pad+ma dmar po'i lte ba la/ / rin chen sgyug pa'i nor bdag bye ba'i steng / / ga yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ /tshogs kyi bdag po glang po'i gdong ba can/ / rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba rab tu gtsigs/ / bcu gnyis phyag gi g.yas la rim pa bzhin/ / dgra sta mda' dang lcags kyu rdo rje dang / / ral gri 'phang mdung 'dzin zhing g.yon pa na/ / gtun shing gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag dang / / sha chen phub dang lhan 379

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ske khrung 4ma/cig mdung dar 'dzin/ / gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs gar ga yis mtshan/ / rang gi thugs ma'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas tshogs kyi bdag / spyan drangs de dang dbyer med bstim par gyur /dbang lha'i tshogs kyang spyan drangs dbang bskur te/ / spyi bor 'od dpag med kyis brgyan par gyur/ / mchod pa byin gyisabarlab4la/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti arnya sogs kyisamachod/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ / gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ / tshogs rje tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag bgegs kyi gtso la mchod cing bstod/ / rang gi thugs gar hūṃ yig la sngags phreng gis bskor ba'i 'od kyi spro bsdus rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te bstem/ tshogs bdag 'khor bcas kyang dbang du byas par bsam la ma sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grot+na groṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ pā ya grot+na pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ā na ya ha bha wan badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci mang bzlas la/ de nas tshogs bdag gi thugs gar ga yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor bar bsam zhing / de'i 'od zer gye lcags kyus 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad dbang du bsdus pa'i dmigs pa byas te/ oṃ spru ga rtu swāhā/zhes bzlas pa bya/ gtor ma byin gyi4brlabasate mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gong 'og tu bdag skyed la mchod bstod bya bar 'dod na mazuta ḍā ma ra arnya zhes sogs dang / dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ / mthu stobs nus pa gcig bsdus te/ / khro bo'i rgyal po'i skur bzhengs pa/ / gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal/ / zhesapas bstod/ mjug tu bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gye gnas su gshegs/dam tshig pa rang nyid la bstem/ tshogs bdag kyang rten yod na de la bstem zhing /med na rang gnas su gshegs te bkra shis kyisamatha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni cha har shog nalodang ldan dge slong ye shesabazang posabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa 380

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4bris pa'o/ /phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin pa/ / bsru med rin chen rnam gsum dang / / nor sbyin lha tshogs la btud nas/ / g.yang skyob mdo sde 'don thabs bri/ / de'ang gser 'od g.yang skyob tu grags pa'i mdo sde 'di ni phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal skyed pa'i thabs mchog tu dam pa du mas gsungs shing phyogs kun la dar so dang phan pa'i 'phrin las kyang che/ g.yang 'gug gi cho ga thams cad kyang khungs 'di la brten pas lag len rgyas pa byed na bca' gzhi 'don thabs thams cad de bzhin byas pas 'thus la/ 'dir mdo klog pa gtso bor byas te zhar byung du g.yang 'gug byed tshul mdor bsdus tsam byed par 'dod na/ ston pa'i sku rab gnas can dang / rnam sras sogs nor lha'i sku bris 'bur ci rigs dgram/ mchod pa tshar gnyis 'bul gtor blum po bcas bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / chos dbyings rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyis kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gtibs shing / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po rgyal ba rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' brgyad la sogs pa skyabs yul dam pa rnams sngon gyi thugs bskyed kyis bskul nas dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ rgyal po chen po rnams thos sras sogs gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyang dgyes bzhin byon nas ston pa'i bka' lung nod cing bzhugs par gyur/thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākyu'i rigs 'khrungs shing / / gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ / gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rigs lnga yum bzhi gtsug tor lha mo'i tshogs/ / gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ / rgyal chen rnam sras gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs/ / phyag bya kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ / skyabs yul 381

༄/ /yo cabs ba re'igayo laga'akhor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur nas/ /thub dbang bden pa'i dbyangs kyis bka' stsal te/ /nor lha'i tshogs kyis 'phrin las skyong gyur cig /ces pasngon du btang nasamado cha tshang ba tshar ci tsam nus pa bklag mjug tu/ thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyi bo nas zhugs te byin gyis brlabs pas zag pa med pa'i bde dga' khyad par can skyes/ de rnams kyis kyang sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa phyogs bcu kun tu spros te 'dzig rten khams kyi zas nor longs spyod mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor phywa g.yang thams cad bsdus te rang gi yul 'khor gnas khang thams cad khengs par bsams la/ oṃ be+e shra ma ṇa ya rat+na sirnyi sa ma ya hūṃ hrī zi/ zhesapa ci 'grub bzla/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ zhesasogasamado'i nang gi g.yang 'bod kyi gzungs ring yang ji ltar 'tsham pa re bzlasan legs/ gtor ma oṃ ā : lan gsum gyisabadud rtsir byin gyis brlabasal/ bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'dod don ma lus pa/ /lhun gyes grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ /thub dbang gdul bya'i skal ba dang / /'tsham par phan pa kun mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa de yis 'jig rten gyi/ /dpal 'byor ma lus 'du bar shog /dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun pa'i rkyen/ /ma tshang med pa la brten nas/ /bshad sgrub bya ba mthar phyin te/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni lhag bsam dang rnam dpyod mchog tu yangayopa rab 'byamasapablo bzang cho4'phel gyisamado 'di'i 'don thabs nor sgrub dang bcas pa zhig dgosatshul byung ba ltar/ rgyud chagasagasum pa la g.yang 'gug gi dmigasapasazur brgyan pa dang bcasapa 'di ni/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyobris pa'o/ /382

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/ro༅/ / mgon po che dpag med la stong mchod 'bul tshul bzhugs/༄7/ / phun sum tshogs pa mtshan dpe'i 'od stong gis/ / dus min 'chi ba'i mun pa mthar byed pa/ / tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa yi/ /zhabs sen 'bral med gtsug na mdzes gyur cig / gang gi mtshan tsam rna bar son pas kyang / /'chi bdag gshin rje'i 'jigs las grol gyur na/ /brgya phrag stong du phyag mchod mtshan smos pas/ / smon bzhin 'grub par nges pas 'dir zhugs shig / de'ang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la stong mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ cho ga'i gzhung kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i zhalasnga nas kyis mdzad pa'i tshe chog 'chi med bum bzang nyid gtso bor paṇa chen gyi gsung dang bstun zhing der mi gsal ba rnams kha bskangs/ skyed tshul sogs spyi 'gros dang bstun te 'jug pa bde bas/ 'dir de nyid gzhir bzhag nas stong mchod byed tshul 'god pa la/ phyogs gtsang mar dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ stegs mthon po'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte ba la tshe bum kha rgyan la dpag bsam gyi ljon pa'i nang du tshe dpag med kyi sku bzhugs pa'am/ yang na rin po che sogs kyi bum pa skyon med pa chu gtsangams sum gnyis bkang zhing bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas btab pa'i steng du tshe dpag med kyi sku bzhugs su bcug mthar chu dang nyer spyod sogs re re nas stong tshang ba'am/ de ma 'byor na mar me dang lha bshos stong re/ ma mtha' 'ang tshe'i rten 'brel yin pas lha bshos stong tshang nges pa dang / de bzhin du bcud len gye sman dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i phye ma snying po lnga dang bzang drug sogs bsres pa'i ril bu stong / dkyus ltar gye 'bul gtor rnams dang dkar gsum mngar gsum rnams sbyar ba'i gtor ril stong / / cha gsum 383

ro༅/ /gung thangabastanapa'atshanace' gsung 'bum/sogasaspyi dang mthun par bsham/ yar tshes lta bu'i dus khyad par can gyi tho rangs lag ris mthong ba'i tshod tsam la bla ma'am rten gyi drung nas theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong gi sdom pa blangs/ bdag bskyed gzhung bzhin lha dgu'am/yang na pad+ma mar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī dmar po/ zhesapa nas/ rang nyid sangs rgyas tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhes sbrel zhing / mchod pa'i skabs su sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa dor te gzhan rnams 'dra/ mdun gyi bum pa steng gi sku dang bcas pa la dmigs te a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa/ zhesapa nas/ dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dmar po/ zhesapa nas/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor zhes pa nas/ lha dgu la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ zhesapa man chad 'dra zhing / chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur ba las so so la 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyes dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis brlab/ na ma sarba burnya bodhi satā dī/ sarba thā ugo te spa ra ṇa hi mi ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod pa 'byung ba'i sngags bajod/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes sogs kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo'i bar dang / snod bcud 'jig rten snying po'i bcud bsdus pa/ /'chi med bdud rtsi sman dang bcud len rdzas/ / legs par sbyar ba'i zas mchog 'di 'bul gyi/ / tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / oṃ sarba bi da bru ra pū ra/su ra su ra/ ā wa rta ya ā wa rta ya ho badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes phul ba legs te/ ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ / 'bras bu de 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pa bzhin/ zhing khyad par can la dngos po gang phul yang rten 'brel gyes de nyid dngos grub kyi thog mar 'byung bar gsungs pas/ 'dir yang 384

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/tshe'i rdzas phul na tshe'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnad khyad par can yod do/ /de nas/ na ma sarba burnya bodhi satā ṭ+wāṃ/ sarba tra saṃ ku su mi ta a snyi dz+nyā rā shi ni na ma stu de swāhā/ zhes bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngags kyis thog drangs/ gang gi thugs rje'i bdud rtsi'i gzegs ma yis/ / dus min 'chi ba'i tsha gdung 'phrog byed cing / / bde legs kuji'i dga' tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ / tshe dpag med mgon lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ / rnam 'dren kun gyi sor rtog ye shes kyi/ / rang mdangs 'od mtshan dra bas 'khyud pa'i skur/ / bzhengs pa tshe dpag med mgon zhabs pad la/ / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas mchod cing bstod/ / 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ / dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ / mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ / sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis thugs ga'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod dang bcas pa'i tshe yar ba nyams pa 'thor ba rnams tshur bsdus/'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba chen po'i bkrag mdangs dang / 'jig rten che dgu rnams kyi tshe bsod nams/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs mtha' dag bsdus/ sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas sku lus kyi nang thams cad dang 'og gi bum pa yongs su gang / bdud rtsi'i gzeg mas rangadang bsgrub bya rnams kyi lus kyi nang thams cad kyang gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ de nas gzungs ring tshar re dang mchod par sbrags te 'don bzhin par skor ba byed cing / rten gyi mdun dngos su sleb pa na skor ba gcig gi yun la gzungs ci song ba'i grangs kyi bstod pa tshigs bcad re phyag dang sbrags par byed/ skor ba grangs ma 'dang ba rnams gzhan gyis bsab kyang rung / gzugs kyi mgor/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te zhes brjod pa 385

༄/ /gung thangabastanapa'isgronasa'i gsang 'thugan lha tshogs yid ngor 'char ba byas te thal mo sbyar nas mgo dud pa re byed/de ltar stong gi grangs tshang ba na gtor ril rnams bcu tshan du byed pa'am srung gtorakhyas la byen gyis brlabs/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / / rgyal dang rgyal sras slob mar bcas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rigs drug tshogs/ /gdon bgegs dang bcas mchog dman gyi/ /mgron rnams ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra arnya sogs kyis mchod/ sgrub pa po'i grangs kyis a kā ro stong gis grangasabasags te bsngo/ mchog dman bar ma'i mgron rnams kun/ / zag med bdud rtsis tshim byas pas/ / bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi/ /sgrib byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cig /brgya tshan so sor bsngon rje4ma bshamasate/ oṃ ā ྅ gis byin gyes brlabs nas mchod pa man chad sngar bzhinabya/ gtso bo'i gtor ma chos skyong gi gtor ma sogs phyogs gcig tu byin gyis brlabs la mdun bskyed kyi mjug tu 'byung ba bzhin dbul/ gzhi bdag gtor ma'i mjug tu cha gsum spyi ltar bsngo/ 'on kyang rten 'brel khyad par can gyi tshe yi dwags ni bsod nams shin tu dman pas dngos grub sgrub pa'i rten 'brel la cung zad 'dzem ste de'i gtor ma mjug tu mi spyor ba phyag len yin pas/ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ces pa'i mtshams su 'jog /gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te tshigs bcad dang bcas pas gong bzhin dbul/ nyi gzhon 'char ka ma sogs bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'azin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba brgyad 386

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig ༅ sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/sogs kyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs te 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob cing / de la brten nas thos bsam sgom gsum sogs rnam dkar gyi 'dod don mtha' dgayid kyis smon pa bzhin du 'grub par byin gyes brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ sku dang dkyil 'khor sogs yod na/ spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams rten dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ ces su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ med na/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ ces 'od zhu byed cing bkra shis pa'i me tog gis char dbab bo/ / dge 'dis bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / / sa dbang sku tshe chab srid dar ba dang / / yul ljongs dge bcu'i dpal gyes 'tsho ba yis/ / dge legs snang bas nor 'dzinakhyab gyur cig / cesamagon po tshe dpag med la stod mchod 'bul tshul bzhin 'di ni sa skyong mi'i dbang phyug o thog jo nong tā pe li bsod namasarab rgyasadage 'dun gyis lha rdzasamadzod btagasagos chen yug bcas bskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rmad byung thugs rje'i gangs kyi ri/ / dad pa'i nyi gzhon gyis bzhus pas/ /byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun 'bebs pa/ spyan ras gzigs mgon de yis skyongs/ / 'dir rang cag kha ba can pa rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha gcig 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bum sgrub byed tshul la thog mar bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / oṃ su bhā shurnya saze dhaspo su bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrī dkar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi donakhyas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras 387

༄/ /yo ོba yo ཿ sa ཿmgazigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs gar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang /g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing / zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po ta la nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/oṃ badz+ras ma dza dza 4 baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hrī yas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya thi ye 〉 rtu/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ subhā wagastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi la rnam pa rang rang gi byed las khyad par can dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā : gis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan/ thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ / spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hrī0dkar po gyen du langs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ de las 388

༄/ /'jam dpal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduspa'i sgrub thabs/'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ rigs drug gi sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par du oṃ las 'od zer 'phros lha'i 'chi 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ ma las 'od zer 'phros lha ma yin gyi 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ṇi las 'od zer 'phros mi'i skye rgan 'chi'i sdug bsngal sbyangs/ 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ pad las 'od zer 'phros dud 'gro'i glen lkug gi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ me las 'od zer 'phros yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ 'phags pa'i go 'phangs la bkod/hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dmyal ba'i tsha grang btso bsreg gi sdug bsngal sbyangs/'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes ci nus bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskangs te mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ de nas bum pa a sri tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byungaba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyangab la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ taste taste mahā taste swāhā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/bum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du yi ge hrī dkar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhes pa nas/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes sogs nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ / spro na rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma'i mjug tu/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shā ra arnya pra tī smo swāhā/ zhesasogasasbyar te dbul/ bstod pa ni/ dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ / zhesapa nas/ snying nas gzigs shig thugs rje rgyal ba'i lha/ / zhes pa'i bar ram/ sku na/ skyon gyes 389

༄/ /yo cabastanami'irna mtha g.yo lam/ma gos zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo tī yig dkar po gyen du langs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ rig drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor yul ljongs dang bcas pa la gnod pa'i pha rol gye bsam ngan sbyor tsub/ nad mug 'khrug rtsod/ sad ser than pa sogs mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i rigs mtha' dag dang / de'i rgyu thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul zhing / de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kye byin rlabs nus mthu ma lusapa bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur par bsams la/ bzlas pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i sgo nas ma ṇi ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgya dang mchod bstod mdor bsdusabyu/ thun rjes ma'i tshe/ stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa zhes dang / bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces sogs sbyar te sngar yod gsal 'debs kyi tshul du bya/dgung thun la yig brgya'i mjug tu/ gtor ma a mṛ ta4bsangs/ su bhāwasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā : lan gsum gyis byin gyisabarlabs/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke sha ra i de ba blata kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ arnya sogs kyis mchod cing / skyon gyiyom gosazhes sogasakyis bstod/ rgyal kun snying rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /khyod min re ba'i skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa kun bsal nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 390

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/ma lus stsol/ / khyad par sngon tshe srog gcod rku 'phrog sogs/ / byas pa'i 'bras bu nad rims 'khrug rtsod dang / / snod bcud g.yang nyams dbul zhing phongs pa sogs/ / rgud pa'i nyes pa mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod/ /mdor na las nyon dri ma kun byang nas/ / gnas skabs chos 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang / / mthar thug nges legs rgyal ba'i gnas thob ste/ / mkha' mnyama'agro ba kun gyi don byed shog / ces pa lta bus skabs thob kyi 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ gang yang bdag blo sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ grol kha'i thun la de'i mtshams su/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gye gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ / zhes sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdud rtsi'i chus/ / 'gro ba'i las nyon sdig sgrib dang / /snyigs ma'i tsha gdung kun bcil te/ / bde chen dpal la 'god gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni ze bo sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin lags kyis gtsosatsho ba'i gra pa rnams kyis bskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes 7skyabasamagon mchog gi gsung la gzhi byas te bsgrigasapa'o/ /na ma spra ra ste/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ su'i was stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rang sems trī yig dkar po/de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid pi wang lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ lang tsho rgyas shing rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ tsog pu'i stabs kyis bzhugs te phyag gnyis kyis be+eḍūr+ya'i rgyud mangs bsgrengs shing zur mig g.yo ba/ de'i thugs gar srog gi ngo bo yi dkar po'i nā da las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi lha mo dbyangs can ma'i thugs ka nas 391

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'irna ce' gsung 'gyamashes rab kyi 'khor lo bkug ste rang gi snying ga'i yi la bstem/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang gi snying gar shes rab kyi 'khor lo pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la sgyu yig dang / 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs bcu drug gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros te lus kyi nang gang / mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sangs/ shes bya thams cad la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par gyur par bsams la/ bhā zhes ci nus bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskangs/ rang skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal bo mi g.yo ba'i skur gyur par bsams la bsngo ba'i mtshams sbyor bya/ mjug tu gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ bsangs sbyangs/bdudañtsar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros lho phyogs rgya mtsho chen po nas lha mo dbyangs can ma spyan drangs la/ a kā ro lan gsum gyisadabul/ su ra suste arnya sogs kyis mchod/ ma lus rgyal ba skyedamadzad cing / / mi zad ngag gi dpal ster ma/ / dbyangs can lha mos rjes bzung ste/ / blo gros snang ba stsal tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab ste mdun gyi lha mo rang la thim par bsams shing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di'ang mkhar sngon thu med shog nasadad ldan 'jigs med dar rgyasakyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabri4pa'o/ /༄7/ / rta mgrin gsang sgrubakyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/༄za/ / rang bzhin spros bral dbyings su pad nyi la/ / rang sems hrī yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar po dbang gi lha/ /dmar ljang dkar ba'i zhal gsum khro gnyer g.yo/ / gsum gsum spyan gyi glog dmar drag tu 'khyug / mched pa rab dkar ti se'i gangs kyi ri'i/ /khongs las gdug pa'i khrag gi gaṅgā 'bab/ / g.yas kyis rdo rje rtse gsum ral 392

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig ma sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/gri 'bar/ / g.yon pas sdegs mdzub mdung dang zhags pa 'dzin/ / skam rlonasago 'phreng rus pa'i rgyan mang 'khol/ / steng na ha har bzhad pa'i rta ljang gi/ / zhal gsum phyogs su rngam pas srid gsum g.yo/ / brkyang bskum zhabs brgyad brdab pas klu chen 'dul/ / me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa yi/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan sa bon gyes/ / ye shes padang dbang lha spyan drangs te/ / dam ye gcig gyur dbang lhas dbang bskur cing / /chu yi lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ / chos sku ye shes 'od mtha' yas pa'i ngang / / long sku dbang chen lha dang dbyer med pa'i/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma sprul sku'i rnam pa can/ / mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas bdun rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams/ / skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs pas dbu brgyan cing / de yi thugs gar hrī la sngags gsum gyis/ / bskor ba las babs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / sdig sgrib nad gdon tshe yi bar chad sogs/ / nyes kun lhag med byang zhing bla ma lha'i/ / byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus thob par gyur/ / ces bsam zhing tshe gzungs ring thung / rta mgrin gyi sngags/ bla ma'i mtshan sngags rnams bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mdun du bde stong ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ / mchod rdzas zag med bde ster sprin 'khrigs pas/ / pad+ma dbang gi lha mchog dgyes gyur te/ / don gnyis dngos grub ma lus stsol gyur cig / nyer bzhi'i dbyings su khro ba mi mnga' yang / / khros pa'i gar gyis bdud sde phye mar brlag / rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i skyabs kyi mchog /bcom ldan khro bo'i dbang po khyod la bstod/ / bdag gis khyod zhabs pad+mo gus brten nas/ / rtse gcig re ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / dam chos sgrub pa'i bar chad kun sel zhing / / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / de nas thugs ga'i sa bon sngags phreng las/ / rang sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing 'od zer dang / / zhi khro sprul ba dpag med 'phro ba yis/ /393

sa / /gung thangabastanapa'azla ce' gas 'a gdonaganyis las bzhi mtha' dag sgrub par gyur/ / ces rtsa sngags bzla zhing de'i tshe re zhig bar du rgyal ba sras bcas mchod nas byin rlabs bsdus te zhugs pas nyes tshogs mtha' dag byang zhing / de dag gi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad thob par bsam pa rang don byin rlabs bsdu ba'i dmigs pa gtso bor bya/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa gzhan don 'phrin las kyi dmigs pa bya/ de nas khro chung dang me dpung spros te gdon bgegs thams cad bsreg pa gnod byed tshar gcod pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ / spyir phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid bzhi dang / bsnyen sogs bzhi/ las bzhi sogs bsnyenadamigs mang du bshad kyang rtsa ba 'di gsum du 'dus so/ / thun gyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra nyun : trig nan dza dza sa ma ya snyi/ zhes sde brgyad dbang sdud dam/ gshed 'bebs kye sngags nyer gcig tsam re bzla zhing / de'i tshe rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal lhag par shugs drag tu bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer drag cing tsub pa dpag tu med pa spros te sde brgyad so so'i mthu stobs nus pa rnams rang rang gi sa bon gye rnam par sdud cing / de'ang lha'i a dkar po/ gshin rje'i ya/ ma mo'i ma/ bdud kyi du gsum nag po/gza'i ru khra bo/ btsan dang rgyal po'i tsa dmar po/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i sha ser po/ klu dang sa bdag gi na sngo skya dang / gnod byed rigs gang yin ngos mi zin pa la spyi'i srog yig bre yig gi rnam par bsdus te rang gi zhabs 'og tu gdan la sib sib thim par bsams/ yang gnod byed shin tu tsub pa rnams kyi snying ga nas rang rang gi dngos ma'i tshe srog sa bon gye rnam par bsdus te rang la thim par bsam pas gnod byed sgrol ba dang / de'i tshe bcud rang gis thob pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod par gsung / las sngags mi 'dra ba ci rigs 'byung bas/ rgyal dbang gi gsung ltar na/ sa ma yacapa sa ma la bzlog/ sa ma ya spyo sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma 394
