༄/ /'jamadapaladapa'abogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad thud/ phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dza dza zhes pa 'di yina'i/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos/ oṃ haṃ sha trig trig nan/ trig hur sum̐ dza mā ra la phaṭa/ oṃ ru trig trig ru trig trig nan/ trig hur bye dzamā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa 'di las sngags su mdzad pas rang gi mos pa dang bstun te rtsa sngags dang sdud sngags kyi bsnyen pa'i rjes su 'di gnyis gang rung zhing / de'i tshe dmigs pa ni gnod byed de nyid rang gi mdun du bkug pa'i snying gar hūṃ dmar po las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa kha dog dmar po rno ngar dang ldan pa gcig tu gyur te g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor bas gnod byed kyi srog rtsa nang khrol dang bcas pa thams cad nyal nyal bcad cing gtub nas thal bar brlag par bsams/ byad phur gyi ltas sogs la bzlog pa gtso bor byed dgos pa byung na/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ pha rol gyi byad ma rbod gtong dang bcas pa lba ra ya phaṭa/ ces spel tshig btags nas bzla zhing thal mo brdeb/ bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang / / pad+ma dbang chenabaden stobs kyis/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod la/ / gnod cing 'tshe ba thams cad bzlog / gdon dang bgegs kyi dpung tshogs bsgog / nad rims dus min 'chi ba bzlog / 'thab rtsod kha smras gleng gzhibazlog / rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog / pha rol byad kha phur kha bzlog / rgyal 'gong dam sre'i cho 'phrul bzlog / mdor na 'gal rkyen bar chad tshogs/ / thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la spyo / thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la spyo / mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ / nas/ rgyas par mdzod cig khro bo'i rgyal/ / de nas rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma lha/ / 'od zhu rang gi sems dang dbyer med gyur/ / ye shes sems dpa' rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ / rang nyid rta mgrin phyag gnyis rnam par gyur/ / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas/ / 'gro ba gcig 395

༄/ /yo ca bam 4tshanas ga 4ma kyangam lus pa/ / de yi sa la 'god par shog / zlog pa mi byed na bzlas pa'i 'phror spyi bo'i bla ma bstem pa sogs byas te bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo/ /zhes pa 'di ni dur bin khu'u kheng tā lbang gi shog nagalhag bsam rnam dpyod yangagapa gu dziblo bzang cho4grag4kyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsunapa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yege pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /༄༅/ / 'khor chen mngonartogs bzhugs/ /༄7/ / stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi mthu dang stobs/ / ches cher gtum po'i gar mdzad khro bo che/ / rnam kun gtsug gis bsten no bdag sogasarnams/ / rjes chags snying rjes 'bral med rjes su skyongs/ / de'ang phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i mngon rtogs mdor bsdus nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis skyabs sems sngon du btang / su'i was stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la tshangs pa dkar po mgo g.yas su bstan te kha spub tu bsgyel ba'i sog phrag tu nyi ma/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mthu stobs nus pa ma lus pa gcig tu bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag rna rdo rje 'khor lo chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal mthing ga g.yas zhal dkar po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ khro gnyer smin phrag tu bsdus shing / spyan rnams dmar la blum pa/ lngags 'dril zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du badzes shing mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing / g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ bar ba 396

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduspa'i sgrub thabs/gnyis thal mo'i sgra bsgrag cing yum la 'khyud pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis klu stobs rgyu dang rigs ldan nag po'i rked pa nas bzung ste mgo bo zhal du gsol zhing mjug ma zhabs 'og tu mnan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu rigs bzhis sku la brgyan pa/ de'i bang na yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yon thod khrag yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ ral pa kham ser phyed bcings su byas shing / dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan cing /zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par ā thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang spyan ma la sogs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du hūṃ zhu ba las rang bzhin bde stong / rnam pa mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa/ byed las zag med kyi bde ba ster ba'i khyad par gsum dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum dang / oṃ a ā rtu/ nas/ ma sta ā ྅ gi bar gyi4byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi a nas/ shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyes mchod/ oṃ 〉 rtu btags la nang mchod dbul/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ / kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ / bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa'i/ / 'khor lo'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ rang gi thugs gar hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer dus mtha'i me 'od lta bu 'phros/ thog med nas 397

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /༄7/ /drag po sum dril gyi mngonartags bzhugs/༄༅/ / na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ oṃ su bhā wasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du rang sems hūṃ yig mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo phyag na rdo rje g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub gdengs pas steng gdon gza'i gnod pa thams cad zlog par mdzad pa/ khro bo'i nyams thams cad rdzogs shing brkyang bskum gyi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor pad+ma'i rigs thams cad kyi ngo bo rta zhal ljang nag rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phro zhing rta skad drag tu bzhad pas bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po thams cad byer bar mdzad pa/de'i spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi ngo bo bya khyung ga ru ṭa dkar po sbrul za zhing gnam lcags kyi mchu sder dang sgro gshog can 'og gdon klu'i rigs thams cad 'dul bar mdzad pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ rta zhal gye mgrin par ā phyag rdor gyi thugs gar hūṃ/ de gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rim pa bzhin sku rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje/ thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams spyanadrangs/ sku'i cha thams cad nas sib kyis thim pas gnyen po lha gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/mchod pa byin gyes brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dug gsum rang mdangs gdon gsum 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rigs gsum lha tshogs sku gsung thugs gsum gyi/ / gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gnyen po lha gsum du/ /shar la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang gi thugs gar nyi ma 3༅

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'itshonas gsung 'bum/la hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las me'i tsha tsha dpag tu med pa spros/gnod byed gdon gsum tshar bcad/ me dpung 'bar ba'i rwa gur gyes yongs su bskor cing sngags kyi rang sgra drag po sa gsum du khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ha ya shrī wa ga ru ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhing mchod bstod bsngo pa spyi ltar bya/ 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa bde tshang dponapo dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rang bzhin spros bral stong ba'i ngang nyid las/ / stobs ldan glang bos btegs pa'i rin chen khri/ / pad+ma zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng / /rang gi sems nyid hūṃ dang rdo rje las/ / bcom ldan mi 'khrugs mgon po sku mdog sngo/ / thun mtshams gos gyon be+eḍūr ri bo bzhin/ / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar sa gnon mnyam gzhag gis/ / dri med gser gye rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams/ /gnas gsum yi ges mtshan pa'i hūṃ yig las/ / 'od 'phros shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba nas/ / sras bcas rgyal bas bskor ba'i mi 'khrugs mgon/ / spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ /kun bzang smon pa'i mthu las byung ba yi/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yod lnga/ / rin chen bdun sogs rab 'byams mchod pa'i tshogs/ / gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ / thog ma med nas bsags pa'i nyes kun dang / / khyad par sdom gsum bcas 'gal ltung ba kun/ / snying nas mthol lo lhag med byang gyur te/ /tshul khrims phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyes rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas ye shes pa/ /mtha' dag rang la thim zhing rang nyid kyi/ /snying gar sa bon sngags kyes bskor ba las/ /'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing kun khyab par spros/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i nyes stung lhag med du/ /sbyangs nas mi 'khrugs go 'phang la bkod cing / /rgyal kun byin 400

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/rlabs sngags 'phreng la bsdus pa'i/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus kun gang bar gyur/ / cesaspro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas ke ka ni bzla/ mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / tshul khrims dag pa'i rang 'od 'bar ba'i sku/ / tshul 'chal nyes ltung dri ma 'khrud pa'i gsung / / tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab rdzogs pa'i thugs/ / mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / mngon dga'i zhing ngam nub phyogs bde ldan du/ / 'dab stong pad+ma'i snying po las skyes nas/ / rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / gsung gi bdud rtsis blo gros lus rgyas te/ / mdo sngags lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /mtha' dag bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las rgyal ba/ / mi bskyod mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog nam mkhas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /na mo mi tri ya/ su'i was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la mai yig ser bo de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po gser gye mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad de klu shing yalag me tog dang bcas pa 'dzin pa'i g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon spyi blug gis mtshan pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / lha'i gos kyi na bza' can mtshan dpes spras shing / bzang po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par be+e thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/dga' ldan nas byams mgon ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur/ār+ya me tri pū dza me gha sa mu tra sba ra ṇa sa ma ye shrī ye hūṃ/ byams chen me yis zheyosogs kyis bstod/ thugs gar zla ba la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 401

sa / /gung thangabastanaba'izla sa' gas 'chaga'aphros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob par gyur/ byam4palodam bca'i gzungasadang / mami mi tri ye swāhā/ zhesaci mang bzla/bstod pa rgyasabasdus ci rig4kyi mthar/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po thugs rje'i gter/ / mgon med nyam thag bdag gi mgon mdzod la/ / deng nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / nam yang 'bral med rjes su bzung du gsol/ / rnam dag tshul khrims nges 'byung byang chub sems/ / rgya chen gzhung don 'byed pa'i shes rab sogs/ / lung rtogs yon tan ma lus lhun rdzogs te/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i pha rol son par shog / khyad par skye bu tshe lo brgyad khri'i tshe/ / byams mgon rgyal ba'i nyi ma shar ba na/ / thog ma kho nar bdag blo 'dab brgya'i kha/ / phye nas lam bzang 'bras bu sman par shog /'dis mtshon dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ / zhes sogalobasngo bas mtshamayosbyar te rang la thim par bsam pa'am/ yang na rgyun du bzhugs te rang gi skyor sbyangayosogasabyed pa'i tshe yang byam4mgon gyi gsungasalhang lhang 'chad pa'i rjesasuzlosabar mosan byin rlabs myur shing / chos kyis rgyud la phan che bar gsungasapasade ltar bya'o/ /ces pa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong dkon mchog chos bzang gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabri4pa'o/ /༄༅/ / 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i mngon rtogs blo gros mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / skal bzang bsod nams shar ri'i rtse mo nas/ / thugs rje ga bur 'od kyi rtse dga' yis/ / ma rig mun sel rje btsun mkhyen pa'i 402

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa'aragacig sgrub sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/gter/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bos gzungs spobs mchog stsol cig /'dir rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar po la brten nas mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ subhā was stang par sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar zhing dwangs pa'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du rang sems a yig dkar po de las 'od 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis yut+pa la'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba thugs gar bzung ba snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba'i steng na stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing / bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ mtshan dpes spras shing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/de'isti bor oṃ/ mgrin par yā thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ār+ya mdzi shrī a nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ ngo bom nor chos nyid rab mkhyen cing / / rnam pa ma lus chos can lhang nger gzigs/ / thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis/ / srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhesapasabastod/ rang gi snying rtse mo gyen bstan pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha 'bus rnam par phye ba'i dbus su ral gri'i 'khor lo bas drug pa rtse mo rno ba'i lte bar zla ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas g.yas skor gyes oṃ wa kye de na ma zhes pa'i yi ge 'bru drug 'khor lo la ma reg par gnas pa/ 'khor lo g.yas dang yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor ba/ yig rku3

༄/ /gung thang bstanaḥrmayo gotshi 4ma/'bru rnams kha dog dkar zhing 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi mkhyen rab ma lus pa bsdus te sngags 'phreng la bstem pas shes bya thams cad la blo gros kyi snang ba thogs pa med par rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ wa kye de na ma zhes dpa' bo 'bru drug gtso bor bzlas la/ thun 'jog khar rang gi lce'i steng du a dkar po zhig gnas par gyur pa de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de dag gi thugs ka nas a dkar po grangs med pa byung ste rang gi lce steng gi a la thim/ thugs ga'i a yig las kyang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gsung rab kyi tshig don mtha' yas pa dbyangs gsal gyi rnam par drangs te snying gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams kyi ngos su bkod/ sngags phreng mar me lta bu'i 'od kyis bkra lam me gsal bar byas shing / mthar gre phug gi a de nyid las rang 'dra mang du chad pas snying ga'i pad+ma kha zum pa'i phyi rol nas go mtshams med par dkris shing khong pa'i nang thams cad gang / ba sru'i khung bu rnams kyang a yig re res gtams pas tshig don mtha' dag mi brjed pa'i gzungs khyad par can thob par bsams la/ a rkyang ba brgya stong sogs bzla/ mjug tu yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskung / chos kun tshig don mi brjed dran pa'i gzungs/ / dri ba kun gyi lan ldon spobs pa mchog / myur du bskyed nas chos kyis phongs rnamasal/ / legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor blum po bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du oṃ ā ḍū zhu ba las gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum gyes byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ga'i 404

༄/ /yo cab ba'i ma'i go las/dkar gyi 'phreng ba dang / g.yon 'og mas gser gyi pad+ma bsnams pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab ste lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan rgyas spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par yāthugasakar hūṃ/ thugasaka'i hūṃ lasa'od zer 'phros pas/ nub phyogasabade ba can nasamagon po 'od dpag med dang 'phags pa spyan rasagazigasa'akhor bcasaspyan drangs/ 'phags mchog spyan ra4gzigasa'akhor bcas rang la thim zhing / mgon po 'od dpag med kyis dbang bskur te spyi bor rigasakyi bdag po'i tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa amṛtasabasangs/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che pa'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin mchod pa'i rdzas phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ ākhye lo ke shwa ra a sogayokyisamachod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogayokyi4bstod/ rang gi thugs gar zla gdan la hrī yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pa sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor zug pa'i rtse mor mgon po spyan ras gzigs re re bzhugs/ de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dmyal ba pa rnams tsha grang dang / yi dwags rnams bkres skom dang / dud 'gro rnams bkol spyad gcig la gcig za dang / lha ma yin rnams 'thab rtsod dang / mi rnams skye rga na 'chi dang / lha rnams 'chi 'pho 'og ltung sogs kyi sdug bsngal las thar par byas/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i skur bzhengs te bde ba can du gshegs/ yang sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne mor mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa 'khod de rgyal ba sras bcasal mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum byin gyis brlab par gyur par bsams la/ gzungs ring tshar bdun dang yig drug ci 'grub bzla/ mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces 406

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduba'i sgrub thabs/sogs dang / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ zhes sogs bsngosgon gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / zhegapa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog thabasamakhasakyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me4sbyar ba'i yege babikhru ra ā nan+ta'o/ /rnam dag 'od gsal dbyings las pad zla'i steng / / rang sems 6 yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang zha' / gcig phyag bzhi pa/ / sku mdog rab dkar rtsa phyag thal sbyar zhing / / lhag mas shel 'phreng gser gyi pad+ma bsnams/ / rin chen rgyan spras dar gyi na bza' can/ / skyil krung gis bzhugs dpral mgrin snying ga ru/ yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ / rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha/ / spyan drangs ye shes pa rnams dbyer med du/ / bstem zhing dbang gi lha yis dbang bskur te/ / spyi bor 'od dpag med pas rgyas btab gyur/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs kun 'bul na/ / brtse chen thugs rje'i stobs kyis legs bzhes shing / / bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdig ltung kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas 'gro kun gye/ / spyi bor byon nas byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chus/ / sgrib sbyangs spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bsgyur te/ / ma lus mgrin gcig gzungs sngags bsgrag par gyur/ / ces tshig ris ltar gyi dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas gzungs ring ci 'grub kyis thog drangs te yig drug ci sbogs bzla/ mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskad/ 'di yi dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / spyan ras gzigs kyis dge ba'i bshes mdzad de/ / yang dag lam bzang gegs med myur bgrod nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro kun srid las sgrol gyur cig / khyad par 'di snang 'gag par rtsom pa na/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang 'dzum zhal mngon gyur te/ / bu bu dag pa'i rku7

༄rngo/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgonace' gsung 'bum/zhing 'dir shog cig ces/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der 'khrid gyur cig /ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas pas kyang / / zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes te/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang sgrub pa yi/ /'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rab 'byams ngag dbang chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /na mo badz+ra satwa ya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi dmigs pa ni/mngon rtogs cho ga gang yang rung ba'i gzhung bzhin byas la sngags bzla pa'i tshe/rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor yang rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum zung re bzhugs pa de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ yig la yig brgya dkar pos bskor ba/mgrin par 〉 yig la yig brgya dmar pos bskor ba/ thugs gar hūṃ yig la yig brgya sngon pos bskor ba bsams te yig brgya bzlas pas/ de dag so so las rang mdog gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas sku lus thams cad gang / de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba'i dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag sems can thams cad kye spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa'i spyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ so so'i spyi bo nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas thog med nas bsags pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs te rdo je sems dpa'i skur bsgyur/ mthar de dag thams cad rim gyis bsdus te spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' la bstem/ des rigs kye bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag go zhes gsungs nas rangal thim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ bum sgrub sogs byed na bum nang gi rdo rje 408

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/sems dpa'i sku las 'od zer spro ba sogs byas te/ mthar de thams cad bsdusanas bum pa'i nang gi rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i cha thams cad dang khyad par thugs ga'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams na legs so/ / zhesadamigs rim snying por dril ba 'di yang dka' bcu byams pa chos ldan gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesadagon lung du brisapa'o/ /na mo gu ru su ra su)/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo sgrub par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du btang / su bhā wasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du rang sems hrī yig dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus te ye shes kyi me long gcig tu gyur/de zhu ba las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rin po che dang g.yon pas me long bsnams pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ nu 'bur rgyas shing zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyun dang dar gyi na bza' can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā0 thugs ga'i hūṃ/ thugs gar hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza ka baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a nab/ shasta pra tī ts+tsha swāhā'i bar gyes mchod/ blo gros snang ba rgyas mdzad cing / / mi zad ngag gi dpal ster ba/ / rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig pu/ / sgra dbyangs lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod/rangagi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrī yig gi mthar sngags kyes bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ las nyon sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs kyis dag rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen rab ma lus pa hrī yig gi rnam par bsdus/ snying gar thim pa'i 'od kyis khong ba'i nang thams cad gang / shes bya thams cad la blo gros rgyas par gyur par bsams rku9

༄/ /gung thangabastanaba'izla ce' gsung 'phagal/ oṃ su ra su ste sgyu sgyu sgyu swāhā/ zhesabazla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhing mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sgra dbyangs lha mo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo/ /zhesapa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog blo gsal gyi4bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yoge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /༄khya/ /seng ldeng nags sgrol la brtenanas tshe sgrubabyu tshul bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las kai la sha ri'i rgyun/ /'azin las klung bzhir 'bebs mdzad bcom ldan ma/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs pad la btud nas/ /de yi tshe sgrub gdams pa mdo tsam bri/ de'ang seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten nas tshe sgrub bya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis rje btsun ma'i sku dang bum pa mchod gtor sogs 'du byas te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa nyams su blangs par bya'o/ /snyam pa gsum sogs bya'o/ /rang nyid rje btsun ma seng sdeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgyas ut+pal bsnams pa/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing / dar bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba mtshan dpes spras pa/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par 〉 thugs gar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs 410

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/ga'ihūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha rnams spyan drangs/ ma rtu baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta asnyi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ su wasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ yi ar+ghaṃ ā :/ nas/ mashasta ā ྅/ gi bar gyis byin gyi4brlabs/ oṃ yār+ya tā re a sogs kyisamachod/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis/ / zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud cing / / phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ / sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhe4pasabastod/ rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du rta yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus te dzim par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ zhesayi ge bcu ba ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgyasalhag chad bskang zhing / mchod bstod mdor bsdusabya/ mdun bskyed la yang seng ldeng nagasasgrol byas chog kyang / spyir sgrol ma nyer gcig tu byas pa ni/ sprul gzhi'am rtsa ba seng ldeng nags sgrol nyid kyi sgo nas las tshogs so sor sgrub pa'i ched yin pas/ jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyis sgrolayang bdag skyed mdzad de/ de'i sgo nas mdun bskyed tha dad pa'i las tshogs rnams sgrub par mdzad pa bzhin/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang skyid shod pas kyang gsungs pas/ 'dir yang bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i 411

sa / /gung thangabastanapa'azla sa' gsung 'bum/gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgo nas bya ste/ de yang bum pa bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ 0ste 〉ste ma hā hāste swāhā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tai yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na tshe'i bum pa ser po dang / g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgyas ut+pal bsnams pa/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing / dar bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ mtshan dpes spras pa/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing / g.yon bskums pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ/thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs par bsams la/'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /rmad byung thugs rje'i gru gzings kyis/ /sgrol ba'i thugs dam bcas pa bzhin/ / dam tshig chen pos ye gye hi/ /ma rtu paṃ ho de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khyeñtsa paṃ/zhes dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsams/ de nas sgo gsumagus pas/ phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor/ / mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma/ / ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i/ / rgyal ba'i sras kyis shin tu bsten ma/ / zhes sho lo ka gcig gis phyag bya/ /mchodapa rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ ār+ya tā re arnya nas/ shasta'i bar 412

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lha duma'i sgrub thabs/gyis mchod/ dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ / thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ / skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / / 'khor ba ma stongs bar du rtag bzhugs nas/ / 'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ / bdag gzhan dge rnams byang chub chen por bsngo/ / zhes yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus phul nas/ mdun gye rje btsun ma'i thugs ka dang bum nang du zla gdan la tai yig gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog ser pos bskor ba/ sngags phreng gnyis las 'od zer dmar ser lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad dang / khyad par du 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa thams cad kyi tshe dang ye shes thams cad 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi dmar ser gyi rnam par bkug bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku'i cha dang phyag gi bum pa la thim/ rje btsun ma'i sku'i cha dang phyag gi bum pa las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bum pa 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang bar bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re ā yu sto na pukhyo ku ru swāhā/ zhes dmigs pa dang sbrags te ci mang bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum/ mtshan sngags la ba bla ta btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyes dbul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya zhing / bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo/ /nyin du mar byed na lha 'od zhu mi byed par rjes ma'i tshe sngar 'od gsal 'debasakyi tshul du bya zhing / grol kha'i thun mthar/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur bar bsams/ bum sgrub dang ma 'brel bar rgyun 413

༄/ /yo bstonapa'isgronasa' ga 'thugagyi rnal 'byor du byed na/ mdun bskyed sgom pa'i tshe/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la te yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma skyed cing / bzlas pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag gi bum pa la thim/ zhes pa'i 'phror/ de las kyang 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ dus dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa bsal/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re ā yu dz+nyā na puzlo ku ru swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas pas tshe lo brgyar 'phel bar 'gyur bar gsungs so/ / mjug gi mchod bstod bsngo ba sogs kyimathar bdag mdun gye ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa ring nyid la bstem ste bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /rgyal yum thugs rje rin chen 'byung gnas las/ / 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang nyer blangs pa'i/ dge bas mthar byed g.yul ngo las rgyal te/ yang dgalam la ring du slob gyur cig / cesapa 'di ni mos brtson lhag bsam dge bar 'byamasapa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /mdun du seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla/ / sku mdog sngon po be+eḍū ra ri bo bzhin/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin sman gyi sdong po dang / /g.yon pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams/ /skyil krung gis bzhugs mtshan dpes spras pa yi/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ gis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ / phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun dang bcas spyan drangs te/ /bstem pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur/ / thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel/ / dug gsum nad sel 414

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ / baiḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sbrul pa'i/ / mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdeg ltung thams cad bshags/ / dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ / 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ / sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ / baiḍūr+ya 'dra'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gsal/ / thabs shes stobs kyis longs spyod mi zad sbyin/ / nyan rang rnams kyang jeg chen lam du gzhug / ming tsam thos pas tshul khrims rnam par dag / dbang po kun tshang lus kyi skyon kun bral/ / bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nang kyi gdud ba zhi/ / bud med lus spangs skyes pa'i dbang bor ldan/ / lta bangan pa'i g.yang sa ring du spangs/ / rgyal po'i chad pa sogs kyi 'jigs las sgrol/ / bkres skom dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi/ / tsha grang gdung skyob gos dang rgyan sogs 'byor/ / de ltar smon lam chen po bcu gnyis kyis/ / mtshon pa'i gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod don kun/ /gegs med bde blag nyid du 'grub pa ru/ / bla ma lha yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / de ltar gsol btab thugs ga'i sngags phreng las/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi / gtsug nas zhugs/ / las nyon sdig ltung dri ma kun byang zhing / / sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhe ṣa byo gu ru baiḍū rā pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā gtā ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ bud dhā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sti ṣa dz+re snyi dzu/ mahā lha ṣa dz+re sti ṣadz+re/ rā dzā sa mugo tesāhā/ zhes gzungs ring dam/ yang na/ tabya thā/ oṃ dhi ṣa dz+re snyi ṣa byo/mahā snyi ṣa byo snyi ṣa dzu/ rā dzā sa mugo te swāhā/ zhes gzungs ring thung gi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ 'dis mtshon dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / bla ma sman pa'i rgyal pos rjes bzung ste/ / be+eḍūr+ya snang zhing dang bde ldan du/ / skyes nas yang dag lam bzang bgrod gyur cig / 'brel thogs pha ma rigs drug 415

sa / /gung thangabastan pa'izla ces gsung 'bum/'gro kun kyang / /mi khom skyon spangs nad rims kun dang bral/ / srid dang zhi ba'i g.yangs las brgal nas/ / bla med byang chub mchog la 'god gyur cig /de nas bla ma spyi bo nas snying gar spyan drangs par bsam la/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med sman gyi bla/ / bdag gi snying khar pad zla'i gdan bzhugs la/ zhes sogayodang / /bye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / / zhes sogs smon pas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhesapa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog dar rgya4kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru lo ke sha rā ya/ skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ bla ma dang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i mos gus dang /rang nyid srid zhi'i rgud pa las skyob pa'i skyabs gnas yang dag zhu snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas te/ tshig don yid la dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas/spyi bor pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng na/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /ngo bo dbyer med 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / ston zla ltar dkar zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba/ / rtsa phyag thal sbyar rgyal kun thugs rje bskul/ / lhag ma'i phyag gis shel phreng pad sdong bsnams/ / thugs rje'i spyan gyes mkha' mnyam 'gro la gzigs/ / dar zab rin chen rgyan ldan skyil krung mdzad/ / mtha' yas yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang / / chos srung rgya mtshos bskor ba thams cad la/ / rang rang gnas nas byon pa'i rang rang gi / ye shes pa rnams dbyer med dzim par gyur/ / dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma 'od dpag med/ / mkha' khyab bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i slad/ /'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs dbang gi / rnal rol skyabs kyi dam par gus phyag 'tshal/ / rnam dkar 'bras bcas khyed la 'bul lags na/ /sdig ltung ma lus byang bar byin gyes rlobs/ / dus gsum dge ba phan 416

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/bde'i gter chen rnams/ / yid rab dang bas gong du spel bar bgyi/ /'di phyi'i dpung gnyen dam pa skyabs mchog rnams/ / rtag bzhugs thar pa'i lam bzang bstan du gsol/ / dge tshogs kun kyang bla med byang chub tu/ / bsngo ba'i re 'bras 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ / 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / i de gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍa la kai ni r+sā ta yā mi/ de yi thugs gar zla ba la gnas pa'i/ / hrī yig sngags phreng dang bcas 'od zer gyis/ / 'gro drug 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod de/ / kun gyis gzungs sngags lhan cig sgrog par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi padro hūṃ/ yi ge brgya ba bzla/ dge 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum dge tshogs mthus/ / deng nas brtsams te tshe rabs thams cad du/ / bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis dgyes ba'in du/ / 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin gyur cig / 'di snang 'gags tshe bde ldan zhing mchog tu/ / khrid nas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong zhing / / sa dang lam gyi rtogs pa rim bgrod nas/ / rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi thugs rje ni/ / gcig bsdus lhag pa'i lha yi rnam rol las/ / srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i gnyen/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnam 'dren kun gyes gdul bar ma nus pa/ / mtha' 'khob srin po gdong dmar pod yul gyi/ /'gro la lhag par brtse ba'i snying stobs can/ / thugs rje'i gter khyod brtse ba'i spyan gyes gzigs/ / mtha' dbus kun na bstan pa gzugs brnyan tsam/ / bstan 'dzin phal cher bstan pa'i dbu 'phang smod/ / bstan srung g.yel bas bdud kyi dpung tshogs dar/ / dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa 417

༄/ /gung thangabastanapa'izla ma'i gas sa /bsal du gsol/ /mkhas rlom gzhung lugs don la ma reg cing / /btsun par bcos rnams blang dor ngo skog 'dzol/ /grub par khas 'che khrel med spyon pa mang / /dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ /sde dpon khengs dregs spyod pa log par zhugs/ /yul khams nad dang 'khrug pa mu ges mnar/ /nyam chung skye bo mgon med sdug grir 'chi/ /dus ngag snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ / lo 'bras mi sman sad ser than pas 'joms/ /rkang bzhi mi 'phel nad sna du mas gtses/ / zas nor bcud nyams nyin re bzhin du 'grib/ / dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ / mdor na rang rang dkon mchog bka' las 'das/ / las 'bras blang dor log par bsgrubs pa yis/ /snod bcud mtha' dag sdig pa'i 'bras bus gang / /dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ /bag med byis pa rang nyid bdeg 'chos te/ /brtse ba'i ma la yus su byed pa bzhin/ /rang las smin pa'i nyam thag 'gro rnams kyis/ /gdung ba'i smre sngags khyod min su la gsol/ /rang gi las su dgongs pas mi skyob na/ /gzhan gyis bsags pa smin pa'i dogs ma mchis/ /de phyir brtse ldan brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bskyab tu gsol/ /las dang nyon mongs 'ching ba gcad du gsol/ / yang dag lam bzang bgrod par byin gyes rlobs/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog /cesapa 'di ni rab 'byams pa tshul khrimasarin chen dang ar dge bsam 'grub gnyisakyisa'aphagasamachog thugasarje chen po la snyigasama'i rgud pa zhi ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debasatshul zhig dgosazhes bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4brisapa'o/ /rang gi spyi bor pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /hūṃ dang rdo rje'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ /rdor sems dkar po rdo dril bsnams pa yis/ /rdo rje bsnyems ma gri 418

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/thod 'dzin par 'khyud/ / rin chen rgyan spras rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ / mi bskyod rgyas btab gnas gsum yi ges mtshan/ / thugs ma'i hūṃ yig 'od kyis ye shes pa/ / spyan drangs ma rtu baṃ ho dbyer med gyur/ / de yi thugs ga'i sngags phreng hūṃ bcas dang / / de yi 'od kyis spyan drangs rigs lnga yi/ / sbyor mtshams nas thon bdud rtsi chongs bug nas/ / zhugs te sgo gsum sdeg ltung byang gyur cig / de nas/ oṃ badz+ra te ru ka sa ma ya/ zhes sogs ha ru ga'i yig brgya dang / de mi shes na yongs grags rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya/ ma mthar/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ā zhesaci 'grub bzla/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ / dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ / bla ma mgon posaskyabs mdzod cig / gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ / thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ / 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ / de nas rigs lnga rdor sems bcas/ / rang la thim pas sgo gsum dang / / de dag rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ / dbyer med sgrib bral ngo bor gyur/ /'od gsal spros dang bral ba nam mkha'i dbyengs/ / bde chen thugs rje'i chu 'dzin rnam rol las/ / gang 'dul gzugs skur snang ba'i bla ma lha/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i tshogs bcas 'dir gshegs shig / gdong lngas nyer btegs 'od 'bar nor bu'i khrir/ / zhi dul chos 'chad mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ / zhing gi mchog rnams brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / dmu rgod gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro ba la/ / skal bar 'tsham pa'i legs bshad mchog sbyin gyis/ /mtho ris thar ba'i bde la sbyor mdzad pa/ / bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon gang ba'i/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin phung sogs/ / rab 'byams phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs kun/ / bde stong dbyer med ngang du dbul bar 419

༄/ /gung cabalomi'isgronasa' ga 4mabagyi/ /thog ma med nas rmongs pa'i bran gyur mthus/ / rang bde 'joms shing sdug bsngal kun 'dren pa'i/ / phung khrol spyod pa ji snyed bgyis pa kun/ /gnong zhing 'gyod pa drag pos mthol lo bshags/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi/ / dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas/ /kun gyi rnam dkar mdzad pa mtha' dag la/ / mchog tu gus pa'i yidakyis rjes yi rang / / thar pa'i sa mkhan ston pa 'khor dang bcas/ /rmongs pa'i skye bo ldongs par mi mdzad par/ / zab rgyas chos kyi sgon me legs sbar nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i grong der 'khrid du gsol/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba ci mchis pa/ / mtha' dag rgyal ba'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin cing / /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid las sgol ba yi/ / ded dpon mchog tu 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa byas la/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma sogs kyisamaṇ+ḍal dbul/ bsru med dkon mchog thugs rje me shel khams/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / 'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel sgron me mchog / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa lta bu rang gi bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad bzlas la/ mjug tudapal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / zhes sogs kyis rang gi snying gar spyan drangs te/ skye zhing skye bar rje btsun bla ma yis/ / 'bral ba med par dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin zhing / / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med myong ba yi/ /skal bzang mchog la 'dod dgur spyod gyur cig /de yi mthu las rgyu 'bras theg pa yi/ / lam bzang skas kyi gdang bu rim bgrod de/ / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma lha'i/ /go 'phang bde blag nyid du thob gyur cig /ces sogs tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon pas mtshams sbyar ba sogs bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang alag shā ho sho'u nas dad brtson ldan pa dge slong ngag dbangadakon mchog gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes420

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/bris pa'o/ /kun khyab kun tu g.yo ba'i dri bzhon shugs/ / gnas gyur bde chen thugs rje'i rol pa las/ / ye shes dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bye ba brgya/ / spro mdzad drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med rdo rje 'chang dbang sku mdog sngo/ / rdo dril phyag rgya'i dpal ldan mtshan dpes mdzes/ / dwangs gsal sku yi cha shas mtha' dag la/ / shel gyi rtsig ngos rab 'byams gzugs snang bzhin/ / 'phreng kro mi tra brgya rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ / lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa kun/ / dag cing gsal la ma 'dres lham mer gsal/ / zhing brgya sprul pas 'gengs bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ / thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'dren pa khyod min pa/ / gnas skabs mthar thug skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /'bral med rjes bzung byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig rnam par dag / bdag tu zhen pa'i snang shas 'ching ba bcad/ / rim gnyis lam gyis smin cing grol byas te/ / sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyes rlobs/ / de ltar gsol btab bla ma lha tshogs kyi/ / gnas rnams kun las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas/ / sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa gsos/ / rim gnyis lam gyi myu gu smin par gyur/ / de nas tshangs bug nas byon snying ga ru/ / gnyug ma'i sems dang dbyer med rtag bzhugs pas/ /zung 'jug go 'phang mngon gyur de srid du/ / 'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur cig / ces pa 'di'ang dpa' ri'i ko'u rtsa bla ma skal bzang mchog grub nyi masa'adi lta bu zhig dgos zheyobaskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /mi bskyod rgyal po'i thugs rje'i ga bur gyis/ / mi mthun rgud pa'i tsha gdung kun bcom ste/ / mi zad mchog sbyin rdul tshon chab 'dren gyi/ / cho ga 421

༄/ /gung bangabastan pa'isgronasa'i gsang 'phagamador bsdus tshul gyes 'god par bya/ / de'ang rdul tshon gye dkyil 'khor la brten nas bsgrubs shing mchod pa'i mthar tshon phye rnams chu klung du spyan 'dren pa ni chu la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams la phan gdags pa dang /klu'i rgyal po rnams byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsis tshim par byas pas chos mthun gyi longasaspyod 'phel ba sogs bkra shis dang dge mtshan rgya cher spel ba'i dgos pa mang du yod pas/ rgyud sde gong 'og gi dkyil 'khor du ma la de ltar mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes dar cha che zhing / khyad par du rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i skabs 'dir de ltar byed pa rgyud kyi dgongs par shin tu gnas te/ ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs mdo las/ ke ka ni'i sngags 'di gsung zhing de'i phan yon gyi skabs su/ gzung sngags bzlas brjod bya la/mchod rten 'bum byas la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mchod nas rgya mtsho chen po'am/ yang na chu klung du btang na de'i sems can rnams dmyal ba la sogs pa nas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ lung 'di bstan rim du drangs par/ rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa'i chu klung du btang na zhes 'byung ngo / / de'ang mchod rten zhes pa ni mchod pa'i rten zhes pa yin pas sku gsung thugs rten sogs mchod yul spyi ming yin pas/ skabs 'dir dge 'dun du mas yun ring por bsgrub cing mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phye ma ni mchod rten gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ / rgya mtsho dang chu klung du gtong b.ragasungs pa ni chu la srog chags kyi rigs grangs med pa gnas pa rnams las ngan byang zhing thar pa'i sa bon bskrun pa'i phan yon che la/ de'i dge bas gang gi don du byas pa'i sbyin bdag sogs la phan yon tshad med pa 'byung ngo / /rgya mtsho ni klu'i rgyal po chen po rnams kyi gnas yin pas de dag tshim zhing dga' nas 'jig rten du bde 'byor spel ba sogs dgos pa che ba la dgongs te mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang bcas chab 'dren byed tshul gsal bar 422

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduma'i sgrub thabs/gsungasapa yin no/ / de'ang tshon phye rnam bum rgyan gyis bkra bar blugs te rten kheb kyis btegs pa'i steng du gdugs phub/ slob dpon de dang mnyam du phebs shing / mchod rol du ma dril gsil dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mdun bdar nas bkra shis kyi dbyangs dang bcas te phebs/ chu 'gram du stegs kyi khar ba byung dang dri dkar pos byug pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du padadakar 'dab brgyad khor yug dang bcas pa bris la lte bar gtso bo'i sa bon hūṃ yig sngon po dang 'dab ma brgyad la klu brgyad kyi sku'am sa bon nam tshom bu dgod/ de'i mdun du gtso bo'i gtor ma dang khor yug gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du klu rgyal nams kyi kham phor brgyad dang / de'i phyi rol tukham phor rnams su 'o ma'i gtor ma ji tsam 'byor pa bshams te klu sman yangablug / de rnams kyi khor yug tu rdzas bdun sbyar ba'i mchod yon dang /me tog dkar po/ klu la mi gnod pa'i bdug spos/ mar dkar gyi snang gsal/ 'o ma dang dri bzang bsres pa'i byug pa/ 'o mas sprus pa'i lha bshos rnams bkod pa mdzes par bshams rnam bum gtor ma'i rgyab tsam du dgod/dpon slob mdun du phyogs nas gral rim gyes 'khod la/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na rdo rje bsnams pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ ces skad cig dkrongaskyed byas te dkar gtor bsngo/ klu'i dkyil 'khor a mṛ tas bsangs/swabhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i/ zhesapa nas/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog in+d+ra dī la'i zhes sogasanas/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ jo rtu baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis 423

༄/ /yo cabayopa'isgroname'i ga lamasu med par gyur/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mtha' yas dkar po/zhes pa nas/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs klu yi bdag /ces spyan drangs la/dza : baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing /ke ka ni/ oṃ ā ya nan+ta ye hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra a glo byu nā ga rā dzas pa ri wā ra a pratī ts+tsha ye swāhā/nas/ shasta'i bar bcug la dbul/ chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad/ / lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan mang mdzes/ / bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtso 'khor gyi gtor ma thun mong du a mṛ tayobasangs/ su'i wa sogs kyis gzhung ltar byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra yoglo bh+ya sa kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogasalan gsum byis gtso bo dang / klu la/ oṃ a nan+ta/ ba su ka zhesasogasasam/ yo mtha' yas nor rgyas/ zhes sogs nas rol mo dang bca4pasamachod/ chos dbyings rang bzhin zhes sogs dang / gdengs ka nor bu zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstod/ rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mchog tu nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /zhes sogs nas bsang gtor byas te shis brjod bya ba'i bar gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed dzaspu brek+ṣa'i rtser/ /chags pa'i byin rlabs rten gyi 'bras smin pa/ / ma dros rgya mtshor zhugs pa'i gser bzang 'od/ /dge legs snang ba nyi ltar 'bar gyur cig /cesapa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog yar 'phel sogs kyis sman pa grwa tshang gi sgrub mchod cha lag tu dgos tshul gyi bskul ma byung ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesaphral du bsgrigayopa'i yege pa ni sngag4ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ de'ang cho ga so so la brten nas khrus dbang 424

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduspa'i sgrub thabs/bskur ba'i tshe lha'i mtshan dang sngags kha bsgyur tsam las khyad par gzhan med pa dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes su mdzad bzhin pa ltar yin pas/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la brten nas kyang khrus dbang bya bar 'dod na cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs/ bum pa'ang rgyas pa'am yang na khrus bum tsam bsgrubs pa sngon du btang ste/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba da nga/ zhes pa nas/ khyad par du'ang 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / zhes tshig sgyur/ khro bo spyan 'dren sogs bgegs sbyang ba yongs grags ltar la bden brjod kyi skabs su'ang gong ltar bya/ za byed mkha' 'gro'isbyin sreg dang brab sngags kyi sgo nas sdig pa sbyangs pa dkyus dang khyad par med/ dri ma spyong ba'i sngon 'gror khrus gsol byed tshul 'dra'ang khrus kyi bar skabs rnams su thugs rje chen po'i gzungs ring 'don/ gtso rgyal ma'i mgorabla ma la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs bcad gnyis kyi 'phror/ skyon gyes ma gos sku mdog dkar/ zhes sogs kyis thugs rje chen po la sger gyi phyag bya'o/ / gshin po'i don du yin na rten bskyed pa dang ngan song dgug dral gyi skor sogs spyi dang 'dra la/ gzhan rnams ni sngar bshad pa dang mtshungs/gshin po lhar skyed pa'i tshe rdo rje sems dpar bskyed kyang rung ste/ khrus dbang sogs kyi skor 'di rnams rtsa ba rnal 'byor rgyud las 'byung bas/ der rdo rje sems dpar skyed tshul gsungs pa de nyid dam pa rnams cho ga gzhan gyi tshe na'ang sor bzhag tu mdzad pa yin 'dug bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrī las 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing / 'og ma gnyis kyis shel phreng dang pad dkar bsnams pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi por oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/425

༄/ /yo cabastanaba'i sa'i ga 'chagajo rtu baṃ ho dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke sha ra a sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ lam sbyang bstan man chad dkyus dang 'dra la/ de'i mtharasras kyi thu bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam pas bde ba can gyi zhingadu mgon po 'od dpag med kyi mdun sar gshegs pa'i mos pa byas na shin tu legs so/ /snyigs ma'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /dmigs med thugs rjes nye bar bskyangs pa las/ /nad gdon nye bar 'tshe ba kun zhi zhing / /'gro kun bde ldan zhing du 'khrid gyur cig /ces thugasarje chen po'i sgo nas khrusadabang byed tshul tho tsam bkod pa 'di'ang or du su shog nayobasngagasa'os yon tan du ma'i rgyan ldan bla zur blo bzang yon tan dang gnyer pa dge slong shes rab dpal bzang sogasakyi4bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru snyi ṣa dz+re rā dzā ya/ 'dir sman chog rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang 'brel bar lho sgo byed tshul la/ cho ga'i gzhung spyi dang 'dra bas 'god mi dgos shing / dogs gnas rnams bsal te go rim gyi tho tsam 'god na/ kha cig sman bla'i mdo chog ces zer ba yin pas 'di sngags su mi gtogs la des na lho sgo sogs mi 'brel zer/ la las sman bla mtho brtsegs kyi rjes gnang sogs tshad ldan du mas gnang bzhin pa yin pas sngags phyogs yin zer/gzhan dag de nyid mdo bya spyod pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yi/ /zhes rgyud sde drug tu 'byed cing 'di 'dra tsho mdo sde rtogs pa'i rgyud ces 'dres ma lta bur smra'o/ /dmigs bsal la thub dbang gnas bcus bskor ba'i rjes gnang dang / jo bo yab sras lta bu'i dbang yang tshad ldan du byed dgos pa yod pas/ nyams su len tshul gyi bsam sbyor tha dad pas mdo sngags gang dang mthun par byas pa las/ rang dbang du gang la 'jog rgyu'i kha 426

༄/ /'jamadapaladapa' bo gcig ma sogs lhag lhachesa'i sgrub thabs/tshonagacod dka'ang 'di la brten nas lho sgo sogs byas pa 'gal ba med de/lam rim gyi tshogs zhing la brten nas kyang lho sgo 'pho ba dang bcas byas chog pa zhal shes man ngag rnams su 'byung ba bzhin no/ / rigs pas brtag na'ang lho sgo'i bya ba bgegs sdig dri ma gsum sbyangs pa gtso bo yin la/ sman chog gi mjug tu bgegs gtor dang za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg khrus dang shisabajod gang yang mi chog don med par ma zad/ bde gshegs bdun gyi bden stobs brjod pa dang sgrubs na snyigs dus su 'grub sla bar zhal gyis bzhes yod pas byin rlabs myur khyad dang nus pa shin tu che'o/ / 'o na dkyil 'khor so so dang 'brel ba'i lhar bskyed pa dang de'i sngags kyi kha bsgyur dgos pa dper na thog mar/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ dza zhes pa dang / oṃ sarba bid sarba ba paṃ bi sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ zhes sogs kun rig gi sgos chos yin pas 'dir ji ltar sgyur snyam na/ badz+ra satwa hūṃ dza zhes pa rdo rje'i sems khug cig ces gshin po'i rnam shes dgug pa'i don yin gyi/ kun rig rtsa lha'i grangs kyi rdor sems min pas bsgyur dgos don med/ sarba bid ces sogs thams cad mkhyen pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i bde mchog dril bu pa'i lho sgor ma bsgyur bar bzhag 'dug cing / 'di dag gi khungs spyod rgyud yin pas de ltar bzhag chog ste/ dper na dbang gi sta gon gyi skor de nyid bsdus pa nas byung pa'i dbang gis de'i sngags/ badz+ra ha sa ha/ badz+ra tik+ṣa sogs rgyud sde gzhan gye dbang gi skabs su'ang ma bsgyur bar 'byung ba bzhin no/ / bum pa rnam bum midagos la/ khrus bum ni sman chog rgyas par 'byung ba bzhin gzungs bzla ba'i tshe bde gshegs brgyad kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros te bum chu byin gyes brlab par bsam pa des go chod par byas kyang rung la/ yang na bsangs sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las rba las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi 427

༄/ /yo thangabastan pa'i 0sa gsang 'thugamathar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces yig brgya dang sman bla'i gzungs a thra ta rnams bzla mthar/ zla pa hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med par gyur/ ces bsgrub/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ni gong 'og kun gyi las thams cad pa yin pas bsang ba rnams a mṛ tas byed/ bden stobs brjod tshe/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bde bar gshegs pa mched brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs bskyed smon lamabasam gyis mi khyab par bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par shes pa/ zhes sgyur/ ngan song dgug dral gyi mjug tu/shi nas bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla'i zhabs drung du skyes/ zhes 'dogs/ tshe 'das kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ zhes sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs byas chog la/ lhar skyed sbyang ba'i gong der byed pa'i bshad pa byung yang da lta phyag len la mi 'dug pa ltar mi dgos/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros khro bo'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes sogs bden brjod gong ltar bsnan pa tsam ma gtogs kun 'dra/ za byed mkha' 'gro spyi dang 'dra/brab sngags kyi mgo dang khrus kyi mtshams su sman bla'i gzungs 'don/ gtso rgyal ma'i 'phror dbang bskur ba med kyang lho sgo'i cho ga ma tshang bar mi 'gyur la/ 'on kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag la de'i dod lta bu zhig byed 'dod na/ sman bla'i lha tshogs rgyal sras sum khri drug stong dang bcas pa tshogs kyi zhing du bzhugs yod pa'i drung der/ ji snyed su dag ces sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas dbul/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs sam/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyis 428

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhadusa'i sgrub thabs/byang sdom 'dzin cing / gshin po des kyang rang dang mnyam du byang sdom bzung bar bsam pa'am/ rang gis byang sdom bzung ba'i dge rtsa de la bsngo bar gsung / zas gtad byed dgos byung na/ lhar ma bskyed tshe dus 'das des gtsos pa'i bar do'i sems can rnams tshim par bsams nas bsngo la/ lhar bskyed tshe yongs grags ltar rdor sems su bskyed nas dbul/ grol byed spor chogagis sdig pa sbyong ba zhes gnas spor bar byed pa ni/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog rin chen zhes sogs kyes 'thus shing / cung zad rgyas par byed na/'olags so/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na mtshan legs kyi zhing /gaṅgā'i klung bdun gyi bye ma snyed 'das pa na sgra dbyangs rgyal po'i zhing /gaṅgā'i klung lnga'i bye ma snyed 'das pa na gser bzang gi zhing nas bzung ste shar phyogs su gaṅgā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed 'das pa na bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla'i zhing khams baiḍūr+ya snang zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan pa/ tha gru yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sman gyi sdong po bsnams shing / g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/mtshan dpes spras shing sku las 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba/ 'jam dpal dang skyabs grol sogs 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba'i mdun du pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa zhig yod pa de'i steng du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa byed dgos/ 'gro tshul yang bcom ldan 'das de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros te/ khyod rang gi rnam shes hūṃ yig gi rnam pa de drangs pa'i dmigs pa byed dgos la/ de'i don du nged rnams kyis dkon mchog rin po che tshogs kyi zhing rnams spyan drangs nas/ dkon mchog rin po che de dag la mchod pa sogs byas pa las byung ba'i dge ba dang / dkon mchog rin po che 429

༄/ /gung bstan ཿ ma'i sa lamade dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs kyi 'od zer tshogs pa'i mthu la brten nas khyod la legs pa'i tshogs rin po che'i 'phreng ba lta bu rim bar byung ba yin/ dang por mchod pa sogs kyis tshogs bsags pa tshogs lam/ sbyang ba rnams dang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba sbyor lam/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi lha tshogs mthong ba mthong lam/ mthong zin nas dad pa sgom pa sgom lam/ de'i zhing du 'gro ba khyad par gyi lam/ phung khams skye mched rnams ye shes kyi mes sbyangs te sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du byed pa bar chad med pa'i lam/ de dag gisgo nas 'khor ba las grol ba rnam par grol ba'i lam yin pas de rnams rim gyis bgrod pa'i mos pa dang smon 'dun shugs drag po mdzad par zhu zhes brda sprad la/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ / zhes sogs 'don/sman bla'i zhing du skye bar shog / ces dang / poḍūr+ya snang zhing du gshegs/der pad+ma las rdzus te skyes nas zhes sogs kha bsgyur bya/ gson por khrus dbang byed lugs kyang de'i rigs 'gros kyis shes sla'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang ab ga tā be+e li'i shog nas dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dge bskos blo bzang rab brtan gyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i 4ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /bdag sogs nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro ba kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ / ring min byang chub rdo rje'i gnas thob ste/ /'gro kun zung 'jug sa la 'god par bgyi/ /rang nyid mi bskyod rdo rje nam mkha'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug yum bcas skur bzhengs te/ /rgyalab kun kyang 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi/ /rnam par spyan drangs mdun du bzhugasapar gyur/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /rgyud don ji bzhin rtogs shing rim gnyis kyi/ /lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /430

༄/ /'jamadapal dpa' bogacig sgrub sogs lhag lhaduba'i sgrub thabs/zhes rgyud klog cing mjug tu/ 'di ltar bskrun pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs mthus/ / dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang rim brgyud de/ / mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyes/ / rjes bzung rgyud don ji bzhin 'doms par shog / thun mong lam sbyangs sngags kyi sgor zhugs te/ / dam tshig sdom pa mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung / / smin cing grol byed rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyis/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la reg gyur cig / 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi 'don thabs mdor bsdus pa 'di ni or du su'i shog nas dad ldan dge slong blo bzang chos 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyosbyar ba'i yege pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ / zhal gcig phyag bzhi rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar/ / lhag ma gnyis kyis shel phreng pad sdong bsnams/ / skyabs yul rgya mtshos bskor cing bzhugs par gyur/ / bla ma kun 'dus mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / yi dam kun 'dus mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / sangs rgyas kun 'dus mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /byang sems kun 'dus mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / nyan rang kun 'dus mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / chos skyong kun 'dus mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyes gzigs/ / 'di snang 'khri ba chod par byin gyes rlobs/ / ngan song skye sgo khegs par byin gyis rlobs/ / las nyon dri ma byang bar byin gyis rlobs/ / srid pa'i mtsho las grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ / byang chub sems mchog skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / yang dag lta ba rtogs par byen gyes rlobs/ / zung 'jug go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol btab thugs ga'i hrī yig la/ / yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las/ / 'od 'phros rgyal kun byin rlabs bsdus pa las/ / bab pa'i bdud rtsis 'gro kun grol bar 431

sa / /gung bang bstanapa'itshanas gas 'bumagyur/ /de nas rang dang skyabs yul nam mkha' gang ba/ 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad kyis mnyam du bton par bsams la ma ṇi bzla/ 'di nas shi 'phos gyur ma thag / bar do'i 'khrul snang mi 'byung bar/ / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mgon gyis/ / bde ba can du 'khrid par shog / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs dang / 'jam dpal dpa' bo zhes sogs dang /shākya'i dbang po zhes sogs kyi bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo/ /'di'ang su nyid shog nas dad ldan dkon mchog bstan dar gyi4bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul mgon po yid bzhin nor/ /srid gsum dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i shugs kyis nyer dgongs te/ / 'dir gshegs rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon du bzhugs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang / /khyad par sbyangs rtogs sbar byas gtor ma'i tshogs/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis 'bul lags na/ / bzhes shing zag med bde bas dgyes gyur cig / byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /chos mthun 'byor pa la sogs phan pa'i rkyen/ / mtha' dag 'dod dgur lhun gyes grub pa yis/ / lam bzang gegs med 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / cesapa 'di'ang ri khrod pa dge slongadakon mchog byam4pasabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /432

༄/ /kunamakhyen blamasamadzad pa'irdoraphrengagidabang ༄7/ / kun mkhyen bla mas mdzad pa'i rdor breng gi dbang gi kha skong kro ba'i phyag len dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dirardo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gi cho ga spyi'i khogs bla med dang sbyar te ngag 'don thar chags kyi rim pa skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bum dubazhugs pa ltar la/ der mi gsal brgyud sde 'og ma'i dbang bskur tshul sogs skyabs mgon 'di nyid kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag bzhes bzhin kha 'geng bani/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang bskur tshul la dkyel 'khor du gzhug pa'i skor rnams bla med dang 'dra zhing / 'on kyang / da ni dad pa'i zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur ro/ / zhes brjod de/ rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol pas/ / zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis dor/ dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs slob ma dang dbang rdzas mnyam du bsangs te/ thu n+ya ta4sbyangs/ slob ma rnams dang dbang rdzas bum chu stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ arnya nas shasta'i bar gyisamachod/ mi bskyod pa zhu 433

༄/ /yo cabastanaba'izla sa' sa 'thugab las byung ba'i dbang rdzas bum chur gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad slob ma rnams la dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ zhes pa man chad 'dra la/'on kyang rgyud sde 'og ma'i dbang cho ga khungs thub mang por/ bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhes tshig ma bsgyur bar bzhag pamang bas de ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med la/ bla med dang khyad par dbye ba'i phyir/ bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhes tshig bsgyur kyang rung ngo / / mchod pa'i mjug tu/ dag pa brjod pa dor te/ cod paṇa gye dbang gi gsol gdab byed cing / slob ma dang dbang rdzas cod paṇa gnyis ka rin 'byung yab rkyang du bskyed pa sogs gong dang 'dra'o/ /rdo dril gnyis kyang de dang mtshungs shing / ming dbang gi tshe slob ma rnam snang du bskyed de ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ gnyi4su med par gyur/ zhes pa'i mjug tu/ bla ma dngagatso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad/ ces sogs sbyor ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'dra'o/ /slob dpon gyi dbang gi tshe slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang stegs khrus dkyil la gnas pa'i seng ge'i khri'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'chang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas rdo dril gyi dam tshig sbyin tshul 'dra zhing / phyag rgya'i dam tshig la/ yid kyi lus ni/ zhes sogs sho lo ka dang pos chog par byas te/ slob ma rdo rje 'chang zhal gcig phyagaganyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gsal bar dmigs pa la brten nas zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo 4slo

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'ishā sa gsung 'thugardzas brgyad sbyin/ de nas skor ba dang lha dbul byas la/ da ni khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /zhes pa nas/ sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ / zhes pa'i bar sho lo ka gnyis kyis dbugs dbyung / dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi tshe/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor mtha' dag 'byung 'dul sogs dang 'dra zhing / dbang dngos gzhi'i tshe chu dbang gi gsol gdabakyi mjug tu/ slob ma skad cig gis dkyil 'khor gye gtso bor bskyed/dbang rdzas bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hrī sko rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bum chur gyur/ ces bskyed cing / dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs te/ dbang bskur/chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan cing / dbang gi lha rnams slob ma la thim par gyur/ slob ma mchod/ de ltar chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa lnga gnas bsgyur/ lam mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog / ces brda sprad/ gnyis pa la slob ma gtso bo bskyed/ dbang rdzas cod paṇa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ hrī ā rnams yongs su gyur ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin cod paṇa du gyur/ dbang lha spyan 'dren pa sogs nas slob ma mchod pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra/ de ltar cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ dri ma lnga sbyangs/ phung po lnga gnas bsgyur/ lam mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu gzugs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /ces brda sprad/ 'khor lo/ dung / dril bu/ po ti/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnams sngar ltar byin pa'i rjes su/ de ltar chos ston pa sogs kyi slob dpon du bya ba'i ched du chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba byin pas/ bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bri sgrub dang /436

༄/ /kunamayo blamasamadzad pa'irdoraphreng gi dbang chos nyan bshad sogs la dbang bar byas/ 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don sgrub pa'i nus pa bzhag 'bras bu chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i go 'phang myur du 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / zhes brda sprad la/ / skor ba man chad 'byung 'dul sogs dang 'dra/ de yang phyag bzhes kyi rgyun la/ 'khor los bsgyur drug gi dbang gi tshe/ rdor 'phreng du mi gsal ba kro ya'i sgos chos rnams de nyid kyis kha bskang ste phyag len rgyas par mdzad snang bas/ des kha 'gengs tshul ni/ gsol gdab nas/ 'phreng ba'i gzhung ltar gyi ye shes 'bebs chog gi mjug gi/ hūṃ ha arto/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi bar dkyus bzhin byas la/ de nas/ slar yang bla ma la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dkyil 'khor ba'i rnam par spyan drangs slob ma la thim par gyur/zhes dang / dril bu dkrol bzhin du/ 'di de dam tshig rdo rje ste/ / rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su brjod/ / rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di/ / de ring nyid du 'bab par shog / oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a a a/ zhes brjod/ me tog 'dor ba'i sngags la/ kṛ ya'i gzhung rang du/ me pra yats+tsha hūṃ/ zhes pa dang / ā khaṃ dī ra'i bar du klu byang gi lugs ltar/ ha ha ha ha ho zhes pa bcug nas 'byung bas bzhag kyang rung bar sems so/ / gzhug pa'i skor lhag ma 'dra zhing / dbang dngos gzhi'i thog mar sbyangs pa nyin 'dir yang byed dgos/shis bajod kyi tshe/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gye ni bdag po mchog / sems can ma lus skyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste/ / des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la zhi byed shog / bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ / zhe sdang zil gnon skye bo yongs su spyong ba po/ / des ni mi bskyod mgon po zhes 437

༄/ /yo b.lob ཿ tsha lagabya'i mtshan 'chang ba/ / des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag gti mug rigs dang ldan/ / rnam par snang mdzad rtag tu srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'phrog / gti mug zil gnon skye bo yongs su sbyong ba po/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag rin chen rigs dang ldan/ / dbul ba'i sdug bsngal yongs su grol ba'i ched du brtson/ /nga rgyal zil gnon skye bo yongs su spyong ba po/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shogabakra shis gang 'ig mtha' dag las kyi rigs dang ldan/ / brdzun smrar dga' ba3mas la snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ / de rnams phrag dog sdig las grol ba'i gnyen po ste/ / des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po/ /chags pa zil gnon skye bo yongs su spyong ba po/ / des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /zhes rigs lnga'i shis brjod yongs rdzogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba zhes sogs kyis shis pa bajod de slob ma la me tog gtor/ dbang bskur rdo rje zhes pa man chad dkyus ltar dang / chu dbang gi dbang lha bstem pa'i rjes su/ bde ba chen po chags pa che/ / rdo rje chen po nor chen po/ / shes rab chen po ye shes che/ /rdo rje sems dpar deng bdag sgrub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje che/ / rdo rje'i dbang phyug bla na med/ / dbang bskur thams cad kun don du/ /dngos grub thams cad bde bar stsol/ /ji bzhin dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam bde ba ster pa po/ / ji bzhin 'dod pa thar pa nor dang chos rnams ster ba po/ / ji bzhin ye shes lnga dang shin tu dga' ba'i grogs byed pa/ /ji bzhin phyag na rdo rje bde ba chen po'i mgon po nyid/ /dza a ā i budhā ba ra ma the de ha o/ / dza a kā mo mok+ṣa dha ṇa dha rmā dā a o/ /438

༄/ /kunamayo zamasamadzad pa'irdoraphrengagidabangakadza a pañdza dzā na sur a sa hā a o/ / dza a badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā su kha ha na o/ /zhes pa rdo rje'i glu'i tshig 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug chu dbang gi dag pa man chad rig pa'i dbang lhag ma rnams dkyus dang 'dra/ slob dpon gyidabang gi brtan kyang chu dbang rdzogs nas slob ma la mchod pa'i mjug tu /slaralang slob ma rnams rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ badz+ra satwa puṣ+pe nas shasta'i bar gyi4mchod/ slob ma la me tog gtor zhing sgeg pa'i rnam pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / sras dang bcas pa rnam rol phyir/ / rdo rje bsnyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ / dga' mchog bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ / a zhes brjod cing sgeg mo'i tshul gyis mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin/ de bzhin du/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phangs/ / sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyis/ / 'di rnams 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ / phreng ba 'di ni rgyan yin no/ / oṃ/ zhes phreng ba ma dang /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ / glu ni khyod kyis blangs par gyis/ / de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ / shin tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ / gri zhes glu ma dang / de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas la rjes chags pa'i/ / sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ / gar mkhan tshul du 'gyur bar gyes/ / ho zhes gar ma dang / rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ / dam tshig brtul zhugs legs bsgom pas/ / lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ / ye shes kyi ni tshul du gyis/ / a zhes bdug spos ma dang / sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dor/ / byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ / mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ / bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ / hūṃ zhes me tog ma dang / chos kyi poni legs spar bas/ / rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar rang / / sems can ma rig ldong rnams la/ / ye shes snang bsagasal bar gyis/ / bra zhes mar me ma dang / rgyal ba rnams la dri phul 439

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'azla ma'i gsang 'bum/bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes gzigs pa yi/ / byang chub lus can rnams la bskor/ / ga zhes dri chab ma te sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin/ de kho na nyid dang las kyi rim pa brjod pa 'dra zhing / sngags dbang skabs drug ga'i sngags gtad/mig sman/ me long / mda' 'phang pa/ dbang gi dag pa rnams dkyus ltar ro/ /gsang dbang gi/ slob ma 'od dpag med du gyur/ zhes pa yan chad dkyus ltar dang / de nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ / rdo rje'i sbyor las yang da ga byung / /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ / khyab bdag bdag kyang de 'drar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob/ /ces bla ma la bstod pa'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug /'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /zhes pa man chad dkyus ltar ro/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin rgyas/ / gsang ba'i dbang bskur bla med thob/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur gyis/ / mgon po rjes su bzung bar mdzod/ / ces pa'i tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs shing /rig ma gtod pa'i tshigs bcad kyi/ nor bu'i nang du chud par blta/ /zhes pa'i mjug tu/ dga' sbyin gnas sbyin lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zungs shig zungs shig sems dpa' che/ / khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ / zhes pa'i tshigs bcad bsnan nas bajod la/ rig ma des kyang gur gum la sogs pas/ zhes pa man chad dang / dbang bzhi pa/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs gsum/lung bstan/ spyi'i chos bshad kyi rjes gnang / 'khor lo/ dung / po ti/dril bu bzhi dang / so so'i chos bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gtod pa rnams dkyus bzhin byas nas/ slar yang kṛ ya las/ rnam pa 440

༄/ /kunamayo blamasamadzadapa'idoraphrengagidabangakasna tshogs las byas pa'i/ / rin chen bdun yang gtad par bya/ / gri gug dang ni bshā pa/ / bgrang phreng glegs bam sam 'bo ra/ / gyo mo rnal 'byor dbyug pa yang / / pad+ma'i lag pa'i lham dang ni/ / rnal 'byor ba yi sgom thag rnams/ / legs par dga' ba'i bsam pa yis/ / sngags chen de yis sbyin par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rin chen sna bdun bzung la/ ma 'ongs pa na thub pa'i dbang po yi/ / go 'phang thob cing 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ / 'das pa'i dbang phyug bla med thob phyir du/ / rin chen sna bdun rjes gnang sbyin par bya/ / oṃ sasta rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes bajod la sbyin/ gre gug kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bgrang phreng rnams bzung la/ ma rig gzung 'dzin rnam tog bcad pa'i phyir/ / gri gug rjes gnang rab tu sbyin bya zhing / / zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i/ / 'phrin las grub phyir kha ṭ+wāṃ bgrang phreng sbyin/ / oṃ garti ka gaṭī ka mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes brjod la sbyin/glegs bam thod lo gor/ sam 'bo ra rnams bzung la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na yi chos/ / bsam pa ji bzhin gzhan la bstan pa'i phyir/ / rang rang rgyud kyi glegs bam dag dang ni/ / thod lo kor dang sam 'bo ra rnams sbyin/ / oṃ puste ka saṃ bu ṭi ka a snyi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes brjod la sbyin/ de nas rdza snod dang / rnal 'byor dbyug pa dang / lham dang / sgom thag rnams bzung la/ rgyal srid la sogs srid pa'i bde ba la/ / chags pa spangs nas bsod snyoms 'tsho ba la/ / brten nas mi chod bsam gtan bya phyir du/ / gyo mo'i snod dang rnal 'byor dbyug pa dang / / lham dang sgom thag rnams kyang sbyin par bya/ / oṃ ka ra bar yo ga daṇ+ḍa ya ṭa ke a bhi ṣi ñtsa mi/ zhes brjod la sbyin/de nas/ the tshom med pa'i bsam pa yis/ / khyod 'dir blo gros ngan mi bya/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul mchog ni/ / mnyam med rang gis rab gsal bya/ / de ltar byas nas sangs rgyas la/ / phan btags byas pa gzo ba yo1

sa / /gung bangabastanapa'izla ma'agasung 'thugayin/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / / khyed la rtag tu kun bsrung mdzad/ / shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag / yid bzhin nor bu ltar mtho bas/ / skyo med dogs dang bral ba yis/ / de ltar sems can don gyes shig / ces bajod/ de nas skor ba dang / lha la dbul ba/ dbugs dbyung / deng bdag skye ba zhes sogs ched du brjod pa'i rjes zlos bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra yang / nyin 'dir dkyil 'khor la bskor ba/ lha dbul sogasakyang dmigs pa tsam ma yin par dngos su byed pa phyag len yin pas/bstan pa'i rgyun la dgongs te dam pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes mtha' dag cha phra mo nas nyams pa med pa gal che'o/ / zhesapa 'di ni dge ba'i bshesaganyen dam pa dusa'akhor slob zur ngag dbang phun tshogasanasabaskul te/ chu mo phag gi lo rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po dpal ldan bkra shisa'akhyil gyi tshogs yongs lardo rje phreng ba'i dbang rdzogayopar phul skabs/ 7skyabasamagon rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigasamed dbang po'i zhalasnga nas kyis mdzad pa'i 'phreng ba'i dbang chog gi kha skong 'di 'dra zhig dgosatshul byung ba ltar btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesa'aphreng ba'i dbang chog rnam4dang / kro ya'i rgya gzhung la gzhig ste bkod pa'o/ /yo2
