༄/ /nganalong thams cadasbyongaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadapa/༄༅/ / ngan song thams cad spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal ston rgya bshad pa chos dung dkar po'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / na mo gu ru bha ga wa ti bai ro tsa nā ya/ dpal ldan mkhas kun ral pa'i zur phud rtser/ / zhabs skyes nor bu'i gdengs ka ngal gso ba/ /'jigs med dbang por mtshan gsol rigs kyi bdag / byang chub bar du gtsug na mdzes gyur cig / ngan song kun sbyong thams cad rig pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor thar pa chen po'i gzhal med du/ / bgrang yas thar 'dod gzhug la sngon 'gro'i gtam/ / zab gsang chos dung dkar po'i dbyangs 'di sgrogs/ / de'ang rgyal ba ma pham mgon pos theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ / 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ / chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ / sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ / skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / / dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / / lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / / bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / / btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dang / / nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / / byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / / bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ / byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / / mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ / yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ / srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad la ris su ma chad pa'i brtse yo3

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'i yo ga las/ba snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur te thugs zag pa med pa'i ye shes chos sku bde ba chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du rjes thob sgyu ma'i rol pa gang la gang 'tsham gye sprul pa'i zlos gar dpag tu med pa ston par mdzad pa chos nyid yin la/ khyad par du rang cag rnams kyi 'dren pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang bo 'di nyid kyang / ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ dpal ldan stug po bkod pa nyid du don dam thugs chud cing / / dga' ldan skye bo'i don mdzad phyir na dam pa tog dkar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar bskal pa bgrang du yas pa'i snga rol nas rgyal ba dbang po'i tog tu mngon par sangs rgyas te sku bzhi ye shes lnga la sogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag mngon par byang chub tu zin kyang / thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor dga' ldan du skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dam pa tog dkar po'i skye ba bzhes shing / de nas gzigs pa lnga la gzigs te rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras su bltams nas mtshan gzhon nu don kun grub par gsol te lo nyi shu rtsa dgur khab tu bzhugs shing lo drug dka' ba spyad de mthar byang chub kyi shing drung du sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i srod la bdud btul gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas tegadul bya rnams kyi dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad bsdus na nyan sa dang kun btus ltar gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sam gsung rab yan lag dgu dang / de'ang mdo sde rgyanalas/ sde snod dag ni gsum mam gnyis kyang rung / / zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo mngon 'dul ba'i sde snod gsum mam theg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis su 'dus/ yang na mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal po las/ rgyu la sprod pa rgyu chos kyi/ / 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ / rdo rje theg pa nye lam zhig / ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/4slo

༄/ /nganasong thams cadatshungaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadal/rgyu lam byed pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu lam byed gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gnyis su 'du zhing / de gnyis kyi nang nas kyang phyi ma ni shin tu dkon zhing ches mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ ji skad du/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ / res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ / u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ / brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig / gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ / mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ / de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ / zhes gsungs shing bskal ba bzang po 'di la'ang / rnam 'dren stong 'byon pa'i nang na sngags kyi bstan pa dar ba bstan pa 'di las gzhan ma bshad cing / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun la rigs pas bsgrubs te gsum bzhi tsam 'byung bar gsungs pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad mdo phyogs rkyang ba yin pas/don 'di la dgongs nas rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang / sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje'i theg / ces 'doms par mdzad pa yin/ 'o na de tsam du dkon pa der snga ma las lhag pa'i khyad chos ji lta bu zhig yod pa yin snyam na/tshulagasum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / / thabs mang dka'ab med pa dang / / dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ / sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ / zhes khyad par bzhi bshad kyang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa ni mdo sngags gnyis la chos sku dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam stong nyid bsgom pa'i ye shes yod par 'dra'ang /gzugs sku dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor yod med dang de la brten nas byin rlabs 'jug tshul sogs mi 'dra ba yod pas phyi ma khyad par du 'phagasapa yin la/ de lta bu'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa de la'ang / rgyud sde'i dbye ba ji lta bu yod ce na/ bla ma snga ma rnams mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i yo5

༄/ /yo cabayob ཿ sa 4margyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dang drug tu 'dod pa sogs bzhed tshul mang yang / rang lugs ni rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya med rnal 'byor de ltag la'o/ / sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes phyi'i bya ba gtso bor gyur pa bya rgyud/ phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi rnal 'byor cha mnyam du spyod pa spyod rgyud/rnal 'byor kho na gtso bor gyur pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor de las gong na med pas rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa yin la/ de bzhi'i 'jog byed gzhan yang / sgron gsal las/ skye bo 'dod chags can don du/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar spyir sngags kyi theg pa ni/ dbang non chags bcas kyi lam gyis 'tshang rgya ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ rig ma'i 'dod yon la chags pa spyod pa'i tshul yang / mngon pa mdzod las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang / / rgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yin/ /zhes rigs mi 'dra ba bzhir yod pa bzhin du/ sasgru ṭa las/ rgod dang blta dang lag bcad dang / / gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes de dag rim pa ltar lam du byed nus pa'i gdul bya rigs bzhi yod pa'i dbang gis rgyud bzhir gsungs pa'i nang nas gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ de la'ang rtsa bshad phyogs mthun gye rgyud mang du bzhugs kyang gtso bor gyur pa sngags rim las rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /dpal ldan de nyid bsdus pa'i 'o ma'i mtsho/ /zhes de nyid bsdus pa gtso bor gsungs pa dang / der ma zad dpal nā ro ta pas/de nyid bsdus pa rtsa rgyud dang / / gsang 'dud rtsa rgyud de'i rgyud phyi ma dang /le'u bco brgyad pa de'i'ang rgyud phyi mar bshad pa ni spyod bsdus kyi'ang dgongs pa yin par mtha' dpyod rin po che'i myu gur gsungs la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'dus pa'ang rgyud sde bzhir phye ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud min kyang / spyir pha6

༄/ /nganarang thamasajadatshungaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston sgrubashadapa/de la rnal 'byor rgyud ces gsungs pa mang zhing gsung ba'i dus la ltos te gcig shos snga pa dang 'dus par dbang gi skor sogs 'ga' zhig de nyid bsdus par zhal 'phang mdzad pa'ang yod pa'i gnad kyis yin/ 'di dag gi skabs nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbye ba la spyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcuganyis sogs mang du yod na'ang / de thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bur gyur ba ni ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid yin pas 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbang rnam par dag pa mnos nas dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing / mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor sogs la tshul bzhin du bslab nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangasgrub dgos pas/ dang por slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las smin byed dbang gi chu rgyun nyams pa med par nod pa shin tu gal che ste/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ dbang bskur ba ni mchog yin te/ / dngos grub thams cad rtag tu mnos/ / zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ lan gcig dbang rnams kyi ni bskur/ / de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi/ / nges par snod du gyurapa'o/ / zhes gsungs shing / dbang ma thob na ci tsam 'bad kyang yon tan skye bar mi nus pa ni sangs rgyas thod pa las/ dper na pi wang spyor kun tshogs/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung / / de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ / sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i 'dus pa'i dkyil chog las/ gtor phyir dri ma 'khrud pa'i phyir/ /blugs phyir nus pa 'jog pa'i phyir/ / dbang phyir 'bras bu mngon gyur phyir/ / lhag med grol ba ster phyir dbang / / zhes a snyi ṣe ga'i sgra la des tshig gi bshad pa byas nas phung khams skye mched kyi dri ma 'khrud pa dang / gdul bya'i rgyud la ye shes kyi nus pa lugs su blugs pa dang /rgyud nyan bshad dang lam bsgom pa sogs la dbang bar byed pa dang / 'bras yo7

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'icanasa'i gotshi thu gabu bla med byang chub thob par byed pas na dbang zhes bshad de/ shākya 'od kyi 'dul ba sum brgya par yang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal nod dbang bskur yin/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin pas dang por dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa'i gzhi rten du dbang thob pa gal che la/ der ma zad rje bdag nyid chen pos bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ṭīk+kar/ dbang bskur ba la/ smin byed rgyu'i dbang dang / grol byed lam gye dbang dang / grol ba 'bras bu'i dbang dang gsum du yod kyang / zhes thog mar 'jug pa'i sgo dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi lam dang / 'bras bu zung 'jug gi go 'phang ste sngags lam gyi gnad thams cad dbang gi khongs su 'dus par gsungs te/ rgyu mtshan 'di dag la brten nas/ sngags rim chen mor/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir wa ba'i gdams pa 'dzin pa'i bod kyi bla ma mkhas pa 'ga' zhig sngags kyi lam gyi gnad thams cad dbang gi khog nas tshol bar mdzad pa ni rmad du byung ba'i srol du mthong ngo / / zhes sa skya pa'i lam 'bras kye gdams ngag ma nor pa rnams la bsngags brjod mdzad pa lta bus mtshon/ dgos pa bsam gyes mi khyab pas 'di la nan tan du byed dgos shing / de la'ang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i rim pa dang / zhugs nas dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pas/ snga ma ni dgos pa che zhing dgag bya chung bas snod min la la'ang byar rung ste/ rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa las/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir gzhug pa la snod du gyur pa dang snod du ma gyur ba brtag mi 'tshal lo/ / zhes dang / rtse mo las/dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po 'dir ni ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gye khams thams cad 'jug tu rung ngo / / snod dang snod ma yin pa yongs su brtag par mi bya ste/ zhugs pa la mngon par zhen pa yongs su gzung bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can thams cad kyis mthong ba tsam gyi mod la phyir mi ldog pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /dad pa med pa dang / dge 448

༄/ /ngan song thams cadasbyong ba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadal/ba'i rtsa ba ma bsags pa dang / rgyud yongs su ma smin pa dang / mos pa med du zin kyang / 'on kyang mthong ba tsam gyis so/ / zhes dang / gzhug pa tsam zhig sbyin bya yi/ / rnam pa thams cad bya ba min/ / zhes gsungs zhing /sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel ba dang / shārnyi bas dgra nagagi 'grel par yang de bzhin du gsungs pas rgyud sde bzhi ga mthun par dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor rnams kun la byas kyang 'gal ba med cing mthong ba tsam gyis thar ba'i sa bon bskrun pas phan yon che la/ de la'ang gdong g.yogs dang bcas te 'jug pa dang / dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid du 'jug pa gnyis/ snga ma la yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug ces bya ba phyag len la yol ba bsal ma bsal dang bsgom don la dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu bya ba dang nang du bya ba'i skor gnyis yod pas/ dang po phyi 'jug la/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ de'ang ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ des kyang mos pas spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ / ci ste nor yod bla ma lnga dbul bya/ / nor dang gter dang 'bru dang dbyig dang gser/ / mdor na rang gi lus kyang dbul bar bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar lus longs spyod thams cad yon du dbul zhing /de nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / zhes sogs/ dga' ba chen po rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor bltas nas gsol ba 'debs dgos pa ni dpal ldan dpa' bo'am mtshan gzhan slob dpon chen po bha bi lhas bla ma lnga bcu par/bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ / tha dad par ni mi brtag go / zhes gsungs zhing / de'ang rdo rje 'chang bya ba'i sangs rgyas shig zur du yod pa ma yin par/rgyud de dang de gsungs pa'i tshe de'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i skur bzhengs nas gsungs pa po de nyid yin pas skabs 'di lta bu la mtshon na rtsa ba'i bla ma dngabacom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po ngo bo dbyer med du mos dgos pa ni/ spyod rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dbang bskur la9

༄/ /yo cabalor+yā mogayo las/bar bya'o/ / zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ de'i 'og tu mig dar 'ching dgos pa ni/ spyong rgyud las/ dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/zhes gsal bar gsungs shing / de'i kha dog gi khyad par dus 'khor gyi dkyil chog las las mthun gyi kha dog tu gsungs la/ abh+ya'i rdor phreng du dmar ser ci rigs bya bar gsung / bzhi brgya lnga bcu par/ de nas gos dmar gyes gdong g.yogs/ zhes dmar bo gtso bor mdzad pas deng sang phyag len la'ang de bzhin byed par snang zhing / 'di'i sngags don ni yid dag par bya ba'i phyir mig dar chings shig ces pa yin la/ de'ang yid mi g.yeng ba'i thabs la 'dod pa sogs bzhed tshul sna tshogs yod kyang rang lugs 'bras ma smin gyi bar du brtol mi rung ba ltar/ dkyil 'khor ston pa'i snod rung du ma gyur gyi bar du mthong na sgrib par 'gyur bas de 'gog byed yin/ de nas me tog gtod pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ yon gyis lag pa bkang ste gzhug par bya/ /zhes slar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dus kye phyag rten du me tog sna mang ba'i phreng ba re ster ba yin la/ zung 'jug gsal bar/ bla mas rab tu dang sems kyis/ / rtag pa'i gzugs su rnam par bsam/ / de la ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ sngags kyi/ / me tog phreng ba ngag bzang po/ / gus pas me tog dor don du/ /'bad pas blo ldan 'dzin du 'jug /ces rtag pa ste rnam snang gi ngo bor bskyed par gsungs pa rgyud sde 'og ma'i skabs 'dir mi dgos kyang /yasnang ba mtha' yas/ khaṃ don yod grub pa/ dī rnam par snang mdzad/ ra rin 'byung / hūṃ mi bskyod pa ste rigs lnga'i sa bon las ye shes lngar bskyed nas tha mal gyi snang zhen dang ma 'dres pa dgos pas/ don 'di la dgongs nas kun rig ṭīka chen du dbang rdzas la skyed chog byed pa bla med kho na'i lugs yin par gsung ba'i dgongs pa'ang / rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshosadabang don de nyid yang gsal las rgyud sde 'og ma'i skabs lha so so'i 450

༄/ /nganasong thamasacadachangaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadal/gzugs su mi skyed pa'i don yin gyi/ chu cod paṇa sogs dag pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin du mos mi dgos pa ni min no/ / zhes 'grel par mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge ba gyis pa dang / / zhes sogs kyi skabs nas sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas byang sdom 'dzin pa yin te/ de'ang dbang rdzogs par bskur ba la/ rtso mo las/sdom pa gsum la bkod nas ni/ / de nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngags sdom yang 'dzin dgos la/ skabs 'di lta bu la ni/rdor 'phreng las/ 'dir sdom pa gang slob dpon du mi byed pa la ster ba de ni thun mong ba ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid do/ /zhes thun mong ba byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa tsam bzung bas chog cing 'dzin pa'i cho ga'ang / nyi shu pa sogs phal mo cher/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs kyi sgo nas 'bog par bshad kyang /'dir rang gi sgos chos lta bu'i rgyud rnams las btus pa'i tshigs bcad 'di dag gi sgo nas 'dzin pa yin/ de nas thams cad rnal 'byor gye sems bskyed pa la thams cad ces pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang du byas na ris su ma chad pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir du rdzogs pa'i byung chub thob par 'dod pa dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems la mtshon na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub par rtogs pa'i don yin la/ rnal 'byor ces pa/ dbus mtha' las/ der gnas las su rung ba nyid/ / don rnams thams cad 'byor par 'gyur/ / zhes zhi gnas kyi stobs kyis sems rnal du gnas par byas pa'i steng nas/ lhag mthong gis sprul bsgyur sogs don thams cad la dbang 'byorapar byed pas zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rnal 'byor du bshad pa lta bu yod kyang / skabs thob kyis 'di ni/ 'dus pa phyi ma 451

༄/ /yo cabaloba'isgronatsamagayo gtsogalas/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ / rnal 'byor ces ni bya bar bshad/ /ces thabs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / shes rab don dam byang chub kyi sems gnyis zla ba dang rdo rje'i rnam par zung 'brel du bsgom pa'i don yin te/ dpal mchog las/ gang zhig skye ba tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ / byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ / phyag rgya rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ / zhes dang / grub chen mar me mdzad kyis/ rnal 'byor sems ni yang dag bskyed/ / snying gar rdo rje snying po bsam/ / zhes sogs dngadagongs pa gcig go / 'di dag rgyas par bshad na/ rgyu bzhi/ rkyen bzhi/ stobs bzhi/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang / bdag gzhan brje'i sgo nas skyed tshul/ dpe sa sogs nyer gnyis/ grogs 'dun sogs nyer gnyis/mi zad pa brgyad cu sogs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam bzhag dang /mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi khyad par gsum dang / de'i 'dzin stangs gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi don rigs pas sgrub tshul rnam lnga rnam bdun mtha' bzhi skye 'gog mu bzhi skye 'gog rten 'brel la sogs pa mtha' yas kyang 'dir brjod kyis mi lang / de nas rdo rje 'byung ba las gsung ba'i sngags/ su ra te sa ma ya/ zhes sogs kyis de nyid brtan par byas/ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gye nang du bcug pa yin te/ a sa me zhes sogs kyang rigs gsum gyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa'i don yin pas/ 'di yan chad kyis yol ba'i phyi 'jug gam/ phyi skal mnyam du byed pa'i rim pa song zin pa yin/ de'ang spyir dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i tshul la/ bya nam mkha' nas 'bab pa ltar steng nas thur du 'jug pa ye shes pa'i 'jug pa/ kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar phyogs mtshams thams cad nas nang du 'jug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pa/ sa'i gting nas chu rdol ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'og nas thol byung gi tshul gyis steng du 'jug pa 452

༄/ /nganaphang thams cadasbyongaba'i dkyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadapa/rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pa/ rgyal po'i pho brang du sgo pa'i rjes su 'brang nas 'jug pa ltar shar sgo nas 'jug pa rdo rje slob ma'i 'jug pa rnams su yod pa'i nang nas 'dir phyi ma yin te/ rgyas par byed na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'i gong du sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rgyas sgo so sor bkug ste/ slar badz+ra sa ma ya zhes pas shar sgo nas gzhug par gsung / 'di la dbang don de nyid yang gsal du sgom rnams kyi/ zhes gsungs pa yi ge ma dag par mngon te/ spyong rgyud shāka thub kyi skabs las/ dpa' bo lcags kyu zhags pa dang / / zhes sgo parnams la dpa' bo'i ming gis btags shing / rtse mor/ lha so bdun gye grangasagasung ba'i skabs su'ang / gsang chen lha mo bcu gnyis dang / zhes lha so bdun gyi grangs su lha mo bcu gnyis las ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /spyong rgyud lo chen gyi 'gyur las lcags kyu ma zhes sogs gsungs kyang / de 'gyur 'chug pa yin pas 'di'i shes byed du mi 'gro'o/ / de'i 'og tu gnas gsumabyin gyis brlab pa ni sbyong rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin zhing / de rjes ye shes 'bebs pa la 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bco lnga par gnas kyi khyad par la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs kyang / 'dir rdo rje 'byung ba nas bshad pa bzhin sgo dbye ba'i sngags kyis bla ma dang slob ma gnyis ga'i snying ga phye ste/ bla ma'i thugasaka'i rdo rje las a yig dmar po zhig byung nas slob ma'i snying ga'i rdo rje'i dbus su zhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kun gang bar bsgom pa dang /de nyid bsdus pa las gsungs pa'i gsol 'debs kyi tshig dang / sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa tshang ba'i sgo nas dbab dgos te/ 'beb ma nus na sbog chog bya tshul dang / sku gsung thugs gang la gang 'bab dang babs pa'i mtshan ma sogs rgyas par de nyid yang gsal sogs su gsungs pa ltar yin/ de ltar ye shes dngos su babs pa'am babs pa'i mos pa brtan po byas pa'i stobs kyis thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa la nang skal 453

༄/ /gung ca gsapa'isgronasa'i ga 4mamanyam gyi tha snyad mdzad pa yin zhing / de nas yang sbyong rgyud las/ rin chen me tog la sogs pa/ / gang la babs pa rigs kyi lha/ / gtso bo'i rigs de sgrub na ni/ / dngos grub myur te the tshom med/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma gang 'grub pa dang / lha'i rigs ci 'dra zhig sgrub pa'i snod du rung ba dang / de'i dngos grub myur bul sogs kyi skal ba mchog dman rtogs pa'i phyir du me tog 'dor dgos shing 'dor ba'i sngags ni oṃ badz+ra pra tī griṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ zhes pa 'di yin la/ phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bcings te me tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba'i sngags ni sngags de'i 'og ma gnyis yin par gsung / de rjes mig dar dbye ba la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad sho lo ka gcig po 'di de nyid bsdus pa las 'byung zhing / de'i mjug tu spyong rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ oṃ badz+ra ha sru/ zhes sogs kyis gdong g.yogs bkrol nas/ oṃ badz+ra pā sh+ya ho zhes pas dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul ba yin la/ 'ga' zhig tu te badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes kyang 'byung ba de dang don gcig cing / de'ang te ni bod skad du bsgyur na kyi zhes 'bod pa'i tshig dang / pā sh+ya zhes pa ltos shig ces pa yin/ gang la lta ba yin na badz+ra zhes pa rdo rje'i skad dod yin zhing /de'ang mi phyed pa la 'jug pas/ rgyud sde gong ma ltar na bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ltar na zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la bya dgos/ la lasade ltar ma go bar/ te badz+ra zhes sbrel nas kye rdor gyi dkyil 'khor zhal ston du bzung ste/ bde mchog lta bu la tsa kra sasba ra pu sh+ya/ zhes sogs su 'don pa bsgyur dgos par 'dod pa gtan mi 'thad pas 'dir gong du bshad pa bzhin badz+ra zhes pa spyi sgra bye brag la sbyar te rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por ngos 'dzin dgos la dkyil 'khor gyi don ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/454

༄/ /nganasang thams cad chaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashad pa/dkyil ni snying po'o/ / 'khor ni len pa'o/ / zhes gsungs shing / de'i don yang ji ltar yin zhe na/ spyong rgyud las/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / / de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ / zhes sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyisa.u med pa'i ye shes ni nang gzugs med kyi dkyil 'khor dang gong du bshadapa'i snying po'ang yin la/ de nyid phyi gzugs can gye dkyil 'khor gye rnam par sprul pa'i sgo nas de la longs su spyod pa ni len pa'i don yin te/'dul 'dzin gyi ṭīka chen las kyang / maṇ+ḍal zhes pa'i maṇ+ḍa snying po la len pa ste/ zhes gsungs so/ / de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor de la dbye ba'i rnam grangs kyang mang du yod de/ 'jam dbyangs dga' blo'i gsang 'dus bskyed rim las/ gang du zhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la du yod snyam na rnam pa bzhi ste/ phyi rdul tshon dang / ras bris gnyis/ nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis dang bzhi'o/ / der ma zad dus 'khor sogs dang bstun na blos bslang du'ang dbang bskur bar mngon no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i nang nas snga ma gnyis ni slob dpon dril bu pas/ ri mor bri ba'i las dang ni/ / thig las tshon dgye'i rim pa dang / / zhes pa nas/bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang / / de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod/ /ces las dang po ba la ched du bsngags shing / de'i nang nas kyang rdul tshon ni/rgyudardor phreng las/ dkyil 'khor sa tshon phra rab dang / / mtshungs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ / mtshan pa nyid du 'gyur ba dang / / zhes phan yon che bar dngos su gsungs pa'i rigs pa ras bris la sbyar du rung zhing / cung zad 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang gis deng sang phyag len phal cher 'di'i steng nas byed pa 'di bzhin yin/ de'ang skabs 'dir ston pa'i shes byed ni/ nyi shu pa las/ de ni blo dang ldan pa yis/ / dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bstan par bya/ / zhes gsungs shing blta ba'i tshe kun slong gi khyad par ji lta bu 455

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgronas g.yo 'phag dgos pa ni/ rdo rje snying po rgyan dang gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs las/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos/ / zhes mthun par gsungs pas yid 'khul nges kyi dad pa shugs drag po bcos ma ma yin pa zhig gsal 'debs pa shin tu gal che/ de'ang dad pa'i ngo bo ni/ mngon pa kun las btus las/ dad pa gang zhe na/ yod pa nyid dang yon tan can dang /nus pa rnams la mngon par yid ches pa dang / dang ba dang / 'dod pa ste 'dun pa'i rten byed pa'i las can no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs 'di lta bu la mtshon na dkyil 'khor 'di nyid rgyud kyi ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos dus nam gyi tshe gnas gang du gdul bya ji lta bu la gsungs nas de nyid smin grol la bkod pa sogs kyi dpe dang gtan tshigs mthong ba'i sgo nas yid ches kyi dad pa skyed pa dang / 'di'i rten brten pa mtha' dag gdos bcas bem chos kyi rang bzhin dang tha mal gyi gtso 'khor don gzhan lta bu ma yin par dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu mthong ba'i sgo nas dang ba'i dad pa skyed pa dang / slar rang rang gis kyang 'di nas gsungs pa ltar gyi lam gyi cha thams cad tshang bar nyams su blangs na de dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis rdzogs par 'grub nus su mthong ba'i sgo nas mngon 'dod kyi dad pa skyed pa'i tshul gsum du yod pas/ de dag cung zad rgyas par bshad na/dang po la'ang ston pa rdo rjes 'chang chen pos rgyud bzhi dus nam gyi tshe gsungs pa ni/ yo ga la mkhas pa'i mi gsum du grags pa'i nang nas slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di nyid zas gtsang gi sras su 'khrungs nas dka' ba spyad pa'i bar du byang sems yin la/ de nas ye shes kyi lus 'og min du phyin te/ mngon byang lngas sangs rgyas nas/ ri rab kyi rtse mor rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs te/ slar dze+e rañdza na'i 'gram gyi rnam smin gyi lus la zhugs nas byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs pa sogs kyi mdzad pa bstan 456

༄/ /nganasong thams cadatshungaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyi bshadal/par bzhed la/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po sogs ni/ de thams cad drang don tshul bstan kho na yin gyi/ nges don du bskal pa bgrang las 'das pa'i snga rol nas sangs rgyas zin par bzhed cing / der ma zad sgron gsal las/rnam par snang mdzad chen po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub par gyur to/ / zhes bdag cag gi ston pa dang rnam par snang mdzad chen po gnyis thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs shing / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo las kyang / shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par spung ba na/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'od zer 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba tshe bskal ba grangs med pa bdun brgya thub pa de ston pa 'di nyid yin par gsungs pa sogs gsang ba bsam mi khyab kyi ngang tshul dpag par dka' la/ de dang mthun par rgyud 'di'ang 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gdul bya so so'i rgyud la rgyun chad med par skor par mdzad pa yin kyang / gdul bya thun mong ba'i ngor gsung tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ spyong rgyud las/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la zhugs te/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas/ ri rab kyi rtse mo/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi byang phyogs/ thams cad dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya bar/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku chags bral gye rnam pa las 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rnam pa'am rnam snang chen po'i rnam par bzhengs te gsungs par kā madhe nus bshad la/ kha cig 'dir tshangs pa chen po zhes gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan lha sku zhal bzhi pa'i rnam par bstan pa la 'dod pa ni rtog bzo kho na yin te/ 'di ni chos mngon pa mdzod las/ de nyid tshangs tshul tshangs pa yi/ / 'khor lo tshangs bas bskor phyir ro/ / zhes tshangs pa'i sgra thar pa la bshad tshul gcig dang / yang rten brten pa ma phye bar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bshad tshul gcig dang gnyis gsungs pa'i phyi ma'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de lta bu'i tshangs pa chen po de nyid kyis ji lta bur 457

༄/ /yo cabalob tsho tsha lamagasungs tshul ni/ 'khor bye ba khrag khrig mang po'i dbus su ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su spyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'od zer gyi spro bsdus ngan song gi sems can grangs med pa grol bar byas shing / de dag gis kyang ched du brjod pa la brten nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba lha yul nas tshe 'phos pa de nyid kyi skye gnas zhus pa'i lan du/ mnar med la sogs pa'i dmyal ba'i gnas rnams su sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa rim gyis myong bar lung bstan pas lha rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas mya ngan gyis brgyal bar gyur te/slar yang de las skyob pa'i thabs zhus pa na/ dang po spyor ba'i teng nge 'dzin/de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog de nas las kyi cho ga dkyil 'khor bri sgrub/bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i rim pa sogs dang / khyad paradu gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga rnams rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin brgya byin gyis cho ga byas pas lha'i bu de nyid dmyal ba las thar te dga' ldan du skyesanas/ e ma shākya mgon po yi/ / zhes sogs ched du brjod pa byas pa yin pas/ dang por cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig sngon du 'gro ba med mi rung yin te/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ bla ma cho ga rgyud bzhin mi shes shing / /dam tshig sdom la mi gnas rnal 'byor bral/ /bsnyen sogs ma dag gang byung lag len gyes/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin dbang gi gzugs brnyan yin/ /dbang gis ma smin skye bo'i tshogs nang du/ / rkang stabs phyag rgya sngags dang dkyil 'khor sogs/ / gsang ba bsgrags pas rnyed bkur don gnyer ba/ /gsang sngags chom rkun cho ga'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /mo dang rtsisalung sman pa'i ngag mnyan nas/ / dam tshig sdom pa spangs pa'i slob ma la/ /brgya phrag dbang bskur 'bul ba'i brje tshong can/ /dmyal ba'i sgrub thabs dbang gi gzugs brnyan yin/ / dbang khrid lung gis zas nor tshol 458

༄/ /nganaphang thamasacadatshungaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadapa/ba dang / / lto phyir rdzun gyi cho ga byung rgyal gyis/ / phan sems med par grong chog brtson pa ni/ / bdag gzhan bslu ba'i gzhan don gzugs brnyan yin/ / zhesagasungs pa ltar dang por cho ga rgyud dang mthun pa zhig ma byung na/ phyi ma thams cad kyang rgyu sngon song dang mthun par gzugs brnyan tsam zhig las mi 'ong bas/ de lta bu'i sgo nas gzhan don byed par rlom yang mthar rang gzhan gnyis ka dmyal bar ltung ba'i rgyur 'gro nyen che bas shin tu gzab dgos te/ rang gis bsnyen sgrub sogs tshul bzhin ma byung bas 'bras bu'ang rgyud kyi bshad tshod ltar ma byung ba na lha sngags sogs la yid gnyis za ba ni/ rang gi blo skyon chos la 'gel ba yin te bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ phyi yi yan lag stobs kun ni/ / khyod kyis yang dag bsgrubs lags te/ / nang gi stobs dag ma tshang bas/ / byis pa rnams ni sdug bsngal brten/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyabs yul rnams kyi ngos nas rgyu tshogs ma tshang pa med par bsgrub tu zin kyang lhan cig byed rkyen yin la/ nyer len rangagi sems steng nas 'grub dgos pas de ma tshang na snga ma gcig pus mi chog ste/ zhing sa ci tsam bzang yang sa bon ma btab na myu gu mi skye ba dang sman pa ci tsam mkhas kyang des byin pa'i sman ma btung na nad pa gso bar mi nus pa dang 'dra bas/ rang ngos nas ma byung ba yin gyi/ yi dam lha'i ngos nas bslu ba nam yang mi srid snyam du yid ches kyi dad pa shugs drag tu skyed dgos/gnyis pa rten brten pa thams cad ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol tu mthong ba'i sgo nas dang pa'i dad pa skyed pa la rten brten pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/dpal mchog las/ mi mnyam med pa'i zur bzhi ste/ dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi yin/ / bsam gtan rnams kyi rta bab bzhi/ / zhes sogs dang cho ga'i gzhung du'ang gsungs pa ltar thabs shes kyi cha so so'i ngo bo yin la der ma zad 'og gzhi'i rlung me chu sa ri rab rnams kyang ye shes kyi rang bzhin las ma 459

༄ / /gung thangabastanaba'irna sa'igasung 'chaga'adas pas/ de dag skyed pa'i tshe'ang rang rang gi sa bon de nyid mnyam bzhag namamakha' lta bu'i ye shes dang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig gnyis kyi bar du bcug nas bskyed par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / 'dir mi mnyam med pa'i zur bzhi zhes pa'i don ṭīka chen dang cho gar/ tshad med pa bzhi'i tshul gyes sems can rnams la mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi/ zhes gru bzhi tshad med bzhi'i ngo bor gnas pa'i don du gsungs la/ snye ma bcu gnyis pa las/ sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas ma yin pa mnyam pa nyid kyis mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi pa ste zur bzhi pa'o/ / zhes dang / snye ma bco brgyad pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang so so skye bo dag de kho na nyid du na gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin nyid kyis mi mnyam pa med pa gsal bar byed pa rnam par dag pas dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnam par dag pas gru bzhi pa'o/ /zhes mi mnyam pa med pa'i don chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig par ston pa'iye shes la gsungs kyang thabs shes dbyer mi phyed pas snga ma dang 'gal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa brten pa'i lha'i rnam dag ni/ 'dul 'dzin chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga dang rnam thar bzhi/ /stong nyid rtogs pa bcu drug sbyin sogs brgyad/ / dad brtson dran dang ting 'dzin yon tan rnams/ /sum cu rtsa bdun lha yi rnam pa ru/ / ji bzhin shar ba zab gsal gnyis med la/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar zab pa stong pa'i de nyid dang /gsalab lha'i 'khor lo zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes gcig pu de nyid la/ ji skad du/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ de la don mthong rnam par shes/ /de yi khyad par sems las byung / / zhes gsungs pa ltar ldog cha so so dang byed las kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas phye ba chos dbyings ye shes la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga dang / yul can rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi dang / stong nyid 460

༄/ /ngan song thams cadachangaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashad pa/rtogs pa'i ye shes bcu drug dang / sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gi steng du smon lam dang thabs mkhas kyi phar phyin bsnan pas brgyad dang / dad brtson dran pa ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rnams kyi ngo bo lha so bdun gye rnam par shar ba yin gyi/ rgyud tha dad pa'i gtso 'khor du ma 'dus pa lta bu ma yin no/ / de'ang skabs 'di dang bla med kyi skabs nas rnam dag gsung tshul cung zad mi 'dra ste/sngags rim chen mo las/ rten brten pa'i rnam dag la/ yo ga nas dad pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gye chos su dag tshul nyid bshad la/ bla med nas lam gyi dag pa dang phung sogs kyi dag pa gnyis ka gsungs so/ / zhes bla med kyi skabs su gzugs kyi phung po dag pa'i rnam snang / tshor phung dag pa rin 'byung du gsungs pa lta bu yod kyang / 'dir de 'dra ma gsungs pa ni gong du dbangajas sogs kyang ye shes kyi ngo bor mos pa tsam las lhar mi skyed par bshad pa dang gnad gcig ste lam dus su ji ltar mos pa de nyid 'bras dus su'ang 'grub dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rang gis kyang lam 'di la brten nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don ma lus pa bsgrub nus su mthong ba'i sgo nas mngon 'dod kyi dad pa bskyed pa la/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyal po bdespyod bzang po la gdams pa rin po che'i phreng ba las/ dang por mngon par mtho ba'i chos/ / phyis ni nges par legs 'byung ba'o/ / gang phyir mngon par mtho thob pas/ / rim gyis nges par legs pa 'byung / / zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ mngon mtho nges legs sgrub byed dad shes gnyis/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gdul bya rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs mngon par mtho ba dang / mthar thug nges par legs pa gnyis su grangs nges pa'i gnad kyis/ston pas chos phung ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad kyang skyes bu chung ngu dang 461

༄/ /gung thangabayopa'isgronaza' ga ཿma/thun mong ba mngon mtho'i chos skor dang / che 'bring gis bsdus pa nges legs kye chos skor gnyis su 'du la/ der ma zad/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'gro rnamasazhi ba'i las dang ni/ / zhesapa nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god pa ste/zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las nyer bdun po thams cad kyang dngawar 'gro ba zhi ba'i 'phrin las mngon mtho la 'god pa nas mthar nges legasami gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa'i 'phrin las su 'du ba sha stag yin la/ dgos pa de gnyis ni lam bzang 'di la brten nas bde blag tu bsgrub par nus pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag / ces ngan song sbyangs te mngon mtho'i rten la 'god cing / rten de la gnas nas byang chub kyi spyod pa la zhugasate nges legs thar ba sgrub par gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po ngan song sbyong tshul ni lho sgor grags pa 'di nyid gtso bo yin la/ 'di'ang don bsdus na bgegs sdig dri ma sbyang ba gsum du 'du bas/ dang po bgegs sbyang ba ni/sbyong rgyud las/ de nas gdon rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ mngon spyod kyang ni brtsoms byas te/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar oṃ sarba bighan sogs kyis gtor ma bsngo ba ni rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum zhi ba yin pas zhi bas sbyang ba dang / ting lo bskor zhing sum bha ni brjod pa rdzas zhi ba dang sngags drag po ting nge 'dzin phyed ma yin pas zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ bde ni stobs brjod de drag sngags brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug yungs gar gyis brab pa ni gsum ka drag po yin pas drag pos sbyang ba ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas mngon mthol bar du gcod pa'i bgegs spyong zhing / de rjes sdig pa sbyong ba la/ sbyong rgyud las/ sbyin bsreg byas par gyur na ni/ / dmyal ba chen por gyur ba yi/ / sdig pa de las thar par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / sbyin bsreg mngon par dbang bskur na/ / gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ / zhes za 462

༄/ /ngan song thams cadasbyongaba'i dkyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadapa/byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba dang / yang de nyid las/thal ba nyungs gar bye ma sogs/ / rang gi ming smos sngags btab pas/ /bzlas pa byas te song nas kyang / / rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i klung dor na/ / de ltar yang ni sdig can yang / / ngan song las ni thar 'gyur na/ / zhes sogs brab sngags kyi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong pa gnyis su yod/ de nas dri ma sbyong ba la/ lha la khrus gsol ba'i chu dang / rnam rgyal gyi bum chu bsdus te phyin drug gi tshigs bcad sogs brjod nas khrus byed pa ni/ gtsug dgu las/ rus pa'am gos sam ming la ni/ / rdo rje chu yis bkru bar bya/ / sdig pa bkru ba'i sngags kyis ni/ / srid gsum dri ma bkru bar bya/ / zhes sogs kyis gsungs shing / de rjes gang ser ma'i shis bajod sogs kyis mi shes pa sbyong ba ni/ de nyid las/ slar yang bkra shis tshigs bcad kyis/ / dus gsum du ni khrus bya'o/ / zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin te sbyang ba 'di dag thams cad rgyud 'di'i skor kho na las gsungs pa ma gtogs gzhan du mi gsal yang / deng sang gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs dkyil 'khor phal cher dang sbyar nas byed pa ni bla ma gong ma nams kyis rgyud 'di'i rigs pas rgyas bkab pa yin pas de thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu ni rgyud 'di nyid yin no/ / de rjes nges legs thar pa 'grub tshul ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / / de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ / chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ / rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar nges legs thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyi thob bya mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang ro gcig tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / theg chen gyi chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pas na longs sku'am gzhom med kyi gsung dang /gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin gang 'tsham du sprul pa'i gzugs kyi sku dang / 'bad 463

༄ / /gung bang bstanapa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/rtsol med par lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa dang bcas pa mdor bsdus na sku gsung thugs 'phrin las dang bzhi po 'dir nges te/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi stobs kyis srid pa'i rgud pa las grol zhing brtse ba snying rje chen po'i dbang gis gzugs sku'i rnam par bstan nas 'khor ba ji srid bar du bzhugs pas zhi ba'i rgud pa las grol te/ de ltar srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pas rang don yongs su rdzogs shing / de nas 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don rgyun chad med par mdzad cing / khyad par du mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi sgo nas chos 'khor bskor te gdul bya mtha' dag byang grol la bkod pas gzhan don yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / 'bras bu de bzhi ni phyag chen/ dam rgya/chos rgya/ las rgya bzhi'i sgo nas legs par sgrub nus pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di la kha cig rgyan las/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / / dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di/ / theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ / thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ / ces longs sku ni mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs sku la bshad pas gsung longs skur 'jog pa mi 'thad snyam na/ de ni mdo'i dbang du byas la/ sngags kyi skabs 'dir longs sku gtso bor gsung la 'jog dgos te/ sngags rim las/ longs sku ni sgyu lus la'ang bshad pas chog mod kyang / sngags kyi sbyi skad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la bshad pa mang bas 'dir de ltar bshad do/ / zhes gsungs shing dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i mtshan brjod ṭīk+kar yang / mdo lugs kyis theg chen gyi chos la longs spyod pa'i byed pa po'i dbang du byas pa dang / sngags kyis longs spyod byed kyi byed pa'i dbang du byas par gsungs so/ / 'on kyang sngags lugs la'ang longs skur lha sku bzhin lag gi rnam pa can gtan mi 'dod pa min te/ sngags rim gyi lung der sgyu lus kyang gsungs pa'i phyir dang 464

༄/ /nganalong thams cad tshoba'i dkyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadal/dbang don de nyid yang gsal las/ sngags spyi tsam du ma zad dus 'khor gyi lugs la'ang zeg chen gye chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i byed pa po'i longs sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa'ang yod par bzhed do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na sku gsung thugs 'phrin las bzhi po de phyag rgya bzhis 'grub lugs ji ltar yin snyam na/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gye rtog pa las/ rdo rje sku gsung thugs rnams kyi/ / gzugs brnyan sbyor ba 'di dag ni/ / phyag rgya kun gye khyad par te/ / zhes dang / rgyud phyi mar/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ / gzugs brnyan gyi ni sbyor ba yis/ / bdag nyid chen po phyag rgya che/ / de ltar shes nas 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / a ba tar las kyang / phyag rgya de'ang 'dir sku la sogs pa'i bye brag gis phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba dang / dam tshig dang / chos dang las kyi phyag rgya dang rnam pa bzhir bstan te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha de dang de'i sku'i rnam pa rjes su dran cing / rang gi lus kyang der mos te lha'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med du bsre ba ni phyag chen gyis rgyas btab pa'i don yin 'ing / de ltar mos pa yid byed kyis goms pa las mthar lha sku dngos gnas par bzhengs pas gzugs sku 'grub pa yin la/ / des mtshon nas/ chos rgyas rang gi ngag dang sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyer med du rgyas 'debs pa dang / dam rgyas rang gi yid dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs dbyer med du rgyas 'debs/ las rgyas rang gi sgo gsumagyi bya ba dang sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dbyer med du rgyas 'debs pa yin te/ gong du gzugs brnyan sbyor ba zhes pa'i don dang por mos pa yid byed kyis de dang cha 'dra tsam bsgoms nas mthar de dngos gnas par 'gro ba'i don no/ / de'ang phyag rgya bzhi'i nang nas chos rgya'i tshe lce la chos kyi yi ge 'god pa ni rlung sngags tha mi dad du byas te gsung 'grub pa'i mtshon don dang / las rgya'i tshe sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa bsgom pa 'phrin las rnam bzhi 465

༄/ /yo cabamapa'irnanasa' g.yo 'chagasogs las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i mtshon don dang / phyag chen gyi tshe dang po'i rdo rje bsgom pa gzugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag mtshan yin pa'i gnad kyis yin nam snyam la/ dam rgya'i tshe snying gar thog mtha' med pa'i chos nyid kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa gsal 'debs pa 'di'i don cung zad rtogs dka' bar snang yang 'di ltar 'chad dgos sam snyam ste/ de'ang dam rgya zhes pa ni tshig bsdus pa tsam las don du dam tshig gi phyag rgya zhes pa yin la/ dam tshig gi don ni/ kun rig ṭīka chen las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi gsang ba ni nges tshig gi tshul gyis yang dag par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir ram yang dag par thob pa'am/ mi 'da' ba'i don gyis dam tshig ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dam tshig gi skad dod sa ma ya zhes pa togs pa dang / thob pa dang / mi 'da' ba sogs la 'jug tshul gsungs pa ni/ rnam 'grel las/ gshegs pa rtogs pa'i don phyir te/ / zhes sogs lugs 'byung ldog gi bshad pa'i skabs su ye shes phun tshogs la sbyar nas rtogs pa dang / spangs pa phun tshogs la sbyar nas thob pa'am mngon du byas pa la bshad pa ltar/ 'dir yang spangs pa dang ye shes gnyis ka la sbyor dgos shing / de'ang ngo bo so so ba ma yin par mi 'da' ba'am mi phyed pas na dam tshig ces bshad pa yin la/ rdo rje'i skad dod badz+ra zhes pa'ang mi phyed pa la 'jug pas/ thog mtha' med pa'i chos kye dbyings dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje ngo bo gcig la ldog pas phye na chos dbyings ye shes la sogs pa ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can de lta bu 'grub pa ni skabs 'di'i phyag mtshan gyi mtshon don yin no/ / der ma zad phyag rgya bzhi'i 'jog tshul la gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang sbyar ba'i bshad tshul du ma yod de/ bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba las/ rnam par shes pa rnam pa bzhi/ / phyag rgya bzhi yi cho ga yis/ / gsang ba gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /sku gsung thugs ni yang dag 'byung / / zhes dang / 'byung ba chen 466

༄/ /nganasong thams cadasbyongaba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston sgrubashadapa/pobazhi po yang / / phyag rgya bzhi zhes bshad pa yin/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi'i phyag chen tha mal gyi lus dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes sa'i khams3mas ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ de spyong byed de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu dang po nas gsungs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang / yul can rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid ni lam gyi phyag chen yin zhing / sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid kyi gzugs sku dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes mi bskyod pa rnams ni 'bras bu'i phyag chen yin no/ / des mtshon te sbyang gzhi tha mal gyi sems dang / chu khams/ nyon yid rnams/ spyong byed dum bu gnyis pa nas gsungs pa'i lam sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang mtshan med sogs kyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang rin 'byung mnyam nyid ye shes rnams ni 'bras bu'i dam rgya/ sbyang gzhi tha mal gyi ngag dang / me khams/ drug pa yid shesanams/ spyong byed dum bu gsum pa nas gsungs pa'i lam shes rab kyi phar phyin dang / smon med sogs kyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang / 'od dpag med/ sor rtog ye shes rnams ni 'bras bu'i chos rgya/ sbyang gzhi tha mal gyi bya ba dang / rlung gi khams/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes rnams sbyong byed dum bu bzhi pa nas gsungs pa'i lam brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin dang mngon par 'du mi byed pa sogs kyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dang don yod grub pa/ bya grub ye shes rnams ni 'bras bu'i las rgya ste/ mdor bsdus na ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyangs nas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i go 'phang bde blag tu ster bar byed pas/ nges legs thar pa sgrub pa la'ang / thabs 'di las mchog tu gyur pa med par mthong nas mngon 'dod kyi dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa bskyed dgos/ de ltar rgyud kyi che ba khong du chud nas dad pa skyed pa ni dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gi lugs yin la/ de tsam mi nus na'ang /yo7

༄za/ /gung thangabastanaba'irja ce' gsung 'bugadakyil 'khor mthong ba'i phan yon tsam zhig shes pa nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ de ni rnam snang mngon byang las/ / bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sdig pa gang zhig sngon byas pa/ /'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba yis /de ma thag tu zad 'gyur na/ /zhes dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis bskal pa mang po'i sdig pa 'dag pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ ras bris mthongab tsam gyis ni/ / gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ / zhes dang /mtshamasamed pa dang sdig can yang / / ras bris mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig gis ni grol bar 'gyur/ / zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo'i lung gong du drangs pa ltar/ ras bris thang gcig mthong bas kyang thar pa'i sa bon khyad par can bzhag ste tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su'ang lam bzang 'di dang mjal zhing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bzung ste mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor sogs la tshul bzhin du bslabs te ring por mi thogs par mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba sogs gnas skabs mngon par mtho ba dang mthar thug nges par legs pa las brtsams pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gsungs pas 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba bdag skal ba bzang snyam pa'i dga' spro dang /nged kyis ji ltar brda sprad pa de'i tshe ras bris su bris pa 'di nyid mtshon byed du byas te/ des mtshon par bya ba dag pa'i rten dang brten pa de dag mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa lhan cig pa'i sgo nas gzigs dgos pa yin la/dkyil 'khor ston pa'i rim pa ni grub chen dpal 'dzin sogs kyis byang sgo pa nas bzung ste mas rim bzhin ston par bzhed la/ lwa ba pa la sogs pas shar sgo pa nas ston par bzhed pas gang ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med par gsungs la/ 'on kyang 'dir ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sgo pa rdo rje lcags kyu nas bcom ldan 'das la thug gi bar du bstan to/ / zhes dang / rdo rje 'byung ba 468

༄/ /ngan song thams cadatshung ba'idakyil 'khor zhalaston gyibashadapa/las kyang / de nas rdo rje lcags kyu nas brtsams te bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi bar du dkyil 'khor chen po bstan par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par byed na/ 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor srung ba'i 'khor lo me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rim pa gnyis su yod pa'i nang ma'i shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgog/ byang sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa/ phyi'i shar lhor bdug spos ma/ lho nub tu me tog ma/ nub byang du mar me ma/ byang shar du dri chab ma/ nang gi shar lhor sgeg mo/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma/ nub byang du glu ma/ byang shar du gar ma/ shar gyi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje sems dpa'/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rgyal po/ gsum pa la rdo rje chags pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje legs pa/ lho'i rtsibs dang po la rdo rje rin chen/gnyis pa la rdo rje gzi brjid/ gsum pa la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bzhi pa la rdo rje bzhad pa/ nub kyi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje chos/ gnyis pa la do rje rnon po/gsum pa la rdo rje rgyu/ bzhi pa la rdo rje smra ba/ byang gi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje las/ gnyis pa la rdo rje bsrung ba/ gsum pa la rdo rje gnod sbyin/ bzhi pa la rdo rje khu tshur/ nang gi shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma kyi/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma/ shar du ngan song spyong ba'i rgyal po/lhor rgyal mchog rin chen/ nub tu shākya rig dbang / byang du me tog cher rgyas/ de dag thams cad kyi dbus su rten dang brten pa mtha' dag spro zhing sdud pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad chen po ste lha so bdun gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod cig / ces brda sprad par bya'o/ /469

༄/ /gung thangabastonapa'isgronama'i go gtsogasmras pa/ rnam dpyod 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs las skyes/ / sngon med legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston 'di/ / 'dzam gling mkhas pa bde 'byung ma lus pa'i/ / gtsug rgyan gsar tshes zla ba'i myu gu yin/ / bshad par 'dod pas mgrin pa bsrang na yang / / rmongs pa'i lcags kyus ro 'dzin phyir drangs te/ / skog mar snying dang sbyar ba de dag la/ / dbugs 'byung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di sbrengs so/ / dge bas mi bzad ngan song gsum gyi rgyud/ /yongs su sbyangs te lam bzang 'di nyid la/ / brten nas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / rnam snang chen po'i sa la 'god par shog / ces ngan song thamasacad spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal ston gyi bshad pa choyodung dkar po'i sgra dbyangasazhes bya ba 'di ni dbang gi skabs gnye bar mkho zhing / spyir yang rang dang skal mnyam rnamasa'adi'i rgyud don ragayorim tsamal blo kha phyogasapa'i thabasasu phan du re nas/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesamakhan chen ngag dbang gragasapa'igadan sad tshang lhun grub gling du brisapa 'disakyang yo ga'i lug4srol dri ma med pa phyogasadus kun tu rgyasapar gyur cig /sarba mgo li/ /470

༄/ /rabaganasadagolegasacar 'bebs kyi phyag lenasatha'adag༄༅/ / rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs kyi phyag len mtha' dag gsal bar bshad pa legs byas sprin gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / dam tshig sku yi bkod pa'i chu 'dzin phreng / / ye shes bde ba chen po'i mkhar 'phags te/ / 'gro la dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs pa'i/ / sgrig rim ma 'chol dbyar rnga'i dbyangs su sgrogs/ / de yang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas rgyas pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs kyi zur 'debs 'god pa la/ / nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad 'du bya ba dang / ji ltar lag tu len pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla ma'i ba'i mdun nam g.yas su khrus stegs gru bzhi/ phyogs rer khru bzhi re/dpangs su khru do yod pa dang / de'i steng du khrus dkyil phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar dmar nag pa'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir snam bu gru bzhi/ de la phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar shar nas g.yas skor du 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/dkar ser dmar ljang / mtshams bzhir shar lho nas g.yas skor du/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ ral gri dkar sngo dmar ljang rnams kyis mtshan pa rdul tshon gyis bri ba'am/ ras bris su byas pa'i shar gyi mtshan ma slob dpon la bstan nas dgab/ de'i dbus su me tog dang ku sha'i gdan la gas chag sogs kyi skyon med pa'i lha bum lha grangs sam/ de ma 'byor na mtshan nyid tshangaba'i rnam rgyal bum pa dung chos gzungs rdor can/ de'i g.yon du las 471

༄khya/ /gung thangabastan pa'izla ma'i gsung 'thugabum ste gnyis gar chu gtsang du bla med nas bshad pa'i bum rdzas nyer lnga 'debs shing so so'i bum mtshan gdags/ bum pa rnams kha dog rang bzhin gyis dkar ba'am/ dkar rtsis byugs pa dang / srog gsum 'dang nges pa'i ras sam gos dar zung re'i mgul chings thor cog gsum pa'i tshul du byas la/oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa ra ru ṭa ma ṭa da shaṃ brnya hūṃ/ zhes bzla zhing srad bu dkar po bdun gyis dkris/ 'o ma can gye shing gi yal ga 'bras bu bcas pas kha rgyan bya/ shar dang shar lho/ lho dang lho nub sogs nas g.yas skor du pad 'dab brgyad la khrus bum brgyad kyi dang por ka ra bu ram sprang rtsi ste mngar gsum/gnyis par zho/ gsum par kham star rgun 'brum sogs 'bras bu'i rigs/bzhi bar nas 'bras gro sran til te 'bru lnga/ lnga par tsan dan dkar dmar ga bur gur kum gla rtsi'am dza ti gang rigs te dri lnga/ drug par 'bras yos/bdun par sle dres/ maṇ+ḍa kā ri/ dbang lag rgya mtsho'i lbu ba/ shu dag ste bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i sman lnga'am/ stag tsher ba/ gaṇ+ḍa kā ri/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po/ dbyug pa'i ut+pal/ dbang lag ste bla med nas bshad pa'i sman lnga gang rigs/ brgyad par gser dngul byi ru mu tig mu min te rin po che lnga rnams chu gtsang dang sbyar ba so sor blug phal khrus kyi 'dag rdzas dang po sbrang / ka ra/ zho/ 'o ma/ mar te phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga'i 'dag chal/gnyis pa dri zhim po'i 'bru mar te/ de yang 'byor na sug spel/ shing tsha/spang spos/ ba la ga tsan dan dkar po rnams zho do re ras dkar gtsang mar so sor btum ste/ til mar bre brgyad kyi nang du bcug nas bskol ba bre drug tsam bskams nas bre do lus pa lta bu'am/ ma 'byor na til mar la dri bzang btab pa dang spos kyis bsgos pa'i rtsi mar gnyis/ gsum pa shing shun gyi phye ma ni gzhung las n+ya krodha dang u dum wa ra sogs lnga gsungs kyang rnyed dka' bas/ de'i dod du 'om bu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing gi shun pa'i phye ma 472

༄/ /rabaganasadage legs char 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagaskam po/ 'di la bkra shis snye mar lugs 'ga' gsungs/ bzhi pa ba'i zho/'o ma/ mar/ lci ba/ chu ste ba byung lnga'i 'dag chal/ lnga ba spos kyis bsgos pa'i mar/ drug pa skyu ru ra'i phye ma dang sran dkar gyi phye ma skam po/ bdun pa gong gi dri bzang lnga'i 'dag chal/ brgyad pa yung ba ste sga ser gyi phye ma skam po rnams kyi dang po bdud rtsi lnga zangs sgod dang / gzhan rnams 'khar ba'i sgod du blug gzhung las khrus kyi skabs 'dag rdzas dang po dri bzang gi lde gu dang /rjes ma dri bzang gi phye ma la byed pa lta bu zhig gsungs kyang / gong du rdzas bsham tshul gyi skabs gsungs pa dang / lcang skya gong ma'i zur 'debs las byung ba gnyis mthun par 'di bzhin yin/ mchog khrus kyi 'dag rdzas la/ dri bzang lnga'i 'dag chal/ dri zhim po'i 'bru mar/ dri bzang lnga'i phye ma skam po rnams rin po che'i snod du blug pa/ dur sngon gyi bir snod bcas/ khrus ras 'byor na ras dkar bzang po kha tshar dang phun tshar ma nyams pa'am ma 'byor na kha btags sam/ gos dar dkar po sogs gtsang ma gang 'byor la gur kum ghi waṃ tsan dan sogs sbyar bas pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ lte bar oṃ/'dab mar mdun nas g.yas skor du phyogs bzhir hūṃ tram̐ hrī 〉 rnams dbu phyir bstan te bri/ 'on kyang rjes su sku dbyi ba'i tshe/ de'i rim pa dang bstun pa ma yin par dbu dang thugs ka lte ba/ phrag pa g.yas g.yon rnams rim pas phyi ba'i tshul gyis byabs par gsungs/ khrus kyi me long che legs la dbus su hūṃ/ mthar mdun nas g.yas skor du ye dha rmā sbrul 'khyil ba ltar rab tshar bdun/ tha ma tshar gcig gur kum sogs kyis bris pa/ bkra shis kyi 'thor 'bru 'bras dkar sogs 'bru gtsang ma dge 'dun tshogs pa mang nyung dang bstun pa'i mi nyung ba snod gtsang mar blug pa'i steng du bzhag sbyang chas bgegs gtor gtor cog gsum ting lo chang bu mtheb kyu rnams gsum re snod bcas/ gu gul gyi bdug pa/ yungs dkar dang chu gtsang snod bcas/473

༄/ /gung cabasab mo tsha lamakham phor dkar po/ dur ba'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i ba lce'i chang bu/ zan chang / seng ras rnams bzhi re thun mong du snod bcas/ nye reg gi chu gtsang dang me long / stegs gcig la dri chab me tog/ mchod yon/ mar me ste mchod pa bzhi so sor snod bcas/ spos dkar mar dang sbyar ba'i ril bu/spos phor/ khrus gzhong / gsol gdab kyi tshe bdug rgyu'i dri bzang / tshogs su sra phyir 'grem rgyu'i spos ring / gos dar bzang po'i na bza' dmar ser zung / rten la 'geb rgyu'i na bza' ser po/ chu bzhi'i gdan ser po/ chu bzhi'iphas zhi ba'i skabs su nas/ 'o ma/ me tog dkar po/ til/ ku sha/'brasams/ ga bur/ bdud rtsi lnga sogs gsungs kyang / 'dir rgyas pa'i las gtso che bas/ til/ ku sha/ gur kum/ me tog ser po/ bdud rtsi lnga/zho rnams dang / snod kyang 'byor na gser dang / ma 'byor na dung dang nya phyis sogs mdog ser por bsgyur pa gsum gyi nang du blug pa dang / de gsum 'bul ba'i snod bzed zhal gsum malji dang bcas/ gser gye mig thur/ gur kum sogs mar dang sprang rtsir sbyar ba'i mig sman dngul gyi rkong bur bzhag pa/ snyan 'bru/ rmang 'tsher/ tshems shing / zhal thur rnams 'byoran rin po che las bzos pa'am bris pa'i tsaka li/ tsa ru'i bza' bar grags pa'i skum gtor che ba dkar po rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mthar sha chang sgog rigs ma gtogs pa'i zas snas bskor ba dang / rdo ja go yu go la'i phye ma dang sbyar ba'i so rtsi yang bsham/ rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs mnga' dbul gyi rdzas rin po che sogs la bzos pa'i dngos sam bris pa'i tsagli dri bzang gi chu bum pa'i nang du sbyar ba/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma/yi dam la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma/ chos skyong gi gtor ma/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma/ dkar gtor/ gtor ma sogs la bran rgyu'i chu gtsang dang / de dran byed nang mchod thod ba'i snod bcas/ khrus bum 'dzin mkhan gye grangs 474

༄/ /rabaganasadage legs char 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagadang mnyam pa'i rten khebs/ rdo dril tshogs pa'i grangs mnyam dang / khrus kyi tshe rol chen byed na spub sil rnga dung sogs kyang dgos la/ me long / ghi waṃ/zho/ ngur ba/ bil ba/ dung dkar/ li khri/ yungs gar te bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad kyi tsa 'am/ rdzas dngos yin na snod gtsang ma so sor bzhagargyas pa'i sbyin sreg la rgyal dbang gis yam shing sbom phra mthe bong gi tshad/bzo dbyibs gru bzhir byed par gsungs kyang / da lta phyag len la shas cher 'o ma can gyi shing gi rked pa'i cha nas blangs pa'i yam shing srid du khru gang /sbom chang ba'i tshad bzhi re lhan du bsdams pa dang / lhag ma/ mar khu til dur ba 'bras zho zan ku sha yungs gar so ba nas sran ma gro rnams zhi rgyas gnyis gar 'dra zhing / khyad par ba'i rdzas zhi ba la 'bru mar gyis byugs pa'i ku sha nas/ til/ zho/ 'o ma/ 'bras zan/ dur ba/ tsan dan/ bri yang ku/ thang chu/ dri zhim po'i me tog 'bras yes rnams sbrang rtsi sogs su bsnyugs pa dang nang gi bdud rtsi lnga/ rgyas pa la 'bras chan zho dang bsres pa la mngar gsum gyis spags pa'i zas mchog dang / zho/ sbrang rtsi/ til nagazho zan/ zhun mar dang bcas pa'i 'bras/ pad+ma ge sar/ nā ga ge sar dang 'brasakhu rnams sbyar ba/ zhi ba la stod gos smad gos dkar po zung / rdzas gdan dang chu bzhi'i gdan/ gos zung / rdzas kyi snod sogs dkar po dang /rgyas pa la thams cad ser po dgos/ rdzas dang yo byad sgrig dgos thams cad sta gon gyi sngar nyin nas tshags su tshud pa bya/ gang du bya ba'i gnas des cho ga sogs sngon song yin na des 'thus shing / min tshe sa chog rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang / ma mtha' lang las ma brtsam pa'i gong nas yul gye gzhi bdag sogs la mchod gtor sngon du btang ste las kyi sbyor ba rtsom dgos so/ /gnyis pa ji ltar lag tu len pa'i tshul la/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/rjes kyi rim pa gsum/ dang po ni/ nangs snga bar 'tshogs te sgrub pa po 475

༄/ /yo thang bstan ཿ sa'i gatshi lam/rnams chos gos gyon/ rdo dril bsnams nas gral la 'khod/ skyabs 'gro/ltung bshags/ chos spyod ci rigs sogs skabs dang sbyar/ de nas skad cig dkrong bskyed byas la/ rdo dril byin rlabs nas bdag bskyed mchod pa'i bar dkyus bzhin bya/ nang mchod byin rlabs gsung bzhin pa'i skabs der sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor bshams shing / bsngos zin pa'i mtshams su mchod gtor gshegs/ bdag bskyed mchod pa byin rlabs kyi tshe de'i mchod me dang bdug spos sbar pa sogs skabs so so'i mchod pa rnams mchod dpon gyis blo la nges par byas te de dang de'i byin rlabs kyi tshe/ de'i spos dang mar me sogs sbar na/ dge 'dun rnams nas kyang dmigs pa gtod sla ba'i khyad yod pas lag len gang zhib bya/ bdag bskyed mchod pa'i rjes su rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang / kharnadh+ri ka gis bsangs nas bum chog rgyas pa gdangs dang bcas te 'don/ de'i bzlas pa'i skabs gzungs thag bla ma'i phyag la 'jog bla mas dbu bskul te gtso bo'i sngags gsum brgya rtsa re/ yum dang 'khor gyi sngags sogs brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig bdun sogs skabs dang bstun/de'i rjes su las bu gye khar gzungs rdor spos la kha dh+ri ka brgya rtsa bzla/ de rjes gzungs rdor rnam bum gyi khar sbos la thun mong du badz+ra u da ka brgya rtsa dang / oṃ ā hūṃ brgya rtsa bzla/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod cing / dang po gnyis kyi skabs su gzungs thag dril/ gsum pa'i skabs su dril bu dkrol te/mthar mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ tī nyi dang / hūṃ bdun brjod cing dung chos kyi chus bum pa gnyis kyi lha la mchod yon dbul/ las sngags brjod cing me tog gsum gsum dbul/ gadhe nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/kharnadhika gis bsangs la/ ji srid sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol te bum lha 'od zhu byed/ de nas tshogs zhing dang / 'dir bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig tu byed dgos pas/ rang nyid ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su 'khod 476

༄/ /rab gnasadage legs char 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagapar mos la/ kharna dh+rika gis bsangs nas sngags gnyis bajod pa man chad 'dra/ mngal 'byin gyi skabs 'khor gye lha spro tshe/ shar gyi mtshan ma dang ngo bo dbyer med du gyur/ ces sogs brjod/ rgyas gdab kyi mjug tu/ rang nyid gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du phye nas dkyil 'khor gye shar sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol tu mchod pa'i las la gnas par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rgyal ba rnam gtsang ma/ rin chen dbang rgyal ma/ 'dzam bu chu gser ma rnams phyag rgya gdangs bcas te 'don/ nang mchod kyi mjug tu/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ gtso bo dang tha mi dad par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas/ zhes pa nas/ stoms par zhugs pas gsang pa dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas dgyes par gyur/ 'jam dpal gser mdog mas bstod/ dag pa dran pa/ phreng chog bla mas dbu bskul te bzlas pa gang 'tsham/ gtor ma chang chu nang mchod gsum gyes bran nas byin gyis brlabs shing dkyus ltar dbul/ gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngos la dkyil 'khor shugs 'jug byas te bdag 'jug len/ de nas 'dag rdzas dang khrus bum rnams las sngags kyis bsangs/ subhā sras sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las t+t+waṃ las 'khar pa dang zhes sogs kyis gzhung bzhin bsgrub/ bum pa rang rang gi sngags brjod tshe gzungs rdor shar nas brtsams te rang rang gi bum pa'i kharasgo/ thun mong du oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs brjod tshe gzungs rdor shar bum gyi khar spos la ye dha rmā yang bzla/ 'bras kyi steng du me long dbus su gzungs rdor dang bcas te bla ma'i mdun du bzhag las sngags kyis bsangs la/ yi ge rnams gyen du 'greng zhing zhes sogs dang yedha rmā ci mang bzlasanas me tog gzhung bzhin bsgrub/ bzlas pa tshar pa dang dri bzang gi chus me long steng gi yedharmā bkrus nas de'i chus me tog la khyab par bya/ / de nas yungs gar dang gu gul bshams te/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 4po

༄/ /gung thangabastonapa'azla sa' gsung 'chaga'aphros/ khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ramahā kro dha rā dzā sa pa ri wā ra a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ khro bo rnamasakyi thugs ka nas rang rang gi mthu stobs dang nus pa thams cad rang rang gi snying po dang hūṃ yig dang me 'od la sogs pa'i rnam par gyur nas gu gul la thim zhing / slar yang khro bo rnams kyi sku las rang rang 'dra ba'i khro bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa sku rngams brjid dang ldan pa/ zhal nas hūṃ hūṃ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ nam mkha' nas glog 'khyug pa ltar byon te yungs gar la zem par gyur par bsams la/ las sngags bzlas nas yungs gar dang gu gul bsgrub/ bsgrubs pa'i me tog nas slob dpon la snod kye nang dang / tshogs par phyag tu me tog 'tsham pa re bkye/ thams cad bzhengs te dbu nab bzhes nas/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das sogs gsol 'debs bzhi dal bus gsungs shing / de re re'i mjug tu me tog 'thor zhing dril bu dkrol bzhin du/ oṃ na mo bha na wa te shākya mu na ye sogs dang / ya mān+ta kayang rab tu gnas bya de mgon po'i sku lta bu yin na/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sogs skabs gang bab kyi sngags bcug pa dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes brjod la/de'i tshe mchod dpon gyes bdug pa bya/ de nas sa la bzhugs te thal mo sbyar nas/ ngo mtshar chen po zhes sogs brjod cing me tog 'thor te sems bskyed/rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la las bum gyi chu gtor te khaṇ+ḍa dhika gis bsangs/ thun+ya tas stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ zhe4pa nas/ g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/zhes pa'i bar gyis mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ dge legs char 'bebs kyi dpe rnams su klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i bar na zhes sprel 'dug kyang /phyag len la dam tshig sems dpa'i zhes sogs bar du bcug ste/ dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng bar gsungs pa bzhin sems dpa' sum brtsegs can du byed 478

༄/ /rabaganasadage legasacar 'bebasakyi phyag lenamatha'adagadagos/ rten bskyed zin pa dang mchod g.yog pas me long bzung ste rab tu gnas bya'i rten gar yod thams cad la so sor bstar nas phyir khyer 'ongs te mgo mjug ma log pa byas la/ da dung dkyil 'khor du gzhugs pa'i skor rnams bya dgos pas khrus dkyil du mi 'god par bla ma'i mdun na khrus dkyil gyi mdun ngos gang bde zhig tu 'jog de nas slob ma'i bya ba rnams rab tu gnasabya'i lha rnams kyis byas te/ gsol 'debs kyi tshig kyang gtso bor de rnams kyis brjod pa la rang gis rjes zlos byas pa'i tshul du mos pa sogs dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur shes par byas na/ bdag sgra gang yod la mtha' gcig tu rab tu gnas bya zhes ma bsgyur kyang skyon med/ sgyur bde ba rnams la rab tu gnas bya zhes sbyar na blo la 'char bde bas/ 'dor len shes par byas te/bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i zhabs drung du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'idakyil 'khor du 'jug par zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes sogs maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa phul/ ro langs ma dang zhes sogs kyi gsol 'debs lan gsum/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin par gyur/ ā ka pir hūṃ zhes brjod pa na/ stabs 'grig tshe rten gye phyag mthil dang / de min na rten nam me long gi mdun du 'bru'i tshom bu re bzhag tsagru brnya zhes sogs kyi skabs su rten nam me long na bza' dmar pos g.yogs/ kharta spreka gis bsangs/de nas sdom pa 'dzin pa'i skor sogs bzhag la/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur/ ces pa nas/ gu ru tsa ra ṇa'i sngags brjod pa'i bar dang / de nas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / rab tu gnas bya bcug pa 'di'i/ / zhes sogs bden stobs brjod pa lan gsum dang /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ho rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/gtso bo 'khor bcas kyi mdun na gnas par gyur/ oṃ spa ra ṇa badz+ra ho479

༄/ /gung cabayopa'itshunasa'i ga 4ma/rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la me tog gtor bar bsams la dngos su bla mas dor/ de nas/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi snying gar zla ba la hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ / ces pa'i skabs su sngar g.yogs pa'i gos dmar po dang me tog rnams bsdus la/ da ni dad pa'i/ zhesapa nas/ sa ma ya ho ho ho zhes pa'i bar brjod pa ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug tshul rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /lha dbang skur tshul rgyas pa mi byed pa'i skabs su/ rten skyed tshar nas me long bstan zin te phyir 'ongs nas bzhag pa na/ gdon g.yogs kyi dod du na bza' dmar pos g.yogs shing 'bru'i tshom bu dgod/ bar 'dir mchod g.yog gnyis kyis dar dmar po sogs rten gye mdun nas phan tshun du then te bsgrib pa'i tshul byas nas sdod pa'i phyag len yang yod par snang / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod la rab tu gnas bya rnams dkyil 'khor du bcug par mos/ oṃ spa ra ṇa badz+ra ho zhes de dag gis dkyil 'khor la me tog dor bar bsams te/dngos su bla mas me tog gtor/ gdong g.yogs phyes nas dkyil 'khor gye lha tshogs bstan par mos te gos dmar pos g.yogs pa bsal/ /de nas gdan la rten bzhag pa ni/ rten rnams khrus dkyil gyi steng du bzhag btub na 'dag rdzas rnams dang khrus bum rnams phyir bkyed/ rnam bum shar gyi 'dag rdzas kyi mdun du bzhag rten khrus dkyil gyi dbus kyi stegs la bzhag mi bde na me long khrus dkyil gyi dbus su 'jog 〉 rtu dang hrī khyi 'khyel ba'i sngags rnams lan bdun bdun bzlas te chu bzhi byin gyis brlabs/ dag cing dri med ma dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes sogs kyis gzhung bzhin dbul/ khro bo'i mchod pa 'jigs byed ltar byin gyis brlabs/de'i tshe tshogs par yungs gar bkram/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs/ zhes pa nas/ drag po'i sbyang ba'i bar gzhung bzhin 480

༄/ /rabaganas dge legasabor 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagal/ sum bha ni dang hrī khyi brjod pa'i skabs su rol mo'i tsham rngam dang /gu gul gyis bdug yungs gar gyis brab ste/ bgegs gtor skyel mkhan la gtad nas rten la g.yon skor byas te 'dor du gzhug / de nas sbyang chas rnams bla ma'i mdun du rim pa bzhin bsham/ las sngags dang hūṃ bdun brjod cing byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bkan la yungs gar bzung nas/ oṃ sarba pā sogs brjod cing / g.yon du lan gnyis bskor zhing byabs nas mer dor/ yang snga ma ltar bzung nas sngags bajod cing g.yas su lan gnyis bskor zhing byabs nas mer dor/ de bzhin du chu nas seng ras kyi bar g.yon dang g.yas su gnyis gnyis bskor zhing byabs nas dor/ kham phor man chad snod nang du dor zhing / zan chang dang ba lce'i chang bu'i mtheb rjes rang la bstan/ dur ba'i myu gu phyir bstan te bzung nas skor dgos/de nas/ chu gtsang kha rna mig sna kha/ / lag lte mgo la te reg bya/ / dri med mchod mar bzhi yis mchod/ / ces pa'i tshul gyis rten nam me long la nye reg bya zhing mchod pa bzhi dbul/ spos dkar mar dang sbyar ba 'khyil ba'i sngags dang hūṃ lan bdun bzlas te byin gyis brlabs nas bdug / de nas phal khrusabyed pa la/ mchod dpon gyis phrag pa g.yon par rten kheb dang / de'i stengadu khrus ras dgab/ gzhan zhig gis khrus gzhong bzung ste gnyis ka bla ma'igayas phyogs dang / gcig gis me long bzung nas phyogs su 'greng ste 'khod/ khrus bum 'dzin mkhan brgyad kyis snam sbyar dang zhwa mo gyon te khrus dkyil gye mtha' bskor nas sdod pa'am/ khrus dkyil dang bla ma'i bar du g.yas g.yon la bzhi re gral byas nas 'greng ste 'khod/ g.yas ma bzhi la mngar gsum dang zho 'bras bu 'bru'i bum pa bzhi dang / g.yon ma bzhi'i gral mjug nas yar dris bzang 'bras yos sman rin po che'i bum pa rnams 'dzin du gzhug phal khrus tshan pa gsum ga'i snga phyir dgos pa'i 'dag rdzas/ byug 481

༄/ /gung thangabastanapa'irnanas ga nga 'thugapa/ dril phyis kyi rdzas rnams rim pa ltar sde tshan du byas te bla ma'i mdun nges su bsgrig nas bzhag khrus bum 'dzin mkhan zur du med na gdong gral g.yasakyi mgo nas bum pa brgyad ka thar chags su bkram ste 'dzin du gzhug pa'am/ yang na 'dag rdzas dang po/ bum pa dang po dang gnyis pa/ de'i byug pa gnyis dang dril phyis kyi rdzas dang po/ yang 'dag rdzas gnyis pa dang /khrus bum gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ byug pa gnyis pa dang dril phyis kyi rdzas gnyis pa/ 'dag rdzas gsum pa dang khrus bum phyi ma gsum/ byug pa dang dril phyis gsum pa rnams spel nas tshogs su bkram ste 'dzin pa'i phyag len yang yod pas gang bde bya/ gang 'dir zhes sogs dang / ri bo ltar ni zhes sogs gsung zhing / de'i tshig bzhi re'i mtshams su mang mas dril gsil dang /khrus bum 'dzin mkhan rnams kyis bum pa yo ba re bya/ de yang 'jig rten na khrusabyed pa'i tshe/ dris bdag sla ba'i phyi dang por bul tog lta bus lus la byugs/ de nas bkru khrus byas te lus kyi dri ma dag pa na/ ba spu'i sgo nas rlung 'jug pa 'gog pa'i phyir rkang mar lta bus phyugs te bsku mnye byed/ de nas de'i snum 'don pa'i phyir sran phye sogs kyis dril phyis byed pa dang sgo bstun la yin pas/ rags bshad la brgya dkar 'dag rdzas zhes gsungs kyang / zhib tu byas na/ phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga/ ba byung lnga/ dri lnga ste 'dag chal gsum rim bzhin phal khrus tshan pa gsum ga'i sngon du bsku rgyu'i 'dag rdzas dngos yin la/'bru mar dang rtsi mar ni khrus re'i rjes su byug rgyu'i byug pa'i rdzas dang / shing shunaphye ma/ skyu ru ra dang sran ma'i phye ma/ yung ba'i phye ma gsum mjug tu 'deb rgyu'i dril phyis kyi rdzas yin no/ / des na/ bdud rtsi lnga skud mngar gsum zho yis bkru/ /mar gnyis byugs shing shing shun phye mas phyi/ /ba byung lnga skud 'bras 'bru dri yis bkru/ / mar phyugs skyu ru ra dang sran phyes phyi/ /dri bzang lnga skud yos sman rin chen chus/ /bkru zhing mar byugs yung ba'i phye 482

༄/ /rabaganasadage legs char 'bebs kyi phyag lenasatha'adagamasaphyi/ / zhes sdoms tshig dang / tshan pa so so'i 'dag rdzas rnams gtsang zhing ma dang / khrus brgyad ka rgyal ba rnams gtsang ma/ bsku mnye rnams mi phyed ma/ dril phyis rnams rang bzhin dag pa ma ste so so'i sngags dang bcas pa'i sgo nas byed dgos pa nges par byas la/ dang po/ gtsang zhing dri ma mi mnga' yang / / zhes sogs kyi mjug tu sngags bajod tshe me long ngos kyi gzugs brnyan shar ba la 'dag rdzas dang po bdud rtsi lnga'i 'dag chal dur ba'i pir gye rtse la blangs nas byugs/ kā ya bi sho dha zhes sogs kyi skabs su bar gyis drung de mnyed pa'i tshul bya/ de nas khrus bum dang po bla ma'i phyag tu phul te/ rgyal ba rnams ni zhes sogs gyis khrus bya/ khrus zin pa dang g.yon gyi gral mgo mar gtad re/ rim pa bzhin g.yas gral ba rnams kyes rang rang gi lag gi bum pa gong ma gong mar brgyud nas bla ma'i phyag tu 'bul zhing /g.yon gral gyis bla ma'i phyag nas byung rim bzhin mar brgyud la/ de phyogs kyi bum pa rnams g.yas gral mjug nas yar gtod/ khrus bum dang po g.yon gyi gral mjug tu sleb pa na de'i shar gye pad 'dab la 'god pa sogs tshar rim bzhinakhrus bum brgyad ka rang rang gnas su 'god dgos/ bum pa dang po gnyis kyi khrus zin pa na/ mi phyed rdo rje ma'i mjug tu dri zhim po'i 'bru mar dang rtsi mar gyes byugs la dur ba'i pir gyis mnye/ rang bzhin ma'i mjug tu shing shun gyi phye ma btab nas dur bas drud/ yang gtsang zhing ma'i mjug tu ba byung lnga'i 'dag bskud/ 'bras bu'i bum pa/ 'bru'i bum pa/ dri'i bum parnams kyis khrus dang / spos mar gyis byugs pa/ skyu ru ra dang sran phyes dril phyis bya/ de nas dri bzang lnga'i 'dag chal bskus la/ 'bras yos kyi bum pa/ sman gyi bum pa/ rin po che'i bum pa rnams kyis khrus dang / 'bru mar gyis byugs pa/ yung ba'i phye ma btab ste dril phyis byed pa'i tshe dur ba'i bar gyis drud tshul sogs sngar bzhin bya/ phal khrus rdzogs pa dang me long khrus 483

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgronas ga 'atsogadakyil gyi dbus su phyir bzhag de nas mchog khrus bya ba la/ dbang lha'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/gshegs pa dang gshegs ma zhes sogs dang / rdo rje can gyis zhes sogs gzhung bzhin dang / mchod dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa btegs la/ bkra shisagang zhig ces sogs tshig bzhi re re'i mthar dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor/ khrus kyi khang ba zhes sogs kyis khrus khang bskyed/ khrus dkyil gyi dbus nas me long blangs te gcig gis bla ma'i g.yon phyogs su bzung /mchog khrus kye 'dag rdzas/ spos mar gye byugs pa/ dri bzang gi phye ma rnams rin po che'i snod du bzhag pa dur ba'i bar re dang bcas pa dang / khrus gzhong / khrus ras rnams bla ma'i mdun du sgrig stong gsum kun tu zhes sogs kyi mjug tu dri bzang lnga'i 'dag chal dur ba'i pir gyis blangs nas byugs shing drud/ rnam bum gye chu/ las bum mam/ bum pa gzhan zhig tu blug pa bla ma'i phyag tu bsnams te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus bya zhing / skabs 'di'i khrus rnams la rnga spub sogs rol chen yang byas na legs/mi phyed rdo rje sogs kyis dri zhim po'i 'bru mar byugs/ rang bzhin dag pa zhes sogs kyis dri bzang gi phye ma 'debs/ de dag sku la sogs kye mthar rigs lnga'i sa bon bkod pa'i ras kyis dbyi/ yang stong gsum kun tu mas 'dag chal byugs la/ phyin drug gi tshigs bcad re re'am/ gnyis gsum res khrus gsol ba'i mtshams su/ mi phyed mas phyu pa dang / rang bzhin mas dril phyis/ de dag skul mas sku dbyi pa gsum po bcug nas byed pa rgyas pa'i phyag len yin la/ 'on kyang lan rjes ma'i skabs su/ rang bzhin dag pa ma dang / de dag sku la ma'i bar du/ sku mchog rnam dag nas/ dam pa'i sku mchog bdag gis thob par shog / ces khrus gsol ba'i dge ba bsngo ba dang /de dag sku la ma'i mjug tu/ bde gshegs sku gsum zhes sogs kyis phyis pa'i 484

༄/ /rabaganasadage legasacar 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagadageb bsngo/ bsngo ba 'di gnyis khrus rjes ma'i skabs ma gtogs mi dgos kyang / stong gsum kun tu ma dang / byug pa/ dril phyis/ sku dbyi'i tshigs bcad rnams snga phyi kun gyi mgo mjug tu spyor dgos/ /'bring du byed na/ dang por stong gsum kun tu mas 'dag chal byugs/ji ltar bltams pa dang sngags gnyis kyis khrus/ de bzhin du/ khyod ni sbyin pa'i nas/ sngags gnyis/ khyod ni tshul khrims/ sngags gnyis sogs rim parasbrar la/ gang la nyes pa zhes sogs sngags gnyis dang bcas pa'i bar thar chags su brjod de/ mjug tu/ mi phyed ma/ rang bzhin ma/ sku mchog ma/ de dag skul ma/ bde gshegs sku gsum ma rnams tshar gcig brjod pa yin zhing / /bsdus pa la/ khrus dngos gzhi ji ltar bltams pa gcig pus chog pas/khyod ni sbyin pa'i zhes sogs nas/ gang la nyes pa zhes pa'i bar mi dgos shing / de dag sku la ma'i snga phyir bsngo ba gnyis 'jug dgos/ /de nas dri dang gos rgyan rnams 'bul ba ni/ mchod g.yog pas me long bla ma'i phyag tu phul/ dri bzang gi chu bteg nas bzung la/ stong gsum kun tu zhes sogs kyis bla mas phyag gis me long byugs/ rten kheb phyag tu bsnams nas/ sna tshogs dbang po'i zhes sogs kyis gos/ rin po che'i rgyan phreng ngam/rgyan gyi tsa ka li phyag tu bsnams te/ bde gshegs sku mchog ces sogs kyis rgyan dbul/ de nas/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros zhes sogs kyis ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ dri med yid du sogs kyis chu gsum/ lha yi me tog sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin bya/ de nas mchod dpon gyis spos bkram/ bdag nyid kyi lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ces brjod cing dbu zhwa bzhes pa/ pus mo g.yas pa btsugs/ spos thogs te/485

༄/ /gung cabastanab po ga lagathugs rje yis ni zhes sogs lan gsum gdon zhing / sang ni rab gnas zhes dang / sang ni yang dag par bgyid par/ / zhes dang / byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa rnams kyi skabs su dril bu dkrol/ de nas spos phyir bsdus la/ lha rnams kyi zhes sogs dang / mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo'i bar sngags kyis dbul/ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da brdo sogs kyi skabs su thal mo sbyar te phyag bya/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin/ zhesapa nas/ 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod pa gshegs gsol dang bcas pa gzhung bzhin bya/rten dngos la dri bzang byugs pa mi bden/ me long dang dri bzang bla ma'i phyag tu phul te/ thugs na mgrin pa/ dpral ba/ phyag gnyis/ spyi gtsug rnams su dri bzang byugs/ yang na rten dngos la de ltar byugs pa'i stangs ka byasakyang rung ngo / / yang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rten cing 'brel bar zhes sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mabye sogs kyis chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dbul/ hrī khyi dang 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla bzhin du rten dam tshig pa'i thugs ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su rdo rjes reg ste bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phyir rten dang bdag nyid bsrung ba'i dmigs pa bya/khrus stegs kyi mdun du stegs dma' ba zhig gi khar phyogs skyong gi mchod gtor bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang / gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa/ zhes pa nas/ zhags pas bcings te bkug nas rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa ni/shar du dbang po/ zhesapa nas/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed phyag na phur bu thogs pa/ zhes pa nas/ yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams 486
