༄/ /rabaganasadage legs char 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagakyi ljags hūṃ las zhes sogs sngon 'gro'i skabs bzhin byas la/ bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis 'dud cing mchis/ / phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis ji srid rab tu gnas pa'i bya ba ma rdzogs pa de srid du rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod nas bgegs rnam par bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces phyogs gtor phul la/ rten rnams na bza' ser bos bkab nas 'jog gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ shis brjod rnams dkyus ltar bya ste sta gon gyi rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ skad cig dkrong bskyed/ rdo dril byin rlabs nas/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ bum chog tshogs zhing nas phyogs skyong gtor ma'i bar dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngos/ dkyil 'khor shugs 'jug grub na bdag 'jug kyang len/ de nas khrus bum dang me togayungs gar/ gu gul rnams sngar nyin ltar bsgrub/ gsol gdab sems bskyed gnyis bzhag ste/ rten sems dpa' sum brtsegs yum bcas su bskyed/ yab la 'khyud pa zhes pa'i 'phror/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor rnams dor la/ chu bzhi bsgrubs te 'bul pa/ sbyang ba'i skor dang / phal khrus/ mchog khrus/ dri dang gos rgyan 'bul ba'i bar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bya/ de rjes bzhengs te gsol 'debs dang / bzhugs nas sems bskyed pa sngar dang 'dra/ de nas/ lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su khro khro dang 'khor lo las/ zhesapa nas/ nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zhes pa'i bar gyis skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ las zhes sogasagazhung bzhin bya/ rten snga ma ar chog byas pa'i me long yod na skabs 'dir spyan 'dren dgos pas/ las kyi rdo rje ar chog gi me long gang na yod pader phyin nas phyag gsum btsal/ spos rol mchod rdzas thogs pa du mas 487

༄/ /yo ca bstan yotshanaza' g.yo 'chagamadun bsus te spyan drangs nas slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mdun du mchod pa tshar gcig bshams la byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sogs kyis mchod/ dza 4 sa rten rnying pa'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa rnams rten gsar pa dang gnyis su med paragyur/ mchod g.yog pas spos bkram ste/ thams cad kyis spos dang rdo dril bsnams nas/ ma lus sems can sogs kyis ye shes spyan drangs/mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te phul la/ bdag nyid kyi lce hūṃ las zhes sogs dang / spos thogs te gsol ba lan gsum 'debs pa sogs sngar nyin dang 'dra yang / sang ni zhes pa rnams da lta zhes par bsgyur dgos/ ye shes pa bstem nas dbang bskur ba la/ /bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros gshegs pa dang gshegs ma zhes sogs gzhung bzhin dang / rgyas par byed na maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ kharna dh+ri ka hūṃ phaṭa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams drangs pa zhal nas zhugs/ zhesapa nas/ stong ba'i ngang las rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams hūṃ dang rdo rje las/ zhesapa nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyis rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams mi bskyod par byas pa la dbang bskur/ zheyopa nas/ rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du/ zhe4pa nas/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnams rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi steng phyogs su 'dzin/ zhes pa nas/ dza : baṃ ho rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi ba spu'i sgo nas thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a na4shasta'ibar dang / de nas rig pa'i dbang phyi ma la yang 'di bzhin bya/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las/ /zhes sogs gsol 'debs/ oṃ kharna dh+ri ka hūṃ phaṭa/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i/ zhes pa 488

༄/ / rab gnasadage legasabor 'be+ebs kyi phyag lenasatha' dganas/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams rdo rje 'chang du gsal bas ye shes kyi phyag rgya 'du byas nas/ zhe4pa nas/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi lus kyi ba spu'i sgo nas thim par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chubado rjes sogs gsol 'debs dang / rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dang / bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa dpal rdo rje 'jigasabyed/ ces pa nas/ bde stong dbyer med de nyid gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin no/ / dbang gsum pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gsol gang ba nas rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ces pa nas/ lhan skyes kye dga' ba ni dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo yin no/ / dbang bzhi ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin sogs gsol 'debs dang / rab tu gnas bya'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis dbang gsum pa thob pa'i skabs su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum du snang bzhin pa'i dus na/ zhe4pa nas/ de ni thob bya don gyi dbang bzhi pa yin no/ / de nas gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gong du gdong g.yogs 'ching ba sogs kyi rigs pa sbyar na dbang rdzas gzhan rnams kyang gtad du rung ba tsam snang yang / lag len cha mtshungs stabs bde ba zhig mi 'ong bas/ de las dkyel 'khor gye lha dang /rab tu gnas bya'i lhas phan tshun bla ma dang slob ma'i tshul du byas pa'i dmigs pa gsal 'debs pa'i phyir/ de gnyis ga'i rjes su zlos ba'i tshul gyis dbang chog gi tshig ma chad par brjod de/ dbang rdzas 'deg rgyu dang phyag rgya sogs kyi rigs thams cad bzhag na 'brel chags par 'ong ngo / / de ltar dbang bskur rgyas bsdus gang rung byas zin pa dang mchod pa byin gyes brlabs la/chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo'i bar gzhung bzhin dbul/ bstod pa 'jam dpal 49

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'itshanas gsang 'thugagaser mdog ma'am/ yang na/ gnyis med thun mong nasa'ajigs byed gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas kun gye dngos po khyod/ /ces pa nas/ dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod/ bla mas rten kheb btegs te/ srab 'jam yang ba zhes sogs dang /rgyan gyi tsa ka li btegs la/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i zhes sogs dang / me long btegs nas/ a las skyes pa'i me long zhes sogs kyis me long lha la phul ba yin gyi/ gong du rten rnams la bstan nas tshur gdan drangs pa'i me long de nyid bstan pa min no/ / de nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya ba las/ kha byang du phyogs par thab kyi dbyibs gru bzhi/ rgyar khru do/ de'i phyir mu ran sor brgyad/ de'i phyi rol tu kha khyer sor brgyad pa rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba/thab kyi dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rin po che cha dgu pa sor drug can rdo rjes mtshan pa'am/ yang na rin po che rkyang ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thab la sa ser dang dri ser pos byugs shing me tog ser po gcal du dgram/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ g.yon du chu yi snod bzhag ste/ / sbyin sreg yo byad g.yas su'o/ / zhes pa ltar/ gong du bshad pa bzhin gyis rdzas dang mchod pa g.yas phyogs dang / chu bzhi g.yon gral du bshams pa sogs phyag len ltar byas la/ stan mthon por bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod pa'am der mos/ ngag 'don phal cher 'dra yang / saṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje 'dzin pa ser po ser mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum zhes dang /ye shes kyi thab kha dog ser zhing dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa/ kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba zhes sogs dang / me lha sku mdog ser po ser mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum zhes sogs dang / me lha'i ljagasardo rje'i rnam pa can ser po la ram̐ yig ces sogs brjod cing / de'i tshe lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sprang pa rin po che'i 4༅

༄/ /rabaganasadage legasajal 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagakhu tshur gyis dgang blug 'dzin/ spel tshig ni/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor gzi bajid dang / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub kyi bya ba dang / khyad par du yang rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa 'phrin las mchod pa'i sprin tshogs thams cad puzlo ku ru oṃ/ zhes brjod de rdzas so so la kha bsgyur mi dgos/ 'das lha'i skabs su/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag la cung zad dmar ba'i mdog can gyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ zhes pa'i mtshams su/ mang mas lha spyan 'dren gyi dmigs pa dang bcas dril bu dkrol bzhin par bzhugs/ las kyi slob ma gcig gis snam sbyar dang zhwa gyon nas song ste rten gye drung du phyag gsum btsal/ bdag cag dpon slob yon bdagadang bcas pa la mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i slad du sbyin sreg 'bul bas/ thab kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du gshegs par zhu/ zhes brjod de lag pa g.yon pas spos 'dzin/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brjod cing rten gyi drung nas me tog re blangs la rten kheb sogs kyi khung du bzung / rab tu gnas bya'i lha las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig byon par mos nas mchod rol dang bcas thab la g.yas skor byas nas gdan drangs te bla ma'i phyag tu phul ba na/mang mas dril bu dkrol ba mtshams byed/ bla mas gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brjod de me tog thab tu dor ba dang / gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rdo rje 'jigasabyed yab yum/ de gnyis kyi sku las 'od zer ser po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ ces dang / lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can ser po zhes dang / lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pas sangs rgyas kyis bum pa ser po bdud rtsi ser posagang ba thogs nas bsgrub bya zla ba ser po la gnas pa la dbang bskur bas/ tshe dpal stobs 'byor lung rtogs kyi yon tan rnams rgyas shing rin po che'i char babs pas phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang / gzi brjid 'bar 491

༄7/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgronasa'i gsung 'bumabar gyur/ ces brjod/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ bla mas gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags dang / oṃ ā : badz+ra yu lha rnams me lha'i thugs ka nas gshegs te/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod la las kyi rdo rje'i lag tu gtad/ des kyang sngar bzhin spyan drangs te rten la gtor/ phyir 'ong gi bar du mang mas dril bu dkrol zhing gzhan rnams dkyus dang 'dra/ de nas nang du phebs te bla mas mig sman mig thur btegs nas 'byed pa'i stangs ka dang bcas spyan dbye zhing / snyan dbye/ shangs dbye/ zhal dbye'i thur ma rnams kyang dngos su bzos pa yod na so sor dbye ba'i stangs ka bya la/ med na rang rang gi tsa ka li btegs te tshigs bcad rnams bajod/ tsa ru nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la gzhung bzhin dbul/ de nas zhal bsil dang mchod yon dbul/mchod g.yog pas so rtsi btegs te/ oṃ badz+ra taspu la ye swāhā/ zhes sngags kyes dbul/ de nas gzugs bsgyur ni/ bla mas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag gis rten so so'i gnas rnams su reg la/ oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hrī ā dang / rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ / zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad brjod la/ hrī khyi dang ya mān+ta ka/ oṃ mā rtu rnams ci mang bzla/ 'on kyang tshigs bcad brjod rgyu 'jog pa'i phyag len yang yod la/ snga ma 'ga' zhig gis chos skyong bsgo ba skabs su 'don par yang bshad do/ sngar bstan nas khrus dkyil du gdan drangs pa'i me long yang skabs 'dir rten la phyir bstan te/ dam ye mtha' dag sku gsung rten so so'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum zhu b.las bris 'bur gyi sku dang / gsung rab kyi yig 'bru so so/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang sogs kyi rnam pa can du gyur/ ces bajod/ sku gsung thugs rten gang rung re tsam yin na skabs dang sbyar ba'i 'dor len shes par bya/ de nas mngal dbul gyi mchod pa chu bzhi/ nyer spyod rol mo/ 'dod 492

༄/ /rabaganas dge legasacar 'bebasakyi phyag lenasatha'adagayon lnga rnams gzhung ltar byin gyes brlabs la/ dag cing dri med/ bsod nams zhing du/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyi tshig4bcad dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya zhes sogs sbyar te dbul/ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru busnye sogs kyis nang mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod pa rnams gzhung bzhin bya/maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rigs/ rtags brgyad kyi tsa ka li btegs te so so'i tshigs bcad rnams rim par bajod cing / de bzhin gshegs dang zhes sogs kyi skabs su rnam bum gyis khrus gsol/ de nas gos/ rgyan/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid sna bdun rnams gzhung bzhin phul la/ rgyal ba mgon po zhes sogs kyi tshe rnam bum mam/ bum rdzas nyer lngas bkang ba'i bum pa logs su yod na de btegs la phul/ gdugs/ 'bru/ rin chen bdun/ sman rnams rim par btegs shing shis pa brjod pa'i bar spyi'i mnga' dbul cha tshang bar bya zhing / bye brag gi mnga' dbul gang dgos rab tu gnas bya'i rten gyi gtso bo longs sprul gang gi rnam pa can dang / gsung rab sogs gang yin pa de dang bstun nas 'dor len gzhung bzhin du bya/ de nas sngar bsgrubs pa'i me tog gi lhag ma tshogs su dgram/ gzungs rdor rten gtso'i thugs ga'am phyag mthil lta bu gang bde dang / glegs bam sogs kyi steng du bzhag rten gzhan mang po yod na mchod g.yog pas gzungs thag rdo rje bzung ste rten so so'i thugs gar bzhag pa'i tshul bya la/ slob dpon gyis gzungs thag gi sne nas bzung ste ye dharmā ci mang bzla/ 'jigs byed kyi shis brjod bya zhing me tog gi char dbab/ me tog 'thor bzhin par oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye sāhā/ gang mang brjod cing brtan bzhugs bya/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar la/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ / zhesapa nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje mas bstod pa'i bar gzhung bzhin bya/ nyin re gnyis la gtang rag gi mchod pa mdor bsdus re dang / 'jigs byed kyi shis brjod dang / rab 493

sa / /gung bangabastanaba'izla ma'i gsung 'bum/rdzogs mas shis brjod gnyis gang rung re bya/ /nyin gsum pa la yi dam chos snroni ༷ sna ༵ gaṭ+wāṃ/ shā snangapa rno snaX ba/sahūṃ ༷ rdoX sa dīXdī ༵t+t+waṃdi dadi dī~X mchod sogs bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pa'i sgrub tshul sngar nyin bzhin bya la/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dkyus dang 'dra zhing / spel tshig la/ rgyas par na/kun rig ṭīka chen gyi 'phrin las skabs su 'byung ba lta bu'am/ bsdu na/rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs dang mdzad pa 'phrin lasal brten nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams sharnyo ku ru swāhā/ zhes bajod/ 'das lha skyed skabs/ zla ba'i gdan zung re re/ zhes pa'i bar gzhal yas khang gdan bcas sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom/de nas las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi drung nas me tog gdan 'dren tshul sogs sngar nyin dang 'dra/ bla mas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags brjod de me tog thab tu dor/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum/zhes pa nas/ mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi/ lha thams cad kyi sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ ces gsal 'debs shing / me tog phyir spyan 'dren pa'i tshegatso 'khor tshad ma'i sngags dang / oṃ ya 4 badz+ra yu lha rnams me lha'i thugs ka nas gshegs te dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces las kyi rdo rje la me tog gtad cing lhag ma dkyus dang 'dra/'o thug sgrub na me lha gshegs gsol gyi rjes su/ thab kyi me la matri'i steng du snod nag po ma yin pa dri dkar pos byugs shing me tog gi phreng ba bcings te/ hūṃ zhes brjod cing / snod de nyid hūṃ las byung bar mos nas bzhag hrī khyi bzla bzhin du/ 'o ma/ 'bras ma grug pa/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ka ra ste rdzas lnga gzar bu gnyis gang rung gis blugs la bskol te bdud rtsi'i 494

༄/ /rab gnasadage legasacar 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagarang bzhin du gyur par bsams/ dkyil 'khor pa'i lha dang chos skyong phyogs skyongagazhi bdag rnams la 'bul rgyu snod gtsang ma so sor blug dī bya asde sa ma dhi dhu na dzā ṇa ne sāhā/ zhes pas bsngags te dbul/ de nas slob dpon sgrub grogs dang bcas par brims te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhag ma 'di/ / sdig pa rnam par nyams byed gsol/ / zhes brjod nas longs spyod cing / yon bdag sogs der 'khod thams cad la sbyin zhing shis bajod bya/ / sbyinasreg mi byed tshe yig brgya lan gsum bzlas la/ gang yang bdag blo zhes sogs dang / ma rnyed yongs su zhes sogs kyis lhag chang bskang /chosaskyong bsgo ba ni/ mgon chos sogs kyi bskang gso rgyas pa dbyangs rol dang bcas pa/ ma mtha' 'ang spyi sgos kyi chos skyong so so'i gtor 'bul legs par byas la/ mjug tu/ me dang sa chu rlung rnams las/ / zhes sogs kyis 'phrin bcol gzhung bzhin bya/yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ yon bdag rnams gos gsar ba spyon/ rten la phyag dang skor ba byed du bcug ste/ gdan legs pa 'bru dkar gye g.yung drung bris pa'i steng du sdod bcug la/ me tog gi phreng ba lag tu gtad/ mdun du chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga dang bcas pa bsham/ bla mas dbu zhwa bzhes te/ rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon/ rab gnas kyi rgyu mtshan/ mchod pagal che tshul sogs skabs don dang 'brel ba'i bshad pa rgyas bsdus gang 'tsham gnang / khyed kyis nged la gang gsol ba'i/ / zhes sogs gzhung bzhin bajod/ de nas yon bdag bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/zhabasado rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis 495

sa༅/ /gung thangabastan pa'izla ma'i gsung 'bumabargyan pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha nams spyan drangs/dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta a yu rto na sa pa ri wā ra ar+bhe nas/ shasta'i bar gyi4mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ dag cing dri med sogs kyis chu bzhi/ lha yi me tog sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo'i bar/ e ma'o mchod pa sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga rnams dbul ba na/ mchod g.yog pas mchod pa re re nas blangs te tshig dang bstun nas yon bdag la gtad pas/ yon bdag rnams kyis reg ste lag brgyud byas nas rten gyi drung du dbul/ de nas bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams bla ma'i mdun du bzhag bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po zhes sogs kyis gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bla mas rdzas dang po phyag tu bsnams te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das/zhesapa nas/ me long gi rdzas la brten nas/ zhes gsungs pa na tshogs pas/bkra shis par gyur cig / ces mthun 'gyur bya/ de'i mjug mthud de dbu mdzad kyis/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho zhes sogs kyi dbu bskul zhing / rdzas yon bdag nas bzung ste tshogs pa kun la g.yas skor gye tshul du brgyud nas mthar rten gyi drung du 'jog pa'am yon bdag rang la phyir gtad/ bkra shis kyiphas lhag ma rnams kyang des rigs 'dra/ de nas gtang rag gi mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyes brlabs/ dag cing dri med/ lha yi me tog e ma 'o mchod pa sogs kyis chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga nams dbul/gtso 'khor thams cad la nang mchod dbul/ gnyis med mas bstod/ de ltar khro bo sogs kyis smon lam btang / yig brgya bzlas la nongs pa bzod 496

༄/ /rab gnas dge legasaphor 'bebs kyi phyag lenamatha'adagapar gsol/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pa'i skabs 'dir nyer bsdu byed tshul la dam pa'i gsung rgyun mi 'dra ba ci rigs yang / ngag 'don smad rgyud kyiphyag bzhes bzhin byed tshe/ thog mar rten dang brten pa'i cha gcig ras bris kyi rnam par gyur pa'i mos pa byas la/ dung khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa zhes sogs dkyus ltar 'don/ gsang 'dus kyi rab yangs ma gsungs nasabakra shis kye me tog char du dbab bo/ / rten bzhengs ming tsam 'dod pa'i sbyin bdag dang / / spyan dbye'i yon tsam re ba'i bla mchod la/ / 'a 'ur zang zing tsam las phra zhib kyi/ / phyag len tshad dang ldan pa mi dgos kyang / / lus can phan bde'i rtsa ba bstan pa dang / / bya ba'i 'khor lo bstan pa'i gzhir mthong ba'i/ / lhag bsam can rnams sngon rabs dam pa'i srol/ / bskyangs te phan bde'i rtsa ba tshugs par mdzod/ / rmongs pa'i mos mno tsam dang rtog ge yi/ / rang bzos ma bslad phra zhib lag len kun/ / ma nor gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba yis/ / dge legs rgya mtshos charachen 'bebs gyur cig / cesarab gnas dge legs char 'bebs kyi phyag len mtha' dag gsal bar bshad pa legs byas sprin gyi sgra dbyangasazhes bya ba 'di ni/skyabasamagon mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang thub bstan 'jigasamed rgya mtshos dbu mdzadade gser khang chen mor nye sras rnams rab gnasamadzad skabs lag len zhib thigasasu bgyis pa de bzhin yi ger 'khod pa zhig dgosatshul tshogs chen dbu mdzad sngags ram pa blo bzang dkon mchog sogs kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dgasabagyis pa 'di yang bstan 'gro yongs la phan bde'i dge mtshan bla nas blar spel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /497

༄/ /yo ca ༅naba'itshonasa'i ga gtseg༄༅/ / rab gnas kyi logrus gtso bor gyur pa'i bshad pa bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / rab gnas kyi lo rgyus gtso bor gyur pa'i bshad pa rgyas bsdus 'tsham par byed tshul ni/ de yang rab tu gnas pa'i bya ba phal cher grub ste yon bdag bsko ba'i mtshams 'dir bshad pa re byed dgos pa ni/ sngon mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang / slob dpon pad+ma sogs kyis rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ zan yang ngam lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rab gnas mdzad skabs yig rnying las/ slob dpon pad+mas gtam lan mdo bsngo gsungs/ / yas gtam mas gtam gnyis ka de nas dar/ / zhes 'byung ba bzhin yon bdag bsko ba'i bshad pa gnang ba de nas srol tshugs te da lta'i bar du gnas pa bzhin rgyu mtshan mdor bsdus tsam zhu ba la/ spyir na dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ / ji ltar bde gshegs sku gzugs shing las byas/ / bgyi ba ci 'dra'ang rung ste mkhas pas mchod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rab gnas ma byas kyang sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams grub tsam nas 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyes mnyam med jo bo chen po'i rab gnas kyi gzhung las/ mchod rten sku gzugs glegs bam sogs/ / sangs rgyas rnam sprul byin rlabs las/ / byung ba min na mi 'gyur bar/ / rtogs te shin tu dad ldan na/ / rab tu gnas pa mi dgos so/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de'i dgongs gzhi ni rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ 'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas/ / rab tu gnas pa rab tu 498

༄/ /rab gnas kyi losgyusagatso bor gyurapa'ibashadal/brtag / dang po'i las can sems can gyis/ / rtogs pa'i rgyu ru bshad par zad/ / ces dgos pa'i gtso bo 'jig rten pa rnams kyis de la tha mal du snang zhing zhen pa'i dri ma sbyong ba'i ched yin zhing / mdo sde rgyan las/ lung dang rtogs dang dbang 'byor las/ / zhes sogs ltar sa thob kyi gang zag rnams la sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan mtha' dag gis chos ston pa sogs rgyal ba'i mdzad pa dngos su bstan te tha mal gyi 'du shes skye ba'i skabs med pas/gangazag khyad par can de 'dra la ltos te rab gnas ma byas kyang 'gal ba med pa'i don yin gye/ spyir rab gnas byed pa med mi rung du gal che ste/sdom 'byung las/ ji ltar rab tu mi gnas lha/ / rab tu gnas par bya bar nus/ /slob ma dad pas gsol 'debs pa'i/ / bsod nams phyir ni bya ba ste/ / zhes dang / kro ya sa mu ts+tsha las/ 'di yi sangs rgyas bzhugs gsol bas/ / gang du zhi dang bzlas 'phel zhing / / nad med chos kyang 'phel bar 'gyur/ / nor dang tshe dang bde ba ster/ / zhes sogs phan yon rnam grangs du ma gsungs la/ slob dpon dam tshig rdo rjes kyang / sngags pas nor ni rnyed pa dang / / skyo bo rab tu dad pa yi/ / byed po dge ba rab 'phel ba'i/ / rab gnas bstan bcos las gsungs so/ / zhes sogs ltar gnas skabs su bsod nams rlabs po che thob pa dang / mkha' 'gro rgya 'tsho las/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las/ / 'khor ba pa yis rab gnas bya/ / thar bde mngon par 'dor rnams kyis/ / 'di la bde ba'i bde ba che/ / zhes mthar thug bde chen thar pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar gsungs/ rab gnas ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la/ / byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na/ / de la bkra mi shis 'gyur zhing / / de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ / zhes sogs dang / rab gnas ma byas par phyag mchod sogs byas na dam tshig las 'das /༅

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'i ma'i ga 'chagapar 'gyur ba sogs nyes dmigs du ma gsungs pas/ cis kyang rab tu gnas par byed dgos/ gang rab tu gnas par bya ba sku gsung thugs kyi rten byung tshul ni/ rgyal ba byams pas/ gang dang gang la gang du ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa/ / de dang de la der snang ngo / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskal pa chen po grangs med pa du mar tshogs gnyis goms ma yongs su rdzogs pa'i lag rjes lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las dang gdul bya'i skal ba tshogs pa na/ gang 'dul gyi snang ba du mar 'char ba'i bkod pa'i pha mtha' bsam gyis mi khyab cing / yongs su grags pa'i lo rgyus la mtshon na/ bstan pa 'di la thog mar thub pa'i dbang po zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe lha chen po rnams kyis jo shākya sogs sku che chung du ma bzhengs pa lta bu 'bur sku dang / 'od zer ma dang chu lon mar grags pa sogs bris sku byung tshul/lha'i dbang pos gser gyi glegs bu la sher mdo bris pa sogs gsung rten byung tshul/ de'i sngon nas sku bltams pa dang / gtsug phud breg pa sogs kyi sar mchod rten brtsigs par 'dul ba lung las bshad pa lta bu thugs rten byung tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus du ma yod la/ de ltar bzhengs pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo ni/ bzhengs mkhan de nyid kyis tshogs rdzogs pa tsam du ma zad/ sangs rgyas dngos su mjal ba dang bsnyen bkur bar ma nus pa rnams kyis kyang sku brnyan la sogs pa de dag mchod na sangs rgyas dngos la mchod pa dang khyad med pa'i bsod nams thob cing 'brel thogs pa'i dgos pa shin tu che ste/ dkon mchogabartsegs pa las/ gang la la zhig bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang da ltar bzhugs pa la mchod pa byed pa de'i phan yon rnams ni mtshungs/ mnyam zhing 'dra'o zhes nga 'chad do/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni chos kyi skus rab tu phye ba yin gyi/ gzugs kyi skus rab tu phye ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes dang / thub pa dgongs rgyan 500

༄/ /rab gnas kyi lo rgyusagatso bor gyur pa'i bshad pa/las/ 'dir sangs rgyas ni gnyis te/ don dam pa ni sku gsum gyis yang dag par bsdus pa'o/ / tha snyad pa ni sku gdung gi mchod rten dang sku gzugs dang / zheyopa nas/ mnyam par sems rab tu dwangs pa'i rnam par smin pa mnyam par gsungs so/ / zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug tu yang / byang chub spyod dang rjes mthun pas/ / rgyal ba'i mchod sdong sgrub pa yang / / byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan las/ / 'das kyang don rnams thams cad mdzad/ / sems med pa la mchod byas pas/ / ji ltar 'bras bu ldan par 'gyur/ / gang phyir bzhugs pa'am mya ngan 'das/ /mtshungs pa nyid du bshad phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ khyad par du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid sogs dam pa gong ma phal cher bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i gtso bo byams chen gyi sku re bzhengs pa'i thugs kyi dgongs gtad ni/ dper na kun shes ko'u t+ya na ya sogs bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'khor du skyes nas dka' tshegs med par gsung gi bdud rtsis smin cing grol ba phal mo che zhig sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs te legs smon gyis mtshams sbyar ba'i stobs yin par 'dul ba lung dang mdo sde mdzangs blun/ las brgya ba sogs su 'byung ba bzhin/ bstan pa 'di la zhugs nas bslab pa sna re bsrung ba dang / sku gsung thugs rten skyu ru ra tsam zhig bzhengs pa/ mchod pa cung zad re phul ba tshun chad kyang rjes sor ma pham rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'jig rten du shar ba'i tshe/ de'i bstan pa dang mjal zhing / yang dag pa'i lam bzang mngon du 'gyur sla ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can yod tshul/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo dang byams pa 'jug pa'i mdo/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdoganyis/ byams pa seng ge'i sgra'i mdo la sogs pa du mar gsungs pa'i don thugs la bcings te/ rang cag rjes 'jug rnams skal ba bzang po de la 501

༄/ /yo cabalob sa'igayo lamaspyor ba'i phyir du bzhengs par mdzad pa yin par 'dug dam pa gong ma de dgagi rnam thar bzang po'i rjes su zhugs te/ rten bzhengs khyad par can 'di nyid legs par grub nas ring bsrel rnam bzhis bsdus pa'i gzungs 'jug sogs tshad dang ldan par byas te rab gnas kyi skabs su slebs pa yin/'di 'dra dang zhor gcig par rten rnying pa rnams la yang rab gnas bskyar ma byas pa phan yon dang dgos pa chen po yod de/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rtag tu dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas rab gnas bya/ /zin pa'i de ma thag pa ru/ rab tu gnas pa mchog tu 'gyur/ / zhes rten gsar pa bzhengs ma thag rab gnas byed dgos pa dang / rnying pa la yang yang rab gnas byas na legs par gsungs pas/ sngon gyi rten 'ga' zhig la rab gnas brgya rtsa mar grags pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin par snang / rab tu gnas pa'i ngo bo ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so la ye shes pa rnams brtan par gnas par byed pa dang / pā ring por byas na a dhe ṣ+ṭha zhes byin gyes rlobs pa dang / yang rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ de nas gser gyi rang bzhin gyi/ /thur mas spyan ni dbye bar bgyi/ /zhes rab gnas kyi bya ba'am dgos pa'i gtso bo dam ye dbyer med du byas te/ 'khor ba'i phyi mtha'i bar du gdulakhya rnams la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa lhur byed pa'i don yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis spyan dbye'i cho gar yang btags pa yin/ de lta bu'i rab gnasakyi rnam gzhag 'di mdo dang rgyud sde gang las gsungs pa yin snyam na/kurma rang byung rdo rjes mdo lugs la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga bum gnyis mar grags pa mdzad cing / garma phrin las pas de la lhan thabs sogs sbyar 'dug na'ang / 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ mdo las rab gnas bshad pa med/ /'on kyang mchog bstod bkra shis sogs/ / rgyal po'i mnga' dbul lta bu la/ / rab gnas yin zhes smra na spros/ / gsungs pa ltar/ chos 502

༄/ /rabaganas kyi losgyusagatso boragyurapa'ibashadapa/rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / / zhes sogs kyis bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor te shis pa brjod pa tsam dang / gaṇ+ḍi'i rab gnas zhes pa lta bu'i tha snyad tsam re yod kyang rab gnas mtshan nyid pa zhig ma bshad/ bya spyod kyi skor la paṇa chen su ma ti kirtes mdzad pa'i gzungs grwa lnga la brten pa'i rab gnas lta bu ma gtogs mang po bod du ma 'gyur zhing / kun snying / shākya bshes gnyen/ shrarnya ka ra warma sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rna / 'byor rgyud kyi rab gnas mang du 'gyur bas/ bsam yas dang / lo chen rin chen bzang po'i tho ling gi gtsug lag khang sogs snga ma phal cher rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgo nas rab gnas byas pa mang du byung / a sto ka ra dang darba na/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ mi thub zla ba/ sā ju pu tra sogs kyi bla med la brten pa'i rab gnas mang du 'gyur zhing / sā ju bu tra'i rjes su 'brangs te bu ston gyis dus 'khor la brten pa'i rab gnas bkra shis dpal 'bar mdzad/ de'i sngon du slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/ kye rdor gyi rgyud las/ rab gnas mtshan nyid bzang po nyid/ / ces pa la brten nas/ gang la bya ba'i rten bzang po/ /gang du bya ba'i gnas bzang po/ / gang tshe bya ba'i dus bzang po/ / gang gis byed pa'i slob dpon bzang po/ / ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga bzang po/ / bya ba'i cha rkyen gye yo byad bzang po ste/ / sa bcad drug tu byas pa'i rab gnas bzang drug du grags pa dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sdom tshig steng nas mdzad pa'i rab gnas don gsal dang / 'gro mgon 'phags pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas bskul ba po'i ming gis sa mi trar grags pa byung / stag lo'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho/ sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho/ rten bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho ste/ rgya mtsho rnam gsum du grags pa dang / dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rab gnas bkra shis gter mdzod dang / bkra shis dga' ston sogs mkhas pa so so'i legs 503

༄/ /yo ca bstan ba'izla sa ga 'a4/bshad dang phyag bzhes kyi tshul tha dad pa mang du byung / rang cag ri bo dge ldan pa'i bka' srol 'di'i dbang du byas na 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung rgyun gyi rab gnas rgyas bsdus gnyis dang / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi gsang ba 'dus sa'i rab gnas dang rab gnas rta thog ma/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bkra shis snye ma/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal gye dge legs char 'bebs/ kun gzigs lnga ba'i rab gnas bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar ngoms/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rab rgyas sogs dang / de dag gi lhan thabs zur 'debs rim pa mang du byung ba rnams kyi nang nas/ 'dir rab gnas rgyas pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebasakyi steng nas bgyis pa yin/ gang gis byed pa'i slob dpon ni rab gnasakyi rgyud las/ slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing / / mtshan nyid kun dngayang dag ldan/ / zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ rdo rje snying po rgyan/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba sogs las rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid mang du gsungs pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin tshang ba dka' yang / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ lha khang sogs kyi rab gnas sogs/ / rtags can gyis ni rtag tu bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan pa'i gzhi ma so thar gyi bslab khrims la gnas pa'i steng nas dbang legs par thob cing dam tshig ci nus su bsrung ba dang / bsnyen pa grangs su 'khyol bar cha mthun tsam 'grub rung du yod par ma zad/ chog grogs mdzad pa'i bla slob dge 'dun rnams kyang kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos/ lus ni rnam 'gyur lha yi rol gar bsgyur/ / ngag ni gsang sngags dbyar rnga lta bur sgrog / yid ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ting 'dzin can/ / tshad ldan rig sngags 'chang ba de rmad byung / / zhes pa ltarasgo thams cad nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i don dang mthun pas byed pa po'i mtshan nyid legs par tshang / bya ba'i dus rab gnas kyi rgyud/ jo bo chen po 5khu

༄/ /rab gnas kyi losgyusagatso bor gyur pa'i bshad pa/dang mi thub zla ba'i rab gnas sogs las byang bgrod kyi zla ba drug gi yar ngo labyed pa spyir btang dang / gza' skar 'dzom na de las bzlog pa la yang nyes pa med pa dmigs bsal du gsungs pas gza' skar gtso che la/ da lan sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa rnams shas cher rab gnas kyi rgyud rang las ched du bsngags pa'i gza' bzhi dang skar ma bcu bzhi gang yang rung bar 'grigs pasadus tshes kyang shin tu legs/ rab gnas dngos gzhi dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ma nor bar gzab rgyas kyi lugs su byas pa yin pas/ de la sbyin sreg kyang nges par gal che ste/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin rtag tu las kun la/ / sbyin sreg gis ni kun tu bya/ / zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ / las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ / sbyin sreg las rnams brtsam par bya/ / zhes spyir las tshogs rab 'byams dang / khyad par du rab gnas kyi yan lag la sbyin sreg gal che bar gsungs pas/ rje drung sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis sogs kyi phyag len la/ bgegs bskrad pa'i skabs su drag po'i sbyin sreg spyan dbye'i gong du lha dbang du byed pa'i dbang gi sbyin sreg spyan dbye sogs grub ste legs tshogs thams cad spel ba'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg mjug tu lhag chad skong ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang bcas bzhi ga mdzad/ lugs 'ga' zhig la drag po'i sbyin sreg gi thad der/ smad las gdug can sgol ba'i brub 'cham kyang byed pa'i srol byung /'on kyang rab gnas kyi rgyud rang gi ngos zin la/ 'o ma can kyi bur shing la/ / sreg khang gru bzhir sreg blug bya/ / bdag dang slob ma thams cad ni/ / zhi dang rgyas pa 'phel bar bya/ / zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par jo bo chen po'i rab gnas dang / slob dpon zla 'od kyi rab gnas sogs su yang / zhi rgyas cho ga las gsungs bzhin/ / cho ga shes pas me bcug ste/ /zhesadang / lho phyogs rgyas pa'i thab byas la/ / zhes pa la sogs pa zhi rgyas 505

༄/ /yo cabasabasgro tsho tsha lagaganyis gtso bor gsungs shing / rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi yang zhi rgyas kyi las dang phyogs mthun shas che bas/ sbyinasreg de gnyis kyis 'thus pa byas pa yin/de ltar sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa cha tshang ba'i sgo nas spyan dbye'i cho ga legs par grub ste/ rang rang gi dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dbyer med du brtan par byas nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi lha'i 'khor lo dngos su grub pa yin pas/ rab gnas kyi rgyud 'di nyid las/ khyed kyis nged la gang gsol ba'i/ / sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa rab gnas pa/ /de dag don ni ngas byas pas/ /de rnams don ni grub zin gyi/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par byas/ /khyed kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ /rab tuganas pa byas zin gyi/ /mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / /zhag bdun bar du mchod par byos/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin mchod pa'i las la brtson par byed dgos/ mchod pa'i phan yon gsal rgyal gyi mdo dang / pad dkar gsum/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo sogs mdo dang rgyud sde du ma las gsungs tshul brjod kyes mi lang zhing / gnad mdor bsdus na chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /dkon mchog gsum po mgatogs pa/ /yon gye gnas 'ga' yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan zla ba'i skyabs 'gro bdun cu bar/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kye skyabs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir 'gro ba yongs kyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas dang / khyad par rang cag thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyi mgon dang gling dang dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur ba ni dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum las gzhan na med pas 'bral ba med par gtsug gi rgyan du bkur te/ sgo gsum nus pa ci yod kyi sgo nas de la mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba sogs rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs la 'bad pa lhur bya ba ni gtan gyi 'dun ma'i rtsa ba yin pas 'khor gsum rnam 506

༄/ /rab gnas kyi lo rgyusagatso boragyur pa'i bshad pa/par dag pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / khyad par du rab gnas grub nas nyin bdun la sogs pa'i bar du gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung grogs kyi blos mi 'khyud pa lta bu 'bul ba la dges pa dang rten 'brel gyi gnad khyad par can yod pas ci nas kyang nan tan du bya ba dang / de nas bla ma gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin sbyin pa'i bdag po rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor bskyed de mchod pa phul pa na bdag gir bzhes nas/ tshogs gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i phyir lhag pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul ba'i spyan dmigs mdzad pa dang / de nas bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams 'grem par byed pa la/ spyir 'jig rten pa'i drang srong bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis kyang bden stobs brjod pas snod bcud gang yang bzang ngan sna tshogs su bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus shin tu mang la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni bskal pa chen po grangs med pa du mar bden tshig goms pa mthar phyin pa'i dbang gis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar yangs pa'i ljags dang / gsung chos kyi dung la sogs pa grub ste/bka' bden pas byin gyes brlabs pa de nyid las cung zad kyang gzhan du 'da' ba mi srid la/ de'i phyir dge legs kyi bya ba rlabs po ches mtha' brgyan pa'i phyir du bkra shis pa'i rdzas 'di rnams 'grem par byas pa yin/'di dag dus dang gnas skabs gang gi tshe bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs tshul ni/ sa'i lha mos me long / rgyal po'i khab tu khyim bdag bzang skyong gis zho/ shing gi lha mos bil ba/ bram ze skar ma la dga' ba'i bus li khri phul ba sogs lo rgyus 'dra min cung zad yod kyang / grags che ba gzhung gi dngos zin 'di ltar yin/ rdzas so so'i byed las kyang nyes pa kun gye rtsa ba ma rig pa'i mun pa drung 'byin zhing / mthong ba dang ma mthong ba'i yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab bskyed de sgrib gnyis zad par spangs pas rang don chos sku mngon du byed pa'i rten 'brel me 507

sa / /gung thangabastanapa' sgronas gsung 'bum/long dang / de nas gdul bya'i don sgrub pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par 'phrin las nyer bdun sogs gsungs kyang / rdo rje theg pa'i skabs 'dir phrin las rnam pa ba'i'i nang du 'du bas/ thog mar zhi ba'i las la lus kyi nadagadon sogs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i rdzas ghi waṃ dang / de'i rgyu nang gi dug gsum sogs zhi bar byed pa'i zho/ / rgyas pa'i las la tshe spel ba'i rdzas dur ba dang / 'dod don mkho dgu'i 'byor pa rnams lhun gyes grub par byed pa bil ba/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab dang bshad sgrub kyi bya ba rnams rgyas par byed pa dung dkar te gsum/ dbang gi las la skye 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i rdzas siju ra'am li khri/ drag po'i las 'grub phyir grub pa'i rdzas yungs dkar te bkra shis kyi grangs dang ldan pa'i rdzas 'di rnams bla slob yon mchod thams cad kyi phyag tu bkram pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bden pa'i tshig la dbang 'byor pa'i gsung gi nus pas byin gyis brlabs pa ltar/ rdzas de dag mthong thos dran reg tsam gyes kyang mi shis pa'i rgud pa mtha' dag bsal te/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan gye dpal yon rgya chen pos sa phyogs yul 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad khyab byung snyam pa'i spyan dmigs mdzad dgos pa thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ 'di ni rab gnas kyi lo rgyus gtso bor bton pa'i bshad pa byed tshul gye dbang du byas pa yin la/rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon sogs las gtso bor brtsams te bshad pa byed par 'dod na kho bos bris pa'i rten bzhengs mchod sogs kyi phan yon bstan pa dkar chag lha'i rnga chen las shes par bya'o/ / zhesapa 'di yang 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabasgrigs pa'o/ /508

༄/ /bkra shis rdzasabargyad kyi3mabashadapakra shisadaga'aston/༄༅/ / bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi rnam bshad bkra shis dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /ra ༅/ / rgya gar skad du/ aṣā maṅga lo bhā ba bi bhā ṣe to lasnyi k+ṣa ṇa nā ma/bod skad du/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad rnam par bshad pa bkra shis dga' ston zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ye shes me long rdul bral don kun snang bas bkra ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / sdug bsngal nad sel sman mchog las nyon mongs pa'i gnyid slong chos kyi dung / / dmar ser li khri'i gos 'chang rnam dag bslab gsum 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun te/ / shis pa'imachog sbyin skyabs gsum thugs rjes 'bral med byang chub bar du skyongs/ / bde gshegs bden pa'i ljags yang pad+mo la/ / chags pa'i byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i thigs pa yis/ / gang la reg par phan bde'i zil mngar gyi/ / ro bda' shis pa'i rdzas kyis dge legs spel/ / gleng bar 'os pa de yi ngo mtshar gtam/ / ring nas blo gros ral bar 'khyil ba'i bcud/ / sa gsum 'jig rten dri ma dag byed du/ / phab 'di skal ldan shing rta'i dga' ston mdzod/ / de'ang bkra shis pa'i rdzas kyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ thog mar bkra shis rang gi ngo bo ni/ / bkra shis chen po'i mdo las/ sngar byas pa yi bsod nams kyis/ / mthun pa'i yul du gnas pa dang / / bdag nyid mchog gi smon lam bya/ / 'di ni mchog gi bkra shis so/ / zhes gsungs te/de'i don yang bshes spring las/ mthun par gyur pa'i yul na gnas pa dang / / skyes bu dam pa la ni brten pa dang / / rang gi legs smon sngon 509

༄/ /yo bstanab sa'i ga ཿma/bsags bsod nams te/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi ni khyod la mnga'/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ legs byas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi ldan theg pa mchog gi shing rtas don gnyis phun tshogs rnam grol nor bu'i gling du phyin par byed pa ni bkra shis kun gyi mchog dang gtso bor gsungs so/ /der bgrod pa'i rim pa'ang mdo de nyid las/ dka' thub dang ni tshangs spyod bya/ /'phags pa'i bden pa mthong bar bya/ / mya ngan 'das pa mngon sum bya/ / 'di ni mchog gi bkra shis so/ / zhes gnas skabs mngon mtho'i tshangs spyod sogs kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas pa dang / 'phags pa'ilam bden pa bzhi'i 'jug ldog gi sgo nas mthar thug nges legs kyi go 'phang sgrub pa ste/ mdor na skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim bskas kyi gdang bu bzhin du bgrod nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das mngon du bya ba ni gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis kyi mchog tu gsungs so/ / mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las kyang / chos shes bkra shis bkra shis 'byung / / bkra shis kun gyis bkra shis pa/ / grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge / zhes chos kyi blang dor shes shing lag tu blangs pa la brten nas tshe 'dir bkra shis shing tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su'ang bkra shis dang bde skyid 'byung la/ de'ang phyogs re ba tsam ma yin par tshe dang bsod nams chos srid/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi bkra shis kun gyis shis pa dang bde legs su 'gyur zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo ma tshang ba med pa'i dbang gis grags pa phyogs kun tu khyab pa la sus kyang smad du med pas bkra shis pa dang / de lta bu'i snyan grags kyis yid 'phrog pa'i skye bo blo ldan kun kyang de'i rjes su zhugs te chos kyi lam la gzhol bas rang gzhan kun la dge bar 'gyur ba sogs mdor na legs byas kyi rten 'brel gcig las gcig 'byung gis lu gu rgyud du 'grel bas nam yang nyams pa med par gong nas gong 'phel du 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i legs byas 510

༄/ /bkra shisajasabargyad kyirnamabashadabakra shisadagangaston/rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa de nyid gang gi thugs rje la brten nas 'byung ba'irtsa ba/ chos shes bkra shis zhes pa 'dis bstan par slob dpon 'jam dpalabashes gnyen gyis gsungs pa ltar na/ chos kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin shes pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs dang / bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan rlabs po che'i bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyis thugs rje bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa kho na la brten nas 'jig rten gsum du bkra shis pa'i tshogs sngar bshad pa bzhin du 'byung ba yin no/ / de'i thugs rje bden stobs kyis de ltar 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan yang legs bshad gser 'phreng las/ ji ltar mos pa bzhin 'grub pas bsdus pa'i smon lam la dbang ba ni brtson 'bras te/ sngon sems can gyi don du brtson pa ma btang bas so/ / zhes sngon bskal pa dpag tu med par rang don yid byed dang ma 'dres pa'i gzhan don la gcig tu brtson par mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ gzhan la phan pa'i thabs 'di lta bur gyur cig ces smon pa mdzad pa'i rigs mi 'grub panam yang mi srid pa ni dbang bcu'i nang gi smon lam dang las la dbang ba'i don yin no/ / tshul 'di rigs pas kyang 'grub ste/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ gsung gi kyal ka kho nas kyang / / 'bigs byed sa dang mnyam par gyur/ / ces pa lta bu 'jig rten pa'i drang srong bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis bden stobs brjod pas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs su bsgyur tshul rig byed nas 'byung ba sogs phyi nang thun mong du grags pa'i gtam rgyud kyang mang du yod na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bskal chen grangs med gsum du bden tshig bsrung ba'i nus pa la the tshom ga la dgos/ rgyal ba rang nyid kyis kyang ljags kyi dbang po bkram pas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs par mdzad de/lce 'di lta bus rdzun smra ba srid dam zhes bden tshig grub pa'i 'bras rtags brtan tshul 'dul ba lung las gsungs shing / khyad par du lung phran tshegs 511

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i me'i ga lam/las/ zla ba skar mar bcas pa sa la lhung yang srid/ / sa 'di ri dang nags tshal mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skam par 'gyur srid kyi/ / drang srong chen pos rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ / zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las kyang / ri dang nags bcas sa 'digs 'gyur zhing / / rgya mtsho'i chu dag de bzhin 'pho 'gyur la/ / nyi ma zla ba sa la lhung gyur kyang / / rgyal bas bshad pa rnam pa gzhan mi 'gyur/ /zhes gang gsung ba de'i thog tu mi 'bab pa mi srid par gsungs so/ / de ltar bden tshig gis byin gyes brlabs na 'grub par ma zad/ 'di dang 'di ltar gyur na snyam du bzhed pa tsam la'ang mi 'grub mi srid pas/ 'grel pa don gsal las 'phrin las bshad pa'i mjug tu bzhed par mdzad pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa de rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rnams bzhed tsam gyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i don yin par slob dpon chos shes kyi 'grel bshad tshig gsal du gsungs so/ / tshul 'di ni dpal ldan zla bas kyang / dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yis/ / rdul gcig yul la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul ston mod/ / rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phrar mi 'gyur/ / zhesagasungs te/ thugs la bzhed pa tsam gyis mi srid pa ci yang srid chog pa'i ngo mtshar bsam las 'das pa 'di lta bu las lhag pa'i gsang ba'i gnas sngags la'ang ston rgyu med pas/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ / zhes sogs 'di 'dra ba mdo sde las 'byung ba rnams kyang tshul bzhi'i nang gi mthar thug gi bshad par sgron gsal dang ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi ṭīk+kar bshad cing / gsang ba bsam mi khyab kyi yon tan 'di'i ming la'ang bzhed pa 'jug pa'i yon tan zhes rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal du gsungs so/ / de ltar gdul bya rnams la phan pa'i bzhed dgongs khyad par can gyi sgo nas bden tshig gis 512

༄/ /bkra shisaras brgyad kyinamabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa bkra shis rdzas brgyad du grags pa 'di rnams ni dbang bskur rab gnas sogs las du ma'i mtha' rten du dge legs spel ba'i rten 'brel la 'phags bod kye mkhas grub gong ma rnar sa kyis 'grem par mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes ma nyams par gnas pa 'ji yin la/de'angagand gang yin go don legs par chags pa'i steng nab/ lag len du bstar na de'i tshod kyis phan brlabs che bas rgyu mtshan legs par shes dgos/de'angablo gros dang skal ba phun sum tshogs pa'i skyes bu mchog gi 'dod bya'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang kho na yin/ sangs rgyas kye go 'phang zhes pa'ang gser sku mchod gral du bshams pa lta bu zhig la zer ba min gyi/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i go 'phang zhig la 'jog dgos/ de ni rgyud bla ma las/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ / de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid do/ / bdag nyid kyi ni 'byor ba'i gnas/ / dam pa'i don gyi sku yin te/ / drang srong rnams kyi brda yi sku/ / pha rol phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas/ / zhes rang don phun tshogs don dam pa'i sku dang /gzhan don phun tshogs kun rdzob pa'i skur gsungs la/ don dam pa'i sku der ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang / ye shes chos kyi sku gnyis yod kyang rang don chos kyi sku zhes gcig tu bsdoms nas sku gsum du byed tshul/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ / sku bsdus par ni shes par bya/ / zhes dang / rgyud blar/ 'dir ni dang po chos sku ste/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / de ltar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / theg chen pa rnams kyi 'dod bya dang dgos pa'i gtso bo gzhan don yin pas/ gdul bya mchog dman so so'i don sgrub tshul gyi sgo nas longs sprul gnyis so sor bgrang / gzugs sku kun tu bzang po'i 'phrin las kyi 'od zer de gnyis gang las 'byung ba'i rten nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid chos kyi sku de kho na yin pas 513

༄/ /yo ca bayo༅tshonace' ga lamagacig tu bgrang ba yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / / gzhan ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ / dang po gnyis po'i rten yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi don yang slob dpon seng ge bzang pos sku bzhir byed tshul 'grel ba'i rtsod lan ltar yin kyang / 'phags pa grol sdes 'di dang mthun par sku gsum du mdzad de/zagapa med pa'i chos gang dag / thob gyur nam kun rnam dag pa/ / zhes pa'i don/ chos can zag med ye shes kyi snang ba dang / chos nyid dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings ngo bo tha mi dad kyi tshul du mdor bstan te/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang / /zhes sogs kyis stong gzhi'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs so/ / skabs 'dir yang me long gis rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ lhag ma rnams kyis gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa byas na sngar bshad pa de dag dang shin tu 'grig ste/ me long la g.ya' dag pa dang gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba'i khyad chos gnyis tshang ba bzhin/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i steng du/ glo bur gye dri mam/ lus pa rnam par dag ste dag pa gnyis ldan du song ba'i spangs pa phun tshogs ngo bo nyid sku dang / zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig sogs kyis chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pas skad cig ma gcig la ji lta ji snyed kyi rnam pa mtha' dag gcig car mngon sum du gzigs pa'i rtogs pa phun tshogs ye shes chos sku gnyi ga 'grub pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad tshang ngo / /tshul 'di ni rnam snang mngon byang las/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /derani gsal dag rnyog pa med/ / ces dang / rang bzhin med cing gnas med par/ / chos rnams de ltar shes kyis la/ / zhes me long gi dbang du gsungs pa dang 'dra ste/ 'di'i tshigs bcad dze tā ri'i gzhung du 'byung ba 514

༄/ /bkra shisarasabargyad kyi3mabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/las kyang / ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ / rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa/ / zhes rnam par dag pa'i cha dang chos thams cad la dbang 'byor pa'i khyad par gnyis su byed pa snga phyi thams cad dgongs pa mthun no/ / sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa dang sbyar na/ dag pa'i rten dang brten pa'i gzugs phung gi cha thams cad rnam snang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyidayin la/ de nyid me long ye shes kyi rang mdangs yin pa'i cha nas kyang 'disagazhan don phun tshogs kyi rtsa ba tshugs tshul zhig yod pa shes dgos la/ye shes gzhan rnams de la brten pas me long lta bu dang ye shes kun gye 'byung gnas su gyur tshul mdo sde rgyan rtsa 'grel sogs su mang yang ma spros so/ /gnyis pa gzhan don phun tshogs 'grub pa'i rten 'brel rdzas phyi ma bdun gyis bsgrig tshul ni/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las mtha' yas pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs mdo sde du mar gsungs shing / rgyan las 'phrin las nyer bdun du bsdus pa dang / de'i rgyu mthun sems can don byed bcu gcig sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa gzhan la phan pa'i sgo tshad med pa zhig byang sadang de'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i byang sems kyi sde snod rnams las gsungs mod kyang / 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa na sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin pas 'dir de dang sbyar nas bshad dgos so/ / 'di la dogs pa'i gnas 'di yod de/ / phar phyin theg pa las kyang sems can thams cad kyi don cha tshang bar sgrub tshul ma gsungs na/ blo gros mizad pa sogs su ched du bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don dang / 'bras buskyon kun zad pa yon tan kun rdzogs pa la dmigs pas rgyal sras kyi lam thams cad mi zad par gsungs pa'i don mi tshang la/ rgyan gyi ldog pa gzung rtog skabs nyi tshe ba sogs gsungs pa der 'gyur bas 'phrin las bzhi mdo la'ang tshang dgos so snyam na/ ched du bya ba dang 'bras bu la rgya che chung byung na 515

༄/ /yo ca bayob po sa lagaskyon de 'jug kyang / sgrub byed kyi thabs mkhas mi mkhas byung ba la skyon med de/ de 'dra zhig med na mdo sngags gnyis theg pa mchog dman gyi khyad 'byed mi nus so/ / khyad par 'di 'byung ba'i rtsa ba ni phar phyin theg par nyon mongasagang yang lam du byed pa med la/ 'on kyang 'od srung gi le'ur/ de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ / de yang sangs rgyas chos rnams skyed la phan/ / zhes dang / rgyan las/ 'dod la spyod la thabs mkhas dang / / zhes gsungs shing / lam shes kyi yan lag skabs kyi rgyan snang las/ lam shes pa nyid kyes nyon mongs pa rnam pa thams cad du spong bar mi byed pa 'di'i rang bzhin yin pas/ zhes pa ltar gser 'phreng las kyang / de lta bu'i rang bzhin gye nyon mongs pa de dag gis byang sems khams gsum du kun tu spyor la/ zhes sogs dang / khye'u skar ma'i lo rgyus lta bu mdo du mar 'byung bas 'dod chags lam gyi grogs su byed pa tsam zhig mdo la'ang yod mod/ zhe sdang ni snying rje'i dngos kyi 'gal zla yin pas lam gyi grogs su 'grob nam yang mi srid par theg bsdus las gsungs so/ / nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa las/ zhe sdang ni sems can yongs su gtong bar byed la/'dod chags ni sems can sdud par byed par gsungs pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i mdor/ zhe sdang gis snying rje dang bral bar byas na thabs mkhas kyang med par 'gro bas sems can spyi'i don las nyams tshul sogs bslab btus las ltung ba'i lce yang gi skabs su rgyas par drangs nas gsungs pa theg bsdus dang mthun no/ /de ltar na zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bzhi'i nang nas snga ma gnyis mdo la yod kyang mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis gzhan don sgrub tshulamado la med/ dbang la'ang zhi drag gi cha gnyis yod pas phyi ma med de/'di dag gi rgyu'i kun slong snying rje shugs drag po phar phyin gyi gdul bya'i de las lhag pa zhig yod kyang dus kyi kun slong khro sems shig byed dgos pas/516

༄/ /bkra shisarasabargyad kyi3mabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/gsang sngags kyi gdul bya mchog gis dug sman du bsgyur ba bzhin de'ang lam gyi grogs su byed nus la mdo'i gdul byas de mi nus pas las de gnyis ma gsungs pa yin no/ / dus kyi kun slong de ltar dgos pa las de dag byed pa'i dus 'byung bzhi'i rlung dang spyor tshul gsungs pa sogs kyi shes te gshed skor gyi rgyud dang rgyud 'grel rnams su bltas na gsal lo/ / des na 'dir 'phrin las bzhi dang spyor ba la/ thog mar zhi ba'i las kyis zhi bar bya rgyu ni/rgyud bla ma las/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyun ni spang bya la/ / zhes sogs ltar nad lta bu'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang / nad kyi rgyu lta bu'i las nyon gyi kun 'byung gnyis las ma 'das pas dang po sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i rdzas ni ghi waṃ ste/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas kyang nad sel ba'i sman mchog tu gyur pa zhig yinal/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gis bden pa bdar ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel ba'i sman mchog tu 'gyur ro/ / nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yod kyang bsdu na rlung mkhris bad gan gsum du 'du la/ de gsum dug gsum so sos skyed tshul sman gyi gzhung las nad so so'i rgyu dang rkyen bshad pa'i skabs su'ang 'byung bas dug gsum zhi na nad kun zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / dug gsum rang rang gi gnyen po 'dod chags la mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang la byams pa lta bu gsungs kyang / rnam 'grel las/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir/ / shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min/ / gsungs pa ltar de dag gis nyon mongs pa'i sa bon drungs 'byin par mi nus/ de drungs 'byin byed kyi sman ni/rjebla mas/ srid pa'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin pa'i lam/ / zhes bsngags pa bzhin chos nyid spros bral gye de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab 'ba' zhig gtso che bas 'di'i tshigs bcad du'ang / sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ / zhes gsungs pa yin no/ / 'brug pa sangs rgyas rdo rje'i 'jig rten dga' ba'i zlos gar las ghi waṃ 'bul mkhan glang po che sa srung gi bu yin pas 517

༄/ /yo cabamab yo ga lamaglang po che nor skyong zhes pa nor bar bshad kyang / nor skyod zhes pa tsam gyis maskyes dgras bcom ldan 'das la rbad pa'i glang po de nyid yin dgos pa'i nges pa med/ gal te yin na'ang de mi yul gyi glang po che gzhan las stobs shin tu che ba lha klu'i yul gyi glang po che'i rgyud cig yin par bshad pas sa srung gi bu ma yin par yang kha tshon mi chod do/ /gnyis pa las nyon zhi bar byed pa'i rten 'brel gyi rdzas ni zho ste/ rtsi thog gi bcud bsdus pa'i snying po 'o ma dang / de bskol zhing bsnyal pa sogs kyi las su bya ba'i rim pas zhor 'gyur ba bzhin/ 'khor 'das kun gye gzhir gyur pa sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de lam bsgom pa'i bya bas rim gyes sbyangs pas gong nas gong du 'phos te rgyal ba'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i tshul rnam gzhagarnam pa bcus gtan la phab pa bzhin yin pas rgyal ba'i snying po zhes bshad pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ de ltar rgyal ba'i snying po ni/ / rnam gzhag rnam pa bcu zhes brjod/ /ces gsungs la/ rgyan stug po bkod par/snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras/ / de bzhin gshegs rnams ston par mdzad/ /ces dang / lang gshegs las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po kun gzhi'i rnam par shes par bsgrags pa zhes sogs kyang sems kyi chos dbyings rang bzhin gnas rigs de nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhir gyur pa laragongs nas snying po dang kun gzhi rnam grangs su gsungs g.yin no/ /'di'i tshigs bcad du/ yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ / zhes pa'ang / rigs kyi skad dod go tra zhes pa'i go gu ṇa/ tra ta ra byas pas yon tan gyis sgrol pa ste de nyid sbyangs pa las sprin nam mkhar yal ba bzhin/las nyon gye dri ma mtha' dag de'i ngang du zad pa'i 'gog pa rang steng du mthong ba ni grol ba thob pa yin pas/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba la/ /zhesapa nas/ de bzhin sa yi mthar thug na/ /chos kyi 518

༄/ /bkra shisaras brgyad kyirnamabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/skulang rdzogs par gsal/ / zhes dang po mthong spangs tsam spangs pa nas mthar sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zad par spangs pa'i bar la chos sku rim gyis mthong par gsungs so/ / snying po zhes pa chos nyid tsam la byed mi rigs te/ snying po rnam dag ye shes mchog rtogs nas/ / zhes de rnam dag ye shes su bshad pas so snyam na/ 'di ni rgyud bla mar/ lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ / gsungs pa bzhin zag med ye shes 'byung rung gi nus pa gnas pa tsam la dgongs kyi/ thos bsam gang yang ma byas pa'i dus nas zag med ye shes rang byung du yod par 'dod pa jo nang ba'i lugs lta bu min no/ / 'di la'ang sangs rdor gyis/ zho 'bul mkhan khyim bdag bzang skyong dang legs skyes mas 'o ma phul ba yin pas/ bla ma snga ma rnams legs skyes mas zho phul zhes pa de 'bul mkhan dang 'bul rgyu'i rdzas gnyi ga nor ba yin zhes bshad mod kyang / 'bul mkhan gnyig lung las 'byung bas gcig kho nar nges mi dgos shing / de'i nang nas legs skyes mas bsnyen bkur ba des gser mdog lang tsho dar ba sogs dge mtshan che bar byung ba kun la grags che bas de smos pa dgos dbang yin/ rdzas kyang ba stong gi 'o ma snying khur byas te sbrang rtsi btab nas phul bar gsungs kyang des 'o ma yin par mi 'grub ste/ nying khur byas zhes pa snying po blangs pa'i don yin pas mar dang zho sogs 'o ma'i snying po yin la/ der ma zad 'o ma'ang rtsi thog gi bcud yin pas/ ye shes rdo rje'i rnam 'joms kyi 'grel par/ rtsi thog gi snying po mar dang chu'i snying po lan tshwar gsungs pa bzhin no/ / mdor na sems kyi chos nyid khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po de nyid dug gsum gyi dri ma dang bral bar gyur pa la grol ba dang thar pa zhes pa yin pas de'i rten 'brelangos 'di'i steng nas bsgrigs pa yin no/ / rgyas pa'i las la tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan te chos srid kyi cha gnyis su yod pas/519

༄/ /༅ cabalopa'isgronasa'i g.yo las/dang po tshe'i rten 'brel ni du ba'i sgo nas byed pa yin te 'di nyid tshe spel ba'i rdzas su rgyud du ma dang 'od snye sogs sbyin sreg gi gzhung kun mthun/ 'di la ming gi steng nas kyang rten 'brel khyad par can zhig yod de/ 'di'i skad dod du rma rā zhes pa 'chi dka' ba'am 'chi bas mi thub pa la 'jug sa ha sra bikhro zhes pa'ang gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i stobs sam nus pa stong dang ldan pa la 'jug pa'i phyir te/ 'dod 'jor rgyud gzhan drangs pa las/ nus pa stong ldan mtha' yas dang / /'chi dka' ngan spong bu skye ldan/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /rtswa 'di'i ngos 'dzin mi mthun pa sna tshogs yod kyang ram ba'am 'jag mar grags pa 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rnam 'joms 'grel pa las/ durba ni ram pa ste/ zhes so/ /'di'i rtsa ba la tshigs shin tu mang bas sha ta sabri kā zhes tshigs brgya bar yang grags pa'i phyir/ 'chi med mdzod las/durba dang ni tshigs brgya pa/ zhes so/ / der ma zad tshigs re re'i mtshams nas myu gu skye bas brdzis pa dang bcad pa sogs kyis skam mi nus pas 'chi dkar btags pa yin la/ de'i cha nas kyang tshe'i rten 'brel du 'gyur lugs shig yod de/ /dper na sman gyi gzhung las/ shug pa ba lu mtshe dang mkhan pa bzhi/ dgun mi skam pa tshe'i gsos su 'gyur/ / zhes shing rang nyid mi skam pa de tshe'i rten 'brel la phan par bshad pa bzhin no/ / 'di'i tshigs bcad du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs te/ /zhes pa yongs grags kyi rdor sems tsam la byed mi dgos/ dkyil 'khor gang dang 'brel bar las byed pa'i dkyil 'khor de'i gtso bo ni skabs de'i rdo rje 'chang ngam rdo rje sems dpar 'jog pas brtag gnyis las/ rdo rje mi phyed ces bya ste/ / sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa/ / zhes gsungs so/ / tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'ang rang gis legs par bsgrubs thub na tshe lhar grags pa zhig mi dgos par dkyil 'khor gang gi sgo nas kyang tshe'i dngos grub bde blag tu 520

༄/ /bkra shis rdzasabargyad kyirnamabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/'grub nus pa'i tshul sngags rim las/ dkyil 'khor gye 'khor lo gcig la bzlas pa dang bsgom pa tshad du song na/ de nas lha'i rnal 'byor de nyid la kha sgyur lugs re byas pas/ zhes pa nas/ gang yang byas pas chog pas tshe sgrub dang blo 'phel sogs kyi gdams pa rnams zur nas btsal mi dgos so/ /zhes gsungs so/ / 'di la'ang sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ durba 'bul mkhan bram zikurnya li yin/ rtswa 'tshong khye'u bkra shis kyis ku sha phul ba yin zhes bshad kyang / khyed cag tshad mar byed pa'i mtshams khrid kyi yi ge mang por durba gdanadu byed tshul 'byung ba 'di ston pas rtswa 'tshong gi khye'u las blangs pa'i rtswa'i gdan la byang chub mngon du mdzad pa de dang rten 'brel sgo bstun pa min na de'i rgyu mtshan smra dgos so/ /gnyis pa bsod nams rgyas par byed pa'i rdzas bil ba ste/ 'di'i tshigs bcad kyi dngos zin la bsam pa'i don 'grub pa gtso bor smos kyang /rgya cher rol ba las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ / bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yis bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ / ces pa ltar bsam don 'grub pa bsod nams la rag las pas/ 'bras bu de don du gnyer na rgyu bsod nams 'phel ba'i thabs gtso bor byed dgos te/bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod ni yon tan rgyu rnams la/ / mngon dgyes 'bras bu rnams la min/ / sgrub pa bzang po 'di nyid kyis/ / khyod kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di la'ang ming gi stenganas rten 'brel 'grig rgyu zhig yod de/ dpal zhes pa bsod nams kyi ming gi rnam grangs yin pas/ a ma ra ko ṣar dpal 'bras zhes gsungs/ka ma dhe nus/ 'di'i 'bras bus dga' bas shrī pha la dga' ba'i 'bras bu'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ / 'di'i tshigs bcad du/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ / zhes gsungs pa gnad shin tu zab ste/ go cha'i 521

༄/ /yo ca bamaḥ lo sa las/bkod pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ rgyu dang rkyen ni mang po dag / lhan cig 'dus las byung ba yin/ / rkyen ni mang po 'dus pa'i phyir/ / rang bzhin gyis ni med pa yin/ / zhes rgyu rkyen tshogs pa la ltos pa'i gtan tshigs kyis rang bzhin med par sgrub pas rigs pa drug cu par/ gang gis stong dang rten 'byungadang / / dbu ma'i lam du don gcig par/ / zhes stong ba dang rten 'byung don gcig par gsungs te/ bden par grub na rgyu rkyen gyis bcos su mi rung la/ bden grub kyis stong pa'i gnad kyis gnas skabs mthar thug gi dgos don thams cad 'grub rung ba 'di la dgongs te/ rtsa she las/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar rkang pa dang pos rten 'byung gi rnam gzhag gsungs pa'i 'phror/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu dag /ces gsungs pa ni snga ma'i rten 'byung gi rnam gzhag de la phra rags gnyis yod pas/ rags pa rgyu dge sdig las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung bar yid ches pa de 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba yin zhing / de'i sgo nas blang dor go ma log par byed pa de 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i spyod pa yin/ rten 'byung phra mo ming rkyang btags yod tsam las rang gi ngo bos grub pa rdul tsam med par rtogs pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / zin pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi nyams len rnams 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yang dag pa'i spyod pa yin/ lta spyod snga mas mtho ris dang /phyi mas thar pa 'grub pas bshes spring las/ gal te mtho ris thar pa mngon bzhed na/ /yang dag lta la goms pa nyid du mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gdulakhya 'khrid pa'i rim pa de'i sgo nas byang chub snying po mchog tu dag tshul yang rin chen phreng ba las/ dang po mngon par mtho ba'i chos/ / phyis ni nges par legs 'byung ba'o/ / gang phyir mngon par mtho zob pas/ /rim 522

༄/ /bkra shisajasabargyad kyi mabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/gyis nges par legs pa 'byung / / zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin zhing / rtsa she las/ dam pa min la bdag 'dzin mchog / ces sogs dang / bzhi brgya bar/ bsod nams min pa dang por bzlog / ces sogs dang gnad gcig la/ khyod kyis ji snyed bka' stsal pa/ / rten 'brel nyid las brtsams te 'jug tshul yang 'di yin no/ / deng sang blun po phal cher las 'bras khyad du bsad de khrel med kyi ngan spyod 'di phyi thams cad phung la 'deb pa re byas nas/ de 'jig rten gyi bya ba shes pa dang 'grub pa yin snyam pa ni go log yin te/ ya rabs ma rabs spyod pas byed/ / ces de 'dra 'jig rten na'ang ma rabasastel med ces kun gyis smad pa'i gnas su 'gyur la/ sus kyang der yid mi ches shing nam phugs kun gyis 'phya ba zhig 'byung ba ni shes rab sdong bu las/ dam pa'i bu la gdong na pad+ma med/ / smad 'tshong dbu la klad nas rwa ma skyes/ / ji lta ji ltar log par byed gyur pa/ / de lta de ltar nal bu'i mtshan nyid brjod/ / ces dang / skyes rabs las/ 'jig rten smod pas 'dzem pa med pa dang / / chos dang phyi ma'i 'bras bur mi lta ba/ / gang yin de la skye bo yid mi ches/ / lha dang dpal gyis rab tu spangs par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / g.yo sgyu ha cang ches na rang gi nang mi rnams kyang zhe khrel nas 'gro bas de nyid las/ skyon dang yon tan rnam brtag na/ / nang mi'am yang na phyi mi'ang rung / / 'jig rten na ni bkur ste dang / / smad par bya ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs so/ / des na 'jig rten yang ya rabs kyi lugs bzhin drang por byed shes na chos su 'gro bas/ shes rab brgya ba las/mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ / lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / / lha dang mitha them skas la/ / 'dzeg na thar pa drung na 'dug / ces dang / skyes rabs las/ chos dang mi 'gal bar 'jig rten gyi tshul la mkhas pa/ zhes gsungs shing / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kyang / rigs pas dpyad na chos lugs mi 523

༄/ /gung cabastanar+yā yo go las/'gal zhing / /'jig rten bya ba kun nas legs bsgrub pa/ /zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten ya rabs kyi lugs de gzhir bzhag pa'i tshul lung sde bzhin shin tu mang zhing / 'od ldan las kyang /skye bo ya rabs rnams kyis smad pa kho na dag la bcom ldan 'das kyis bkag pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so/ / byed shes na 'jig rten yang chos su 'gro/byed ma shes na chos kyang sdig tu 'gro bas 'dir/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ / byang chub snying po mchog tu dag ces pa las brtsams te cung zad bshad pa yin gyi/ byang sar byang chub sems dpas 'jig rten shes par byed tshul dang / bslab btus las 'jig rten ma dad pa bkag nas sems 'dzin dgos par mdo du ma drangs te gsungs tshul/'jig rten gyi dpal 'byor du grags pa de'ang dpal du 'gro mi 'gro bsod nams yin min skyes rabs dang jo bo yab sras kyi gsung sgros/ be'u bum sngon mo sogs su 'byung ba mtha' yas kyang ma spros so/ /bil ba 'bul mkhan shing gi lha mo yin zhes tshangs pas phul ba bkag kyang / de gnyis phan tshun spangs te 'gal ba ma yin pas/ tshangs pas phul ba rnams gcad la khegs don med cing / ston pas chos 'khor bskor ba la tshangs pas bskul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed pa por grags pas kun yid ches pa'i thabs su lung las gsungs pa bzhin 'di'ang don thams cad 'grub pa la 'bulab po'i cha nas kyang rten 'brel gyi sgo zhig yod de/ gsum pa chos kyi dpal 'byor lung rtogs kyi yon tan rgyas par byed pa'i rten 'brel gyi rdzas dung g.yas 'khyil te/ 'di'i tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa dang pos thos pa'i rten 'brel dang / gnyis pas zos don bsam pas sgro 'dogs bcad de sgom byung gi ye shes mngon du byed tshul/ gsum pas rang gis nges nas gzhan la ston tshul/ bzhi pas smra ba bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'grub tshul te 524

༄/ /bkra shisarasabargyad kyirnam bshadabakra shisadaga'aston/bshad sgrub kyi bya ba lam 'bras bu dang bcas te cha tshang bar ston pa yin no/ / 'on kyang dngos su mtshon rgyu/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgogs pa'i tshul/ / zhes chos nyan bshad kye thos pa gtso bor mdzad pa ni lam bgrod pa'i mgo rtsom byed kyi gzhi rtsa de la rag las pa'i gnad kyis yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / / tshul bzhin yid la byed las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /zhes sogs dang / rgyud bla ma las/ shes rab nyon mongs shes bya kun spong de yi phyir/ / 'di mchog nyid de de yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin/ / zhes dang / shes rab mchog yin de gzhi ni/ / thos pa de phyir thos pa mchog / ces gsungs so/ / bzhi brgya par yang / mnyan pa po dang mnyan bya dang / / smra bo 'byung ba shin tu dkon/ / de phyir mdor na 'khor ba ni/ / mtha' yod ma yin mtha' med min/ / zhes mgo chos nyan bshad kyi rten 'brel 'di dpyis phyin pa zhig dka' bas 'khor mtha' mngon dka' bar gsungs te/ rnam grol sgrub pa la 'di las gal che ba med tshul byang chub lam gyi rim par gsungs pa bzhin no/ / dung g.yas 'khyil lam skye ba lnga par grags pa 'di bus pas rims nad zhi ba sogs bkra shis par 'gyur la/ khyad par du dung gi sgras rol mo gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon par sher mdo las gsungs pas/chos kyi sgras chos min gye smra ba ngan pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo zhig kyang yod do/ / kha cig dung 'bul mkhan klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa zer yang / des dung phul tshul lang gshegs rgya nag gi 'gyur las 'byung ba'i dung ni rje rin po ches gter nas bzhes pa da lta 'bras srung gi tshogs dung 'di yin pas byin rlabs che'ang g.yas 'khyil min no/ /gsum pa dbang gi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i rten 'brel gyi rdzas li khri ste da lta sin+d+ra ra dang 'di gnyis so sor byed kyang 'di'i rgya skad sin+d+ra ram̐ yin pas de 525

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgronas gsung 'bum/zur chag nas sin du rar song ba yin/ dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang 'di'i thig le las bskyed pa sogs dbang gi las sbyor thams cad la nye bar mkho ba grags che/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dod 'jor/ pa sasto t+pa pa zhes dpyid kyi dga' ston du bshad la/ rak+ta pā lu ke zhes bye ma dmar por grags shing / dmar po las bzhi'i nang nas dbang gi mdog yin pas ming dang kha dog gnyi ga'i rten 'brel re yod do/ / tshig ris gzhan rnams go sla la/chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang / / zhes pa 'dir dpyad gzhi zhig yod/ rgyal po dbang du bsdu bar 'dod nas blon po dbang du bsdus pa lta bu yul nor ba'i don min/ dbang du byed don gyi kun slong ma nor ba zhig dgos/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i dbang gi las rnam dag tu 'gro ba la/ 'dus pa phyi ma las/ dbang la chags pa'i yid du bya/ /khro la gtum pas rab tu sgrub/ /ces dus kye kun slong dgos dbang gis de 'dra re dgos kyang / phugs kyi zhe 'dod pha rol po de rang gis dbang du ma byas na lcags kyu med pa'i glang po bzhin don chen po las nyams par mthong ste/ rang don yid byed dang ma 'dres par snying rje kho na'i dbang du gyur pa zhig dgos/ rang mtho btsan phyugs pa zhig 'dod de 'jig rten khams kye dpal 'byor thams cad 'ub kyis 'dus par bsam pa ni rlabs po che'i brnab sems bsgom pa yin pas mi dge ba'i phung po 'ba' zhig las chos kyi dri tsam yang mi bro na/gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i lam dang las rgyal mchog gi rnal 'byor du 'gro ba'i re ba ga la yod/ nor sa 'di 'dra yod pa la dgongs nas rje bla mas/ byang chub sgrub pa'i rjes su rab gzhol ba'i/ / bde gshegs dgyes pa'i rab 'byams dbang gi las/ / gsungs pa yin/ snga ma'i brnab sems de 'dra bsgoman chos su rlom yang don 'khor ba'i gting rdor 'gyur gyi/ byang chub sgrub pa'i rjes su gzhol ba'i re ba med/ chos su song na bde gshegs dgyes 526

༄/ /bkra shisaras brgyadakyinam bshadabakra shisadaga'asnyon/pa gzhir bcas kyang / de 'dra de bde gshegs sras dang bcas thugs khrel ba'i rgyu las ma 'das pas zhib cha phye nas gsungs pa yin/ de 'dra tsho sngon bsags re dang stabs 'grigs nas phan phan 'dra ba 'byung srid kyang /dngos gnas la rin chen 'phreng bar/ brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ / gsungs pa bzhin phun tshogs thams cad than sprin rlung gis gtor ba dang / sbrul gyis gla rtsi'i dri tshor ba bzhin ring du byed pa'i rgyu las ma 'das pas/ dbang drag gi las byed par 'dod pa rnams brnab sems gnod sems la nyams len snying por byas pas dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi sgrub thabs su ma song ba re mdzad na rang la legs so/ / rje yab sras kyi gsung sogs tshad ldan du mar 'di bzhin 'byung ba la/ 'brug pa sangs rgyas rdo rje ngag bton te/ chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang / / zhes bcos pa ni mun pas snang ba la gsal 'debs su snang / kha cig 'di nyid 'bul mkhan skar ma la dga' ba'i bur bshad ces dogs pa byed kyang mi gcig la ming du ma dang ming gcig kyang 'gyur khyad kyis sna tshogs su song ba mang bas gu dogs mi dgos so/ /bzhi pa drag po'i 'azin las sgrub pa'i rten 'brel gye rdzas yungs gar te/'dir/ yungs gar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ / bgegs rnams ma lus zhi bar byed pa ste/ / zhes rdo rje'i rigs su bshad pa ni 'dus pa'i le'u bcu gsum par/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ / zhes pa'i 'grel ba mchan sbrags las/ zhe sdang ni mi bskyod pa yin la de'i gnas te sa bon ni yi ge hūṃ ste/zhes sogs kyis khro bo bcu hūṃ las skyed pa ni/ spyir rta mgrin 'od dpag med kyi rigs yin pas trī las skyed dgos pa lta bu yod kyang / 'dir drag po'i las sgrub pa la de'i rigs kyi lha mi bskyod pa yin pas khro bo bcu ka hūṃ las skyed pa dang / spro ba'i tshe'ang rdo rje 'chang zhi ba de nyid mi bskyod pa drag por bsgyur 527

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'is ces gsung 'bumanas byed dgos pa'i phyir/ dngos grub rgya mtsho las/ zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgyur ba'idagos pa ni khro bo la bka' bsgo ba'i phyir yin la/ mi bskyod pa bcug pa'isgo nas bsgyur ba ni mi bskyod pa zhe sdang gi rigs yin pas so/ / zhes gsungs so/ /des na yungs gar drag las la mchog tu gyur pa'i rtsa ba thugs rdo je mi bskyod pa'i rigs kye rdzas yin pa la thug cing / de'i rtsa ba'ang mthar gtugs na phung byed gdon bgegs nyer 'tshe thams cad kyi rtsa ba bden 'dzin gyi ma rig pa dang / de 'joms byed kyi gnyen po mthar thug pa bde stong gi ye shes yin zhing / bde stong gnyis su med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes de nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin yin pas so/ /'di la'ang spyod 'jug dang blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo/ mi la'i mgur/ lab sgron gyi gsung sogs gzhung mtha' yas pa drang du yod la/ yongs su grags pa/ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar zhes sogs kyi steng nas kyang dpyad shes na des chog par yod do/ / 'dir bgegs rnams ma lus zhes pa'ang steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon bgegs thams cad ces pa'i don min gyi/ phyi'i bgegs rang las rgyud tha dad pa'i gnod byed thams cad dang / de'i rtsa ba nang gi bgegs dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i don yin te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje'i gshed du 'gyur tshul dang gnad gcig la/ rgyud bla mar/ 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / spyod 'jug tu sems las gzhan pa'i 'jigs chen med par gsungs pa rnams 'dra'o/ / dpal ldan thal 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dir chos thams cad ming gis btags pa la ltos pas/ 'di la'ang ming gi rten 'brel 'grig tshul ni/ 'chi med mdzod las/dpal kha dang ni gnod 'joms gnyis/ / de dkar po ni don grub ste/ /zhes yungs dkar nag gnyi ga'i spyi ming sar+sha pa dpal kha/ ka daspa ka gnod 'joms yin pas pha rol gyi gnod byed 'joms pa la bsngags te thun rdzas 528

༄/ /bkra shisarasabargyad kyirnamabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/sogs drag las la mkho che ba yongs su grags pa ltar ro/ / der ma zad yungs gar rdzas brgyad ga'i mjug tu bzhag pa'ang rten 'brel gyi khyad par zhig yin te/ mdzod sngar drangs pa ltar yungs gar gyi sger ming / sidha tho ste don thams cad grub pa zhes zas gtsang sras kyi mtshan dang mthun pas/rdzas snga ma rnams kyes bsgrigs pa'i don gnyis kyi rten 'brel thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa'i byin rlabs kyi sgo yod pa'i phyir/ ra bha sas/ sidhā rja pho zas gtsang gi / sras dang yungs gar la yang ngo / / zhes bshad pa bzhin no/ / blo chung kha cig rang gi sngon bsags kyi las la rag las pa ma gtogasaphyi'i rdzas la ltos pa ci yod snyam pa ni las 'bras la yid ches pa'i khul gyes las 'bras bsam mi khyab la skur ba btab pa yin te/ de dag ni tshor ba bde sdug myong ba 'di tsam zhig las kyi 'bras bu yin pa ma gtogs/dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba/ rtsi shing lo 'bras sa rdo ri brag tshun chad mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa/ khab len gyis lcags dang spur len gyis rdul len pa lta bu rdzas kyi rten 'brel/ tha na rma bya'i mdongs kyi nyag ma re re la'ang mdangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'char ba thams cad las kyis ma 'dres par sgrub tshul sangs rgyas kho na'i mngon sum gyi yul du gyur pa/ kun btus las bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhi'i nang du gsungs pa lta bu ma shes pa yin pas/ rdzas kyi nus pas de ltar byed pa de'ang las kyi mthu yin par shes na las 'bras la dad pa rkyen gang gis kyang mi 'phrog pa zhig 'byung ngo / / yang bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad po de la lam so so dang sbyar ba'i mtshon don nam rten 'brel re'ang yod par mngon te/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang sbyar na/ me long gis yang dag pa'i rtogs pa mtshon te/ der gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba bzhin drang nges kyi mdo sna tshogs pa'i don ma 'dres par shar nas gzhan la ston pa'i kun slong gi rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo las/ chos de dag pa rnam 529

༄/ /yo cabalo༅ ཿ ga lam/thar blta'o/ /rnam par rtog go /ma 'dres par rab tu shes te/ zhes dang /dbus mthar go byed dang zhes pa'i thad kyi blo gros brtan pa'i 'grel bshad las/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa ni ngag kun nas slong ste ma brtag ma dpyad par tshig mi smra'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ghi waṃ gis dran pa mtshon te/des nad sel ba bzhin drag pas rtag tu bsrung ste nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba'i phyogs byung tshad sel ba'i phyir/ gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo las/ dran pa gang gis nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi skabs mi 'byed/ ces pa nas/ mi dge ba thams cad kyi skabs mi 'byed pa ni yang dag pa'i dran pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ gang yang dran pa'i yid sgo nas/ /bsrung ba'i don du gnas gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhos yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba mtshon te/ sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i zas gos gang byung gis chog shes pa'i phyir/ dbus mthar/ yo byad bsnyung zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ du rbasalang dag pa'i rtsol ba mtshon te skyo ngal med par tshe ring du gnas nas lam la bslab ste shes sgrib sogs spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ rgyan gyi dbyig 'grel las/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba la sogs pas ni yun ring por mi skyo bar shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po sgom par byed do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/bil bas yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' mtshon te/ de don 'grub pa'i rdzas yin pas sdig pa spong zhing dge ba'i las thams cad 'dod pa bzhin byed pa'i phyir/gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo las/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni dge ba'i mngon par 'du bya ba thams cad mngon par 'du byed de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dung gis yang dag pa'i ngag mtshon te/ des sgra snyan sgrogs pa ltar ngag gi nyes pa dang bral bar chos ston pa'i phyir/ 'dis lta ba rnam dag dang /las mthas tshul khrims rnam dag yang dag pa'i 'tsho bas 'tsho ba rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i phyir/ dbus mtha' las/ rnam gsum gzhan yid 530
