༄/ /bkra shisarasabargyad kyinamabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/ches par byed/ / ces dang / lha dang tshul khrims yo byad bsnyung / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ li khris ting nge 'dzin mtshon te/ ting nge 'dzin gyes mngon shes sogs bsgrubs nas kun la dbang 'byor par byed pa'i phyir/gser phreng las/ ting nge 'dzin gyes mngon shes sogs yon tan khyad par canasgrub pa'i dbang gis mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po byed de zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yungs gar gyis bgegs 'joms pas yang dag pa'i lta ba mtshon te/ rnam gzhag ji bzhin rtogs pa dang / / zhes rgyan las 'byung bas 'grel pa rnams su rjes kyi shes pas mthong lam skabs der gzigs tshul shes pa la'ang gsungs kyang / de tsam ma yin par mthong lam ltar chos mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa la byed dgos shing / de ltar na nyes pa'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra bo gzhom tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo las/ gang chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ni yang dag pa'i lta ba zhes bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhib par ni mdo sde rgyan dang dbus mtha' rtsa 'grel las shes dgos/ rdzas 'di dag lung las gsungs pa'i tshe so so'i dgos don rim gtogs lam dang sbyar ba med pas rang bzor 'gyur ro snyam na mi 'gyur te/ dper na rgyal srid sna bdun yang dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs pa rje rin po ches mchod phreng tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa ltar yin zhing / mngon 'byung gi mdo las rkang pa tha mar de ni de yis 'thob/ / ces pa tsam ma gtogs/ lha rdzas las byas zhes sogs yongs grags kyi 'di yin/nga las nu'i yal 'dab kyi gzhan 'dra la/ khyim bdag dmag dpon sngon 'gro ba'o/ / zhes blon po ma bgrang yang dmag dpon blon po gnyis 'thus su byas pa yin/ mngon 'byung gi 'di khyim bdag dang blon po gnyis bsdoms pa yin pas/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i 'phrin yig rnam gzhag tu khyim bdag ma drangs par dmag dpon dang blon po grangs rer byas na rin chen gcig chad pa'i skyon 531

༄/ /gung thangabastan ba'irnanas gsung 'bum/'byung gsung pa'ang / de gang rung la khyem bdag gi mkho dgu sbyin pa'i don tshangadagos pa ma shes par khyim bdag grangs nas dor na gnad mi tshang ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba la dgongs pa yin te/ srid mthar khyim bdag de blon por bzhag pa yod par gsungs so/ / de bzhin du 'dul ba lung / rgya cher rol brnams las kyang rgyal srid sna bdun rang rang gi khyad par ma gtogs lam dang sbyar ba med kyang / de'i dgongs pa byams mgon gyis 'grel ba'i tshe rgyal srid sna bdun dngos ni 'khor sgyur gyi skye ba nam blangs pa'i tshe 'byung ba 'khor bas bsdus pas snying po med la/ 'on kyang 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyis de bdun la brten nas 'jig rten la dbang sgyur tshul shes na des mtshon te/ byang chub yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang sgyur tshul shes shing spro ba skye bas/ mdo sde rgyan las/ shes bya ma rgyal rgyal ba'i phyir/ / dran pa dag ni kun tu spyod/ / ces sogs kyis byang chub yan lag bdun la sbyar ba dang /ka ma dhe nus sdong po bkod pa'i mdo drangs pa las kyang / pha rol phyin pa rtag 'byung 'khor lo yin te glang po mngon par shes pa mchog / ye shes rdzu 'phrul rta ste chags pa med 'gro nor bu dam pa yin/ / spyod pa btsun mo bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi po khyim bdag dam pa'o/ / thabs la shin tu mkhas pa blon po yin te 'khor los bsgyur/ / zhes rgyal sras kye lam spyi la sbyar zhing / jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsar 'phags pa'i nor bdun la sbyar ba zhig kyang 'byung ba rnams mdo'i don 'grel tshul gyi man ngag yin pas/ 'dir yang de'i rung mthun sbyar te 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang sbyar ba nges pa skyed lugs dang bag chags 'jog tshul gyi gnad mang po yod pas shin tu phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro/ /smrasapa/ dge ba'i sa bon legs smon rlan gyis bsgos/ / rgyal ba nyi ma'i drod kyis smin pa las/ / bde skyid snye ma mngon par mtho ba'i rtser/ /532

༄/ /bkra shisaras brgyad kyinamabashadabakra shisadaga'aston/nges legs 'bras bu smin pa'i so nam rmad/ / gser ldan yangs pa'i khor yug mtha' klas kyang / /legs bshad gsar ba'i me tog rnyed min dus/ /rmad byung gtam gyi ut+pal bzhad pa 'di/ / snyan gong mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'bralamed mdzod/ / ches phra'i nam mjug pad+ma'i bsung zer tsam/ / phog tshe dbugs mthar son pa'i sbrang bu yang / / phyogs der ngal gyis 'dab ma skyod byed na/ / snyigs dus lhag par chos la brtson par rigs/ / gang las brtsams kyang gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don/ / mi zad 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bum pa bzang / / stsol mdzad sto na'i mtshan dang a byerngas/ / byang chub bar du 'bral med skyong gyur cig / dge tshogs chu 'dzin phung po 'khrigs pa las/ / dge legs dbyar rnga bzhad pa'i gdangs dang bcas/ / dge mtshan bye ba'i gru char bsnyil ba yis/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i chu mtsho rgyas gyur cig /ces bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi rnam par bshad pa bkra shisadaga' ston zhesabya ba 'di ni gzhung brgya smra ba dmu dge dpon slobazung chu'i lha ram pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyes sngar nasabaskul ba'i thog nye char mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug bstan pa'i gsalabyed sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog dam chosayar 'phel nasanan gyi4bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral la sug bris subagyis pa las shog bur 'bebs pa po ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /533

༄ / /gung bangabastanaba'irna ce' gas 'gyam/༄༅/ / rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi cho ga'i zur 'debs bdud rtsi'i zil mngar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / na mo gu ru usmi ṣa bi dza ya ye/ 'dir gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i stong mchod byed tshul gyi cho ga'i gzhung rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa de nyid shin tu gsal zhing phun sum tshogs par 'dug pas/ cung zad kha bskangs te lag tu len tshul gye zur 'debs mdo tsam brjod pa la/ nyin snga mar rten dgram zhing mchod gtor 'phan gdugs dar gye lda ldi sogs bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ nangs par lag ris mthong tsam la sgrub pa po rnams 'tshogs te chos gos gyon zhing gding ba'i steng nas phyag gsum btsal te bzhugs/ dbu mdzad kyis mgo bskul nas sangs rgyas chos tshogs mas skyabs 'gro dang / tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang ste maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bla ma rang gis sngar rten gyi drung du gso spyong blangs yod pas sgrub pa po rnams la kun slong 'chos tshul dang bcas theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa phog slob ma la 'bog tshe/ ji ltar sngon gyi zhes pa'i gong der/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes pa dang / 'bog chog lan gsum gyi mjug tu thabs lags bya dgos/ de nas bslab pa brjod pa'i tshig la rjes zlos lan gcig bya/ tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs lan gsum rjes zlos dang lhag ma mnyam 'don byas te nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims zhes sogs kyis smon lam bya/ de nas gral la 'khod/ /bdag dang 'gro ba zhes sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems skyed gzhung bzhin 534

༄/ /rnam rgyalastongamachod kyicho ga'izur 'debs bdud rtsi/bya/ long skabs dal ba'i tshe dkyus kyi skyabs 'gro'i gong der skyabs 'gro rgyas pa dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod tshogs/ bla ma'i zhabs brtan sogs sngon du gtong / de nas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /a bha ya dang dar pan mi tra sogs/ / spyi yi smin grol gdams pa'i bka' bab kyi/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / bstan 'dzin skyes bu bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ / dpag yas tshe dang ye shes mchog thob ste/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / dze tā'i dang rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ / ba ri pa dang sa chen yab sras sogs/ / sgos kyi smin grol gdams pa'i bka' bab kyi/ / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / bstan 'dzin skyes bu bsten pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ / dpag yas tshe dang ye shes mchog thob ste/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyes rlobs/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras dang / / rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po sogs/ / gdams pa'i chu rgyun gcig tu 'dres pa yi/ / drin can bla ma rnamasal gsol ba 'debs/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ / dpag yas tshe dang ye shes mchog thob ste/ / don gnyis lhun gyes grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang gi mtshan tsam yid la dran pas kyang / / mthar byed 'tshe ba'i g.yul ngo las rgyal te/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol pa/ / rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / bstan 'dzin skyes bu bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ / dpag yas tshe dang ye shes mchog thob ste/ / don gnyis lhun gyes grub par byin gyes rlobs/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha tshogs dbyer med pa'i/ / thugs rje'i 'od kyis rgud mun drungs phyung ste/ / phan bde pad+ma dkar po'i tshal phye nas/ / nges 535

ra / /gung thang bstanapa'asgronasa'i gsung 'bum/ṭ+wāṃ /rdo ṭ+wāṃ/ hūṃX dī/ dihūṃdīhūṃs baṭ+wāṃni ṭ+wāṃ/ cho ga/༵ rdozloṭ+wāṃ dī rnordoṭ+wāṃs dīnarmi baṭ+wāṃṭ+wā sems can don kun mdzad/ / cesasog4kyi 'phror/ badz+ra mu ma shes pa rang bzhin gye gnas su gshegs/ rang nyid dam tshig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gnas par gyur/ ceyobarjod/ de nasacho ga'i gzhung ltar chu gnyiyonyer spyod rol mo 'phan gdug4lda ldi sogagabasangs sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed bsgrubs te bzlasamatshams kyi/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ cesabarjod pa'i mthar sgrub pa po rnamasabazhengs te rten gye drung du thal mo sbyar nasadabu 'dud pa dang bcas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa zhes sogs gzung ring gi dbu bskul te gzungs ring tshar re skor ba re dang sprags ma byas pa'i mjug tu mchod bstod bsdusapa re bya/ de bzhin du sngagasadang skor ba gsum pa'i mjug tu phyag gsum re btsal te thams cad sa la bzhugasanasamachod bstod bsdusapa bya/ de ltar sum tshan ji tsam re dgoyopa grub nasaskor ba rje4ma'i mjug tu phyag gsum btsal te thamasacad gral la 'khod nas mchod bstod bya/ thun rjesam rnams kyi tshe sa bon las skyed mi dgos pas/ de dag gi tshe skad cig dkrong skyed dang stong sbyang byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyel 'khor gyi steng du rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rin po che las grub 'i sa 'dzin gyi steng du them skas dang bcas pa'i khri la sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten bang rim blum po gsum pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bum rten dang bcas pa'i bum pa blum po sgo dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du bre gdugs rim pa bcu gsum char kheb tog rnams brtsegs shing me tog gi phreng ba dang dar gyi lda ldis mdzes 536

༄/ /rnam rgyalasangamachod kyi choga'izur 'debasabadud rtsi/par byas pa/ de lta bu'i bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma/ zhesasbrel zhingagazhan rnams dkyusabazhin bya/ thun rjes ma'i dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi mjug tu/ sku khrus gsol bar zhu/ zhes pa nas/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par shog / cesapa'i bar dang / de nayomachod pa byin gyis brlabasate mchod 'phreng cho ga'i dkyus bzhin bya/ mjug tu/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ / zhes sogs bya zhing maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma dbul/ bstod pa man chad sngar bzhin no/ /gtor snod bcu'i nang du gtor ril bcu bcu chu dang sbyar nas bshams thebs re la byin rlabs byas te/ dang po'i tshe gtor mgron spyan 'dren dang phyi ma rnams la mgron spyan 'dren mi dgos/ phyag byar 'os pa zhe4sogs man chad dkyus bzhin la bsngo tshul sgrub pa po'i grangs kyis tshar stong 'gro nges byed/ cha gsum kyi skabs/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gtor ma'i mgron du mchis par gyur/ ceyotshig skyur/ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ cesapa'i mtshams subazhag ste yi dwags gtor ma mi dgos/ long skabs shin tu dal ba'i tshe zhog ka bdag skyed skabs bzlasapa gang mang byasate bdag mdun gyi mtshams su grol chung dang / thun dang po'i mdun bskyed 'phror yang spyan 'dren khrus gsol rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang / thun gang rigs la bstod pa rgyas pa byed pa sogs long skabs dang sbyar/gtang rag gi mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnamasagrub rjesasmon lam bya ba ni/ /bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs la/ / mchod bstod bzlas pa phyag dang skor pa sogs/ / rgyud don ji bzhin bgyis pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /537

༄/ /yo bamab mo tsha la /'gro kun 'phags mas rjes 'dzin rgyu ru bsngo/ /sngon tshe shin tu brtan pa zhes bya'i lha/ / gang gi thugs rjes 'chi bdag las grol bzhin/ / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mtha' dag kyang / / dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul las rgyal gyur cig / nad rims gdon bgegs nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / tshe dpal bsod nams legs tshogs rgyas pa dang / / dmu rgod dbang drag thabs kyis 'dul ba sogs/ / las bzhi'i 'azin las lhun gyis grub par shog /thub pa'i spyan sngar g.yar dam bcas pa bzhin/ / lha yi dbang po 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi/ /khyad par lha chen chos kye rgyal po yis/ /g.yel bamed par rtag tu grogs byed shog / mdor na bla ma lha tshogs dbyer med pas/ /thugs rje'e phyag gis nam yang mi gtong zhing / / mtshan bcas mtshan med lam bzang nyer bgrod nas/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /yig brgyasalhag chad bskang4shing rten la brtan bzhugs sogasadakyus bzhinakhyas te shiyopa brjod pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /a bha ya dang dar pan mi tra sogs/ / spyi yi smin grol gdams pa'i bka' bab kyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dze tā ri dang rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ /ba ri pa dang sa chen yab sras sogs/ /sgos kyi smin grol gdams pa'i bka' bab kyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog / blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras dang / /rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po sogs/ /gdams pa'i chu rgyun gcig tu 'dres pa yi/ / drin can bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che/ /gnas gcig lha yi bu dang bcas pa yi /rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rgyud 'di gang gis 'dzin par byed pa rnams/ /skyong bar zhal bzhes lha dbang rgyal chen bzhi/ /khyad par 538

༄/ /rnam rgyalastongamachodakyicho ga'izur 'debasabadudaci/lha chen chos kyi rgyal po sogs/ / dam can srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / bstan 'dzin skyes bu bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ / dpag yas tshe dang ye shes mchog thob ste/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog / bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ / snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ / tshe ring nadamed gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ / yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog / cesabarjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo/ / zhes pa 'di ni lhag bsam rnam dpyod mchog tu dge ba chos rje yoshesadar rgyasakyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabrisapa'o/ /bkra shisashog /539

gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/dpar sgrig dpe skrun mi sna/blo 'dri sa/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/gling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gung thang thub bstan/bsod nams rgya mtsho/gtso sgrig pa/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ 'jam dga'/spyi khubajus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/rtsom sgrig khongasami/ mgon po dar rgyas/ phur kho/ rta mgrin rdo rje/'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ pan de mkhar/ting 'dzin bkra shis/ rta rdo/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ ting 'dzin bkra shis/

dkon mchogakunadangosathajigs medarabangaba'iris/ /bshad babastanaba'ibadagabaradabarabaskur bzhin/ /lung rtogasanya mazung githon meyis/ /byedagu'i mongs munasel babadi rmadabyungaka /zhesadabal mngapanitas mdzad pa'i chigs bcad kyis mdun bsus te mkhasagrubayongs kyi gartsog rgyan rje btsun dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum dpe spun byed par mthun rkyen spyar mkhan ya ri'i zam pa'i thebs mtshogasaparabugasarje chetha/ 4 7khri

spyi khyab jus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/thu ma ོ ོ mazhu chen pa/ dbus skyabs/ṣ+ṭha ngo yo zartsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ ting 'dzin bkra shi /zopo tsho zoskamapomadzes cha jus 'god pa/ garma rdo rje tshe ring /zamashā po zo za༄tsho/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(tagung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes brtsams/ mi rigasadape skrun khang gisabaskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/pocin ho ping li byang layo.ang 4pa/sbrag yang 0003kha par abagrangs5830ma pocin kreng ta'o parakhang nasapar btab/2)bolo'i zla 5par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs2ma lo'i zla 5par pocin du par theng4dbapo brgyab/debar 8༅77ma 4thal 72dpar shog 7 25dpar grangasas —2ma deb rer sgor 35ga
